Q108499.about: San Joaquin County (  SAN whah-KEEN; Spanish: San Joaquín, meaning "St. Joachim"), officially the County of San Joaquin, is a county in the U.S. state of California.

Q108503.name: Stanislaus County
Q108503.about: Stanislaus County (  STAN-iss-law(ss); Spanish: Condado de Estanislao) is a county located in the San Joaquin Valley of the U.S. state of California. As of 2025, its estimated population  is 557,719.

Q1010240.name: Valdosta
Q1010240.desc: county seat of Lowndes County, Georgia, United States
Q1010240.about: Valdosta is a city in and the county seat of Lowndes County in the U.S. state of Georgia. As the principal city of the Valdosta metropolitan statistical area, which in 2023 had a metropolitan population of 151,118, according to the US Census Bureau its metropolitan area includes Brooks County to the west.

Q1010360.name: Dearborn Heights
Q1010360.desc: city in Wayne County, Michigan, USA
Q1010360.about: Dearborn Heights is a city in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. An inner-ring suburb of Detroit, Dearborn Heights is located about 12 miles (19 km) west of downtown Detroit.

Q1010595.name: Lehi
Q1010595.desc: city in Utah County, Utah, United States
Q1010595.about: Lehi ( LEE-hy) is a city in Utah County, Utah, United States.  The population was 75,907 at the 2020 census, up from 47,407 in 2010, and it is the center of population of Utah.

Q1011138.name: Yiwu
Q1011138.about: Yiwu is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Jinhua, in central Zhejiang province, China. It is best known for hosting the Yiwu International Trade City, the world's largest wholesale market for small commodities.

Q108871.name: Butler County
Q108871.about: Butler County is a county located in the south central portion of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 19,051.

Q108952.name: Comanche County
Q108952.about: Comanche County is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in Central Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 13,594.

Q108957.name: Crockett County
Q108957.about: Crockett County is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 3,098.

Q108962.name: Dickens County
Q108962.about: Dickens County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,770.

Q109079.name: Kaesong
Q109079.about: Kaesong (UK: , US: ; Korean: [kɛ.sɔŋ]) is a special city in the southern part of North Korea (formerly in North Hwanghae Province), and the capital of Korea during the Taebong kingdom and subsequent Goryeo dynasty. The city is near the Kaesong Industrial Region close to the border with South Korea and contains the remains of the Manwoldae palace.

Q109150.name: Cass County
Q109150.about: Cass County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 28,454.

Q109155.name: Carson County
Q109155.about: Carson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 5,807.

Q109160.name: Brewster County
Q109160.about: Brewster County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. It is in West Texas and its county seat (and only city) is Alpine.

Q109165.name: Briscoe County
Q109165.about: Briscoe County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,435.

Q109170.name: Brown County
Q109170.about: Brown County is a county in central Texas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 38,095.

Q109204.name: Comal County
Q109204.about: Comal County ( KOH-mal) is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 161,501.

Q109209.name: Loving County
Q109209.about: Loving County is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. With a population of 64 according to the 2020 census, it is the least populous county in the United States with a permanent population.

Q1061069.name: Metro Vancouver Regional District
Q1061069.desc: regional district of British Columbia, Canada
Q1061069.about: The Metro Vancouver Regional District (MVRD), or simply Metro Vancouver, is a Canadian political subdivision and corporate entity representing the metropolitan area of Greater Vancouver, designated by provincial legislation as one of the 28 regional districts in British Columbia. The organization was known as the Regional District of Fraser–Burrard for nearly one year upon incorporating in 1967, and as the Greater Vancouver Regional District (GVRD) from 1968 to 2017.

Q1062186.name: Changyi
Q1062186.desc: county-level city in Weifang, Shandong, China
Q1062186.about: Changyi (Chinese: 昌邑; pinyin: Chāngyì) is a county-level city of Weifang, Shandong province, People's Republic of China. The city is 1627.5 square kilometers in area, with a household population of 581,000 as of 2010.

Q1066730.name: Charlevoix-Est
Q1066730.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1066730.about: Charlevoix-Est (French pronunciation: [ʃaʁləvwa ɛst]) is a regional county municipality in the Capitale-Nationale region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is Clermont.

Q1067162.name: Charlotte County
Q1067162.about:
Charlotte County (2021 population 26,015) is the most southwestern county of New Brunswick, Canada.
It was formed in 1784 when New Brunswick was partitioned from Nova Scotia and named for Queen Charlotte.

Q1069687.name: East Harlem
Q1069687.desc: neighborhood of Upper Manhattan, New York City, New York, United States
Q1069687.about: East Harlem, also known as Spanish Harlem or El Barrio, and formerly Italian Harlem, is a neighborhood of Upper Manhattan in New York City, north of the Upper East Side and bounded by 96th Street to the south, Fifth Avenue to the west, and the East and Harlem Rivers to the east and north. Despite its name, it is generally not considered to be a part of Harlem proper, but it is one of the neighborhoods included in Greater Harlem.

Q1073644.name: Chinatown
Q1073644.desc: neighborhood in San Francisco, California, United States
Q1073644.about: The Chinatown, centered on Grant Avenue and Stockton Street in San Francisco, California, is the oldest Chinatown in North America and is one of the largest Chinese enclaves outside Asia. It is also the oldest and largest of the four notable Chinese enclaves within San Francisco.

Q1085274.name: Meridian
Q1085274.desc: city in Ada County, Idaho, United States
Q1085274.about: Meridian is a city located in Ada County, Idaho, United States. The population was 117,635 at the 2020 census, making it the second most populous city in the county and Idaho, after Boise, the state capital.

Q1086276.name: Irvington
Q1086276.desc: township in Essex County, New Jersey, United States
Q1086276.about: Irvington is a township in Essex County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the township's population was 61,176, an increase of 7,250 (+13.4%) from the 2010 census count of 53,926, which in turn reflected a decline of 6,769 (−11.2%) from the 60,695 counted in the 2000 census.

Q1090087.name: Chuxiong City
Q1090087.desc: county-level city in Chuxiong, Yunnan, China
Q1090087.about:
Chuxiong City (Chinese: 楚雄市; pinyin: Chǔxióng Shì; Chuxiong Yi Script: , IPA: /ɣo21 lu21 lu21/) is a county-level city and the capital of the Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Prefecture, in Central Yunnan Province, China.

Chuxiong City borders Lufeng to the east, Shuangbai County to the south, Nanhua County and Jingdong County to the west, and Mouding County to the north.

Q10832464.name: Venustiano Carranza
Q10832464.about: Venustiano Carranza is a borough (demarcación territorial) in Mexico City, Mexico. Venustiano Carranza extends from the far eastern portion of the historic center of Mexico City eastward to the Peñón de los Baños and the border dividing the then Federal District from the State of Mexico.

Q10870671.name: Donghai Subdistrict
Q10870671.about: Donghai Subdistrict (simplified Chinese: 东海街道; traditional Chinese: 東海街道; pinyin: Dōnghǎi Jiēdào) is a subdistrict in Lufeng, Guangdong, China.

Q10893880.name: Guankou
Q10893880.desc: Subdistrict in Liuyang City, Changsha City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China
Q10893880.about: Guankou Subdistrict (simplified Chinese: 关口街道; traditional Chinese: 關口街道; pinyin: Guānkǒu Jiēdào) is an urban subdistrict and the seat of Liuyang City, Hunan Province, China. As of the 2015 census it had a population of 50,400 and an area of 161.8 square kilometres (62.5 sq mi).

Q10928810.name: Tanzhou Town
Q10928810.about: Tanzhou is a town situated at the southern extremity of the prefecture-level city of Zhongshan, Guangdong province.  At the 2020 census, the population of Tanzhou was 382,445.

Q10931810.name: Eye and ENT Hospital of Fudan University
Q10931810.wiki: Eye and ENT Hospital of Fudan University
Q10931810.about: The Eye, Ear, Nose and Throat (Eye and ENT) Hospital of Fudan University (Chinese: 复旦大学附属眼耳鼻喉科医院), formerly the Shanghai Jewish Hospital (also B'nai B'rith Foundation Polyclinic), is a teaching hospital in Shanghai, China, affiliated with the Shanghai Medical College of Fudan University and the Red Cross Society of Shanghai. It is rated Grade 3, Class A, the highest rating in the Chinese medical system.

Q105339619.name: Middletown Village
Q105339619.desc: unincorporated community in Middletown Township, New Jersey
Q105339619.about: Middletown Village is an unincorporated community located in the central part of Middletown Township, Monmouth County, New Jersey. It was the first settlement in the township and one of the oldest in New Jersey.

Q10126.name: Serang
Q10126.about: Serang (Indonesian: Kota Serang, Indonesian pronunciation: ['seraŋ], Javanese: ꦱꦺꦫꦁ; Sundanese: ᮞᮦᮛᮀ) is a city and the capital of Banten province and was formerly also the administrative center of Serang Regency in Indonesia (the Regency's capital is now at Ciruas). The city is located towards the north of Banten province, on the island of Java; the north part of the city (Kasemen District) contains the coast zone facing onto Banten Bay, and includes the historical site of Old Banten, after which the province is named.

Q10127.name: Tangerang
Q10127.about: Tangerang (Indonesian pronunciation: [ˈt̪aŋəɾaŋ] ) is the city with the largest population in the province of Banten, Indonesia. Located on the western border of Jakarta and bordered with South Tangerang city, Tangerang is the sixth largest city proper in the nation (excluding Jakarta, which is classed as a province containing five administrative cities and one regency).

Q10128.name: South Tangerang
Q10128.about: South Tangerang (Indonesian: Tangerang Selatan, Sundanese: ᮓᮚᮩᮂ ᮒᮍᮨᮛᮀ ᮊᮤᮓᮥᮜ᮪, romanized: Dayeuh Tangerang Kidul)  abbreviated as Tangsel, is a city in the province of Banten, Indonesia. Located 30 km (19 mi) on the southwestern border of Jakarta, the city forms part of the Greater Jakarta metropolitan area.

Q10392.name: Bekasi
Q10392.desc: city in West Java Province, Indonesia
Q10392.about: Bekasi (Indonesian pronunciation: [bəˈkasi] ) is the largest city in the province of West Java and the third-largest city in Indonesia. Located on the eastern border of Jakarta, it serves as a commuter city within the Jakarta metropolitan area.

Q10393.name: Bogor
Q10393.desc: city in West Java Province, Indonesia
Q10393.about: Bogor (Sundanese: ᮘᮧᮌᮧᮁ; Dutch: Buitenzorg) is a landlocked city in West Java, Indonesia. Located around 53 kilometers (33 mi) south of the national capital of Jakarta, it is the 6th largest city in the Jakarta metropolitan area and the 14th overall nationwide.

Q10395.name: Cirebon
Q10395.desc: city in West Java Province, Indonesia
Q10395.about: Cirebon (Indonesian pronunciation: [t͡ʃirə'bɔn] , formerly rendered Cheribon or Chirebon in English) is a port city on the northern coast of the Indonesian island of Java. It is the only coastal city of West Java, located about 40 km west of the provincial border with Central Java, approximately 297 km (185 mi) east of Jakarta, at 6°43′S 108°34′E. It had a population of 296,389 at the 2010 census and 333,303 at the 2020 census; the official estimate as of mid 2025 was 347,537 (comprising 174,364 males and 173,173 females).

Q10396.name: Depok
Q10396.desc: city in West Java Province, Indonesia
Q10396.about: Depok is a landlocked city in West Java province. It is located directly south of Jakarta, and it is the third largest urban center in the Greater Jakarta metropolitan area after Jakarta and Bekasi, covering an area of about 199.91 km2.

Q10397.name: Sukabumi
Q10397.desc: city in West Java Province, Indonesia
Q10397.about:
Sukabumi (Sundanese: ᮞᮥᮊᮘᮥᮙᮤ) is a landlocked city surrounded by the regency of the same name (within which it is an enclave) in the southern foothills of Mount Gede, in West Java, Indonesia, about 100 km (62 mi) south of the national capital, Jakarta.
At an altitude of approximately 584 m (1,916 ft), the city is a minor hill station resort, with a cooler climate than the surrounding lowlands.

Q10399.name: Tasikmalaya
Q10399.about: Tasikmalaya (also known as Tasik) is a landlocked city in West Java, Indonesia. The city is sometimes dubbed kota santri (city of religious learners) or "the City of a Thousand Pesantrens" for its abundance of Islamic boarding schools.

Q10566.name: Saskatoon
Q10566.about: Saskatoon () is the largest city in the Canadian province of Saskatchewan. It straddles a bend in the South Saskatchewan River in the central region of the province.

Q10686.name: Belfast
Q10686.about: Belfast (  BEL-fast, , -⁠fahst; from Irish: Béal Feirste [bʲeːlˠ ˈfʲɛɾˠ(ə)ʃtʲə]) is the capital, largest city and main port of Northern Ireland. It stands on the banks of the river Lagan, and is connected to the open sea through Belfast Lough and the North Channel.

Q108520.name: Baylor County
Q108520.about: Baylor County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 3,465.

Q108534.name: Andrews County
Q108534.about: Andrews County is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. It is in West Texas and its county seat is Andrews.

Q1011205.name: Turlock
Q1011205.desc: city in Stanislaus County, California, United States
Q1011205.about: Turlock is a city in Stanislaus County, California, United States. Its population was 72,740 at the 2020 United States census, making it the second-largest city in Stanislaus County after Modesto.

Q1012089.name: Leesburg
Q1012089.desc: historic town within and the county seat of Loudoun County, Virginia, United States
Q1012089.about: Leesburg is a town in and the county seat of Loudoun County, Virginia, United States. It is part of both the Northern Virginia region of the state and the Washington metropolitan area, including Washington, D.C., the nation's capital.

Q1012122.name: Carol City
Q1012122.desc: neighborhood in Miami Gardens, Florida, United States
Q1012122.about: Carol City is a neighborhood in Miami Gardens, Florida, United States. It was formerly listed as a census-designated place in the 2000 U.S. census.

Q1012388.name: Hoffman Estates
Q1012388.desc: northwestern suburb of Chicago in Illinois, United States
Q1012388.about: Hoffman Estates is a village mostly in Cook County, Illinois, United States with a very small portion in Kane County, Illinois. It is a suburb of Chicago.
Q1012388.img: Sunderlage Farm Smokehouse - Farmhouse (Hoffman Estates, IL) 03.JPG

Q1012706.name: Rourkela
Q1012706.about: Rourkela (Odia: [ɾauɾɔkela] ) officially Raurkela is a planned city located in the northern district Sundargarh of Odisha, India. It is a Tier-2 city and the third-largest city in Odisha after Bhubaneswar and Cuttack.

Q1013520.name: Orland Park
Q1013520.desc: village in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q1013520.about: Orland Park is a village in Cook County, Illinois, United States, with a small portion in Will County. It is a south suburb of Chicago.

Q109215.name: Orange County
Q109215.about: Orange County is a county located in the very southeastern corner of the U.S. state of Texas, sharing a boundary with Louisiana, within the Golden Triangle of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 84,808.

Q109265.name: Denton County
Q109265.about: Denton County is a county located in the northern portion of the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 906,422, making it the seventh-most populous county in Texas.

Q10704.name: Tórshavn
Q10704.about: Tórshavn (Faroese: [ˈtʰɔu̯ʂhau̯n] ; lit. 'Thor's harbour'; Danish: Thorshavn), locally referred to as Havn, is the capital and largest city of the Faroe Islands. It is located in the southern part on the east coast of Streymoy.

Q10717.name: Georgetown
Q10717.about: Georgetown is the capital and largest city of Guyana. It is situated in Demerara-Mahaica, region 4, on the Atlantic Ocean coast, at the mouth of the Demerara River.

Q108607.name: Culberson County
Q108607.about: Culberson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 2,188.

Q108612.name: Bowie County
Q108612.about: Bowie County ( BOO-ee) is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. Its legal county seat is Boston, though its courthouse is located in New Boston.

Q108618.name: Orange County
Q108618.desc: county in New York, United States
Q108618.about: Orange County is a county located in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 401,310.

Q108626.name: Big Horn County
Q108626.desc: county in northern Wyoming, United States
Q108626.about: Big Horn County is a county in the U.S. state of Wyoming. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 11,521.

Q108784.name: Burnet County
Q108784.about: Burnet County ( BUR-nit) is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 49,130.

Q108788.name: Adams County
Q108788.about: Adams County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 29,538.
Q108788.img: Adams County Courthouse, Natchez, MS IMG 6982.JPG

Q108793.name: Archer County
Q108793.about: Archer County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 8,560.

Q108798.name: Adams County
Q108798.about: Adams County is the westernmost county in the U.S. state of Illinois. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 65,737.

Q108803.name: Hall County
Q108803.about: Hall County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, the population is 2,825.

Q108821.name: Burleson County
Q108821.about: Burleson County ( BUR-liss-ən) is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 17,642.

Q1022954.name: St. Clair Shores
Q1022954.desc: city in Macomb County, Michigan, United States
Q1022954.about: St. Clair Shores is a city in Macomb County in the U.S. state of Michigan.

Q1023703.name: Oyo
Q1023703.about: Oyo is a city in Oyo State, Nigeria. It was founded as the capital of the remnant of the historic Oyo empire in the 1830s, and is known to its people as 'New Oyo' (Ọ̀yọ́ Àtìbà) to distinguish it from the former capital to the north, 'Old Oyo' (Ọ̀yọ́-Ilé), which had been deserted as a result of the Yoruba Civil Wars.
Q1023703.img: Random images at Photowalk at Ogun and Oyo states 06.jpg

Q1023726.name: Ijebu Ode
Q1023726.about: Ijebu-Ode () is a city and Local government area in Ogun State, South West Nigeria, close to the A121 highway. The city is located 110 km by road northeast of Lagos; it is within 100 km (62 mi) of the Atlantic Ocean in the eastern part of Ogun State and possesses a warm tropical climate.

Q1028279.name: Cambridge
Q1028279.desc: city in the Regional Municipality of Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
Q1028279.about: Cambridge is a city in the Regional Municipality of Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, located at the confluence of the Grand and Speed rivers, in the central part of the Ontario Peninsula. The city had a population of 138,479 as of the 2021 census.

Q10690.name: Cardiff
Q10690.desc: capital city of Wales, United Kingdom
Q10690.about: Cardiff is the capital and largest city of Wales. Cardiff had a population of 381,516 in 2025 and forms a principal area officially known as the City and County of Cardiff (Welsh: Dinas a Sir Caerdydd).

Q1014420.name: Wuchang District
Q1014420.desc: district of Wuhan in Hubei Province, China
Q1014420.about: Wuchang is one of 13 urban districts of the prefecture-level city of Wuhan, the capital of Hubei Province, China. It is the oldest of the three cities that merged into modern-day Wuhan, and stood on the right (southeastern) bank of the Yangtze River, opposite the mouth of the Han River.
Q1014420.img: 从黄鹤楼上看武汉长江大桥 - panoramio.jpg

Q1014957.name: Tumebamba
Q1014957.about: Tumebamba, Tomebamba (hispanicized spellings), or Tumipampa (Kichwa for "Knife Field", Tumi: Knife, Pampa: Field) was a main regional city in the Inca Empire. Tumebamba was chosen by the Emperor Huayna Capac (ruled 1493–1525) to be the Inca northern capital.

Q1015132.name: Danzhou
Q1015132.desc: city in the northwest of the Chinese island province of Hainan
Q1015132.about: Danzhou (Chinese: 儋州; pinyin: Dānzhōu) is a prefecture-level city in the northwest of the Chinese island province of Hainan. The administrative seat and urban center of Danzhou is Nada Town.
Q1015132.img: 海南国际旅游岛——洋浦大桥上俯视洋浦港码头（西北向） - panoramio (1).jpg

Q1015631.name: Welkom
Q1015631.about: Welkom (Afrikaans pronunciation: [ˈvɛlkɔm]) is a city in the Free State province of South Africa, located about 140 kilometres (90 mi) northeast of Bloemfontein, the provincial capital. Welkom is also known as Circle City, City Within A Garden, Mvela and Matjhabeng.

Q1015654.name: Santo Domingo
Q1015654.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas Province
Q1015654.about: Santo Domingo de los Colorados, often simply referred to as Santo Domingo (Quechua: Tsachila), is an Ecuadorian city and seat of the canton that bears its name and the Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas Province. It is the fourth most populous city in Ecuador, with a population of 334,826, and is an important commercial and industrial center.

Q1015823.name: Jiangyin
Q1015823.about: Jiangyin (simplified Chinese: 江阴; traditional Chinese: 江陰; pinyin: Jiāngyīn; Wade–Giles: Chiangyin, Jiangyin dialect: [kɐ̞ŋ.jɪŋ]) is a county-level city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River. It is administered by the prefecture-level city of Wuxi, Jiangsu province.
Q1015823.img: 望江楼眺望江阴市区 2017冬.jpg

Q1015874.name: Sherman Oaks
Q1015874.desc: neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles, California, United States
Q1015874.about: Sherman Oaks is a neighborhood in the city of Los Angeles. Located within the San Fernando Valley region, the neighborhood includes a portion of the Santa Monica Mountains.

Q1016633.name: Burlington
Q1016633.desc: city in Alamance and Guilford counties, North Carolina, United States
Q1016633.about: Burlington is a city in predominantly Alamance County (with western outskirts of the city in Guilford County) in the U.S. state of North Carolina. The city is located in the Piedmont Triad, where it is the principal city of the Burlington, NC Metropolitan Statistical Area, located directly east of the Greensboro-High Point Metropolitan Area.

Q1017594.name: Merlo
Q1017594.desc: city in the province of Buenos Aires in Argentina
Q1017594.about:
Merlo is the head city of the eponymous partido of Merlo and seat of the municipal government, located in the Greater Buenos Aires urban area of Buenos Aires Province, Argentina.
The city was founded by Francisco de Merlo in 1755 and rebuilt by Juan Dillon in 1859.

Q1017637.name: Nawabshah
Q1017637.about: Nawabshah is a city and also the headquarter of Nawabshah Tehsil in Shaheed Benazirabad District of Sindh province, Pakistan. This city is situated in the middle of Sindh province.

Q1017651.name: Chiniot
Q1017651.about: Chiniot (Punjabi / Urdu: چنیوٹ; Punjabi: [t͡ʃɐ.nĕ.joːʈᵊ]; Urdu: [ˈt͡ʃɪ.ni.joːʈ]) is a city and the administrative headquarters of Chiniot District in the province of Punjab, Pakistan. Located on the bank of the river Chenab, it is the 28th most populous city in the country.
Q1017651.img: Chiniot seen from Omar Hayat Mahal.jpg

Q1017715.name: Sadr City
Q1017715.desc: suburb district of the city of Baghdad, Iraq
Q1017715.about: Sadr City (Arabic: مدينة الصدر, romanized: Madīnat aṣ-Ṣadr), formerly known as Al-Thawra (Arabic: الثورة, romanized: aṯ-Ṯawra) and Saddam City (Arabic: مدينة صدام, romanized: Madīnat Ṣaddām), is a suburb district of the city of Baghdad, Iraq. It was built in 1959 by Prime Minister Abdul Karim Qassim and named Al-Rafidain District.

Q1018693.name: Pasir Gudang
Q1018693.desc: city in Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
Q1018693.about: Pasir Gudang is a city located in eastern Johor Bahru District, Johor, which is the second largest district in Malaysia by population. The main industries are transportation and logistics, shipbuilding, petrochemicals and other heavy industries, and oil palm storage and distribution, which is located in Johor Port and Tanjung Langsat.

Q1019386.name: Bécancour
Q1019386.desc: regional county municipality of Centre-du-Québec, Quebec, Canada
Q1019386.about: Bécancour (French pronunciation: [bekɑ̃kuʁ]) is a regional county municipality in the Centre-du-Québec region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Bécancour.

Q1019424.name: Rufisque
Q1019424.about: Rufisque (Arabic: روفيسك; Wolof: Tëngeéj) is a city in the Dakar region of western Senegal, at the base of the Cap-Vert Peninsula 25 kilometres (16 mi) east of Dakar, the capital. It has a population of 295,459 (2023 census).

Q1019431.name: M'Bour
Q1019431.about: M'Bour or Mbour (Arabic: مبور; Wolof: Mbuur), is a city in the Thiès Region of Senegal. It lies on the Petite Côte, approximately 80 kilometres (50 mi) south of Dakar.

Q1020159.name: Etobicoke
Q1020159.about: Etobicoke ( , eh-TOH-bik-oh) is an administrative district and former city within Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Q128244.name: Waco

Q128244.about: Waco ( WAY-koh) is a city in and the county seat of McLennan County, Texas, United States. It is situated along the Brazos River and I-35, halfway between Dallas and Austin.

Q128261.name: Carrollton
Q128261.desc: city in Denton, Dallas, and Collin counties in Texas, United States
Q128261.about: Carrollton is a city in Dallas, Denton, and Collin counties in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 133,434, making it the 27th-most populous city in Texas.

Q128269.name: Frisco
Q128269.desc: city in Collin and Denton counties in Texas, United States
Q128269.about: Frisco is a city in Collin and Denton counties in the U.S. state of Texas. It is part of the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex (DFW) and about 25 miles (40 km) from both Dallas Love Field and Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport.
Q128269.img: Frisco June 2019 05 (George A. Purefoy Municipal Center and Frisco Square).jpg

Q128282.name: Beaumont
Q128282.desc: city and county seat of Jefferson County, State of Texas, United States
Q128282.about: Beaumont is a city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the county seat of Jefferson County, within the Beaumont–Port Arthur metropolitan area, located in Southeast Texas on the Neches River about 85 miles (137 km) east of Houston (city center to city center).

Q128295.name: Abilene
Q128295.desc: city in Taylor and Jones counties in Texas, United States, that is the county seat of Taylor County
Q128295.about: Abilene ( AB-i-leen) is a city in Taylor and Jones counties, Texas, United States. Its population was 125,182 at the 2020 census.

Q128306.name: Denton
Q128306.desc: city in and the county seat of Denton County, Texas, United States
Q128306.about: Denton is a city in the U.S. state of Texas and the county seat of Denton County. With a population of 139,869 as of 2020, it is the 20th-most populous city in Texas, the 177th-most populous city in the United States, and the 10th-most populous city in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.

Q128321.name: Midland
Q128321.desc: city in and county seat of Midland County, Texas, United States
Q128321.about: Midland is a city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the county seat of Midland County in West Texas, with small portions extending into Martin County.

Q128334.name: Round Rock
Q128334.desc: city in Travis and Williamson counties in Texas, United States
Q128334.about: Round Rock is a city in Williamson and Travis counties in the U.S. state of Texas. The population was 119,468 at the 2020 census.

Q11506.name: Denpasar
Q11506.about:
Denpasar (Indonesian pronunciation: [denˈpasar]; Balinese: ᬤᬾᬦ᭄ᬧᬲᬃ, Dénpasar) is the capital and the largest city of the province of Bali, Indonesia.
Denpasar is the largest city in the Lesser Sunda Islands and the second largest city in Eastern Indonesia after Makassar.
Q11506.img: Aerial view of Bajra Sandhi Monument Denpasar Bali Indonesia.jpg

Q11720.name: Shenyang
Q11720.desc: Prefecture-level and sub-provincial city in Liaoning, China
Q11720.about: Shenyang, formerly known by its Manchu name Mukden, is a sub-provincial city in China and the provincial capital of Liaoning province. It is the province's most populous city with a population of 9,070,093 as of the 2020 census, also making it the largest city in Manchuria by urban population, and the second-largest by metropolitan population (behind Harbin).

Q11739.name: Lahore
Q11739.desc: capital of the Punjab province, Pakistan
Q11739.about: Lahore is the capital and largest city of the Pakistani province of Punjab. It is the second-largest city in Pakistan, after Karachi, and 27th largest in the world, with a population of over 14 million.
Q11739.img: Eye Of Lahore (Minar e Pakistan) evening.jpg

Q115386.name: Des Moines County
Q115386.about: Des Moines County is located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 38,910, and was estimated to be 38,077 in 2025.

Q115396.name: Buchanan County
Q115396.about: Buchanan County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,565.

Q131335.name: Sioux Falls
Q131335.desc: city in and seat of Minnehaha County, and largest city in South Dakota, United States
Q131335.about: Sioux Falls ( soo FAWLZ) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of South Dakota. It is the county seat of Minnehaha County and also extends into northern Lincoln County.

Q131429.name: Oaxaca de Juárez
Q131429.desc: capital of the Mexican state of Oaxaca
Q131429.about: Oaxaca de Juárez (Spanish pronunciation: [waˈxaka ðe ˈxwaɾes]), or simply Oaxaca (Valley Zapotec: Ndua), is the capital and largest city of the eponymous Mexican state of Oaxaca. It is the municipal seat for the surrounding municipality of Oaxaca, the most populous municipality in Oaxaca, and the fourth most densely populated municipality in Oaxaca, only being less densely populated than San Jacinto Amilpas, Santa Lucía del Camino, and Santa Cruz Amilpas.

Q131491.name: Brighton
Q131491.desc: part of Brighton & Hove, East Sussex, England
Q131491.about: Brighton ( , BRY-tən) is a seaside resort in the unitary authority area and city of Brighton and Hove, in East Sussex, England, 47 miles (76 km) south of London. Archaeological evidence of settlement in the area dates back to the Bronze Age, Roman and Anglo-Saxon periods.

Q1297.name: Chicago
Q1297.desc: city and county seat of Cook County, and largest city in State of Illinois, United States of America
Q1297.about: Chicago is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Illinois and in the Midwestern United States. Located on the western shore of Lake Michigan, it is the third-most populous city in the United States and the fifth-most populous city in North America, with a population of 2.74 million at the 2020 census.

Q1335.name: Montevideo
Q1335.desc: capital and largest city of Uruguay
Q1335.about: Montevideo (, US also ; Spanish: [monteβiˈðeo] ) is the capital and largest city of Uruguay. As of the 2023 census, the city proper has a population of 1,287,452, making up about 36.8% of the country's total population, in an area of 201 square kilometers (78 sq mi).

Q11443.name: Kediri
Q11443.desc: city in East Java Province, Indonesia
Q11443.about: Kediri (Javanese: ꦏꦸꦛꦏꦝꦶꦫꦶ, Kutha Kadhiri, Javanese pronunciation: [ku.ʈa kə.d̪i.ri]) is a city, located near the Brantas River in the province of East Java on the island of Java in Indonesia. It covers an area of 67.23 km2 and had a population of 268,950 at the 2010 Census and 286,796 at the 2020 Census; the official estimate as of mid 2025 was 301,815 (comprising 149,851 males and 151,964 females).

Q115323.name: Sumbawanga
Q115323.about: Sumbawanga is a city located in western Tanzania. It is the capital of Rukwa Region and the municipal seat of Sumbawanga Urban District with postcode number 55100 .

Q115324.name: Macon County
Q115324.about: Macon County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 United States census, it had a population of 103,998.

Q115329.name: Camagüey
Q115329.about: Camagüey (Spanish pronunciation: [kamaˈ(ɣ)wej]) is a city and municipality in central Cuba and is the nation's third-largest city with more than 333,000 inhabitants. It is the capital of the Camagüey Province.

Q130009.name: Humphreys County
Q130009.about: Humphreys County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,785.

Q130083.name: Choctaw County
Q130083.about: Choctaw County is a county located in the central part of the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 8,246.

Q130364.name: Singa
Q130364.about: Sinja (Arabic: سنجة) is a town  located in the Sennar State of Sudan at an elevation of 439 meters (1,440 feet) above sea level. The town is situated on the west bank of the Blue Nile at a distance of 360 kilometers (220 miles) to the southeast of the capital, Khartoum, and 60 kilometers from the city of Sennar.

Q130469.name: Mazar-i-Sharif
Q130469.about: Mazar-i-Sharif or Mazar-e-Sharif is a city in northern Afghanistan, serving as the capital and largest city of Balkh Province. It has 12 city districts (nahias) and an estimated population of 568,013 people.
Q130469.img: Nowruz in northern Afghanistan in March 2011.jpg

Q11445.name: Malang
Q11445.desc: city in East Java Province, Indonesia
Q11445.about: Malang (; Javanese: ꦏꦸꦛꦩꦭꦁ, romanized: Kutha Malang, Indonesian: Kota Malang), historically known as Tumapel, is a landlocked city in East Java, Indonesia. It has a history dating back to the age of the Singhasari Kingdom.

Q11462.name: Surabaya
Q11462.desc: city in East Java Province, Indonesia
Q11462.about: Surabaya is the capital and largest city of East Java province and the second-largest city in Indonesia, after Jakarta. Located on the northeastern corner of Java island, on the Madura Strait, it is one of the earliest port cities in Southeast Asia.

Q115332.name: Gallatin County
Q115332.about: Gallatin County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it has a population of 4,946, making it the third-least populous county in Illinois.

Q115337.name: Hamilton County
Q115337.about: Hamilton County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois. As of the 2020 census, its population was 7,993.

Q115344.name: Union County
Q115344.about: Union County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. It was formed in 1870 from Tippah and Pontotoc counties, and in 1874 a portion of Lee County was added.

Q115349.name: Clarke County
Q115349.about: Clarke County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,615.

Q115356.name: Bolivar County
Q115356.about: Bolivar County ( BOL-i-vər) is a county located on the western border of the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 30,985.

Q130514.name: Luxor
Q130514.about: Luxor is a city in Upper Egypt. Luxor had a population of 284,952 in 2023, with an area of 43.0 km2 (16.6 sq mi) and is the capital of the Luxor Governorate.

Q130800.name: Papeete
Q130800.about: Papeete (Tahitian: Papeʻete, pronounced [pa.pe.ʔe.te]) is the capital city of French Polynesia, an overseas collectivity of the French Republic located in the Pacific Ocean. The commune of Papeʻete is located on the island of Tahiti, in the administrative subdivision of the Windward Islands, of which Papeʻete is the administrative capital.

Q131243.name: Oranjestad
Q131243.about:
Oranjestad (UK:  orr-AN-yə-staht, US:  or-AHN-, oh-RAHN-, Dutch: [oːˈrɑɲəstɑt]; literally "Orange City" in Dutch; Papiamento: Playa, lit. 'beach'),  the capital and most populous of Aruba's eight regions, is located on the southwestern coast of the island.
Administratively, the Oranjestad is divided into two regions: East and West.

Q131290.name: Ganja
Q131290.about: Ganja (; Azerbaijani: Gəncə [ɟænˈdʒæ] ) is Azerbaijan's third largest city, with a population of around 335,600. The city has been a historic and cultural center throughout most of its existence.

Q131301.name: Homs
Q131301.about: Homs, known in pre-Islamic times as Emesa, is a city in western Syria and the capital of the Homs Governorate. It is 501 m (1,644 ft) above sea level and is located 162 km (101 mi) north of Damascus.

Q131323.name: Misrata
Q131323.about: Misrata ( miss-RAH-tə; Arabic: مصراتة, romanized: Miṣrāta, Libyan Arabic: Məṣrāta; also spelled Misratah and known by the Italian spelling Misurata, is a city in northwestern Libya located in the Misrata District, situated 187 km (116 mi) to the east of Tripoli on the Mediterranean coast near Cape Misrata. With a population of about 881,000 , it is the third-largest city in Libya, after Tripoli and Benghazi.

Q11746.name: Wuhan
Q11746.desc: capital city of Hubei Province, China
Q11746.about: Wuhan is the capital of Hubei, China. With a population of 13,861,900, it is the most populous city in Hubei and the seventh-most-populous city in China.

Q11751.name: Nagoya
Q11751.desc: capital city of Aichi prefecture, Japan
Q11751.about: Nagoya (名古屋市, Nagoya-shi; [nä́.ɡò̞.jä̀, -ŋò̞.jä̀, nä̀.ɡó̞.jä́.ɕì, -ŋó̞.jä́-] ) is the capital and most populous city of Aichi Prefecture in Japan. It is the largest city in the Chūbu region, the fourth-most populous city in Japan (with a 2025 population of 2.3 million), and the principal city of the Chūkyō metropolitan area, which is itself the third-most populous metropolitan area in Japan (with a population of 10.11 million).

Q118743.name: Tucker County

Q118743.about: Tucker County is a county in the U.S. state of West Virginia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 6,762, making it West Virginia's fourth-least populous county.

Q119219.name: Pimpri-Chinchwad
Q119219.desc: municipality and twin-town in Pune district, Maharashtra, India
Q119219.about: Pimpri-Chinchwad, also known as PCMC, is a city in the Indian state of Maharashtra. The city is about 15 km (9.3 mi) northwest of the historic city of Pune, at an altitude of 590 m (1,940 ft) above sea level.

Q119372.name: Tama County
Q119372.about: Tama County  is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,135.

Q132679.name: Willemstad
Q132679.about: Willemstad ( WIL-əm-staht, VIL-; Dutch: [ˈʋɪləmstɑt]; Papiamento: [wiləmˈstad]) is the capital and largest city of Curaçao, an island in the southern Caribbean Sea that is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It was the capital of the Netherlands Antilles prior to that entity's dissolution in 2010.

Q132732.name: Bratsk
Q132732.about: Bratsk (UK: , UK: ; Russian: Братск [ˈbratsk]) is a city in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, located on the Angara River near the vast Bratsk Reservoir. It had population of 224,071 (2021 census).

Q115404.about: Madison County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 16,548.

Q115428.about: Kendall County is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. In the 2020 census, its population was 44,279.

Q115433.about: Wichita County ( WITCH-ih-taw) is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 129,350.

Q115463.about: Lapeer County ( lə-PEER) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 88,619.

Q115480.about: Shiawassee County ( SHY-ə-WOSS-ee) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 68,094.

Q115551.name: Eagle County
Q115551.about: Eagle County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 55,731.

Q115563.name: Elbert County
Q115563.about: Elbert County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 26,062.

Q131662.name: Polokwane
Q131662.about: Polokwane (UK: , meaning "Sanctuary" in Northern Sotho), formerly and sometimes also known as Pietersburg, is the capital city of the Limpopo Province of South Africa. It is the country's largest urban centre north of Gauteng.

Q131694.name: Aden
Q131694.desc: port city and temporary capital of Yemen
Q131694.about: Aden is an ancient port city in the southern part of the Arabian peninsula, on the north coast of the Gulf of Aden, positioned near the eastern approach to the Red Sea, and has been the de facto capital of the internationally recognized government of Yemen since 2014. It is approximately 170 km (110 mi) east of the Strait of Bab al-Mandab.

Q131818.name: Oran
Q131818.desc: coastal city in Oran Province, Algeria
Q131818.about: Oran (Arabic: وهران, romanized: Wahrān;  Northern Berber: ⵡⴰⵀⵔⴻⵏ, romanized: Wahṛen, or ⵡⴰⵀⵔⴰⵏ, Wahṛan) is a major coastal city located in the northwest of Algeria, 432 km (268 mi) west-southwest from the capital, Algiers. It is considered the second most important city of Algeria after Algiers because of its population and commercial, industrial and cultural importance.

Q132115.name: Squamish-Lillooet Regional District
Q132115.desc: regional district of British Columbia, Canada
Q132115.about: The Squamish-Lillooet Regional District (SLRD) is a local government federation, consisting of four municipalities in British Columbia, Canada: Lillooet, Pemberton, Whistler and Squamish.  It stretches from Britannia Beach in the south to Pavilion in the north.

Q132381.name: Sanhe
Q132381.about: Sanhe (Chinese: 三河; pinyin: Sānhé Shì) is a county-level city administered by the Langfang prefecture-level city in eastern Hebei province, People's Republic of China with around one million people. Sanhe city, Dachang Hui Autonomous County, and Xianghe County form the "Northern Three Counties of Langfang", an exclave of Hebei province surrounded by the Beijing and Tianjin municipalities.
Q132381.img: 三河迎賓路 Motorcycle Taxi in Sanhe 三河のオートバイタクシー - panoramio.jpg

Q132676.name: Mamoudzou
Q132676.about: Mamoudzou (French pronunciation: [mamudzu] ; Momojou) is the capital city of Mayotte, a French overseas region and department in the Indian Ocean. Mamoudzou is the most populated commune (municipality) of Mayotte.

Q12191.name: Nantes
Q12191.desc: city in Loire-Atlantique, Pays de la Loire, France
Q12191.about: Nantes (, US also ; French: [nɑ̃t] ; Gallo: Naunnt or Nantt [nɑ̃(ː)t]; Breton: Naoned [ˈnãunət]) is a city in the Loire-Atlantique department of France on the Loire, 50 km (31 mi) from the Atlantic coast. The city is the sixth largest in France, with a population of 327,734 in Nantes proper (2023) and a metropolitan area of 1,050,815 inhabitants (2023).

Q12245.name: Stanley
Q12245.desc: capital city of the Falkland Islands, a British Overseas Territory
Q12245.about: Stanley (also known as Port Stanley) is the capital city of the Falkland Islands. It is located on the island of East Falkland, on a north-facing slope in one of the wettest parts of the islands.

Q12439.name: Detroit
Q12439.desc: city in and county seat of Wayne County, and largest city in State of Michigan, United States
Q12439.about: Detroit (  dih-TROYT, locally also  DEE-troyt) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Michigan. It is situated on the bank of the Detroit River across from the Canadian city of Windsor, Ontario.

Q122803.name: Erzurum
Q122803.about: Erzurum (Armenian: Կարին, romanized: Karin; Kurdish: Erzîrom) is a city in eastern Turkey. It is the largest city and capital of Erzurum Province and is 1,900 meters (6,233 feet) above sea level.

Q123766.name: Charlottesville
Q123766.desc: independent city in Virginia, United States
Q123766.about: Charlottesville, colloquially known as C'ville, is an independent city in Virginia, United States. It is the county seat of Albemarle County, which surrounds the city, though the two are separate legal entities.

Q124637.name: Seward County
Q124637.about: Seward County is a county in the U.S. state of Nebraska. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,609, and was estimated to be 18,032 in 2025.

Q124739.name: Tijuana
Q124739.desc: municipal seat of Tijuana, State of Baja California, Mexico
Q124739.about: Tijuana is the most populous city of the Mexican state of Baja California, located on the northwestern Pacific Coast of Mexico. It is the municipal seat of the Tijuana Municipality, the hub of the Tijuana metropolitan area and the most populous city in northern Mexico.

Q125163.name: Islington
Q125163.about: Islington ( IZ-ling-tən) is an inner-city area of north London, England, within the wider London Borough of Islington. It is a mainly residential district of Inner London, extending from Islington's High Street to Highbury Fields and Regent's Canal, encompassing the area around the busy High Street, Upper Street, Essex Road, and Southgate Road to the east.

Q133118.name: Şanlıurfa
Q133118.about: Urfa, officially called Şanlıurfa (Turkish pronunciation: [ʃanˈɫɯuɾfa] lit. 'Urfa the Glorious'), is a city in southeastern Turkey and the capital of Şanlıurfa Province. Urfa is situated on a plain about 80 km (50 mi) east of the Euphrates.

Q1142579.name: Krasnogvardeysky District
Q1142579.desc: district in federal city of St. Petersburg, Russia
Q1142579.about: Krasnogvardeysky District (Russian: Красногварде́йский райо́н) is a district of the federal city of St. Petersburg, Russia.

Q1142667.name: Mangyŏngdae
Q1142667.about: Mangyongdae (Korean: 만경대) is a neighborhood in Mangyongdae-guyok, Pyongyang, North Korea. North Korean propaganda claims that Mangyongdae is the birthplace of North Korean leader Kim Il Sung, although in his memoirs he wrote that he had been born in the nearby neighborhood of Chilgol.

Q1145335.name: Dufferin County
Q1145335.about: Dufferin County is a county and census division located in Central Ontario, Canada. The county seat is Orangeville, and the current Warden is Janet Horner.

Q1145574.name: Jackson Heights
Q1145574.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, USA
Q1145574.about: Jackson Heights is a neighborhood in the northwestern part of the borough of Queens in New York City. Jackson Heights is neighbored by North Corona to the east, Elmhurst to the south, Woodside to the west, and today northern Astoria (Ditmars-Steinway) to the northwest, and East Elmhurst to the north and northeast.

Q1147110.name: Westmorland County
Q1147110.about: Westmorland County (2021 population: 163,576) is a county in New Brunswick, a province of Canada. It is in the southeastern part of the province.

Q1177705.name: Davidson County
Q1177705.about: Davidson County is a county in the U.S. state of Tennessee. It is located in the central part of the region of Middle Tennessee.

Q1179105.name: Daye
Q1179105.about: Daye (Chinese: 大冶; pinyin: Dàyě) is a county-level city in eastern Hubei province, China. It is under the administration of the Huangshi prefecture-level city.

Q1183907.name: Levittown
Q1183907.desc: census-designated place in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q1183907.about: Levittown is a census-designated place (CDP) and planned community in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, United States. The community includes portions of the municipalities of Bristol Township, Falls Township, Middletown Township and Tullytown Borough, but is not itself an independent municipality.

Q1185317.name: Sham Shui Po
Q1185317.desc: area of Kowloon, Hong Kong, China
Q1185317.about: Sham Shui Po (Chinese: 深水埗) is an area of Kowloon, Hong Kong, situated in the northwestern part of the Kowloon Peninsula, north of Tai Kok Tsui, east of Cheung Sha Wan and south of Shek Kip Mei (石硤尾). It is located in and is the namesake of the Sham Shui Po District.

Q1191460.name: Johns Creek
Q1191460.desc: city in Fulton County, Georgia, United States
Q1191460.about: Johns Creek is a city in Fulton County, Georgia, United States. According to the 2020 census, the population was 82,453.

Q11854.name: Rajkot
Q11854.about: Rajkot (Hindi: [ˈraːdʒkoːʈ] ) is the fourth-largest city in the western Indian state of Gujarat, after Ahmedabad, Surat, and Vadodara. It is in the centre of the Saurashtra region of Gujarat.

Q11864.name: Junagadh
Q11864.about: Junagadh () is the city and headquarters of Junagadh district in the Indian state of Gujarat. Located at the foot of the Girnar hills, 355 kilometres (221 mi) southwest of Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar (the state capital), it is the seventh largest city in the state.

Q11909.name: Vadodara
Q11909.about: Vadodara (Gujarati: [ˌʋəˈɖo.d̪ɾɐ̯] ), also known as Baroda, is a city on the banks of the Vishwamitri River in the Indian state of Gujarat. It serves as the administrative headquarters of the Vadodara district.

Q11910.name: Gandhinagar
Q11910.about: Gandhinagar (Gujarati: gāndhīnagara, pronounced [ˈɡɑːndʱinəɡəɾ(ə)] ) in India is the capital of the state of Gujarat and of Gandhinagar district. Gandhinagar is located approximately 23 kilometres (14 mi) north of Ahmedabad, on the west central point of the industrial corridor between the megacities of Delhi and Mumbai.

Q120080.name: Lincoln Parish
Q120080.about: Lincoln Parish (French: Paroisse de Lincoln) is a parish located in the U.S. state of Louisiana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 48,396.

Q121157.name: Mashhad
Q121157.desc: capital city of Razavi Khorasan Province, Iran
Q121157.about: Mashhad (Persian: مشهد [mæʃˈhæd] ), historically also known as Mashad ( mə-SHAD), Meshhed, or Meshed, is the second-most-populous city in Iran, located in the north-east of the country about 740 kilometres (460 miles) east of Tehran. In the Central District of Mashhad County, it serves as the capital of Razavi Khorasan province, the county, and the district.
Q121157.img: Aerial view of imam reza shrine - 1976.jpg

Q121765.name: Astoria
Q121765.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, United States
Q121765.about: Astoria is a neighborhood in the western portion of the New York City borough of Queens. Astoria is bounded by the East River to the west and north and is adjacent to four other Queens neighborhoods: Long Island City to the southwest, Sunnyside to the southeast, and Woodside and East Elmhurst to the east.

Q122044.name: Lubango
Q122044.about: Lubango, formerly known as Sá da Bandeira, is a municipality in Angola, capital of the Huíla Province, with a population of 890,384 in 2024. The city center had a population of 805,272 in 2024 making it the second-most populous city in Angola after the capital city Luanda.

Q122563.name: Eau Claire
Q122563.desc: city in Eau Claire and Chippewa counties in Wisconsin, United States, that is the county seat of Eau Claire County
Q122563.about: Eau Claire (  oh-KLAIR; French: [o klɛʁ] lit. 'clear water') is a city in Eau Claire and Chippewa counties in the U.S. state of Wisconsin.
Q122563.img: Eau Claire - Barstow street looking north 2005.jpg

Q132754.name: Erbil
Q132754.desc: capital of Kurdistan Region in Iraq
Q132754.about: Erbil (Arabic: أربيل, romanized: ʾArbīl; Syriac: ܐܲܪܒܹܝܠ, romanized: Arbēl), also called Hawler (Kurdish: هەولێر, romanized: Hewlêr), is the capital and most populated city in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and the capital of the Erbil Governorate. Erbil is described as the region's cultural, economic, industrial, educational and medical hub.

Q132830.name: Douala
Q132830.about: Douala is the largest city in Cameroon and its economic capital. It is also the capital of Cameroon's Littoral Region.

Q133116.name: Hamilton
Q133116.about: Hamilton is a port city in the Canadian province of Ontario. Hamilton has a population of 569,353 as of the 2021 Canadian census, and its census metropolitan area, which encompasses Burlington and Grimsby, has a population of 785,184.

Q1319893.name: Valencia
Q1319893.desc: neighborhood of Santa Clarita/Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q1319893.about: Valencia is a neighborhood in Santa Clarita located within Los Angeles County, California. It is one of the four unincorporated communities (along with Saugus, Newhall, and Canyon Country) that merged to create the city of Santa Clarita in 1987.

Q1320403.name: Jamaica
Q1320403.desc: neighborhood of Queens, New York City, United States
Q1320403.about: Jamaica is a neighborhood in the New York City borough of Queens. Jamaica is bordered by Hollis, Queens Village, St.
Q1320403.img: NY Jamaica Bay Broad Channel Cross Bay Bridge IMG 1987.JPG

Q1321216.name: Cuautitlán Izcalli
Q1321216.desc: municipal seat of Cuautitlán Izcalli, State of Mexico, Mexico
Q1321216.about: Cuautitlán Izcalli (Spanish pronunciation: [kwawtiˈtlan isˈkaʎi]) is a city and one of the 125 municipalities that make up the State of Mexico. Its municipal seat is Cuautitlán Izcalli.

Q1325316.name: Saint-Leonard
Q1325316.about: Saint-Leonard ( LEE-oh-nard; French: Saint-Léonard [sɛ̃ leɔnaʁ] ) is a borough (arrondissement) of Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Formerly a separate city, it was amalgamated into the city of Montreal in 2002.

Q1331388.name: Yuanping
Q1331388.about: Yuanping is a county-level city under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Xinzhou, in north-central Shanxi Province, China.

Q1333417.name: Lingyuan
Q1333417.about: Lingyuan (Chinese: 凌源; pinyin: Língyuán) is a city in the west of Liaoning province in Northeast China, bordering Hebei province and Inner Mongolia. It is under the administration of Chaoyang City, which lies 94 kilometres (58 mi) to the east-northeast.
Q1333417.img: G25 Changshen Expressway in the southern suburbs of Lingyuan (20220824110919).jpg

Q11997784.name: Richmond County
Q11997784.desc: county in New York, United States
Q11997784.about: Staten Island  ( STAT-ən) is the southernmost of the five boroughs of New York City. It is separated from New Jersey by the Arthur Kill and the Kill Van Kull and from the rest of New York by New York Bay.

Q12191144.name: New Cairo
Q12191144.desc: town east of Cairo in Egypt
Q12191144.about:
New Cairo is a modern satellite city within the Cairo Governorate of Egypt and the metropolitan area of Greater Cairo, whose formation was first initiated by a presidential decree in 1995 during the presidency of former Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
Administratively, it is officially part of the Eastern Area of Cairo city, but like all new settlements in Egypt, it is directly governed by the New Urban Communities Authority (NUCA).

Q12489610.name: Karawang
Q12489610.about: Karawang (Kota Karawang or Karawang Kota) is the capital of the Karawang Regency of West Java, Indonesia. It is 32 miles east of Jakarta, and had a population of 307,880 at the 2020 Census, spread over two districts of the regency - West Karawang and East Karawang.

Q13052701.name: Denver County
Q13052701.desc: county in Colorado, United States, coterminous with the City of Denver
Q13052701.about: Denver  (  DEN-vər), officially the City and County of Denver, is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Colorado. Officially a consolidated city and county, it is located in the South Platte River valley on the western edge of the High Plains, and is just east of the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains (Rockies).

Q13139252.name: Samut Prakan
Q13139252.desc: city in Samut Prakan province, Thailand
Q13139252.about: Samut Prakan (Thai: สมุทรปราการ, RTGS: Samut Prakan) officially the City of Samut Prakan (Thai: เทศบาลนครสมุทรปราการ, RTGS: Thetsaban Nakhon Samut Prakan) is the capital of Samut Prakan province in Thailand. It is located 25 kilometres (16 mi) south of Bangkok, The city was established in 1999.

Q117286825.name: Northeastern Connecticut Planning Region
Q117286825.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286825.about: The Northeastern Connecticut Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Northeastern Connecticut Council of Governments (NECCOG).
Q117286825.img: Putnam District, Putnam, CT 06260, USA - panoramio (33).jpg

Q117286852.name: Greater Bridgeport Planning Region
Q117286852.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286852.about: The Greater Bridgeport Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Connecticut Metropolitan Council of Governments (MetroCOG).
Q117286852.img: Mechanics & Farmers Savings Bank, Bridgeport, Connecticut.jpg

Q117286854.name: Capitol Planning Region
Q117286854.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286854.about: The Capitol Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. As of the 2020 census, the population was 976,248, and was estimated to be 991,508 in 2024, making it the most populous planning region in Connecticut.

Q117286902.name: Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region
Q117286902.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286902.wiki: Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region, Connecticut
Q117286902.about: The Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Lower Connecticut River Valley Council of Governments (RiverCOG).

Q117286946.name: Naugatuck Valley Planning Region
Q117286946.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286946.about: The Naugatuck Valley Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Naugatuck Valley Council of Governments (NVCOG).

Q117286972.name: Northwest Hills Planning Region
Q117286972.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117286972.about: The Northwest Hills Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Northwest Hills Council of Governments (NHCOG).

Q117287005.name: South Central Connecticut Planning Region
Q117287005.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117287005.wiki: South Central Connecticut Planning Region, Connecticut
Q117287005.about: The South Central Connecticut Planning Region is a planning region in the Councils of governments in Connecticut and a county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is entirely within New Haven County.

Q117287053.name: Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region
Q117287053.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117287053.about: The Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Southeastern Connecticut Council of Governments (SCCOG).
Q117287053.img: New London Downtown Historic District, Connecticut.jpg

Q117287069.name: Western Connecticut Planning Region
Q117287069.desc: planning region in Connecticut, United States
Q117287069.about: The Western Connecticut Planning Region is a planning region and county-equivalent in the U.S. state of Connecticut. It is served by the coterminous Western Connecticut Council of Governments (WestCOG), one of nine regional councils of governments in Connecticut.

Q123653859.name: Abington
Q123653859.desc: unincorporated community in Abington Township, Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q123653859.about: Abington is an unincorporated community in Abington Township, Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, United States, coterminous with the ZIP Code 19001.

Q125293.name: Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza
Q125293.desc: capital of the State of Puebla, Mexico
Q125293.about: Puebla de Zaragoza (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpweβla] ; Nahuatl languages: Cuetlaxcoapan; Mezquital Otomi: Nde'ma), formally Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, formerly Puebla de los Ángeles during colonial times, or known simply as Puebla, is the seat of Puebla Municipality. It is the capital and largest city of the state of Puebla, and the fourth-largest city in Mexico, after Mexico City, Monterrey, and Guadalajara.

Q125434.name: Gqeberha
Q125434.desc: city in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
Q125434.about: Gqeberha (English:  keb-AIR-khə, Xhosa: [ᶢǃʱɛ̀ɓéːxà]), also known as Port Elizabeth and colloquially P.E., is a major seaport and the most populous city in the Eastern Cape province of South Africa. It is the seat of the Nelson Mandela Bay Metropolitan Municipality, South Africa's second-smallest metropolitan municipality by area.

Q125495.name: La Nouvelle-Beauce
Q125495.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q125495.about: La Nouvelle-Beauce (French pronunciation: [la nuvɛl bos], New Beauce) is a regional county municipality in the Chaudière-Appalaches region in southeastern Quebec, Canada, south of the Saint Lawrence River. It is located south of Lévis, along the Chaudière River.

Q126269.name: Wolverhampton
Q126269.desc: city in the West Midlands, England, United Kingdom
Q126269.about: Wolverhampton (  WUUL-vər-HAMP-tən) is a city and metropolitan borough, in the West Midlands, England. Located around 12 miles (19 km) north-west of Birmingham, it forms the north-western part of the West Midlands conurbation, with the towns of Willenhall and Walsall to the east, and the towns of Sedgley and Dudley to the south.

Q126624.name: Fort McMurray
Q126624.about: Fort McMurray ( mək-MURR-ee) is an urban service area in the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo in Alberta, Canada. It is located in northeast Alberta, in the middle of the Athabasca oil sands, surrounded by boreal forest.

Q126661.name: Metairie
Q126661.desc: unincorporated suburban community and census-designated places in Jefferson Parish, Louisiana, United States
Q126661.about: Metairie ( MET-ər-ee) is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Jefferson Parish, Louisiana, United States, and is part of the New Orleans metropolitan area. With a population of 143,507 in 2020, Metairie is the largest community in Jefferson Parish, the fifth-largest CDP in the United States, and the largest outside Clark County, Nevada.

Q126805.name: St. Catharines
Q126805.about: St. Catharines is the most populous city in Canada's Niagara Region and the 8th-largest urban area in the province of Ontario.

Q126829.name: Richland County
Q126829.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q126829.about: Richland County is a county in the far southeast corner of the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 16,529, and was estimated to be 16,731 in 2025.

Q126995.name: Weinan
Q126995.about: Weinan (Chinese: 渭南; pinyin: Wèinán) is a prefecture-level city in east-central Shaanxi province, northwest China. The city lies on the lower section of the Wei River confluence into the Yellow River, about 60 km (37 mi) east of the provincial capital Xi'an, and borders the provinces of Shanxi and Henan to the east.

Q127041.name: Mangaluru
Q127041.desc: coastal city in Karnataka state, India
Q127041.about: Mangaluru (Kannada: [mɐŋɡɐɭuːru]), formerly called Mangalore ( MANG-gə-lor, -⁠LOR), is a major industrial port city in the Indian state of Karnataka and on the west coast of India. It is located between the Arabian Sea and the Western Ghats about 352 km (219 mi) west of Bengaluru, the state capital, 14 km (8+1⁄2 mi) north of the Karnataka–Kerala border and 297 km (185 mi) south of Goa.

Q127184.name: Chippewa County
Q127184.about: Chippewa County ( ) is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. It is named for the indigenous Chippewa people, also known as the Ojibwe, who historically controlled this territory.

Q127238.name: Jackson County
Q127238.about: Jackson County is located in the western portion of the U.S. state of Missouri, on the border with Kansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 717,204.

Q1197650.name: Tongshan District
Q1197650.desc: district of Xuzhou City, Jiangsu Province, China
Q1197650.about: Tongshan District (simplified Chinese: 铜山区; traditional Chinese: 銅山區; pinyin: Tóngshān Qū; lit. 'bronze mountain'), formerly Tongshan County (铜山县; 銅山縣; Tóngshān Xiàn), is one of six districts of Xuzhou, Jiangsu province, People's Republic of China, bordering Anhui and Shandong provinces.
Q1197650.img: Exit 2 of Keyunbei Station, Xuzhou Metro, 2501.jpg

Q1198038.name: Laixi
Q1198038.about:
Laixi (simplified Chinese: 莱西; traditional Chinese: 萊西; pinyin: Láixī) is a county-level city of Qingdao sub-provincial city, Shandong Province, China.
Laixi is known as "Qingdao's Back Garden".

Q1198349.name: Yishui County
Q1198349.desc: county in Linyi Prefecture, Shandong Province, China
Q1198349.about: Yishui County (simplified Chinese: 沂水县; traditional Chinese: 沂水縣; pinyin: Yíshuǐ Xiàn) is a county in the south-central part of Shandong province, People's Republic of China. Located in the central and southern region of Shandong, it lies in the hinterland of the Yimeng Mountain area and is situated in the upper reaches of the Yi River and Shu River.
Q1198349.img: 2024年秋季的沂水县沂河西岸中心城区俯瞰.jpg

Q1198379.name: Feicheng
Q1198379.desc: county-level city in Tai'an, Shandong Province, People's Republic of China
Q1198379.about: Feicheng (Chinese: 肥城; pinyin: Féichéng) is a county-level city under the administration of Tai'an City in the west of Shandong Province, China. As of 2017, the population was 992,000.

Q1200726.name: Longling County
Q1200726.about:
Longling County (simplified Chinese: 龙陵县; traditional Chinese: 龍陵縣; pinyin: Lónglíng Xiàn) is a county in Baoshan City, in the west of Yunnan Province, China, bordering Burma's Shan State to the south.
Its capital is the large community Longshan (龙山镇).

Q1200738.name: Kluang
Q1200738.desc: town in Johor, Malaysia and district capital of Kluang District
Q1200738.about: Kluang, formerly spelled Keluang, is a town and the district capital of Kluang District, Johor, Malaysia. Founded in 1915 by the British as the administrative capital for central Johor, Kluang is situated in the central geographical core of the state and lies within a 90-minute drive of major urban hubs across Johor.

Q1201657.name: Donghe District
Q1201657.about: Donghe District (Mongolian: ᠳ᠋ᠦᠩ ᠾᠧ ᠲᠣᠭᠣᠷᠢᠭ; Chinese: 东河区) is a district of Baotou, the largest city of Inner Mongolia, China. It contains the core of the "Old Baotou" before large-scale inward migration to other, newer districts.

Q1201692.name: Hondlon District
Q1201692.about: Hondlon District (Mongolian: ᠬᠥᠨᠳᠡᠯᠡᠨ ᠲᠣᠭᠣᠷᠢᠭ; Chinese: 昆都仑区) is a district of Baotou, the largest city of Inner Mongolia, China. It was a major destination of migration from Shaanxi, as opposed to Donghe District which retains a mostly native population.

Q1202211.name: Forest Hills
Q1202211.desc: neighborhood of Queens, New York City, New York, USA
Q1202211.about: Forest Hills is a neighborhood in the central portion of the borough of Queens in New York City. It is adjacent to Corona to the north, Rego Park and Glendale to the west, Forest Park to the south, Kew Gardens to the southeast, and Flushing Meadows–Corona Park and Kew Gardens Hills to the east.

Q1206594.name: Deux-Montagnes
Q1206594.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1206594.about: Deux-Montagnes (French pronunciation: [dø mɔ̃taɲ]) is a regional county municipality in the Laurentides region of Quebec, Canada. It is located immediately north of Laval on the north shore of the Rivière des Mille-Îles and on the north shore of the Lake of Two Mountains.

Q12523299.desc: former higher education institution in Bandung, Indonesia

Q131546626.desc: capital city of Nicaragua and seat of Managua Municipality and Managua Department

Q12919.name: Majuro
Q12919.about: Majuro is the capital and largest city of the Marshall Islands. It is also a large coral atoll of 64 islands in the Pacific Ocean.

Q127506.name: Taunton
Q127506.desc: city in Bristol County, Massachusetts, United States
Q127506.about: Taunton is a city in and the county seat of Bristol County, Massachusetts, United States. Taunton is situated on the Taunton River, which winds its way through the city on its way to Mount Hope Bay, 10 miles (16 km) to the south.

Q127623.name: Vantaa
Q127623.desc: city in the region of Uusimaa in Finland
Q127623.about: Vantaa (Finnish pronunciation: [ˈʋɑntɑː]; Swedish: Vanda, Finland Swedish: [ˈvɑnːdɑ]) is a city in Finland. It is located to the north of the capital, Helsinki, in southern Uusimaa.
Q127623.img: Alepa bicycles at Ulrikankuja in Asola, Vantaa, Finland, 2021 May.jpg

Q127970.name: Larimer County
Q127970.about: Larimer County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 359,066.
Q127970.img: Larimer County Justice Center, NE corner.jpg

Q127972.name: Kiowa County
Q127972.about: Kiowa County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,446, making it the fifth-least populous county in Colorado.

Q127975.name: Jackson County
Q127975.about: Jackson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,379, and it was the fourth least populated in the state and the least populous “Jackson County” in the United States.

Q1207076.name: Tengzhou
Q1207076.about: Tengzhou (Chinese: 滕州; pinyin: Téngzhōu) is a county-level city of Zaozhuang, Shandong province of the People's Republic of China. It is the site of the feudal vassal State of Teng during the Spring and Autumn period.
Q1207076.img: 中国山东省滕州市界河镇鲁班圣祖坊.jpg

Q1209135.name: Gaozhou
Q1209135.about: Gaozhou is a county-level city in southwestern Guangdong Province, China. Formerly the primary city in the area, it is now administered as part of the prefecture-level city of Maoming.

Q1241464.name: Dongsheng District
Q1241464.about: Dongsheng District (Mongolian: ᠳ᠋ᠦᠩᠱᠧᠩ ᠲᠣᠭᠣᠷᠢᠭ; Chinese: 东胜区; alternate spelling English: Koshang; Turkic: Košang) is a district and former seat of Ordos City, Inner Mongolia, China. It has a population of 574,242.

Q1249798.name: Fraser Valley Regional District
Q1249798.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q1249798.about: The Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) is a regional district in British Columbia, Canada. Its headquarters are in the city of Chilliwack.

Q1249888.name: Dera Ismail Khan
Q1249888.about: Dera Ismail Khan (; Saraiki: ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان, Pashto: ډېره اسماعيل خان), abbreviated as DI Khan, is a city and headquarters of Dera Ismail Khan District, located in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. It is the 10th largest city of Pakistan and sixth largest in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by population.
Q1249888.img: ALLAH NAWAZ CASTLE OF THE NAWAB OF DERA ISMAIL KHAN.jpg

Q1250417.name: Tando Allahyar
Q1250417.about: Tando Allahyar (Sindhi: ٽنڊوالهيار, Urdu: ٹنڈو الہ یار)  is a city and capital of Tando Allahyar District of Hyderabad Division located in Sindh, Pakistan. As of 2023 Pakistani census, city had a population of 171185.

Q1251234.name: Sadiqabad
Q1251234.about:
Sadiqabad (Punjabi/Urdu: صادق آباد) is a city and capital of Sadiqabad Tehsil in Rahim Yar Khan District, Punjab province of Pakistan.
It is situated at the border of Sindh and Punjab.

Q1253663.name: Hafizabad
Q1253663.about: Hafizabad (Punjabi / Urdu: حافظ آباد; Punjabi pronunciation: [ˈɦäːfᵊ zäbäːd̪]; Urdu pronunciation: [ˈɦɑːfɪzɑbɑːd̪]) is a city and capital of Hafizabad District located in Punjab, Pakistan. Hafizabad is an old settlement.

Q1260929.name: Kamoke

Q138391.name: Paterson

Q134080.about: Taliaferro County ( TOL-iv-ər) is a county located in East central Piedmont region of the U.S. state of Georgia. Q1341.name: Tolyatti

Q134279.name: Luhansk

Q134279.about: Luhansk (Ukrainian: Луга́нськ), also known as Lugansk (Russian: Луга́нск), is a city in the Donbas in eastern Ukraine. As of 2022, the population was estimated to be 397,677 (2022 estimate), making Luhansk the 12th-largest city in Ukraine.

Q135328.name: Grand Forks County
Q135328.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q135328.about: Grand Forks County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 73,170, and was estimated to be 74,501 in 2025, making it the third-most populous county in North Dakota.

Q135615.about: Springfield is the third most populous city in the U.S. state of Missouri and the county seat of Greene County. The city's population was 169,176 at the 2020 census.

Q1375280.name: Reston

Q1375280.about: Reston is a census-designated place in Fairfax County, Virginia, United States, and a principal city of both Northern Virginia and the Washington metropolitan area. As of the 2020 U.S. census, Reston's population was 63,226.

Q1375967.name: Port Conway

Q1375967.about: Port Conway is an unincorporated community on the north side  of the Rappahannock River in King George County, in the Northern Neck of Virginia, United States. It is opposite Port Royal, which is on the south side of the river in Caroline County.

Q1376480.name: Universal City
Q1376480.desc: community in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q1376480.about: Universal City is an unincorporated area within the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles County, California, United States. Q1390081.name: Santa Teresa del Tuy

Q1345.name: Philadelphia

Q1345.about: Philadelphia (  FIL-ə-DEL-fee-ə), colloquially referred to as Philly, is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Pennsylvania and the sixth-most populous city in the United States. Its population was 1.60 million at the 2020 census and estimated at 1.57 million in 2025.

Q1348.name: Kolkata

Q134291.name: Mersin

Q134509.name: Port Said

The city is the capital of the Port Said Governorate and forms the majority of the governorate, comprising seven of the governorate's eight administrative regions.

Q134514.name: Suez
Q134514.desc: seaport city in Suez Governorate, Egypt
Q134514.about: Suez is a seaport city in north-eastern Egypt, located on the north coast of the Gulf of Suez on the Red Sea, near the southern terminus of the Suez Canal. The city is the capital and largest city of the Suez Governorate.
Q134514.img: US Navy 031013-N-6187M-001 The nuclear powered aircraft carrier USS Enterprise (CVN 65) passes an Islamic mosque on the western bank of the Suez Canal while transiting to the Red Sea.jpg

Q134703.name: Kahramanmaraş

Q134902.name: Stoke-on-Trent

Q1370292.name: Washington Heights
Q1370292.desc: neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City, United States
Q1370292.about: Washington Heights is a neighborhood in the northern part of the borough of Manhattan in New York City. Q1374678.name: Centreville

Q1354.name: Dhaka

Q1354.about: Dhaka (  DAH-kə or   DAK-ə; Bengali: ঢাকা, romanized: Ḍhākā, pronounced [ˈɖʱaka] ), formerly spelled as Dacca, is the capital and largest city of Bangladesh. With an estimated population of 36.6 million, Dhaka is the second largest city by population in the world, and is widely considered to be the most densely populated built-up urban area in the world.

Q1355.name: Bengaluru
