Q1355.about: Bengaluru, also known as Bangalore (its official name until 1 November 2014), is the capital and largest city of the southern Indian state of Karnataka. As per the 2011 census, the city had a population of 8.4 million, making it the third most populous city in India and the most populous in South India.

Q137509.name: Kalamazoo County
Q137509.about: Kalamazoo County ( KAL-ə-mə-ZOO) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of 2020, the population was 261,670.

Q137516.name: Calhoun County
Q137516.about: Calhoun County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 134,310.

Q137562.name: Van Buren County
Q137562.about: Van Buren County is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 75,587.

Q137828.name: Morgan County
Q137828.about: Morgan County is a county in the north-central part of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, its population was 123,421.

Q1453196.name: Muzaffarpur
Q1453196.about: Muzaffarpur () also spelled as Mozufferpore, is a city located in Muzaffarpur district  on the banks of Burhi Gandak river in the Tirhut division of the Indian state of Bihar. It serves as the headquarters of the Tirhut division, the Muzaffarpur district.

Q1457954.name: Kitikmeot Region
Q1457954.about: Kitikmeot Region (; Inuktitut: ᕿᑎᕐᒥᐅᑦ, romanized: Qitirmiut ) is an administrative region of Nunavut, Canada. It consists of the southern and eastern parts of Victoria Island with the adjacent part of the mainland as far as the Boothia Peninsula, together with King William Island and the southern portion of Prince of Wales Island.

Q1471757.name: Richards Bay
Q1471757.about: Richards Bay (Afrikaans: Richardsbaai) is a city in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. It is situated on a 30-square-kilometre lagoon of the Mhlatuze River, which makes it one of the country's largest harbours.

Q1487593.name: Rampur
Q1487593.about: Rampur ( ; ISO: Rāmapura; formerly Mustafabad) is a city and the administrative headquarters of Rampur district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It was formerly known for industries such as sugar refining and cotton milling.

Q1497865.name: La Haute-Yamaska
Q1497865.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1497865.about: La Haute-Yamaska (French pronunciation: [la ot jamaska], lit. 'The Upper Yamaska') is a regional county municipality in the Estrie region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Granby.

Q1503514.name: Muratpaşa
Q1503514.about: Muratpaşa is a municipality and district of Antalya Province, Turkey. Its area is 96 km2, and its population is 526,293 (2022).

Q1503540.name: South Hill
Q1503540.desc: census designated place in Pierce County, Washington, United States
Q1503540.about: South Hill is a census-designated place (CDP) in Pierce County, Washington, United States. The population was 64,708 at the 2020 census.

Q1352.name: Chennai
Q1352.desc: city and state capital of Tamil Nadu, India
Q1352.about: Chennai, also known as Madras, is the capital and largest city of Tamil Nadu, the southernmost state of India. It is located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal.

Q1353.name: Delhi
Q1353.desc: megacity and union territory of India
Q1353.about: Delhi, officially the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi, is a megacity and a union territory of India containing New Delhi, the capital of India. Straddling the Yamuna river, but spread chiefly to the west, or beyond its right bank, Delhi shares borders with the state of Uttar Pradesh in the east and with the state of Haryana in the remaining directions.

Q135744.name: Galveston
Q135744.desc: city in and county seat of Galveston County, Texas, United States; port and coastal city
Q135744.about: Galveston ( GAL-vis-tən) is a resort city and port on the Gulf Coast of the U.S. state of Texas. It encompasses 211.31 square miles (547.3 km2) on Galveston Island and Pelican Island.
Q135744.img: Galveston Texas Skyline From The Carnival Ecstasy.jpg

Q137271.name: Kota Kinabalu
Q137271.about: Kota Kinabalu (Malaysian: [ˈkota kinaˈbalu]; previously Jesselton), colloquially referred to as KK, is the state capital of Sabah, Malaysia. It is also the capital of the Kota Kinabalu District as well as the West Coast Division of Sabah.

Q1406913.name: Lambton County
Q1406913.about: Lambton County is a county in Southwestern Ontario, Canada. It is bordered on the north by Lake Huron, which is drained by the St.

Q1421013.name: Qikiqtaaluk Region
Q1421013.about: The Qikiqtaaluk Region (Inuktitut: ᕿᑭᖅᑖᓗᒃ, pronounced [qikiqtaːˈluk]), Qikiqtani Region or Baffin Region is the easternmost, northernmost, and southernmost administrative region of Nunavut, Canada. Qikiqtaaluk is the traditional Inuktitut name for Baffin Island.

Q1421308.name: Ranipet
Q1421308.desc: Village in Vellore District, Tamil Nadu, India
Q1421308.about: Ranipet (lit. Queen's colony) is an industrial town and the administrative headquarters of Ranipet district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

Q1425428.name: Newcastle upon Tyne
Q1425428.desc: city in Tyne and Wear, England, UK
Q1425428.about: Newcastle upon Tyne, or simply Newcastle (  new-KASS-əl, RP:   NEW-kah-səl), is a city and metropolitan borough, in Tyne and Wear, England. While the hyphenated form of the name, Newcastle-upon-Tyne, is seen sometimes, correct usage is generally unhyphenated.
Q1425428.img: Tyne Bridge - Newcastle Upon Tyne - England - 2004-08-14.jpg

Q1428659.name: Piscataway
Q1428659.desc: township in Middlesex County, New Jersey, United States
Q1428659.about: Piscataway (English pronunciation: /pɪsˈkætəweɪ/ ) is a township in Middlesex County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. It is a suburb of the New York metropolitan area, in the Raritan Valley.

Q1430348.name: Stikine Region
Q1430348.desc: unincorporated area not administered by a regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q1430348.about: The Stikine Region () is an unincorporated area in northwestern British Columbia, Canada. It is the only area in the province that is not part of a regional district.

Q1436530.name: Nipissing District
Q1436530.about: Nipissing District is a district in Northeastern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario. It was created in 1858.

Q1436816.name: Tirupati
Q1436816.desc: city in Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q1436816.about: Tirupati ( Tiru-pa-ti) is a city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh and serves as the administrative headquarters of Tirupati district. It is known for its significant religious and cultural heritage, being home to the renowned Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, a major Hindu pilgrimage site, as well as other historic temples.

Q1444136.name: Tigard
Q1444136.about: Tigard (  TY-gərd) is a city in Washington County, Oregon, United States. The population was 54,539 at the 2020 census, making it the 12th most populous city in Oregon.

Q1444781.name: Joliette
Q1444781.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1444781.about: Joliette (French pronunciation: [ʒɔljɛt] ) is a regional county municipality in the Lanaudière region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Joliette.

Q1451121.name: Les Collines-de-l'Outaouais
Q1451121.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1451121.about: Les Collines-de-l'Outaouais (French pronunciation: [le kɔlin də lutawɛ], "The hills of the Outaouais") is a regional county municipality in the Outaouais region of western Quebec, Canada. The region nearly encircles the City of Gatineau, which is to the south.

Q1451232.name: Stoney Creek
Q1451232.about: Stoney Creek is a community in the city of Hamilton in the Canadian province of Ontario located 10 km east of Downtown Hamilton and 57 km south-west of Toronto. It was a municipality until 2001, when it was amalgamated with Hamilton, Dundas, Ancaster,  Flamborough and Glanbrook to form the City of Hamilton.
Q1451232.img: Battle of Stony Creek Monument, Stony Creek.jpg

Q1451335.name: Regional District of Fraser-Fort George
Q1451335.about: The Regional District of Fraser–Fort George (RDFFG) is a regional district located in the Central Interior of British Columbia, Canada. It is bounded by the Alberta border to the east, the Columbia–Shuswap and Thompson–Nicola regional districts to the south and southeast, Cariboo Regional District to the southwest, the Regional District of Bulkley–Nechako to the west, and the Peace River Regional District to the north and northeast.

Q1452991.name: Firozabad
Q1452991.desc: city in Firozabad district, Uttar Pradesh, India
Q1452991.about: Firozabad (Hindustani pronunciation: [fɪɾoːzaːbaːd̪]) is a city near Agra in Firozabad district in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India. It is the centre of India's glassmaking industry and is known for the quality of the bangles and glassware produced here.

Q1453180.name: Rohtak
Q1453180.about: Rohtak (Hindustani pronunciation: [roɦ.t̪ək] ) is a city and the administrative headquarters of the Rohtak district in the Indian state of Haryana. It lies 70 kilometres (43 mi) north-west of New Delhi and 250 kilometres (160 mi) south of the state capital Chandigarh on NH 9 (old NH 10).

Q1361.name: Hyderabad
Q1361.about: Hyderabad is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Telangana. It occupies 650 km2 (250 sq mi) on the Deccan Plateau along the banks of the Musi River, in the northern part of Southern India.

Q1362.name: Islamabad
Q1362.about: Islamabad is the capital city of Pakistan. It is the country's tenth-most populous city with a population of over 1.1 million and is federally administered by the Pakistani government as part of the Islamabad Capital Territory — with a metropolitan population of over 2.3 million.

Q137916.name: Washtenaw County
Q137916.about: Washtenaw County ( WAWSH-tə-naw) is a southern county in the U.S. state of Michigan. At the 2020 census, the population was 372,258.
Q137916.img: Washtenaw County Downtown Ann Arbor Campus.JPG

Q138141.name: Burlington County
Q138141.desc: county in New Jersey, United States
Q138141.about: Burlington County is a county in the U.S. state of New Jersey. The county is the largest by land area in New Jersey and ranks second behind neighboring Ocean County in total area.
Q138141.img: CLARA BARTON SCHOOL IN BORDENTOWN HISTORIC DISTRICT.jpg

Q138311.name: Elizabeth
Q138311.desc: city in and county seat of Union County, New Jersey, United States
Q138311.about: Elizabeth is a city in and the county seat of Union County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the city retained its ranking as the state's fourth-most-populous city behind neighboring Newark, Jersey City and Paterson, with a population of 137,298, an increase of 12,329 (+9.9%) from the 2010 census count of 124,969, which in turn reflected an increase of 4,401 (3.7%) from the 120,568 counted in the 2000 census.

Q138338.name: New Brunswick
Q138338.desc: city in and county seat of Middlesex County, New Jersey, United States
Q138338.about: New Brunswick is a city in Middlesex County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. A regional commercial hub for Central New Jersey, the city is both a college town (the main campus of Rutgers University, the state's largest university) and a commuter town for residents working in New York City within the New York metropolitan area.
Q138338.img: New Brunswick NJ Skyline at Sunset.jpg

Q138367.name: Camden
Q138367.desc: city in and county seat of Camden County, New Jersey, United States
Q138367.about: Camden is a city in and the county seat of Camden County, New Jersey, United States. Located across the Delaware River from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, it is part of the Philadelphia metropolitan area.

Q1508363.name: Kivalliq Region
Q1508363.about: The Kivalliq Region (; Inuktitut: ᑭᕙᓪᓕᖅ) is an administrative region of Nunavut, Canada. It consists of the portion of the mainland to the west of Hudson Bay together with Southampton Island and Coats Island.

Q1511248.name: Le Domaine-du-Roy
Q1511248.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1511248.about: Le Domaine-du-Roy (French pronunciation: [lə dɔmɛn dy ʁwa], lit. 'The King's Domain') is a regional county municipality in the Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is in Roberval, and it is named for the King of France, who owned the land at the time of the colonization of Quebec.

Q1511288.name: La Haute-Côte-Nord
Q1511288.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1511288.about: La Haute-Côte-Nord (French pronunciation: [la ot kot nɔʁ]) is a regional county municipality in northeastern Quebec, Canada, in the Côte-Nord region. It is located on the Gulf of St.

Q1515546.name: Wanyjok
Q1515546.desc: city in Aweil East State, South Sudan
Q1515546.about: Wanjok (also known as Wanyjok) is a town in the Aweil East County, Republic of South Sudan.

Q1516974.name: L'Île-d'Orléans
Q1516974.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q1516974.about: L'Île-d'Orléans (French pronunciation: [lil dɔʁleɑ̃]) is a regional county municipality in central Quebec, Canada, in the Capitale-Nationale region. Its seat is Sainte-Famille-de-l'Île-d'Orléans.

Q1517234.name: La Côte-de-Beaupré
Q1517234.desc: regional county municipality of Capitale-nationale, Quebec, Canada
Q1517234.about: La Côte-de-Beaupré (French pronunciation: [la kot də bopʁe]) is a regional county municipality in the Capitale-Nationale region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is Château-Richer.

Q1517236.name: Rivière-du-Loup
Q1517236.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517236.about: Rivière-du-Loup (French pronunciation: [ʁivjɛʁ dy lu]) is a regional county municipality in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region of Quebec, Canada. Its most important city is Rivière-du-Loup, which contains more than half of the population.

Q1517251.name: Nicolet-Yamaska
Q1517251.desc: regional county municipality of Centre-du-Québec, Quebec, Canada
Q1517251.about:
Nicolet-Yamaska (French pronunciation: [nikɔlɛ(t) jamaska]) is a regional county municipality in the Centre-du-Québec region of Quebec, Canada.
The county seat is Nicolet.

Q1517260.name: Rimouski-Neigette
Q1517260.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517260.about:
Rimouski-Neigette (French pronunciation: [ʁimuski nɛʒɛt]) is a regional county municipality in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region of Quebec, Canada.
The county seat is in Rimouski.

Q1517280.name: Beauce-Centre
Q1517280.about: Beauce-Centre (French pronunciation: [bos sɑ̃tʁ]) is a regional county municipality in the Chaudière-Appalaches region of southeastern Quebec, Canada. It is located on the Chaudière River, between La Nouvelle-Beauce Regional County Municipality and Beauce-Sartigan Regional County Municipality.

Q1517282.name: Les Basques
Q1517282.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q1517282.about: Les Basques (French pronunciation: [le bask], the Basques) is a regional county municipality in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region in eastern Quebec, Canada. It is located on the south bank of the Saint Lawrence River halfway between Rimouski and Rivière-du-Loup.

Q1517286.name: Le Val-Saint-François
Q1517286.desc: regional county municipality in Estrie, Quebec, Canada
Q1517286.about: Le Val-Saint-François (French pronunciation: [lə val sɛ̃ fʁɑ̃swa]) is a regional county municipality in the Estrie region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is Richmond.

Q1517310.name: Les Sources
Q1517310.desc: regional county municipality in Estrie, Quebec, Canada
Q1517310.about: Les Sources (French pronunciation: [le suʁs]) is a regional county municipality in the Estrie region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is the city of Val-des-Sources.

Q1517325.name: La Jacques-Cartier
Q1517325.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q1517325.about: La Jacques-Cartier (French pronunciation: [la ʒak kaʁtje], Canadian French: [la ʒɑːk kaʁt͡sje]) is a regional county municipality in the Capitale-Nationale region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is in Shannon.

Q1517350.name: Portneuf
Q1517350.desc: regional county municipality of the province of Quebec, Canada
Q1517350.about: Portneuf (French pronunciation: [pɔʁnœf]) is a regional county municipality (RCM) in the Capitale-Nationale administrative region of Quebec, Canada. RCM of Portneuf has been established on January 1, 1982.

Q1517363.name: La Mitis
Q1517363.desc: regional county municipality of Bas-Saint-Laurent, Quebec, Canada
Q1517363.about: La Mitis is a regional county municipality in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region in eastern Quebec, Canada on the Gaspé peninsula. It is named for the Mitis River (The Mitis) which has its source in the region (at Lac Inférieur) and flows through the central part of the region before emptying into the Saint Lawrence River.

Q1517559.name: Témiscamingue
Q1517559.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517559.about: Témiscamingue (French pronunciation: [temiskamɛ̃ɡ]) is a regional county municipality in the Abitibi-Témiscamingue region of western Quebec, Canada. The county seat is Ville-Marie.

Q1517564.name: Les Appalaches
Q1517564.desc: regional county municipality in Chaudière-Appalaches, Quebec, Canada
Q1517564.about: Les Appalaches (French pronunciation: [lez‿apalaʃ]) is a regional county municipality (RCM) in the Chaudière-Appalaches region in southeastern Quebec, Canada.  It was established in 1982 from parts of the historic counties of Beauce, Frontenac, Mégantic, and Wolfe.

Q1517571.name: Le Haut-Saint-François
Q1517571.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q1517571.about: Le Haut-Saint-François (French pronunciation: [lə o sɛ̃ fʁɑ̃swa]; The Upper Saint-François [St. Francis]) is a regional county municipality in southeastern Quebec, Canada in the Estrie region.

Q1517579.name: Montmagny
Q1517579.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517579.about: Montmagny (French pronunciation: [mɔ̃maɲi] ) is a regional county municipality (RCM) in the Chaudière-Appalaches region of Quebec, Canada. Montmagny is the seat.

Q1517587.name: Témiscouata
Q1517587.desc: regional county municipality in Bas-Saint-Laurent, Quebec, Canada
Q1517587.about: Témiscouata (French pronunciation: [temiskwata]) is a regional county municipality in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region of Quebec, Canada. It is located southeast of Rivière-du-Loup, bordering New Brunswick, and is centred on Lake Témiscouata.

Q1517596.name: Memphrémagog
Q1517596.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517596.about: Memphrémagog (French pronunciation: [mɛmfʁemaɡɔɡ]) is a regional county municipality in the Estrie region of Quebec, Canada.

Q1517613.name: Le Haut-Richelieu
Q1517613.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517613.about: Le Haut-Richelieu Regional County Municipality (French pronunciation: [lə o ʁiʃ(ə)ljø], lit. 'The Upper Richelieu') is a regional county municipality in the Montérégie region in southwestern Quebec, Canada. Its seat is in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu.

Q1517624.name: Vaudreuil-Soulanges
Q1517624.desc: regional county municipality in Montérégie, Quebec, Canada
Q1517624.about: Vaudreuil-Soulanges (French pronunciation: [vodʁœj sulɑ̃ʒ]) is a regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada. It is located on a triangular peninsula in the western Montérégie region of Quebec, formed by the confluence of the Ottawa River to the north, and the St.

Q1517640.name: Pierre-De Saurel
Q1517640.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517640.about: Pierre-De Saurel (French pronunciation: [pjɛʁ də soʁɛl]) is a regional county municipality  in the Montérégie region in southwestern Quebec, Canada. Originally named Le Bas-Richelieu Regional County Municipality, the name change to Pierre-De Saurel took effect on January 1, 2009.

Q1517648.name: La Côte-de-Gaspé
Q1517648.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517648.about: La Côte-de-Gaspé (French pronunciation: [la kot də ɡaspe] ) is a regional county municipality on the Gaspé peninsula in eastern Quebec, Canada, part of the Gaspésie–Îles-de-la-Madeleine region. The seat is Gaspé.

Q1517681.name: Le Rocher-Percé
Q1517681.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1517681.about: Le Rocher-Percé (French pronunciation: [lə ʁɔʃe pɛʁse]) is a regional county municipality in the Gaspésie–Îles-de-la-Madeleine region of Quebec, Canada.  Its seat is Chandler.

Q1435.name: Zagreb
Q1435.about: Zagreb ( ZAH-greb; Croatian: [zǎːɡreb] ) is the capital and largest city of Croatia. It is in the north of the country, along the Sava River, at the southern slopes of the Medvednica mountain.

Q1461.name: Manila
Q1461.about: Manila, officially the City of Manila, is the capital and second-most populous city of the Philippines after Quezon City. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 1,902,590 people.

Q139473.name: Sherbrooke
Q139473.about: Sherbrooke ( SHUR-bruuk, Quebec French: [ʃɛʁˈbʁʊk]) is a city in southern Quebec, Canada. It is at the confluence of the Saint-François and Magog rivers in the heart of the Estrie administrative region.

Q139706.name: Panipat
Q139706.about: Panipat () historically known as Pandavprastha is an industrial city, located 95 km north of Delhi and 169 km south of Chandigarh on NH-44 in Panipat district, Haryana, India. It is famous for three major battles fought in 1526, 1556 and 1761.

Q140075.name: Gold Coast
Q140075.about: The Gold Coast, also known by its initials, GC, is a coastal city and region in the state of Queensland, Australia, located approximately 66 kilometres (41 mi) south-southeast of the centre of the state capital, Brisbane. It is on the central eastern coast of Australia adjoining the Pacific Ocean.

Q140147.name: Brest
Q140147.desc: city of Belarus, capital of Byerastsye Region
Q140147.about: Brest, formerly Brest-Litovsk (1600s–1923) and Brest-on-the-Bug (1923–1939), is a city in south-western Belarus at the border with Poland opposite the Polish town of Terespol, where the Bug and Mukhavets rivers meet, making it a border town. It serves as the administrative center of Brest Region and Brest District, though it is administratively separated from the district.

Q140304.name: Zagazig
Q140304.about: Zagazig (Egyptian Arabic pronunciation: [ez.zæʔæˈziːʔ], locally [ez.zæɡæˈziːɡ]) is a city in Egypt. Situated in the eastern part of the Nile delta, it is the capital of the governorate of Sharqia.

Q140561.name: Zahedan
Q140561.desc: city in Sistan and Baluchestan province, Iran
Q140561.about: Zahedan (Balochi and Persian: ; [zɒːheˈd̪ɒːn]) is a city in the Central District of Zahedan County, Sistan and Baluchestan province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district. It is near the borderlands between Iran and Pakistan in an area inhabited by Baloch people.

Q140631.name: Tainan
Q140631.about: Tainan (), officially Tainan City, is a special municipality in southern Taiwan, facing the Taiwan Strait on its western coast. Tainan is the oldest city on the island and commonly called the "prefectural capital" for its 263-year history as the capital of Taiwan under Dutch rule, the Kingdom of Tungning and later Qing dynasty rule until 1887.

Q1533.name: Caracas
Q1533.desc: capital and largest city of Venezuela
Q1533.about: Caracas, officially Santiago de León de Caracas (CCS), is the capital and largest city of Venezuela, and the center of the Metropolitan Region of Caracas (or Greater Caracas). It is located along the Guaire River in the northern part of Venezuela, within the Caracas Valley of the Venezuelan coastal mountain range.

Q1538.name: Pune
Q1538.about: Pune (Marathi: Puṇē, pronounced [ˈpuɳeː] ), previously spelled in English as Poona (the official name until 1978), is a city in the state of Maharashtra in the Deccan Plateau in Western India. It is the administrative headquarters of the Pune district, and of Pune division.

Q13379.name: Kurgan
Q13379.about: Kurgan (Russian: Курган, IPA: [kʊrˈɡan]) is the largest city and the administrative center of Kurgan Oblast in the south of the Urals Federal District of Russia. Population: 310,911 (2021 census); 333,606 (2010 census); 345,515 (2002 census); 355,517 (1989 Soviet census).

Q14126.name: Mataram
Q14126.desc: city in West Nusa Tenggara Province, Indonesia
Q14126.about: Mataram (Indonesian: Kota Mataram; pronounced [ˌkot̪a maˈt̪aram]) is a capital city of the Indonesian province of West Nusa Tenggara. The city is surrounded on all the landward sides by (but is not administratively part of) West Lombok Regency and lies on the western side of the island of Lombok, Indonesia.

Q14155.name: Kupang
Q14155.desc: city in East Nusa Tenggara Province, Indonesia
Q14155.about: Kupang (Indonesian: Kota Kupang, Indonesian pronunciation: [ˈkupaŋ]), formerly known in Dutch as Koepang, is the capital of the Indonesian province of East Nusa Tenggara. At the 2020 Census, it had a population of 442,758; the official estimate as of mid 2025 was 482,734 (comprising 242,903 males and 239,831 females).

Q14168.name: Pontianak
Q14168.desc: city in West Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14168.about: Pontianak, also known as Khuntien or 坤甸 in Teochew and Hakka, is the capital of the Indonesian province of West Kalimantan, founded first as a trading port on the island of Borneo, occupying an area of 118.21 km2 in the delta of the Kapuas River, at a point where it is joined by its major tributary, the Landak River. The city is precisely on the equator, hence it is widely known as Kota Khatulistiwa (Equatorial City).

Q14169.name: Singkawang
Q14169.desc: city in West Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14169.about: Singkawang (Selako Dayak: Sakawokng),  or San-Khew-Jong (Chinese: 山口洋; pinyin: Shānkǒuyáng; Pha̍k-fa-sṳ: Sân-gú-yòng), is a coastal city and port located in the province of West Kalimantan, on the island of Borneo in Indonesia. It is located at about 145 km north of Pontianak, the provincial capital, and is surrounded by the Pasi, Poteng, and Sakkok mountains.

Q14181.name: Banjarbaru
Q14181.desc: city in South Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14181.about: Banjarbaru is the capital city of South Kalimantan, one of the provinces in Indonesia. It is located 35 km (22 mi) southeast of Banjarmasin, the largest city of the province.
Q14181.img: Tugu Selamat Datang di Kota Banjarbaru.jpg

Q14492.name: Balikpapan
Q14492.desc: city in East Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14492.about: Balikpapan is a port city in East Kalimantan, Indonesia, on the eastern coast of Borneo. An important oil-refining, commercial and transport centre, it is often called Kota Minyak ("Oil City").

Q14499.name: Samarinda
Q14499.desc: city in East Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14499.about: Samarinda (Indonesian pronunciation: [samaˈrɪnda]) is the capital city of the Indonesian province of East Kalimantan. It is situated on the riverbanks of lower Mahakam, and both parts are connected by Mahakam Bridge, Mahakam Ulu Bridge, and Achmad Amins Bridge.

Q14501.name: Tarakan
Q14501.desc: city in North Kalimantan Province, Indonesia
Q14501.about: Tarakan is an island and co-extensively the sole city within the Indonesian province of North Kalimantan. The island city is the largest urban area in North Kalimantan population-wise and is located in northern Borneo, midway along the coast of the province.

Q14773.name: Macau
Q14773.desc: city and special administrative region of China
Q14773.about: Macau or Macao is a special administrative region of China. It consists of the Macau Peninsula, the islands of Taipa and Coloane, the Cotai reclamation zone between Taipa and Coloane, and several smaller islets.

Q1467.name: Cebu City
Q1467.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Cebu
Q1467.about: Cebu City, officially the City of Cebu, is a  highly urbanized city in the Central Visayas region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 965,332 people, making it the sixth-most populated city in the country and the most populous in the Central Visayas Region and in the whole Visayas.
Q1467.img: Cebu downtown, capitol view from Tops Lookout (Cebu City; 09-06-2022).jpg

Q1473.name: Davao City
Q1473.about: Davao City, officially the City of Davao, is a highly urbanized city in the Davao Region, Philippines. The city has a total land area of 2,443.61 km2 (943.48 sq mi), making it the largest city in the Philippines in terms of land area.

Q1475.name: Quezon City
Q1475.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q1475.about: Quezon City (UK: , US: ; Filipino: Lungsod Quezon [luŋˈsod ˈkɛson] ), also known as the City of Quezon and Q.C. (read and pronounced in Filipino as Kyusi), is the most populous city in the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 3,084,270 people.
Q1475.img: Katipunan area with Eastwood (view from SMDC Blue) (Quezon City and Marikina)(2017-09-06).jpg

Q1478.name: Caloocan
Q1478.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q1478.about: Caloocan, officially the City of Caloocan (Filipino: Lungsod ng Caloocan/Kalookan; IPA: [kalɔˈʔokan]), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 1,712,945 people, making it the fourth-most populous city in the Philippines.

Q1479.name: Bordeaux
Q1479.desc: city and commune in Gironde, New Aquitaine, France
Q1479.about: Bordeaux ( bor-DOH; French: [bɔʁdo] ; Gascon Occitan: Bordèu [buɾˈðɛw]; Basque: Bordele) is a city on the river Garonne in the Gironde department, southwestern France. A port city, it is the capital of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, as well as the prefecture of the Gironde department.
Q1479.img: 138 - Place de la Bourse et le miroir d'eau - Bordeaux.jpg

Q1486.name: Buenos Aires
Q1486.desc: capital and largest city of Argentina
Q1486.about: Buenos Aires, officially the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, is the capital and largest city of Argentina. It is located on the southwest of the Río de la Plata.
Q1486.img: Vista aérea de la Plaza del Congreso 10.jpg

Q141724.name: Saint-Jérôme
Q141724.about: Saint-Jérôme (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃ ʒeʁom]) (2021 population 80,213) is a suburban city located about 45 kilometres (28 mi) northwest of Montreal on the Rivière du Nord. It is part of the North Shore sector of Greater Montreal.

Q141810.name: Laval
Q141810.about: Laval is a city in Quebec, Canada. It is in the southwest of the province, north of Montreal.

Q141844.name: Gatineau
Q141844.about: Gatineau ( GAT-in-oh; French: [ɡatino] ) is a city in southwestern Quebec, Canada. It is located on the northern bank of the Ottawa River, directly across from Ottawa, Ontario.

Q141881.name: Granby
Q141881.about: Granby (Canadian French: [ɡʁanbi]) is a town in the Estrie region of Quebec, and the administrative centre of the La Haute-Yamaska Regional County Municipality. The municipality had a population of 69,025 in the 2021 Canadian census, while the Granby census agglomeration had 90,833.

Q141940.name: Drummondville
Q141940.about: Drummondville (Canadian French: [dʁɔmɔndvil] ) is a city in the Centre-du-Québec region of Quebec, Canada, located east of Montreal on the Saint-François River. The population as of the Canada 2021 Census was 79,258.

Q141977.name: Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu
Q141977.about: Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃ ʒɑ̃ syʁ ʁiʃ(ə)ljø], lit. 'Saint-Jean on Richelieu') is a city in eastern Montérégie in the Canadian province of Quebec, about 40 kilometres (25 mi) southeast of Montreal, roughly halfway between Montreal and the Canada–United States border with the state of Vermont. It straddles the west and east banks of the Richelieu River (which is accompanied by a canal) at the northernmost navigable point of Lake Champlain.

Q142130.name: Liaozhong District
Q142130.about: Liaozhong District (simplified Chinese: 辽中区; traditional Chinese: 遼中區; pinyin: Liáozhōng Qū) is one of ten districts of the prefecture-level city of Shenyang, the capital of Liaoning Province, Northeast China. The name of the district literally means "Central Liao[ning]", referring to its central location within the province.

Q142312.name: Lunenburg County
Q142312.desc: county located on the South Shore of Nova Scotia
Q142312.about: Lunenburg County is a historical county and census division on the South Shore of the Canadian province of Nova Scotia. Major settlements include Bridgewater, Lunenburg, and Mahone Bay.

Q142369.name: Lancaster County
Q142369.about:
Lancaster County (; Pennsylvania German: Lengeschder Kaundi), sometimes nicknamed the Garden Spot of America or Pennsylvania Dutch Country, is a county in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, United States.
As of the 2020 census, the population was 552,984, making it Pennsylvania's sixth-most populous county.

Q1489.name: Mexico City
Q1489.desc: capital and largest city of Mexico
Q1489.about: Mexico City is the capital and  largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. It is one of the world's leading cultural and financial centers and, according to the Globalization and World Cities Research Network's 2024 ranking, is classified as an Alpha world city.

Q1490.name: Tokyo
Q1490.desc: capital and largest city of Japan
Q1490.about: Tokyo, officially the Tokyo Metropolis, is the capital and most populous city of Japan. The population of the city proper was over 14 million as of 2023.

Q142811.name: Allentown
Q142811.desc: city in and seat of Lehigh County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q142811.about: Allentown is a city in eastern Pennsylvania, United States. The county seat of Lehigh County, it is the third-most populous city in Pennsylvania, with a population of 125,845 as of the 2020 census.

Q143782.name: North Las Vegas
Q143782.desc: city in Clark County, Nevada, United States
Q143782.about: North Las Vegas is a suburban city in Clark County, Nevada, United States, in the Las Vegas Valley. As of the 2020 census, it had a population of 262,527, with an estimated population of 296,653 in 2025.

Q145006.name: West Baton Rouge Parish
Q145006.about: West Baton Rouge Parish (French: Paroisse de Bâton Rouge Ouest, Spanish: Parroquia del Oeste de Baton Rouge) is one of the sixty-four parishes in the U.S. state of Louisiana. Established in 1807, its parish seat is Port Allen.

Q146699.name: Zanjan
Q146699.about: Zanjan (Persian: زنجان; pronounced [zænˈdʒɒːn] ) is a city in the Central District of Zanjan County, Zanjan province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district.Zanjan's population boasts the highest level of happiness among the people of 30 other provinces in Iran, according to a detailed survey conducted by Isna.

Q146723.name: Kisangani
Q146723.desc: city in the Democratic Republic of Congo
Q146723.about: Kisangani (), formerly Stanleyville (Dutch: Stanleystad), is the capital of Tshopo Province, located on the Congo River in the eastern part of the central Congo Basin in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is the country's fifth-most populous urban area, with an estimated population of 1,602,144 as of 2016, and the largest of the cities in the tropical woodlands of the Congo.
Q146723.img: Kisangani rond-point Cathédrale et Congo Palace.jpg

Q146790.name: Aomori
Q146790.about: Aomori (青森, Aomori; Japanese pronunciation: [ä̀.ó̞.mò̞.ɾʲì], locally [ä̀.ó̞.mó̞.ɾʲí]), officially Aomori City (青森市, Aomori-shi; [ä̀.ó̞.mó̞.ɾʲí.ɕì]), is the capital city of Aomori Prefecture, in the Tōhoku region of Japan. As of 1 August 2023, the city had an estimated population of 264,945 in 136,781 households, and a population density of 321 people per square kilometer spread over the city's total area of 824.61 km2 (318.38 sq mi).

Q14960.name: Brno
Q14960.about: Brno ( BUR-noh, Czech pronunciation: [ˈbr̩no] ; German: Brünn [bʁʏn] ) is a city in the South Moravian Region of the Czech Republic. Located at the confluence of the Svitava and Svratka rivers, Brno has about 404,000 inhabitants, making it the second-largest city in the Czech Republic after the capital, Prague, and one of the 100 largest cities in the European Union.
Q14960.img: Brno, Štýřice, Pražákova, výhled z AZ Toweru (2013-05-22; 28).jpg

Q15379.name: Kendari
Q15379.desc: city in Southeast Sulawesi Province, Indonesia
Q15379.about: Kendari is the capital city of the Indonesian province of Southeast Sulawesi. It had a population of 289,966 at the 2010 Census and 345,107 at the 2020 census, making it the most populous city in the province, and the fourth most on Sulawesi.

Q1491.name: La Paz
Q1491.desc: capital city and seat of government of Bolivia
Q1491.about: La Paz (Spanish: [la ˈpas]; lit. 'the peace'), officially Nuestra Señora de La Paz (Aymara: Chuqi Yapu Aymara pronunciation: [ˈtʃoqɛ ˈjapʊ]), is the seat of government of Bolivia. With 755,732 residents as of 2024, it is the third-most populous city in Bolivia.

Q1492.name: Barcelona
Q1492.about: Barcelona is a city on the northeastern coast of Spain. It is the capital and largest city of the autonomous community of Catalonia, as well as the second-most populous municipality of Spain after Madrid.
Q1492.img: Aerial view of La Sagrada Familia, Barcelona, Spain (51227006134).jpg

Q147171.name: Zaoyang City
Q147171.desc: county-level city in Hubei, People's Republic of China
Q147171.about: Zaoyang (simplified Chinese: 枣阳; traditional Chinese: 棗陽; pinyin: Zǎoyáng) is a city in the north of Hubei province, People's Republic of China, bordering Henan province to the north. Administratively, it is a county-level city under the administration of Xiangyang.

Q147187.name: Zaozhuang
Q147187.about: Zaozhuang (simplified Chinese: 枣庄; traditional Chinese: 棗莊; pinyin: Zǎozhuāng) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Shandong province, People's Republic of China. Since January 2019 (after Laiwu prefecture got incorporated into Jinan prefecture), it has been the smallest prefecture-level city in the province, bordering Jining to the west and north, Linyi to the east, and the province of Jiangsu to the south.

Q147402.name: Zapopan
Q147402.desc: municipal seat of Zapopan, State of Jalisco, Mexico
Q147402.about: Zapopan (Latin American Spanish pronunciation: [saˈpopan]) is a city and municipality located in the Mexican state of Jalisco. It is part of the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area.

Q147738.name: Saint Helier
Q147738.desc: one of the twelve parishes and capital of Jersey in the Channel Islands
Q147738.about: St Helier ( ; Jèrriais: Saint Hélyi; French: Saint-Hélier) is the capital of Jersey, the largest of the Channel Islands in the English Channel. It is the most populous of the twelve parishes of Jersey, with a population of 35,822, over one-third of the island's total population.

Q147975.name: Zaria
Q147975.desc: city and local government area in Kaduna, Nigeria
Q147975.about: Zaria  (formerly Zazzau) is a metropolitan city in Nigeria, located within four local government areas in Kaduna State. It serves as the capital of the Zazzau Emirate Council and is one of the original seven Hausa city-states.

Q148062.name: Zarqa
Q148062.about: Zarqa (Arabic: الزرقاء) is the capital of Zarqa Governorate in Jordan. Its name means "the blue (city)".

Q151958.name: Yueyang
Q151958.about:
Yueyang, formerly known as Yuezhou or Baling, is a prefecture-level city on the eastern shores of Dongting Lake and the Yangtze river in the northeastern corner of Hunan Province in the People's Republic of China.
Yueyang has an administrative area of 14,896 km2 (5,751 sq mi) and the city proper, 304 km2 (117 sq mi).

Q152831.name: Duhok
Q152831.about: Duhok (Kurdish: دهۆک, romanized: Dihok; Arabic: دهوك, romanized: Dohūk; Syriac: ܒܝܬ ܢܘܗܕܪܐ, romanized: Beth Nohadra, Lishanid Noshan: דוהוך, romanized: Dohok) is a city in Kurdistan Region, Iraq and the capital city of Duhok Governorate.

Q14874689.name: Metropolis at Metrotown
Q14874689.desc: shopping mall complex in Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada
Q14874689.about: Metropolis at Metrotown (commonly referred to as Metrotown) is a three-storey shopping mall complex in the Metrotown area of Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada. Opened in 1986, it is the largest mall in British Columbia and the third-largest in Canada, behind Alberta's West Edmonton Mall and Ontario's Square One Shopping Centre, with 27 million customer visits annually.

Q14906254.name: Álvaro Obregón
Q14906254.about: Álvaro Obregón (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈalβaɾo oβɾeˈɣon]) is a borough (demarcación territorial) in Mexico City. It contains a large portion of the south-west part of Mexico City.

Q14920600.name: San Francisco Coacalco
Q14920600.desc: municipal seat of Coacalco, State of México, Mexico
Q14920600.about: Coacalco de Berriozábal (; simply known as Coacalco) is one of 125 municipalities in the State of Mexico, Mexico. The municipal seat is the city of San Francisco Coacalco.

Q15207942.name: Gauriganj
Q15207942.about: Gauriganj is a city, municipal corporation, tehsil and administrative headquarters of Amethi district in Ayodhya division, Uttar Pradesh, India. It is situated about 126 km from the state capital Lucknow.

Q1520.name: Astana
Q1520.about: Astana is the capital city of Kazakhstan. With a population of 1,7 million within the city limits, it is the second-largest in the country after Almaty,  the national capital until 1997.

Q1524.name: Athens
Q1524.desc: capital and largest city of Greece
Q1524.about: Athens is the capital and largest city of Greece. A significant coastal urban area in the Mediterranean, Athens is also the capital of the Attica region and is the southernmost capital on the European mainland.

Q1530.name: Baghdad
Q1530.about: Baghdad is the capital and the largest city of Iraq. It is located on the banks of the Tigris in central Iraq.

Q1349532.name: Division No. 7
Q1349532.about: Division No. 7 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q1349542.name: Division No. 13
Q1349542.about: Division No. 13 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q1349556.name: Division No. 20
Q1349556.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q1349556.about: Census Division No. 20 (Swan River) is a census division located within the Parkland Region of the province of Manitoba.

Q1349566.name: Division No. 9
Q1349566.about: Division No. 9, Canada, is one of the eighteen census divisions within the province of Saskatchewan, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q1350548.name: Division No. 2
Q1350548.about: Division No. 2 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q1357984.name: Shouguang
Q1357984.about: Shouguang (simplified Chinese: 寿光; traditional Chinese: 壽光; pinyin: Shòuguāng) is a county-level city in the north-central part of Shandong Province, China, situated on the southwest shore of Laizhou Bay. Under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Weifang, it has 1,139,454 people residing within the municipality and its surrounding towns and villages as of the 2010 Census, even though the built-up (or metro) area is much smaller.

Q1359251.name: Kaili City
Q1359251.about: Kaili (simplified Chinese: 凯里; traditional Chinese: 凱里; pinyin: Kǎilǐ, Hmu: Kad Linx) is a county-level city and the prefecture seat of Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, in southeastern Guizhou province, China. It is the center of Miao culture, hosting more than 120 festivals every year.

Q1359367.name: Xingyi
Q1359367.desc: county-level city and seat of Qianxinan Prefecture, Guizhou, China
Q1359367.about: Xingyi (simplified Chinese: 兴义; traditional Chinese: 興義; pinyin: Xīngyì) (Bouyei language: Xinyyiq siq) is a county-level city and seat of the Qianxinan Buyei and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, in the southwest of Guizhou Province, China. In March 2024, UNESCO designated the area a Global Geopark; the designation covers the cone karst peak forest at Wanfenglin, the Maling River gorge, and the Middle Triassic marine reptile fossils known as the Xingyi Fauna.

Q1362055.name: Xinmin
Q1362055.about: The city of Xinmin (Chinese: 新民; pinyin: Xīnmín; Wade–Giles: Hsin-min) is a county-level city of Liaoning Province, Northeast China, under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Shenyang. It contains the westernmost point of and is by far the most spacious of the county-level divisions of Shenyang City.

Q1362669.name: Kentwood
Q1362669.desc: city in Kent County, Michigan, United States
Q1362669.about: Kentwood is a city in Kent County in the U.S. state of Michigan. The population was 54,304 as of the 2020 census.

Q1508.name: Makati
Q1508.desc: highly urbanized city in Metro Manila, Philippines
Q1508.about: Makati (  mə-KAH-tee; Tagalog pronunciation: [mɐˈkaː.t̪ɪ]), officially the City of Makati (Filipino: Lungsod ng Makati), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. It is the country's leading center for finance, commerce, business, and diplomacy, and is home to numerous foreign embassies and diplomatic missions.

Q1513.name: Nagpur
Q1513.about: Nagpur is the largest and most populous city in central India. It is the second capital and the third-largest city of the Indian state Maharashtra.

Q1515.name: Abidjan
Q1515.desc: major city and economic capital of Côte d'Ivoire
Q1515.about: Abidjan ( AB-ih-JAHN, French: [abidʒɑ̃] ; N'ko: ߊߓߌߖߊ߲߬) is the seat of government, largest city and former capital of Ivory Coast. As of the 2021 census, Abidjan's population was 6.3 million, which is 21.5 percent of the overall population of the country, making it the sixth most populous city proper in Africa, after Lagos, Cairo, Kinshasa, Dar es Salaam, and Johannesburg.

Q1519.name: Abu Dhabi
Q1519.desc: capital city of the United Arab Emirates
Q1519.about:
Abu Dhabi is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, the seat of the Abu Dhabi Central Capital District and the UAE's second-most populous city, after Dubai. Situated on a T-shaped island, Abu Dhabi extends into the Persian Gulf from the central-western coast of the UAE.
Abu Dhabi is located on an island in the Persian Gulf, off the Central West Coast.

Q152891.name: Hamilton County
Q152891.about: Hamilton County is located in the southwestern corner of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 830,639, making it the third-most populous county in Ohio.

Q152902.name: Tanga
Q152902.about: Tanga  (Jiji la Tanga, in Swahili) is a historic city and the capital of Tanga Region. The city is located in the northern port city of Tanzania to the west of the Indian Ocean on Tanga Bay.

Q153251.name: Mesa County
Q153251.about: Mesa County is a county in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 155,703, making Mesa County the most populous county in western Colorado, and the 11th-most populous in the state.

Q1335508.name: Pengze County
Q1335508.about: Pengze County (simplified Chinese: 彭泽县; traditional Chinese: 彭澤縣; pinyin: Péngzé Xiàn) is a county in the north of Jiangxi Province, situated on the southeast (right) bank of the Yangtze. The northernmost county-level division of the province, it is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Jiujiang.

Q1337083.name: Pingyin County
Q1337083.about: Pingyin County (simplified Chinese: 平阴县; traditional Chinese: 平陰縣; pinyin: Píngyīn Xiàn) is under the administration of Jinan, the capital of Shandong province, People's Republic of China.  The ancient Kingdom of Jibei was located to the northeast of present-day Pingyin County.

Q1337818.name: Woodland Hills
Q1337818.desc: neighborhood in the city of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q1337818.about: Woodland Hills is a neighborhood bordering the Santa Monica Mountains in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles, California, United States.

Q1339902.name: Xiuying District
Q1339902.about: Xiuying (Chinese: 秀英区; pinyin: Xiùyīng Qū) is a district in Haikou City, Hainan. The district's total area is 512 square kilometers, and its population was 603,600 people in 2025.

Q1342831.name: Maskinongé
Q1342831.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1342831.about: Maskinongé (French pronunciation: [maskinɔ̃ʒe] ) is a regional county municipality in the Mauricie region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is Louiseville.

Q1342853.name: Pizhou
Q1342853.about: Pizhou (Chinese: 邳州; pinyin: Pīzhōu) is a county-level city under the administration of Xuzhou, Jiangsu province, China. As of 2020 it had a population of 1,462,563; it borders the Shandong prefecture-level cities of Linyi to the northeast and Zaozhuang to the northwest.

Q1344696.name: Enterprise
Q1344696.desc: census-designated place in Clark County, Nevada, United States
Q1344696.about: Enterprise  is an unincorporated town in the Las Vegas Valley in Clark County, Nevada, United States. The population was 221,831 at the 2020 U.S. census, up from 14,676 at the 2000 census.

Q1344902.name: Xinyi
Q1344902.desc: county-level city in Xuzhou, Jiangsu province, China
Q1344902.about: Xinyi (Chinese: 新沂; pinyin: Xīnyí; Wade–Giles: Hsin-i; lit. 'New Yi [River]') is a county-level city under the administration of Xuzhou, Jiangsu province, China.
Q1344902.img: 新沂市维多利亚娱乐广场 - panoramio.jpg

Q1346536.name: Puning
Q1346536.desc: PRC county-level city in the municipal region of Jieyang, in Guangdong province
Q1346536.about: Puning (simplified Chinese: 普宁; traditional Chinese: 普寧; pinyin: Pǔníng; Teochew: Pou2 leng5), officially Puning City, is a county-level city located in eastern Guangdong, China, under the administration of Jieyang. Nevertheless, its administrative power in economic matters is comparable to that of prefecture-level cities.
Q1346536.img: Skyline of Urban of Puning in Jan 2011.jpg

Q1349304.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q1349304.about: Division No. 7 (Brandon Area) is a census division located within the Westman Region in the south western area of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q1349328.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q1349328.about: Division No. 19, also informally known as North East Manitoba, is a census division within the Province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q1349342.about: Census Division No. 12 (Beausejour Area) is a census division located within the Eastman Region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q1349356.about: Division No. 6 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q1349451.about: Census Division No. 16 is a census division located within the Parklands Region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q1349461.about: Division No. 4 (Pilot Mound) is a census division located within the Pembina Valley Region in the south-central region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q1349521.about: Division No. 15 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q155277.name: Tlaquepaque
Q155277.desc: municipal seat of Tlaquepaque, State of Jalisco, Mexico
Q155277.about: Tlaquepaque (Spanish pronunciation: [tlakeˈpake]), officially San Pedro Tlaquepaque, is a city and the surrounding municipality in the Mexican state of Jalisco.

Q154814.name: Bandar Abbas
Q154814.about: Bandar Abbas (Persian: بندرعباس, pronounced [bænˌdæɹʔæbˈbɒːs] ) is a port city in the Central District of Bandar Abbas County, Hormozgan Province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district. Bandar Abbas is a port on the southern coast of the country, on the Persian Gulf.

Q154835.name: Mahilyow
Q154835.desc: city in Belarus, capital of Mahilyow region, on Dniapro River
Q154835.about: Mogilev, or Mahilyow, is a city in eastern Belarus. It is located on the Dnieper River, about 76 kilometres (47 miles) from the border with Russia's Smolensk Oblast and 105 km (65 miles) from Bryansk Oblast.

Q153881.name: Vineland
Q153881.desc: city in Cumberland County, New Jersey, United States
Q153881.about: Vineland  is a city and the most populous municipality in Cumberland County, within the U.S. state of New Jersey. Bridgeton and Vineland are the two principal cities of the Vineland-Bridgeton metropolitan statistical area, which encompasses those cities and all of Cumberland County for statistical purposes.

Q154462.name: Brookhaven
Q154462.desc: city in western DeKalb County, Georgia, United States
Q154462.about: Brookhaven, formerly North Atlanta, is a city in the northeastern suburbs of Atlanta that is located in western DeKalb County, Georgia, United States, directly northeast of Atlanta. On July 31, 2012, Brookhaven was approved in a referendum to become DeKalb County's 11th city.

Q154801.name: Komsomolsk-on-Amur
Q154801.desc: city in Komsomolsk-on-Amur Urban Okrug, Khabarovsk Krai, Russia
Q154801.about: Komsomolsk-on-Amur (Russian: Комсомольск-на-Амуре, romanized: Komsomolsk-na-Amure, IPA: [kəmsɐˈmolʲsk nɐ‿ɐˈmurʲə]) is the second-largest city in Khabarovsk Krai, Russia, located on the west bank of the Amur River in the Russian Far East. It is located on the Baikal-Amur Mainline, 356 kilometers (221 mi) northeast of Khabarovsk.

Q156156.name: New Castle County
Q156156.about: New Castle County is the northernmost of the three counties of the U.S. state of Delaware (New Castle, Kent, and Sussex). As of the 2020 census, the population was 570,719, making it the most populous county in Delaware, with nearly 60% of the state's population of 989,948.

Q156163.name: Baldwin County
Q156163.about: Baldwin County is a  county located in the southwestern part of the U.S. state of Alabama, on the Gulf coast. It is one of only two counties in Alabama that border the Gulf of Mexico, along with Mobile County.

Q156253.name: Columbia County
Q156253.about: Columbia County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 3,952, making it the second-least populous county in Washington.

Q156257.name: Allegany County
Q156257.about: Allegany County is a county located in the northwestern part of the U.S. state of Maryland. As of the 2020 census, the population was 68,106.

Q156265.name: San Juan County
Q156265.desc: county in New Mexico, United States
Q156265.about: San Juan County (Spanish: Condado de San Juan) is a county located in the U.S. state of New Mexico. As of the 2020 census, its population was 121,661, making it the fifth-most populous county in New Mexico.

Q156270.name: Eastland County
Q156270.about: Eastland County is a county located in central West Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 17,725.
Q156270.img: Eastland County, TX, Courthouse Eastland, TX IMG 6422.JPG

Q1563.name: Havana
Q1563.desc: capital and largest city of Cuba
Q1563.about: Havana (, US also ; Spanish: La Habana [la‿aˈβana] ) is the capital and largest city of Cuba. The heart of La Habana Province, Havana is the country's main port and commercial center.

Q156220.name: Douglas County
Q156220.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156220.about: Douglas County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, its population was 42,938.

Q156243.name: Sinuiju
Q156243.about: Sinŭiju (Korean: 신의주시; MR: Sinŭiju-si; IPA: [sʰinɰid͡zu sʰi]) is a city in North Korea which faces Dandong, Liaoning, China, across the international border of the Yalu River. It is the capital of North P'yŏngan province.

Q159260.name: Santa Clara
Q159260.desc: city in Santa Clara County, California, United States
Q159260.about: Santa Clara ( SAN-tə KLAR-ə; Spanish for 'Saint Clare') is a city in Santa Clara County, California, United States. Located in the southern San Francisco Bay Area, it was founded by the Spanish in 1777 with the establishment of Mission Santa Clara de Asís under the leadership of Junípero Serra.

Q159273.name: Arequipa
Q159273.desc: city of Peru, capital of Arequipa region
Q159273.about: Arequipa is a city in southern Peru and the capital of Arequipa Province and the Department of Arequipa. With a projected population of 1,195,700 in 2025, it is the country's second most populous city after Lima.

Q172.name: Toronto
Q172.desc: capital and largest city of the province of Ontario, Canada
Q172.about: Toronto is the most populous city in Canada and the capital city of the Canadian province of Ontario. It is located on a harbour at the northwestern shore of Lake Ontario.
Q172.img: Sunset Toronto Skyline Panorama Crop from Snake Island.jpg

Q156168.name: Autauga County
Q156168.about: Autauga County is a county located in the central portion of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census the population was 58,805.

Q156177.name: Amador County
Q156177.about: Amador County ( ) is a county located in the U.S. state of California, in the Sierra Nevada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 40,474.

Q156181.name: Butte County
Q156181.about: Butte County ( ) is a county located in the northern central part of the U.S. state of California. In the 2020 census, its population was 211,632.

Q156186.name: Del Norte County
Q156186.about: Del Norte County (; Spanish: [del ˈnoɾte]; Spanish for 'Of the North') is a county located at the far northwest corner of the U.S. state of California, along the Pacific Ocean adjacent to the Oregon border. Its population was 27,743 as of the 2020 census, down from 28,610 from the 2010 census.

Q156188.name: Trinity County
Q156188.desc: county in northwestern California, United States
Q156188.about: Trinity County is a county located in the northwestern portion of the U.S. state of California. Trinity County is rugged, mountainous, heavily forested, and lies along the Trinity River (for which it is named) within the Salmon, Klamath Mountains, as well as a portion of the Scott, Trinity, and North Yolla Bolly Mountains.

Q156191.name: Mariposa County
Q156191.about: Mariposa County ( ) is a county in the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 U.S. census, the population was 17,131.

Q156213.name: Sussex County
Q156213.about: Sussex County is a county in the southern part of the U.S. state of Delaware, on the Delmarva Peninsula. As of the 2020 census, the population was 237,378, making it the state's second most populated county behind New Castle and ahead of Kent.

Q156216.name: Benton County
Q156216.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156216.about: Benton County is a county in the south-central portion of the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, its population was 206,873.

Q157835.name: Zaporizhzhia
Q157835.desc: city and administrative centre of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Ukraine
Q157835.about: Zaporizhzhia, formerly known as Aleksandrovsk or Oleksandrivsk until 1921, is a city in southeast Ukraine, situated on the banks of the Dnieper River. It is the administrative centre of Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

Q158467.name: Gwalior
Q158467.about: Gwalior (pronounced [ɡʋɑːlɪjəɾ] ) is the fourth largest city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division. It is an important cultural, industrial, sports and political centre.

Q159232.name: Santa Cruz
Q159232.desc: city in and county seat of Santa Cruz County, California, United States
Q159232.about: Santa Cruz (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsanta ˈkɾus]; Spanish for 'Holy Cross') is the largest city in, and the county seat of, Santa Cruz County, California, United States. As of the 2020 census, the city population was 62,956.

Q1721.name: Wiesbaden
Q1721.desc: capital of the German state of Hesse
Q1721.about: Wiesbaden (German pronunciation: [ˈviːsˌbaːdn̩] ; lit. 'meadow baths') is the capital of the German state of Hesse, and the second-largest Hessian city after Frankfurt am Main. With around 283,000 inhabitants, it is Germany's 24th-largest city.

Q1726.name: Munich
Q1726.desc: capital and most populous city of Bavaria, Germany
Q1726.about: Munich (German: München [ˈmʏnçn̩] , Bavarian: Minga [ˈmɪŋ(ː)ɐ] ) is the capital and most populous city of the German state of Bavaria. As of 30 November 2024, its population was 1,604,384, making it the third most-populous city in Germany after Berlin and Hamburg.

Q156366.name: Mono County
Q156366.about: Mono County ( MOH-noh) is a county located in the east-central portion of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 United States census, its population was 13,195, making it the fourth-least populous county in California.

Q156370.name: Sierra County
Q156370.about: Sierra County ( ) is a county located in the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 3,236, making it California's second-least populous county.

Q156374.name: Siskiyou County
Q156374.about: Siskiyou County (  SISK-yoo) is a county in the northwest of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 44,076.

Q156377.name: Sutter County
Q156377.about: Sutter County is located in the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 99,633.

Q156380.name: Panola County
Q156380.about: Panola County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 22,491, with its county seat in Carthage.

Q161491.name: Reading
Q161491.desc: historic market town in the English county of Berkshire
Q161491.about: Reading (  RED-ing) is a town and borough in Berkshire, England, and the county town of Berkshire. It is Berkshire's largest town, with a total population of 203,795 in its built-up area as of 2021.

Q1624.name: Pasig
Q1624.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q1624.about: Pasig, officially the City of Pasig (Filipino: Lungsod ng Pasig), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 853,050 people.

Q1626.name: Hamburg-Mitte
Q1626.about: Hamburg-Mitte (German pronunciation: [ˈhambʊʁk ˈmɪtə], "Hamburg Central") is one of the seven boroughs of Hamburg, Germany, covering most of the city's urban center. The quarters of Hamburg-Altstadt and Neustadt cover much of the city's historic core.

Q1627.name: Hamburg-Nord
Q1627.about: Hamburg-Nord (German pronunciation: [ˈhambʊʁk ˈnɔʁt], "Hamburg North") is one of the seven boroughs of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, in northern Germany. In 2020, according to the residents registration office, the population was 315,514 in an area of 57.5 km2.

Q1629.name: Zamboanga
Q1629.about: Zamboanga City, officially the City of Zamboanga (Chavacano/Spanish: Ciudad de Zamboanga; Subanen: Bagbenwa Sembwangan; Sama: Lungsud Samboangan; Tausug: Daira sin Sambuwangan; Filipino: Lungsod ng Zamboanga; Cebuano: Dakbayan sa Zamboanga), is a  highly urbanized city in the Zamboanga Peninsula region of the Philippines, with a total population of 1.02 million inhabitants. It is the third-largest city by land area in the Philippines, and is also the sixth-most populous city in the archipelago; additionally, it is the second most populous in Mindanao after Davao City.
Q1629.img: Zamboanga City from Garden Orchid Hotel.jpg

Q1630.name: Altona
Q1630.about: Altona (German: [ˈaltonaː] ), also called Hamburg-Altona, is the westernmost urban borough (Bezirk) of the German city state of Hamburg. Located on the right bank of the Elbe river, Altona had a population of 270,263 in 2016.

Q1632.name: Eimsbüttel
Q1632.about: Eimsbüttel (German pronunciation: [ˈaɪmsˌbʏtl̩] ) is one of the seven boroughs (Bezirke) of Hamburg, Germany. In 2020, the borough had a population of 269,118.

Q1636.name: Antipolo
Q1636.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Rizal
Q1636.about: Antipolo, officially the City of Antipolo (Filipino: Lungsod ng Antipolo), is a component city and capital of the province of Rizal, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 913,712 people.
Q1636.img: José Rizal statue in front of Antipolo City Hall - 1.jpg

Q1643.name: Taguig
Q1643.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q1643.about: Taguig (Tagalog: [taˈɡiɡ] ), officially the City of Taguig (Filipino: Lungsod ng Taguig), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 1,308,085 people, making it the fifth most populous city in the country.

Q1645.name: Cagayan de Oro
Q1645.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Misamis Oriental
Q1645.about: Cagayan de Oro (CDO), officially the City of Cagayan de Oro, is a highly urbanized city in the Northern Mindanao region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 741,617 people, making it the 10th most populous city in the Philippines and the most populous in Northern Mindanao.
Q1645.img: CDO CM Recto-Corrales skyline alt (Cagayan De Oro City; 12-08-2023).jpg

Q156273.name: Adams County
Q156273.about: Adams County is a county in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,613.

Q156276.name: Cowlitz County
Q156276.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156276.about: Cowlitz County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, its population was 110,730.

Q156278.name: Smith County
Q156278.about: Smith County is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 233,479.

Q156287.name: Clark County
Q156287.about: Clark County is the southernmost county in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 503,311, making it Washington's fifth-most populous county.

Q156291.name: Allegheny County
Q156291.desc: county in southwestern Pennsylvania, United States
Q156291.about: Allegheny County ( AL-ig-AY-nee) is a large urban county in Pennsylvania, United States. As of the 2025 census estimate, the population was 1,225,035, a 2% decrease of 25,543 residents since 2020, making it the state's second-most populous county, after Philadelphia County.

Q156295.name: Asotin County
Q156295.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156295.about: Asotin County () is a county in the far southeastern corner of the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 22,285.

Q156297.name: Bernalillo County
Q156297.desc: county in New Mexico, United States
Q156297.about: Bernalillo County () is the most populous county in the U.S. state of New Mexico. As of the 2020 census, the population was 676,444.

Q156306.name: Clallam County
Q156306.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156306.about: Clallam County is a county in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 77,155, with an estimated population of 77,616 in 2023.

Q156340.name: Lassen County
Q156340.about: Lassen County (  LASS-ən) is a county located in the northeastern portion of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 32,730.

Q156342.name: Plumas County
Q156342.about: Plumas County ( ) is a county located in the Sierra Nevada of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 19,790.
Q156342.img: Quincy, California from Q on mountain..JPG

Q159288.name: Santa Barbara
Q159288.desc: city in and county seat of Santa Barbara County, California, United States
Q159288.about: Santa Barbara (Spanish: Santa Bárbara, meaning 'Saint Barbara') is a coastal city in Santa Barbara County, California, of which it is also the county seat. Situated on a south-facing section of coastline, the longest such section on the West Coast of the United States excepting Alaska, the city lies between the steeply rising Santa Ynez Mountains and the Pacific Ocean.

Q1686.name: Butuan
Q1686.about: Butuan (pronounced ), officially the City of Butuan (Cebuano: Dakbayan sa Butuan; Butuanon: Dakbayan hong Butuan; Filipino: Lungsod ng Butuan), is a highly urbanized city and the regional center of Caraga, Philippines. It is the de facto capital of the province of Agusan del Norte where it is geographically situated but has an administratively independent government.

Q1707.name: Kiel
Q1707.about: Kiel ( KEEL; German: [kiːl] ) is the capital and most populous city in the northern German state of Schleswig-Holstein. With a population of around 250,000, it is Germany's largest city on the Baltic Sea.

Q1718.name: Düsseldorf
Q1718.desc: capital city of the German federated state of North Rhine-Westphalia
Q1718.about: Düsseldorf (German: [ˈdʏsl̩dɔʁf] ) is the capital city of North Rhine-Westphalia, the most populous state of Germany. It is the second-largest city in the state after Cologne and the seventh-largest city in Germany, with a 2025 population of 619,444.

Q156346.name: Tuolumne County
Q156346.about: Tuolumne County ( ), officially the County of Tuolumne, is a county located in the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 55,620.

Q156350.name: Shasta County
Q156350.about: Shasta County ( ), officially the County of Shasta, is a county located in the northern portion of the U.S. state of California. Its population is 182,155 as of the 2020 census, up from 177,223 recorded in 2010.

Q156353.name: Placer County
Q156353.about: Placer County ( PLASS-ər), officially the County of Placer, is located in the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 404,739.

Q156358.name: Kings County
Q156358.about: Kings County is a county located in the U.S. state of California. The population was 152,486 at the 2020 census.

Q156361.name: Lake County
Q156361.about: Lake County is a county located in the north central portion of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 68,163.

Q159835.name: Batman
Q159835.desc: central district and city in Batman Province, Turkey
Q159835.about: Batman (Kurdish: Êlih; Syriac: Elīḥā) is a city and capital of Batman District in Batman Province, Turkey. It lies on a plateau, 540 meters (1,772 feet) above sea level, near the confluence of the Batman River and the Tigris and had a population of 452,157 in 2021.

Q160320.name: Dammam
Q160320.desc: port city in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
Q160320.about: Dammam (Arabic: الدمام, romanized: ad-Dammām) is the seat and largest city of the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. An industrial port city on the coast of the Persian Gulf, it had a population of 1,386,166 as of 2022, making it the country's fifth-largest city after Riyadh, Jeddah, Mecca, and Medina.

Q160450.name: Samsun
Q160450.about: Samsun is a city on the north coast of Turkey and a major Black Sea port. The urban area recorded a population of 738,692 in 2022.

Q160750.name: Pachuca
Q160750.desc: capital of the Mexican state of Hidalgo
Q160750.about: Pachuca (Spanish pronunciation: [paˈtʃuka] ; Mezquital Otomi: Nju̱nthe), formally known as Pachuca de Soto, is the capital and largest city of the east-central Mexican state of Hidalgo, located in the south-central part of the state. Pachuca de Soto is also the name of the municipality for which the city serves as municipal seat.
Q160750.img: Reloj Monumental, Pachuca, Hidalgo, México, 2013-10-10, DD 06.JPG

Q161176.name: Fukushima
Q161176.about: Fukushima (福島市, Fukushima-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ɸɯ̥̈.kɯ̈́.ɕì.mä̀, -ɕí.mä́.ɕì]) is the capital city of Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It is located in the northern part of the Nakadōri or central region of the prefecture.

Q16552.name: San Diego
Q16552.desc: seat of San Diego County, California, United States; second-largest city in California
Q16552.about: San Diego (  SAN dee-AY-goh; Spanish: [san ˈdjeɣo]) is a city on the Pacific coast of Southern California, next to the Mexican border. It is the eighth-most populous city in the U.S. and second-most populous city in California with a population of over 1.4 million, while the San Diego area with over 3.3 million residents is the 18th-largest metropolitan area in the country.

Q16553.name: San Jose
Q16553.desc: city and county seat of Santa Clara County, California, United States
Q16553.about: San Jose, officially the City of San José (  SAN hoh-ZAY, -⁠SAY; Spanish: [saŋ xoˈse]), is the most populous city in the San Francisco Bay Area and Northern California, and the 13th-most populous in the United States, with an estimated 989,814 residents as of 2025. The city's metropolitan area is home to nearly two million people, while the broader combined statistical area (the fifth-largest in the United States) has a population of over nine million.

Q16554.name: Denver
Q16554.desc: consolidated city-county and capital of the U.S. state of Colorado
Q16554.about: Denver  (  DEN-vər), officially the City and County of Denver, is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Colorado. Officially a consolidated city and county, it is located in the South Platte River valley on the western edge of the High Plains, and is just east of the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains (Rockies).

Q156448.name: Clark County
Q156448.about: Clark County is a rural county in the U.S. state of Idaho; its county seat and largest city is Dubois. As of the 2020 census, the population was 790, making it the least populous county in the state.

Q156452.name: Carbon County
Q156452.about: Carbon County is a county in the U.S. state of Wyoming. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 14,537.

Q156455.name: Nacogdoches County
Q156455.about: Nacogdoches County ( NAK-ə-DOH-chiss) is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 64,653.

Q156459.name: Pierce County
Q156459.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156459.about: Pierce County is a county in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 921,130, and was estimated to be 946,288 in 2025, making it the second-most populous county in Washington, behind King County, and the 60th-most populous in the United States.
Q156459.img: Old City Hall in Tacoma, WA 2.jpg

Q156463.name: Mills County
Q156463.about: Mills County is located in Texas, United States. It was created on March 15, 1887, from parts of four existing counties in Central Texas—Brown, Comanche, Hamilton, and Lampasas—and named after John T. Mills.

Q156464.name: Moore County
Q156464.about: Moore County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 21,358.

Q162548.name: Oskemen
Q162548.about: Öskemen (Kazakh: Өскемен [ʉ̯ɵskʲeˈmʲen] ) or Ust-Kamenogorsk (Russian: Усть-Каменогорск, IPA: [ˌʊsʲtʲ kəmʲɪnɐˈgorsk]) is the largest city in eastern Kazakhstan and the administrative center of the East Kazakhstan Region.

Q162560.name: Loup County
Q162560.about: Loup County is a county in the U.S. state of Nebraska. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 607, making it Nebraska's fifth-least populous county and the tenth-least populous county in the United States.

Q162880.name: Dezhou
Q162880.about: Dezhou (Chinese: 德州; pinyin: Dézhōu) is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Shandong province, People's Republic of China. It borders the provincial capital of Jinan to the southeast, Liaocheng to the southwest, Binzhou to the northeast, and the province of Hebei to the north.

Q163097.name: Greene County
Q163097.about: Greene County is a county in Virginia in the eastern United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,552.

Q163132.name: Akron
Q163132.desc: city in and seat of Summit County, Ohio, United States
Q163132.about: Akron () is a city in Summit County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. It is located in Northeast Ohio along the Little Cuyahoga River, approximately 40 miles (64 km) south of Cleveland.
Q163132.img: Downtown skyline as seen from Ohio & Erie Canalway at Martin Luther King Boulevard, Akron, Ohio - 20200530.jpg

Q15674.name: Kagoshima
Q15674.about: Kagoshima (鹿児島市, Kagoshima-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [kä̀.ɡó̞.ɕí.mä́(.ɕì), -ŋó̞-], locally [kä̀.ɡó̞ɕ.mä̀, -ɡò̞ɕ.mä́.ɕì]), is the capital city of Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. As of 31 July 2024, the city had an estimated population of 583,966 in 285,992 households, and a  population density of 1100 persons per km2.

Q15826.name: Palu
Q15826.desc: city in Central Sulawesi Province, Indonesia
Q15826.about: Palu, officially known as the City of Palu (Indonesian: Kota Palu; pronounced [ˌkot̪a ˈpalu]), is the capital and largest city of Central Sulawesi Province in Indonesia. Palu is located on the northwestern coast of Sulawesi at the mouth of the long Palu River, whose extensive valley stretches far to the south (including the Lore Lindu National Park).

Q15847.name: Manado
Q15847.desc: city in North Sulawesi Province, Indonesia
Q15847.about: Manado (Indonesian pronunciation: [maˈnado], Minahasan: Wenang) is the capital city of the Indonesian province of North Sulawesi.  It is the second largest city in Sulawesi after Makassar, with the 2020 census giving a population of 451,916, and the official estimates for mid 2025 showing 462,658 inhabitants (232,553 males and 230,105 females), distributed over a land area of 162.35 km2.

Q16461.name: Nanaimo
Q16461.desc: city on Vancouver Island in British Columbia, Canada
Q16461.about: Nanaimo ( nə-NY-moh) is a city on the east coast of Vancouver Island, in British Columbia, Canada. The city lies on the western shores of the eponymous Nanaimo Harbour, for which it has become known as the "Harbour City".

Q156385.name: Park County
