Q163749.name: West Palm Beach
Q163749.desc: county seat of Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q163749.about: West Palm Beach (WPB) is a city in and the county seat of Palm Beach County, Florida, United States. It is located immediately to the west of the adjacent Palm Beach, which is situated on a barrier island across the Lake Worth Lagoon.
Q163749.img: West Palm Beach Aerial November 2014 photo Don Ramey Logan.jpg

Q163798.name: Thrissur
Q163798.about: Thrissur (Malayalam: തൃശൂർ, pronounced [triˈʃ(ː)uːr] ), formerly Trichur, also known by its historical name Thrissivaperur (Thiru-siva-perur), is a city and the headquarters of the Thrissur district in Kerala, India. It is the third largest urban agglomeration in Kerala after Kochi and Kozhikode, and the 21st largest in India.

Q164234.name: Kawasaki
Q164234.about: Kawasaki, officially Kawasaki City, is a city in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, one of the main cities of the Greater Tokyo Area and Keihin Industrial Area. It is the second most populated city in Kanagawa Prefecture after Yokohama, and the eighth most populated city in Japan (including the Tokyo Metropolitan Area).

Q171810.name: Alanya
Q171810.desc: district and town in Antalya, Turkey
Q171810.about: Alanya ( ə-LAHN-yə; Turkish pronunciation: [aˈɫanja] ), formerly Alaiye, is a beach resort city, a municipality and district of Antalya Province, Turkey. It is on the southern coast of Turkey, in the country's Mediterranean Region, 133 kilometres (83 mi) east of the city of Antalya.

Q172996.name: George Town
Q172996.desc: capital and largest city of the Cayman Islands
Q172996.about: George Town is the capital and largest city in the Cayman Islands, located on Grand Cayman. It was named after King George III. As of 2025, the city had a population of 47,009, making it the largest city (by population) of all the British Overseas Territories.

Q1546177.name: Grey County
Q1546177.desc: county of the Canadian province of Ontario
Q1546177.about: Grey County is a county in the province of Ontario. The county is located in the Southwestern Ontario region, and is a part of the Georgian Triangle.

Q1557691.name: Guédiawaye
Q1557691.about: Guédiawaye is a city in the Guédiawaye Department of the Dakar Region of Senegal.  Lying on the Atlantic Ocean to the northeast of Dakar city centre, in 2013 it had a population of 329,659.

Q1561403.name: Yei
Q1561403.about:
Yei River County is an administrative area in Central Equatoria with a large population of people who settled in that particular county.
Aggrey Cyrus Kanyikwa is the current commissioner for Yei River County.

Q1571033.name: Haliburton County
Q1571033.about: Haliburton is a county of Ontario, Canada, known as a tourist and cottage area in Central Ontario for its scenery and for its resident artists. Minden Hills is the county seat.

Q1580709.name: Thembisa
Q1580709.about: Thembisa, formerly Tembisa, is a large township situated to the north of Kempton Park on the East Rand, Gauteng, South Africa. It was established in 1957 when black people were resettled from Alexandra and other areas in Edenvale, Kempton Park, Midrand and Germiston.

Q1583289.name: Hempstead
Q1583289.desc: town in Nassau County, New York, United States, suburb of NYC
Q1583289.about: Hempstead is the most populous town in the state of New York. It is the largest of the three towns within Nassau County (alongside North Hempstead and Oyster Bay), located on Long Island, immediately east of southern Queens.

Q1588807.name: Hastings County
Q1588807.about: Hastings County is a county and census division of the Canadian province of Ontario. Geographically, it is located on the border of Eastern Ontario and Central Ontario.

Q1612609.name: Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles
Q1612609.about: Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles (French pronunciation: [ʁivjɛʁ de pʁɛʁi pwɛ̃t o tʁɑ̃bl]) is a borough (arrondissement) on the eastern tip of the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada.  It is located at the eastern end of the Island of Montreal.

Q1631665.name: Sunshine Coast Regional District
Q1631665.about: The Sunshine Coast Regional District is a regional district in British Columbia, Canada. It is located on the southern mainland coast, across Georgia Strait (part of the Salish Sea) from Vancouver Island.

Q1635606.name: Temara
Q1635606.about:
Temara (Arabic: تمارة; Standard Moroccan Tamazight: ⵜⵎⴰⵔⴰ) is a coastal city in Morocco.
It is located in the region of Rabat-Salé-Kénitra, directly south of Rabat on the Atlantic coast, in the suburban area of the capital.

Q1638386.name: Kenora District
Q1638386.about: Kenora District is a district and census division in Northwestern Ontario, Canada. The district seat is the City of Kenora.

Q1638493.name: Huron County
Q1638493.about: Huron County ( HURE-on, -⁠ən) is a county in the Canadian province of Ontario. It is located on the southeast shore of its namesake, Lake Huron, in the southwest part of the province.

Q1639083.name: Nepean
Q1639083.desc: neighbourhood in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, former municipality
Q1639083.about: Nepean ( nə-PEE-ən) is an area of Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Located west of Ottawa's inner core, it was an independent city until amalgamated with the Regional Municipality of Ottawa–Carleton in 2001 to become the new city of Ottawa.

Q1639492.name: Rajahmundry
Q1639492.desc: city in East Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q1639492.about: Rajamahendravaram, previously known as Rajahmundry ( RAH-juh-mun-dree), is a city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh and the district headquarters of the East Godavari district. It is the seventh most populated city in the state.
Q1639492.img: Rail Cum Road Bridge on Godavari at Rajahmundry.jpg

Q1640079.name: Hyderabad
Q1640079.about: Hyderabad, also known as Neroonkot, is the capital and largest city of the Hyderabad Division in the Sindh province of Pakistan. It is the second-largest city in Sindh, after Karachi, and the 7th largest in Pakistan.
Q1640079.img: PK Hyderabad asv2020-02 img29 Pakka Qila Road.jpg

Q1645069.name: Noblesville

Q1645069.about: Noblesville is a city in and the county seat of Hamilton County, Indiana, United States, a part of the north Indianapolis suburbs along the White River. The population was 69,604 at the 2020 census, making it the state's 10th most populous city, up from 14th in 2010.

Q1650454.name: Chicopee
Q1650454.desc: city in Hampden County, Massachusetts, United States
Q1650454.about: Chicopee ( CHIK-ə-pee) is a city located on the Connecticut River in Hampden County, Massachusetts, United States. At the 2020 census, the city had a population of 55,560, making it the second-largest city in western Massachusetts after Springfield.

Q1657003.name: Gajuwaka
Q1657003.desc: neighborhood in Gajuwaka mandalam of Visakhapatnam district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q1657003.about: Gajuwaka is a major residential area of Visakhapatnam City, India. This neighborhood of Visakhapatnam is considered the biggest shopping district in Andhra Pradesh by revenue.

Q1658159.name: Ikorodu
Q1658159.about: Ikorodu is a city and Local government area in Lagos State, Nigeria.  It is located to the north-east of Lagos, along the Lagos Lagoon and shares boundary with Ogun State.

Q1659468.name: Beauport
Q1659468.desc: borough in Quebec City, Quebec, Canada, former city
Q1659468.about:
Beauport (French pronunciation: [bopɔʁ]) is a borough of Quebec City, Quebec, Canada on the Saint Lawrence River.
Beauport is a northeastern suburb of Quebec City.

Q1660491.name: Charlesbourg
Q1660491.desc: borough in Quebec City, Quebec, Canada, former city
Q1660491.about: Charlesbourg (French pronunciation: [ʃaʁləbuʁ]) is a borough of Quebec City, in the northeastern part of the city, west of the borough of Beauport.

Q1660549.name: Allapattah
Q1660549.desc: neighborhood in Miami, Florida, United States of America
Q1660549.about: Allapattah is a neighborhood, located mostly in the city of Miami, Florida in metropolitan Miami. As of May 2011, the county-owned portion of Allapattah, from State Road 9 to LeJeune Road, is being annexed by the city proper.

Q1661516.name: Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen
Q1661516.about: The Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen (RDOS) is in southern British Columbia, adjacent to the U.S. state of Washington. It is bounded by Fraser Valley Regional District to the west, Thompson-Nicola Regional District and Regional District of Central Okanagan to the north, Regional District of Kootenay Boundary to the east, and by Okanogan County, Washington to the south.

Q1665608.name: Iwo
Q1665608.desc: city and LGA in Osun State, Nigeria
Q1665608.about: Iwo () is a city in Osun State, Nigeria. The Iwo people, like all other people of the Yoruba kingdom, are believed to have originated from Ile-Ife, where they migrated sometime in the 11th century according to Alademomi Kenyon and Prince Adelegan Adegbola (2009).

Q1670967.name: Kings County
Q1670967.about: Kings County  is located in southern New Brunswick, Canada. Its historical shire town is Hampton, and it was named as an expression of loyalty to the British Crown.

Q1673881.name: Iseyin

Q1700010.name: Regional District of Central Kootenay

Q1723642.name: Kanata
Q1723642.desc: neighbourhood in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, former municipality
Q1723642.about: Kanata (, kə-NAT-ə) is a satellite community and former city within Ottawa, Ontario. It is located about 22 km (14 mi) west of the city's downtown core.

Q16563.name: Memphis
Q16563.desc: city in and county seat of Shelby County, Tennessee, United States
Q16563.about: Memphis (, MEM-fis) is a city in Shelby County, Tennessee, United States, and its county seat. Situated along the Mississippi River, it had a population of 633,104 at the 2020 census, making it the second-most populous city in Tennessee, the fifth-most populous in the Southeast, and the 29th-most populous in the US. While being the most populous single municipality on the Mississippi River, Memphis anchors the third largest metropolitan area by population behind only the Twin Cities and St.

Q16565.name: Charlotte
Q16565.desc: city in and county seat of Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, United States
Q16565.about: Charlotte is the most populous city in the U.S. state of North Carolina. With a population of 874,579 at the 2020 census, it is the 14th-most populous city in the U.S., seventh-most populous city in the South, and second-most populous city in the Southeast (after Jacksonville, Florida).

Q16567.name: Columbus
Q16567.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Ohio and seat of Franklin County, also located in Delaware and Fairfield counties
Q16567.about: Columbus ( kə-LUM-bəs) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Ohio. With a population of 905,748 at the 2020 census, it is the 14th-most populous city in the U.S., second-most populous city in the Midwest (after Chicago), and third-most populous U.S. state capital (after Phoenix, Arizona, and Austin, Texas).

Q16568.name: Jacksonville
Q16568.desc: city in Duval County, and largest city in State of Florida, United States
Q16568.about: Jacksonville (US:  , JAK-sən-vil), colloquially nicknamed Jax, is the most populous city proper in the U.S. state of Florida, located on the Atlantic coast of northeastern Florida. It is the county seat of Duval County, with which the city consolidated in 1968.

Q156619.name: Cook County
Q156619.about: Cook County is the easternmost county in the U.S. state of Minnesota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,600, making it Minnesota's seventh-least populous county.

Q156623.name: Whatcom County
Q156623.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156623.about: Whatcom County (, ) is a county located in the northwestern corner of the U.S. state of Washington, bordered by the Lower Mainland (the Metro Vancouver and Fraser Valley Regional Districts) of the Canadian province of British Columbia to the north, Okanogan County to the east, Skagit County to the south, San Juan County across Rosario Strait to the southwest, and the Strait of Georgia to the west. Its county seat and largest population center is the coastal city of Bellingham.

Q156628.name: Black Hawk County
Q156628.about: Black Hawk County is a county in the northeastern part of the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 131,144, making it Iowa's fifth-most populous county.

Q156629.name: Yakima County
Q156629.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q156629.about: Yakima County is a county in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, its population was 256,728.

Q167280.img: Iuliu Maniu Ave and Valea Cascadelor St, Sector 6 (Bucharest).JPG

Q167551.name: Gitega
Q167551.about: Gitega (French pronunciation: [ɡiteɡa]), formerly Kitega, is the political capital of Burundi. Located in the centre of the country, in the Burundian central plateau roughly 62 kilometres (39 mi) east of Bujumbura, the largest city and former political capital, Gitega is the country's fourth largest city and former royal capital of the Kingdom of Burundi until its abolition in 1966.

Q16558.name: Fort Worth
Q16558.desc: city and county seat of Tarrant County, Texas, United States
Q16558.about: Fort Worth is a city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the county seat of Tarrant County, covering nearly 350 square miles (910 km2) and extending into Denton, Johnson, Parker, and Wise counties.

Q16559.name: Austin
Q16559.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Texas and seat of Travis County
Q16559.about: Austin (  AW-stin) is the capital city of the U.S. state of Texas. With a population of 961,855 at the 2020 census, it is the 12th-most populous city in the U.S., fifth-most populous city in Texas, and second-most populous U.S. state capital (after Phoenix, Arizona), while the Austin metro area with an estimated 2.55 million residents is the 25th-largest metropolitan area in the nation.

Q16562.name: El Paso
Q16562.desc: city in and county seat of El Paso County, Texas, United States
Q16562.about: El Paso (English:  ; Spanish: [el ˈpaso] , lit. 'the route' or 'the pass') is a city in and the county seat of El Paso County, Texas, United States. It is the 23rd-most populous city in the U.S., sixth-most populous city in Texas, and the most populous city in West Texas with a population of 678,815 at the 2020 census.

Q156575.name: Coahoma County
Q156575.about: Coahoma County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,390.

Q156577.name: Bradford County
Q156577.about: Bradford County is a county in the north central region of the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 28,303.

Q156580.name: Clay County

Q156580.img: Clay County Courthouse in Fort Gaines Georgia.jpg

Q156582.name: Irion County
Q156582.about: Irion County ( EYE-ree-ən) is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,513.

Q156613.name: Young County
Q156613.about: Young County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 17,867.
Q156613.img: Young County courthouse in Graham, Texas.jpg

Q156618.name: Sterling County
Q156618.about: Sterling County is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,372, making it the ninth-least populous county in Texas.

Q166304.name: Billings
Q166304.desc: city in and county seat of Yellowstone County, Montana, United States
Q166304.about: Billings is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Montana, and the 253rd most populous city in the United States. The population was 117,116 at the 2020 census, while the Billings metropolitan area has an estimated 193,000 people.

Q166771.name: Jizhou District
Q166771.about: Jizhou (Chinese: 冀州), formerly Ji County (冀县), is a district in Hengshui, Hebei Province, China. It shares its name with a province of old, Jizhou or Ji Province, which covered parts of modern-day Hebei, Henan, and Shandong Provinces.

Q166824.name: Afyonkarahisar
Q166824.desc: central district and city in Afyonkarahisar Province, Turkey
Q166824.about: Afyonkarahisar (Turkish pronunciation: [ɑfˌjon.kɑˈɾɑhisɑɾ], Turkish: afyon 'poppy, opium', kara 'black', hisar 'fortress') is a major city in western Turkey. It is the administrative centre of Afyonkarahisar Province and Afyonkarahisar District.

Q167024.name: Basse-Terre
Q167024.desc: French commune and capital city of Guadeloupe
Q167024.about: Basse-Terre (, bas-TAIR; French: [bɑstɛʁ] ; Guadeloupean Creole: Bastè [bastɛ]) is a commune in the French overseas department of Guadeloupe, in the Lesser Antilles. It is also the prefecture (capital city) of Guadeloupe.

Q16039783.name: Karimnagar
Q16039783.desc: city in Karimnagar district, Telangana, India

Q16556.name: Phoenix
Q16556.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Arizona and seat of Maricopa County
Q16556.about: Phoenix (  FEE-niks) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Arizona. With over 1.6 million residents at the 2020 census, Phoenix is the fifth-most populous city in the United States and the most populous state capital.

Q16557.name: Dallas
Q16557.desc: city in the state of Texas, United States
Q16557.about: Dallas is a city in the U.S. state of Texas. Located in northern Texas, it is the ninth-most populous city in the United States and third-most populous city in Texas, with a population of 1.3 million at the 2020 census.

Q156496.name: Houston County

Q156500.name: Butler County

Q156503.name: Coffee County

Q156566.name: Rensselaer County

Q156566.about: Rensselaer County  ren-sə-LEER is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 161,130, its highest decennial count ever.

Q164380.about: Bethlehem is a city in Northampton and Lehigh counties in the Lehigh Valley region of eastern Pennsylvania, United States. As of the 2020 census, Bethlehem had a total population of 75,781, making it the second-largest city in the Lehigh Valley after Allentown and the seventh-largest city in the state.
Q164380.img: View of Widow's House from church belltower.jpg

Q164603.name: Floyd County
Q164603.about: Floyd County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. Its county seat is New Albany.

Q165204.name: Mérida
Q165204.about: Mérida (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmeɾiða] ; Yucatec Maya: Joꞌ) is the capital and largest city of the Mexican state of Yucatán. The city is also the seat of the eponymous municipality.

Q165857.name: Tokorozawa
Q165857.about: Tokorozawa (所沢市, Tokorozawa-shi) is a city located in Saitama Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 February 2024, the city had an estimated population of 343,298 in 168,939 households and a population density of 4761 persons per km2.

Q165972.name: Fort Lauderdale
Q165972.desc: city in and seat of Broward County, Florida, United States
Q165972.about: Fort Lauderdale () is a coastal city located in the U.S. state of Florida, 30 miles (48 km) north of Miami along the Atlantic Ocean. It is the seat of government of and most populous city in Broward County with a population of 182,760 at the 2020 census, making it the tenth-most populous city in Florida.

Q16572.name: Guangzhou
Q16572.desc: capital city of Guangdong Province, China
Q16572.about: Guangzhou, also known as Canton, is the capital and largest city of Guangdong in southern China. Located on the Pearl River, about 120 kilometres (75 mi) northwest of Hong Kong and 145 kilometres (90 mi) north of Macau, Guangzhou has a history of over 2,200 years and was a major terminus of the Silk Road.

Q16666.name: Nanjing
Q16666.desc: capital city of Jiangsu Province, China, former capital of the Republic of China and China's Ming dynasty
Q16666.about: Nanjing is the capital of Jiangsu province in China. The city, which is located in the southwestern corner of the province, has 11 districts, an administrative area of 6,600 square kilometres (2,500 sq mi), and as of 2021 a population of 9,423,400.

Q156632.name: Calhoun County
Q156632.about: Calhoun County is a rural county in the southwestern part of the U.S. state of Georgia. Its county seat is Morgan and its population was 5,573 in 2020.

Q156634.name: Decatur County
Q156634.about: Decatur County () is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,645.

Q156637.name: Effingham County
Q156637.about: Effingham County ( EFF-ing-ham) is a county located in the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 64,769.

Q156639.name: Sac County
Q156639.about: Sac County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 9,814.

Q156642.name: Ida County
Q156642.about: Ida County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census the population was 7,005, making it the state's eighth-least populous county.

Q156643.name: Escambia County
Q156643.about: Escambia County is the westernmost and oldest county in the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 321,905.

Q156647.name: Howard County
Q156647.about: Howard County is a county located in the US state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 9,469.

Q156650.name: Brantley County
Q156650.about: Brantley County is a county located in the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 18,021.

Q167565.name: Lenawee County
Q167565.about: Lenawee County ( LEN-ə-way) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 99,423.

Q167580.name: Branch County
Q167580.about: Branch County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 44,862.

Q167583.name: Cass County
Q167583.about: Cass County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 51,589.

Q167589.name: St. Joseph County
Q167589.about: Saint Joseph County is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan, on the central southern border with Indiana. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 60,939.

Q167630.name: Sector 5
Q167630.about: Sector 5 (Romanian: Sectorul 5) is an administrative unit of Bucharest.

Q167656.name: Berrien County
Q167656.about: Berrien County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. It is located at the southwest corner of the state's Lower Peninsula, located on the shore of Lake Michigan and sharing a land border with Indiana.

Q167715.name: Thiruvananthapuram
Q167715.desc: city in southern India; the capital of Kerala
Q167715.about: Thiruvananthapuram (Malayalam pronunciation: [t̪iɾuʋənən̪d̪ɐˈbuɾəm]  tirr-ROO-və-nun-Tə-poor-əm), also known as Trivandrum, is the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala. As of 2011, the Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation had a population of 957,730 over an area of 214.86 km2, making it the most populous city in Kerala.

Q170433.name: Passaic
Q170433.desc: city in Passaic County, New Jersey, United States
Q170433.about: Passaic ( pə-SAY-ik or locally  pə-SAYK) is a city in Passaic County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the city was the state's 16th-most-populous municipality, with a population of 70,537, falling behind Bayonne (ranked 16th in 2010), an increase of 756 (+1.1%) from the 2010 census count of 69,781, which in turn reflected an increase of 1,920 residents (+2.8%) from the 2000 census population of 67,861.

Q170454.name: Agartala
Q170454.about: Agartala (, Bengali: [ˈagɔɾˌtɔla] , Kok Borok: [aguli]) is the capital and the largest city of the Indian state of Tripura, situated on the banks of Haora/Saidra River, about 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) east of the border with Bangladesh and about 2,499 km (1,552 mi) from the national capital, New Delhi. According to 2022 AMC data, Agartala is the second most populous city after Guwahati in Northeast India.

Q170482.name: Avarua
Q170482.desc: capital city of the Cook Islands
Q170482.about: Avarua (meaning "two harbours" in Māori) is a district and township in the north of the island of Rarotonga, the largest island of the Cook Islands. It serves as the capital of the country and is divided into 19 tapere (sub-districts).

Q170513.name: Taganrog
Q170513.desc: port city in Rostov Oblast in southern Russia
Q170513.about: Taganrog (Russian: Таганрог, IPA: [təɡɐnˈrok]; Ukrainian: Таганрог or Таганріг, romanized: Tahanroh, Tahanrih) is a port city in Rostov Oblast, Russia, on the north shore of Taganrog Bay in the Sea of Azov, several kilometers west of the mouth of the Don River. It is in the Black Sea region.

Q170521.name: Kashgar
Q170521.desc: city in Kashgar Prefecture, Xinjiang, China
Q170521.about: Kashgar (Uyghur: قەشقەر, romanised: Qeshqer), also known as Kashi (Chinese: 喀什; pinyin: Kāshí), is a city in the Tarim Basin region of southern Xinjiang, China. It is one of the westernmost cities of China, located near the country's border with Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.

Q170525.name: Agadir
Q170525.about: Agadir (Arabic: أكادير or أڭادير, romanized: ʾagādīr, pronounced [ʔaɡaːdiːr]; Tachelhit: ⴰⴳⴰⴷⵉⵔ) is a major city in Morocco, on the shore of the Atlantic Ocean near the foot of the Atlas Mountains, just north of the point where the Souss River flows into the ocean, and 509 kilometres (316 mi) south of Casablanca. Agadir is the capital of the Agadir-Ida Ou Tanane Prefecture and of the Souss-Massa economic region.

Q170573.name: Qom
Q170573.about: Qom (Persian: قم; [qom] ) is the capital of Qom province, Iran. It is also the capital of Qom County and its Central District.

Q170616.name: Chiba
Q170616.about: Chiba (千葉市, Chiba-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [c̟͡ɕí.bä̀, c̟͡ɕì.bä́(.ɕì)]) is the capital city of Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It sits about 40 kilometres (25 mi) east of the centre of Tokyo on Tokyo Bay.

Q170688.name: Santa Cruz de la Sierra
Q170688.about:
Santa Cruz de la Sierra (Spanish: [ˈsanta ˈkɾus ðe la ˈsjera]; lit. 'Holy Cross of the Mountain Range'), commonly known as Santa Cruz, is the largest city in Bolivia and the capital of the Santa Cruz department.
Situated on the Pirai River in the eastern Tropical Lowlands of Bolivia, the Santa Cruz de la Sierra Metropolitan Region is the most populous urban agglomeration in Bolivia with an estimated population of 2.4 million in 2020.

Q170967.name: Denizli
Q170967.about: Denizli is a city in Aegean Turkey, and seat of the province of Denizli. The city forms the urban part of the districts Merkezefendi and Pamukkale, with a population of 691 783 in 2024.
Q170967.img: TR Denizli asv2020-02 img11 view from Teleferik viewpoint.jpg

Q171224.name: Eugene
Q171224.desc: city in and county seat of Lane County, Oregon, United States
Q171224.about: Eugene (  yoo-JEEN) is a city in and the county seat of Lane County, Oregon, United States. It is located at the southern end of the Willamette Valley, near the confluence of the McKenzie and Willamette rivers, about 50 miles (80 km) east of the Oregon Coast and approximately 110 miles south of Portland.

Q171632.name: Maracaibo
Q171632.desc: capital city of the Zulia state, Venezuela
Q171632.about: Maracaibo ( MARR-ə-KY-boh, Spanish: [maɾaˈkajβo] ; Wayuu: Marakaaya) is a city and municipality in northwestern Venezuela, located on the western shore of the strait that connects Lake Maracaibo to the Gulf of Venezuela. It is the capital of Zulia and is the  second-largest city proper in Venezuela, after the national capital, Caracas.
Q171632.img: Maracaibo panoramica avenida Cecilio Acosta cuted.jpg

Q171714.name: Kerman
Q171714.about: Kerman (Persian: كرمان; [kʲeɾˈmɒːn] ) is a city in the Central District of Kerman County, Kerman province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district.

Q171771.name: Bhubaneswar
Q171771.about: Bhubaneswar (/bʊbəˈneɪswəɹ/; Odia: [ˈbʱubɔneswɔɾɔ] ), also known as Bhubaneshwar, is the capital and the largest city of the Indian state of Odisha. It is located in the Khordha district.

Q16959.name: Ürümqi
Q16959.desc: capital of Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China
Q16959.about: Ürümqi is the capital and largest city of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region in Northwestern China. With a census population of 4,054,000 in 2020, Ürümqi is the second-largest city in China's northwestern interior after Xi'an.

Q17042.name: Oakland
Q17042.desc: city in and county seat of Alameda County, California, United States
Q17042.about: Oakland is a city in the East Bay region of the San Francisco Bay Area in the U.S. state of California. It is the county seat of and the most populous city in Alameda County, California, with a population of 440,646 in 2020.
Q17042.img: OAKLAND, CA, USA - Skyline and Bridge.JPG

Q17151.name: Thessaloniki
Q17151.about: Thessaloniki (; Greek: Θεσσαλονίκη [θesaloˈnici] ; also known by various spellings and names) is the capital and largest city of the administrative region of Central Macedonia, and the second-largest city in Greece. It is the largest city of Northern Greece, with over 300,000 in the city proper and slightly over one million inhabitants in its metropolitan area, the capital of the geographic region of Macedonia, and the Decentralized Administration of Macedonia and Thrace.

Q17175.name: Marikina
Q17175.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q17175.about: Marikina (), officially the City of Marikina (Filipino: Lungsod ng Marikina), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 471,323 people.

Q17176.name: Muntinlupa
Q17176.desc: highly urbanized city in Metro Manila, Philippines
Q17176.about: Muntinlupa (Tagalog: [mʊntɪnˈlupɐ]), officially the City of Muntinlupa (Filipino: Lungsod ng Muntinlupa), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 552,225 people.

Q17189.name: Pasay
Q17189.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q17189.about: Pasay, officially the City of Pasay (Filipino: Lungsod ng Pasay; IPA: [ˈpaː.saɪ̯]), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 453,186 people.
Q17189.img: Pic geo photos - ph=mm=pasay=bay city skyline - aerial shot from cityland vito cruz -philippines--2015-0624--ls-.JPG

Q170247.name: Jinan
Q170247.about: Jinan is the capital of the Shandong province in Eastern China. With a population of 9.2 million, it is one of the largest cities in Shandong in terms of population.

Q170315.name: Abbottabad
Q170315.desc: city in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa of Pakistan
Q170315.about: Abbottabad is a city and the capital of the Hazara Division in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also serves as the headquarters of its eponymous tehsil (subdistrict) and district.

Q170322.name: Qingdao
Q170322.about: Qingdao, previously transliterated as Tsingtao, is a prefecture-level city in China's Shandong province. Lying across the Shandong Peninsula and looking out to the Yellow Sea, it borders the prefecture-level cities of Yantai to the northeast, Weifang to the west, and Rizhao to the southwest.
Q170322.img: 青岛湛山及太平山俯瞰 2018-10-10.jpg

Q170366.name: Ahvaz
Q170366.about:
Ahvaz (Persian: اهواز; [ʔæhˈvɒːz] ) is a city in the Central District of Ahvaz County, Khuzestan province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district.
Positioned near the border with Iraq, along the banks of the Karun River, Ahvaz serves as a key industrial and transportation hub, with a diverse population and a history shaped by its proximity to Iraq and the Persian Gulf.

Q16739.name: Long Beach
Q16739.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q16739.about: Long Beach is a coastal city in southeastern Los Angeles County, California, United States. It is the 44th-most populous city in the United States, with a population of 450,469 as of 2025.

Q16740.name: Maple Ridge
Q16740.about: Maple Ridge is a city in British Columbia, Canada. It is located in the northeastern section of Greater Vancouver between the Fraser River and the Golden Ears, a group of mountain summits that  constitute the southernmost portion of the Garibaldi Ranges of the Coast Mountains.

Q156713.name: Zhytomyr
Q156713.desc: capital city of Zhytomyr Oblast in northwestern Ukraine
Q156713.about: Zhytomyr (Ukrainian: Житомир [ʒeˈtɔmer] ; see below for other names) is a city in the north of the western half of Ukraine. It is the administrative center of Zhytomyr Oblast (province), as well as the administrative center of the surrounding Zhytomyr urban hromada (commune) and Zhytomyr Raion (district).
Q156713.img: Приміщення Житомирського державного університету імені Івана Франка.jpg

Q156717.name: Khmelnytskyi
Q156717.desc: capital city of Khmelnytskyi Oblast in western Ukraine
Q156717.about: Khmelnytskyi (Ukrainian: Хмельницький, IPA: [xmelʲˈnɪtsʲkɪi̯] ) is a city in western Ukraine. Located on the Southern Bug, it serves as the administrative centre of Khmelnytskyi Oblast as well as Khmelnytskyi Raion within the oblast.

Q156747.name: Poltava
Q156747.desc: capital city of Poltava Oblast in central Ukraine
Q156747.about: Poltava is a city on the Vorskla River in Central Ukraine. It serves as the administrative center of Poltava Oblast as well as Poltava Raion within the oblast.

Q156752.name: Sumy
Q156752.desc: city and capital of Sumy Oblast in north-eastern Ukraine
Q156752.about: Sumy (Ukrainian: Суми, IPA: [ˈsumɪ] ) is a city in northeastern Ukraine. It serves as the administrative center of Sumy Oblast.

Q157053.name: Chernihiv
Q157053.desc: capital city of Chernihiv Oblast in northeastern Ukraine
Q157053.about: Chernihiv (Ukrainian: Чернігів, IPA: [tʃerˈn⁽ʲ⁾iɦiu̯] ; Russian: Чернигов, romanized: Chernigov, IPA: [tɕɪrˈnʲiɡəf]) is a city and municipality in northern Ukraine, which serves as the administrative center of Chernihiv Oblast and Chernihiv Raion within the oblast. Chernihiv's population is 282,747 (2022 estimate).

Q157055.name: Cherkasy
Q157055.about: Cherkasy (Ukrainian: Черкаси, pronounced [tʃerˈkɑsɪ] ) is a city in central Ukraine. Cherkasy serves as the administrative centre of Cherkasy Oblast as well as Cherkasy Raion within the oblast.

Q168144.name: Logan County
Q168144.about: Logan County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Oakley.

Q168193.name: Najaf
Q168193.about: Najaf is the capital city of the eponymous Najaf Governorate in central Iraq, about 160 km (99 mi) south of Baghdad. Its estimated population in 2024 was about 1.41 million people.

Q168197.name: Adıyaman
Q168197.desc: central district and city in Adıyaman Province, Turkey
Q168197.about: Adıyaman (Kurdish: Semsûr) is a city in southeastern Turkey. It is the administrative centre of Adıyaman Province and Adıyaman District.

Q16861.name: Bexar County
Q16861.about: Bexar County ( BAIR or   BAY-ər; Spanish: Béxar [ˈbexaɾ]) is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. It is in South Texas and its county seat is San Antonio.

Q16868.name: Laredo
Q16868.desc: city in and county seat of Webb County, Texas, United States
Q16868.about: Laredo (English pronunciation: /ləˈɹeɪdoʊ/ ; Spanish pronunciation: [laˈɾeðo] ) is a city in the U.S. state of Texas and the county seat and largest city of Webb County, on the north bank of the Rio Grande in South Texas, across from Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas, Mexico. Founded in 1755, Laredo grew from a village to the capital of the short-lived Republic of the Rio Grande to the largest inland port on the Mexican border.
Q16868.img: Laredo US Post Office, Court House and Custom House.jpg

Q16918.name: Maipú
Q16918.about: Maipú is a commune in the Santiago Province in the Santiago Metropolitan Region in Chile, forming part of the Greater Santiago conurbation. It was founded on 16 February 1821 and is historically significant as the site of the Battle of Maipú (5 April 1818), where Chile's independence was consolidated.

Q157134.name: Makiivka
Q157134.desc: city in Donetsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast of Ukraine
Q157134.about: Makiivka (Ukrainian: Макіївка, IPA: [mɐˈkijiu̯kɐ] , Russian: Макеевка, romanized: Makeyevka), formerly Dmytriivsk (Ukrainian: Дмитріївськ) until 1931, is an industrial city in Donetsk Oblast, eastern Ukraine, located 15 kilometers (9.3 mi) east from Donetsk. The two cities are practically a conurbation.

Q157137.name: Kryvyi Rih
Q157137.desc: city of regional significance in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast in central Ukraine
Q157137.about: Kryvyi Rih is a city in central Ukraine. It hosts the administration of Kryvyi Rih Raion and its subordinate Kryvyi Rih urban hromada in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

Q157144.name: Vinnytsia
Q157144.desc: capital city of Vinnytsia Oblast in western Ukraine
Q157144.about: Vinnytsia ( VIN-it-s(y)ə, VEEN-; Ukrainian: Вінниця, IPA: [ˈwinːɪtsʲɐ] ) is a city in west-central Ukraine, located on the banks of the Southern Bug. It serves as the administrative center of Vinnytsia Oblast in Ukraine.

Q157725.name: Chernivtsi
Q157725.desc: capital city of Chernivtsi Oblast in western Ukraine and historical center of the Bukovina
Q157725.about: Chernivtsi (Ukrainian: Чернівці, pronounced [tʃern⁽ʲ⁾iu̯ˈts⁽ʲ⁾i] ; Romanian: Cernăuți, pronounced [tʃernəˈutsʲ] ; see also other names) is a city in southwestern Ukraine on the upper course of the Prut River. Formerly the capital of the historic region of Bukovina, which is now divided between Romania and Ukraine, Chernivtsi serves as the administrative center for the Chernivtsi urban hromada, the Chernivtsi Raion, and the oblast itself.

Q168652.name: Hargeisa
Q168652.about: Hargeisa ( har-GAY-sə;  Somali: Hargeysa; Arabic: هرجيسا, romanized: Harjīsā) is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Somaliland, a partially recognised sovereign state in the Horn of Africa, still considered internationally to be part of Somalia. It is also the regional capital of the Maroodi Jeex region of Somaliland.

Q168843.name: Sari
Q168843.about: Sari (Persian: ساری [sɒːˈɾiː] ) is a city in the Central District of Sari County, Mazandaran province, serving as capital of the district, county, and province. Sari was the former capital of Iran for a short period and is in the north of the country, between the northern slopes of the Alborz Mountains and southern coast of the Mazandaran Sea.

Q169943.name: San Mateo
Q169943.desc: city in San Mateo County, California, United States
Q169943.about: San Mateo is the most populous city in San Mateo County, California, United States, on the San Francisco Peninsula. It is part of the San Francisco Bay Area metropolitan region, and is located about 20 miles (32 km) south of San Francisco.

Q169948.name: Yuba City
Q169948.desc: city and the county seat of Sutter County, California, United States
Q169948.about: Yuba City (Maidu: Yubu) is a city in and the county seat of Sutter County, California, United States. The population was 70,117 at the 2020 census.
Q169948.img: Aerial view of Yuba City, December 2021.JPG

Q169952.name: Imperial County
Q169952.about: Imperial County is located on the southeast border of the U.S. state of California. As of the 2020 census, the population was 179,702, ranking as the least populous county in Southern California.
Q169952.img: Imperial County Superior Courthouse El Centro Night.jpg

Q170024.name: Ras Al Khaimah
Q170024.desc: One of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates
Q170024.about: The Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is the northernmost of the seven emirates that make up the United Arab Emirates. The city of Ras Al Khaimah, abbreviated to RAK or RAK City, is the capital of the emirate and home to most of the emirate's residents.
Q170024.img: Ras al-Khaimah December 2015 by Vincent Eisfeld.jpg

Q170115.name: Srinagar
Q170115.desc: city in Jammu and Kashmir, India
Q170115.about: Srinagar is a city in Indian-administered  Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region. It is the largest city and summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir, which is an Indian-administered union territory.

Q15897817.name: Chongqing Shi
Q15897817.img: Chaotianmen Bridge, Nan'an District of Chongqing.jpg

Q173121.name: Santiago de Querétaro
Q173121.desc: capital of the State of Querétaro, Mexico
Q173121.about: Santiago de Querétaro (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo ðe keˈɾetaɾo]; Otomi:  Dähnini Maxei), most commonly known as Querétaro, is the capital and largest city of the state of Querétaro, located in central Mexico. It is part of the macroregion of Bajío.

Q188204.name: Cullman County
Q188204.about: Cullman County is a county located in the north central portion of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 87,866.

Q188275.name: Renville County
Q188275.about: Renville County is a county in the U.S. state of Minnesota. As of the 2020 census the population was 14,723.

Q1731.name: Dresden
Q1731.desc: capital city of the Free State of Saxony in Germany
Q1731.about: Dresden ( DREZ-den; German: [ˈdʁeːsdn̩] ; Upper Saxon: Dräsdn; Upper Sorbian: Drježdźany, pronounced [ˈdʁʲɛʒdʒanɨ]) is the capital city of the German state of Saxony and its second most populous city after Leipzig. It is the 12th most populous city of Germany, the fourth largest by area (after Berlin, Hamburg, and Cologne), and the third-most populous city in the area of former East Germany, after Berlin and Leipzig.

Q173270.name: Veracruz
Q173270.desc: town in Veracruz Municipality, State of Veracruz, Mexico
Q173270.about: Veracruz (Latin American Spanish pronunciation: [beɾaˈkɾus] ), also known as Heroica Veracruz, is a major port city and municipal seat for the surrounding municipality of Veracruz on the Gulf of Mexico and the most populous city in the Mexican state of Veracruz. The city is located along the coast in the central part of the state, 90 km (56 mi) southeast of the state capital Xalapa.

Q173310.name: Kirkuk
Q173310.about: Kirkuk (Arabic: كركوك, romanized: Kirkūk; Kurdish: کەرکووک, romanized: Kerkûk; Syriac: ܟܪܟܘܟ, romanized: Kerkouk; Turkish: Kerkük) is a major city in northern Iraq, serving as the capital of the Kirkuk Governorate. The city is home to a diverse population of Kurds, Iraqi Turkmens and Arabs, as well as smaller numbers of Assyrians.

Q173545.name: Hama
Q173545.about: Hama is a city on the banks of the Orontes River in west-central Syria. It is located 213 kilometres (132 mi) north of Damascus and 46 km (29 mi) north of Homs.

Q189383.name: Damietta
Q189383.about: Damietta (Egyptian Arabic: دمياط, romanized: Dumyāṭ, pronounced [domˈjɑːtˤ]) is a port city which serves as the capital city of the Damietta Governorate in Egypt. It is located at the Damietta branch, an eastern distributary of the Nile Delta, 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the Mediterranean Sea, and about 200 kilometres (120 mi) north of Cairo.

Q188376.name: Hamilton County
Q188376.about: Hamilton County is a county located in the U.S. state of Tennessee. It is located in the southern part of East Tennessee on the border with Georgia.

Q188693.name: Blantyre
Q188693.about: Blantyre is Malawi's centre of finance and commerce, and its second largest city, with a population of 800,264 as of 2018. It is sometimes referred to as the commercial and industrial capital of Malawi as opposed to the political capital, Lilongwe.

Q175735.name: Regional Municipality of Waterloo
Q175735.about: The Regional Municipality of Waterloo (Waterloo Region or Region of Waterloo) is a metropolitan area of Southern Ontario, Canada. It contains the cities of Cambridge, Kitchener and Waterloo (KWC or Tri-Cities), and the townships of North Dumfries, Wellesley, Wilmot and Woolwich.

Q175756.name: Cumberland County
Q175756.about: Cumberland County is a county located in the Pennyroyal Plateau region of the U.S. state of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,888.

Q175799.name: Clearwater County
Q175799.about: Clearwater County is a county located in the U.S. state of Idaho. As of the 2020 census, the population was 8,734.

Q176068.name: Taylor County
Q176068.about: Taylor County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,896, making it the fourth-least populous county in Iowa.

Q191130.name: Kanazawa
Q191130.desc: capital city in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan
Q191130.about: Kanazawa (金沢市, Kanazawa-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [kä̀.nä́.(d͡)zä̀.β̞ä̀, -(d͡)zä́.β̞ä́.ɕì]) is the capital of Ishikawa Prefecture in central Japan. As of 1 January 2018, the city had an estimated population of 466,029 in 203,271 households, and a population density of 990 persons per km2.

Q191204.name: Sulaymaniyah
Q191204.about: Sulaymaniyah (Arabic: السليمانية, romanized: as-Sulaymāniyyah) or Slemani (Kurdish: سلێمانی, romanized: Silêmanî), is a city in the east of the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and is the capital of the Sulaymaniyah Governorate. It is surrounded by the Azmar, Goizha and Qaiwan Mountains in the northeast, Baranan Mountain in the south and the Tasluja Hills in the west.

Q1741.name: Vienna
Q1741.desc: capital of and state in Austria
Q1741.about: Vienna (  vee-EN-ə; German: Wien [viːn] ; Austro-Bavarian: Wean [veɐ̯n]) is the capital, most populous city, and one of the nine states of Austria. It is Austria's primate city, with just over two million inhabitants.
Q1741.img: Wien katedra sw Szczepana widok z wiezy 6.jpg

Q192235.name: Ciudad del Este
Q192235.desc: city and departmental capital of Alto Paraná, Paraguay
Q192235.about: Ciudad del Este (Spanish pronunciation: [sjuˈðað ðel ˈeste], Spanish for Eastern City; often shortened as CDE) is the second-largest city in Paraguay and capital of the Alto Paraná Department, situated on the Paraná River. It is located 327 km (203 mi) east of Asunción, the capital, and is adjacent to the border with Brazil, to which it is connected by the Friendship Bridge on the Paraná River.
Q192235.img: Boqueron street in downtown Ciudad del Este.jpg

Q192271.name: Guiyang
Q192271.about: Guiyang is the capital of Guizhou province in the People's Republic of China. It is centrally located within the province, on the eastern part of the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau, and sits on the north bank of the Nanming River, a tributary of the Wu River.

Q1748.name: Copenhagen
Q1748.desc: capital and largest city of Denmark
Q1748.about: Copenhagen (Danish: København [kʰøpm̩ˈhɑwˀn] ) is the capital and most populous city of Denmark, with an urban population of 1.4 million. The city is situated mainly on the island of Zealand (Sjælland), with a smaller part on the island of Amager.

Q176307.name: Cabarrus County
Q176307.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q176307.about: Cabarrus County ( kuh-BAIR-us) is a county located in the south-central part of the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 225,804, making it the 9th-most populous county in North Carolina.

Q176480.name: Dougherty County
Q176480.about: Dougherty County is located in the southwestern portion of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 85,790.

Q192379.name: Aizawl
Q192379.about: Aizawl (English:   EYE-zawl; Mizo: [ˈaɪ̯.ˈzɔːl] ), formerly known as Aijal, is the capital city and the most populous city of Mizoram, India. It is also the third largest city in northeast India.

Q192517.name: Boulder
Q192517.desc: city in and county seat of Boulder County, Colorado, United States
Q192517.about: Boulder is a home rule city that is the county seat of, and the most populous municipality in, Boulder County, Colorado, United States. With a population of 108,250 at the 2020 census, it is the 12th-most populous city in Colorado.

Q192564.name: Gaochang District
Q192564.about: Gaochang or Karahoja (Uyghur: قاراھوجا, romanized: Qarahoja, Қарахоҗа; Chinese: 高昌; pinyin: Gāochāng), is the only district and the seat of the oasis city of Turpan, in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. Its population was 254,900 at the end of 2003.

Q192650.name: Blaine County
Q192650.desc: county in northern Montana, United States
Q192650.about: Blaine County is a county in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,044.

Q192753.name: Broadwater County
Q192753.desc: county in south central Montana, United States
Q192753.about: Broadwater County is a county in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 6,774.

Q192992.name: Carbon County
Q192992.desc: county in south-central Montana, United States
Q192992.about: Carbon County is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 10,473.
Q192992.img: Calvary Episcopal Church NRHP 86002928 Carbon County, MT.jpg

Q193072.name: Carter County
Q193072.about: Carter County is a county located in the southeastern region of the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,415, making it the seventh-least populous county in Montana.

Q193167.name: Cascade County
Q193167.desc: county in central Montana, United States
Q193167.about: Cascade County (cascade means waterfall in French) is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 84,414, making it the fifth-most populous county in Montana.

Q174.name: São Paulo
Q174.desc: largest city of Brazil, and capital of the State of São Paulo
Q174.about: São Paulo (; Portuguese: [sɐ̃w ˈpawlu] ; Portuguese for 'Saint Paul') is the capital and largest city of the state of São Paulo. The largest city in Brazil, it is also the most populous city in the Americas.

Q173849.name: São José
Q173849.desc: municipality of Santa Catarina state, Brazil
Q173849.about: São José is a city in Santa Catarina, Brazil. It is approximately 5 km from and encircles the continental section of Florianópolis.

Q173867.name: Columbia County
Q173867.about: Columbia County is a county located in the north central portion of the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 69,698, up from 67,531 at the 2010 census.
Q173867.img: Lake City Comm Hist Dist crths05.jpg

Q173985.name: Faisalabad
Q173985.about: Faisalabad, formerly known as Lyallpur, is the second-largest city and primary industrial center of the Pakistani province of Punjab. Located in the Rachna Doab of the central Punjab, it is the third-most populous city in Pakistan.

Q174060.name: Elazığ
Q174060.desc: central district and city in Elazığ Province, Turkey
Q174060.about: Elazığ (Turkish pronunciation: [eˈlazɯː]) is a city in the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey, and the administrative centre of Elazığ Province and Elazığ District. Founded in and around the former city of Harput, it is located in the uppermost Euphrates valley.

Q174123.name: Dongfang
Q174123.about: Dongfang (simplified Chinese: 东方; traditional Chinese: 東方; pinyin: Dōngfāng; lit. 'the East') is one of the five county-level cities of Hainan province, China.
Q174123.img: Ghosttown at Front of Dongfang(Hainan) Railway Station.jpg

Q174224.name: Wilmington
Q174224.desc: seat of New Castle County, and largest city in Delaware, United States
Q174224.about: Wilmington is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Delaware. It lies at the confluence of the Christina River and Brandywine Creek, near where the Christina flows into the Delaware River.

Q188806.name: Kitakyūshū
Q188806.about: Kitakyushu (北九州市, Kitakyūshū-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [kʲi̥.ta.kʲɯꜜː.ɕɯː, kʲi̥.ta.kʲɯː.ɕɯꜜː.ɕi]) is a city in Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. In 2019, Kitakyushu had an estimated population of 940,978, making it the second-largest city in Fukuoka Prefecture and on the island of Kyushu, after the city of Fukuoka.

Q189074.name: Harlem
Q189074.desc: neighborhood in Manhattan, New York City, New York, United States
Q189074.about: Harlem is a neighborhood in Upper Manhattan, New York City. It is bounded roughly by the Hudson River on the west; the Harlem River and 155th Street on the north; Fifth Avenue on the east; and 110th Street on the south.

Q189128.name: León de Los Aldama
Q189128.about: León (Spanish pronunciation: [leˈon] ), officially León de Los Aldama, is the most populous city and municipal seat of the municipality of León in the Mexican state of Guanajuato. In the 2020 census, INEGI reported 1,579,803 people living in the city of León and 1,721,215 in the municipality, making it the fourth-most populous city and third-most populous municipality in Mexico.

Q189134.name: Uşak
Q189134.desc: central district and city in Uşak Province, Turkey
Q189134.about: Uşak (Turkish pronunciation: [ˈuʃak]) is a city in the interior part of the Aegean Region of Turkey. It is the seat of Uşak Province and Uşak District.
Q189134.img: Antikle Kirche von Sebaste, bei Selcikler (Usak).JPG

Q189138.name: Hermosillo
Q189138.desc: city in Mexico, Sonora state capital
Q189138.about: Hermosillo (Latin American Spanish: [eɾmoˈsiʝo] ), formerly called Pitic (as in Santísima Trinidad del Pitic and Presidio del Pitic), is the capital and largest city of the northwestern Mexican state of Sonora, and the municipal seat of the municipality of Hermosillo. It also is the primary economic center for the state and the region.

Q1757.name: Helsinki
Q1757.desc: capital and most populous city of Finland
Q1757.about: Helsinki, until about 1930 known in English by its Swedish name of Helsingfors, is the capital and most populous city in Finland. It is on the shore of the Gulf of Finland and is the seat of southern Finland's Uusimaa region.

Q178178.name: Kamouraska
Q178178.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q178178.about: Kamouraska (French pronunciation: [kamuʁaska] ) is a regional county municipality in eastern Quebec, Canada. The regional county municipality seat is Saint-Pascal, but the largest town is La Pocatière.

Q178281.name: Henry County
Q178281.about: Henry County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, its population was 20,482.

Q178341.name: Day County
Q178341.desc: county in South Dakota, United States of America
Q178341.about: Day County is a county in the U.S. state of South Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,449.
Q178341.img: First National Bank NRHP 05000626 Day County, SD.jpg

Q178373.name: Rasht
Q178373.about: Rasht (Persian: رشت; [ɾæʃt] ) is a city in the Central District of Rasht County, Gilan province, Iran, serving as the capital of the province, the county, and the district. Known as the "City of Silver Rain" (Shahr-e Bārān Ha-ye Noghre i), Rasht has, throughout Iran’s history, served as a border city, earning the historical nickname "Dār al-Marz Rasht" or "Rasht on the Border".

Q1742133.name: Kings County
Q1742133.desc: county in Prince Edward Island, Canada
Q1742133.about:
Kings County (2021 population 18,327) is located in eastern Prince Edward Island, Canada.
It is the province's smallest, most rural and least-populated county.

Q1752038.name: York County
Q1752038.about: York County (2021 population 105,261) is located in west-central New Brunswick, Canada. The county contains the provincial capital, Fredericton.

Q1752156.name: Northumberland County
Q1752156.about: Northumberland County is a county situated on the north shore of Lake Ontario, east of Toronto in Central Ontario, Canada. The Northumberland County headquarters are located in Cobourg.

Q1756617.name: Tongi
Q1756617.about: Tongi (Bengali: টঙ্গী) is a major township in Gazipur, Bangladesh, with a population of 350,000. It hosts the Biswa Ijtema and features a BSCIC industrial area, which produces BDT 1500 crore of industrial products annually, and marks the northern border of Dhaka since 1786.

Q174262.name: Saint Peter Port
Q174262.desc: parish, port, and capital of Guernsey in the Channel Islands
Q174262.about: St. Peter Port (French: Saint-Pierre Port) is a town and one of the ten parishes on the island of Guernsey in the Channel Islands.

Q174318.name: Division No. 8
Q174318.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q174318.about: Census Division No. 8 (Central Manitoba) is a census division located within the Central Plains Region of the Province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q174341.name: İskenderun
Q174341.desc: district and city in Hatay, Turkey
Q174341.about: İskenderun (Arabic: إسكندرونة), historically known as Alexandretta (Greek: Αλεξανδρέττα, lit. 'little Alexandria') and Scanderoon, is a municipality and district of Hatay Province, Turkey. Its area is 247 km2, and its population is 251,682 (2022).
Q174341.img: City View of Iskenderun Turkey - panoramio.jpg

Q174461.name: Ranchi
Q174461.desc: capital of East Indian state Jharkhand
Q174461.about: Ranchi (Hindi: rāñcī, pronounced [ˈɾaːɲt͡ɕiː]) is the capital city and also the largest district by population of the Indian state of Jharkhand. Ranchi was the centre of the Jharkhand movement, which called for a separate state for the tribal regions of South Bihar, northern Odisha, western West Bengal and the eastern area of what is present-day Chhattisgarh.

Q174913.name: Calhoun County
Q174913.about: Calhoun County is a rural county located in the northern panhandle of the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,648, making it the fifth-least populous county in Florida.

Q174916.name: Tartus
Q174916.about: Tartus (Arabic: طَرْطُوس / ALA-LC: Ṭarṭūs; also known as Tartous and also historically known in the County of Tripoli as Tortosa) is a major port city on the Mediterranean coast of Syria. It is the second largest port city in Syria (after Latakia), and the largest city in Tartus Governorate.

Q175035.name: Prowers County
Q175035.about: Prowers County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 11,999.

Q175323.name: Adapazarı
Q175323.about: Adapazarı (pronounced [ɑˈdɑpɑzɑɾɯ]) is a municipality and the capital district of Sakarya Province, Turkey. Its area is 324 km2, and its population 281,489 (2022).

Q189471.name: Cupertino
Q189471.desc: city in Santa Clara County, California, United States
Q189471.about: Cupertino ( KOOP-ər-TEEN-oh) is a city in Santa Clara County, California, United States, directly west of San Jose on the western edge of the Santa Clara Valley with portions extending into the foothills of the Santa Cruz Mountains. The population was 60,381 as of the 2020 census, decreasing by 1,671 (-2.9%) to a Census-estimated 58,710 by 2024.

Q189602.name: Missoula
Q189602.desc: county seat of Missoula County, Montana, United States
Q189602.about: Missoula (  mih-ZOO-lə) is a city in and the county seat of Missoula County, Montana, United States. It is located along the Clark Fork River near its confluence with the Bitterroot and Blackfoot rivers in western Montana and at the convergence of five mountain ranges, and thus it is often described as the "hub of five valleys".

Q189633.name: Guilin
Q189633.about: Guilin (Chinese: 桂林; Standard Zhuang: Gveilinz), formerly romanized as Kweilin, is a prefecture-level city in the northeast of China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. It is situated on the west bank of the Li River and borders Hunan to the north.
Q189633.img: View of Guilin from Elephant Trunk Hill.jpg

Q189823.name: Haikou
Q189823.about: Haikou is the capital and most populous city of the Chinese province of Hainan. Haikou city is situated on the northern coast of Hainan, by the mouth of the Nandu River.

Q190828.name: Petah Tikva
Q190828.desc: city in the Central District of Israel, part of the Tel Aviv metropolitan area
Q190828.about: Petah Tikva (Hebrew: פתח תקווה, pronounced [ˈpetaχ ˈtikva] ), also spelt Petah Tiqwa, is a city in the Central District of Israel, 10.6 km (6.6 mi) east of Tel Aviv. It was founded in 1878, mainly by Haredi Jews of the Old Yishuv, and became a permanent settlement in 1883 with the financial help of Edmond Rothschild.

Q1754.name: Stockholm
Q1754.desc: capital and largest city of Sweden
Q1754.about: Stockholm (; Swedish: [ˈstɔ̂kː(h)ɔlm] ) is the capital and most populous city of Sweden, as well as the largest urban area in the Nordic countries. Approximately 1 million people live in the municipality, with 1.6 million in the urban area, and 2.5 million in the metropolitan area.

Q176603.name: Saint-Michel
Q176603.desc: metro station on the Blue Line, Montreal, Quebec, Canada
Q176603.about: Saint-Michel station (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃ miʃɛl] ) is a Montreal Metro station in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It is operated by the Société de transport de Montréal (STM) and is the eastern terminus of the Blue Line.

Q176891.name: Carapicuíba
Q176891.desc: municipality of São Paulo state, Brazil
Q176891.about: Carapicuíba (Portuguese pronunciation: [kaɾapikuˈibɐ]) is a municipality in the state of São Paulo in Brazil. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of São Paulo.

Q177562.name: Caddo Parish
Q177562.about: Caddo Parish (; French: Paroisse de Caddo) is a parish located in the northwestern corner of the U.S. state of Louisiana. According to the 2020 U.S. census, the parish had a population of 237,848.

Q177678.name: Emporia
Q177678.desc: independent city in Virginia, United States
Q177678.about: Emporia is an independent city in the Commonwealth of Virginia in the United States.  It is the county seat of Greensville County.

Q177690.name: Perth County
Q177690.desc: county of the Canadian province of Ontario
Q177690.about: Perth County is a county and census division in the Canadian province of Ontario in Southwestern Ontario, 100 kilometres (62 mi) west of Toronto. Its population centres are Listowel, Mitchell and Milverton.

Q178067.name: Toamasina
Q178067.about: Toamasina (Malagasy pronunciation: [toˈmasinə̥]), meaning "like salt" or "salty", unofficially and in French Tamatave or in the past as Port aux prunes, is the capital of the Atsinanana region on the east coast of Madagascar on the Indian Ocean. The city is the chief seaport of the country, situated 215 km (134 mi) northeast of its capital and largest city Antananarivo.

Q193230.name: Chouteau County
Q193230.desc: county in central Montana, United States
Q193230.about: Chouteau County is a county located in the North-Central region of the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,895.

Q193250.name: Bulawayo
Q193250.about: Bulawayo (, ; Northern Ndebele: Bulawayo) is the second largest city in Zimbabwe, and the largest city in the country's Matabeleland region. The city's population is disputed; the 2022 census listed it at 665,940, while the Bulawayo City Council claimed it to be about 1.2 million.

Q193289.name: Iquitos
Q193289.desc: city of Peru, capital of Loreto region
Q193289.about: Iquitos ( ; Spanish pronunciation: [iˈkitos]) is the capital city of Peru's Maynas Province and Loreto Region. It is the largest metropolis in the Peruvian Amazon, east of the Andes, as well as the ninth-most populous city in Peru.

Q193478.name: Buda
Q193478.desc: western part of Budapest, Hungary, former independent city
Q193478.about: Buda (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈbudɒ], German: Ofen) is the part of Budapest, the capital city of Hungary, that lies on the western bank of the Danube. Historically, "Buda" referred only to the royal walled city on Castle Hill (Hungarian: Várhegy), which was constructed by Béla IV between 1247 and 1249 and subsequently served as the capital of the Kingdom of Hungary from 1361 to 1873.

Q193802.name: Oujda
Q193802.about: Oujda is a major city in northeast Morocco near the border with Algeria. Oujda is the largest city and capital of the Oriental region of northeastern Morocco and has a population of 506,224 people (2024 census).
Q193802.img: Bab Sidi Aissa Oujda Brahim FARAJI 2.jpg

Q194165.name: Irbid
Q194165.about: Irbid (Arabic: إِربِد) is a city located on the northern ridge of the Gilead mountains in northern Jordan in the Irbid Governorate. The city lies approximately 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of the Syrian border, and is the largest city of the Irbid Governorate and the third most populous city of Jordan.

Q1781.name: Budapest
Q1781.desc: capital and largest city of Hungary
Q1781.about: Budapest is the capital and largest city of Hungary. It is Hungary's primate city with 1.7 million inhabitants and its greater metro area has a population of about 3.3 million, representing one-third of the country's population and producing more than 40% of the country's economic output.

Q1792.name: Gdańsk
Q1792.desc: city and capital of the Pomeranian Voivodeship on the Baltic coast of northern Poland
Q1792.about: Gdańsk (Kashubian: Gduńsk), historically known in English as Danzig, is a city on the Baltic coast of northern Poland, and the capital of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. With a population of 486,492, it is Poland's sixth-largest city and its major seaport.
Q1792.img: Calle Dlugie Pobrzeze, Gdansk, Polonia, 2013-05-20, DD 05.jpg

Q1764.name: Reykjavík
Q1764.desc: capital and largest city in Iceland
Q1764.about: Reykjavík is the capital and largest city of Iceland. It is located on the southern shore of the Faxaflói bay in southwest Iceland and has a latitude of 64°08′ N, making it the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state.

Q1770.name: Tallinn
Q1770.desc: capital and most populous city of Estonia
Q1770.about: Tallinn is the capital and largest city of Estonia. Located on a bay in northern Estonia, on the shore of the Gulf of Finland of the Baltic Sea, it has a population of 452,563 as of 2026, making it the third most-populous city in the Baltics.

Q179665.name: Urmia
Q179665.desc: city in West Azerbaijan Province, Iran
Q179665.about: Urmia (Persian: ارومیه; pronounced [oɾumiˈje] ) is the largest city in West Azerbaijan Province of Iran. In the Central District of Urmia County, it is capital of the province, the county, and the district.

Q179833.name: Sumgait
Q179833.about: Sumgait, also spelled Sumgayit or Sumqayit; ; (Azerbaijani: Sumqayıt, Azerbaijani: [sumɡɑˈjɯt] ) is a city in Azerbaijan, located near the Caspian Sea, on the Absheron Peninsula, about 31 kilometres (19 miles) away from the capital Baku. The city had a population of 427,000 at the beginning of 2024, making it the second largest city in Azerbaijan after Baku.

Q179950.name: Denali Borough
Q179950.about: The Denali Borough is a borough located in the U.S. state of Alaska. As of the 2020 census, the population of the borough was 1,619, down from 1,826 in 2010.

Q179954.name: Edmunds County
Q179954.desc: county in South Dakota, United States of America
Q179954.about: Edmunds County is a county in the U.S. state of South Dakota. At the 2020 census, the population was 3,986.

Q180078.name: Kermanshah
Q180078.about: Kermanshah (Persian: کرمانشاه, romanized: Kermânšâh, pronounced [kʰʲeɾmɒːnˈʃɒːʰ] ; Southern Kurdish: کرماشان, romanized: Kirmaşan.) is a city in the Central District of Kermanshah province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district. The city is 525 kilometres (326 miles) from Tehran in the western part of the country.

Q1776238.about: Division No. 12 is a census division in Alberta, Canada.

Q1778727.name: Alberni-Clayoquot Regional District
Q1778727.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q1778727.about: The Alberni–Clayoquot Regional District of British Columbia is located on west central Vancouver Island. Adjacent regional districts it shares borders with are the Strathcona and Comox Valley Regional Districts to the north, and the Nanaimo and Cowichan Valley Regional Districts to the east.

Q1778780.name: Greenwood
Q1778780.desc: city in Johnson County, Indiana, United States
Q1778780.about: Greenwood is a city in Johnson County, Indiana, United States. The population was 63,830 at the 2020 Census.

Q1780338.name: Ramagundam
Q1780338.desc: city in Peddapalli district, Telangana, India
Q1780338.about: Ramagundam is a city under  municipal corporation in Peddapalli district of the Indian state of Telangana. It is the most populous city in the district and falls under the Ramagundam revenue division.

Q1780528.name: qathet Regional District
Q1780528.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q1780528.about: The qathet Regional District (, qRD) is a regional district in the Canadian province of British Columbia. Its only incorporated municipality is the City of Powell River, although it includes a number of unincorporated areas.

Q1782406.name: Apodaca
Q1782406.desc: municipal seat of Apodaca, State of Nuevo León, Mexico
Q1782406.about: Apodaca (Spanish pronunciation: [apoˈðaka]) is a city and its surrounding municipality that is part of Monterrey Metropolitan area. It lies in the northeastern part of the Monterrey Metropolitan Area.

Q1784180.name: Doral
Q1784180.desc: city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q1784180.about: Doral is a city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. One of 34 municipalities in the county, it is a principal city in the Miami metropolitan area that is located 5 miles (8 km) west of Miami International Airport and 13 miles (21 km) west of Downtown Miami.

Q1854.name: Ho Chi Minh City
Q1854.about: Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC; Vietnamese: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, [tʰaɲ˨˩ fow˦˥ ho˨˩ cɪj˦˥ mɨn˧˧] ), formerly Saigon (Sài Gòn, [ʂaj˨˩ ɣɔŋ˨˩]), is the most populous city and centrally-governed city of Vietnam, with a population of more than 14 million in 2025. Its geography is defined by rivers and canals, of which the largest is the Saigon River.

Q1858.name: Hanoi
Q1858.about: Hanoi ( ha-NOY; Vietnamese: Hà Nội, pronounced [haː˨˩ noj˧˨ʔ] ) is the capital and second-most populous centrally-governed city of Vietnam. It covers an area of 3,358.6 km2 (1,296.8 mi2), and as of 2026 has a population of 8.7 million.

Q1861.name: Bangkok
Q1861.about: Bangkok, known in Thai as Krung Thep Maha Nakhon and colloquially as Krung Thep, is the capital and largest city of Thailand. The city occupies 1,568.7 square kilometres (605.7 sq mi) in the Chao Phraya River delta in central Thailand and has an estimated population of 9.1 million people as of 2024, 15.9% of the country's population.
Q1861.img: Temple of the Emerald of buddha or Wat Phra Kaew (cropped).jpg

Q184116.name: Gary
Q184116.desc: city in Lake County, State of Indiana, United States
Q184116.about: Gary is a city in Lake County, Indiana, United States. The population was 69,093 at the 2020 census, making it Indiana's eleventh-most populous city.

Q184345.name: Viña del Mar
Q184345.about: Viña del Mar (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈbiɲa ðel ˈmaɾ]; meaning "Vineyard of the Sea" or "Vineyard-on-Sea") is a city and commune on central Chile's Pacific coast. Often referred to as La Ciudad Jardín ("The Garden City"), the city is located on the central coast, on the basins of the Reñaca and Marga Marga streams and along the shores of Valparaíso Bay.

Q18383.name: Providence
Q18383.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Rhode Island and seat of Providence County
Q18383.about: Providence ( ) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Rhode Island. It is the third-most populous city in New England, with a population of 190,934 at the 2020 census.

Q18094.name: Honolulu
Q18094.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Hawaii and seat of Honolulu County
Q18094.about: Honolulu (  HON-ə-LOO-loo; Hawaiian: [honoˈlulu]) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Hawaii, located in the Pacific Ocean. It is the county seat of the consolidated City and County of Honolulu, situated along the southeast coast of the island of Oʻahu.

Q18125.name: Manchester
Q18125.about: Manchester is a city and metropolitan borough in North West England, at the centre of the eponymous county of Greater Manchester. It had a population of over 589,000 in 2024.

Q1895.name: Petrozavodsk
Q1895.desc: capital city of the Republic of Karelia in north-western Russia
Q1895.about: Petrozavodsk is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Karelia, Russia, which stretches along the western shore of Lake Onega for some 27 kilometers (17 mi). The population of the city is 280,890 as of 2022.

Q1899.name: Kyiv
Q1899.desc: capital and largest city of Ukraine
Q1899.about: Kyiv, also spelt Kiev, is the capital and most populous city of Ukraine. Located in the north-central part of the country, it straddles both banks of the Dnieper River.

Q1903.name: Catania
Q1903.about: Catania (, UK also , US also ; Sicilian and Italian: [kaˈtaːnja] ) is the second-largest city in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy, after Palermo, both by area and by population. Despite being the second largest city of the island, Catania is the centre of the most densely populated Sicilian conurbation, which is among the largest in Italy.

Q185533.name: Aleutians West Census Area
Q185533.desc: census area in Alaska, United States of America
Q185533.about: Aleutians West Census Area (Russian: Западные Алеутские острова) is a census area located in the U.S. state of Alaska. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,232, down from 5,561 in 2010.

Q185582.name: Knoxville
Q185582.desc: city and county seat of Knox County, State of Tennessee, United States
Q185582.about: Knoxville is a city in Knox County, Tennessee, United States, and its county seat. Located on the Tennessee River within the Appalachian Mountains, it is the largest city in the Grand Division of East Tennessee.

Q185591.name: Pietermaritzburg
Q185591.about: Pietermaritzburg (; Zulu: uMgungundlovu) is the capital and second-largest city in the province of KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa after Durban. It was named in 1838 and is currently governed by the Msunduzi Local Municipality.

Q185672.name: Grytviken
Q185672.desc: abandoned whaling station; settlement on the island of South Georgia–South Sandwich Islands
Q185672.about: Grytviken ( GRIT-vee-kən; Norwegian: [ˈɡɾŷːtviːkn̩]) is a hamlet on South Georgia in the South Atlantic. Formerly a whaling station, it was the largest settlement on the island.
Q185672.img: Grytviken Harbour, Island of South Georgia, United Kingdom.jpg

Q185678.name: Saint-Pierre
Q185678.about: Saint-Pierre (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃ pjɛʁ] ) is the capital of the French collectivité d'outre-mer (territory) of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, off the coast of the Canadian island of Newfoundland. Saint-Pierre is the more populous of the two communes (municipalities) making up Saint Pierre and Miquelon.

Q185684.name: Hefei
Q185684.about: Hefei is the capital of Anhui province, China. A prefecture-level city, it is the political, economic, and cultural center of Anhui.

Q1863.name: Andorra la Vella
Q1863.about: Andorra la Vella is the capital and largest city of Andorra. It is located high in the east Pyrenees, between France and Spain.

Q1867.name: Taipei
Q1867.desc: special municipality and capital city of Taiwan
Q1867.about: Taipei ( ), officially Taipei City, is the capital and a special municipality of Taiwan. Located in Northern Taiwan, Taipei City is an enclave of the municipality of New Taipei City that sits about 25 kilometres (16 mi) southwest of the northern port city of Keelung.

Q1874.name: Odesa
Q1874.desc: city in southwestern Ukraine, administrative center of Odesa Oblast and Odesa Raion
Q1874.about: Odesa, also spelled Odessa, is the third-most populous city and municipality in Ukraine and a major seaport and transport hub located in the south-west of the country, on the northwestern shore of the Black Sea. The city is also the administrative centre of the Odesa Raion and Odesa Oblast, as well as a multiethnic cultural centre.

Q184587.name: Grand Rapids
Q184587.desc: city in and seat of Kent County, Michigan, United States
Q184587.about: Grand Rapids is a city in and the county seat of Kent County, Michigan, United States. The city had a population of 198,917 at the 2020 census and an estimated population of 201,183 in 2025.
Q184587.img: Downtown Grand Rapids from River House.jpg

Q185125.name: Hamamatsu
Q185125.about: Hamamatsu (浜松市, Hamamatsu-shi) is a city located in western Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. In September 2023, the city had an estimated population of 780,128 in 340,591 households, making it the prefecture's largest city, with a population density of 500/km2 (1,300/sq mi) over the total urban area of 1,558.06 km2 (601.57 sq mi).

Q185157.name: Tétouan
Q185157.desc: Moroccan city located in the Western Rif
Q185157.about: Tétouan is a city in northern Morocco. It lies along the Martil Valley and is one of the two major ports of Morocco on the Mediterranean Sea, a few miles south of the Strait of Gibraltar, and about 60 kilometres (37 mi) E.S.E. of Tangier.

Q185216.name: Grapevine
Q185216.desc: city in Tarrant County, Texas, United States
Q185216.about: Grapevine is a city located in northeast Tarrant County, Texas, United States, with minor portions extending into Dallas and Denton counties. Its population was 50,631 in the 2020 census, up from 46,334 in the 2010 census.

Q185453.name: Multan
Q185453.about: Multan is a city in the Punjab province of Pakistan. Located along the eastern bank of the Chenab River, it is the sixth-largest city in the country; and serves as the administrative headquarters of its eponymous division and district.

Q185458.name: Quetta
Q185458.about: Quetta is the capital and largest city of the Pakistani province of Balochistan. It is the ninth largest city in Pakistan with an estimated population of over 1.7 million in 2024.

Q185518.name: Mandalay
Q185518.desc: cultural city in Mandalay Region, Myanmar
Q185518.about: Mandalay is the second-largest city in Myanmar, after Yangon. It is located on the east bank of the Irrawaddy River, 631 km (392 mi) north of Yangon.

Q1930.name: Ottawa
Q1930.about: Ottawa ( , ; Canadian French: [ɔtawɑ] ) is the capital city of Canada. It is located in the southeastern portion of the province of Ontario, at the confluence of the Ottawa River and the Rideau River.

Q17943.name: Arlington
Q17943.desc: suburban city in Tarrant County, Texas, United States
Q17943.about: Arlington is a city in Tarrant County, Texas, United States. It is part of the Mid-Cities region of the Dallas–Fort Worth–Arlington metropolitan statistical area, and is a principal city of the metropolis and region.
Q17943.img: University of Texas at Arlington March 2021 039 (Arlington Hall).jpg

Q18013.name: Sacramento
Q18013.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of California and seat of Sacramento County
Q18013.about: Sacramento is the capital city of the U.S. state of California. The county seat of Sacramento County, it is located at the confluence of the Sacramento and American Rivers in the Sacramento Valley.

Q187346.name: Constantine
Q187346.about: Constantine (Arabic: قسنطينة, romanized: Qusanṭīnah, Tamazight: ⵇⵙⵏⵟⵉⵏⴰ, romanized: Qsnṭina), also spelled Qacentina or Kasantina, is the capital of Constantine Province in northeastern Algeria. During Roman times it was called Cirta and was renamed "Constantina" in honour of Emperor Constantine the Great.

Q187593.name: Lubumbashi
Q187593.desc: second largest city in Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q187593.about: Lubumbashi (UK:  LOO-buum-BASH-ee, US:  LOO-boom-BAH-shee), formerly Élisabethville (French: [elizabɛtvil]; Dutch: Elisabethstad [eːˈlisaːbɛtstɑt] ), is the second-largest city in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, located in the southeasternmost part of the country, near the border with Zambia. The capital and principal city of the Haut-Katanga Province, Lubumbashi is the center of mining in the region, acting as a hub for many of the country's largest mining companies.
Q187593.img: Downtown Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo - 20061130.jpg

Q187805.name: Spokane
Q187805.desc: city in and county seat of Spokane County, Washington, United States
Q187805.about: Spokane (  spoh-KAN; Spokane: sƛ̓x̌etkʷ) is a city in and the county seat of Spokane County in the U.S. state of Washington.
