It lies along the Spokane River, adjacent to the Selkirk Mountains and west of the Rocky Mountain foothills, 110 miles (180 km) south of the Canadian border, twenty miles (30 km) west of the Idaho state line, 279 miles (449 km) southwest of Calgary, and 280 miles (450 km) east of Seattle, via I-90.

Q187861.name: Wollongong
Q187861.desc: city in New South Wales, Australia
Q187861.about: Wollongong ( WUUL-ən-gong; Dharawal: Woolyungah) is a city in the Illawarra region of New South Wales, Australia. It lies on the narrow coastal strip between the Illawarra Escarpment and the Pacific Ocean, 85 kilometres (53 miles) south of Sydney.

Q18419.name: Brooklyn
Q18419.desc: borough of New York City, New York, United States
Q18419.about: Brooklyn, coextensive with Kings County, is the most populous of the five boroughs and counties of New York City, New York. Located at the westernmost end of Long Island and formerly an independent city, Brooklyn shares a land border with the borough and county of Queens.

Q18424.name: Queens
Q18424.desc: borough in New York City, New York, United States
Q18424.about: Queens is the largest by area of the five boroughs of New York City, and the second most populous, with a population of 2,405,464 as of the 2020 census. Since 1899 the borough is coextensive with Queens County, the second-most populous county in New York state, behind Kings County (Brooklyn).

Q18426.name: The Bronx
Q18426.desc: borough of New York City, New York, United States
Q18426.about: The Bronx ( BRONKS) is the northernmost of the five boroughs of New York City. The Bronx has a land area of 42 square miles (109 km2) and a population of 1,472,654 at the 2020 census.

Q18432.name: Staten Island
Q18432.desc: borough of New York City, New York, United States
Q18432.about: Staten Island  ( STAT-ən) is the southernmost of the five boroughs of New York City. It is separated from New Jersey by the Arthur Kill and the Kill Van Kull and from the rest of New York by New York Bay.
Q18432.img: USS Leyte Gulf (CG 55) under the Verrazano Narrows Bridge.jpg

Q18458.name: Regional Municipality of York
Q18458.desc: regional municipality in Southern Ontario, Canada
Q18458.about: The Regional Municipality of York, also called York Region, is a regional municipality in Southern Ontario, Canada, between Lake Simcoe and Toronto. The region was established after the passing of then Bill 102, An Act to Establish The Regional Municipality of York, in 1970.

Q18569.name: Douglas
Q18569.desc: capital city of the Isle of Man
Q18569.about: Douglas (Manx: Doolish, pronounced [ˈdðuːlʲəʃ]) is a port city and the capital of the Isle of Man, situated on the Douglas Bay, near the Irish Sea. It is located at the mouth of the River Douglas, and on a sweeping bay of two miles (three kilometres).
Q18569.img: The View From Douglas Head, Isle Of Man..jpg

Q18575.name: Tucson
Q18575.desc: city in and county seat of Pima County, Arizona, United States
Q18575.about: Tucson (; O'odham: Cuk Ṣon; Spanish: Tucsón, also Spanish: Tucson) is the county seat of and the most populated city in Pima County, Arizona, United States. It is the second-most populous city in Arizona with a population of 542,630 at the 2020 census, behind the capital city, Phoenix, while the Tucson metropolitan statistical area has an estimated 1.08 million residents and is the 52nd-largest metropolitan area in the United States.

Q18780.name: Likasi
Q18780.desc: town in the Haut-Katanga province in the Democratic Republic of Congo
Q18780.about: Likasi (formerly official names: Jadotville (French) and Jadotstad (Dutch)) is a city in Haut-Katanga Province, in the south-east of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

Q18970.name: Ambon
Q18970.about: Ambon (Indonesian pronunciation: [ˈambɔn]; formerly Dutch: Amboina) is the capital and largest city of the Indonesian province of Maluku. This city is also known as Ambon Manise, which means "beautiful" or "pretty" Ambon in the Ambonese language.
Q18970.img: USNS Mercy off the coast of Ambon, Indonesia.jpg

Q17347332.name: Jember
Q17347332.desc: former administrative city and capital of Jember Regency

Q18812162.name: Tlalnepantla
Q18812162.desc: municipal seat of Tlalnepantla, State of Mexico, Mexico

Q1761.name: Dublin
Q1761.desc: capital and largest city of Ireland
Q1761.about: Dublin is the capital and largest city of Ireland. Situated on Dublin Bay at the mouth of the River Liffey, it is in the province of Leinster, and is bordered on the south by the Dublin Mountains, part of the Wicklow Mountains range.

Q1763.name: Murmansk
Q1763.desc: city in the northwest of Russia
Q1763.about: Murmansk (Russian: Мурманск) is the administrative center and largest city of Murmansk Oblast in the far northwest part of Russia. It is a major port city and is the world's most populous city north of the Arctic Circle.

Q178663.name: Meknes
Q178663.about: Meknes is one of the four imperial cities of Morocco, located in northern central Morocco and the sixth largest city by population in the kingdom. Founded in the 11th century by the Almoravids as a military settlement, Meknes became the capital of Morocco during the reign of Sultan Ismail Ibn Sharif (1672–1727), son of the founder of the Alaouite dynasty.

Q178725.name: Niterói
Q178725.desc: municipality in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Q178725.about: Niterói (English:  NEE-tə-ROY, NIT-ə-ROY, Brazilian Portuguese: [niteˈɾɔj]) is a municipality in the state of Rio de Janeiro, in the southeast region of Brazil. It lies across Guanabara Bay, facing the city of Rio de Janeiro and forming part of the Rio de Janeiro Metropolitan Area.

Q178945.name: Bazhong
Q178945.about: Bazhong (Chinese: 巴中; pinyin: Bāzhōng; lit. 'centre of Ba') is a prefecture-level city in north-eastern Sichuan province, China.

Q179431.name: Road Town
Q179431.desc: capital of the British Virgin Islands
Q179431.about: Road Town, located on Tortola, is the capital and largest town of the British Virgin Islands. It is situated on the horseshoe-shaped Road Harbour in the centre of the island's south coast.

Q179553.name: Saanich
Q179553.desc: district municipality in British Columbia, Canada
Q179553.about: Saanich ( SAN-ich) is a district municipality on the southern end of Vancouver Island in British Columbia, Canada, within the Greater Victoria area. The population was 117,735 at the 2021 census, making it the most populous municipality in the Capital Regional District and Vancouver Island, and the eighth-most populous in the province.

Q179608.name: Nanning
Q179608.about: Nanning is the capital of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in southern China. It is known as the "Green City (绿城)" because of its abundance of lush subtropical foliage.

Q179645.name: Shinjuku
Q179645.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis, Japan
Q179645.about:
Shinjuku (新宿区, Shinjuku-ku) [ɕìɲ̟́.ɟ̟͡ʑɨ́.kɯ̈́, -kɯ̥̈.kɯ̈̀, ɕíɲ̟́-] , officially called Shinjuku City, is one of the 23 special wards of Tokyo.
Since the end of World War II, Shinjuku has become a major secondary center of Tokyo (fukutoshin), rivaling the original city center in Marunouchi.
Q179645.img: US Air Force photo 170903-F-PM645-1558 An aerial view of Shinjuku’s skyscraper district from a UH-1N Iroquois.jpg

Q1758751.name: Tuen Mun
Q1758751.about: Tuen Mun (Chinese: 屯門) or Castle Peak is an area near the mouth of Tuen Mun River and Castle Peak Bay in the west of New Territories, Hong Kong. It was one of the earliest settlements in what is now Hong Kong and can be dated to the Neolithic period.

Q1758870.name: Tai Po
Q1758870.about: Tai Po  is an area in the New Territories of Hong Kong. It refers to the vicinity of the traditional market towns in the area presently known as Tai Po Old Market or Tai Po Kau Hui (大埔舊墟) (the original "Tai Po Market") on the north of Lam Tsuen River and the Tai Po Hui (the current Tai Po Market; historically Tai Wo Shi, literally Tai Wo market) on Fu Shin Street on the south of the Lam Tsuen River, near the old Tai Po Market railway station of the Kowloon-Canton Railway (British Section).

Q1758914.name: Tsuen Wan
Q1758914.about: Tsuen Wan (formerly also spelled Tsun Wan) is a town built on a bay in the western New Territories of Hong Kong, opposite Tsing Yi Island across Rambler Channel. The market town of Tsuen Wan emerged from the surrounding villages and fleets of fishing boats in the area.

Q1759693.name: South Boston
Q1759693.desc: neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, United States
Q1759693.about: South Boston (colloquially known as Southie) is a densely populated neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, United States, located south and east of the Fort Point Channel and abutting Dorchester Bay. It has undergone several demographic transformations since being annexed to the city of Boston in 1804.

Q1761214.name: Tinley Park
Q1761214.desc: village located in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q1761214.about: Tinley Park is a village in Cook and Will counties in the U.S. state of Illinois. The population was 55,971 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 54,856 in 2024.

Q1771762.name: Purnia
Q1771762.about: Purnia (; also romanized and officially known as Purnea) is the fourth largest city of Bihar and is emerging as the largest economic hub in North Bihar. It serves as the administrative headquarters of both Purnia district and Purnia division in the Indian state of Bihar.

Q1772825.name: Hisar
Q1772825.about: Hisar (), also known as Hissar, is the administrative headquarters of Hisar district in the state of Haryana in northwestern India. It is located 164 km (102 mi) to the west of the national capital New Delhi, and has been identified as a counter-magnet city for the National Capital Region to develop as an alternative center of growth to Delhi.

Q1775128.name: Gómez Palacio
Q1775128.desc: municipal seat of Gómez Palacio, State of Durango, Mexico
Q1775128.about: Gómez Palacio is a city and its surrounding municipality in northeastern Durango, Mexico, adjacent to the border of the state of Coahuila. The city is named in honor of former Durango governor, Francisco Gómez Palacio y Bravo.
Q1775128.img: Parroquia de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe, Gomez Palacio, Dgo.jpg

Q1773.name: Riga
Q1773.desc: capital and largest city of Latvia
Q1773.about: Riga (  REE-gə), officially Riga State City (Latvian: Rīgas valstspilsēta), is the capital, primate, and largest city of Latvia and the second most-populous city in the Baltics. Home to 588,911 inhabitants (as of 2026), the city accounts for a third of Latvia's total population.
Q1773.img: Vistas desde la iglesia de San Pedro, Riga, Letonia, 2012-08-07, DD 12.JPG

Q1780.name: Bratislava
Q1780.about: Bratislava (Hungarian: Pozsony; German: Pressburg) is the capital and largest city of Slovakia and the fourth largest of all cities on the river Danube. Officially, the population of the city proper is about 479,000, with the wider Bratislava Region exceeding 732,000 inhabitants.

Q180084.name: Ile Ife
Q180084.desc: an ancient Yoruba city in south-western Nigeria founded sometime between the years 1000 BC and 500 BC
Q180084.about: Ifẹ̀ (Yoruba: Ifẹ̀ , also called Ilé-Ifẹ̀) is an ancient Yoruba city in south-western Nigeria founded sometime between the years 1000 BC and 500 BC. By 900 AD, the city had become an important West African emporium producing sophisticated art forms.  The city is located in present-day Osun State.
Q180084.img: Faculty of Medicine, Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, Osun State, Nigeria (12998041954).jpg

Q180103.name: Ardabil
Q180103.about: Ardabil (Persian: اردبیل, ) is a city in northwestern Iran. It is in the Central District of Ardabil County, Ardabil province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district.

Q180215.name: Macapá
Q180215.about: Macapá (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [makaˈpa] ) is the capital of the Brazilian state of Amapá, in the country's North Region, located on the northern channel of the Amazon Delta near its mouth on the Atlantic Ocean. Its population is estimated to be 512,902 (2020).

Q180785.name: Otter Tail County
Q180785.about: Otter Tail County is a county in the U.S. state of Minnesota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 60,081, and it was estimated at 61,041 in 2025.
Q180785.img: Edward J. Devitt U.S. Courthouse and Federal Building.jpg

Q180921.name: Omdurman
Q180921.about: Omdurman (Arabic: أُمّ دُرمان, romanized: Umm Durmān) is a major city in Sudan. It is the second most populous city in the country, located in the State of Khartoum.

Q1786989.name: Saint John County
Q1786989.about: Saint John County (2021 population: 76,558) is located in southern New Brunswick, Canada. The city of Saint John dominates the county.

Q1788128.name: Owo
Q1788128.desc: local government area in Ondo State, Nigeria
Q1788128.about: Owo is a city and local government area in Ondo state, Nigeria. Between 1400 and 1600 CE, it was the capital of a Yoruba city-state.

Q1795453.name: Lincoln Park
Q1795453.desc: community area of Chicago, United States
Q1795453.about: Lincoln Park is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States. It is located west of the public park Lincoln Park.

Q1798108.name: Parry Sound District
Q1798108.about: Parry Sound District is a census division of the Canadian province of Ontario.  Its boundaries are District of Muskoka to the south, the Sudbury District to the north-northwest, the French River and Lake Nipissing in the north, Nipissing District and North Bay in the north and east and parts of Algonquin Park in the northeast.

Q1798241.name: Santa Catarina
Q1798241.desc: municipal seat of Santa Catarina, State of Nuevo León, Mexico
Q1798241.about: Santa Catarina is a city in the Mexican state of Nuevo León. It serves as the seat of the municipality of the same name and is part of the Monterrey Metropolitan area.

Q1798559.name: Tonalá
Q1798559.desc: municipal seat of Tonalá, State of Jalisco, Mexico
Q1798559.about: Tonalá (Spanish pronunciation: [tonaˈla]) is a city and municipality within the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area in the state of Jalisco in Mexico. With a population of 442,440, it is the fourth largest city in the state, the other three being the other major population centres in the metro area: Guadalajara, Zapopan, and Tlaquepaque.

Q1798945.name: La Matapédia
Q1798945.desc: Regional County Municipality (RCM) of Bas-Saint-Laurent, Quebec, Canada
Q1798945.about: La Matapédia (French pronunciation: [la matapedja]) is a regional county municipality (RCM) in eastern Quebec, Canada at the base of the Gaspé peninsula, in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region. Its seat is in Amqui.

Q1801463.name: Panihati
Q1801463.about: Panihati is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q1801761.name: Lanark County
Q1801761.about: Lanark County is a county and census division located in the Canadian province of Ontario. Its county seat is Perth, which was first settled in 1816 and was known as a social and political capital before being overshadowed by a city known today as Ottawa.

Q1816.name: Marienthal
Q1816.about: Marienthal (German pronunciation: [maˈʁiːənˌtaːl] ) is a quarter of Hamburg, Germany in the Wandsbek borough.

Q1822.name: Baguio
Q1822.about: Baguio (UK:  BAG-ee-oh, US:  BAH-ghee-oh, -⁠OH, Tagalog: [ˈbaɡjo]), officially the City of Baguio (Ibaloi: Siudad ne Bagiw; Ilocano: Siudad ti Baguio; Tagalog: Lungsod ng Baguio), is a highly urbanized city in the Cordillera Administrative Region, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 368,426 people.

Q1829.name: Kaliningrad
Q1829.desc: Russian Baltic city between Poland and Lithuania
Q1829.about: Kaliningrad, until 1946 known in English as Königsberg, is the largest city and administrative centre of Kaliningrad Oblast, an exclave of Russia between Lithuania and Poland (663 kilometres (412 mi) west of the bulk of Russia). Located on the Pregolya River at the head of the Vistula Lagoon, it is the only ice-free Russian port on the Baltic Sea.
Q1829.img: Old cathedral of Kaliningrad in Russia.jpg

Q1833.name: Wandsbek
Q1833.about: Wandsbek (German pronunciation: [ˈvantsbeːk] ) is an urban quarter in the Wandsbek borough of Hamburg, Germany, and the former city Wandsbek in the Duchy of Holstein. In 2020 the population was 36,671.

Q1842.name: Luxembourg
Q1842.desc: capital and largest city of Luxembourg
Q1842.about: Luxembourg (Luxembourgish: Lëtzebuerg; French: Luxembourg; German: Luxemburg), also known as Luxembourg City (Luxembourgish: Stad Lëtzebuerg or d'Stad; French: Ville de Luxembourg; German: Stadt Luxemburg or Luxemburg-Stadt), is the capital city of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the country's most populous commune. Standing at the confluence of the Alzette and Pétrusse rivers in southern Luxembourg, the city lies in the centre of Western Europe, situated 213 km (132 mi) by road from Brussels and 209 km (130 mi) from Cologne.

Q182625.name: Windsor
Q182625.desc: city in Essex County, Ontario, Canada
Q182625.about: Windsor ( WIND-zər) is a city in southwestern Ontario, Canada. It is situated on the south bank of the Detroit River directly across from the U.S. city of Detroit, Michigan.

Q182640.name: Ta'if
Q182640.about: Taif (Arabic: اَلطَّائِفُ, romanized: Aṭ-Ṭāʾif, lit. 'The circulated or encircled', Hejazi Arabic pronunciation: [atˤˈ tˤaː(j)ɪf]) is a city and governorate in Mecca Province in Saudi Arabia. Located at an elevation of 1,879 m (6,165 ft) in the slopes of the Hijaz Mountains, which themselves are part of the Sarat Mountains, the city has a population of 563,282 people in 2022, making it one of the most populous cities in the kingdom.

Q182644.name: Van Buren County
Q182644.about: Van Buren County ( van BURE-ən) is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census the population was 7,203, making it the state's tenth-least populous county.

Q182845.name: Clark County
Q182845.about: Clark County is a county located in the northeastern corner of the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, its population was 6,634.

Q182852.name: Kunming
Q182852.about: Kunming is the capital and largest city of the province of Yunnan in China. The political, economic, communications and cultural centre of the province, Kunming is also a major tourism centre in China.
Q182852.img: 五华区与盘龙区天际线 - 航拍 - 2025-05-16 03.jpg

Q182984.name: Kano
Q182984.about: Kano (; Ajami: كَنُواْ) is a city in northern Nigeria and the capital of Kano State. It is the second largest city in Nigeria after Lagos, with over four million citizens living within 449 km2 (173 sq mi).

Q183002.name: Surgut
Q183002.about: Surgut (Russian: Сургут, IPA: [sʊrˈgut]; Khanty: Сәрханӆ, Sərhanł; Сө̆ркут, Sörkut) is the largest and most populous city in Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug, Russia, located on the Ob River. It is one of the few cities in Russia to be larger than the capital or the administrative center of its federal subject in terms of population, economic activity, and tourist traffic.

Q1920284.name: Parbhani
Q1920284.desc: city in Maharashtra state of India
Q1920284.about: Parbhani (parbhani, Marathi pronunciation: [pəɾbʰəɳiː] ) is a city in Maharashtra state of India. It is the administrative headquarters of Parbhani District.

Q1926941.name: Bokaro
Q1926941.desc: human settlement in Bokaro district, North Chotanagpur division, Jharkhand, India
Q1926941.about: Bokaro Thermal is a census town in Bermo CD block in the Bermo subdivision of the  Bokaro district  in the state of Jharkhand, India. Often colloquially referred to as 'BTPS', as the Bokaro Thermal Power Station is located in this area.

Q1931946.name: Middlesex County
Q1931946.about: Middlesex County is a primarily rural county and census division in Southwestern Ontario, Canada. Landlocked, the county is bordered by Huron and Perth counties on the north, Oxford County on the east, Elgin County on the south, and Chatham-Kent and Lambton County on the west.

Q1932224.name: Xico
Q1932224.desc: municipal seat of Valle de Chalco, State of Mexico, Mexico
Q1932224.about: Xico is a city in the State of Mexico, Mexico. It serves as the municipal seat of Valle de Chalco municipality, with which it is, for all practical purposes, coterminous.

Q18120072.name: Prince of Wales–Hyder Census Area
Q18120072.desc: census area in Alaska, United States
Q18120072.wiki: Prince of Wales–Hyder Census Area, Alaska
Q18120072.about: Prince of Wales–Hyder Census Area is a census area located in the U.S. state of Alaska. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,753, up from 5,559 in 2010.

Q1800.name: Kochi
Q1800.about: Kochi ( KOH-chee, Malayalam: [kotˈt͡ʃi] ), formerly known as Cochin ( KOH-chin), is a major port city along the Malabar Coast of India bordering the Laccadive Sea. It is part of the district of Ernakulam in the state of Kerala and is the financial, industrial and commercial capital of the state.

Q181578.name: Qazvin
Q181578.about: Qazvin (Persian: قزوین; ; IPA: [ɢæzˈviːn] ) is a city in the Central District of Qazvin County, Qazvin province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district. It is the largest city in the province.

Q181966.name: Naha
Q181966.desc: capital city of Okinawa prefecture, Japan
Q181966.about: Naha (Japanese: 那覇市, Hepburn: Naha-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [nä́.hä̀, nä̀.hä́.ɕì]; Okinawan: Naafa or Nafa) is the capital city of Okinawa Prefecture, the southernmost prefecture of Japan. As of 1 June 2019, the city has an estimated population of 317,405 and a population density of 7,939 people per km2 (20,562 persons per sq.

Q181967.name: Adair County
Q181967.about: Adair County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 18,903.

Q182025.name: Aksaray
Q182025.desc: central district and city in Aksaray Province, Turkey
Q182025.about: Aksaray (pronounced [ˈaksaɾaj]) is a city in the Central Anatolia region of Turkey. It is the seat of Aksaray Province and Aksaray District.

Q182049.name: Rustenburg
Q182049.about: Rustenburg (; Afrikaans pronunciation: [ˈrœstənbœrχ], Afrikaans and Dutch: Town of Rest) is a City at the foot of the Magaliesberg mountain range. Rustenburg is the most populous city in North West province, South Africa (549,575 in 2011 and 626,522 in the 2016 census).

Q182059.name: Kumasi
Q182059.about: Kumasi is a city and the capital of the Kumasi Metropolitan Assembly and the Ashanti Region of Ghana. It is the second largest city in the country, with a population of 443,981 as of the 2021 census.

Q182112.name: Essex County
Q182112.about: Essex County is a United States county located in the Middle Peninsula of the Commonwealth of Virginia.  The county is bordered by the Rappahannock River on the north and King and Queen County on the south.

Q182176.name: De Baca County
Q182176.desc: county in New Mexico, United States
Q182176.about: De Baca County is a county in the U.S. state of New Mexico. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,698, making it New Mexico's second-least populous county.

Q182394.name: Yazd
Q182394.desc: capital city of Yazd Province, Iran
Q182394.about: Yazd (Persian: یزد; [jæzd] ) is a city in the Central District of Yazd County, Yazd province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district. At the 2016 census, its population was 529,673.

Q1851708.name: West Bloomfield Township
Q1851708.desc: charter township in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan
Q1851708.about: West Bloomfield Township (commonly, West Bloomfield) is a charter township in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A northwestern suburb of Detroit, West Bloomfield is located roughly 27 miles (43.5 km) from downtown Detroit.

Q1853310.name: Ondo
Q1853310.about: Ondo Town is the second largest city in Ondo State, Nigeria. Ondo Town is the trade center for the surrounding region; commercial crops such as yams, cassava, grain, tobacco and cotton are grown, the latter of which is often used to weave a culturally significant  cloth known as Aso Oke fabric, which is commonly used to make clothing amongst the local population.

Q1875153.name: Qibao
Q1875153.desc: town in Shanghai, People's Republic of China
Q1875153.about: Qibao (simplified Chinese: 七宝镇; traditional Chinese: 七寶鎮; pinyin: Qībǎo Zhèn; Shanghainese: Tshih4pau2) is a town in Minhang District, Shanghai. Its formation can be traced back to the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, to the Northern Song Dynasty.

Q1889017.name: Mandaue
Q1889017.about: Mandaue (locally [mɐnˈdaʊ.ɛ]), officially the City of Mandaue (Cebuano: Dakbayan sa Mandaue; Filipino: Lungsod ng Mandaue), is a highly urbanized city in the Central Visayas region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 364,482 people.
Q1889017.img: Mandaue, Mactan view from Tops Lookout (Cebu City; 09-06-2022).jpg

Q1898798.name: Deltona
Q1898798.desc: city in Volusia County, Florida, United States
Q1898798.about: Deltona is a city in Volusia County, Florida, United States. It is located on the northern shore of Lake Monroe.

Q1908110.name: Matawinie
Q1908110.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1908110.about: Matawinie (French pronunciation: [matawini]) is a regional county municipality in the region of Lanaudière in southwestern Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Rawdon.

Q1918837.name: Bogura
Q1918837.about: Bogra (Bengali: বগুড়া),  officially Bogura, is a city located in Bogra District, Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh. The city is a major commercial hub in Northern Bangladesh.

Q1794.name: Frankfurt
Q1794.desc: most populated city of Hesse, Germany
Q1794.about: Frankfurt am Main, usually shortened to Frankfurt, is the most populous city in the German state of Hesse. Its 778,589 inhabitants as of 2025 make it the fifth-most populous city in Germany.

Q1799.name: Wrocław
Q1799.desc: city in the Lower Silesian Voivodeship, southwestern Poland, and historical capital of Silesia
Q1799.about: Wrocław (Polish: [ˈvrɔt͡swaf] ; German: Breslau [ˈbʁɛslaʊ] ; also known by other names) is a city in southwestern Poland, and the capital of the Lower Silesian Voivodeship. It is the largest city and historical capital of the regions of Silesia and Lower Silesia.

Q181004.name: Madawaska County
Q181004.about: Madawaska County (2021 population 32,603), also known as the "New Brunswick Panhandle", is located in northwestern New Brunswick, Canada. 94% of the county’s population speaks French (88% as first language, 6.1% as second language).

Q181015.name: Charleston County
Q181015.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q181015.about: Charleston County is located in the U.S. state of South Carolina along the Atlantic coast. As of the 2020 census, the population was 408,235, making it the third-most populous county in South Carolina (behind Greenville and Richland counties).

Q181325.name: Labette County
Q181325.about: Labette County is a county located in Southeast Kansas.  Its county seat is Oswego, and its most populous city is Parsons.

Q181376.name: Hrodna
Q181376.desc: city in Belarus, capital of Hrodna Region
Q181376.about: Grodno, or Hrodna, is a city in western Belarus. It is one of the oldest cities in Belarus.

Q181557.name: Kaohsiung
Q181557.about: Kaohsiung, officially Kaohsiung City, is a special municipality located in southern Taiwan. With a population of approximately 2.7 million people, it is Taiwan's third most populous city and the largest city in southern Taiwan.

Q1806100.name: Parauapebas
Q1806100.about: Parauapebas is a municipality in the state of Pará in the Northern region of Brazil.

Q1807947.name: Maheshtala
Q1807947.about: Maheshtala (Bengali: [mɔɦeːʃt̪ɔlɑː]) is a city and a municipality of South 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q1809910.name: Le Granit
Q1809910.desc: regional county municipality in Estrie, Quebec, Canada
Q1809910.about: Le Granit (French pronunciation: [lə ɡʁanit], lit. 'The Granite') is a regional county municipality in the Estrie region of eastern Quebec, Canada. Located directly south of Quebec City, it borders the region of Chaudière-Appalaches, as well as the US states of New Hampshire and Maine.

Q1810072.name: Le Plateau-Mont-Royal
Q1810072.about:
Le Plateau-Mont-Royal (French pronunciation: [lə plato mɔ̃ ʁwajal]) is a borough (arrondissement) of the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada.
The borough takes its name from its location on a plateau, on the eastern side of Mount Royal and overlooking downtown Montreal, across its southern border.

Q1810131.name: Tri-Cities
Q1810131.desc: group of three closely-tied contiguous cities in the U.S. state of Washington
Q1810131.about: The Tri-Cities are three closely linked cities (Kennewick, Pasco, and Richland) at the confluence of the Yakima, Snake, and Columbia Rivers in the U.S. state of Washington. Located in the Columbia Basin of Eastern Washington, the cities border one another, making the Tri-Cities seem like one uninterrupted mid-sized city.

Q1810586.name: La Matanie
Q1810586.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q1810586.about: La Matanie (French pronunciation: [la matani]) is a regional county municipality, located in the Bas-Saint-Laurent region of Quebec, in Canada. From January 1, 1982, to March 9, 2013, it was known as Matane.

Q1810607.name: Roussillon
Q1810607.desc: regional county municipality in Montérégie, Quebec, Canada
Q1810607.about: Roussillon (French pronunciation: [ʁusijɔ̃] ) is a regional county municipality in the Montérégie region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is in Saint-Constant, Quebec.

Q1811004.name: Les Moulins
Q1811004.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q1811004.about:
Les Moulins (French pronunciation: [le mulɛ̃]) is a regional county municipality in the Lanaudière region of Quebec, Canada.
It is located immediately north of Laval on the north shore of the Rivière des Mille-Îles, and comprises the municipalities of Terrebonne and Mascouche.

Q1815526.name: Renfrew County
Q1815526.about: Renfrew County is a county and census division in the Canadian province of Ontario. It is located on the west bank of the Ottawa River.

Q1815566.name: Manitoulin District
Q1815566.about: Manitoulin District is a district in Northeastern Ontario within the Canadian province of Ontario. It was created in 1888 from part of the Algoma District.

Q1815593.name: United Counties of Prescott and Russell
Q1815593.wiki: United Counties of Prescott and Russell
Q1815593.about: The United Counties of Prescott and Russell  (French: Comtés unis de Prescott et Russell) is a county located in the Canadian province of Ontario. Its county seat is L'Orignal.

Q1827219.name: Ciudad Benito Juárez
Q1827219.desc: municipal seat of Juárez, State of Nuevo León, Mexico
Q1827219.about: Ciudad Benito Juárez, or simply Juárez, is the name of a city located in the eastern part of the Monterrey metropolitan area in the Mexican state of Nuevo León. It is the seat of the municipality of the same name.
Q1827219.img: Vista del Cerro de la Silla. 2.jpg

Q1828539.name: Riverview
Q1828539.desc: census-designated place in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States
Q1828539.about: Riverview is an unincorporated census-designated place in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States. It is located south of Brandon.

Q1829357.name: Millcreek
Q1829357.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q1829357.about: Millcreek is a city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States, and part of the Salt Lake City metropolitan area. The population as of the 2020 census was 63,380.

Q1832732.name: Miguel Hidalgo
Q1832732.desc: territorial demarcation of the Mexico City in Mexico
Q1832732.about: Miguel Hidalgo is a borough (alcaldía) in western Mexico City, it encompasses the historic areas of Tacuba, Chapultepec and Tacubaya along with a number of notable neighborhoods such as Polanco and Lomas de Chapultepec. With landmarks such as Chapultepec Park and the Museo Nacional de Antropología, it is the second most visited borough in Mexico City after Cuauhtémoc where the historic center of Mexico City is located.

Q1832744.name: Muar
Q1832744.desc: town in Johor and district capital of Muar District
Q1832744.about: Muar (Muarian dialect: Muo), officially known by the sobriquet Bandar Maharani ("Empress Town"), is a historical town and the capital of Muar District, Johor, Malaysia, situated by the estuary of the eponymous Muar River. It is the fourth largest urban area in Johor, after Johor Bahru, Batu Pahat and Kluang.

Q1848.name: San Marino
Q1848.about: The City of San Marino (Italian: Città di San Marino), also known simply as San Marino and locally as Città, is the capital city of the Republic of San Marino and one of its nine castelli. It has a population of 4,118.
Q1848.img: View of Mount Titano - San Marino.jpg

Q1850.name: Phnom Penh
Q1850.about: Phnom Penh is the capital and most populous city of Cambodia. It has been the national capital since 1865 and has grown to become the nation's primate city and its political, economic, industrial, and cultural centre.

Q1851.name: Arkhangelsk
Q1851.desc: city in the northwest of Russia
Q1851.about: Arkhangelsk (Russian: Архангельск, pronounced [ɐrˈxanɡʲɪlʲsk]), historically called in English Archangel and later Archangelsk, is the administrative center and largest city of Arkhangelsk Oblast, Russia. It lies on both banks of the Northern Dvina River, near its mouth into the White Sea.

Q183135.name: Jefferson County
Q183135.about: Jefferson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 15,663.

Q183263.name: Prince William County
Q183263.about: Prince William County lies beside the Potomac River in the Commonwealth of Virginia. At the 2020 census, the population was 482,204, making it Virginia's second most populous county.
Q183263.img: Prince William County, VA, Courthouse IMG 4347.JPG

Q183298.name: Ibadan
Q183298.desc: capital city of Oyo State in Nigeria
Q183298.about: Ibadan ( UK: , US: ; Yoruba: Ìbàdàn [ì.bà.dã̀]) is the capital and most populous city of Oyo State, in Nigeria. It is   one of the largest cities by population in Nigeria with a population of 4.3 million within its metropolitan area.

Q183303.name: Jalalabad
Q183303.about: Jalalabad, previously known as Tarunshahr, and historically known as Nagarahara or Adinapur, is a city in eastern Afghanistan, serving as the capital of Nangarhar Province. It has an estimated population of 318,733 people.

Q183405.name: Safi
Q183405.about: Safi, commonly known as Asfi, is a city in western Morocco on the Atlantic Ocean. It is the capital and namesake of Safi Province.
Q183405.img: منظر بانورامي لآسفي من هضبة سيدي بوزيد.jpg

Q183584.name: Lanzhou
Q183584.about: Lanzhou, formerly Lanchow, is the capital and largest city of Gansu province in northwestern China. Located on the banks of the Yellow River, it is a key regional transportation hub, connecting areas further west by rail to the eastern half of the country.

Q184090.name: Preston
Q184090.desc: city and the administrative centre of Lancashire, England
Q184090.about: Preston ( ) is a city on the north bank of the River Ribble in Lancashire, England. The city is the administrative centre of the county of Lancashire and the wider City of Preston local government district.

Q186702.name: Chattanooga
Q186702.desc: city in and county seat of Hamilton County, Tennessee, United States
Q186702.about: Chattanooga ( CHAT-ə-NOO-gə) is a city in Hamilton County, Tennessee, United States, and its county seat. It is located along the Tennessee River and borders Georgia to the south.

Q187136.name: Luoyang
Q187136.desc: prefecture-level city in Henan, People's Republic of China
Q187136.about: Luoyang (simplified Chinese: 洛阳; traditional Chinese: 洛陽; pinyin: Luòyáng) is a city located in the confluence area of the Luo River and the Yellow River in the west of Henan province, China. Governed as a prefecture-level city, it borders the provincial capital of Zhengzhou to the east, Pingdingshan to the southeast, Nanyang to the south, Sanmenxia to the west, Jiyuan to the north, and Jiaozuo to the northeast.

Q196489.name: Sterlitamak
Q196489.desc: city in Bashkortostan, Russia, administrative centre of Sterlitamaksky District
Q196489.about: Sterlitamak (Russian: Стерлитама́к, IPA: [stʲɪrlʲɪtɐˈmak]; Bashkir: Стәрлетамаҡ, romanized: Stärletamaq; Bashkir pronunciation: [stær.ˌlɪ̞.tɑ.ˈmɑq] ) is the second-largest city in the Republic of Bashkortostan, Russia, after the capital, Ufa. The city is located on the left bank of the Belaya River (a tributary of the Kama River), 121 kilometers (75 mi) from Ufa.

Q197377.name: Zhangjiagang
Q197377.desc: county-level city in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China
Q197377.about: Zhangjiagang (simplified Chinese: 张家港; traditional Chinese: 張家港; pinyin: Zhāngjiāgǎng; Wade–Giles: Chang¹-chia¹-kang³; lit. 'Zhang family port'), formerly Shazhou County (Chinese: 沙洲县), is a county-level city under the administration of Suzhou, Jiangsu province, China and one of the many ports along the Yangtze river.

Q195492.name: Kibaha
Q195492.about: Kibaha is the capital of Pwani Region in eastern Tanzania, located in Kibaha District. As of the 2022 census, Kibana had a population of 265,360.

Q195658.name: Monroe County
Q195658.about: Monroe County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 154,809.

Q195664.name: Wayne County
Q195664.about: Wayne County is the most populous county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of 2020, the United States census placed its population at 1,793,561, making it the 19th-most populous county in the United States.

Q197379.name: Zhangjiajie
Q197379.about: Zhangjiajie (simplified Chinese: 张家界; traditional Chinese: 張家界; pinyin: Zhāngjiājiè; Tujia: Zanxjiaxgaif /tsán tɕá kǎi/) is a prefecture-level city in the northwestern part of Hunan Province, China. It comprises the district of Yongding, Wulingyuan and counties of Cili and Sangzhi.

Q197402.name: Zhangye
Q197402.about: Zhangye (simplified Chinese: 张掖; traditional Chinese: 張掖; pinyin: Zhāngyè), formerly romanized as Changyeh and also formerly known as Kanchow, is a prefecture-level city in central Gansu Province in the People's Republic of China. It borders Inner Mongolia on the north and Qinghai on the south.

Q196014.name: Yuba County
Q196014.about: Yuba County ( ; Maidu: Yubu) is a county located in north-central Central Valley, California, United States. As of the 2020 U.S. census, its population was 81,575.

Q194332.name: Mogi das Cruzes
Q194332.desc: municipality of São Paulo state, Brazil
Q194332.about: Mogi das Cruzes (Portuguese pronunciation: [moˈʒi] or [muˈʒi das ˈkɾuzis]) is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, located within the metropolitan region of the state capital of the city of São Paulo. The population is 451,505 (2022 census) in an area of 713 km2.
Q194332.img: Vista de Mogi das Cruzes a partir do Pico do Urubu.JPG

Q194531.name: Shaoyang
Q194531.about: Shaoyang (simplified Chinese: 邵阳; traditional Chinese: 邵陽; pinyin: Shàoyáng), formerly named Baoqing (Paoking) (Chinese: 宝庆), is a prefecture-level city in southwestern Hunan province, China, bordering Guangxi to the south. It has a history of 2500 years and remains an important commercial and transportation city in Hunan.

Q211360.name: Burke County
Q211360.about: Burke County is a county located along the eastern border of the U.S. state of Georgia in the Piedmont. As of the 2020 census, the population was 24,596.

Q211489.name: Espoon keskus
Q211489.about: Espoon keskus (Finnish for Espoo Centre, Swedish: Esbo centrum) is the central district of Espoo, the second biggest city of Finland and the administrative centre with the city hall of Espoo. The areas of Kiltakallio, Kirkkojärvi, Saarniraivio, Suna, Suvela and Tuomarila belong to Espoon keskus.

Q211563.name: Beira
Q211563.about:
Beira (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈbejɾɐ]) is the capital and largest city of Sofala Province, in the central region of Mozambique. 
Beira is where the Pungwe River meets the Indian Ocean.

Q211629.name: Sparks
Q211629.desc: city in Washoe County, Nevada, United States
Q211629.about: Sparks is a city in Washoe County, Nevada, United States. It was founded in 1904, incorporated on March 15, 1905, and is located just east of Reno.

Q1957.name: Vologda
Q1957.desc: city in the northwest of Russia
Q1957.about: Vologda (Russian: Во́логда, IPA: [ˈvoləɡdə]) is a city and the administrative center of Vologda Oblast, Russia, located on the river Vologda within the watershed of the Northern Dvina. Population: 313,944 (2021 census); 301,755 (2010 census); 293,046 (2002 census); 282,802 (1989 Soviet census).

Q1960.name: Dar es Salaam
Q1960.desc: largest city in Tanzania and capital of Dar es Salaam Region
Q1960.about: Dar es Salaam (English: , Swahili: [ɗɑr‿ɛs‿sɑˈlɑːm] ; from Arabic: دَار السَّلَام, romanised: Dār as-Salām, lit. 'Abode of Peace') is the largest city and financial hub of Tanzania and capital of the Dar es Salaam Region. It is located on the Swahili coast.

Q199909.name: Karbala
Q199909.about: Karbala is a major city in Iraq, and the capital of Karbala Governorate. With a population of around 800,000 people in 2024, Karbala is the second-largest city in central Iraq, after Baghdad.

Q209801.name: Himeji
Q209801.about: Himeji (姫路市, Himeji-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [çì.mé̞.(ɟ̟͡)ʑí(.ɕì), çí.mè̞.(ɟ̟͡)ʑì]) is a city located in Hyōgo Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan. As of 1 June 2022, the city had an estimated population of 525,682 in 227,099 households and a population density of 980 persons per km2.

Q210161.name: Ambato
Q210161.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the Tungurahua Province
Q210161.about: Ambato (Spanish pronunciation: [amˈbato]; full form, San Juan de Ambato; Quechua: Ampatu Llaqta) is a city located in the central Andean valley of Ecuador. Lying on the banks of the Ambato River, the city also sits beneath several tall mountains.

Q220.name: Rome
Q220.desc: capital and largest city of Italy
Q220.about: Rome is the capital and largest city of Italy. It is also the administrative centre of the Lazio region and of the Metropolitan City of Rome.

Q1947.name: Juba
Q1947.desc: capital of the Republic of South Sudan
Q1947.about: Juba is the capital and largest city of South Sudan. The city is situated on the White Nile and also serves as the capital of the Central Equatoria State.

Q199605.name: Guwahati
Q199605.desc: largest city in the Indian state of Assam and also the largest metropolis in Northeastern India
Q199605.about: Guwahati (Assamese: [ɡua.ɦa.ti]), formerly known as Gauhati, is the largest city of the Indian state of Assam, and also the largest metropolis in northeastern India. Dispur, the capital of Assam, is in the circuit city region located within Guwahati and is the seat of the Government of Assam.

Q199609.name: Ōita-shi
Q199609.desc: capital city of Oita Prefecture, Japan
Q199609.about: Ōita (大分市, Ōita-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ó̞ò̞.ì.tä̀, ò̞ó̞.í.tä́(.ɕì), ó̞ó̞.í.tä́(.ɕì)]) is the capital city of Ōita Prefecture, located on the island of Kyushu, Japan. As of 30 November 2023, the city had an estimated population of 474,804 in 230,867 households, and a  population density of 950 persons per km2.

Q199797.name: Tacoma
Q199797.desc: county seat of Pierce County, Washington, United States
Q199797.about: Tacoma ( tə-KOH-mə) is a city in and the county seat of Pierce County, Washington, United States. A port city, it is situated along Puget Sound roughly 30 miles (48 km) from Seattle and Olympia, and 58 miles (93 km) northwest of Mount Rainier National Park.

Q199889.name: Kumamoto
Q199889.about: Kumamoto (熊本市, Kumamoto-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [kɯ̈̀.mä́.mó̞.tó̞(.ɕì)]) is the capital city of Kumamoto Prefecture on the island of Kyushu, Japan. As of June 1, 2019, the city had an estimated population of 738,907 and a population density of 1,893 people per km2.

Q209698.name: Kolhapur
Q209698.about:
Kolhapur () is a city on the banks of the Panchganga River in the southern part of the Indian state of Maharashtra.
Kolhapur is one of the most significant cities in South Maharashtra and has been a hub of historical, religious, and cultural activities for centuries.

Q209779.name: Sagamihara
Q209779.about: Sagamihara (相模原市, Sagamihara-shi) is a city in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. As of May 1, 2021, the city has an estimated population of 723,470, with 334,812 households, and a population density of 1,220 persons per km2.

Q209785.name: Ichikawa
Q209785.about: Ichikawa (市川市, Ichikawa-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ì.c̟͡ɕi̥.kä̀.β̞ä̀, -kä́.β̞ä̀, -kä́.β̞ä́.ɕì]) is a city in western Chiba Prefecture, Japan. As of 31 January 2024, the city had an estimated population of 492,749 in 256,229 households and a population density of 8577 persons per km2.

Q216.name: Vilnius
Q216.desc: capital and largest city of Lithuania
Q216.about: Vilnius (  VIL-nee-əs; Lithuanian: [ˈvʲɪlʲnʲʊs] ) is the capital and largest city of Lithuania and the most-populous city in the Baltic states. The city's estimated July 2026 population was 619,405, and the Vilnius urban area (which extends beyond the city limits) has an estimated population of 767,907.

Q197519.name: Zhaotong
Q197519.about: Zhaotong (Chinese: 昭通) is a prefecture-level city located in the northeast corner of Yunnan province, China, bordering the provinces of Guizhou to the south and southeast and Sichuan to the northeast, north, and west. By the end of 2024, the resident population of the city was 4.804 million.

Q197789.name: Zhijiang
Q197789.desc: county-level city of Yichang City in People's Republic of China
Q197789.about: Zhijiang (Chinese: 枝江; pinyin: Zhījiāng) is a county-level city of Yichang City, in the west of Hubei province, People's Republic of China. Until the 1990s Zhijiang was a county.

Q197919.name: Zhongxiang City
Q197919.desc: county-level city in Jingmen, Hubei, China
Q197919.about: Zhongxiang (simplified Chinese: 钟祥; traditional Chinese: 鍾祥; pinyin: Zhōngxiáng; Wade–Giles: Chung1-hsiang2) is a county-level city of Jingmen, central Hubei province, People's Republic of China. The name Zhongxiang means "Blessed with propitious omen", and was given to the city by the Jiajing Emperor in the Ming dynasty.

Q198061.name: Zhoukou
Q198061.about: Zhoukou (Chinese: 周口; pinyin: Zhōukǒu; Wade–Giles: Chou-k’ou; postal: Chowkow) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Henan province, China. It borders Zhumadian to the southwest, Xuchang and Luohe to the west, Kaifeng to the northwest, Shangqiu to the northeast, and the province of Anhui on all other sides.

Q198159.name: Zhuanghe
Q198159.about: Zhuanghe (simplified Chinese: 庄河; traditional Chinese: 莊河; pinyin: Zhuānghé) is one of the two "northern county-level cities", the other being Wafangdian, under the administration of Dalian, located in the south of Liaoning province, People's Republic of China. Its area is 3,655.70 square kilometres (1,411.47 sq mi) and its permanent population as of 2020 is 742,496, making it Dalian's most spacious county-level division.

Q198266.name: Zhuzhou
Q198266.about: Zhuzhou (Chinese: 株洲; pinyin: Zhūzhōu, joo-joh), formerly Jianning (建宁), is a prefecture-level city of Hunan Province, China, straddling the Xiang River southeast of the provincial capital, Changsha, and bordering Jiangxi province to the east. It is part of the "Greater Changsha Metropolitan Region, also known as Changzhutan Golden Triangle" (comprising the cities of Changsha, Zhuzhou and Xiangtan).

Q198370.name: Zibo
Q198370.about: Zibo (Chinese: 淄博; pinyin: Zībó) is a prefecture-level city in central Shandong province, China. It borders the provincial capital Jinan to the west, Tai'an to the southwest, Linyi to the south, Weifang to the east, Dongying to the northeast, and Binzhou to the north.

Q198529.name: Ziebach County
Q198529.desc: county in South Dakota, United States of America
Q198529.about: Ziebach County ( ZEE-bahk) is a county in the U.S. state of South Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 2,413.

Q199440.name: Mexicali
Q199440.desc: capital of the State of Baja California, Mexico
Q199440.about: Mexicali (English:  ; Spanish: [mexiˈkali] ; Yue Chinese: 墨西加利)  is the capital city of the Mexican state of Baja California. The city, which abuts the Mexico–United States border and the U.S. city of Calexico, California, is the seat of the Mexicali Municipality.

Q208818.name: Fuchū
Q208818.about: Fuchū (府中市, Fuchū-shi) is a city located in the western portion of the Tokyo Metropolis, Japan. Fuchū serves as a regional commercial center and a commuter town for workers in central Tokyo.

Q208863.name: Hachiōji-shi
Q208863.about: Hachiōji (八王子市, Hachiōji-shi) is a city located in the western portion of the Tokyo Metropolis, Japan. As of 31 March 2021, the city has an estimated population of 561,344, and a population density of 3,000 persons per km2.

Q209016.name: Santa Marta
Q209016.desc: capital of the Colombian department of Magdalena
Q209016.about: Santa Marta (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsanta ˈmaɾta]), officially the Distrito Turístico, Cultural e Histórico de Santa Marta (English: Historic, Cultural & Tourist District of Santa Marta), is a port city on the coast of the Caribbean Sea in northern Colombia. It is renowned in Latin American as the place of death of Simón Bolívar.
Q209016.img: 2018 Santa Marta (Colombia) - Edificio de los Bancos en el Parque Simón Bolívar.jpg

Q209034.name: Toluca de Lerdo
Q209034.desc: capital of the State of Mexico, Mexico
Q209034.about: Toluca (Spanish pronunciation: [toˈluka]), officially Toluca de Lerdo (pronounced [toˈluka ðe ˈleɾdo]), is a state capital and municipality in the State of Mexico. Toluca has a population of 223,876 as of the 2020 census.

Q209338.name: Oxnard
Q209338.desc: city in Ventura County, California, United States
Q209338.about: Oxnard ( ) is a city in Ventura County, California, United States. On California's Central Coast, it is the most populous city in Ventura County and the 22nd-most-populous city in California.

Q209537.name: East London
Q209537.desc: city in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
Q209537.about: East London (Xhosa: eMonti; Afrikaans: Oos-Londen), officially KuGompo City since February 2026, is a city in the Buffalo City Metropolitan Municipality of the Eastern Cape Province, on the southeastern coast of South Africa. The city lies on the Indian Ocean coast, largely between the Buffalo River and the Nahoon River, and hosts the country's only river port.

Q1963.name: Khartoum
Q1963.about: Khartoum, also spelled Khartum, is the capital and most populous city of Sudan as well as Khartoum State. With an estimated population of 7.1 million people, Greater Khartoum is the largest urban area in Sudan.

Q200016.name: Visakhapatnam
Q200016.desc: city in Visakhapatnam district, Andhra Pradesh
Q200016.about: Visakhapatnam (; formerly known as Vizagapatam, and also referred to as Vizag, Visakha, and Waltair) is the largest and most populous city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is between the Eastern Ghats and the coast of the Bay of Bengal.

Q200017.name: Vijayawada
Q200017.desc: city in NTR district, Andhra Pradesh
Q200017.about: Vijayawada (  Vijay-uh-waw-duh), also called as Bezawada, is the second largest city and a major commercial hub in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. The city forms an integral part of the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region and is situated on the banks of the Krishna River, flanked by the Eastern Ghats and the Indrakeeladri Hills.

Q200019.name: Jodhpur
Q200019.about: Jodhpur (Hindi pronunciation: [ˈd͡ʑoːd̪ʱ.pʊr] ) is the second-largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, after its capital Jaipur. As of 2025, the city has a population of 1.6 million.

Q210205.name: Pest
Q210205.desc: eastern part of Budapest, Hungary, former independent city (–1873)
Q210205.about: Pest (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈpɛʃt]) is the part of Budapest, the capital city of Hungary, that lies on the eastern bank of the Danube. Pest was administratively unified with Buda and Óbuda in 1873.

Q210307.name: Ciudad Nezahualcóyotl
Q210307.desc: municipal seat of Nezahualcóyotl, State of México, Mexico
Q210307.about: Ciudad Nezahualcóyotl (Spanish pronunciation: [sjuˈðað nesawalˈkoʝotl], Nahuatl for 'fasting coyote'), or more commonly Neza, is a city and municipal seat of the municipality of Nezahualcóyotl in Mexico. It is located in the state of Mexico, adjacent to the east side of Mexico City.

Q210365.name: Beihai
Q210365.about: Beihai (Chinese: 北海; pinyin: Běihǎi; Postal romanization: Pakhoi) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Guangxi, People's Republic of China. Its status as a seaport on the north shore of the Gulf of Tonkin has granted it historical importance as a port of international trade for Guangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Yunnan.

Q210493.name: Yantai
Q210493.about: Yantai, formerly Chefoo, is a coastal prefecture-level city on the Shandong Peninsula in China. Lying on the southern coast of the Bohai Strait, Yantai borders Qingdao on the southwest and Weihai on the east, with sea access to both the Bohai Sea (via the Laizhou Bay and the Bohai Strait) and the Yellow Sea (from both north and south sides of the Shandong Peninsula).

Q210628.name: Machida
Q210628.about: Machida (町田市, Machida-shi) is a city located in the western portion of the Tokyo Metropolis, Japan. As of 1 April 2021, the city had an estimated population of 428,851, and a population density of 6,000 persons per km2.

Q210886.name: Villahermosa
Q210886.about: Villahermosa ( VEE-(y)ə-air-MOH-sə, Spanish: [ˌbiʝaeɾˈmosa] ; "beautiful town") is the capital and largest city of the Mexican state of Tabasco, and serves as the municipal seat (governing county) of the state. Located in Southeast Mexico, Villahermosa is known for its cultural history, natural resources, commercial development, and modern industrialization.

Q211070.name: Mbandaka
Q211070.desc: is a port city in the Equateur Province of the Democratic Republic of Congo,
Q211070.about: Mbandaka (pronounced [mbaˈnda.ka], formerly known as Coquilhatville in French, or Coquilhatstad in Dutch) is a city in the Democratic Republic of Congo located near the confluence of the Congo and Ruki rivers. It is the capital of Équateur Province.
Q211070.img: Mbandaka koloniale architectuur Banque du Congo belge.JPG

Q211243.name: Yinchuan
Q211243.about: Yinchuan (Chinese: 银川; pinyin: Yínchuān; lit. 'Silver River') is a prefecture‑level city and the capital of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region in northwest China.

Q200022.name: Matsuyama
Q200022.about: Matsuyama (松山市, Matsuyama-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [mä̀.t͡sɨ́.jä̀.mä̀, -jä́.mä́.ɕì]) is the capital city of Ehime Prefecture, on the island of Shikoku, in Japan and is also Shikoku's largest city. As of 1 October 2022, the city had an estimated population of 494,100 in 243,541 households and a population density of 1,200 persons per km2.

Q200030.name: Latakia
Q200030.about: Latakia (; Arabic: اللَّاذِقِيَّة, romanized: al-Lāḏiqiyya;  Syrian pronunciation: [el.laːdˈʔɪjje]), officially Lattakia, is the principal port city of Syria and capital city of the Latakia Governorate located on the Mediterranean coast. Historically, it has also been known as Laodicea in Syria or Laodicea ad Mare.

Q200049.name: Ajmer
Q200049.about: Ajmer (pronounced [əd͡ʑ.meːɾ] ) is a city in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It serves as the administrative headquarters of the Ajmer district and Ajmer division.
Q200049.img: Mayo college in a sunny day.jpg

Q200054.name: Jamshedpur
Q200054.about: Jamshedpur (Hindi: [d͡ʒəmˈʃeːd̪pʊɾ] ; Bengali: [ˈd͡ʒamʃedpuɾ]), also known as Tatanagar, is a major industrial city in eastern India. Located on the confluence of the Swarnarekha and Kharkai rivers, the city is surrounded by the Dalma Hills.

Q200077.name: Morioka
Q200077.about: Morioka (盛岡市, Morioka-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [mò̞.ɾʲí.ò̞.kä̀, -ó̞.kä́.ɕì]) is the capital city of Iwate Prefecture located in the Tōhoku region of northern Japan. As of 1 August 2023, the city had an estimated population of 283,981 in 132,719 households, and a population density of 320 per square kilometre (830/sq mi).
Q200077.img: Morioka and Mount Iwate and River Kitakami in May 2019.jpg

Q211760.name: Culiacán
Q211760.desc: capital of the State of Sinaloa, Mexico
Q211760.about: Culiacán, officially Culiacán Rosales, is the capital and largest city of Sinaloa in northwestern Mexico. Located within the Culiacán Municipality, the city was founded on 29 September 1531, by the Spanish conquistadors Lázaro de Cebreros and Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán.

Q211867.name: Oshawa
Q211867.desc: city in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada
Q211867.about: Oshawa is a city in Ontario, Canada, on the Lake Ontario shoreline. It lies in Southern Ontario, approximately 60 kilometres (37 mi) east of downtown Toronto.

Q212628.name: Arak
Q212628.about:
Arak (Persian: اراک; IPA: [æˈɾɒːkʲ] ) is a city in the Central District of Arak County, Markazi province, Iran, serving as capital of the province, the county, and the district.
The city is nicknamed the "Industrial Capital of Iran".

Q212938.name: East Jerusalem
Q212938.desc: Eastern part of Jerusalem, in dispute between Israel and the Palestinian Arabs since 1967
Q212938.about: East Jerusalem (Arabic: القدس الشرقية, romanized: al-Quds ash-Sharqiya; Hebrew: מִזְרַח יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, romanized: Mizraḥ Yerushalayim) is the portion of Jerusalem east of the Green Line. It was established formally by the armistice agreements at the end of the 1948 Palestine war.

Q212991.name: Santa Rosa
Q212991.desc: city in and county seat of Sonoma County, California, United States
Q212991.about: Santa Rosa (Spanish for "Saint Rose") is a city in and the county seat of Sonoma County, United States, in the North Bay region of the Bay Area in California. Its population as of the 2020 census was 178,127.
Q212991.img: Old Courthouse Square, Downtown Santa Rosa (Smaller Version).jpg

Q213014.name: Akola
Q213014.about: Akola  () is a major city in the Vidarbha region of the Indian state of Maharashtra. With an estimated population of 600,000, Akola is a growing metropolis surrounded by forts, and has the Morna River running through the center of the city.

Q213026.name: Bareilly
Q213026.about: Bareilly, also spelled Bareli, is a city in Bareilly district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is among the largest metropolises in Western Uttar Pradesh and is the centre of the Bareilly division as well as the historical region of Rohilkhand.

Q213248.name: Tirunelveli
Q213248.desc: city in Tamil Nadu, South India
Q213248.about: Tirunelveli (Tamil: [tiɾɯnelʋeːli] ), also known as Nellai, is a city and municipal corporation in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the southern part of the state, on the west bank of the Thamirabarani River.

Q213318.name: Amagasaki
Q213318.about: Amagasaki (尼崎市, Amagasaki-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ä̀.mä́.ɡä́.sä̀.k̟ʲì, -ŋä́.sä̀.k̟ʲì, -ɡä́.sä́.k̟ʲi̥.ɕì, -ŋä́.sä́.k̟ʲi̥.ɕì]) is an industrial city located in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. As of 30 November 2022, the city had an estimated population of 455,555 in 223,812 households, and a population density of 9000 persons per km².

Q2009.name: Yukon
Q2009.about: Yukon (, Canadian French: [jukõ]) is a territory of Canada, bordering British Columbia to the south, the Northwest Territories to the east, the Beaufort Sea to the north, and the U.S. state of Alaska to the west. It is Canada's westernmost and smallest territory by land area.
Q2009.img: Sheep Slot Rapids, Firth River, Ivvavik National Park, YT.jpg

Q2028.name: Verona
Q2028.about: Verona ( və-ROH-nə; Italian: [veˈroːna] ; Venetian: Verona or Veròna) is the largest city in the region of Veneto in Italy, with a population of 255,139 as of 2026. It is one of the seven provincial capitals of the region, and is also the 2nd-largest city in northeast Italy.

Q200119.name: Ujjain
Q200119.desc: ancient city beside the Kshipra River in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh
Q200119.about: Ujjain (,  Hindi pronunciation: [ʊ̯d͡ːʑæn] , [əʋən̪t̪ɪkaː]), also known as Ujjayini, is a city in Ujjain district of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. It is the fifth-largest city in Madhya Pradesh by population and is the administrative as well as religious centre of Ujjain district and Ujjain division.

Q200123.name: Ludhiana
Q200123.about: Ludhiana (Panjabi: Ludhiāṇā, pronounced [lʊ́d̪͜tɪ̀ɪˈäːɳäː]) is the most populous city in the Indian state of Punjab. The city has an estimated population of 1,618,879 as of the 2011 census and distributed over 310 km2 (120 sq mi), making Ludhiana the most densely populated urban centre in the state.

Q200166.name: Kitchener
Q200166.about: Kitchener is a city in the Canadian province of Ontario, about 100 km (62 mi) west of Toronto. It is one of three cities that make up the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and is the regional seat.
Q200166.img: City Hall Clock Tower Victoria Park Kitchener.jpg

Q200235.name: Nashik
Q200235.desc: city in western India in the state of Maharashtra
Q200235.about: Nashik, formerly Nasik, is a city in the northern region of the Indian state of Maharashtra situated on the banks of the river Godavari, about 165 km (103 mi) northeast of the state capital Mumbai. The city lies in the Nashik Metropolitan Region.

Q200237.name: Meerut
Q200237.desc: metropolitan city in Uttar Pradesh, India
Q200237.about: Meerut is a city that serves as the administrative headquarters of the Meerut district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. The city lies in western Uttar Pradesh and is part of the Indian National Capital Region (NCR).

Q213325.name: Rapid City
Q213325.desc: seat of Pennington County, South Dakota, United States
Q213325.about: Rapid City is a city in and the county seat of Pennington County, South Dakota, United States. It is located on the eastern slope of the Black Hills in western South Dakota and was named after Rapid Creek, where the settlement developed.

Q213464.name: Adachi
Q213464.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q213464.about: Adachi (足立区, Adachi-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [ä̀.dä́.c̟͡ɕí, -c̟͡ɕi̥.kɯ̈̀]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. It is located to the north of the heart of Tokyo.

Q214164.name: Bellevue
Q214164.desc: city in King County, Washington, United States
Q214164.about: Bellevue (, BEL-vew) is a city in the Eastside region of King County, Washington, United States, located across Lake Washington from Seattle. It is the third-largest city in the Seattle metropolitan area, and the fifth-largest city in Washington.

Q214173.name: Trujillo
Q214173.desc: city of Peru, capital of La Libertad region
Q214173.about: Trujillo (Spanish: [tɾuˈxiʝo]; Quechua: Truhillu; Mochica: Cɥimor) is a city in coastal northwestern Peru and the capital of the Department of La Libertad. It is the third most populous city and center of the third most populous metropolitan area of Peru.

Q200696.name: Gordon County
Q200696.about: Gordon County is a county in the Northwest region of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 57,544.

Q200713.name: Aurangabad
Q200713.desc: city in the district of Aurangabad
Q200713.about: Aurangabad (), officially renamed as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in 2023, is a city in the Indian state of Maharashtra. It is the administrative headquarters of Aurangabad district and is the largest city in the Marathwada region.
Q200713.img: Bibi Ka Maqbara in the morning hours, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India 37.jpg

Q200718.name: Bikaner
Q200718.desc: city in Bikaner district, Rajasthan, India
Q200718.about: Bikaner (IPA: [biːkaːneːɾ] ) is a city in the  Indian state of Rajasthan. It is situated approximately 330 kilometres (205 mi) northwest of the state capital, Jaipur, in the Thar Desert region of western Rajasthan.

Q200740.name: Asahikawa
Q200740.about: Asahikawa (旭川市, Asahikawa-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ä̀.sä́.çi̥.kä̀.β̞ä̀, -kä́.β̞ä́.ɕì]) is a city in Kamikawa Subprefecture, Hokkaido, Japan. It is the capital of the subprefecture, and the second-largest city in Hokkaido after Sapporo.

Q200805.name: Aguascalientes City
Q200805.desc: capital of the Mexican state of Aguascalientes
Q200805.about: Aguascalientes (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌaɣwaskaˈljentes] , lit. "hot waters" in Spanish) is the capital of the Mexican state of Aguascalientes and its most populous city, as well as the head of the Aguascalientes Municipality, with a population of 948,990 inhabitants in 2012 and 1,225,432 in the metro area.

Q216902.name: Kabwe
Q216902.desc: city in central province of Zambia
Q216902.about: Kabwe is the capital of the Zambian Central Province and the Kabwe District, with a population estimated at 288,598 at the 2022 census. Named Broken Hill until 1966, it was founded when lead and zinc deposits were discovered in 1902.

Q216990.name: Blida
Q216990.about: Blida (Arabic: البليدة, romanized: al-bulaydah, Tamazight: ⵍⴻⴱⵍⵉⴷⴰ, romanized: Leblida) is a city in Algeria. It is the capital of Blida Province, and it is located about 45 km south-west of Algiers, the national capital.

Q2044.name: Florence
Q2044.desc: Italian city and commune, located in Tuscany
Q2044.about: Florence (Italian: Firenze) is the capital and most populous city of the Italian region of Tuscany, and, as of 2026, with a population of 361,625, the 8th most populous city in the country. It is also the capital of the eponymous metropolitan province, which counts 988,494 inhabitants, while Eurostat estimates that 696,767 people live in the urban area of Florence.

Q2066.name: Essen
Q2066.desc: city in Ruhr Region, Düsseldorf Government Region, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Q2066.about: Essen (German pronunciation: [ˈɛsn̩] ) is the central and, after Dortmund, second-largest city of the Ruhr, the largest urban area in Germany. Its population of 573,618 makes it the fourth-largest city of North Rhine-Westphalia after Cologne, Düsseldorf and Dortmund, as well as the tenth-largest city of Germany.

Q2079.name: Leipzig
Q2079.about: Leipzig is the most populous city in the German state of Saxony. The city has a population of 633,592 residents as of 31 December 2025.
Q2079.img: Innenstadt Leipzig mit Thomaskirche von Panorama Tower 2013.jpg

Q2082.name: St. John's
Q2082.desc: capital and largest city of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q2082.about: St. John's is the capital and largest city of the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador.

Q2096.name: Edmonton
Q2096.desc: capital city of the province of Alberta, Canada
Q2096.about: Edmonton (  ED-mən-tən) is the capital city of the Canadian province of Alberta. It is situated on the North Saskatchewan River and is the centre of the Edmonton Metropolitan Region, which is surrounded by Alberta's central region.

Q2107.name: Wuppertal
Q2107.about: Wuppertal (German pronunciation: [ˈvʊpɐtaːl] ; lit. 'Wupper Dale') is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia, in western Germany, with a population of 355,000. Wuppertal is the seventh-largest city in North Rhine-Westphalia and 17th-largest in Germany.

Q214215.name: La Paz
Q214215.desc: capital city of Baja California Sur, México
Q214215.about: La Paz (pronounced [la ˈpas] , English: "peace") is the capital and largest city of the Mexican state of Baja California Sur, with a population of 250,141 in the 2020 census. La Paz is located in La Paz Municipality, the fourth-largest municipality in Mexico by area (20,275 km2 (7,828 sq mi)), with a population of 292,241.
Q214215.img: La Paz vista desde the one.jpg

Q214248.name: Benguela
Q214248.about: Benguela (Portuguese pronunciation: [bẽˈɡɛlɐ]; Umbundu: Luombaka) is a city in western Angola, capital of Benguela Province. Benguela is one of Angola's most populous cities with a population of 555,124 in the city and 561,775 in the municipality, at the 2014 census.

Q206900.name: Çorum
Q206900.desc: central district and city in Çorum Province, Turkey
Q206900.about: Çorum (Turkish pronunciation: [ˈtʃoɾum]) is a northern Anatolian city in Turkey. Çorum is located inland in the central Black Sea Region of Turkey and is approximately 244 km (152 mi) from Ankara and 608 km (378 mi) from Istanbul.

Q207098.name: Ghaziabad
Q207098.desc: city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh
Q207098.about: Ghaziabad (Hindustani: [ɣaːziːaːbaːd̪]) is a city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh and a part of Delhi NCR. It is the administrative headquarters of Ghaziabad district and is the largest city in Western Uttar Pradesh, with a population of 1,729,000. Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation is divided into 5 zones - City Zone, Kavi Nagar Zone, Vijay Nagar Zone, Mohan Nagar Zone and Vasundhara Zone.
Q207098.img: New Academic Block & Library, IMT Ghaziabad (cropped).jpg

Q207201.name: London Borough of Brent
Q207201.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q207201.about: Brent ( ) is a borough in west and north-west London, England; it forms part of Outer London. It is known for landmarks such as Wembley Stadium, the Swaminarayan Temple and the Kiln Theatre.

Q207322.name: Huambo
Q207322.about: Huambo, formerly Nova Lisboa (English: New Lisbon), is the third-most populous city in Angola, after the capital city Luanda and Lubango, with a population of 710,000 (2024) in the city and a population of 836,293 in the municipality of Huambo (Census 2024). The city is the capital of the province of Huambo and is located about 220 km E from Benguela and 600 km SE from Luanda.

Q207324.name: Cuttack
Q207324.desc: second largest city of Odisha, India
Q207324.about: Cuttack ( , officially Kataka [ˈkɔʈɔkɔ]), is the second largest city and the former capital of the Indian state of Odisha. It is also the headquarters of the Cuttack district.

Q207429.name: Tuxtla Gutiérrez
Q207429.desc: capital of the state of Chiapas, Mexico
Q207429.about: Tuxtla Gutiérrez, or Tuxtla, (Spanish: [ˈtuɣstla ɣuˈtjeres] , Nahuatl: [ˈtuʃt͡ɬa]) is the capital and the largest city of the Mexican southeastern state of Chiapas. It is the seat of the municipality of the same name, which is the most developed and populous in the state.

Q207749.name: Thane
Q207749.about: Thane (Marathi: [ˈʈʰaːɳeː]; known as Thana until 1996) is a city in western India, in the state of Maharashtra. It neighbours Mumbai and is part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

Q2095384.name: Regional District of Bulkley-Nechako
Q2095384.about: The Regional District of Bulkley–Nechako (RDBN) is a regional district in the Canadian province of British Columbia, Canada. As of the 2021 census, the population was 37,737.

Q2096191.name: Shelburne County
Q2096191.desc: county in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia
Q2096191.about: Shelburne County is a county in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia.

Q2105593.name: Zumpango de Ocampo
Q2105593.desc: municipal seat of Zumpango, State of Mexico, Mexico
Q2105593.about: Zumpango de Ocampo is a city and the municipal seat of municipality of Zumpango, State of Mexico. It is also the regional seat of the Zumpango Region, an administrative sub-division.

Q2110336.name: Prince County
Q2110336.about: Prince County is located in western Prince Edward Island, Canada. The county's defining geographic feature is Malpeque Bay, a sub-basin of the Gulf of St.

Q2117999.name: Saint-Laurent
Q2117999.desc: borough in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, former city
Q2117999.about:
Saint-Laurent (French: [sɛ̃lɔʁɑ̃] ) is a borough of the city of Montreal, Canada, located in the northern part of the island. Although it is no longer an independent city, it is still commonly known as Ville Saint-Laurent (City of Saint-Laurent) or by its initials, VSL.
Saint-Laurent is the largest of Montreal's boroughs by land area.

Q2138250.name: Regional District of Kitimat-Stikine
Q2138250.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q2138250.about: The Regional District of Kitimat–Stikine is a local government administration in northwestern British Columbia, Canada. As of the 2021 Canadian census, it had a population of 37,790 living on a land area of 104,307.25 km2 (40,273.25 sq mi).

Q2138252.name: Regional District of Mount Waddington
Q2138252.desc: regional district of British Columbia, Canada
Q2138252.about: The Regional District of Mount Waddington (RDMW) is a regional district in British Columbia. It takes in the lower Central Coast region centred on the Queen Charlotte Strait coast of northern Vancouver Island and the adjoining parts of mainland British Columbia.

Q2138253.name: Regional District of Kootenay Boundary
Q2138253.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q2138253.about: The Regional District of Kootenay Boundary (RDKB) is one of 28 regional districts in the province of British Columbia, Canada. As of the 2016 Canadian census, the population was 31,447.

Q2138257.name: Regional District of North Okanagan
Q2138257.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q2138257.about: The Regional District of North Okanagan (RDNO) is a regional district in the Canadian province of British Columbia, Canada. The Canada 2011 Census population was 81,237.

Q2140691.name: Algoma District
Q2140691.desc: district and census division in the northeastern part of the Canadian province of Ontario
Q2140691.about:
Algoma District is a district and census division in Northeastern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario.
The name was created by an American  ethnologist, Henry Rowe Schoolcraft (1793–1864), who was appointed Indian agent to the Ojibwe in Sault Ste.

Q2151669.name: Pinellas Park
Q2151669.desc: city in Pinellas County, Florida, United States
Q2151669.about: Pinellas Park is a city located in central Pinellas County, United States. The population was 53,093 at the 2020 census.

Q2155370.name: North Port
Q2155370.desc: city in Sarasota County, Florida, United States
Q2155370.about: North Port is a city in Sarasota County, Florida, United States. The population was 74,793 at the 2020 census.

Q2155610.name: Tamiami
Q2155610.desc: census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q2155610.about: Tamiami is a census-designated place (CDP) in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is part of the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida.

Q2022168.name: Takoradi
Q2022168.desc: capital city of Western Region, Ghana

Q2110515.name: Naucalpan de Juárez
Q2110515.desc: municipal seat of Naucalpan, State of México, Mexico
Q2110515.img: Santuario de Los Remedios, Naucalpán, Estado de México.JPG

Q204561.name: Modesto
Q204561.desc: city in and county seat of Stanislaus County, California, United States
Q204561.about: Modesto ( mə-DESS-toh; Spanish pronunciation: [moˈðesto]; Spanish for "modest") is the county seat of and the largest city in Stanislaus County, California, United States. With a population of 218,069 according to 2022 U.S. Census Bureau estimates, it is the 19th-most populous city in California.
Q204561.img: Modesto California photo Don Ramey Logan.jpg

Q204761.name: Newton County
Q204761.about: Newton County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,291.

Q205327.name: Kananga
Q205327.desc: capital city of the Kasai-Central Province in DRC and capital of the former Kasaï-Occidental Province
Q205327.about: Kananga, formerly known as Luluabourg or Luluaburg, is the capital city of the Kasai-Central Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and was the capital of the former Kasaï-Occidental Province. It is the fourth most populous urban area in the country, with an estimated population of 1,524,000 in 2021.

Q205697.name: Howrah
Q205697.about: Howrah (; Bengali: [ˈɦao̯ɽa]) is a city in the Indian state of West Bengal. Howrah is located on the western bank of the Hooghly River, opposite to its twin city of Kolkata.

Q205715.name: Caldwell Parish
Q205715.about: Caldwell Parish is a parish located in the U.S. state of Louisiana. As of 2020, its population was 9,645.

Q205922.name: Qiqihar
Q205922.desc: City in Heilongjiang, China, and its surrounding prefecture
Q205922.about: Qiqihar (also spelled Tsitsihar) is the second-largest city in the Heilongjiang province of China, in the west central part of the province. The built-up (or metro) area made up of Longsha, Tiefeng and Jianhua districts had 959,787 inhabitants, while the total population of the prefecture-level city was shrinking to 4,067,489 as of the 2020 census (5,367,003 as of 2010).

Q206116.name: Gebze
Q206116.desc: district and town of Kocaeli Province, Turkey
Q206116.about: Gebze (Turkish pronunciation: [ˈɟebze]), formerly known as Libyssa, Λίβυσσα (in Ancient Greek), is a working-class district and one of the municipalities in Kocaeli Province, Turkey.  Its area is 418 km2, and its population is 407,019 (2022).

Q206484.name: Abeokuta
Q206484.about: Abeokuta () is the capital city of Ogun State, which is located in southwestern Nigeria. It is situated on both banks of the Ogun River, near a group of rocky outcrops in a wooded savanna; 77 kilometres (48 mi) north of Lagos by railway, or 130 kilometres (81 mi) by water.

Q2008189.name: Korba
Q2008189.about: Korba is a city and an industrial area in Korba District in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. Korba was part of Bilaspur District before 25 May 1998.

Q2008706.name: Elkhart
Q2008706.desc: city in Elkhart County, Indiana, United States
Q2008706.about: Elkhart ( EL-kart) is a city in Elkhart County, Indiana, United States. The population was 53,923 at the 2020 census.

Q2017187.name: Okene
Q2017187.about: Okene () is a town in the Nigerian state of Kogi. The town is based in a Local Government Area of the same name.

Q2028183.name: Huntersville
Q2028183.desc: town in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, United States of America
Q2028183.about: Huntersville is a suburban town in northern Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, United States. As of the 2020 census, its population was 61,376, making Huntersville the 15th-most populous municipality in North Carolina.

Q2042638.name: Narsingdi District
Q2042638.about: Narsingdi District (Bengali: নরসিংদী জেলা) is a district in central Bangladesh. It is located 50 km north-east of Dhaka, the Bangladeshi capital.

Q2050326.name: Northridge
Q2050326.desc: neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles, California, United States
Q2050326.about: Northridge is a neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley region of the City of Los Angeles. The community is home to California State University, Northridge and the Northridge Fashion Center.

Q2060398.name: Pingdu
Q2060398.desc: county-level city in Shandong, People's Republic of China
Q2060398.about:
Pingdu (Chinese: 平度; pinyin: Píngdù) is the largest county-level city of Qingdao sub-provincial city, Shandong Province, China.
It is located in the east of the Shandong Peninsula (Jiaodong Peninsula), the heart of peninsula.

Q2065651.name: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
Q2065651.wiki: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
Q2065651.about: The United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry (SDG) is a county and census division in the Canadian province of Ontario, that comprises three historical counties. The county's administrative office is located within the City of Cornwall, which, together with the Mohawk Nation of Akwesasne, is geographically within the county but administered independently.

Q2065772.name: Peace River Regional District
Q2065772.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
