Q2065772.about: The Peace River Regional District is a regional district in northeastern British Columbia, Canada. The regional district comprises seven municipalities and four electoral areas.

Q2076017.name: Region 6, Northwest Territories
Q2076017.about: Region 6 is the name of a Statistics Canada census division, one of six in the Northwest Territories, Canada. It was introduced in the 2011 census, along with Regions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, resulting in the abolition of the former census divisions of Fort Smith Region and Inuvik Region (the latter not to be confused with the modern-day administrative region of the same name).

Q2078241.name: Shahjahanpur
Q2078241.about: Shahjahanpur () is a municipal corporation, town and district headquarters of Shahjahanpur District in Western Uttar Pradesh, India. It is located between Bareilly and Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh.

Q2085319.name: Nabarangpur
Q2085319.about: Nabarangpur is a town and municipality in Nabarangapur district in the Indian state of Odisha. It is the headquarters of Nabarangpur district.

Q2086257.name: Canton
Q2086257.desc: charter township in Wayne County, Michigan, USA
Q2086257.about: Canton Township (commonly known simply as Canton) is a charter township in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A western suburb of Detroit, Canton is located roughly 23 miles (37.0 km) west of downtown Detroit, and 15 miles (24.1 km) east of Ann Arbor.

Q2092485.name: Pictou County
Q2092485.about: Pictou County is a county in the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was established in 1835, and was formerly a part of Halifax County from 1759 to 1835.

Q2095362.name: Regional District of Nanaimo
Q2095362.desc: regional district in British Columbia, Canada
Q2095362.about: The Regional District of Nanaimo is a regional district located on the eastern coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. It is bordered to the south by the Cowichan Valley Regional District, to the west by the Alberni-Clayoquot Regional District, and to the northwest by the Comox Valley Regional District.

Q2183942.name: Nilüfer
Q2183942.about: Nilüfer (Turkish: [nilyˈfæɾ]) is a municipality and district of Bursa Province, Turkey. Its area is 552 km2, and its population is 536,365 (2022).

Q2192801.name: Fanling
Q2192801.about: Fanling (Chinese: 粉嶺; also spelled Fan Ling or Fan Leng) is a town in New Territories East of Hong Kong. Administratively, it is part of the North District.

Q19660.name: Bucharest
Q19660.desc: capital and largest city of Romania
Q19660.about: Bucharest (Romanian: București [bukuˈreʃtʲ] ) is the capital and largest city of Romania. The metropolis stands on the River Dâmbovița in south-eastern Romania.

Q19689.name: Tirana
Q19689.desc: capital and the largest city of Albania
Q19689.about: Tirana (  tih-RAH-nə; Albanian pronunciation: [tiˈɾana]; Gheg Albanian: Tirona) is the capital and largest city of Albania. It is located in the centre of the country, enclosed by mountains and hills, with Dajti rising to the east and a slight valley to the northwest overlooking the Adriatic Sea in the distance.

Q201117.name: Toyota
Q201117.about: Toyota (豊田市, Toyota-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [tó̞.jò̞.tä̀, tò̞.jó̞.tä́.ɕì]), formerly known as Koromo, is a city in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 October 2019, the city had an estimated population of 426,162 and a population density of 464 people per km2.
Q201117.img: Toyota City Hall West-East Office02, Toyota 2018.jpg

Q201141.name: Charlevoix
Q201141.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q201141.about: Charlevoix is a regional county municipality (French: Municipalité Regionale de Comté de Charlevoix) in the Capitale-Nationale region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is Baie-Saint-Paul.

Q201485.name: Division No. 8
Q201485.about: Division No. 8 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q217426.name: Soweto
Q217426.about: Soweto () is a township of the City of Johannesburg Metropolitan Municipality in Gauteng, South Africa and one of the suburbs of Johannesburg, bordering the city's mining belt in the south. Its name is an English syllabic abbreviation for South Western Townships.

Q217432.name: Port Harcourt
Q217432.about: Port Harcourt (Nigerian Pidgin: Po-ta-kot or Pi-ta-kwa, is a port city, capital and largest city of Rivers State in Nigeria. It is the fourth most populous city in Nigeria after Lagos, Kano and Ibadan.

Q2119.name: Mannheim
Q2119.about: Mannheim (German pronunciation: [ˈmanhaɪm] ; Palatine German: Mannem or Monnem), officially the University City of Mannheim (German: Universitätsstadt Mannheim), is the second-largest city in Baden-Württemberg after Stuttgart, the state capital, and Germany's 21st-largest city, with a population of over 315,000. It is located at the border with Rhineland-Palatinate.

Q2123.name: Regina
Q2123.desc: capital and second-largest city of the province of Saskatchewan, Canada
Q2123.about: Regina (  rih-JY-nə) is the capital city of the Canadian province of Saskatchewan. The city is the second-largest in the province, after Saskatoon, and is a commercial centre for southern Saskatchewan.

Q2132.name: Victoria
Q2132.desc: capital city of the province of British Columbia, Canada
Q2132.about: Victoria is the capital city of the Canadian province of British Columbia, located on the southern tip of Vancouver Island off Canada's Pacific coast. The city has a population of 91,867, and the Greater Victoria area has a population of 397,237.

Q2135.name: Winnipeg
Q2135.desc: capital and largest city of the province of Manitoba, Canada
Q2135.about: Winnipeg ( ) is the capital and largest city of the Canadian province of Manitoba. It is centred on the confluence of the Red and Assiniboine rivers.

Q200252.name: Morelia
Q200252.desc: capital of the State of Michoacán, Mexico
Q200252.about: Morelia (Spanish pronunciation: [moˈɾelja]; from 1545 to 1828 known as Valladolid; Otomi: Mänxuni) is the capital and most populous city of the Mexican state of Michoacán. Situated in the Guayangareo Valley in the north-central part of the state, it is the municipal seat of the municipality of Morelia.

Q200311.name: Mathura
Q200311.about: Mathura (Braj pronunciation: [mɐ.t̪ʰʊ.ɾäː] ) is a city and the administrative headquarters of Mathura district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is located 162 kilometres (101 mi) south-east of Delhi; and about 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the town of Vrindavan.

Q200340.name: Udaipur
Q200340.about: Udaipur (Hindi: IPA: [ʊdəjpʊɾ], ) (ISO 15919: Udayapura) is a city in the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan, about 415 km (258 mi) south of the state capital Jaipur. It serves as the administrative headquarters of Udaipur district.

Q200578.name: Yokosuka
Q200578.about:
Yokosuka (Japanese: 横須賀市, Hepburn: Yokosuka-shi; pronounced [jokosɯ̥ka]) is a city in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
As of February 2024, the city has a population of 373,797, and a population density of 3,708 inhabitants per square kilometre (9,600/sq mi).

Q200663.name: Faridabad
Q200663.about: Faridabad (Hindi: [fəˈɾiːˌd̪aːbaːd̪]) is the most populous city in the Indian state of Haryana and is a part of Delhi National Capital Region. It is one of the major satellite cities around Delhi and is located 284 kilometres south of the state capital, Chandigarh.

Q214485.name: Kisumu
Q214485.about: Kisumu ( kee-SOO-moo) is the third-largest city in Kenya located in the Lake Victoria area in the former Nyanza Province. It is the second-largest city in the Lake Victoria Basin after Kampala.

Q215080.name: Machala
Q215080.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the El Oro Province
Q215080.about: Machala (Spanish pronunciation: [maˈtʃala]) is a city in south-west Ecuador. It is the capital of the El Oro Province, and is located near the Gulf of Guayaquil on fertile lowlands.

Q216820.name: Youngstown
Q216820.desc: county seat of Mahoning County, Ohio, United States
Q216820.about: Youngstown is a city in Mahoning County, Ohio, United States, and the county seat (however, a small portion of the city is in Trumbull County). It lies along the Mahoning River in Northeast Ohio.

Q2138.name: Fredericton
Q2138.desc: capital city of the province of New Brunswick, Canada
Q2138.about: Fredericton (; French pronunciation: [fʁedeʁiktœn]) is the capital city of the Canadian province of New Brunswick. The city is situated in the west-central portion of the province along the Saint John River, which flows west to east as it bisects the city.

Q2144.name: Cherepovets
Q2144.about: Cherepovets (Russian: Череповец, IPA: [tɕɪrʲɪpɐˈvʲets]) is a city in Vologda Oblast, Russia, located in the west of the oblast on the banks of the Sheksna River (a tributary of the Volga River) and on the shores of the Rybinsk Reservoir. As of the 2010 Census, its population was 312,310, making it the most populous city in the oblast.
Q2144.img: Октябрьский мост в Череповце с птичьего полёта.jpg

Q2145.name: Quebec City
Q2145.desc: capital city of the province of Quebec, Canada
Q2145.about: Quebec City (French: Ville de Québec) is the capital city of the Canadian province of Quebec. As of July 2021, the city had a population of 549,459 and the Quebec City census metropolitan area (including surrounding communities) had a population of 839,311.
Q2145.img: Buildings and Roads of Old Quebec City 14.jpg

Q2180.name: Malolos
Q2180.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Bulacan
Q2180.about: Malolos [maˈlɔlɔs], officially the City of Malolos (Filipino: Lungsod ng Malolos;  Kapampangan: Ciudad/Lakanbalen ning Malolos), is a  component city and capital of the province of Bulacan, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 269,809 people.

Q2193.name: San Jose del Monte
Q2193.desc: city of the Philippines in the province of Bulacan
Q2193.about: San Jose del Monte (SJDM), officially the City of San Jose del Monte (Tagalog: Lungsod ng San José del Monte; Tagalog pronunciation: [ˌsɐn hoˌsɛ dɛl ˈmonte]), is a component city in the province of Bulacan, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 685,688 people, making it the largest local government unit within the province of Bulacan and Central Luzon, and the 18th most populated city in the Philippines.

Q19566.name: Simferopol
Q19566.about: Simferopol ( SIM-fər-OH-pəl), also known as Aqmescit, is the second-largest city on the Crimean Peninsula. The city, along with the rest of Crimea, is internationally recognized as part of Ukraine, but controlled by Russia.
Q19566.img: Simferopol, Cathedral of Peter and Paul, 2016.06.21 (06) (29653802846).jpg

Q200878.name: Jabalpur
Q200878.about: Jabalpur (IPA: [ˈd͡ʐəˌbəlpʊɾ]), formerly anglicised as Jubbulpore, is the fourth largest city by area of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. It is situated on the banks of the Narmada River in the state of Madhya Pradesh, India.

Q201014.name: Perquimans County
Q201014.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q201014.about: Perquimans County ( pur-KWIM-unz) is a county located in the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,005.

Q201051.name: Rishon LeZion
Q201051.desc: city in the Central District of Israel, south of Tel Aviv
Q201051.about: Rishon LeZion (Hebrew: רִאשׁוֹן לְצִיּוֹן , lit. "First to Zion") is a city in Israel, located along the central Israeli coastal plain eight kilometres (5 mi) south of Tel Aviv.

Q217040.name: Tamale
Q217040.about: Tamale (Dagbani: [ˈtamali]) is the capital city of the Northern Region of Ghana. It is Ghana's third largest city, with a population of 374,744 people (185,051 males and 189,693 females) as of the 2021 population census).

Q217071.name: Pucallpa
Q217071.about: Pucallpa (Spanish pronunciation: [pu'kalpa], Quechua: puka allpa, lit. 'red dirt'; Shipibo: May Ushin) is a city in eastern Peru located on the banks of the Ucayali River, a major tributary of the Amazon River. It is the capital of the Ucayali region, the Coronel Portillo Province and the Calleria District.
Q217071.img: Pucallpa Plaza San Martín Fountain by Night.jpg

Q217156.name: Ismailia
Q217156.about: Ismailia (Egyptian Arabic: الإسماعيلية el-Ismāʻīlīyah, Egyptian Arabic: [lesmæʕiˈlejjæ]) is a city in north-eastern Egypt. Situated on the west bank of the Suez Canal, it is the capital of the Ismailia Governorate.

Q201516.name: Miami Beach
Q201516.desc: city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q201516.about: Miami Beach is a coastal resort city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is a principal city in the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida.

Q201618.name: Fukui
Q201618.about: Fukui (福井市, Fukui-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ɸɯ̥̈.kɯ̈́ì, -kɯ̈́í, -kɯ̈̀ì, -kɯ̈́.í.ɕì, -kɯ̈́ì-]) is the capital city of Fukui Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 March 2024, the city had an estimated population of 255,332 in 107,553 households.

Q201832.name: Aligarh
Q201832.desc: city in Aligarh district of Uttar Pradesh, India
Q201832.about: Aligarh (Hindi pronunciation: [əliːgəɽʱ]; formerly known as Koil) is a city in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India. It is the administrative headquarters of Aligarh district and lies 342 kilometres (213 mi) northwest of state capital Lucknow and approximately 130 kilometres (81 mi) southeast of the capital, New Delhi.

Q202139.name: Asansol
Q202139.about: Asansol is a city in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is the second largest city in West Bengal.

Q202162.name: Aba
Q202162.desc: city in Abia State, southern Nigeria
Q202162.about: Aba is a city in southeastern Nigeria. It lies along the west bank of the Aba River and is at the intersection of roads leading to cities such as Port Harcourt, Owerri, Umuahia, Ikot Ekpene, and Ikot-Abasi.

Q202454.name: Walworth County
Q202454.about: Walworth County is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 census, the population was 106,478.

Q202907.name: Otsu
Q202907.about: Ōtsu (大津市, Ōtsu-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ó̞ò̞.t͡sɨ̀, ò̞ó̞.t͡sɨ̥.ɕì, ó̞ó̞.t͡sɨ̥-]) is the capital city of Shiga Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 October 2021, the city had an estimated population of 343,991 in 153,458 households and a population density of 740 persons per km2.
Q202907.img: Otsu at the south end of Lake Biwa in Shiga prefecture.jpg

Q202973.name: Kingston
Q202973.about: Kingston is a city in Ontario, Canada, on the northeastern end of Lake Ontario. It is at the beginning of the St.
Q202973.img: Kingston - ON - Town hall at night.jpg

Q203022.name: Mineral County
Q203022.about: Mineral County is a county located in the U.S. state of Nevada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,554, making it the fifth-least populous county in Nevada.
Q203022.img: Old Esmeralda & Mineral County Court House.jpg

Q217568.name: Serekunda
Q217568.about: Serekunda (or Serrekunda; Wolof pronunciation: [sɛːɾɛkuⁿd̺ɐ]) is a major city and the largest metropolitan area in The Gambia. It is situated close to the Atlantic coast, on the Gambia River, near the capital, Banjul.

Q217646.name: Mudanjiang
Q217646.about: Mudanjiang (Chinese: 牡丹江; pinyin: Mǔdānjiāng; Manchu: Mudan bira; Russian: Муданьцзян), alternately romanized as Mutankiang, is a prefecture-level city in the southeast part of Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China. It was called Botankou under Japanese occupation.

Q217698.name: Weifang
Q217698.about: Weifang (simplified Chinese: 潍坊; traditional Chinese: 濰坊; pinyin: Wéifāng) is a prefecture-level city in central Shandong province, People's Republic of China. The city borders Dongying to the northwest, Zibo to the west, Linyi to the southwest, Rizhao to the south, Qingdao to the east, and looks out to the Laizhou Bay to the north.

Q218753.name: Mahajanga
Q218753.desc: port city on the northwest coast of Madagascar
Q218753.about: Mahajangā ([maːˈdzaŋɡə̥]; French: Majunga) is a city and an administrative district on the northwest coast of Madagascar. The city of Mahajanga (Mahajanga I) is the capital of the Boeny Region.

Q218861.name: Gondar
Q218861.about: Gondar, also spelled Gonder (Amharic: ጎንደር, Gonder or Gondär; formerly ጐንደር, Gʷandar or Gʷender), is a city and woreda in Ethiopia. Located in the North Gondar Zone of the Amhara Region, Gondar is north of Lake Tana on the Lesser Angereb River and southwest of the Simien Mountains.

Q20714.name: Suwon
Q20714.about: Suwon (Korean: 수원; Korean pronunciation: [sʰu.wʌn]) is the largest city and capital of Gyeonggi Province, South Korea's most populous province. The city lies approximately 30 km (19 mi) south of the national capital, Seoul.
Q20714.img: Hwaseong Third North Secret Gate and Dongbuk Gangnu - 2009-03-01.JPG

Q20929.name: Sejong
Q20929.desc: Special Autonomous city in South Korea
Q20929.about:
Sejong or Sejong City (Korean: 세종; Korean: [seːdʑoŋ] ), officially Sejong Special Self-Governing City (세종특별자치시), is a special self-governing city and the de facto administrative capital of South Korea.
Sejong was founded in 2007 as the new planned capital of South Korea created mostly from parts of South Chungcheong Province and some parts of North Chungcheong Province in order to ease congestion in South Korea's current capital and largest city, Seoul, and to encourage investment in the country's central region.

Q20934.name: Incheon
Q20934.desc: city in Seoul Capital Area, South Korea
Q20934.about: Incheon is a city located in northwestern South Korea, bordering Seoul and Gyeonggi Province to the east. Inhabited since the Neolithic, Incheon was home to just 4,700 people when it became an international port in 1883.

Q21197.name: Chișinău
Q21197.about: Chișinău (  KIH-shih-NOW; Romanian: [kiʃiˈnəw] ; also known by its english exonym Kishinev) is the capital and largest city of Moldova by area and population. The city is Moldova's main industrial and commercial centre.
Q21197.img: Arch of Triumph, Chisinau, Republic of Moldova (51160304626 cropped).jpg

Q203027.name: Tsu
Q203027.about: Tsu (津市, Tsu-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [t͡sɨ́(.ɕì)]) is the capital city of Mie Prefecture, Japan.  As of 31 July 2021, the city had an estimated population of 274,879 in 127,273 households and a population density of 390 persons per km2.

Q203049.name: Gage County
Q203049.about: Gage County is a county in the U.S. state of Nebraska. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,704, and was estimated to be 21,711 in 2025.

Q203263.name: Athens
Q203263.desc: consolidated city-county and county seat of Clarke County, Georgia, United States
Q203263.about: Athens is a consolidated city-county in the U.S. state of Georgia. Downtown Athens lies about 70 miles (110 km) northeast of downtown Atlanta.
Q203263.img: Athens City Hall from NE corner.JPG

Q203299.name: Faiyum
Q203299.about: Faiyum ( fy-YOOM; Egyptian Arabic: الفيوم, romanized: el-Fayyūm, locally [elfæjˈjuːm]) is a city geographically in Lower Egypt but culturally and politically in Upper Egypt, 100 kilometres (62 miles) southwest of Cairo. In the Faiyum Oasis, it is the capital of the modern Faiyum Governorate.

Q219526.name: Fayetteville
Q219526.desc: county seat of Washington County, Arkansas, United States
Q219526.about: Fayetteville ( FAY-ət-vil) is a city in Washington County, Arkansas, United States, and its county seat. The population was 93,949 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 106,623 in 2025, making it the second-most populous city in Arkansas and the most populous city in Northwest Arkansas.

Q219656.name: Macon
Q219656.desc: consolidated city-county in Bibb County, Georgia, United States of America
Q219656.about: Macon ( MAY-kən), officially Macon–Bibb County, is a consolidated city-county in Georgia, United States. Situated near the fall line of the Ocmulgee River in Central Georgia, it is 85 miles (137 km) southeast of Atlanta and 165 miles (266 km) northwest of Savannah.

Q219671.name: Ndola
Q219671.about: Ndola is the third largest city in Zambia in terms of size and population, with a population of 624,579 (2022 census),. after the capital, Lusaka, and Kitwe, and the second largest in terms of infrastructure development after Lusaka.

Q220005.name: Daviess County
Q220005.about: Daviess County  is a county in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 33,381.
Q220005.img: Monument at the Daviess County Courthouse in Washington.jpg

Q220445.name: Kuching
Q220445.about: Kuching ( KOO-ching, Malay pronunciation: [ˈkut͡ʃiŋ] ), officially the City of Kuching, is the capital and the most populous city in the state of Sarawak in Malaysia. It is also the capital of Kuching Division.

Q1962080.name: Soledad de Graciano Sánchez
Q1962080.desc: municipal seat of Soledad, State of San Luis Potosí, Mexico
Q1962080.about: Soledad de Graciano Sánchez, formerly Soledad Diez Gutiérrez, is the second-largest city of the state of San Luis Potosí in Mexico. It lies adjacent to the east side of the state's capital city of San Luis Potosí in the west-central part of the state.

Q1962087.name: Nicolás Romero
Q1962087.desc: municipal seat of Romero, State of México, Mexico
Q1962087.about: Ciudad Nicolás Romero is the largest city and municipal seat of the municipality of Nicolás Romero in the State of Mexico, Mexico. It is located 58 km from the city of Toluca, the state capital and lies in the north-central part of the state, just northwest of the Federal District (Mexico City).

Q203301.name: Umuahia
Q203301.desc: City in the Eastern land, Nigeria
Q203301.about: Umuahia (, pronounced [ʊmʊaːhiaː]) is the capital city of Abia State in southeastern Nigeria. Umuahia is located along the rail road that lies between Port Harcourt to its south, and Enugu city to its north.

Q203308.name: Shimonoseki
Q203308.about: Shimonoseki (Japanese: 下関市, Hepburn: Shimonoseki-shi) is a city located in Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The city used to be referred to as Bakan (馬関).

Q203403.name: Saint John
Q203403.about: Saint John (French: Saint-Jean) is a seaport city located on the Bay of Fundy in the province of New Brunswick, Canada. It is Canada's oldest incorporated city, established by royal charter on 18 May 1785, during the reign of George III. The Port of Saint John is Canada's third-largest by tonnage with a cargo base that includes dry and liquid bulk, break bulk, containers, and cruise.

Q203995.name: Southend-on-Sea
Q203995.about: Southend-on-Sea ( ), commonly referred to as Southend (), is a coastal city and unitary authority area in south-eastern Essex, England. It lies on the north side of the Thames Estuary, 40 miles (64 km) east of central London.

Q204234.name: Milton Keynes
Q204234.desc: city in Buckinghamshire, England, United Kingdom
Q204234.about: Milton Keynes (  KEENZ) is a city in Buckinghamshire, England, about 50 miles (80 km) north-west of London. At the 2021 census, the population of its urban area was 264,349.

Q204245.name: Cuernavaca
Q204245.desc: capital of the State of Morelos, Mexico
Q204245.about: Cuernavaca is the capital and largest city of the state of Morelos in Mexico. Along with Chalcatzingo, it is likely one of the origins of the Mesoamerican civilization.

Q204266.name: Toyama
Q204266.about: Toyama (富山市, Toyama-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [tó̞.jä̀.mä̀, tò̞.jä́.mä́.ɕì]) is the capital city of Toyama Prefecture, Japan, located on the coast of the Sea of Japan in the Chūbu region on central Honshū, about 200 km (120 mi) north of the city of Nagoya and 300 km (190 mi) northwest of Tokyo. As of 1 June 2019, the city had an estimated population of 415,844 in 176,643 households, and a population density of 335 persons per km2.

Q204271.name: San Luis Potosí
Q204271.desc: capital of the State of San Luis Potosí, Mexico
Q204271.about: San Luis Potosí, commonly referred to as San Luis, or by its initials SLP (Otomi: Nmiñ'u), is the capital and the most populous city of the Mexican state of San Luis Potosí. It is the municipal seat of the surrounding municipality of San Luis Potosí.

Q204365.name: Zinder
Q204365.about: Zinder (locally, Damagaram), formerly also spelled Sinder, is the third largest city in Niger, with a population of 235,605 as by the 2012 census. It is situated 861 km (535 mi) east of the capital Niamey and 240 km (150 mi) north of the Nigerian city of Kano.

Q1963483.name: Ciudad López Mateos
Q1963483.desc: municipal seat of Atizapán de Zaragoza, State of México, Mexico
Q1963483.about: Ciudad López Mateos (most commonly called "Atizapán") is a city in the State of Mexico, Mexico, and the municipal seat of the municipality called Atizapán de Zaragoza. The city was previously named San Francisco Atizapán, but the official name was changed after president Adolfo López Mateos, who was born in that town.

Q1964822.name: Palm Harbor
Q1964822.desc: unincorporated community in Pinellas County, Florida, United States
Q1964822.about: Palm Harbor is a census-designated place (CDP) and unincorporated community in Pinellas County, Florida, United States. As of the 2020 census, the CDP had a population of 61,366.

Q1989904.name: Greenville
Q1989904.desc: city in Pitt County, North Carolina, United States
Q1989904.about: Greenville ( GREEN-vil; locally  GREEN-vəl) is the county seat of and the most populous city in Pitt County, North Carolina, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 87,521.

Q1999000.name: Uyo
Q1999000.about: Uyo  is the capital of Akwa Ibom state located in South South, Nigeria. It became the capital on September 23, 1987 when Akwa Ibom was created from the former Cross River State.
Q1999000.img: Uyo roundabout, Uyo, Akwa Ibom state.jpg

Q2000528.name: North Bergen
Q2000528.desc: township in Hudson County, New Jersey, United States
Q2000528.about: North Bergen is a township in the northern part of Hudson County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the township's population was 63,361, an increase of 2,588 (+4.3%) from the 2010 census count of 60,773, which in turn reflected an increase of 2,681 (+4.6%) from the 58,092 counted in the 2000 census.

Q2000891.name: North Vancouver
Q2000891.desc: district municipality in British Columbia, Canada
Q2000891.about: The District of North Vancouver, commonly North Vancouver or North Van, is a district municipality in British Columbia, Canada, situated north of the city of Vancouver across the Burrard Inlet. It surrounds the respective City of North Vancouver on three sides, and the remaining North Shore municipality of West Vancouver on the other, and is part of the Metro Vancouver Regional District.

Q2001097.name: Northern Rockies Regional Municipality
Q2001097.desc: district municipality in British Columbia, Canada
Q2001097.about: The Northern Rockies Regional Municipality (NRRM), formerly the Northern Rockies Regional District (NRRD), and before that the Fort Nelson–Liard Regional District, is a single-tier municipality in northeastern British Columbia, Canada. Although described as a regional municipality in its official name, and existing on the same administrative level as a regional district, it is actually classified as a district municipality.

Q2003323.name: Warner Robins
Q2003323.desc: city in Houston and Peach counties, Georgia, USA
Q2003323.about: Warner Robins (WRB; typically  waw-rnur-RAW-binz) is a city in Houston and Peach Counties in the U.S. state of Georgia. It is the state's 11th-largest incorporated city, with a population of 85,830 according to the World Population Review.

Q2006290.name: Queens County
Q2006290.desc: county in Prince Edward Island, Canada
Q2006290.about: Queens County is a county in the province of Prince Edward Island, Canada. It is the largest county in the province by population with 89,770 (2021) and land.

Q2006307.name: Queens County
Q2006307.about: Queens County is a county in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia.

Q2162128.name: Al-Kharj
Q2162128.about: Al-Kharj or Kharj (Arabic: الخرج) is a governorate in Riyadh Province, Saudi Arabia. It is located 83 km (52 mi) southeast of the capital city, and has the second-largest population in the province.

Q2166182.name: Roodepoort
Q2166182.about: Roodepoort (locally  ROOR-də-poort) is a city in the Gauteng province of South Africa. Formerly an independent municipality, Roodepoort became part of the Johannesburg municipality in the late 1990s, along with Randburg and Sandton.

Q2180242.name: Elmhurst
Q2180242.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, New York, United States
Q2180242.about: Elmhurst (formerly Newtown) is a neighborhood in the borough of Queens in New York City. It is bounded by Roosevelt Avenue on the north; the Long Island Expressway on the south; Junction Boulevard on the east; and the New York Connecting Railroad on the west.

Q207754.name: Tiruchirappalli
Q207754.about: Thiruchchirappalli (Tamil pronunciation: [ˈt̪iɾɯtːʃiɾapːaɭːi] ), also known as Tiruchchi or Trichy or historically known as Trichinopoly, is a major tier II city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Tiruchirappalli district. The city is credited with being the most livable and cleanest city in all of Tamil Nadu, as well as the fifth safest city for women in India.

Q207972.name: Tepic
Q207972.desc: capital of the State of Nayarit, Mexico
Q207972.about:
Tepic (Spanish pronunciation: [teˈpik] ) is the capital and largest city of the western Mexican state of Nayarit, as well as the seat of the Tepic Municipality.
Located in the central part of the state, it stands at an altitude of 915 metres (3,002 ft) above sea level, on the banks of the Río Mololoa and the Río Tepic, approximately 225 kilometres (140 mi) north-west of Guadalajara, Jalisco.

Q208097.name: Imphal
Q208097.desc: capital of the Indian state of Manipur
Q208097.about: Imphal (UK:  IM-fahl, US:   IMP-hul; Meitei: [impʰal]) is the capital city of the Indian state of Manipur. The metropolitan centre of the city contains the ruins of Kangla Palace (officially known as Kangla Fort), the royal seat of the former Kingdom of Manipur, surrounded by a moat.

Q208162.name: Patiala
Q208162.about: Patiala (Punjabi pronunciation: [pʌʈeɑ̈ːɭɑ]) is a city in southeastern Punjab, northwestern India. It is the fourth largest city in the state and is the administrative capital of Patiala district.

Q208318.name: Kaduna
Q208318.desc: state capital of Kaduna State in Nigeria
Q208318.about: Kaduna  is the capital city of Kaduna State, and the former political capital of Northern Nigeria. It is located in north-western Nigeria, on the Kaduna River.

Q208445.name: Vallejo
Q208445.desc: city in Solano County, California, United States
Q208445.about: Vallejo ( və-LAY-(h)oh; Spanish pronunciation: [baˈʎexo] ) is a city in Solano County, California, United States, and the second largest city in the North Bay region of the Bay Area. Located on the shores of San Pablo Bay, the city had a population of 126,090 at the 2020 United States census.

Q208447.name: Thousand Oaks
Q208447.desc: city in Ventura County, California, United States
Q208447.about: Thousand Oaks is the second-largest city in Ventura County, California, located in the northwestern part of Greater Los Angeles. Approximately 15 miles (24 km) from the city of Los Angeles and 40 miles (64 km) from Downtown Los Angeles, it is named after the many oak trees present in the area.

Q208459.name: Sunnyvale
Q208459.desc: city in Santa Clara County, California, United States
Q208459.about:
Sunnyvale () is a city in the Santa Clara Valley in northwestern Santa Clara County, California, United States.
Sunnyvale lies along the historic El Camino Real and Highway 101 and is bordered by the San Francisco Bay to the north, Moffett Federal Airfield and NASA Ames Research Center to the northwest, Mountain View to the northwest, Los Altos to the southwest, Cupertino to the south, and Santa Clara to the east.

Q208471.name: Kaifeng
Q208471.desc: prefecture-level city in Henan, China, a former capital of China
Q208471.about: Kaifeng (Chinese: 开封; pinyin: Kāifēng) is a prefecture-level city in east-central Henan province, China. It is one of the Eight Ancient Capitals of China, having been the capital eight times in history.

Q208718.name: Port Sudan
Q208718.desc: Port city on the Red Sea in Eastern Sudan
Q208718.about: Port Sudan (Arabic: بور سودان, romanized: Būr Sūdān, Beja: Bar'uut) is a major port city on the Red Sea in eastern Sudan, and the capital of Red Sea State. Port Sudan is Sudan's main seaport and the source of 90% of the country's international trade.

Q221914.name: Moçâmedes
Q221914.about: Moçâmedes is a city in southwestern Angola, and the capital of Namibe Province. The city's current population is 345,987 (2024 census).

Q221051.name: Xalapa
Q221051.desc: capital of the Mexican state of Veracruz
Q221051.about: Xalapa or Jalapa (English: , Spanish: [xaˈlapa] ), officially Xalapa-Enríquez (IPA: [xaˈlapa enˈrikes]), is the capital city of the Mexican state of Veracruz and the name of the surrounding municipality. In 2020 census the city reported a population of 443,063 and the municipality of which it serves as municipal seat reported a population of 488,531.

Q221436.name: Maiduguri
Q221436.desc: capital and largest city of Borno state in Northeastern Nigeria
Q221436.about: Maiduguri ( my-DOO-guurr-ee) is the capital and the largest city of Borno State in north-eastern Nigeria, on the continent of Africa. The city sits along the seasonal Ngadda River which disappears into the Firki swamps in the areas around Lake Chad.

Q2321558.name: Spring Hill
Q2321558.desc: census-designated place in Hernando County, Florida, United States
Q2321558.about: Spring Hill is a census-designated place (CDP) in Hernando County, Florida, in the United States of America. The community is unincorporated.

Q2330278.name: Division No. 5
Q2330278.desc: census division in Alberta in Canada
Q2330278.about: Division No. 5 is a census division in Alberta, Canada.

Q2330309.name: Division No. 4
Q2330309.desc: census division in Alberta in Canada
Q2330309.about: Division No. 4 is a census division in Alberta, Canada.

Q2332949.name: Phú Mỹ
Q2332949.desc: ward of Ho Chi Minh City
Q2332949.wiki: Phú Mỹ, Ho Chi Minh City
Q2332949.about: Phú Mỹ (Vietnamese: Phường Phú Mỹ) is a ward of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is one of the 168 new wards, communes and special zones of the city following the reorganization in 2025.
Q2332949.img: Phú Mỹ, Tân Thành, Ba Ria - Vung Tau, Vietnam - panoramio (11).jpg

Q2356998.name: Benito Juárez
Q2356998.about: Benito Juárez (Spanish: [beˈnito ˈxwaɾes] ), is a borough (demarcación territorial) in Mexico City. It is a largely residential area, located to the south of historic center of Mexico City, although there are pressures for areas to convert to commercial use.

Q2360927.name: Pierrefonds
Q2360927.desc: human settlement in Pierrefonds-Roxboro, Quebec, Canada
Q2360927.about: Pierrefonds (Canadian French pronunciation: [pjaɛ̯ʁˈfõ]) is a former city in southwestern Quebec, Canada. It is located along the Rivière des Prairies on the western shore of the southern part of the Island of Montreal (part of what is colloquially called the West Island).

Q223177.name: Casper
Q223177.desc: city in and county seat of Natrona County, Wyoming, United States
Q223177.about: Casper is a city in and the county seat of Natrona County, Wyoming, United States. It is the second-most populous city in the state after Cheyenne, with its population at 59,038 as of the 2020 census.

Q223517.name: Ahilyanagar
Q223517.about: Ahmednagar, officially Ahilyanagar, is a city in, and the headquarters of the Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra, India. Ahmednagar has several dozen buildings and sites from the Nizam Shahi period.

Q223587.name: Mansoura
Q223587.about: Mansoura (Egyptian Arabic: المنصورة, romanized: El Manṣūra, IPA: [el.mɑnˈsˤuːɾɑ], locally [el.mænˈsˤuːɾe]; lit. 'The Victorious') is a city in Egypt located on the eastern bank of the Damietta branch of the Nile river. The city is the capital of the Dakahlia Governorate and has an estimated population of 600,000 as of 2024.

Q2211.name: Malmö
Q2211.about: Malmö is the third-largest city in Sweden, after Stockholm and Gothenburg, and the seventh-largest city in the Nordic region. Located on the Öresund strait on the southwestern coast of Sweden, it is the largest city in Scania, with a municipal population of 365,644 in 2024, and is the gubernatorial seat of Skåne County.

Q2256.name: Birmingham
Q2256.desc: large city in the West Midlands region of England; classed as the 'second city' of the United Kingdom, behind London
Q2256.about: Birmingham (  BUR-ming-əm) is a city and metropolitan borough in the centre of the West Midlands region of England. It is the largest local authority district in England by population and the second-largest city in Britain – commonly referred to as the second city of the United Kingdom – with a population of 1.2 million people in the city proper in 2025.

Q224910.name: Jasper County
Q224910.about: Jasper County is a county located in the central portion of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,588, up from 13,900 in 2010.

Q224982.name: Hungnam
Q224982.about: Hŭngnam (Korean: 흥남) is a district of Hamhung, the second largest city in North Korea. It is a port city on the eastern coast on the Korean East Sea (Sea of Japan).

Q225641.name: Mombasa
Q225641.about: Mombasa ( mom-BASS-ə; also US:  -⁠BAH-sə) is a coastal city in southeastern Kenya along the Indian Ocean. It was the first capital of British East Africa, before Nairobi was elevated to capital status in 1907.

Q227034.name: Zoucheng
Q227034.about: Zoucheng (Chinese: 邹城市; pinyin: Zōuchéng shì) is a county-level city in the south of Shandong province, China. Before it was incorporated as a city in October 1992, it was known as Zou County (邹县) or Zouxian.

Q228405.name: Madurai
Q228405.desc: city of Tamil Nadu in southern India
Q228405.about: Madurai is a major city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Madurai district, which is governed by the Madurai Municipal Corporation established on 1 November 1866.

Q231318.name: Johor Bahru
Q231318.desc: city and state capital of Johor, Malaysia
Q231318.about: Johor Bahru (JB) is the capital city of the Malaysian state of Johor. It is the core city of Johor Bahru District, Malaysia's second-largest district by population and economy.

Q226.name: Nuuk
Q226.about: Nuuk (Greenlandic pronunciation: [nuːk] ; formerly Danish: Godthåb) is the capital and most populous city of Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark. It is the seat of the Sermersooq municipality and the government of Greenland and is the territory's largest cultural and economic center.

Q239.name: Brussels
Q239.desc: municipality in the Brussels-Capital Region and capital of Belgium
Q239.about: The City of Brussels is the largest municipality and historical centre of the Brussels-Capital Region, as well as the capital of Belgium. It is additionally the capital of the French Community of Belgium, the Flemish Community, and the Flemish Region (from which it is separate).

Q223718.name: Redmond
Q223718.desc: city in King County, Washington, United States
Q223718.about: Redmond is a city in King County, Washington, United States, located 15 miles (24 km) east of Seattle. The population was 73,256 at the 2020 census.

Q223761.name: Bobo-Dioulasso
Q223761.about: Bobo-Dioulasso (Dyula: Bɔbɔjulaso N'Ko script: ߓߐ߬ߓߐߖߎ߬ߟߊ߬ߛߏ߫, Mossi: Sɩa) (often colloquially called Bobo) is a city in Burkina Faso with a population of 1,129,000 (as of 2023); it is the second-largest city in the country, after Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso's capital. The name means "home of the Bobo-Dioula".

Q223914.name: Lobito
Q223914.about: Lobito is a municipality in Angola. It is located in Benguela Province, on the Atlantic Coast north of the Catumbela Estuary.

Q223917.name: Boma
Q223917.desc: city in Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q223917.wiki: Boma, Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q223917.about: Boma is a port town on the Congo River, some 100 kilometres (62 mi) upstream from the Atlantic Ocean, in the Kongo Central Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), adjacent to the border with Angola. It had an estimated population of 162,521 in 2012.

Q223920.name: Pointe-Noire
Q223920.desc: city in the Republic of the Congo
Q223920.about: Pointe-Noire (French pronunciation: [pwɛ̃t.nwaʁ]; Kongo: Njinji, French: Ndjindji with the letter d following French spelling standards) is the second largest city and main economic centre in the Republic of the Congo, with a population of 1,420,612 inhabitants in 2023. Since the 2002 constitution, it has also been an autonomous department and a commune; before this date it was the capital of the Kouilou region (now a separate department).

Q223966.name: Piura
Q223966.desc: city of Peru, capital of Piura region
Q223966.about: Piura is a city in northwestern Peru, located north of the Sechura Desert along the Piura River. It is the capital of the Piura Region and the Piura Province.

Q224603.name: Xichang
Q224603.desc: county-level city in Liangshan, Sichuan, China
Q224603.about: Xichang (Northern Yi: /o̝˨˩dʐo̝˧/) is a city in and the seat of the Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in the south of Sichuan, China.

Q2361035.name: Kendall
Q2361035.desc: census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q2361035.about: Kendall is an unincorporated area and census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is a principal city in the Miami metropolitan area.

Q2361176.name: Russeifa
Q2361176.about: Russeifa (Arabic: الرصيفة, also spelled Ruseifa(h), Rusaifa(h), Russiefa, etc., also with preceding article el-, al-, er- or ar-) is a city in Zarqa Governorate in Jordan. It had a population of 472,604 inhabitants in 2015, making it the fourth-largest city in Jordan, after Amman, Irbid, and Zarqa.

Q2365407.name: Waterford
Q2365407.desc: charter township in Oakland county, Michigan, United States
Q2365407.about: Waterford Township (commonly known simply as Waterford) is a charter township in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A northern suburb of Detroit, Waterford is located roughly 30 miles (48.3 km) northwest of downtown Detroit.

Q2408877.name: Pasar Kemis
Q2408877.desc: district in Tangerang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia
Q2408877.about: Pasarkemis is an administrative district within Tangerang Regency in the province of Banten, on Java, Indonesia. It covers an area of 30.73 km2 and had a population of 238,377 at the 2010 Census and 273,659 at the 2020 Census; the official estimate as of mid-2024 was 263,289 (comprising 133,377 males and 129,912 females).

Q2425179.name: Gboko
Q2425179.about:
Gboko is a city and local government area in Benue state, North-central Nigeria.
Gboko LGA was created on 11 May 1970 with a landmass of 2,264 square kilometres (874 mi2).

Q2428996.name: The Hammocks
Q2428996.desc: census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q2428996.about: The Hammocks is a planned community and census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is part of the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida.

Q2429216.name: Carleton County
Q2429216.about:
Carleton County (2021 population 26,360) is located in west-central New Brunswick, Canada.
The western border is Aroostook County, Maine, the northern border is Victoria County, and the southeastern border is York County from which it was formed in 1831.

Q2443471.name: Kendale Lakes
Q2443471.desc: census-designated place in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q2443471.about: Kendale Lakes is a census-designated place (CDP) and a suburb of Miami in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is located in the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida.

Q2449019.name: Division No. 7
Q2449019.desc: census division in Alberta in Canada
Q2449019.about: Division No. 7 is a census division in Alberta, Canada.

Q2449042.name: Division No. 8
Q2449042.desc: census division in Alberta in Canada
Q2449042.about: Division No. 8 is a census division in Alberta, Canada.

Q2455368.name: Sector 3
Q2455368.about: Sector 3 (Romanian: Sectorul 3) is an administrative unit of Bucharest. It is the most populous, most densely populated and also the third-largest division of the city.

Q2457268.name: Canoga Park
Q2457268.desc: neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley region of the City of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q2457268.about: Canoga Park is a neighborhood in the city of Los Angeles, California, located in the San Fernando Valley. Before the Mexican–American War, the neighborhood was part of a rancho, and after the American victory it was converted into wheat farms and then subdivided, with part of it named Owensmouth as a town founded in 1912.

Q2460416.name: Gazipur
Q2460416.about: Gazipur (Bengali: গাজীপুর) is the seat of Gazipur District and the second-largest city in Dhaka Division of  Bangladesh. It is a major industrial city 25 km (16 mi) north of the national capital Dhaka.

Q2337.name: Smolensk
Q2337.desc: city and administrative center of Smolensk Oblast in central Russia
Q2337.about: Smolensk is a city and the administrative center of Smolensk Oblast, Russia, located on the Dnieper River, 360 kilometers (220 mi) west-southwest of Moscow. Population: 316,570 (2021 census).

Q2423.name: Yaroslavl
Q2423.about: Yaroslavl (; Russian: Ярославль, IPA: [jɪrɐˈsɫavlʲ]) is a city and the administrative center of Yaroslavl Oblast, Russia, located 250 kilometers (160 mi) northeast of Moscow. The historic part of the city is a World Heritage Site, and is located at the confluence of the Volga and the Kotorosl rivers.

Q234053.name: Vancouver
Q234053.desc: city in and the county seat of Clark County, Washington, United States
Q234053.about: Vancouver (  van-KOO-vər) is a city in Clark County, Washington, United States, located on the north bank of the Columbia River. It had a population of 190,915 at the 2020 census, making it the fourth-most populous city in Washington.

Q234061.name: Erie
Q234061.desc: city on the south shore of Lake Erie and the county seat of Erie County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q234061.about: Erie is a city on the south shore of Lake Erie and the county seat of Erie County, Pennsylvania, United States. It is the fifth-most populous city in Pennsylvania and the most populous in Northwestern Pennsylvania with a population of 94,831 as of the 2020 census.

Q234087.name: Nakano
Q234087.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q234087.about: Nakano (中野; Japanese pronunciation: [nä̀.kä́.nó̞]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. The English translation of its Japanese self-designation is Nakano City (中野, Nakano-ku; [nä̀.kä́.nó̞.kɯ̈̀]).

Q234453.name: Hollywood
Q234453.desc: city in southern Broward County, Florida, United States
Q234453.about: Hollywood is a city in Broward County, Florida, United States. It is a suburb in the Miami metropolitan area.

Q234600.name: Al Ain
Q234600.about: Al Ain (Arabic: ٱلْعَيْن, romanized: Al-ʿAyn, lit. 'The Spring') is a city in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, and the seat of the administrative division of the Al Ain Region. The city is bordered to the east by the Omani town of Al-Buraimi.

Q235130.name: Kita
Q235130.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q235130.about: Kita (北区, Kita-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [k̟ʲi̥.tä́(.kɯ̈̀)]; lit. 'Northern Ward') is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. The English translation of its Japanese self-designation is City of Kita.

Q235135.name: Sumida
Q235135.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q235135.about: Sumida (墨田区, Sumida-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [sɨ̀.mʲí.dä́(.kɯ̈̀), sɨ́.mʲì.dä̀]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. The English translation of its Japanese self-designation is Sumida City.

Q235190.name: Manizales
Q235190.desc: capital of the Colombian department of Caldas
Q235190.about: Manizales (Spanish pronunciation: [maniˈsales])  is a city in central Colombia. It is the capital of the Department of Caldas, and lies near the Nevado del Ruiz volcano.

Q235389.name: Hotan
Q235389.desc: oasis town in the Tarim Basin, southwestern Xinjiang, an autonomous region in Western China
Q235389.about: Hotan is a major oasis town in southwestern Xinjiang, an autonomous region in Northwestern China. The city proper of Hotan broke off from the larger Hotan County to become an administrative area in its own right in August 1984.

Q2280.name: Minsk
Q2280.desc: capital and largest city of Belarus
Q2280.about: Minsk (Belarusian: Мінск, Russian: Минск, Belarusian and Russian: [mʲinsk] ) is the capital and largest city of Belarus, located on the Svislach and the now subterranean Nyamiha rivers. As the capital, Minsk has a special administrative status in Belarus and is the administrative centre of Minsk region and Minsk district.

Q2288.name: Tver
Q2288.desc: town and administrative center of Tver region in western Russia
Q2288.about: Tver (Russian: Тверь, IPA: [tvʲerʲ]) is a city and the administrative centre of Tver Oblast, Russia. It is situated at the confluence of the Volga and Tvertsa rivers.

Q231645.name: Setagaya
Q231645.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q231645.about: Setagaya (世田谷区, Setagaya-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [sè̞.tä́.ɡä́.jä́(.kɯ̈̀), -ŋä́-]; officially called Setagaya City or the City of Setagaya) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. It is also the name of a neighborhood and administrative district within the ward.

Q231765.name: Geelong
Q231765.about: Geelong ( jih-LONG; Wathawurrung: Djilang/Djalang) is a port city in Victoria, Australia, located at the western end of Corio Bay (the smaller western portion of Port Phillip Bay) and the left bank of Barwon River, about 75 km (47 mi) southwest of Melbourne. With an estimated population of 282,809 in 2023, Geelong is the second-largest city in the state of Victoria.

Q232226.name: Kelowna
Q232226.about: Kelowna (  kə-LOH-nə) is a city on Okanagan Lake in the Okanagan Valley in the southern interior of British Columbia, Canada. It serves as the head office of the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Q232628.name: Katsushika
Q232628.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q232628.about: Katsushika (葛飾区, Katsushika-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [kä̀.t͡sɨ́.ɕi̥.kä̀, -kä́(.kɯ̈̀)]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. It is known as Katsushika City in English.

Q232635.name: Itabashi
Q232635.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q232635.about: Itabashi (板橋区, Itabashi-ku) Japanese pronunciation: [ì.tä́.bä̀.ɕì, -bä́.ɕi̥.kɯ̈̀] is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. In English, it is called Itabashi City.

Q233129.name: Peoria
Q233129.desc: county seat of Peoria County, Illinois, United States
Q233129.about: Peoria ( pee-OR-ee-ə) is a city in Peoria County, Illinois, United States, and its county seat. Located on the Illinois River, the city had a population of 113,150 as of the 2020 census, making it the eighth-most populous city in Illinois.

Q233892.name: Rockford
Q233892.desc: county seat of Winnebago County, Illinois, United States
Q233892.about: Rockford is a city in Winnebago and Ogle counties in the U.S. state of Illinois. It is located in far northern Illinois on the banks of the Rock River.
Q233892.img: Aerial view of Rockford, Illinois, June 2017.JPG

Q233903.name: Meguro
Q233903.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q233903.about: Meguro (目黒区, Meguro-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [mé̞.ɡɯ̈̀.ɾò̞, -ŋɯ̈̀.ɾò̞, mè̞.ɡɯ̈́.ɾó̞.kɯ̈̀, -ŋɯ̈́.ɾó̞-]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. The English translation of its Japanese self-designation is Meguro City.

Q2473939.name: Abomey-Calavi
Q2473939.desc: commune and city in Atlantique Department, Benin
Q2473939.about: Abomey-Calavi [a.bɔ.mɛ.ka.la.vi] is a city, arrondissement, and commune located in the Atlantique Department of Benin. It is now essentially a suburb of Cotonou and at its closest it begins approximately 18 km from the city centre of Cotonou.

Q2495519.name: Utica
Q2495519.desc: city in Oneida County, New York, United States
Q2495519.about: Utica ( ) is a city in the U.S. state of New York, and the county seat of Oneida County. The tenth-most populous city in New York, its population was 65,283 in the 2020 census.

Q246791.name: Yanzhou District
Q246791.desc: district in Shandong, People's Republic of China
Q246791.about: Yanzhou (postal: Yenchow; simplified Chinese: 兖州; traditional Chinese: 兗州; pinyin: Yǎnzhōu) is a district in the prefecture-level city of Jining, in the southwest of Shandong province, People's Republic of China. It was also the name of one of the Nine Provinces in ancient China, where Yu combated floods by water control.
Q246791.img: 山东济宁市兖州区航拍, 2023-02-20.jpg

Q247055.name: Division No. 13
Q247055.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q247055.about: Census Division No. 13 (Selkirk Area) is a census division located within the Interlake Region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q247123.name: Ville-Marie
Q247123.about: Ville-Marie (French pronunciation: [vil maʁi]) is the name of a borough (arrondissement) in the centre of Montreal, Quebec. The borough is named after Fort Ville-Marie, the French settlement that would later become Montreal (now Old Montreal), which was located within the present-day borough.

Q247715.name: Meade County
Q247715.about: Meade County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas. Its county seat and largest city is Meade.

Q2449.name: Mogadishu
Q2449.desc: capital and the largest city of Somalia
Q2449.about: Mogadishu, locally known as Xamar or Hamar, is the capital and most populous city of Somalia. The city has served as an important port connecting traders across the Indian Ocean for millennia and has an estimated urban population of 4,126,815.
Q2449.img: Pictures from an armed convoy trip in Mogadishu.jpg

Q236680.name: Toshima
Q236680.desc: special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan
Q236680.about: Toshima (豊島区, Toshima-ku; Japanese pronunciation: [tò̞.ɕí.mä́(.kɯ̈̀), tó̞.ɕì.mä̀]) is a special ward in the Tokyo Metropolis in Japan. It is one of the eight central wards of the Tokyo Metropolitan area.

Q236837.name: Richmond
Q236837.about: Richmond is a city in British Columbia, Canada. It occupies almost the entirety of Lulu Island (excluding Queensborough), the adjacent Sea Island (where the Vancouver International Airport is located) and several other smaller islands and uninhabited islets to its north and south.

Q237847.name: Solapur
Q237847.about: Solapur () is a city located in the south-western region of the Indian state of Maharashtra, close to its border with Karnataka. Solapur is located on a major highway, rail routes between Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore and Hyderabad, with a branch line to the cities of Kalaburagi and Vijayapura in the neighbouring state of Karnataka.

Q237896.name: Reading
Q237896.desc: city in and county seat of Berks County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q237896.about: Reading ( RED-ing; Pennsylvania German: Reddin) is a city in Berks County, Pennsylvania, United States, and its county seat. The city had a population of 95,112 at the 2020 census and is the fourth-most populous city in Pennsylvania after Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, and Allentown.

Q238508.name: Gurgaon
Q238508.about: Gurgaon (Hindi: [ɡʊɽɡãːw]), officially named Gurugram ([ɡʊɾʊɡɾaːm]), is a satellite city of Delhi and administrative headquarters of Gurgaon district, located in the northern Indian state of Haryana. It is situated near the Delhi–Haryana border, about 30 kilometres (19 mi) southwest of the national capital New Delhi and 268 km (167 mi) south of Chandigarh, the state capital.
Q238508.img: Cyber Green Building, Gurgaon, Haryana, India - 20070613.jpg

Q239097.name: Deir ez-Zor
Q239097.about: Deir ez-Zor (Arabic: دَيْرُ ٱلزَّوْرِ / دَيْرُ ٱلزُّور, romanized: Dayru z-Zawr / Dayru z-Zūr) is the largest city in eastern Syria and the seventh largest in the country. Located on the banks of the Euphrates 450 km (280 mi) to the northeast of the capital Damascus, Deir ez-Zor is the capital of the Deir ez-Zor Governorate.

Q239143.name: Kowloon
Q239143.about: Kowloon (), formerly Kaulung, is one of the three areas of Hong Kong, along with Hong Kong Island, and the New Territories. It is an urban area comprising the Kowloon Peninsula and New Kowloon.

Q239421.name: Nakuru
Q239421.about: Nakuru, sometimes referred to as Nakuru City, is the capital and largest city of Nakuru County, Kenya. As of 2019, Nakuru had an urban population of 570,674.

Q239580.name: Kitwe
Q239580.about: Kitwe is the third largest city in terms of infrastructure development (after Lusaka and Ndola) and second largest city in terms of size and population (after Lusaka) in Zambia. With a population of 661,901 as of the 2022 census, Kitwe is one of the most developed commercial and industrial areas in the nation, alongside Ndola and Lusaka.

Q239870.name: Columbus
Q239870.desc: consolidated city-county in Muscogee County, Georgia, United States
Q239870.about: Columbus is a consolidated city-county located on the west-central border of the U.S. state of Georgia. Columbus lies on the Chattahoochee River directly across from Phenix City, Alabama.

Q239877.name: Mission
Q239877.desc: city in Hidalgo County, Texas, United States
Q239877.about: Mission is a city in Hidalgo County, in the US state of Texas. Its population was 85,778 at the 2020 census and an estimated 86,635 in 2022.

Q240475.name: Kashan
Q240475.about: Kashan (Persian: کاشان; [kɒːˈʃɒːn] ) is a city in the Central District of Kashan County, in the northern part of Isfahan province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district. Kashan is one of the oldest cities in Iran and is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
Q240475.img: View of the Zagros Mountains from the hotel (6223549543).jpg

Q240621.name: Page County
Q240621.about: Page County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,211.

Q2537446.name: Qarchak
Q2537446.about: Qarchak (Persian: قرچک) is a city in the Central District of Qarchak County, Tehran province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district.

Q2542396.name: Queens County
Q2542396.about: Queens County (French: Comté de Queens; 2021 population 10,998) is located in south central New Brunswick, Canada. The county shire town is the village of Gagetown.

Q22065012.name: Immediate Geographic Region of Uberaba
Q22065012.about:
The Immediate Geographic Region of Uberaba is one of the 4 immediate geographic regions in the Intermediate Geographic Region of Uberaba, one of the 70 immediate geographic regions in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais and one of the 509 of Brazil, created by the National Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) in 2017.
It is composed of 10 municipalities with a population of 458.608 people (2021) within an area of 14.281652 km2 (5.514177 sq mi).

Q22905.name: Bradford
Q22905.desc: city and largest settlement in the City of Bradford district, Yorkshire, England
Q22905.about: Bradford is a city in West Yorkshire, England. It became a municipal borough in 1847, received a city charter in 1897 and, since the 1974 reform, the city status has belonged to the larger City of Bradford metropolitan borough.

Q23025.name: Red Deer
Q23025.about: Red Deer is a city in Alberta, Canada, located alongside the Red Deer River, midway on the Calgary–Edmonton Corridor. Red Deer is Alberta's third-largest city, after Calgary and Edmonton, with a slightly higher population than Lethbridge.

Q243325.name: Khulna
Q243325.about: Khulna (Bengali: খুলনা, pronounced [ˈkʰulna] ) is the capital and largest city of Khulna Division and Khulna District in Bangladesh. It is the fifth-largest city in Bangladesh after Dhaka, Chittagong, Gazipur, and Narayanganj, and the third most-populous metropolitan area in the country after Dhaka and Chittagong.

Q243327.name: Changwon
Q243327.desc: specific city in South Gyeongsang, South Korea
Q243327.about: Changwon (Korean: 창원; Korean pronunciation: [tɕʰaŋ.wʌn]) is the capital and largest city of South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea (with a population of 1,025,702 as of 2023), and the 11th largest city of the country. A port city, Changwon is bordered by Masan Bay to the south, and the cities of Busan and Gimhae to the east.

Q243699.name: Rosetta
Q243699.about: Rosetta ( roh-ZET-ə) or Rashid (Arabic: رشيد, romanized: Rašīd, IPA: [ɾɑˈʃiːd]; Coptic: ϯⲣⲁϣⲓⲧ, romanized: ti-Rashit) is a port city of the Nile Delta, 65 km (40 mi) east of Alexandria, in Egypt's Beheira governorate. The Rosetta Stone was discovered in nearby Fort Julien in 1799.

Q243846.name: Hillah
Q243846.about: Hillah (Arabic: ٱلْحِلَّة al-Ḥillah), also spelled Hilla, is a city in central Iraq. On the Hilla branch of the Euphrates River, it is 100 km (62 mi) south of Baghdad.

Q23564.name: Podgorica
Q23564.about: Podgorica is the capital and largest city of Montenegro. The city is located in central Montenegro, at the confluence of Ribnica and Morača rivers, where the southern foothills of Dinaric Alps meet the northernmost part of Zeta Plain.

Q2464208.name: Osasco
Q2464208.desc: microregion in the state of São Paulo in Brazil

Q23984578.name: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
Q23984578.desc: innhabited place in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain

Q23990454.name: Vigo City
Q23990454.desc: city in north-west Spain in Pontevedra province

Q24017120.name: City of Valencia
Q24017120.desc: city in Spain, capital of the Valencian Community
Q24017120.img: Vista cap a l'ajuntament des de l'edifici Roca, València.JPG

Q24019772.name: Murcia City
Q24019772.desc: human settlement in Murcia, Region of Murcia, Spain

Q24854316.name: Camayenne
Q24854316.img: Hôpital Donka, Bâtiment de la chirurgie.jpg

Q2467.name: Nassau
Q2467.desc: capital and largest city of the Bahamas
Q2467.about: Nassau ( NASS-aw) is the capital and largest city of the Bahamas. It is on the island of New Providence, which has a population of 296,522, 74.26% of the country's total population.
Q2467.img: BHA Nassau, Paradise Island, Atlantis Bridge 001.jpg

Q2486.name: Tarawa
Q2486.desc: atoll in the central Pacific Ocean and the capital of Kiribati
Q2486.about: Tarawa is an atoll and the capital of the Republic of Kiribati, in the Micronesia region of the central Pacific Ocean. It comprises North Tarawa, which has 6,629 inhabitants and much in common with other more remote islands of the Gilbert group, and South Tarawa, which has 56,388 inhabitants as of 2015, half of the country's total population.

Q22595.name: Aurora
Q22595.desc: city on tripoints of DuPage, Kane, Kendall and Will Counties in Illinois, United States
Q22595.about: Aurora is a city in northeastern Illinois, United States, located along the Fox River. The population was 180,542 at the 2020 census.

Q241814.name: Kingsport
Q241814.desc: city in Sullivan, Hawkins, and Washington counties in Tennessee, United States
Q241814.about: Kingsport is a city in Sullivan and Hawkins counties in the U.S. state of Tennessee. It lies along the Holston River and had a population of 55,442 at the 2020 census.

Q242144.name: Bhilai
Q242144.about: Bhilai is a city in Durg district of the Indian state of Chhattisgarh, in east-central India. Along with its twin city, Durg, the urban agglomeration of Durg-Bhilai Nagar has a population of more than a million, making it the second most populous urban area in Chhattisgarh, after Raipur.

Q242783.name: Okazaki
Q242783.about: Okazaki (岡崎市, Okazaki-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ò̞.kä́.(d͡)zä̀.k̟ʲì, -(d͡)zä́.k̟ʲi̥.ɕì]) is a city located in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 October 2019, the city had an estimated population of 386,999 in 164,087 households, and a population density of 999 persons per km2.

Q242895.name: Saharanpur
Q242895.about: Saharanpur is a city and a municipal corporation in Uttar Pradesh, India. It is also the administrative headquarters of Saharanpur district.

Q242992.name: Bhavnagar
Q242992.about: Bhavnagar is a city and the headquarters of Bhavnagar district in the Indian state of Gujarat. Bhavnagar was founded in 1723 by Bhavsinhji Gohil.

Q242995.name: Jhansi
Q242995.desc: historic city in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India
Q242995.about: Jhansi (pronounced [d͡ʑʱãː.siː] ) is a historic city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. (Toshan) Balwant Nagar was the old name of Jhansi.

Q243007.name: Naperville
Q243007.desc: city in DuPage and Will counties in Illinois, United States
Q243007.about: Naperville (, NAY-pər-vil) is a city in DuPage and Will counties in the U.S. state of Illinois. It is a city in the Chicago metropolitan area located 28 miles (45 km) west of the city on the DuPage River.
Q243007.img: City of Naperville City Hall main entrance.jpg

Q243319.name: Morogoro
Q243319.about: Morogoro  is a city located in the eastern part of Tanzania, approximately 196 kilometers (122 miles) west of Dar es Salaam. It serves as the capital of the Morogoro Region.

Q243322.name: Gujranwala
Q243322.about: Gujranwala is the fourth-largest city in the province of Punjab, serving as the headquarters of its eponymous district and division. It is nicknamed the "City of Wrestlers" and is famous for its cuisine and historical significance.

Q24058852.name: Central Coast
Q24058852.desc: local government area in New South Wales, Australia
Q24058852.about: The Central Coast Council is a local government area in the Central Coast region of New South Wales, Australia. It is adjacent to the Pacific Highway, Central Coast Highway, the Northern railway line and the Pacific Ocean.

Q23051.name: Swansea
Q23051.about: Swansea ( SWON-zee; Welsh: Abertawe [abɛrˈtawɛ]) is a port and coastal city in Wales. It is the second-largest city in the country.

Q23154.name: Bristol
Q23154.desc: city in South West England, United Kingdom
Q23154.about: Bristol ( ) is a city and ceremonial county in South West England. It is on the River Avon, and bordered by Gloucestershire to the north and Somerset to the south, with a short coastline on the Bristol Channel to the west.

Q23197.name: Nashville
Q23197.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Tennessee and seat of Davidson County
Q23197.about: Nashville ( NASH-vil) is the capital and most populous city in the U.S. state of Tennessee. It is the seat of Davidson County in Middle Tennessee, located on the Cumberland River.

Q244004.name: Sétif
Q244004.about: Sétif (Tamazight: Sṭif, Tifinagh: ⵚⵟⵉⴼ, Arabic: سطيف, romanized: Siṭīf) is the capital city of the Sétif Province and the 5th most populous city of Algeria, with an estimated population of 1,866,845 in 2017). It is one of the most important cities of eastern Algeria and the country as a whole, since it is considered the trade capital of the country and an industrial pole with three industrial zones within the borders of the city.

Q244025.name: Burnaby
Q244025.about: Burnaby is a city in the Lower Mainland region of British Columbia, Canada. Located in the centre of the Burrard Peninsula, it neighbours the City of Vancouver to the west, the District of North Vancouver across the confluence of the Burrard Inlet with its Indian Arm to the north, Port Moody and Coquitlam to the east, New Westminster and Surrey across the Fraser River to the southeast, and Richmond on Lulu Island to the southwest.

Q244146.name: Clearwater
Q244146.desc: county seat of Pinellas County, Florida, United States
Q244146.about: Clearwater is a city in and the county seat of Pinellas County, Florida, United States, west of Tampa and north of St. Petersburg.

Q244159.name: Dhanbad
Q244159.about: DhanbadHindi pronunciation: [dʱənˌbɐːd̪] is the second-most populated city in the Indian state of Jharkhand after Jamshedpur and a major financial hub of Jharkhand. In terms of economy, Dhanbad has the largest economy in the state of and is often referred to as the 'economic capital of Jharkhand'.

Q244232.name: Tabuk
Q244232.desc: place in Tabuk province, Saudi Arabia
Q244232.about: Tabuk (Arabic: تَبُوك Tabūk, Arabic: [taˈbuːk]) is a city in northwestern Saudi Arabia, and the capital of Tabuk Province. It is located near the Jordan–Saudi Arabia border.

Q244898.name: New Taipei City
Q244898.desc: city in Taiwan, and most populous municipality of Taiwan
Q244898.about: New Taipei City is a special municipality located in northern Taiwan. The city is home to an estimated population of 4,004,367 as of January 2023, making it the most populous city in Taiwan, and the second largest special municipality by area, behind Kaohsiung.
Q244898.img: View of Banqiao District, New Taipei, Taiwan Cityscape 2017.jpg

Q23337.name: Salt Lake City
Q23337.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Utah and seat of Salt Lake County
Q23337.about: Salt Lake City, often shortened to Salt Lake or SLC, is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Utah. It is the county seat of Salt Lake County, the most populous county in the state.

Q23436.name: Edinburgh
Q23436.about: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland and one of its 32 council areas. It is located in southeast Scotland and is bounded to the north by the Firth of Forth and to the south by the Pentland Hills.

Q248521.name: Sherman County
Q248521.about: Sherman County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat is Goodland.

Q249007.name: Wuwei
Q249007.about: Wuwei (Chinese: 武威; pinyin: Wǔwēi) is a prefecture-level city in northwest central Gansu province. In the north it borders Inner Mongolia, in the southwest, Qinghai.

Q249638.name: Winnebago County
Q249638.about: Winnebago County is a county in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 10,679.

Q249994.name: Hsinchu City
Q249994.about: Hsinchu (Chinese: 新竹; pinyin: Xīnzhú, IPA: [ɕin˥ʈʂu˧˥]), officially Hsinchu City, is a city located in northwestern Taiwan. It is the most populous city in Taiwan that is not a special municipality, with estimated 476,273 inhabitants.

Q249995.name: Chiayi City
Q249995.about:
Chiayi (), officially known as Chiayi City, is a city located in Chianan Plain in southwestern Taiwan, surrounded by Chiayi County with a population of 263,188 inhabitants as of January 2023.
The Hoanya people inhabited present-day Chiayi under its historical name of Tirosen prior to the arrival of Han Chinese in Taiwan and was ruled by the Dutch and the Kingdom of Tungning under various names.

Q249996.name: Keelung
Q249996.desc: provincial-level city and the northernmost city in Taiwan
Q249996.about: Keelung ( kee-LUUNG; Chinese: 基隆; pinyin: Jīlóng; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Ke-lâng), Chilung or Jilong ( jee-LUUNG), officially known as Keelung City, is a major port city in northeastern Taiwan. The city is part of the Taipei–Keelung metropolitan area with neighboring New Taipei City and Taipei.

Q250220.name: Bharatpur
Q250220.desc: metropolitan city in Chitwan District, Nepal
Q250220.about: Bharatpur (, Nepali: भरतपुर, pronounced [ˈbʱʌɾʌt̪pur] ) is a metropolitan city in south central Nepal. It is the third most populous city of Nepal after Kathmandu and Pokhara with  369,268 inhabitants in 2021.

Q250880.name: Innere Stadt
Q250880.about: Innere Stadt (German pronunciation: [ˈɪnəʀə ʃtat] ) is the 1st city-district of the Austrian city of Graz, capital of the state of Styria. It is the part of the Old Town (in German: Altstadt) containing the Schloßberg and the city park (Stadtpark).

Q251267.name: Cuyahoga County
Q251267.about: Cuyahoga County ( KY-ə-HOG-ə or  KY-ə-HOH-gə, see Cuyahoga River § Pronunciation) is a large urban county in the U.S. state of Ohio. The county seat and most populous city is Cleveland.

Q251277.name: Lorain County
Q251277.about: Lorain County () is a county in the northeastern part of the U.S. state of Ohio As of the 2020 census, the population was 312,964. Its county seat is Elyria, and its largest city is Lorain.

Q251329.name: Gaya
Q251329.about: Gaya (IAST: Gayā) is a city, municipal corporation and the administrative headquarters of Gaya district and Magadh division of the Indian state of Bihar. Gaya is 116 kilometres (72 mi) south of Patna and is the state's second-largest city, with a population of 470,839.

Q252901.name: Avignon
Q252901.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q252901.about: Avignon (French pronunciation: [aviɲɔ̃] ) is a regional county municipality located in the Gaspésie–Îles-de-la-Madeleine region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat and largest city is Carleton-sur-Mer.

Q253182.name: Sancaktepe
Q253182.about: Sancaktepe is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 63 km2, and its population is 489,848 (2022).

Q253186.name: Jefferson County
Q253186.about: Jefferson County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. At the 2020 census, the population was 24,502.

Q253538.name: Perry County
Q253538.about: Perry County is a county located in the Black Belt region in the central part of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 8,511.

Q2213440.name: West Jerusalem
Q2213440.desc: section of Jerusalem that remained under Israeli control after the 1948 Arab–Israeli War
Q2213440.about: West Jerusalem or Western Jerusalem (Hebrew: מַעֲרַב יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, Ma'aráv Yerushaláyim; Arabic: القدس الغربية, al-Quds al-Ġarbiyyah) is the section of Jerusalem that was controlled by Israel at the end of the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. As the city was divided by the Green Line (Israel's erstwhile de facto border, established by the 1949 Armistice Agreements), West Jerusalem was formally delineated as the counterpart to East Jerusalem, which was controlled by Jordan.
Q2213440.img: Jerusalem bird's eye view from west to north-east.jpeg

Q25330.name: Trenton
Q25330.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of New Jersey and seat of Mercer County
Q25330.about: Trenton is the capital city of the U.S. state of New Jersey and the county seat of Mercer County. It was the capital of the United States from November 1 until December 24, 1784.

Q25395.name: Newark
Q25395.desc: city in Essex County, and largest city in New Jersey, United States
Q25395.about: Newark ( NEW-ərk, locally  NOORK) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of New Jersey, the county seat of Essex County, and a principal city of the New York metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census, the city's population was 311,549.
Q25395.img: 2021-09-25 10 50 38 View of downtown Newark from the intersection of Essex County Route 510 (Market Street) and Mulberry Street in Newark, Essex County, New Jersey.jpg

Q25247514.name: Lekki
Q25247514.about: Lekki is a city in Lagos State, Nigeria. It is to the southeast of Lagos city proper.

Q25408755.name: Petersburg Borough
Q25408755.about: Petersburg Borough is a borough in the U.S. state of Alaska. According to the 2020 census, the population was 3,398.

Q23438.name: Ashgabat
Q23438.about: Ashgabat is the capital and largest city of Turkmenistan. It lies between the Karakum Desert and the Köpetdag mountain range in Central Asia, approximately 50 km (30 mi) away from the Iran-Turkmenistan border.

Q23443.name: Provo
Q23443.desc: city in and county seat of Utah County, Utah, United States
Q23443.about: Provo ( PROH-voh) is a city in and the county seat of Utah County, Utah, United States. It had a population of 115,162 at the 2020 census, making it the fourth-most-populous city in Utah and the most populous in Utah outside the Salt Lake City metropolitan area.

Q23551.name: Mérida
Q23551.about: Mérida, officially known as Santiago de los Caballeros de Mérida, is the capital of the municipality of Libertador and the state of Mérida, and is one of the main cities of the Venezuelan Andes. It was founded in 1558 by Captain Juan Rodríguez Suárez, forming part of Nueva Granada, but later became part of the Captaincy General of Venezuela and played an active role in the War of Independence.

Q23556.name: Atlanta
Q23556.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Georgia and seat of Fulton County, also located in DeKalb County
Q23556.about: Atlanta is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Georgia. It is the county seat of Fulton County and extends into neighboring DeKalb County.

Q2222874.name: Zanzibar City
Q2222874.about: Zanzibar City or Mjini District,  often simply referred to as Zanzibar (Wilaya ya Zanzibar Mjini or Jiji la Zanzibar in Swahili), is one of two administrative districts of Mjini Magharibi Region in Tanzania. The district covers an area of 15.4 km2 (5.9 sq mi).

Q2237435.name: Kukatpally
Q2237435.about: Kukatpally is a suburb in northwestern Hyderabad in the Indian state of Telangana. It is the headquarters of Balanagar mandal in the Malkajgiri revenue division of the Medchal–Malkajgiri district.

Q2244063.name: L. B. Nagar
Q2244063.about: Lal Bahadur Nagar, commonly known as L. B. Nagar, is a commercial and residential hub in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It was once a Municipality in Ranga Reddy district.

Q2269797.name: Poinciana
Q2269797.desc: human settlement in Florida, United States of America
Q2269797.about: Poinciana (English: ) is a settlement and census-designated place (CDP) in Osceola and Polk counties in the U.S. state of Florida. It is part of the Greater Orlando area.

Q2270906.name: Sunset Park
Q2270906.desc: neighborhood of Brooklyn in New York City, New York, United States
Q2270906.about: Sunset Park is a neighborhood in the western part of the New York City borough of Brooklyn, bounded by Park Slope and Green-Wood Cemetery to the north, Borough Park to the east, Bay Ridge to the south, and New York Harbor to the west. The neighborhood is named for a public park of the same name that covers 24.5 acres (9.9 ha) between Fifth and Seventh Avenues from 41st to 44th Street.

Q2279529.name: Konak
Q2279529.desc: district of İzmir Province in Turkey
Q2279529.about: Konak is a municipality and district of İzmir Province, Turkey. Its area is 24 km2, and its population is 332,277 (2022).

Q2284046.name: Fishers
Q2284046.desc: city in Hamilton County, Indiana, United States
Q2284046.about: Fishers is a city in Hamilton County, Indiana, United States. The population was 98,677 at the 2020 census.

Q2288728.name: Bushwick
Q2288728.desc: neighborhood in Brooklyn, New York City, New York, United States
Q2288728.about: Bushwick is a neighborhood in the northern part of the New York City borough of Brooklyn. It is bound by the neighborhood of Ridgewood, Queens, to the northeast; Williamsburg to the northwest; the cemeteries of Highland Park to the southeast; and Bedford–Stuyvesant to the south and southwest.

Q2296366.name: Randburg
Q2296366.desc: town located in north western Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
Q2296366.about: Randburg is an area located in the Gauteng province of South Africa. Formerly a separate municipality, its administration devolved to the newly created City of Johannesburg Metropolitan Municipality, along with neighbouring Sandton and Roodepoort, in the late 1990s.

Q2298823.name: Shelby Charter Township
Q2298823.desc: charter township and census-designated place in Macomb County, Michigan
Q2298823.about: Shelby Charter Township, officially the Charter Township of Shelby, is a charter township located in Macomb County in the U.S. state of Michigan. The township is an affluent northern suburb of Detroit.

Q2304294.name: Viana
Q2304294.about: Viana is a city and one of the nine municipalities that make up the province of Luanda in Angola.
