Viana lies 15 to 30 kilometers east as a suburb of the capital Luanda and had a population of 865,863 at the 2024 census, including about 6,000 long-term refugees primarily from Katanga Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Q2308343.name: Bihar Sharif
Q2308343.desc: Sub-metropolitan city in Nalanda district, Patna division, Bihar, India
Q2308343.about: Bihar Sharif is the headquarters of Nalanda district and the fifth-largest sub-metropolitan area in the eastern Indian state of Bihar. Its name is a combination of two words: Bihar, derived from vihara (meaning monastery), also the name of the state; and Sharif (meaning noble).

Q24861.name: Albany
Q24861.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of New York and seat of Albany County
Q24861.about: Albany (  AWL-bə-nee) is the capital city of the U.S. state of New York. It is also the county seat of, and the most populous city in Albany County.

Q24879.name: Bremen
Q24879.desc: city in the Bremen federated state, Germany
Q24879.about: Bremen (German pronunciation: [ˈbʁeːmən] ), officially the City Municipality of Bremen, is the capital and most populous city of the German state of the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen (Freie Hansestadt Bremen), a two-city-state consisting of the city of Bremen itself, and Bremerhaven. An important port city with about 586,000 inhabitants, this Hanseatic city is the 11th-largest city of Germany and the second-largest city in Northern Germany after Hamburg.

Q25096.name: Cabuyao
Q25096.desc: city of the Philippines in the province of Laguna
Q25096.about: Cabuyao (Tagalog: [kɐˈbujaʊ]), officially the City of Cabuyao (Filipino: Lungsod ng Cabuyao), is a component city in the province of Laguna, Philippines. According to the 2025 census, it has a population of 365,202 people.

Q25270.name: Pristina
Q25270.desc: capital and the largest city of Kosovo
Q25270.about: Pristina (or Prishtina; UK:  PREE-shtin-ə, prish-TEE-nə, US:  PRISHT-in-ə) is the capital and largest city of Kosovo. It is the administrative center of the eponymous municipality and district.

Q25280.name: Harrisburg
Q25280.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Pennsylvania and seat of Dauphin County
Q25280.about: Harrisburg ( HARR-iss-burg; Pennsylvania German: Harrisbarrig) is the capital city of the U.S. commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It is the ninth-most populous city in the state, with a population of 50,099 at the 2020 census, while the Harrisburg–Carlisle metropolitan statistical area has an estimated 615,000 residents and is the fourth-most populous metropolitan area in Pennsylvania.

Q25282.name: Da Nang
Q25282.about: Da Nang (Vietnamese: Đà Nẵng, pronounced [ɗa˨˩ naŋ˨˩˦ˀ]), also written unspaced as Danang, is the fourth largest city in Vietnam by population and the second largest by geographical area and located in the South Central Coast and Central Highlands. As one of the country's nine centrally-governed city, it falls under the administration of the central government.

Q25287.name: Gothenburg
Q25287.desc: second-largest city in Sweden and capital of the Västra Götaland County
Q25287.about: Gothenburg (  GOTH-ən-burg; Swedish: Göteborg [jœtəˈbɔrj] ) is the second-largest city in Sweden, after the capital Stockholm, and the fifth-largest in the Nordic countries. Situated by the Kattegat on the west coast of Sweden 400 km from the capital, it is the gubernatorial seat of Västra Götaland County, with a population of approximately 600,000 in the city proper and about 1.1 million inhabitants in the metropolitan area.

Q25319.name: Aarhus
Q25319.about: Aarhus (, US also ; Danish: [ˈɒːˌhuˀs] , locally also [ˈɒːˌhus]) is the second-largest city in Denmark and the seat of Aarhus Municipality. It is located on the eastern shore of Jutland in the Kattegat sea and approximately 187 kilometres (116 mi) northwest of Copenhagen.

Q23661.name: Wellington
Q23661.desc: capital city of New Zealand; urban area of the cities of Wellington, Lower Hutt, Upper Hutt, and Porirua
Q23661.about: Wellington is the capital city of New Zealand. It is located at the southwestern tip of the North Island, between Cook Strait and the Remutaka Range.

Q23768.name: Las Vegas
Q23768.desc: seat of Clark County, and largest city in state of Nevada, United States
Q23768.about: Las Vegas, colloquially shortened to Vegas, is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Nevada and the county seat of Clark County. It is the 24th-most populous city in the United States, with 641,903 residents at the 2020 census.

Q24464.name: LaGrange County
Q24464.about: LaGrange County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the population was 40,446.

Q24603.name: Independence
Q24603.desc: city in Jackson and Clay counties in Missouri, United States, that is one of two county seats in Jackson County
Q24603.about: Independence is a city mostly in, and one of two county seats of, Jackson County, Missouri, United States. It is a satellite city of Kansas City, Missouri, and is the largest suburb on the Missouri side of the Kansas City metropolitan area.

Q24639.name: Vancouver
Q24639.desc: largest city in the province of British Columbia, Canada
Q24639.about: Vancouver is a major city in Western Canada, located in the Lower Mainland region of British Columbia. As the most populous city in the province, the 2021 Canadian census recorded 662,248 people in the city, up from 631,486 in 2016.

Q24645.name: Elkhart County
Q24645.about: Elkhart County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the county's population was 207,047.

Q24646.name: Steuben County
Q24646.about: Steuben County is a county located at the northeastern corner of the  U.S. state of Indiana. As of the 2020 United States census, the county's population was 34,435.

Q24648.name: LaPorte County
Q24648.about: LaPorte County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the population was 112,417.

Q24826.name: Liverpool
Q24826.desc: city in Merseyside, England, United Kingdom
Q24826.about: Liverpool is a port city and metropolitan borough in Merseyside, England. It is situated on the eastern side of the Mersey Estuary, near the Irish Sea, 178 miles (286 km) north-west of London.

Q268.name: Poznań
Q268.desc: capital of the Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland
Q268.about: Poznań (Polish: [ˈpɔznaj̃] or [ˈpɔznaɲ] ; German: Posen [ˈpoːzn̩] ; Latin: Posnania) is a city on the River Warta in west Poland, within the Greater Poland region. The city is an important cultural and business center with customs such as Saint John's Fair (Jarmark Świętojański), traditional Saint Martin's croissants, and a local dialect.

Q26760.name: Millard County
Q26760.desc: county in western Utah, United States
Q26760.about: Millard County ( MIL-ərd) is a county in the U.S. state of Utah. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 12,975.

Q26762.name: Starr County
Q26762.about: Starr County is located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 65,920.

Q254428.name: Clifton
Q254428.desc: city in Passaic County, New Jersey, United States
Q254428.about: Clifton is a city in Passaic County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. Criss-crossed by several major highways, the city is a regional commercial hub for North Jersey, and bedroom suburb of New York City, in the New York Metropolitan Area.

Q255455.name: Jammu
Q255455.about: Jammu () is a city in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in the Jammu division. It serves as the winter capital of the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.

Q269.name: Tashkent
Q269.about: Tashkent ( ), also spelled Toshkent, is the capital and largest city of Uzbekistan. It is the most populous city in Central Asia, with a population of more than 3.1 million people as of July 1, 2025.

Q255943.name: Liberty County
Q255943.desc: county in Florida, United States of America
Q255943.about: Liberty County is a county located in the state of Florida, part of the Big Bend region. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,974, making it the least populous county in Florida.

Q256194.name: Karnal
Q256194.desc: city and the headquarters of Karnal District in the Indian state of Haryana
Q256194.about: Karnal (Punjabi pronunciation: [ˌkʌ̯ˈɾ.ˈnɐː˩˥l]) is a city located in the Indian state of Haryana and serves as the administrative headquarters of the Karnal district. The city lies on National Highway 44, which connects it to the national capital, New Delhi, and the state capital, Chandigarh, placing Karnal almost midway between the two.

Q2656.name: Palermo
Q2656.about: Palermo (Sicilian: Palermu) is the capital and largest city of the autonomous island region of Sicily in southern Italy, located on the eponymous gulf facing the Tyrrhenian Sea. A 2,700-year-old city, it is noted for its history, culture, architecture and gastronomy, playing an important role throughout much of its existence.

Q26891.name: Sutton County
Q26891.about: Sutton County is a county located on the Edwards Plateau in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 3,372.

Q261380.name: Grundy County
Q261380.about: Grundy County is located in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it has a population of 52,533.

Q261672.name: Lauderdale County
Q261672.about: Lauderdale County is a county located in the northwestern corner of the U.S. state of Alabama. At the 2020 census the population was 93,564.
Q261672.img: Lauderdale County Courthouse in Florence, Alabama.JPG

Q261887.name: Kikwit
Q261887.about: Kikwit is the largest city in Kwilu Province, in the southwest of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Located at the furthest navigable point of the Kwilu River, the urban area of Kikwit is primarily on the river's left bank.

Q261988.name: Rajpur Sonarpur
Q261988.about: Rajpur Sonarpur (Bengali: [ɾɑːd͡ʒpuɾ soːnɑːɾpuɾ]) is a city and a municipality of South 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q262708.name: Manatee County
Q262708.about: Manatee County is located in the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 United States census, its population was 399,710.

Q2749.name: Augsburg
Q2749.about: Augsburg (UK:  OWGZ-burg, also US:  AWGZ-; German: [ˈaʊksbʊʁk] ; Swabian German: Ougschburg) is a city in the Bavarian part of Swabia, Germany, around 50 kilometres (31 mi) west of the Bavarian capital Munich. It is a university town and the regional seat of the Regierungsbezirk Swabia with a well-preserved Altstadt (historical city centre).
Q2749.img: Plaza del Ayuntamiento, Augsburgo, Alemania, 2021-06-04, DD 32-34 HDR.jpg

Q27011.name: Frio County
Q27011.about: Frio County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 18,385.

Q27018.name: Hays County
Q27018.about: Hays County is a county in the central portion of the U.S. state of Texas. It is part of the Austin-Round Rock metropolitan area.

Q265079.name: Hancock County
Q265079.about: Hancock County is a county in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it has a population of 17,620.

Q266014.name: Yongzhou
Q266014.desc: prefecture-level city in Hunan, People's Republic of China
Q266014.about: Yongzhou (Chinese: 永州; pinyin: Yǒngzhōu) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Hunan province, People's Republic of China, located on the southern bank of the Xiang River, which is formed by the confluence of the Xiao and Xiang Rivers, and bordering Guangdong to the southeast and Guangxi to the southwest. With a history of 2000 years, Yongzhou is one of the four ancient counties in Hunan.

Q2592.name: Kostroma
Q2592.desc: city in the center of European Russia
Q2592.about: Kostroma (Russian: Кострома́, IPA: [kəstrɐˈma]) is a historic city and the administrative center of Kostroma Oblast, Russia. A part of the Golden Ring of Russian cities, it is located at the confluence of the rivers Volga and Kostroma.

Q2630.name: Ivanovo
Q2630.desc: city in the center of European Russia
Q2630.about: Ivanovo (Russian: Иваново, IPA: [ɪˈvanəvə] ) is a city in Russia and the administrative center and largest city of Ivanovo Oblast, located 254 kilometers (158 mi) northeast of Moscow and approximately 100 kilometers (62 mi) from Yaroslavl, Vladimir and Kostroma. Ivanovo has a population of 361,644 as of the 2021 Census, making it the 50th largest city in Russia.

Q26883.name: Walker County
Q26883.about: Walker County is a county located in the east-central section of the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 76,400.

Q26885.name: Colorado County
Q26885.about: Colorado County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 20,557.

Q26887.name: Davenport
Q26887.desc: county seat of Scott County, Iowa, United States
Q26887.about: Davenport (US:  DAV-ən-port) is a city in Scott County, Iowa, United States, and its county seat. The population was 101,724 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 100,938 in 2024, making it the third-most populous city in Iowa, after Des Moines and Cedar Rapids.

Q26889.name: Sabine County
Q26889.about: Sabine County is a county located on the central eastern border of the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 9,894.

Q260282.name: Conroe
Q260282.desc: city in and county seat of Montgomery County, Texas, United States
Q260282.about: Conroe is a city in and the county seat of Montgomery County, Texas, United States, about 40 miles (64 km) north of Houston. It is a principal city in the Houston–Pasadena–The Woodlands metropolitan area.

Q260871.name: Catoosa County
Q260871.about: Catoosa County is a county in the Northwest region of the U.S. state of Georgia. According to the 2020 census, the population was 67,872.

Q260911.name: Chiclayo
Q260911.desc: city of Peru, capital of Lambayeque region
Q260911.about: Chiclayo (Spanish pronunciation: [tʃiˈklaʝo]; Mochica: Cɥiclaiæp) is the principal city and capital of the Lambayeque region and Chiclayo Province in northern Peru. It is located 13 km (8.1 mi) from the Pacific coast, 208 km (129 mi) from the city of Trujillo, and 770 km (480 mi) from the country's capital, Lima.

Q261076.name: Margilan
Q261076.about: Margilan (Uzbek: Marg‘ilon, Persian: مرغیلان, pronounced [mɐrʁɨˈlɒn]) is a city in eastern Uzbekistan's Fergana Region. As of the 2024 census, its population was 253,500.

Q270.name: Warsaw

Q26766.name: Wasatch County

Q26766.about: Wasatch County ( WAH-satch) is a county in the U.S. state of Utah. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 34,788.

Q26793.about: Bergen (Norwegian pronunciation: [ˈbæ̀rɡən] , locally [ˈbæ̂ʁgæn]) is a city and municipality in the Vestland county on the west coast of Norway. Bergen is the second-largest city in Norway after the capital, Oslo.

Q26807.name: Prince George's County
Q26807.about: Prince George's County (often shortened to PG County, PG, or PGC) is located in the U.S. state of Maryland bordering the eastern portion of Washington, D.C. The 2020 census counted an increase of nearly 104,000 in the previous ten years.

Q26880.name: Morgan County

Q257311.name: Hamilton County
Q257311.about: Hamilton County is a county located in the north central portion of the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,004, down from 14,799 at the 2010 census.

Q257334.name: Jefferson County
Q257334.about: Jefferson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and most populous city is Oskaloosa.

Q257536.name: Janesville

Q257536.about: Janesville is a city in, and the county seat of Rock County, Wisconsin, United States. The population was 65,615 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 66,428 in 2024, making it the tenth-most populous city in Wisconsin.

Q259095.name: Ralls County
Q259095.about: Ralls County is a county located in the northeastern portion of the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, the population was 10,355.

Q259253.name: Burayda
Q259253.about: Buraidah (Arabic: بريدة; also spelled as Buraydah)  is the capital and largest city of Al-Qassim Province in north-central Saudi Arabia. Q2678.name: Gomel
Q2678.about: Gomel (Russian: Гомель, IPA: [ˈɡomʲɪlʲ]) or Homyel (Belarusian: Гомель, romanized: Homieĺ, IPA: [ˈɣomʲelʲ]) is a city in south-eastern Belarus. It serves as the administrative centre of Gomel Region and Gomel District, though it is administratively separated from the district.

Q2684.name: Vladimir
Q2684.desc: city in the center of European Russia
Q2684.about: Vladimir (Russian: Влади́мир, IPA: [vlɐ'dʲimʲɪr] ) is a city and the administrative center of Vladimir Oblast, Russia, located on the Klyazma River, 200 kilometers (120 mi) east of Moscow. It is served by a railway and the M7 highway.

Q2746.name: Ryazan
Q2746.about: Ryazan (Russian: Рязань, IPA: [rʲɪˈzanʲ] ; also Riazan) is the largest city and the administrative center of Ryazan Oblast, Russia. The city is located on the banks of the Oka River in Central Russia, 196 km (122 mi) southeast of Moscow.

Q26895.name: Fort Bend County
Q26895.about:
Fort Bend County is a [[List of counties in Texas
|county]] in the U.S. state of Texas. The county was founded on December 29, 1837, and organized the next year.

Q26898.name: Terrell County
Q26898.about: Terrell County is a county in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 760, making it the seventh-least populous county in Texas, and the 37th-least populous county in the nation.

Q26906.name: Ciudad Bolívar
Q26906.about: Ciudad Bolívar (Spanish pronunciation: [sjuˈðað βoˈliβaɾ]; Spanish for "Bolivar City"), formerly known as Angostura and St. Thomas de Guyana, is the capital of Venezuela's southeastern Bolívar State.

Q26907.name: Rich County

Q27009.about: Trinity County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 13,602.

Q263742.name: Monroe County
Q263742.about: Monroe County is the southernmost county of the state of Florida. As of the 2020 census, the population was 82,874.

Q264206.img: 260801 Koriyama Station Koriyama Fukushima pref Japan05s3.jpg

Q2765.name: Gelsenkirchen
Q2765.about: Gelsenkirchen (; German: [ˌɡɛlzn̩ˈkɪʁçn̩] ; Westphalian: Gelsenkiärken) is the 26th-most populous city of Germany and the 12th-most populous in the state of North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 266,199 as of 2025. On the Emscher River (a tributary of the Rhine), it lies at the centre of the Ruhr area, the largest urban area of Germany, of which it is the fifth-largest city after Dortmund, Essen, Duisburg and Bochum.

Q2770.name: Tula

Q2770.about: Tula (Russian: Ту́ла, IPA: [ˈtulə]) is the largest city and the administrative center of Tula Oblast in Russia, located 193 kilometers (120 mi) south of Moscow. Tula is located in the northern Central Russian Upland on the banks of the Upa River, a tributary of the Oka.
Q2770.img: Tula asv2019-09 img04 Kremlin aerial view.jpg

Q2801.about: Bryansk (Russian: Брянск, IPA: [brʲansk] ) is a city and the administrative center of Bryansk Oblast, Russia, situated on the Desna River, 379 kilometers (235 mi) southwest of Moscow. It has a population of 379,152 at the 2021 census.

Q27021.name: Leon County

Q266438.name: Aurora

Q266438.about: Aurora (2021 population: 62,057) is a town in central York Region, in the Greater Toronto Area of Southern Ontario, Canada. It is located 48 km (29 mi) from Downtown Toronto, north of Richmond Hill partially situated on the Oak Ridges Moraine, and  surrounded by the Greenbelt.

Q266493.about: Wayne County is a county located in the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 19,779.

Q267164.about: Kingfisher County is a county located in the U.S. state of Oklahoma. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,184.

Q269164.about: Montgomery County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 28,114.

Q269960.name: Shobra Elkhema
Q269960.about: Shubra El Kheima, (Egyptian Arabic: شبرا الخيمة, lit. 'hamlet of the tent', IPA: [ˈʃobɾɑ lˈxeːmæ]) is the fourth-largest city in Egypt after Cairo, Giza and Alexandria. It is located in the Qalyubia Governorate along the northern edge of the Cairo Governorate.

Q270041.name: Al Hudaydah
Q270041.about: Hodeidah (Arabic: الْحُدَيْدَة, romanized: al-ḥudayda), also transliterated as Hodeda, Hodeida, Hudaida or al-Hudaydah, is the fourth-largest city in Yemen, its principal port on the Red Sea, and the capital of Hodeidah Governorate. As of 2023, it had an estimated population of 735,000.

Q25923.name: Longyearbyen
Q25923.desc: town and administrative centre in Svalbard, Norway
Q25923.about: Longyearbyen (Urban East Norwegian: [ˈlɔ̀ŋjɛrˌbyːən], locally [ˈlɔ̀ŋjɑrˌbyːən], 'Longyear town') is one of the world's northernmost settlements, with an estimated population of around 2,400–2,800, and is the capital and largest settled area of Svalbard. It stretches along the foot of the left bank of the Longyear Valley and on the shore of Adventfjorden, the short estuary leading into Isfjorden on the west coast of Spitsbergen, the island's broadest inlet.

Q26323.name: Jieyang
Q26323.about: Jieyang (simplified Chinese: 揭阳; traditional Chinese: 揭陽; pinyin: Jiēyáng; Chaozhou dialect: gig4 iên5; Jieyang dialect: gêg4 ion5) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Guangdong Province (Yuedong), People's Republic of China, part of the Chaoshan region. People in Jieyang speak Chaoshan Min distinct from neighbouring Yue speakers.

Q26339.name: Jersey City

Q27037.about: Duval County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 9,831.

Q27174.about: Najran (Arabic: نجران Najrān; IPA: [nad͡ʒ.raːn]), is a city in southwestern Saudi Arabia. It is the capital of Najran Province.

Q270810.name: Ichinomiya

The city is sometimes called Owarichinomiya to avoid confusion with other municipalities of the same name, including Ichinomiya (now part of the city of Toyokawa) and Ichinomiya in Chiba Prefecture.

Q270887.name: Lethbridge
Q270887.about: Lethbridge ( LETH-brij) is a city in the province of Alberta, Canada. With a population of 106,550 in the 2023 municipal census, Lethbridge became the fourth Alberta city to surpass 100,000 people.

Q271395.name: Scranton

Q273779.name: Saint-Louis

Q30771.desc: city in Jalna district in the Aurangabad Division, or Marathwada region, in Maharashtra, India
Q30771.about: Jalna  is a city in Jalna district, in the Aurangabad division, or Marathwada region, of the Indian state of Maharashtra. It was part of Hyderabad State as a tehsil of Aurangabad district, before Jalna district was formed effective 1 May 1981.

Q30951.name: Jalgaon
Q30951.desc: city in northern Maharashtra, India; administrative headquarters of the Jalgaon district
Q30951.about: Jalgaon () is a city in the state of Maharashtra, India. The city is located in North Maharashtra in the sub-region of Khandesh, and serves as the administrative headquarters of its namesake district, the Jalgaon district.

Q30958.name: Philipsburg
Q30958.about: Philipsburg (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈfilɪpsˌbʏr(ə)x]) is the main town and capital of Sint Maarten, a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It is located on the southern coast of Saint Martin island, between Great Bay and the Great Salt Pond.

Q30963.name: Kingston
Q30963.desc: capital city of Norfolk Island, Australia
Q30963.about: Kingston (Norf'k: Daun a'Taun) is the capital and main administrative centre of the Australian external territory of Norfolk Island.  The Norfolk Island Regional Council is based in Kingston.

Q30966.name: Alofi
Q30966.about: Alofi is the capital of the island nation of Niue. With a population of 610 in 2022, Alofi is the second-smallest national capital by population (after Ngerulmud, capital of Palau).

Q30970.name: Jamestown
Q30970.about: Jamestown is the capital city of the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha, located on the island of Saint Helena in the South Atlantic Ocean. It is also the historic main settlement of the island and is on its north-western coast.

Q317865.name: Joplin
Q317865.desc: city in southern Jasper County and northern Newton County, Missouri, USA
Q317865.about: Joplin is a city in Jasper and Newton counties in the U.S. state of Missouri. Most of the city lies in Jasper County, with the southern portion of Joplin extending into Newton County.

Q318156.name: Bahawalpur
Q318156.about: Bahawalpur (Urdu: بہاول پور; Urdu pronunciation: [bəɦɑːwəlˈpuːɾ]) is a city in Punjab, Pakistan. It is the 13th most populous city of Pakistan and 8th most populous of Punjab.

Q318306.name: Quelimane
Q318306.about: Quelimane (Portuguese pronunciation: [keliˈmani]) is a seaport in Mozambique. It is the administrative capital of the Zambezia Province and the province's largest city, and stands 25 km (16 mi) from the mouth of the Rio dos Bons Sinais (or "River of the Good Signs").

Q319476.name: Cumaná
Q319476.about: Cumaná (Spanish pronunciation: [kumaˈna]) is the capital city of Venezuela's Sucre State. It is located 402 kilometres (250 mi) east of Caracas.

Q2836049.name: Alhambra
Q2836049.desc: urban village of Phoenix, Arizona, United States
Q2836049.about: Alhambra is an urban village of Phoenix, Arizona.

Q2892151.name: Bawshar
Q2892151.about: Bawshar (Arabic: بوشر Bawšar) is one of the provinces of Muscat, in northeastern Oman. The province borders wilayat Muttrah in the east and wilayat Seeb in the west, it overlooks the Sea of Oman to the north.

Q2892339.name: Bayside
Q2892339.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, United States
Q2892339.about: Bayside is a neighborhood in the New York City borough of Queens. It is bounded by Whitestone to the northwest, the Long Island Sound and Little Neck Bay to the northeast, Douglaston to the east, and Fresh Meadows to the west.

Q2895017.name: Belmont Cragin
Q2895017.desc: human settlement in Cook County, Illinois, United States of America
Q2895017.about: Belmont Cragin is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, located on the Northwest Side of Chicago. It is designated Community Area 19, and is located 8 miles (13 km) northwest of the Loop.

Q2911280.name: Borough Park
Q2911280.about: Borough Park (also spelled Boro Park) is a neighborhood in the southwestern part of the borough of Brooklyn, in New York City. The neighborhood is bordered by Bensonhurst to the south, Dyker Heights to the southwest, Sunset Park to the west, Kensington and Green-Wood Cemetery to the north, Flatbush to the east, and Mapleton to the southeast.

Q2923029.name: Boyle Heights
Q2923029.desc: neighborhood east of Downtown Los Angeles on the East Side of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q2923029.about: Boyle Heights is a neighborhood in the Eastside of Los Angeles, California, United States, located east of the Los Angeles River. It is one of the city's most notable and historic Chicano/Mexican American communities, and is home to cultural landmarks like Mariachi Plaza and events like the annual Día de los Muertos celebrations.
Q2923029.img: Congregation Talmud Torah (Breed Street Shul), Boyle Heights, Los Angeles.JPG

Q2925063.name: Briarwood
Q2925063.desc: neighborhood of Queens in New York, United States
Q2925063.about: Briarwood is a middle-class neighborhood in the New York City borough of Queens. The neighborhood is roughly bounded by the Van Wyck Expressway to the west, Parsons Boulevard to the east, Union Turnpike to the north, and Hillside Avenue to the south.

Q2963317.name: Chicago Lawn
Q2963317.desc: human settlement in Cook County, Illinois, United States of America
Q2963317.about: Chicago Lawn is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago, Illinois. It is located on the southwest side of the city.

Q2978509.name: Muridke
Q2978509.about: Muridke (Punjabi / Urdu: مریدکے), is a city and headquarters of Muridke Tehsil of Sheikhupura District in Punjab, Pakistan. It is the 37th most populous city of Pakistan as well 25th of the province Punjab.

Q30980.name: Flying Fish Cove
Q30980.desc: capital city and main settlement of Australia's Christmas Island
Q30980.about: Flying Fish Cove (Chinese: 飞鱼湾, Malay: Pantai Ikan Terbang) is the capital city and main settlement of Christmas Island. Although it was originally named after the British survey-ship Flying Fish, many maps simply label it "The Settlement".

Q30985.name: Hamilton
Q30985.about: Hamilton is the capital city of the British Overseas Territory of Bermuda, and the main settlement of Pembroke Parish. A port city, Hamilton is Bermuda's financial and commercial centre, and a popular tourist destination.

Q30988.name: Hagåtña
Q30988.desc: capital city of Guam, United States
Q30988.about: Hagåtña, formerly Agana or Agaña, is a coastal village and the capital of the United States territory of Guam. The settlement is on the west coast of Guam at the mouth of the Hagåtña River.

Q30990.name: Plymouth
Q30990.desc: de jure capital of Montserrat, West Indies, now a ghost town
Q30990.about: Plymouth is a ghost town and the de jure capital of the island of Montserrat, an overseas territory of the United Kingdom located in the Leeward Island chain of the Lesser Antilles, West Indies. It is the only ghost town that is the capital of a political territory.

Q30994.name: The Valley
Q30994.desc: capital of the island of Anguilla
Q30994.about: The Valley is the capital of Anguilla, one of its fourteen districts, and the main town on the island. As of 2011, it had a population of 3,269.

Q31002.name: Mata-Utu
Q31002.about: Mata Utu (French pronunciation: [mata utu]; Wallisian: Matāʻutu, [mataːʔutu]) is the capital city of Wallis and Futuna, an overseas collectivity of France. It is located on the island of Uvéa (ʻUvea), in the district of Hahake, of which it is also the capital.
Q31002.img: Mata-Utu seen from a drone (Wallis and Futuna).png

Q31091.name: Glacier County
Q31091.about: Glacier County is located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,778.
Q31091.img: Glacier County Courthouse in Cut Bank, Montana.JPG

Q31350.name: Shibin Al Kawm
Q31350.about: Shibin El Kom (pronounced [ʃɪˈbiːn elˈkoːm], colloquially shortened to Shibin) is a city in Egypt's Nile Delta, and the capital of the Monufia Governorate.

Q31356.name: Mingora
Q31356.desc: city in Swat District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
Q31356.about: Mingora is the capital city of Swat District Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Located on the Swat River, it is the third largest city in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and the 26th largest in Pakistan.

Q31487.name: Kraków
Q31487.desc: capital city of Lesser Poland Voivodeship in southern Poland
Q31487.about: Kraków, officially the Royal Capital City of Kraków, is the second-largest and one of the oldest cities in Poland. Situated on the Vistula River in Lesser Poland Voivodeship, the city has a population of 816,614 (2025), with 1,428,363 people living in the Kraków metropolitan area.

Q2979739.name: Cloverdale
Q2979739.desc: district of Surrey in British Columbia, Canada
Q2979739.about: Cloverdale is a town centre in the city of Surrey, British Columbia, a southeastern suburb of Greater Vancouver, located just west of the City of Langley.  The town centre was initially founded as a small farm community in 1870 for its fertile land and temperate climate.

Q2984767.name: Arif Wala
Q2984767.about:
Ārifwāla  (Punjabi and Urdu: عارفوالا) is a city and headquarters of Arif Wala Tehsil of Pakpattan District in the Punjab province of Pakistan.
It is the 69th most populous city in Pakistan.

Q2991355.name: Nantucket County
Q2991355.about: Nantucket () is an island in Massachusetts, United States, about 30 miles (48 km) south of the Cape Cod peninsula. Together with the small islands of Tuckernuck and Muskeget, it constitutes the Town and County of Nantucket, a combined county/town government.

Q3021334.name: Deira
Q3021334.desc: area in the city of Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Q3021334.about: Deira (Arabic: دَيْرَة, romanized: Dayrah) is a historically significant district within the U.A.E. city of Dubai. It is located at the northern end of Dubai Creek.

Q3030757.name: Rogers Park
Q3030757.about: Rogers Park is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, located on the North Side of Chicago. Located 9 miles (14 km) north of the Loop along the shore of Lake Michigan, it features green spaces, early 20th-century architecture, live theater, bars, restaurants, and beaches.
Q3030757.img: Gerald Farinas Rogers Park Loyola University Chicago.jpg

Q3034709.name: Dombivli
Q3034709.about: Dombivli (pronunciation: [ɖoːmbiʋliː]) city located on the banks of Ulhas River in Thane district of Maharashtra, India. One of the busiest railway stations of the Central Railway, Dombivli railway station makes Dombivli an important transportation hub.

Q3046621.name: Eastvale
Q3046621.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q3046621.about: Eastvale is a city in northwestern Riverside County, California, in the Inland Empire region of Southern California. The area transitioned from a dairy farm enclave to a developed community starting in the 1990s and was incorporated on October 1, 2010.

Q3047557.name: Edgewater
Q3047557.desc: community area in Illinois, United States
Q3047557.about: Edgewater is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, located on the North Side of Chicago. It is 6 miles (10 km) north of the Loop.

Q3120966.name: Guntur
Q3120966.desc: city in Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q3120966.about: Guntur (), natively spelt as Gunturu, is a city in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh and the administrative headquarters of Guntur district. The city is part of the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region and is located on the Eastern Coastal Plains approximately 14 miles (23 km) south-west of the state capital Amaravati.

Q3123584.name: Karabağlar district
Q3123584.about: Karabağlar (Turkish: [kaˈɾabaːɫaɾ]) is a municipality and district of İzmir Province, Turkey. Its area is 89 km2, and its population is 479,338 (2022).
Q3123584.img: Izmir atatürk eğitim ve araştırma hastanesi - panoramio.jpg

Q3129405.name: Kalay
Q3129405.about: Kalay (Burmese: ကလေး), also known as Kale, is one of the largest towns in the Sagaing Region of Myanmar. It is located upstream from Mandalay and Monywa on the Myittha River, a tributary of the Chindwin River.

Q3135371.name: Tin Shui Wai
Q3135371.about: Tin Shui Wai New Town is a satellite town in the northwestern New Territories of Hong Kong. Originally a gei wai (基圍) fish pond area, it was developed in the 1980s as the second new town in Yuen Long District and the eighth in Hong Kong.

Q3154615.name: Irving Park
Q3154615.desc: human settlement in Cook County, Illinois, United States of America
Q3154615.about: Irving Park is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, and is located on the city's Northwest Side. It is bounded by the Chicago River on the east, the Milwaukee Road railroad tracks on the west, Addison Street on the south and Montrose Avenue on the north, west of Pulaski Road stretching to encompass the region between Belmont Avenue on the south and, roughly, Leland Avenue on the north.

Q28456847.name: Stonecrest
Q28456847.desc: city in DeKalb County, Georgia, United States of America
Q28456847.about: Stonecrest is a city in DeKalb County, Georgia, United States. The boundaries of the city generally lie in the far southeastern corner of the county, with a smaller portion just north of Interstate 20.

Q283368.name: Raqqa
Q283368.about: Raqqa (Arabic: ٱلرَّقَّة, romanized: ar-Raqqah, also al-Raḳḳa) is a city in Syria on the north bank of the Euphrates River, about 160 kilometres (99 miles) east of Aleppo. It is located 40 kilometres (25 miles) east of the Euphrates Dam, Syria's largest dam.

Q283657.name: Nicholas County
Q283657.desc: county in West Virginia, United States
Q283657.about: Nicholas County is a county located in the central region of U.S. state of West Virginia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 24,604.

Q2837.name: Kaluga
Q2837.desc: town and administrative center of Kaluga Oblast in central Russia
Q2837.about: Kaluga (Russian: Калу́га, IPA: [kɐˈɫuɡə] ) is a city and the administrative center of Kaluga Oblast, Russia. It stands on the Oka River 150 kilometers (93 mi) southwest of Moscow.

Q3043.name: Belmopan
Q3043.about: Belmopan () is the capital city of Belize. Its population in 2022 was 20,754.

Q284439.name: Martin County
Q284439.about: Martin County is a county in Minnesota, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,025.

Q284806.name: Wright County
Q284806.about: Wright County is a county located in the southern portion of the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, the population was 18,188.

Q284840.name: Latah County
Q284840.about: Latah County ( LAY-tə) is a county located in the north central region of the U.S. state of Idaho. As of the 2020 census, the population was 39,517.

Q285488.name: Iligan
Q285488.about: Iligan, officially the City of Iligan (Cebuano: Dakbayan sa Iligan; Bukid: Ciudad ta Iligan; Maranao: Bandar a Iligan; Filipino: Lungsod ng Iligan), is a highly urbanized city in the region of Northern Mindanao, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 368,132 people.

Q300577.name: Vellore
Q300577.about: Vellore (Tamil: ['ʋeːluːɾ] WAY-loor), also spelled Velur, is a city and municipal corporation in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the administrative headquarters of Vellore district.

Q302165.name: Hardin County
Q302165.about: Hardin County is a county located in the U.S. state of Tennessee. As of the 2020 census, the population was 26,831.

Q3130.name: Sydney
Q3130.desc: capital city of New South Wales, Australia
Q3130.about: Sydney is the capital of the state of New South Wales and the largest city in Australia. The metropolis surrounds Sydney Harbour and extends about 80 kilometres (50 mi) from the Pacific Ocean in the east to the Blue Mountains in the west, and about 80 kilometres (50 mi) from Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park and the Hawkesbury River in the north and north-west, to the Royal National Park and Macarthur in the south and south-west.

Q3141.name: Melbourne
Q3141.about: Melbourne ( MEL-bərn, locally [ˈmæɫbən] ; Boonwurrung/Woiwurrung: Narrm or Naarm)  is the capital and most populous city of the Australian state of Victoria and the second-most populous city in Australia. The city's name generally refers to a 9,993-square-kilometre (3,858 sq mi) area, comprising an urban agglomeration of 30 local government areas.
Q3141.img: Melbourne CBD and Ceremonial Avenue (in 2024) as seen from the rooftop of Shrine of Remembrance.jpg

Q3159.name: Kursk
Q3159.desc: city in the south-west of Russia
Q3159.about: Kursk (Russian: Курск, IPA: [ˈkursk]) is a city and the administrative center of Kursk Oblast, Russia, located at the confluence of the Kur, Tuskar, and Seym rivers. It has a population of 440,052 (2021 census).

Q302246.name: Ruiru
Q302246.about: Ruiru is a municipality and sub-county in Kiambu County, Kenya. It sits within the greater Nairobi Metropolitan region.

Q302852.name: Lincoln County
Q302852.about: Lincoln County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, its population was 50,395.

Q302912.name: Kakamega
Q302912.about: Kakamega is a town in western Kenya lying about 30 km north of the Equator. It is the headquarters of Kakamega County that has a population of 1,867,579 (2019 census).

Q302918.name: Talladega County
Q302918.about: Talladega County is one of sixty-seven counties in the U.S. state of Alabama, located in its east-central portion. As of the 2020 census, the population was 82,149.

Q303491.name: Sherman County
Q303491.about: Sherman County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,870, making it the second-least populous county in Oregon after nearby Wheeler.

Q2844.name: Brasília
Q2844.about: Brasília ( brə-ZIL-ee-ə; Brazilian Portuguese: [bɾaˈziliɐ, bɾaˈziljɐ] ) is the capital city of Brazil and the Federal District. Located in the Brazilian Highlands in the country's Central-West region, it was founded by President Juscelino Kubitschek on 21 April 1960, to replace Rio de Janeiro as the national capital.

Q2868.name: Lima
Q2868.desc: capital and largest city of Peru
Q2868.about: Lima is the capital and largest city of Peru, as well as a primate city. It is located in the valleys of the Chillón, Rímac and Lurín Rivers, in the desert zone of the central coastal part of the country, overlooking the Pacific Ocean.

Q2887.name: Santiago
Q2887.about: Santiago ( SAN-tee-AH-goh, US also  SAHN-; Spanish: [sanˈtjaɣo]), also known as Santiago de Chile (Spanish: [sanˈtjaɣo ðe ˈtʃile] ), is the capital and largest city of Chile and one of the largest cities in the Americas. Located in the Chilean Central Valley within the Santiago Basin, between the Andes to the east and the Chilean Coastal Range to the west, it anchors the Santiago Metropolitan Region and its conurbation of Greater Santiago, which comprises more than forty communes and concentrates over a third of the national population and around 45% of Chile's GDP. Most of the city lies between 500 and 650 meters (1,640 and 2,130 ft) above sea level, with recent urban growth extending into the Andean foothills.
Q2887.img: Santiago de Chile, Desde Cerro San Cristóbal (cropped).jpg

Q3114.name: Canberra
Q3114.about: Canberra (  KAN-brə; Ngunawal: Kanbarra) is the capital city of Australia and the largest population centre in the Australian Capital Territory. With an estimated population of 484,630 as of 2025, Canberra is Australia's largest inland city and the eighth-largest Australian city by population.

Q3118.name: Oryol
Q3118.desc: town and administrative center of Oryol Oblast in central Russia
Q3118.about: Oryol (Russian: Орёл, IPA: [ɐˈrʲɵl] , lit. 'eagle'), also transliterated as Orel or Oriol, is a city and the administrative center of Oryol Oblast, Russia, situated on the Oka River, approximately 368 kilometers (229 mi) south-southwest of Moscow. It is part of the Central Federal District, as well as the Central Economic Region.
Q3118.img: Epiphany Cathedral (even without Ivan the Terrible) (29711780983).jpg

Q290157.name: Maries County
Q290157.about: Maries County ( MAIR-iz) is a county located in the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, its population was 8,432.

Q290356.name: San Pedro
Q290356.desc: neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q290356.about: San Pedro ( san PEE-droh; Spanish for 'Saint Peter') is a neighborhood located within the South Bay and Harbor region of the city of Los Angeles, California, United States. Formerly a separate city, it consolidated with Los Angeles in 1909.

Q295787.name: Dare County
Q295787.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q295787.about: Dare County is the easternmost county in the U.S. state of North Carolina and the southernmost county in the Hampton Roads Combined Statistical Area (CSA). As of the 2020 census, the population was 36,915.

Q2841.name: Bogotá
Q2841.about: Bogotá (, also UK: , US: , Spanish pronunciation: [boɣoˈta] ) is the capital and largest city of Colombia. The city is administered as the Capital District, as well as the capital of, though not politically part of, the surrounding department of Cundinamarca.

Q3070.name: San José
Q3070.about: San José (Spanish: [saŋ xoˈse]; meaning "Saint Joseph") is the capital and largest city of Costa Rica, and the capital of San José Province. It is in the center of the country, in the mid-west of the Central Valley.
Q3070.img: Cityscape of San José, Costa Rica (253552473).jpg

Q3110.name: San Salvador
Q3110.about: San Salvador (Spanish pronunciation: [san salβaˈðoɾ]) is the capital and largest city of El Salvador and of its eponymous department. It is the country's largest agglomeration, serving as the country's political, cultural, educational and financial center.

Q285599.name: Albany
Q285599.desc: city in and county seat of Dougherty County, Georgia, United States
Q285599.about: Albany ( awl-BIN-ee) is a city in the U.S. state of Georgia. Located on the Flint River, it is the county seat of Dougherty County, and is the sole incorporated city in that county.

Q285625.name: Augusta County
Q285625.about: Augusta County is a county in the Shenandoah Valley on the western edge of the Commonwealth of Virginia in the United States. The second-largest county of Virginia by total area, it completely surrounds the independent cities of Staunton and Waynesboro.

Q288196.name: Ed Daein
Q288196.desc: capital of East Darfur in Sudan
Q288196.about: Ed Daein (also spelt Ad Du'ayn, Ad Da'en or El Da'ein; Arabic: الضعين) is a city located in southwestern Sudan. It lies about 831 km from the capital Khartoum and has population of about 300,000 people.

Q288592.name: Geauga County
Q288592.about: Geauga County ( jee-AW-gə) is a county located in the northeast portion of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 95,397.

Q288606.name: Lake County
Q288606.about: Lake County is a county in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 232,603.
Q288606.img: Lake County Courthouse, Painesville, rear and western side.jpg

Q289051.name: Jiaozhou City
Q289051.about: Jiaozhou (simplified Chinese: 胶州; traditional Chinese: 膠州; pinyin: Jiāozhōu), formerly Jiaoxian or Jiao County, is a county-level city of Qingdao sub-provincial municipality, Shandong Province, China. It gained its current county-level city designation in 1987.

Q289661.name: Rialto
Q289661.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q289661.about:
Rialto is a city in the Inland Empire region of San Bernardino County, California, United States, 56 miles east of Los Angeles, near the Cajon Pass, Interstate 15, Interstate 10, State Route 210 and Metrolink routes.
Its population was 104,026 as of the 2020 census, up from 99,171 at the 2010 census.

Q289693.name: Sharjah
Q289693.desc: city in the United Arab Emirates
Q289693.about: Sharjah (; Arabic: ٱلشَّارقَة aš-Šāriqah, Gulf Arabic: aš-Šārja) is a major port city and the third-most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, after Dubai and Abu Dhabi. It is the capital of the Emirate of Sharjah and forms part of the Dubai-Sharjah-Ajman metropolitan area.

Q2900.name: Quito
Q2900.about: Quito (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkito] ; Quechua: Kitu), officially San Francisco de Quito, is the capital of Ecuador, and the province of Pichincha. It is the largest city in Pichincha and the second-largest city in Ecuador, with an estimated population of 1.7 million in the city and 2.8 million in its metropolitan area.

Q2907.name: Sucre
Q2907.about: Sucre (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsukɾe]; Quechua: Chuqichaka; Aymara: Sukri; Guarani: Sucre), officially La Ilustre y Heroica Sucre ("The Illustrious and Heroic Sucre") is the de jure capital city of Bolivia, the capital of the Chuquisaca Department and the sixth most populous city in Bolivia. Located in the south-central part of the country, Sucre lies at an elevation of 2,790 m (9,150 ft), making it the second-highest capital city in the world after Quito.

Q2933.name: Asunción
Q2933.about: Asunción (English: , Spanish: [asunˈsjon] ; Guarani: Paraguay) is the capital and the largest city of Paraguay. The city lies on the eastern bank of the Paraguay River,  immediately north northeast of the confluence where it is joined by the Pilcomayo River.

Q3183.name: Perth
Q3183.desc: capital city of Western Australia, Australia
Q3183.about: Perth (Nyungar: Boorloo) is the capital and largest city of the state of Western Australia. It is the fourth-most-populous city in Australia, with a population of over 2.2 million in the city and 2.3 million within Greater Perth as of 2023.

Q28321.name: Billings County
Q28321.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28321.about: Billings County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 945, and was estimated to be 1,071 in 2025, making it the second-least populous county in North Dakota.

Q28488.name: Dickey County
Q28488.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28488.about: Dickey County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,999 and was estimated to be 4,895 in 2025.

Q303794.name: Clovis
Q303794.desc: city in Fresno County, California, United States
Q303794.about: Clovis is a city in Fresno County, California, United States. It was established in 1890 as a freight stop for the San Joaquin Valley Railroad by a group of Fresno businessmen and Michigan railroad speculator Marcus Pollasky.

Q304065.name: Lee County
Q304065.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q304065.about: Lee County is a county located in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, its population was 16,531, making it the fifth-least populous county in South Carolina.

Q304289.name: Miami County
Q304289.about: Miami County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the population was 35,962.

Q304671.name: Washington County
Q304671.about: Washington County is a county in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 28,182.

Q304791.name: Skamania County
Q304791.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q304791.about: Skamania County ( skə-MAY-nee-ə) is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 12,036.

Q304848.name: Daqing
Q304848.about: Daqing (simplified Chinese: 大庆; traditional Chinese: 大慶; pinyin: Dàqìng) is a prefecture-level city in the west of Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China. The name literally means "Great Celebration" and refers to the tenth anniversary of the PRC. Daqing is known as the "Oil Capital of China" and has experienced a phenomenal boom since oil was discovered at the Daqing Oil Field in 1959.

Q30651.name: Kadapa
Q30651.desc: city in YSR district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q30651.about: Kadapa is a city in the southern part of Andhra Pradesh, India. It is located in the Rayalaseema region, and is the district headquarters of YSR Kadapa district.

Q312731.name: Pueblo County
Q312731.about: Pueblo County ( or  ) is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 168,162.

Q312734.name: Routt County
Q312734.about: Routt County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 24,829.

Q312737.name: Rio Grande County
Q312737.about: Rio Grande County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 11,539.

Q3001.name: Paramaribo
Q3001.about: Paramaribo, locally nicknamed Foto, is the capital and largest city of Suriname, located on the banks of the Suriname River in the Paramaribo District. Paramaribo has a population of roughly 252,581 people as of the 2025 estimate, almost half of Suriname's population.
Q3001.img: Waterkant Paramaribo with the Unesco Heritage Buildings.jpg

Q3037.name: Kathmandu
Q3037.about: Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal, situated in the central part of the country within the Kathmandu Valley. The city is in Kathmandu District.

Q28496.name: Williams County
Q28496.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28496.about: Williams County is located on the western border of the U.S. state of North Dakota, next to Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 40,950, and was estimated to be 41,767 in 2025, making it the fifth-most populous county in North Dakota.

Q28499.name: Morton County
Q28499.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28499.about: Morton County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 33,291, and was estimated to be 34,601 in 2025, making it the sixth-most populous county in North Dakota.

Q28503.name: Dunn County
Q28503.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28503.about: Dunn County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,095, and was estimated to be 4,058 in 2025.

Q28515.name: Springfield
Q28515.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Illinois and county seat of Sangamon County
Q28515.about: Springfield is the capital city of the U.S. state of Illinois and the county seat of Sangamon County. Its population was 114,394 at the 2020 United States census, making it the state's seventh-most populous city, the second-most populous outside of the Chicago metropolitan area (after Rockford) and the most populous in Central Illinois.

Q28523.name: Cavalier County
Q28523.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q28523.about: Cavalier County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. It is south of the Canada–US border with Manitoba.

Q306343.name: Abbeville County
Q306343.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q306343.about: Abbeville County is a county located in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, its population was 24,295.

Q309475.name: El-Obeid
Q309475.desc: city and capital of North Kurdufan, Sudan
Q309475.about: El Obeid (Arabic: الأُبَيِّض, romanized: al-ʔubayyiḍ, lit. 'the white' ), also romanized as Al-Ubayyid, is the capital of the state of North Kordofan, in Sudan. It is located within the Sheikan locality and under the former administrative structure within Sheikan District.

Q310114.name: Khartoum North
Q310114.about: Khartoum North, or Khartoum Bahri or simply Bahri (Arabic: الخرطوم بحري, romanized: al-Kharṭūm Baḥrī), is a city in Khartoum State, lying to the north of Khartoum city, the capital of Sudan. It has a population of 1,012,211 people, making it the third-largest city proper in Sudan, behind the neighbouring cities of Omdurman and Khartoum.

Q310117.name: Minya
Q310117.about: Minya (Arabic: المنيا  [elˈmenjæ]) is the capital of the Minya Governorate in Upper Egypt. It is located approximately 245 km (152 mi) south of Cairo on the western bank of the Nile River, which flows north through the city.

Q310350.name: Al Hoceima
Q310350.desc: Moroccan town located in the Central Rif, beetween Ibaqoyen region and Ayt Ouriarhel region
Q310350.about: Al Hoceima is a city in the north of Morocco, on the northern edge of the Rif Mountains and on the Mediterranean coast. It is the capital city of the Al Hoceima Province.

Q310772.name: Mukalla
Q310772.about: Mukalla, officially the Mukalla City District, is a seaport and the capital city district of Yemen's largest governorate, Hadhramaut. The city is in the southern part of the Arabian Peninsula on the Gulf of Aden, on the shores of the Arabian Sea, about 480 kilometres (300 miles) east of Aden.

Q29445.name: Juneau
Q29445.desc: consolidated city-borough and capital of the U.S. state of Alaska
Q29445.about: Juneau (  JOO-noh; Tlingit: Dzántik'i Héeni [ˈtsʌ́ntʰɪ̀kʼɪ̀ ˈhíːnɪ̀] transl. Base of the Flounder's River), officially the City and Borough of Juneau, is the capital of the U.S. state of Alaska, located along the Gastineau Channel in Southeast Alaska. Juneau was named the capital of Alaska in 1906, when the government of what was then the District of Alaska was moved from Sitka as dictated by the U.S. Congress in 1900.

Q29888.name: Aswan
Q29888.about: Aswan is a city in Upper Egypt and the capital of the Aswan Governorate. The city of Aswan is among the oldest continuously inhabited cities, with its recorded history spanning over 2,600 years.

Q29962.name: Asyut
Q29962.about: Asyut (Asyūṭ  pronounced [ʔɑsˈjuːtˤ]) is a city in Egypt. Located in Upper Egypt, it is the capital of the modern Asyut Governorate in Egypt.

Q30002.name: Chengdu
Q30002.about: Chengdu is the capital city of the Chinese province of Sichuan. With a population of 20,937,757 at the 2020 census, it is the country's fourth most populous city and the only city with a population of over 20 million apart from provincial-level municipalities.

Q30340.name: Zhengzhou
Q30340.about: Zhengzhou, previously romanized as Chengchow, is the capital and the largest city of Henan Province, China. With a population of 12.6 million people in 2021, it is China's 11th largest city by population.
Q30340.img: 20220812 Central Business District of Zhengdong New Area.jpg

Q312455.name: Conejos County
Q312455.about: Conejos County (Spanish for "rabbits") is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,461.

Q312470.about: Logan County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,528.

Q312473.about: Mineral County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 865, making it the third-least populous county in Colorado, behind San Juan County and Hinsdale County.

Q312475.about: Pitkin County is a county in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,358.

Q312723.name: El Mahalla El Kubra
Q312723.about: El Mahalla El Kubra (Arabic: المحلة الكبرى, Egyptian Arabic: [elmæˈħællæ lˈkobɾɑ]) – commonly shortened to El Maḥalla – is the largest city of the Gharbia Governorate and in the Nile Delta, with a population of 550,000 as of 2024. It is a large industrial and agricultural city in Egypt, located in the middle of the Nile Delta on the western bank of the Damietta Branch tributary.

Q29015.name: Zigong
Q29015.about: Zigong (Chinese: 自贡, tsih-kung), formed by the merger of the two former towns of Ziliujing (Tzuliuching, literally "self-flow well") and Gongjing (Kungching, literally "offering well"), is a prefecture-level city in Sichuan, Southwestern China.

Q29118.name: Burke County
Q29118.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q29118.about: Burke County is a county on the north edge of the U.S. state of North Dakota, adjacent to the south line of Canada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 2,201, and was estimated to be 2,132 in 2025.

Q29124.name: Bottineau County
Q29124.desc: county in North Dakota, United States
Q29124.about: Bottineau County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 6,379.

Q29364.name: Montgomery
Q29364.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Alabama and seat of Montgomery County
Q29364.about: Montgomery is the capital city of the U.S. state of Alabama and the county seat of Montgomery County. It was named for Continental Army Major-General Richard Montgomery and stands beside the Alabama River on the Gulf Coastal Plain.
Q29364.img: Aerial view of Montgomery, Alabama LCCN2011646683.jpg

Q29422.name: Boca Raton
Q29422.desc: city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q29422.about: Boca Raton ( BOH-kə rə-TOHN; Spanish: Boca Ratón [ˈboka raˈton]) is a city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States. The population was 97,422 in the 2020 census, and it ranked as the 23rd-largest city in Florida in 2022.

Q311904.name: Arapahoe County
Q311904.about: Arapahoe County ( ə-RAP-ə-hoh) is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, its population was 655,070, making it the third-most populous county in Colorado.

Q311908.about: Cheyenne County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. The county population was 1,748 at 2020 census.

Q312453.about: Summit County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 31,055, and was estimated to be 30,882 in 2024.
