Q28919032.desc: unincorporated community in Waterford Township, Camden County, New Jersey
Q28919032.about: Gloucester Township is a township in Camden County in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the township was the state's 22nd-most-populous municipality, with a population of 66,034, an increase of 1,400 (+2.2%) from the 2010 census count of 64,634, which in turn reflected an increase of 284 (+0.4%) from the 64,350 counted in the 2000 census.

Q31811295.name: Milford
Q31811295.desc: balance of Milford, Connecticut, United States
Q31811295.about: Milford is a coastal city in New Haven County, Connecticut, United States, between New Haven and Bridgeport. The population was 50,558 at the 2020 United States Census.

Q28587.name: Hamadan
Q28587.about: Hamadan is a mountainous city in western Iran. It is located in the Central District of Hamadan County in Hamadan province, serving as the capital of the province, county, and district.
Q28587.img: Iran - Hamedan view from Alvand Mountain - panoramio.jpg

Q28729.name: Kozhikode
Q28729.about: Kozhikode (pronounced [koːɻikːoːɖɨ̆] ), also known as Calicut, is a historic city along the Malabar Coast in the state of Kerala in India. The city is also known as the City of Spices.

Q28848.name: Saint Paul
Q28848.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Minnesota and seat of Ramsey County
Q28848.about: Saint Paul (often abbreviated to St. Paul) is the capital city of the U.S. state of Minnesota and the county seat of Ramsey County.

Q28979.name: Jixi
Q28979.about: Jixi (simplified Chinese: 鸡西; traditional Chinese: 雞西; pinyin: Jīxī) is a city in southeastern Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China. At the 2020 census, 1,502,060 people resided within its administrative area of 22,488.47 square kilometres (8,682.85 sq mi) and 560,118 in its built-up (or metro) area made up of 3 out of 6 urban districts (including Jiguan, Hengshan and Chengzihe).
Q28979.img: The Tengfei Overpass in Jixi City.jpg

Q28994.name: Zunyi
Q28994.about: Zunyi (simplified Chinese: 遵义; traditional Chinese: 遵義; pinyin: Zūnyì) is a prefecture-level city in northern Guizhou province, People's Republic of China, situated between the provincial capital Guiyang to the south and Chongqing to the north, also bordering Sichuan to the northwest. Along with Guiyang and Liupanshui, it is one of the most important cities of the province.

Q28996.name: Jinzhou
Q28996.desc: prefecture-level city in Liaoning, People's Republic of China
Q28996.about: Jinzhou (, simplified Chinese: 锦州; traditional Chinese: 錦州; pinyin: Jǐnzhōu), formerly Chinchow, is a coastal prefecture-level city in central-west Liaoning province, China. It is a geographically strategic city located in the Liaoxi Corridor, which connects most of the land transports between North China and Northeast China, and is the economic center of western Liaoning.

Q29003.name: Jiamusi
Q29003.about: Jiamusi (Manchu: ᡤᡳᠶᠠᠮᡠᠰᡳ Chinese: 佳木斯; pinyin: Jiāmùsī [ˌtɕiá.mû.sí]; Russian: Цзямусы; formerly Kiamusze) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China. Located along the middle and lower reaches of the Songhua River, it faces Russia's Khabarovsk Krai across the Ussuri River and the Heilongjiang.

Q311199.name: Al Qadarif
Q311199.desc: capital of the state of Al Qadarif, Sudan
Q311199.about: El-Gadarif (Arabic: القضارف Al Qaḍārif), also spelt Gedaref or Gedarif, is the capital of the state of Al Qadarif in Sudan. It lies on the road that connects Khartoum with Gallabat on the Ethiopian border, about 410 kilometres (250 mi) from the capital.

Q311204.name: Al-Fashir
Q311204.desc: capital city of North Darfur, Sudan
Q311204.about: El Fasher (also alternatively rendered as Al-Fashir; Arabic: الفاشر, romanized: al-Fāshir) is a city in western Sudan. It serves as the capital of the North Darfur State, is located in the Darfur region of Sudan, and is 195 kilometres (121 mi) northeast of Nyala.

Q311272.name: Al Rayyan Municipality
Q311272.about: Al Rayyan (Arabic: الريان; also spelled Ar Rayyan) is the third-largest municipality in Qatar. Its primary settlement is the city of the same name, which occupies the entire eastern section and is a part of the Doha Metropolitan Area.
Q311272.img: Aerial view of Aspetar Hospital in Baaya.jpg

Q311321.name: Hasakah
Q311321.desc: capital city of Hasakah Governorate in Syria
Q311321.about: Hasakah is a city in northeastern Syria and the capital of the Hasakah Governorate. With a 2023 estimated population of 422,445, Hasakah is populated by Arabs, Kurds, Assyrians and a smaller number of Armenians and Chechens.

Q311700.name: Witbank
Q311700.about: Witbank (), officially eMalahleni, is a city located on the Highveld of Mpumalanga, South Africa, within the Emalahleni Local Municipality. The name Witbank is Afrikaans for "white ridge", and is named after a white sandstone outcrop where wagon transport drivers rested.

Q311894.name: Archuleta County
Q311894.about: Archuleta County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,359.

Q311897.name: Costilla County
Q311897.about: Costilla County (Spanish for "rib") is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 3,499.

Q311901.name: Alamosa County
Q311901.about: Alamosa County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 16,376.

Q3306.name: Panama City
Q3306.about: Panama City, also known as Panama, is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Panama. It has a total population of 410,354 in the city proper and 1,086,990 in the Panamá District, which includes the outer corregimientos of the city.
Q3306.img: Panorámica nocturna de la ciudad de Panamá.jpg

Q3323.name: Belgorod
Q3323.about: Belgorod (Russian: Белгород, pronounced [ˈbʲelɡərət]) is a city that serves as the administrative center of Belgorod Oblast, Russia, located on the Seversky Donets River, approximately 40 kilometers (25 mi) north of the border with Ukraine. It has a population of 339,978 (2021 census).

Q320704.name: Benin City
Q320704.desc: capital city of Edo State, Nigeria
Q320704.about: Benin City () is the capital and largest city of Edo State, southern Nigeria. It is the fourth-largest city in Nigeria according to the 2006 census, after Lagos, Kano, and Ibadan.

Q3257855.name: Logan Square
Q3257855.desc: community area in Chicago, Illinois, United States
Q3257855.about:
Logan Square is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States.
The Logan Square neighborhood, located within the Logan Square community area, is centered on the public square that serves as its namesake, located at the three-way intersection of Milwaukee Avenue, Logan Boulevard and Kedzie Boulevard.

Q3267838.name: Woodlands station
Q3267838.about: Woodlands MRT station is a Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) interchange station on the North–South (NSL) and Thomson–East Coast (TEL) lines in Singapore. Located in Woodlands, the MRT station was the first to feature an underground bus interchange underneath the NSL station.

Q3294005.name: Town 'n' Country
Q3294005.desc: census-designated place in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States
Q3294005.about: Town 'n' Country is a census-designated place (CDP) in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States. The population was 85,951 at the 2020 census.

Q3294011.name: Pine Hills
Q3294011.desc: census-designated place in Orange County, Florida, United States
Q3294011.about: Pine Hills is a census-designated place (CDP) and unincorporated subdivision in Orange County, Florida, United States, west of Orlando. Per the 2020 U.S. census, the population was 66,111.

Q3294366.name: East New York
Q3294366.desc: residential neighborhood in the eastern section of the borough of Brooklyn in New York City, United States
Q3294366.about: East New York is a residential neighborhood in the eastern section of the New York City borough of Brooklyn. Its boundaries, starting from the north and moving clockwise, are roughly the Cemetery Belt and the Queens borough line to the north; the Queens borough line to the east; Jamaica Bay to the south; the New York City Subway's BMT Canarsie Line, the Bay Ridge Branch railroad tracks, and Van Sinderen Avenue to the west.

Q3297273.name: Masina
Q3297273.desc: is a commune in the east of the city of Kinshasa, located between Pool Malebo to the north and Boulevard Lumumba to the south.
Q3297273.about:
Masina is a municipality (commune) in the Tshangu District of Kinshasa, the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
It is bordered by the Pool Malebo in the north and Boulevard Lumbumba to the south.

Q3300932.name: Brentwood
Q3300932.desc: census-designated place in Suffolk County, New York, United States
Q3300932.about: Brentwood is a hamlet in the Town of Islip in Suffolk County, on Long Island, in New York, United States. The population was 62,387 at the 2020 Census, making it the most populous CDP in Suffolk County and on all of Long Island outside of New York City.

Q3302051.name: Division No. 5
Q3302051.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3302051.about: Census Division No. 5 is a Statistics Canada statistical division composed of the areas of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador called Humber Valley, Bay of Islands, and White Bay.

Q3302090.name: Division No. 4
Q3302090.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3302090.about: Census Division No. 4 is a Statistics Canada statistical division that comprises the areas of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador called St.

Q3303397.name: Division No. 1
Q3303397.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3303397.about: Division 1, Newfoundland and Labrador is a census division covering the entire Avalon Peninsula including the Isthmus of Avalon of the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador. Like all census divisions in Newfoundland and Labrador, but unlike the census divisions of some other provinces, the division exists only as a statistical division for census data, and is not a political entity.

Q3303457.name: Division No. 8
Q3303457.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3303457.about: Division No. 8 is a census division on the north coast of the island of Newfoundland in the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada.

Q3303482.name: Division No. 10
Q3303482.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3303482.about: Census Division No. 10 of Newfoundland and Labrador is composed of the Labrador region of the province, excluding Nunatsiavut.

Q3314958.name: Minganie—Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent
Q3314958.about: Minganie—Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent is a census division of Quebec, with geographical code 98.  It consists of the regional county municipalities of Minganie and Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent.

Q3320803.name: Ikare
Q3320803.about:
Ikare is a city in the northern senatorial part of Ondo State, Nigeria.
Ìkàré-Àkókó (Ikare for short), city in southwestern Nigeria, is located in the Northern Senatorial District of Ondo State.

Q3321415.name: Chak Jhumra
Q3321415.about: Chak Jhumra  (Punjabi: چک جُھمرہ) is a town and railway junction located in Punjab, Pakistan. The town is situated approximately 21 kilometres (13 mi) northeast of Faisalabad on Faisalabad-Sangla Hill Road.

Q3338563.name: Division No. 9
Q3338563.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3338563.about: Census Division No. 9 is composed of the area of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador called the Northern Peninsula.

Q3338566.name: Division No. 6
Q3338566.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3338566.about: Division No. 6 is a census division in the central part of the island of Newfoundland in the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada.

Q3343560.name: North Delta
Q3343560.desc: middle-class bedroom community situated in the Lower Mainland, in British Columbia, Canada
Q3343560.about: North Delta (founded as Annieville) is a largely middle-class commuter town situated in the Lower Mainland, of British Columbia, Canada. The community is the most populous of the three communities  (North Delta, Ladner, and Tsawwassen) that make up the City of Delta.

Q3356503.name: Orléans
Q3356503.desc: administrative sector and neighbourhood in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
Q3356503.about:
Orleans (; French: [ɔʁleɑ̃]; officially and in French Orléans) is a satellite suburban community in the east end of Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, located along the Ottawa River about 16 km (10 mi) from Downtown Ottawa.
Based on the adjusted boundary definition used for Orléans, the community had a population of 139,309 in the 2021 Canadian Census.

Q3357747.name: Ottawa South
Q3357747.desc: federal electoral district in Ontario, Canada (Since 1988)
Q3357747.about: Ottawa South (French: Ottawa-Sud) is a federal electoral district in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. It is represented in the House of Commons of Canada by David McGuinty, brother of former Premier of Ontario and Ottawa South MPP Dalton McGuinty.

Q3452134.name: Levittown
Q3452134.desc: census-designated place in Nassau County, New York, United States
Q3452134.about: Levittown is a hamlet and census-designated place (CDP) in the Town of Hempstead in Nassau County, on Long Island, in New York. It is a suburb of New York City, located halfway between the villages of Hempstead and Farmingdale.

Q3452472.name: Irondequoit
Q3452472.desc: town in Monroe County, New York, United States
Q3452472.about: Irondequoit () is a town (and census-designated place) in Monroe County, New York, United States. As of the 2020 census, the coterminous town-CDP had a population of 51,043.

Q3461383.name: Cheektowaga
Q3461383.desc: suburban community and census-designated place (CDP) in Erie County, New York, USA
Q3461383.about: Cheektowaga is a suburban community and census-designated place (CDP) in Erie County, New York, United States. The population was 75,178 at the 2010 census, making it the most populous census-designated place in New York.

Q3476253.name: Sherwood Park
Q3476253.about: Sherwood Park is a large suburban hamlet in Alberta, Canada within Strathcona County that is recognized as an urban service area. It is adjacent to the City of Edmonton's eastern boundary.

Q3476276.name: Menifee
Q3476276.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q3476276.about: Menifee is a city in Riverside County, California, United States, and is part of the Inland Empire. Named after a local miner, Luther Menifee Wilson, it was settled in the 19th century, and incorporated as a city in 2008.

Q3492258.name: South Lawndale
Q3492258.desc: community area in Chicago, Illinois, United States
Q3492258.about: South Lawndale is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, located on the West Side of Chicago. Over 80% of the residents are of Mexican descent and the community is home to the largest foreign-born Mexican population in Chicago.

Q3492273.name: South Shore
Q3492273.about: South Shore is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States. Located on the city's South Side, the area is named for its location along the city's southern lakefront.

Q3495356.name: Sapele
Q3495356.desc: Local government areas in Delta State,in Nigeria.
Q3495356.about:
Sapele is a city and one of the Local Government Areas of Delta State, Nigeria.
Sapele city [səpā´lē]  (2016 pop.

Q3506894.name: Sylmar
Q3506894.desc: neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q3506894.about: Sylmar is a suburban neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley and the northernmost neighborhood within the city of Los Angeles, California, United States. Historically known for its profusion of sylvan olive orchards, Sylmar can trace this back to the 18th century and the founding of the San Fernando Mission.

Q3509545.name: Agege
Q3509545.desc: local government area in Lagos State, Nigeria
Q3509545.about: Agege is a large city and local government area in the Ikeja Division of Lagos State, Nigeria, it is part of Greater Metropolitan Lagos. Until 1927, Agege was the capital of Ikeja Division.

Q3509580.name: Alimosho
Q3509580.about:
Alimosho is a neighborhood of Lagos and a Local Government Area in Lagos State, Nigeria with the largest population of about 4,082,900 which is according to Population [2019] – Projection The 2006 Census says the population was 1,288,714 (but the Lagos State Government argued that the population as at 2006 within the LGA was more than 2 million residents).
It has now been subdivided between several Local Community Development Areas (LCDA).

Q3525848.name: Thornhill
Q3525848.desc: neighbourhood in the Greater Toronto Area
Q3525848.about: Thornhill is a suburban district in the Regional Municipality of York in Ontario, Canada.  The western portion of Thornhill is within the City of Vaughan  and its eastern portion is within the City of Markham, with Yonge Street forming the boundary between Vaughan and Markham.

Q3519.name: Bari
Q3519.desc: Italian city, capital of the Apulia region
Q3519.about: Bari ( BAR-ee; Italian: [ˈbaːri] ; Barese: Bare [ˈbæːrə]; Latin: Barium) is the capital city of the Metropolitan City of Bari and of the region of Apulia, on the Adriatic Sea in southern Italy. It is one of the most important economic centres of mainland southern Italy.

Q3426.name: Voronezh
Q3426.desc: capital city of Voronezh Oblast in central Russia
Q3426.about: Voronezh is a city and the administrative centre of Voronezh Oblast in southwestern Russia, straddling the Voronezh River 12 kilometers (7.5 mi) from where it flows into the Don River. The city sits on the Southeastern Railway, which connects western Russia with the Urals and Siberia, the Caucasus and Ukraine, and the M4 highway (Moscow–Voronezh–Rostov-on-Don–Novorossiysk).

Q319740.name: Kawagoe
Q319740.about: Kawagoe (川越市, Kawagoe-shi) is a city in Saitama Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 February 2021, the city had an estimated population of 353,214 in 162,210 households and a population density of 3200 persons per km2.
Q319740.img: Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine, Kawagoe City; December 2019 (01).jpg

Q319743.name: Kashiwa
Q319743.about: Kashiwa (柏市, Kashiwa-shi) is a city located in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. As of May 1, 2024, the city had an estimated population of  435,578 in 199,926 households and a population density of 3800 persons per km2.

Q319804.name: Sanya
Q319804.about: Sanya is a resort city and the southernmost city on Hainan Island, and one of the four prefecture-level cities of Hainan Province in South China. It is a major tourist destination with several large scale resorts and contains the Sanya coral reef, a national protected nature reserve spanning 4000 hectares.

Q320514.name: Lancaster
Q320514.desc: city in central Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, United States
Q320514.about: Lancaster is a city in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, United States, and its county seat. With a population of 58,039 at the 2020 census, it is the eighth-most populous city in the state.

Q3490.name: Lipetsk
Q3490.desc: city in the center of European Russia
Q3490.about: Lipetsk (Russian: Ли́пецк, IPA: [ˈlʲipʲɪtsk]), also romanized as Lipeck, is a city and the administrative center of Lipetsk Oblast, Russia, located on the banks of the Voronezh River in the Don basin, 438 kilometers (272 mi) southeast of Moscow.

Q33408.name: Bắc Ninh
Q33408.about: Bắc Ninh (Vietnamese pronunciation: [ɓɐ̌k˧˥ nīɲ]) is a centrally-governed city in Vietnam, located in the Red River Delta region. It borders Hanoi, Hải Phòng, Quảng Ninh cities, Hưng Yên province, Lạng Sơn province, and Thái Nguyên province.

Q33412.name: Hubli
Q33412.about: Hubli, officially Hubballi, is a city in the Indian state of Karnataka. The twin cities Hubli–Dharwad form the second largest municipality and urban agglomeration of Karnataka in terms of area and population and the largest city in North Karnataka.
Q33412.img: Panoramic View of Hubli City from Nrupatunga Hill.jpg

Q33486.name: Hartford
Q33486.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Connecticut, located in Hartford County and the Capitol Planning Region
Q33486.about: Hartford is the capital city of the U.S. state of Connecticut. The city, located in Hartford County, had a population of 121,054 at the 2020 census and was estimated at 124,006 in 2025.

Q33555.name: Rio Rancho
Q33555.desc: city in Sandoval and Bernalillo County, New Mexico, United States
Q33555.about: Rio Rancho (Spanish: Río Rancho) is the largest and most populous city in Sandoval County, New Mexico, United States. A small portion of the city extends into northern Bernalillo County.
Q33555.img: City Hall Rio Rancho New Mexico.jpg

Q33935.name: Tel Aviv
Q33935.about: Tel Aviv, officially Tel Aviv-Yafo, and also known as Tel Aviv-Jaffa, is the most populous city in the Gush Dan metropolitan area of Israel. Located on the Israeli Mediterranean coastline and with a population of 494,900, it is the economic and technological center of the country and a global high-tech hub.

Q340.name: Montreal
Q340.about: Montreal (French: Montréal) is the largest city in the province of Quebec, the second-largest in Canada, and the eighth-largest in North America. Founded in 1642 as Ville-Marie, or "City of Mary", it now takes its name from Mount Royal, the triple-peaked mountain around which the early settlement was built.

Q3238.name: Tegucigalpa
Q3238.desc: capital and largest city of Honduras
Q3238.about:
Tegucigalpa (UK:  US:  Spanish: [teɣusiˈɣalpa])—formally Tegucigalpa, Municipality of the Central District (Spanish: Tegucigalpa, Municipio del Distrito Central or Tegucigalpa, M.D.C.), and colloquially referred to as Tegus, Teguz or Cerrocigalpa —is the capital and largest city of Honduras along with its sister city, Comayagüela.
Claimed on 29 September 1578 by the Spaniards, Tegucigalpa became the Honduran capital on 30 October 1880, under President Marco Aurelio Soto, when he moved the seat of government from Comayagua, which had been the Honduran capital since its independence in 1841.
Q3238.img: Centro historico de Tegucigalpa y Comayagüela.jpg

Q3544.name: Tambov
Q3544.about: Tambov (UK:  tam-BOF, US:  tahm-BAWF, -⁠BAWV; Russian: Тамбов, IPA: [tɐmˈbof]) is a city and the administrative center of Tambov Oblast, central Russia, at the confluence of the Tsna and Studenets rivers, about 418 km (260 mi) south-southeast of Moscow. With a population of 261,803 as of 2021, Tambov is the largest city, and historical center, of the Tambov Oblast as a whole.

Q32348.name: Gogebic County
Q32348.about: Gogebic County ( goh-GHEE-bik or  goh-GHEH-bik) is a county in the Upper Peninsula of the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,380.

Q32349.name: Lake County
Q32349.about: Lake County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,436.

Q33147.name: Allen
Q33147.desc: city in Collin County, Texas, United States
Q33147.about: Allen is a city in Collin County, Texas, United States, and a northern suburb in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Its population was 104,627 at the 2020 census, and the United States Census Bureau estimated it at 113,447 as of July 1, 2025.

Q33264.name: Las Cruces
Q33264.desc: city in and county seat of Doña Ana County, New Mexico, United States
Q33264.about: Las Cruces (; Spanish: [las 'kruses]; lit. 'the crosses') is a city in Doña Ana County, New Mexico, United States, and its county seat.

Q33304.name: Quảng Ngãi
Q33304.about: Quảng Ngãi (Vietnamese pronunciation: [kwâŋ ŋǎjˀ]) is a province in South Central Coast and Central Highlands region of Vietnam. The province borders Da Nang to the north, the South China Sea to the east, Gia Lai to the south, the Lao provinces of Sekong and Attapeu, and the Cambodian province of Ratanakiri to the west.

Q33351.name: Hà Tĩnh
Q33351.about: Hà Tĩnh is a province in the North Central Coast region of Vietnam. It borders Nghệ An to the north, Quảng Trị to the south, Laos to the west, and the South China Sea (Gulf of Tonkin) to the east.

Q33377.name: Jalandhar
Q33377.desc: ancient city in the north Indian state of Punjab
Q33377.about: Jalandhar (Punjabi pronunciation: [d͡ʐəˈlənˌdə̀ɾᵊ]) is a city in the state of Punjab in India. With a considerable population, it ranks as the third most-populous city in the state and is the largest city in the Doaba region.

Q33405.name: Little Rock
Q33405.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Arkansas and seat of Pulaski County
Q33405.about: Little Rock is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Arkansas. The population was 202,591 at the 2020 census, while the Little Rock metropolitan area with an estimated 770,000 residents is the 81st-most populous metropolitan area in the United States.

Q34180.name: Brantford
Q34180.about: Brantford is a city in Ontario, Canada, founded on the Grand River in Southwestern Ontario. It is surrounded by Brant County but is politically separate with a municipal government of its own that is fully independent of the county's municipal government.

Q34183.name: Barrie
Q34183.about: Barrie is a city in Central Ontario, Canada, about 90 kilometres (56 mi) north of Toronto. The city is located along the shores of Kempenfelt Bay and geographically within Simcoe County, although it is a single-tier municipality that is politically independent from the surrounding county.

Q34205.name: Cockburn Town
Q34205.desc: capital of the Turks and Caicos Islands
Q34205.about: Cockburn Town ( KOH-bərn) is the capital of the Turks and Caicos Islands, spreading across most of Grand Turk. It was founded in 1681 by salt collectors.

Q34218.name: Burlington
Q34218.desc: city in Halton Region, Ontario, Canada
Q34218.about: Burlington is a city at the west end of Lake Ontario in Halton Region, Ontario, Canada. It borders Hamilton to the south, Milton to the northwest, and Oakville to the northeast.

Q34227.name: Belleville
Q34227.about: Belleville is a city in Ontario, Canada, situated on the eastern end of Lake Ontario, located at the mouth of the Moira River and on the Bay of Quinte. Its population as of the 2021 Canadian census was 55,071 (Census Metropolitan Area population 111,184).

Q34370.name: Rotterdam
Q34370.desc: city in South Holland, the Netherlands
Q34370.about: Rotterdam ( ROT-ər-dam, UK also  ROT-ər-DAM; Dutch: [ˌrɔtərˈdɑm] ) is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4 km2). It is in the province of South Holland, part of the North Sea mouth of the Rhine–Meuse–Scheldt delta, via the New Meuse inland shipping channel, dug to connect to the Meuse at first and now to the Rhine.

Q34404.name: New Orleans
Q34404.desc: largest city of the state of Louisiana, United States
Q34404.about: New Orleans (commonly known as NOLA or  The Big Easy, among other nicknames) is a consolidated city-parish located along the Mississippi River in the U.S. state of Louisiana. With a population of 383,997 at the 2020 census, New Orleans is the most populous city in Louisiana, the second-most populous in the Deep South (after Atlanta), and the twelfth-most populous in the Southeastern United States; the New Orleans metropolitan area, with about 1 million residents, is the 59th-most populous metropolitan area in the United States.

Q34412.name: Foshan
Q34412.about: Foshan (UK: , US also ; Chinese: 佛山) or Futsan is a prefecture-level city in central Guangdong Province, China. The entire prefecture covers 3,848 km2 (1,486 sq mi) and had a population of 9,498,863 as of the 2020 census.
Q34412.img: Century Lotus Sports Center & Fangta seen from Dongping Bridge.jpg

Q34600.name: Kyoto
Q34600.desc: city in the Kyōto Prefecture, Japan
Q34600.about: Kyoto ( or ; Japanese: 京都, Kyōto [k̟ʲjó̞ò̞.tò̞] ), officially Kyoto City (京都市, Kyōto-shi; [k̟ʲjò̞ó̞.tó̞.ɕì, k̟ʲjó̞ó̞-] , locally [k̟ʲjó̞ó̞.tó̞.ɕì]), is the capital city of Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan's largest and most populous island of Honshu. As of 2020, the city had a population of 1.46 million, making it the ninth-most populous city in Japan.
Q34600.img: Pedestrian road with pavements, paper umbrellas and people in yukata, Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto, Japan.jpg

Q33959.name: Nice
Q33959.desc: city and commune in Alpes-Maritimes, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France
Q33959.about: Nice is a city and commune, and the prefecture of the department of Alpes-Maritimes, and the administrative region of Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France. It is located on the French Riviera, the country's southeastern coast on the Mediterranean Sea, at the foot of the French Alps.

Q33986.name: Valparaíso
Q33986.about: Valparaíso is a major city, commune, seaport, and naval base facility in the Valparaíso Region of Chile. Valparaíso was originally named after Valparaíso de Arriba, in Castile-La Mancha, Spain.

Q320729.name: Pocatello
Q320729.desc: city in Bannock and Power counties in Idaho, United States, that is the county seat of Bannock County
Q320729.about: Pocatello ( ) is the county seat of and the largest city in Bannock County, with a small portion on the Fort Hall Indian Reservation in neighboring Power County, containing the city's airport. It is the principal city of the Pocatello metropolitan area, which encompasses all of Bannock County in the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Idaho.

Q320934.name: Kurume
Q320934.about: Kurume (久留米市, Kurume-shi) is a city in Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 February 2024, the city had an estimated population of 295,367 in 137,140 households, and a  population density of 1309 people per km².

Q320943.name: Matsudo
Q320943.about: Matsudo (松戸市, Matsudo-shi) is a city in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 October 2024, the city had an estimated population of  499,533 in 242,918 households and a population density of 8,138 persons per km2.

Q321079.name: Jos
Q321079.about: Jos  is a city in Plateau State of North-Central region of Nigeria with a population of about 900,000 residents based on the 2006 census. Popularly called "J-Town", it is the administrative capital and largest city of Plateau State.

Q321475.name: Kollam
Q321475.about: Kollam (Malayalam: [kolːɐm] ;) is an ancient seaport and the fourth largest city in the Indian state of Kerala. Located on the southern tip of the Malabar Coast of the Arabian Sea, the city is on the banks of Ashtamudi Lake and is 71 kilometres (44 mi) northwest of Thiruvananthapuram.

Q321503.name: Abitibi-Ouest
Q321503.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q321503.about: Abitibi-Ouest Regional County Municipality (French pronunciation: [abitibi wɛst], Abitibi West) is a regional county municipality located in the Abitibi-Témiscamingue region of Quebec. Its seat is La Sarre.

Q321513.name: Abitibi
Q321513.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q321513.about: Abitibi Regional County Municipality (French pronunciation: [abitibi] ) is a regional county municipality in the Abitibi-Témiscamingue region of Quebec. The seat is Amos.

Q322149.name: Eldoret
Q322149.about: Eldoret is a city in the Rift Valley region of Kenya. It serves as the capital of Uasin Gishu County.

Q322155.name: Rajshahi
Q322155.about: Rajshahi (Bengali: রাজশাহী, pronounced [radʒ.ʃaɦi] ) is a metropolitan city and a major urban, administrative, commercial and educational centre of Bangladesh. It is also the administrative seat of the eponymous division and district.

Q322624.name: Abobo
Q322624.desc: Municipality of the city of Abidjan
Q322624.about: Abobo is a northern suburb of Abidjan and one of the 10 urban communes of this city in Ivory Coast. Abobo is one of the most populated communes in the country with about 1.3 million inhabitants in an area of 6,925 ha (69.25 km2), a density of 193 inhabitants per hectare.
Q322624.img: Tunnel du rond-point d'Abobo en Côte d'Ivoire 07.jpg

Q323414.name: Simi Valley
Q323414.desc: city in Ventura County, California, United States
Q323414.about: Simi Valley ( ; Chumash: Shimiyi) is a city in the valley of the same name in southeastern Ventura County, California, United States. It is 37 miles (60 km) northwest of Downtown Los Angeles, making it part of the Greater Los Angeles Area.

Q34006.name: Hollywood
Q34006.desc: neighborhood in Los Angeles, California, United States
Q34006.about: Hollywood, sometimes informally called Tinseltown, is a neighborhood in Central Los Angeles, California. Its name has become synonymous with the American film industry and the people associated with it.

Q34106.name: Sarnia
Q34106.about: Sarnia is a city in Lambton County, Ontario, Canada.  It had a 2021 population of 72,047, and is the largest city on Lake Huron.

Q34109.name: Fargo
Q34109.desc: city in and the county seat of Cass County, North Dakota, United States of America
Q34109.about: Fargo is the most populous city in the U.S. state of North Dakota. The population was 125,990 at the 2020 census and estimated at 136,285 in 2024.

Q34112.name: Gustavia
Q34112.desc: main settlement and capital city of St. Barthélemy
Q34112.about: Gustavia (, French: [ɡystavja], Swedish: [ɡɵˈstɑːvɪa]) is the main town and capital of the island of Saint Barthélemy. Originally called Le Carénage, it was renamed in honor of King Gustav III of Sweden.

Q34116.name: Thunder Bay
Q34116.desc: city in Thunder Bay District, Ontario, Canada
Q34116.about: Thunder Bay is a city in and the seat of Thunder Bay District, Ontario, Canada. It is the most populous municipality in Northwestern Ontario and the second most populous (after Greater Sudbury) municipality in Northern Ontario.

Q34126.name: Funafuti
Q34126.about: Funafuti is an atoll, comprising numerous islets, that is the capital of Tuvalu. As of the 2017 census, it has a population of 6,320 people.

Q34144.name: Grand Forks
Q34144.desc: city in North Dakota, United States
Q34144.about: Grand Forks is a city in and the county seat of Grand Forks County, North Dakota, United States. The population was 59,166 at the 2020 census, and was estimated to be 59,845 in 2024, making it the state's third-most populous city, after Fargo and Bismarck.

Q323432.name: Fairfield
Q323432.desc: city in and county seat of Solano County, California, United States
Q323432.about:
Fairfield is a city in and the county seat of Solano County, California, United States, in the North Bay sub-region of the San Francisco Bay Area.
The city has a diversified economy, with government, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, professional and commercial construction sectors.

Q323801.name: Nampula
Q323801.about: Nampula [nɐ̃ˈpulɐ] is the capital city of Nampula Province in Northern Mozambique. With a population of 743,125 (2017 census), it is the third-largest city in Mozambique after Maputo and Matola.

Q326339.name: Üsküdar
Q326339.about: Üsküdar (Turkish pronunciation: [ysˈcydaɾ]) is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 35 km2, and its population is 524,452 (2022).

Q327022.name: Rockville
Q327022.desc: city in and seat of Montgomery County, Maryland, United States; suburb of Washington, D.C.
Q327022.about: Rockville is a city in and the county seat of Montgomery County, Maryland, United States, and is part of the Washington metropolitan area. The 2020 census tabulated Rockville's population at 67,117, making it the fourth most populous incorporated city in Maryland.

Q327080.name: Cleburne County
Q327080.about: Cleburne County is a county located in the east central portion of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,056.

Q328030.name: Kut
Q328030.about: Kūt (Arabic: ٱلْكُوت, romanized: al-Kūt), officially Al-Kut, also spelled Kutulamare, Kut al-Imara or Kut Al Amara, is a city in eastern Iraq, on the left bank of the Tigris River, about 160 kilometres (99 miles) south east of Baghdad, and the capital of the Wasit Governorate. As of 2018 the estimated population is about 389,400 people.

Q328153.name: Damanhur
Q328153.about: Damanhur (Egyptian Arabic: دمنهور Damanhūr, IPA: [dɑmɑnˈhuːɾ]) is a city in Lower Egypt, and the capital of the Beheira Governorate. It is located 160 km (99 mi) northwest of Cairo, and 70 km (43 mi) ESE of Alexandria, in the middle of the western Nile Delta.

Q34692.name: Kingston
Q34692.about: Kingston is the capital and largest city of Jamaica, located on the southeastern coast of the island. It faces a natural harbour protected by the Palisadoes, a long sand spit which connects the town of Port Royal and Norman Manley International Airport to the rest of the island.

Q34739.name: Dayton
Q34739.desc: city and county seat of Montgomery County, Ohio, United States
Q34739.about:
Dayton ( ) is a city in Montgomery County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. It is the 
sixth-most populous city in Ohio, with a population of 137,644 at the time of 2020 United States census.

Q34750.name: Fuxin
Q34750.about: Fuxin (Chinese: 阜新; pinyin: Fùxīn) is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Liaoning province, People's Republic of China, bordering the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region to the north. As of the 2020 census, its decreasing total population was 1,647,280 inhabitants (contrast to 1,819,339 in 2010), of whom 716,494 lived in the built-up (or metro) area, encompassing the four urban districts, collectively known as 'Fuxin City'.

Q34761.name: Fularji District
Q34761.about: Fularji (simplified Chinese: 富拉尔基区; traditional Chinese: 富拉爾基區; pinyin: Fùlā'ěrjī Qū) is a district of the province of Heilongjiang, People's Republic of China. It is under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Qiqihar.
Q34761.img: 富拉尔基街景 QQ696847 - panoramio (17).jpg

Q34804.name: Albuquerque
Q34804.desc: city and county seat of Bernalillo County, New Mexico, United States and the largest city in the state
Q34804.about: Albuquerque is the most populous city in the U.S. state of New Mexico. Founded in 1706 as La Villa de Alburquerque by Santa Fe de Nuevo México governor Francisco Cuervo y Valdés, and named in honor of Francisco Fernández de la Cueva, 10th Duke of Alburquerque and Viceroy of New Spain, it was an outpost on El Camino Real, linking Mexico City to the northernmost territories of New Spain.

Q34820.name: Santo Domingo
Q34820.about: Santo Domingo, officially known as Santo Domingo de Guzmán, is the capital and largest city of the Dominican Republic and the largest metropolitan area in the Caribbean by population. As of 2022, the city center had a population of 1,029,110 while its metropolitan area, Greater Santo Domingo, had a population of 4,274,651.
Q34820.img: Santo Domingo (Dominican Republic) taken atop Novocentro tower viewing the city to the southwest 2010.jpg

Q332753.name: Heze
Q332753.about: Heze (Chinese: 菏泽; pinyin: Hézé) is the westernmost prefecture-level city in Shandong province, China. The Peony Capital of China, formerly known as Caozhou, the city borders Jining to the east, and the provinces of Henan and Anhui to the west and south respectively.

Q333928.name: Maracay
Q333928.about: Maracay (Spanish pronunciation: [maɾaˈkaj]) is a city in north-central Venezuela, near the Caribbean coast, and is the capital and most important city of the state of Aragua. Most of it falls under the jurisdiction of Girardot Municipality.

Q334924.name: Ümraniye
Q334924.about: Ümraniye (pronounced [ymˈɾaːnije]) is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 46 km2, and its population is 723,760 (2023).

Q335017.name: Newport News

Q335021.name: Abu Ghraib
Q335021.about: Abu Ghraib (  or ; Arabic: أبو غريب, romanized: Abū Ghurayb) is a city in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq, located just west of Baghdad's city center, or northwest of Baghdad International Airport. It has a population of 900,000 (2025).

Q335121.about: Gloucester County (, GLOSS-tər) is a county in the Commonwealth of Virginia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 38,711.

Q335423.name: Takatsuki
Q335423.about: Takatsuki (高槻市, Takatsuki-shi) is a city in Osaka Prefecture, Japan.  As of 31 March 2023, the city had an estimated population of 348,020 in 164,494 households and a population density of 3.300 persons per km2.

Q34863.name: Oklahoma City
Q34863.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Oklahoma and seat of Oklahoma County
Q34863.about: Oklahoma City (  OH-klə-HOH-mə -⁠), often shortened to OKC, is the capital and most populous city in the U.S. state of Oklahoma. It is the 21st-most populous U.S. city and 8th largest in the Southern United States, with a population of 681,054 at the 2020 census.
Q34863.img: Downtown Oklahoma City skyline at twilight.jpg

Q34932.name: Brisbane
Q34932.about: Brisbane (  BRIZ-bən; Turrbal/Yagara: Meanjin) is the capital and most populous city of the Australian state of Queensland and the third-most populous city in Australia, with a population of about 2.8 million. Brisbane lies at the centre of South East Queensland, a bio-geographical and urban region with an estimated population of 4.1 million as of 2024.
Q34932.img: Skyline of Brisbane from Kangaroo Point Cliffs Park, Nov 2020, 05.jpg

Q35178.name: Kuwait City
Q35178.about: Kuwait City ( ; Arabic: مدينة الكويت, romanised: Madīnat al-Kuwayt) is the capital and largest city of Kuwait. Located at the heart of the country on the south shore of Kuwait Bay on the Persian Gulf, it is the political, cultural and economic primate city of the emirate, being home to the headquarters of most Kuwaiti corporations and the entirety of its banking system.

Q34664.name: Hiroshima
Q34664.desc: capital city of Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan
Q34664.about: Hiroshima (広島市, Hiroshima-shi; English: , also UK: , US: , Japanese: [çì.ɾó̞.ɕí.mä́(.ɕì)] ) is the capital of Hiroshima Prefecture in Japan. As of August 1, 2026, the city had an estimated population of 1,170,194.

Q328846.name: Nuevo Laredo

Q328846.about: Nuevo Laredo (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈnweβo laˈɾeðo]) is a city in the Municipality of Nuevo Laredo in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas. The city lies on the banks of the Rio Grande, across from Laredo, Texas, United States.

Q328941.name: Clarksville
Q328941.about: Clarksville is a city in Montgomery County, Tennessee, United States, its county seat, and only incorporated municipality. The city had a population of 166,722 as of the 2020 census, making it the fifth-most populous city in Tennessee.

Q330202.name: Itaquaquecetuba
Q330202.desc: municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil
Q330202.about: Itaquaquecetuba, also simply called Itaquá, is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of São Paulo.

Q330531.name: Kota
Q330531.desc: city on the Chambal River in Rajasthan, northern India
Q330531.about: Kota (Hindi pronunciation: [ko.ʈɐ] ), previously known as Kotah, is the third-largest city of the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is located about 230 km (143 mi) south of the state capital, Jaipur, on the banks of the Chambal River.

Q330643.name: Moradabad
Q330643.desc: city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh
Q330643.about: Moradabad (Hindi pronunciation: [mʊɾaːd̪aːbaːd̪] ) is an industrial city, police commissionerate and municipal corporation in Moradabad district of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is on the banks of the Ramganga river, 165 km (103 mi) from the national capital, New Delhi and 356 km north-west of the state capital, Lucknow.

Q331104.name: Fayetteville
Q331104.desc: city in and seat of Cumberland County, North Carolina, United States
Q331104.about: Fayetteville ( FAY-ət-vil, locally  FED-vəl) is a city in and the county seat of Cumberland County, North Carolina, United States. Fort Bragg, the world's largest military installation, is located on the outskirts of the city.

Q331300.name: Mauá

Q331380.name: Schenectady

Q331380.about: Schenectady ( skə-NEKT-ə-dee) is a city in Schenectady County, New York, United States, of which it is the county seat. As of the 2020 census, the city's population of 67,047 made it the state's ninth-most populous city and the 25th-most populous municipality.

Q331397.name: Oak Park

Q331584.name: Kralendijk
Q331584.about: Kralendijk (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈkraːlə(n)dɛik]) is the capital and the main port of the island of Bonaire in the Caribbean Netherlands. The language spoken in the town is Papiamentu, but Dutch and English are widely used.

Q331661.name: Ciudad Victoria
Q331661.desc: capital of the State of Tamaulipas, México
Q331661.about: Ciudad Victoria (Spanish pronunciation: [sjuˈðað biɣˈtoɾja] ) (English: Victoria City) is the capital city of the Mexican state of Tamaulipas and the seat of the Municipality of Victoria. It is located in the northeast of Mexico at the foot of the Sierra Madre Oriental.

Q332319.name: Mekele

Q332319.about: Mekelle (Tigrinya: መቐለ, romanized: Mek'ele) is a special zone and capital of the Tigray Region of Ethiopia. Mekelle was formerly the capital of Enderta awraja in Tigray.

Q349973.name: Shuangyashan
Q349973.about: Shuangyashan (simplified Chinese: 双鸭山; traditional Chinese: 雙鴨山; pinyin: Shuāngyāshān) is a coal mining prefecture-level city located in the eastern part of Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China, bordering Russia's Khabarovsk and Primorsky Krais to the east. The city's name means a pair-of-ducks mountains and refers to two peaks northeast of the city.

Q349979.name: Qitaihe
Q349979.about: Qitaihe (Chinese: 七台河; pinyin: Qītáihé) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Heilongjiang province, China. Covering an area 6,223 km2 (2,403 sq mi), it is geographically the smallest prefecture-level division of the province.

Q349982.name: Hegang
Q349982.about: Hegang (Chinese: 鹤岗; pinyin: Hègǎng, also known as Heli and Xingshan) is a prefecture-level city in Heilongjiang province of China, situated in the southeastern section of the Lesser Khingan Range, facing Jiamusi across the Songhua River to the south and Russia's Jewish Autonomous Oblast across the Amur River to the north. Hegang is one of the principal coal-producing cities in China.

Q349985.name: Suihua
Q349985.about: Suihua (Chinese: 绥化) is a prefecture-level city in west-central Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China, adjacent to Yichun to the east, Harbin, the provincial capital, to the south, Daqing to the west, Qiqihar to the northwest and Heihe to the north. It has 3,756,167 inhabitants at the 2020 census, of whom 698,025 lived in the built-up (or metro) area of Beilin District.

Q338424.about: Goshen County (, GOH-shən) is a county in the U.S. state of Wyoming. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 12,498.

Q360235.name: Ma'anshan
Q360235.about: Ma'anshan (simplified Chinese: 马鞍山; traditional Chinese: 馬鞍山; pinyin: Mǎ ān Shān), also colloquially written as Maanshan, is a prefecture-level city in the eastern part of Anhui province in Eastern China. Its aliases include Taiping, Steel City, and Poetry City.
Q360235.img: 含山县含城太湖山路小公园景色 - panoramio (2).jpg

Q360268.name: Huaibei
Q360268.about: Huaibei (Chinese: 淮北; pinyin: Huáiběi) is a prefecture-level city in northern Anhui Province, China. It borders Suzhou (Anhui) to the east, Bengbu to the south, Bozhou to the west, and the provinces of Henan to the northwest and Jiangsu to the northeast.

Q3718.name: Dakar
Q3718.desc: capital and the largest city of Senegal
Q3718.about: Dakar ( UK also: ; French: [dakaʁ]; Wolof: Ndakaaru) is the capital and largest city of Senegal. The department of Dakar has a population of 1,278,469, and the population of the Dakar metropolitan area was at 4.0 million in 2023.

Q3551.name: Rabat
Q3551.about: Rabat is the capital city of Morocco, located on the northwestern coasts of the Atlantic Ocean. Rabat is the country's seventh-largest city with a population of 515,619 (2024) and the second largest metropolitan area after Casablanca, with a population of approximately 2.1 million (2025).

Q359955.name: Ado Ekiti
Q359955.desc: state capital and headquarters of the Ekiti, Nigeria
Q359955.about: Ado Ekiti is the capital city of Ekiti State, Nigeria. It is the headquarter of the Ekiti central senatorial district, southwest, Nigeria.
Q359955.img: The Highway of the City of Ado-Ekiti in Ekiti State, Nigeria.jpg

Q360069.name: Bengbu
Q360069.about: Bengbu (Chinese: 蚌埠; pinyin: Bèngbù; Wade–Giles: Peng-pu) is a city in northern Anhui Province, China. Its population was 3,296,408 registered residents at the 2020 census.
Q360069.img: Bengbu Huaishang Ave. and Beijing - Shanghai Railway 2.jpg

Q360374.name: Anqing
Q360374.about: Anqing (simplified Chinese: 安庆; traditional Chinese: 安慶; pinyin: Ānqìng, also Yicheng, Nganking and formerly Hwaining, now the name of Huaining County) is a prefecture-level city in the southwest of Anhui province, People's Republic of China. Its population was 4,165,284 as of the 2020 census, with 728,501 living in the built-up (or metro) area made up of three urban districts.

Q360584.name: Fuyang
Q360584.about: Fuyang (simplified Chinese: 阜阳; traditional Chinese: 阜陽; pinyin: , previously romanized as Fowyang) is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Anhui province, China. It is bordered by Henan province to the west and the cities of Bozhou to the northeast, Huainan to the southeast, and Lu'an to the south.

Q3604.name: Djibouti
Q3604.about: Djibouti City (also called Djibouti and Jibuti in early Western texts) is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Djibouti. It is located in the coastal Djibouti Region on the Gulf of Tadjoura.

Q3739.name: Bissau
Q3739.about: Bissau (; Portuguese pronunciation: [biˈsaw]) is the capital and largest city of Guinea-Bissau. As of 2015, it had a population of 492,004.

Q363166.name: Ganzhou
Q363166.about: Ganzhou (Chinese: 赣州; pinyin: Gànzhōu, Hakka: Kam-chû-sṳ), alternately romanized as Kanchow, is a prefecture-level city in the south of Jiangxi province, China, bordering Fujian to the east, Guangdong to the south, and Hunan to the west. Its administrative seat is at Zhanggong District.

Q363262.name: Ji'an
Q363262.about: Ji'an (Chinese: 吉安; pinyin: Jí'ān) is a prefecture-level city situated in the central region of Jiangxi province of the People's Republic of China and bordering Hunan province to the west. It has an area of 25,219 km2 (9,737 sq mi) and as of the 2020 census, had a population of 4,469,176, of whom 643,399 live in the built-up (or metro) area made of 2 urban districts.

Q3751.name: Praia
Q3751.about: Praia (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈpɾajɐ], Portuguese for "beach") is the capital and largest city of Cape Verde. Located on the southern coast of Santiago island within the Sotavento Islands group, the city is the seat of the Praia Municipality.

Q366754.name: Kalyan
Q366754.about: Kalyan (Pronunciation: [kəljaːɳ]) is a city on the banks of Ulhas River in Thane district of Maharashtra state in Konkan division. It is governed by Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation.

Q366871.name: Scott County
Q366871.about: Scott County is a county located in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the population was 24,384.

Q3612.name: Antofagasta
Q3612.about: Antofagasta (Spanish pronunciation: [antofaˈɣasta] ) is a port city in northern Chile, about 1,100 kilometres (700 mi) north of Santiago. It is the capital of Antofagasta Province and Antofagasta Region.

Q3616.name: Tehran
Q3616.about: Tehran is the capital and largest city of Iran. It is also the capital of Tehran province and the administrative center for Tehran County and its Central District.

Q3748.name: Monrovia
Q3748.about: Monrovia is the capital and largest city of the African country of Liberia. Founded in 1822, it is located on Cape Mesurado on the Atlantic coast and, as of the 2022 census, had a population of 1,761,032 residents.

Q363326.name: Yichun
Q363326.about: Yichun (Chinese: 宜春; pinyin: Yíchūn; Wade–Giles: I2-ch'un1; postal: Ichun, Yichun dialect: [ȵi˦ tɕʰyn˧˦]) is a mountainous prefecture-level city in the western/northwestern Jiangxi Province, China, bordering Hunan province to the west. It is located in the northwest of the province along a river surrounded by mountains.
Q363326.img: 在袁山公园看广电中心 - panoramio - 邓利.jpg

Q363391.name: Fuzhou
Q363391.desc: prefecture-level city in Jiangxi, People's Republic of China
Q363391.about:
Fuzhou is a prefecture-level city in the northeastern part of Jiangxi province, People's Republic of China.
Fuzhou is located to the south of the provincial capital Nanchang, bordered in the east by Fujian Province.

Q366010.name: Amarah
Q366010.about: Amarah (Arabic: ٱلْعَمَارَة, romanized: al-ʿAmārah), also spelled Amara, is a city in south-eastern Iraq, located on a low ridge next to the Tigris River waterway south of Baghdad about 50 km (31 mi) from the border with Iran. It lies at the northern tip of the marshlands between the Tigris and Euphrates.

Q3624.name: Addis Ababa
Q3624.about: Addis Ababa (  AD-iss AB-ə-bə; Amharic: አዲስ አበባ [adˈdis ˈaβəβa] , lit. 'new flower'; Oromo: Finfinnee, lit. 'fountain of hot mineral water') is the capital and largest city of Ethiopia. With an estimated population of 6,287,000 inhabitants as of 2025, it is the tenth largest city in Africa.

Q366959.name: Jackson County
Q366959.about: Jackson County is the northeasternmost county in the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 52,579.

Q367567.name: Division No. 17
Q367567.desc: census division in Saskatchewan in Canada
Q367567.about: Division No. 17 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q367632.name: Newton County
Q367632.about: Newton County is a county located near the northwestern corner of the U.S. state of Indiana. As of 2020, the population was 13,830.

Q3659.name: N'Djamena
Q3659.desc: capital and largest city of Chad
Q3659.about: N'Djamena (English:   ən-jah-MAY-nə) is the capital and largest city of Chad. It is also a Special Status Province, divided into 10 districts or arrondissements.

Q3792.name: Lomé
Q3792.about: Lomé (UK:  LOH-may, US:  loh-MAY) is the capital and largest city of Togo. It has an urban population of 837,437 while there were 2,188,376 permanent residents in its metropolitan area as of the 2022 census.
Q3792.img: Monuments de l'indépendance et Palais des congrès de Lomé.jpg

Q372791.name: Jining
Q372791.about: Jining (Chinese: 济宁; pinyin: Jǐníng) is a prefecture-level city in southwestern Shandong province. It borders Heze to the southwest, Zaozhuang to the southeast, Tai'an to the northeast, and the provinces of Henan and Jiangsu to the northwest and south respectively.

Q372796.name: Dodge County
Q372796.about: Dodge County is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 census, the population was 89,396.

Q373023.name: Weihai
Q373023.about: Weihai (Weihainese: Wé4iHæ, [ʋeɪ̯˥˩ hɛ̆꜌]; Chinese: 威海; pinyin: Wēihǎi), formerly Weihaiwei (Chinese: 威海卫; pinyin: Wēihǎiwèi; lit. 'Mighty Sea Fort'), is a prefecture-level city and major seaport city in the easternmost Shandong province of China.

Q373346.name: Linyi
Q373346.about: Linyi (simplified Chinese: 临沂; traditional Chinese: 臨沂; pinyin: Línyí) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Shandong province, China. As of 2011, Linyi is the largest prefecture-level city in Shandong, both by area and population, Linyi borders Rizhao to the east, Weifang to the northeast, Zibo to the north, Tai'an to the northwest, Jining to the west, Zaozhuang to the southwest, and the province of Jiangsu to the south.

Q3561.name: Algiers
Q3561.about: Algiers ( al-JEERZ; Arabic: الجزائر, romanized: al-Jazāʾir, pronounced [al.d͡ʒazaːʔir] , locally [(ɪ)ˈd͡ːzaːjir]; French: Alger, pronounced [alʒe] ; Algerian Tamazight: ⴷⵣⴰⵢⵔ, romanized: Dzayer), officially Capital City of Algiers (Arabic: الجزائر العاصمة, romanized: al-Jazāʾir al-ʿĀṣima; Algerian Tamazight: ⴷⵣⴰⵢⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵏⴰⵖⵜ, romanized: Dzayer Tamaneɣt), is the capital and largest city of Algeria, located on the Mediterranean Sea in the north-central portion of the country. In 2025, an estimated 4.325 million people resided within the urban area.

Q3572.name: Tunis
Q3572.about: Tunis (Arabic: تونس, ) is the capital and largest city of Tunisia. The greater metropolitan area of Tunis, often referred to as "Grand Tunis", has about 2,700,000 inhabitants.

Q3726.name: Banjul
Q3726.about: Banjul (UK: , US: ), officially the City of Banjul, is the capital city of the Gambia. The city of Banjul is located on St Mary's Island (Banjul Island), which is in the Gambia River where it enters the Atlantic Ocean.

Q3733.name: Conakry
Q3733.about: Conakry ( KON-ə-kree, French: [kɔnakʁi]; Susu: Kɔnakiri; N'Ko: ߞߐߣߊߞߙߌ߫, romanized: Kɔnakrí; Fula: 𞤑𞤮𞤲𞤢𞥄𞤳𞤭𞤪𞤭, romanized: Konaakiri) is the capital and largest city of Guinea. A port city, it serves as the economic, financial and cultural centre of Guinea.
Q3733.img: Un aperçu de la ville de conakry.jpg

Q360702.name: Lu'an
Q360702.about: Lu'an (Chinese: 六安; pinyin: Lù'ān) is a prefecture-level city in western Anhui province, People's Republic of China, bordering Henan to the northwest and Hubei to the southwest. As of the 2020 census, it had a total population of 4,393,699 inhabitants whom 1,752,537 lived in the built-up (or metro) area made of Yu'an and Jin'an urban districts.
Q360702.img: Pihe River Waterway from train for Shanghai-Hongqiao Station.jpg

Q360769.name: Bozhou
Q360769.about: Bozhou (Chinese: 亳州; pinyin: Bózhōu) is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Anhui province, China. It borders Huaibei to the northeast, Bengbu to the southeast, Huainan to the south, Fuyang to the southwest, and Henan to the north.

Q360870.name: Chizhou
Q360870.about: Chizhou (Chinese: 池州; pinyin: Chízhōu) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Anhui province, China. It borders Anqing to the northwest, Tongling and Wuhu to the northeast, Xuancheng to the east, Huangshan to the southeast, and the province of Jiangxi to the southwest, respectively.

Q362865.name: Pingxiang
Q362865.desc: prefecture-level city in Jiangxi, People's Republic of China
Q362865.about: Pingxiang (simplified Chinese: 萍乡; traditional Chinese: 萍鄉; pinyin: Píngxiāng; Wade–Giles: P'ing-hsiang) is a medium-sized prefecture-level city located in western Jiangxi province, People's Republic of China. Pingxiang City is located in the west of Jiangxi Province, bordering Yichun and Ji'an of this province to the east and south, and Zhuzhou and Changsha of Hunan to the northwest.

Q362959.name: Xinyu
Q362959.about: Xinyu (Chinese: 新余; pinyin: Xīnyú, formerly 新喻; Xīnyú) is a prefecture-level city in west-central Jiangxi province, People's Republic of China.
Q362959.img: View from 33th floor in Xinyu building.jpg

Q3640.name: Ankara
Q3640.about: Ankara is the capital city of Turkey. Located in the central part of Anatolia, the city has a population of over 5.3 million residents in its urban center, out of 6 million residents in Ankara Province.

Q3642.name: Asmara
Q3642.about: Asmara ( əs-MAHR-ə), or Asmera, is the capital and most populous city of Eritrea, in the country's Central Region. It sits at an elevation of 2,325 metres (7,628 ft), making it the sixth-highest capital in the world by altitude and the second-highest capital in Africa.

Q3768.name: Yamoussoukro
Q3768.about: Yamoussoukro (; French pronunciation: [jamusukʁo] , locally [jamsokʁo]) is the capital city of Ivory Coast and an autonomous district. As of the 2014 census, Yamoussoukro is the third most populous city in the Ivory Coast, with a population of 361,893.

Q3777.name: Ouagadougou
Q3777.about: Ouagadougou or Wagadugu ( ; Mossi: Waogdgo, pronounced [ˈwɔɣədəɣʊ]; Dyula: Wagadugu; French: Ouagadougou, pronounced [waɡaduɡu]) is the capital and largest city of Burkina Faso, and the administrative, communications, cultural and economic centre of the nation. It had a population of 2,415,266 in 2019.

Q370329.name: Mineral County
Q370329.about: Mineral County is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,535.

Q370654.name: Waukesha County
Q370654.about: Waukesha County ( ) is a county in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 United States Census, the population was 406,978, making it the third-most populous county in Wisconsin.

Q370710.name: San Juan County
Q370710.about: San Juan County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 705, making it the least populous county in Colorado.

Q370925.name: Daly City
Q370925.desc: city in San Mateo County, California, United States
Q370925.about: Daly City () is the second-most populous city in San Mateo County, California, United States. Located in the San Francisco Bay Area, and immediately south of San Francisco (sharing its northern border with almost all of San Francisco's southern border), it is named for businessman and landowner John Donald Daly.

Q370972.name: Pembroke Pines
Q370972.desc: city in southern Broward County, Florida, United States
Q370972.about: Pembroke Pines (/ˈpɛmˌbroʊk ˈpaɪnz/) is a city in southern Broward County, Florida, United States. The city is located 22 miles (35 km) north of Miami.
Q370972.img: Aerial photo of the Hollywood Sportatorium.jpg

Q371640.name: Laiyang
Q371640.about: Laiyang city (simplified Chinese: 莱阳; traditional Chinese: 萊陽; pinyin: Láiyáng) is a county-level city within Yantai bordering Qingdao, located in the middle of the Shandong Peninsula, in Shandong province, China. The majority (70%) of its population are farmers and it is famous for producing the Laiyang pear.

Q3630.name: Jakarta
Q3630.desc: capital and largest city of Indonesia
Q3630.about: Jakarta, officially the Special Capital Region of Jakarta, is the capital and largest city of Indonesia, with administrative status equivalent to a province. It lies on the northwestern coast of Java, bordering West Java and Banten and facing the Java Sea.

Q3761.name: Accra
Q3761.about: Accra () is the capital and largest city of Ghana, located on the southern coast at the Gulf of Guinea, which is part of the Atlantic Ocean. As of the 2021 census, the Accra Metropolitan District, 20.4 km2 (7.9 sq mi), had a population of 284,124, and the larger Greater Accra Region, 3,245 km2 (1,253 sq mi), had a population of 5.46 million.

Q3766.name: Damascus
Q3766.desc: capital and largest city of Syria
Q3766.about: Damascus is the capital and largest city of Syria. It is the oldest capital city in the world.

Q368006.name: McPherson County
Q368006.desc: county in South Dakota, United States
Q368006.about: McPherson County is a county in the U.S. state of South Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 2,411.

Q368241.name: Medicine Hat
Q368241.about: Medicine Hat is a city in southeast Alberta, Canada. It is located along the South Saskatchewan River, west of the Saskatchewan border.

Q368766.name: Morrill County
Q368766.about: Morrill County is a county in the U.S. state of Nebraska. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 4,555.

Q369211.name: Bienville Parish
Q369211.about: Bienville Parish (French: Paroisse de Bienville, pronounced [paʁwas də bjɛ̃vil]) is a parish located in the northwestern portion of the U.S. state of Louisiana. At the 2020 census, the population was 12,981.
Q369211.img: New Bienville Parish, LA, Courthouse IMG 8329.JPG

Q369947.name: El Cajon
Q369947.desc: city in San Diego County, California, United States
Q369947.about: El Cajon ( el kə-HOHN, Spanish pronunciation: [el kaˈxon] ; Spanish: El Cajón, lit. 'the box') is a city in San Diego County, California, United States, 17 mi (27 km) east of downtown San Diego.

Q370310.name: Hardy County
Q370310.desc: county in West Virginia, United States
Q370310.about: Hardy County is a county in the U.S. state of West Virginia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,299.

Q3646.name: Krasnodar
Q3646.desc: capital of Krasnodar region (Krai) in Southern Russia
Q3646.about: Krasnodar, formerly Yekaterinodar (until 1920), is the largest city and the administrative centre of Krasnodar Krai, Russia. The city stands on the Kuban River in southern Russia, with a population of 1,154,885 residents, and up to 1.263 million residents in the Urban Okrug.

Q3780.name: Freetown
Q3780.about: Freetown (Krio: Fritɔun) is the capital and largest city of Sierra Leone. It is a major port city on the Atlantic Ocean and is located in the Western Area of the country.

Q3787.name: Abuja
Q3787.about: Abuja () is the capital city of Nigeria, strategically situated at the geographic midpoint of the country within the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). As the seat of the Federal Government of Nigeria, it hosts key national institutions, landmarks, and buildings spread across its over 50 districts.

Q372364.name: Auglaize County
Q372364.about: Auglaize County ( AW-glayz) is a county in Northwestern Ohio, United States of America. As of the 2020 census, the population was 46,442.

Q372373.name: Morgan County
Q372373.about: Morgan County is a county located in the U.S. state of Tennessee. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,035.

Q372454.name: Escondido
Q372454.desc: city in San Diego County, United States
Q372454.about: Escondido (Spanish for 'hidden') is a city in San Diego County, California, United States.  Located in the North County region, it was incorporated in 1888, and is one of the oldest cities in San Diego County.
Q372454.img: Mark Skovorodko Photography - Escondido City Hall.jpg

Q372648.name: Polk County
Q372648.about: Polk County is a county in the northwestern part of the U.S. state of Minnesota. The population was 31,192 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 30,413 in 2024.

Q372773.name: Raipur
Q372773.about: Raipur (Hindi: rāypura, pronounced [ɾaːɪpʊɾᵊ] ) is the capital city of the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. Raipur is also the administrative headquarters of Raipur district and Raipur division, and the most populous city of the state.

Q3692.name: Riyadh
Q3692.desc: capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia
Q3692.about: Riyadh is the capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia. It is also the capital of the Riyadh Province and the centre of the Riyadh Governorate.

Q3820.name: Beirut
Q3820.desc: capital and largest city of Lebanon
Q3820.about: Beirut (  bay-ROOT; Arabic: بيروت, romanised: ) is the capital and largest city of Lebanon. As of 2025, Greater Beirut has a population of 2.4 million, just under half of Lebanon's population, which makes it the twelfth-largest city in the Levant region and the sixteenth-largest in the Arab world.

Q3825.name: Libreville
Q3825.about: Libreville (; French: [libʁəvil]) is the capital and largest city of Gabon, located on the Gabon Estuary. Libreville occupies 65 square kilometres (25 sq mi) of the northwestern province of Estuaire.

Q373953.name: Shelby County
Q373953.about: Shelby County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it had a population of 20,990.

Q374200.name: Wichita County
Q374200.about: Wichita County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat is Leoti.

Q374256.name: Wilson County
Q374256.about: Wilson County is a county located in Southeast Kansas.  Its county seat is Fredonia.

Q374334.name: Osborne County
Q374334.about: Osborne County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Osborne.

Q374342.name: Morris County
Q374342.about: Morris County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Council Grove.

Q374358.name: Miami County
Q374358.about: Miami County is a county located in east-central Kansas, United States. It is part of the Kansas City metropolitan area.

Q3674.name: Niamey
Q3674.about: Niamey is the capital and largest city of Niger. It is in the western part of the country, surrounded by the Tillabéri Region.

Q3688.name: Nouakchott
Q3688.about: Nouakchott ( nwa(h)k-SHOT) is the capital and largest city of Mauritania. Located in the southwestern part of the country, it is one of the largest cities in the Sahara.

Q3799.name: Porto-Novo
Q3799.about: Porto-Novo (Portuguese for 'New Port', pronounced [ˈpoɾtu ˈnovu]; French: [pɔʁtɔnɔvo]; Yoruba: Àjàṣẹ́; Fon: Xɔ̀gbónù; also known as Hogbonu and Ajashe) is the capital and second-largest city of Benin. The commune covers an area of 52 square kilometres (20 sq mi) and as of 2013 had a population of 264,320 people.

Q3805.name: Amman
Q3805.about: Amman is the capital and the largest city of Jordan, and the country's economic, political, and cultural center. With a population of five million as of 2026, Amman is Jordan's primate city and is the largest city in the Levant region, the seventh-largest city in the Arab world, and the eighth-largest metropolitan area in the Middle East.

Q3808.name: Yaoundé
Q3808.about: Yaoundé (UK: ; US: , French pronunciation: [ja.unde]) is the capital city of Cameroon. It has a population of more than 2.8 million, which makes it the second-largest city in the country after the port city Douala.

Q373348.name: Russell County
Q373348.about: Russell County is a county located in the U.S. Commonwealth of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,991.

Q373564.name: Liaocheng
Q373564.about: Liaocheng (Chinese: 聊城; pinyin: Liáochéng) is a prefecture-level city in western Shandong province, China. It borders the provincial capital of Jinan to the southeast, Dezhou to the northeast, Tai'an to the south, and the provinces of Hebei and Henan to the west.

Q373575.name: Fallon County
Q373575.about: Fallon County is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 3,049.

Q373687.name: Binzhou
Q373687.about: Binzhou (Chinese: 滨州, bin-joe), formerly Putai, is a prefecture-level city in northern Shandong Province in the People's Republic of China. The city proper sits on the northern bank of the Yellow River, while its administrative area straddles both sides of its lower course before its present delta.

Q373886.name: Washington County
Q373886.about: Washington County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Washington.
Q373886.img: Washington County, Kansas courthouse from W 2.JPG

Q3711.name: Belgrade
Q3711.desc: capital and largest city of Serbia
Q3711.about: Belgrade ( bel-GRAYD or  BEL-grayd; Serbian: Београд / Beograd, lit. 'White City', pronounced [beǒɡrad] ) is the capital and largest city of Serbia. It is located at the confluence of the Sava and Danube rivers and at the crossroads of the Pannonian Plain and the Balkan Peninsula.

Q3826.name: Muscat
Q3826.about: Muscat ( MUSK-at, -⁠ət, US also  -⁠aht; Arabic: مَسْقَط, romanized: Masqaṭ, pronounced [ˈmasqatˤ] ) is the capital and most populous city of Oman. It is the seat of the Governorate of Muscat.

Q3832.name: Bangui
Q3832.desc: capital city of the Central African Republic
Q3832.about: Bangui (French pronunciation: [bɑ̃ɡi]; or Bangî in Sango, formerly written Bangi in English) is the capital and largest city of the Central African Republic. Q37100.about: Auckland is a large metropolitan city in the North Island of New Zealand. It has an urban population of approximately 1,547,200 (June 2025).

Q37112.name: Kalaburagi
Q37112.about: Kalaburagi, formerly known as Gulbarga, is a city in the Indian state of Karnataka. It is headquarters of the eponymous Kalaburagi district and Kalaburagi division.

Q37320.name: Cleveland
Q37320.desc: city in and county seat of Cuyahoga County, Ohio, United States
Q37320.about: Cleveland ( KLEEV-lənd) is a city in the U.S. state of Ohio, located along the southern shore of Lake Erie.  It is across the lake from the Canadian province of  Ontario, and is approximately 60 miles (97 kilometers) west of the Ohio–Pennsylvania state line.

Q377131.name: Greeley County
Q377131.about: Greeley County is a county located in western Kansas, in the Central United States. Its county seat and largest city is Tribune.
Q377131.img: Greeley County, Kansas courthouse W entrance.JPG

Q377148.name: Geary County
Q377148.about: Geary County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas. Its county seat and most populous city is Junction City.

Q377157.name: Hamilton County
Q377157.about: Hamilton County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and most populous city is Syracuse.

Q377162.name: Norton County
Q377162.about: Norton County is a county in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Norton.

Q377171.name: Harper County
Q377171.about: Harper County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and most populous city is Anthony.

Q377181.name: Morton County
Q377181.about: Morton County is a county in the southwestern corner of the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat and largest city is Elkhart.

Q377234.name: Anderson County
Q377234.about: Anderson County is a county located in East Central Kansas, in the Central United States. Its county seat and most populous city is Garnett.

Q377952.name: Pleasants County
Q377952.desc: county in West Virginia, United States
Q377952.about: Pleasants County is a county located in the U.S. state of West Virginia. At the 2020 census, the population was 7,653.

Q378438.name: Marion County
Q378438.about: Marion County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois, in the southern half of the state known as "Little Egypt". According to the 2020 census, it had a population of 37,729.

Q35728355.name: Metairie Terrace
Q35728355.desc: human settlement in Jefferson Parish, Louisiana, United States of America

Q37995.name: Yangon
Q37995.desc: former capital of Myanmar (Burma) and the current capital of Yangon Region
Q37995.about: Yangon, also romanized in English as Rangoon,  is the capital city of the Yangon Region and the largest city of Myanmar. Yangon was the capital city of Myanmar until 2005 and served as such until 2006, when the military government relocated the administrative functions to the purpose-built capital city of Naypyidaw in north central Myanmar.

Q38022.name: St. Louis
Q38022.desc: independent city in Missouri, United States
Q38022.about: St. Louis (officially the City of St.

Q38283.name: Yokohama
Q38283.desc: designated city in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan
Q38283.about: Yokohama (横浜市, Yokohama-shi; [jò̞.kó̞.hä́.mä́(.ɕì)] ) is the second-largest city in Japan by population as well as by area, and the country's most populous municipality. It is the capital and most populous city in Kanagawa Prefecture, with a population of 3.7 million in 2023.
Q38283.img: Minato-mirai from Yamashita Park at night.jpg

Q381896.name: Regional Municipality of Niagara
Q381896.desc: Regional Municipality in the Golden Horseshoe area of the Province of Ontario, Canada.
Q381896.about: The Regional Municipality of Niagara, also colloquially known as the Niagara Region or Region of Niagara, is a regional municipality in Southern Ontario, Canada, which occupies most of the Niagara Peninsula. As of 2024, the region had an estimated population of 539,180.

Q382458.name: Regional Municipality of Halton
Q382458.about: The Regional Municipality of Halton (), or Halton Region, is a regional municipality in Ontario, Canada, located in the Golden Horseshoe of Southern Ontario. It comprises the city of Burlington and the towns of Oakville, Milton, and Halton Hills.

Q382508.name: Muskoka District Municipality
Q382508.about: The District Municipality of Muskoka, often referred to as the District of Muskoka or simply Muskoka, is a regional municipality in Central Ontario, Canada. It extends from Georgian Bay in the west, to the northern tip of Lake Couchiching in the south, to the western border of Algonquin Provincial Park in the east.

Q382652.name: Oxford County
Q382652.about: Oxford County is a regional municipality in the Canadian province of Ontario. Highway 401 runs east–west through the centre of the county, creating an urban industrial corridor with more than half the county's population, spanning 25 km between the Toyota auto assembly plant in Woodstock and the CAMI General Motors auto assembly plant in Ingersoll.

Q382993.name: Crawford County
Q382993.about: Crawford County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. Its population was 12,988 as of the 2020 census.

Q383434.name: Greater Sudbury
Q383434.desc: city and unitary authority in Ontario, Canada
Q383434.about: Greater Sudbury (French: Grand Sudbury), also known as Sudbury, is the most populous city in Northern Ontario with a population  around 166,004 in 2021. Greater Sudbury is the only single-tier municipality in Northern Ontario, the largest city in Ontario by area and the fifth largest in Canada.

Q3555926.name: Lucentum
Q3555926.desc: human settlement in Alicante, L'Alacantí, Alicante Province, Spain
Q3555926.about: Lucentum (Ancient Greek: Λούκεντον, Loúkenton), called Lucentia by Pomponius Mela, is the Roman predecessor of the city of Alicante, Spain. Particularly, it refers to the archaeological site in which the remains of this ancient settlement lie, at a place known as El Tossal de Manises, in the neighborhood of Albufereta.

Q3567449.name: West Town
Q3567449.desc: community area in Chicago, Illinois, United States
Q3567449.about:
West Town is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States, located on the northwest of the Loop.
Much of this area was historically part of Polish Downtown, along Western Avenue, which was then the city's western boundary.

Q3569134.name: Willowdale
Q3569134.desc: human settlement in Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Q3569134.about: Willowdale is a neighbourhood in the city of Toronto, Ontario, Canada, located in the district and former township of North York. It developed from three postal villages: Newtonbrook, Willowdale and Lansing.

Q3622137.name: Luancheng
Q3622137.desc: town in Hebei, People's Republic of China
Q3622137.about: Luancheng (simplified Chinese: 栾城; traditional Chinese: 欒城; pinyin: Luánchéng) is a town in and the seat of Luancheng District of Shijiazhuang, in southwestern Hebei province, China, about 20 km (12 mi) south of the provincial capital of Shijiazhuang along China National Highway 308. As of 2011, it has 47 villages under its administration.

Q3635276.name: Kurnool
Q3635276.desc: city in Kurnool district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q3635276.about: Kurnool is a city in the state of Andhra Pradesh, India. It formerly served as the capital of Andhra State (1953–1956).

Q3636023.name: Vijayapura
Q3636023.about: Bijapur (officially Vijayapura) is the district headquarters of the Bijapur district of the Karnataka state of India. It is also the headquarters for Bijapur Taluk.

Q3695832.name: Jalalpur Pirwala
Q3695832.about: Jalalpur Pirwala (Urdu: جلالپُور پِيروالا) is a city and the capital of Jalalpur Pirwala Tehsil, Multan District, Pakistan. This city is about 90 km south of Multan city.

Q3695904.name: Chunian
Q3695904.about: Chunian  (Urdu: چُونياں), is a historic city and the capital of Chunian Tehsil of Punjab, Pakistan. It is located at 30° 58' N 73° 51' E and at an elevation of 177 meters (583 feet), and lies about 70 km south of Lahore, the capital of Punjab.

Q3712111.name: Division No. 2
Q3712111.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3712111.about: Division No. 2, Newfoundland and Labrador is a census division in the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador, primarily comprising the Burin Peninsula.

Q3712113.name: Division No. 3
Q3712113.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3712113.about: Division No. 3, Newfoundland and Labrador is a census division in the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador, primarily comprising the South Coast of the island of Newfoundland, starting roughly 10km northwest of Channel-Port aux Basques and ending roughly 10km east of Rencontre East.

Q3712119.name: Division No. 7
