Q3712119.desc: census division in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Q3712119.about: Division No. 7, Newfoundland and Labrador is a census division in the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador, primarily comprising the Bonavista Bay region.

Q384.name: Skopje
Q384.about: Skopje is the capital and largest city of North Macedonia. It lies in the northern part of the country, in the Skopje Valley along the Vardar River, and is the political, economic, and cultural centre of the country.

Q383600.name: Sudbury District
Q383600.about: The Sudbury District is a district in Northeastern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario. It was created in 1894 from townships of eastern Algoma District and west Nipissing District.

Q383739.name: DeSoto Parish
Q383739.about: DeSoto Parish (Spanish: Parroquia de DeSoto; French: Paroisse DeSoto) is a parish located in the U.S. state of Louisiana. The parish was formed in 1843.
Q383739.img: DeSoto Parish Courthouse in Mansfield, LA IMG 2421.JPG

Q384737.name: Jefferson County
Q384737.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q384737.about: Jefferson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 32,977.

Q384754.name: York County
Q384754.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q384754.about: York County is a county on the north central border in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 282,090, making it the seventh-most populous county in the state.

Q384755.name: Kawartha Lakes
Q384755.about: Kawartha Lakes (2021 population: 79,247) is a single-tier municipality in Central Ontario, Canada. Though structured as a single-tier municipality, Kawartha Lakes is the size of a typical Ontario county and is mostly rural.

Q384890.name: Chatham County
Q384890.about: Chatham County ( CHAT-əm) is the easternmost county in the U.S. state of Georgia, on the state's Atlantic coast. The county seat and largest city is Savannah.

Q384944.name: County of Brant
Q384944.about: The County of Brant (2021 population 39,474) is a single-tier municipality in the Canadian province of Ontario. Although it retains the word "county" in its name, the municipality is a single-tier municipal government and has no upper tier.

Q385085.name: Prince Edward County
Q385085.about: Prince Edward County (PEC) is a single-tier municipality in southern Ontario, Canada on the Bay of Quinte. Located on  Lake Ontario’s northeastern shore, the area is known for Sandbanks Provincial Park and as a cottage country and wine country destination due to its waterfront forested landscapes and many small wineries.
Q385085.img: Mariners Memorial Park, Prince Edward County, Southwest view 20170416 1.jpg

Q385229.name: Norfolk County
Q385229.about: Norfolk County ( NOR-fohk) is a rural single-tier municipality on the north shore of Lake Erie in Southwestern Ontario, Canada with a 2023 population of 73,015. Despite its name, it is no longer a county by definition, as all municipal services are handled by a single level of government.

Q41572.name: Mykolaiv
Q41572.desc: capital city of Mykolaiv Oblast in southern Ukraine
Q41572.about: Mykolaiv (Ukrainian: Миколаїв [mɪkoˈlɑjiu̯] , Russian: Николаев, romanized: Nikolayev [nʲɪkɐˈla(j)ɪf]) is a port city and a hromada (municipality) in southern Ukraine. Mykolaiv is the administrative center of Mykolaiv Raion (district) and Mykolaiv Oblast (province).

Q3838.name: Kinshasa
Q3838.desc: capital and the largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo having the status of a province
Q3838.about: Kinshasa (; French: [kinʃasa]; Lingala: Kinsásá), formerly named Léopoldville (Dutch: Leopoldstad) from 1881 to 1966, is the capital and largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kinshasa is one of the world's fastest-growing megacities, with an estimated population of 18.5 million in 2026.

Q42053.name: Isfahan
Q42053.about: Isfahan (Persian: اصفهان [esfæˈhɒːn] ) is a city in the Central District of Isfahan County, Isfahan Province, Iran. It is the capital of the province, the county, and the district.

Q386271.name: Pickaway County
Q386271.about: Pickaway County is a county in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 58,539.

Q386338.name: Whitby
Q386338.desc: town in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada
Q386338.about: Whitby is a town in Durham Region in Ontario, Canada. Whitby is located in Southern Ontario 11 km (6.8 mi) east of Ajax and 8 km (5.0 mi) west of Oshawa, on the north shore of Lake Ontario and is home to the headquarters of Durham Region.

Q3856.name: Nicosia
Q3856.about: Nicosia, also known as Lefkosia or Lefkoşa, is the capital of Cyprus. It is the southeasternmost capital city among European Union member states.
Q3856.img: Nicosia 01-2017 img23 View from Shacolas Tower.jpg

Q3859.name: Kigali
Q3859.desc: province-level city, capital and largest city of Rwanda
Q3859.about: Kigali (Kinyarwanda pronunciation: [ki.ɡɑ́.ɾi]), officially the City of Kigali also known as Kigali City (abbreviated as KGL), is the capital, largest city, and a province-level administrative unit of Rwanda. It is located near the country's geographic centre, in a landscape of rolling hills marked by valleys and ridges connected by steep slopes.

Q42099.name: Bucheon
Q42099.desc: city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea
Q42099.about: Bucheon (Korean: 부천; Korean pronunciation: [pu.tɕʰʌn]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Bucheon is located 25 kilometers (16 mi) away from Seoul, of which it is a satellite city.

Q42112.name: Suncheon
Q42112.about: Suncheon (Korean: 순천; Korean pronunciation: [sʰun.tɕʰʌn]) is the largest city in Jeonnam-Gwangju, South Korea, with a population of 280,719 as of 2022. It is located in the southeast of the province and is a scenic agricultural and industrial city, known for tourist attractions, such as Suncheon Bay.

Q42117.name: Ansan
Q42117.about: Ansan (Korean: 안산, Korean pronunciation: [an.san]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.  It lies southwest of Seoul and is part of the Seoul Metropolitan Area.

Q42123.name: Yangsan
Q42123.desc: a city in South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea
Q42123.about:
Yangsan (Korean: 양산; Korean pronunciation: [jaŋ.san]) is a city in Gyeongsangnam-do Province, South Korea.
It borders Ulsan to the northeast, Gijang-gun and Geumjeong District in Busan to the southeast, Gimhae to the southwest, and Miryang to the northwest.

Q42125.name: Yeosu
Q42125.about: Yeosu (Korean: 여수; Korean pronunciation: [jʌ.sʰu]; formerly romanized as Yŏsu) is a coastal city located in Jeonnam-Gwangju, South Korea. It has a population of 268,823.

Q42131.name: Wonju
Q42131.about: Wonju (Korean: 원주; Korean pronunciation: [wʌn.dʑu]) is the most populous city in the state of Gangwon, South Korea, with a population of 364,860 as of 2023. The city is located approximately 140 kilometres (87 mi) east of Seoul.

Q42137.name: Iksan
Q42137.about:
Iksan (Korean: 익산; Korean pronunciation: [ik̚.s͈an]) is a city and major railway junction in North Jeolla Province, South Korea.
The city center and railway junction was formerly called "Iri" (Korean: 이리시; Hanja: 裡里市), but merged with Iksan County (Iksan-gun) in 1995.

Q387136.name: Kawaguchi
Q387136.about: Kawaguchi (川口市, Kawaguchi-shi) is a city located in southeastern Saitama Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 April 2025, the city had an estimated population of 595,011 in 293,582 households and a population density of 9605 persons per km2.

Q387216.name: Schley County
Q387216.about: Schley County ( SLY) is a county located in the west-central portion of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 U.S. census, its population was 4,547.

Q387322.name: Centennial
Q387322.desc: city in Arapahoe County, Colorado, United States of America
Q387322.about: Centennial is a home rule city located in Arapahoe County, Colorado, United States. The city population was 108,418 at the 2020 United States census, making Centennial the 11th most populous municipality in Colorado.

Q387555.name: Terrebonne Parish
Q387555.about: Terrebonne Parish ( TERR-ə-BOHN; French: Paroisse de Terrebonne) is a parish located in the southern part of the U.S. state of Louisiana. At the 2020 census, the population was 109,580.
Q387555.img: Terrebonne Parish Courthouse Houma Louisiana WPA.jpg

Q385.name: Gdynia
Q385.about: Gdynia is a city in northern Poland and a seaport on the Baltic Sea coast. With a population of c. 239,000, it is the 12th-largest city in Poland and the second-largest in the Pomeranian Voivodeship after Gdańsk.

Q406.name: Istanbul
Q406.about: Istanbul (Greek: Κωνσταντινούπολη) is the largest city in Turkey, a megacity, constituting the country's economic, cultural, and historical center. With a population of over 15 million, it is home to 18% of the population of Turkey.

Q41621.name: Haifa
Q41621.about: Haifa ( HY-fə; Hebrew: חיפה, romanized: Ḥayfā, IPA: [ˈχajfa]; Arabic: حيفا, romanized: Ḥayfā, IPA: [ħaj.faː]) is the third-largest city in Israel—after Jerusalem and Tel Aviv—with a population of 297,082 in 2024. The city of Haifa forms part of the Haifa metropolitan area, the third-most populous metropolitan area in Israel.

Q41699.name: Castries
Q41699.about: Castries ( ) is the capital and largest city of Saint Lucia, an island country in the Caribbean. The urban area has a population of approximately 20,000, while the eponymous district has a population of just under 70,000, as of May 2013.

Q41819.name: Kansas City
Q41819.desc: city in Missouri, United States, that is one of two county seats of Jackson County and the largest city in Missouri
Q41819.about: Kansas City, abbreviated KC or KCMO, is the largest city in the U.S. state of Missouri by both population and area. It is located on the Missouri River at its confluence with the Kansas River, within Jackson, Clay, Platte and Cass counties.

Q385341.name: Jimma
Q385341.about: Jimma (Oromo: Jimmaa) is the largest city in southwestern Oromia Region, Ethiopia. It is a special zone of the Oromia Region and is surrounded by Jimma Zone.

Q385365.name: Cecil County
Q385365.about: Cecil County is located in the U.S. state of Maryland at the northeastern corner of the state, bordering both Pennsylvania and Delaware. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 103,725.

Q385689.name: Thunder Bay District
Q385689.about: Thunder Bay District is a district and census division in Northwestern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario. The district seat is Thunder Bay.

Q385780.name: Timiskaming District
Q385780.about: Timiskaming is a district and census division in Northeastern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario. The district was created in 1912 from parts of Algoma, Nipissing, and Sudbury districts.

Q385931.name: Franklin County
Q385931.about: Franklin County is a county in the Northeast region of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 23,424.

Q386189.name: Washington County
Q386189.about: Washington County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 22,565.

Q3861.name: Doha
Q3861.about: Doha is the capital and largest city, and main financial hub of Qatar. Located on the Persian Gulf coast in the east of the country, north of Al Wakrah and south of Al Khor and Lusail, it is home to most of the country's population.

Q3866.name: Dodoma
Q3866.about: Dodoma  (lit. 'It has sunk' in Gogo), officially Dodoma City (Jiji Kuu la Dodoma, in Swahili), is the capital city of Tanzania. With a population of 765,179 as of 2022 which is projected to reach 1,000,000 by the end of 2026 (given the current pace of relocation of government organizations and NGOs), it is also the administrative capital of both Dodoma Municipal Council and the entire Dodoma Region.
Q3866.img: Scene at Nyerere Square, Dodoma City.jpg

Q42140.name: Jeonju
Q42140.desc: capital of North Jeolla Province, South Korea
Q42140.about: Jeonju (Korean: 전주; Korean pronunciation: [t͡ɕʌɲ.d͡ʑu], lit. 'Perfect region') is the capital and largest city of the province of Jeonbuk, South Korea. It is both urban and rural due to the closeness of Wanju County which almost entirely surrounds Jeonju (Wanju County has many residents who work in Jeonju).

Q42142.name: Jeju
Q42142.about: Jeju City (Korean: 제주; Korean pronunciation: [tɕe.dʑu]) is the capital of the Jeju Province in South Korea and the largest city on Jeju Island. The city is served by Jeju International Airport (IATA code CJU).

Q42144.name: Jinju
Q42144.desc: Jinju City, the largest city in western South Gyeongsang Province, where the western office of Gyeongsangnam-do Office is located
Q42144.about: Jinju (Korean: 진주; Korean pronunciation: [tɕin.dʑu]) is a city in South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea. It was the location of the first (1592) and second (1593) Sieges of Jinju by Japanese forces during the Imjin War.

Q42146.name: Cheonan
Q42146.about: Cheonan (Korean: 천안; Korean pronunciation: [tɕʰʌ.nan] ) is the largest and most densely populated city of South Chungcheong Province, South Korea, and the third largest city in the Hoseo region after Daejeon and Cheongju. Cheonan borders Gyeonggi Province (Pyeongtaek and Anseong) in the north, North Chungcheong Province (Jincheon County and Cheongju) to the east and southeast, Sejong to the south and Asan and Gongju to the west and southwest.

Q42147.name: Cheongju
Q42147.desc: City in North Chungcheong Province, South Korea
Q42147.about: Cheongju (Korean: 청주; Korean pronunciation: [tɕʰʌŋ.dʑu]) is the capital and largest city of North Chungcheong Province in South Korea. The "Cheong" in the name of the province is the same as in Cheongju.

Q42148.name: Chuncheon
Q42148.desc: city in South Korea, capital of Gangwon Province
Q42148.about: Chuncheon (Korean: 춘천) is the capital city of Gangwon Province, South Korea. Its population is about 290,000 as of 2026.

Q387978.name: Gallatin County
Q387978.about: Gallatin County is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. With its county seat in Bozeman, it is the second-most-populous county in Montana, with a population of 118,960 in the 2020 census.

Q388108.name: Sohag
Q388108.about: Sohag (Arabic: سوهاج, romanized: Sawhāj, Egyptian Arabic pronunciation: [soˈhæːɡ], Sa'idi Arabic pronunciation: [suːˈhaːdʒ]), also spelled as Suhag or Suhaj, is a city on the west bank of the Nile in Egypt. It has been the capital of Sohag Governorate since 1960, before which the capital was Girga and the name of the governorate was Girga Governorate.

Q388130.name: Yarmouth County
Q388130.about: Yarmouth County is a rural county in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia. It has both traditional Anglo-Scottish and Acadian French culture as well as significant inland wilderness areas, including over 365 lakes and several major rivers.

Q388242.name: Tete
Q388242.about: Tete is the capital city of Tete Province in Mozambique.  It is located on the Zambezi River, and is the site of two of the four bridges crossing the river in Mozambique.

Q389365.name: White County
Q389365.about: White County is a county in the Northeast region of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 28,003.
Q389365.img: White County Courthouse Museum, Cleveland GA April 2017.jpg

Q389483.name: West Allis
Q389483.desc: city in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin, USA
Q389483.about: West Allis is a city in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin, United States. A suburb of Milwaukee, it is part of the Milwaukee metropolitan area.
Q389483.img: West Allis July 2023 44 (Greenfield School--West Allis Historical Society Museum).jpg

Q389551.name: Jenkins County
Q389551.about: Jenkins County is a county located in the southeastern area of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 8,674.

Q3844.name: Brazzaville
Q3844.desc: capital of the Republic of the Congo
Q3844.about: Brazzaville (French pronunciation: [bʁazavil]) is the capital and largest city of the Republic of the Congo. Administratively, it is a department and a commune.

Q3854.name: Bujumbura
Q3854.about: Bujumbura (French pronunciation: [buʒumbuʁa]; Kirundi pronunciation: [buʒuᵐbuɾa]), formerly Usumbura, is the economic capital, former political capital, largest city and main port of Burundi. It ships most of the country's chief export, coffee, as well as cotton and tin ore.

Q42059.name: Gyeongsan
Q42059.desc: city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea
Q42059.about: Gyeongsan (Korean: 경산; Korean pronunciation: [kjʌŋ.san]) is a satellite city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea. Its western border abuts the metropolitan city of Daegu, and much of Gyeongsan lies within the Daegu metropolitan area.

Q42061.name: Goyang
Q42061.desc: city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea
Q42061.about: Goyang (Korean: 고양; Korean pronunciation: [ko.jaŋ]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province in the northern part of South Korea. It is part of the Seoul Metropolitan Area, making Goyang one of Seoul's satellite cities.

Q42073.name: Gumi
Q42073.desc: city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea
Q42073.about: Gumi (Korean: 구미; Korean pronunciation: [ku.mi]) is the second largest and most densely populated city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea. It is located on the Nakdong River, halfway between Daegu and Gimcheon, also lies on the Gyeongbu Expressway and Gyeongbu Line railway which are the principal traffic routes of the country.

Q42074.name: Gunsan
Q42074.about: Gunsan (Korean: 군산; [kun.sʰan]), also romanized as Kunsan, is a city in North Jeolla Province, South Korea. It is on the south bank of the Geum River just upstream from its exit into the Yellow Sea.

Q42075.name: Gunpo
Q42075.about: Gunpo (Korean: 군포; Korean pronunciation: [kun.pʰo]), formerly romanized as Kunp'o, is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. It is south of Seoul and in the Seoul National Capital Area.

Q42094.name: Mokpo
Q42094.desc: city in South Jeolla Province, South Korea
Q42094.about: Mokpo (Korean: 목포; Korean pronunciation: [mok̚.pʰo]) is a city in Jeonnam-Gwangju, South Korea. It is located at the southwestern tip of the Korean Peninsula, close to the mountain Yudalsan.

Q386567.name: Ajax
Q386567.desc: town in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada
Q386567.about:
Ajax (; 2021 population: 126,666) is a waterfront town in Durham Region in Southern Ontario, Canada, located in the eastern part of the Greater Toronto Area.
The town is named for HMS Ajax, a Royal Navy cruiser that served in the Second World War.
Q386567.img: Aerial Photograph of Ajax, Ontario - Discover The Town Of Ajax (01m08s) (edited).jpg

Q386626.name: Pickering
Q386626.desc: city in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada
Q386626.about: Pickering (2021 census population: 99,186) is a city located in Southern Ontario, Canada, immediately east of Toronto in the Regional Municipality of Durham. It is named after the town of Pickering, in North Yorkshire.

Q386661.name: Fujisawa
Q386661.about: Fujisawa (藤沢市, Fujisawa-shi) is a city in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 June 2021, the city had an estimated population of 439,728 and a population density of 6300 persons per km2.

Q386885.name: Flagler County
Q386885.desc: county in Florida, United States of America
Q386885.about:
Flagler County is situated in the northeastern quadrant of the U.S. state of Florida. 
The population  as of the 2020 census was 115,378.
Q386885.img: Bunnell Coquina City Hall - Full Front View with Lake Lucille & Fountain.jpg

Q386961.name: Des Plaines
Q386961.desc: city in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q386961.about: Des Plaines ( dis PLAYNZ) is a city in Cook County, Illinois, United States. Per the 2020 census, the population was 60,675.

Q386991.name: Torreón
Q386991.desc: municipal seat of Torreón, State of Coahuila, Mexico
Q386991.about: Torreón (Spanish pronunciation: [toreˈon] ) is a city and seat of Torreón Municipality in the Mexican state of Coahuila. The city's population is 720,848 inhabitants, making it the second largest city in the state of Coahuila.

Q42735.name: Olympia
Q42735.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Washington and seat of Thurston County
Q42735.about: Olympia is the capital city of the U.S. state of Washington. The population was 55,605 at the 2020 census, while the Olympia metropolitan statistical area has an estimated 300,000 residents.

Q42751.name: Palikir
Q42751.desc: capital of Federated States of Micronesia
Q42751.about: Palikir () is the capital city of the Federated States of Micronesia located in the western Pacific Ocean. A town of slightly above 5,000 residents, it is part of the larger Sokehs municipality, which had a population of 6,964 as of 2024, out of the nation's total population of 106,487.

Q3870.name: Nairobi
Q3870.about: Nairobi (  ny-ROH-bee) (Jiji kuu la Nairobi, in Swahili),  is the capital and largest city of Kenya, located in the south-central part of the country. As of 2026, it has a population of 5.6 million and a metropolitan population of 15.95 million, making it the 8th most populous city in Africa and the 4th most populous metropolitan area.

Q3876.name: Lilongwe
Q3876.about: Lilongwe (UK: , US: ,) is the capital and largest city of Malawi. It has a population of 989,318 as of the 2018 Census, up from a population of 674,448 in 2008.

Q42153.name: Paju
Q42153.about: Paju (Korean: 파주; Korean pronunciation: [pʰɐ.d͡ʑu]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Paju was made a city in 1997; it had previously been a county (gun).

Q42154.name: Pyeongtaek
Q42154.desc: city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea
Q42154.about: Pyeongtaek (Korean: 평택; Korean pronunciation: [pʰjʌŋ.tʰɛk̚]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Located in the southwestern part of the province, Pyeongtaek was founded as a union of two districts in 1940.

Q42157.name: Pohang
Q42157.desc: city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea
Q42157.about:
Pohang (Korean: 포항; Korean pronunciation: [pʰo.ɦaŋ]) is the largest city in  North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea, with a population of 499,363 as of 2022, bordering the East Sea to the east, Yeongcheon to the west, Gyeongju to the south, and Cheongsong and Yeongdeok County to the north.
The city has food, textile, and metal industries.

Q42159.name: Hanam
Q42159.desc: city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea
Q42159.about: Hanam (Korean: 하남; Korean pronunciation: [ha.nam]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.  Formerly a part of Gwangju County, it was designated a city in 1989.

Q42160.name: Hwaseong
Q42160.desc: city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea
Q42160.about: Hwaseong (Korean: 화성; Korean pronunciation: [ɸa.sʰʌŋ]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. It is located on the coast of the Yellow Sea.

Q42308.name: Kharkiv
Q42308.desc: capital city of Kharkiv Oblast in eastern Ukraine
Q42308.about: Kharkiv, also known as Kharkov, is the second-largest city in Ukraine. Located in the northeast of the country, it is the largest city of the historic region of Sloboda Ukraine.

Q389573.name: Champaign County
Q389573.about: Champaign County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 38,714.

Q389783.name: Johnson County
Q389783.about: Johnson County is a county in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it has a population of 13,308.

Q390141.name: York County
Q390141.about: York County is the southernmost county in the U.S. state of Maine, along the state of New Hampshire's eastern border. It is divided from Strafford County, New Hampshire, by the Salmon Falls River and the connected tidal estuary, the Piscataqua River.

Q390583.name: Surrey
Q390583.desc: second largest city in British Columbia, Canada
Q390583.about: Surrey ( SURR-ee) is a city in British Columbia, Canada. It is located south of the Fraser River on the Canada–United States border.

Q391221.name: Barcelona
Q391221.about: Barcelona, originally called Nueva Barcelona, is the capital of Anzoátegui State in Venezuela. Together with Puerto La Cruz, Lechería and Guanta, Barcelona forms Barcelona-Puerto La Cruz with a population of approximately 950,000.

Q392599.name: Everett
Q392599.desc: city in and county seat of Snohomish County, Washington, United States of America
Q392599.about: Everett ( EV-rit; Lushootseed: dᶻəɬigʷəd [d͜zəˈɬi̞ɡʷəd]) is the county seat of and the most populous city in Snohomish County, Washington, United States. It is 25 miles (40 km) north of Seattle and is one of the main cities in the metropolitan area and the Puget Sound region.

Q3901.name: Moroni
Q3901.about: Moroni (French pronunciation: [mɔʁɔni] ; Arabic: موروني, romanized:  Mūrūnī) is the largest city, national capital, and seat of the government of the Union of the Comoros, a sovereign archipelago nation in the Indian Ocean. Moroni means "at the river" (mroni in Shingazidja).

Q3904.name: Mbabane
Q3904.about:
Mbabane () is the most populous city in Eswatini (previously called Swaziland), and is one of the two capitals (along with Lobamba), serving as the executive capital.
It has an estimated population of 94,874 (2010).

Q3909.name: Maseru
Q3909.about: Maseru is the capital and largest city of Lesotho. It is also the capital of the Maseru District.

Q403184.name: Wayne County
Q403184.about: Wayne County is a county located in the northeastern quadrant of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 116,894.

Q403310.name: Richland County
Q403310.about: Richland County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 124,936.

Q403319.name: Wyandot County
Q403319.about: Wyandot County is a county located in the northwestern part of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,900.

Q403544.name: Ashland County
Q403544.about: Ashland County is a county located in the northeastern portion of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 52,447.

Q403777.name: Crawford County
Q403777.about: Crawford County is a county located in the north central portion of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 42,025.

Q404116.name: Pingdingshan
Q404116.about: Pingdingshan (simplified Chinese: 平顶山; traditional Chinese: 平頂山; pinyin: Píngdǐngshān), also known as Eagle City (simplified Chinese: 鹰城; traditional Chinese: 鷹城; pinyin: Yīngchéng), is a prefecture-level city in central Henan province, China. It had 4,904,701 inhabitants at the 2010 census whom 1,756,333 lived in the built-up (or metro) area including Ye county being conurbated.

Q404301.name: Hebi
Q404301.about: Hebi (simplified Chinese: 鹤壁; traditional Chinese: 鶴壁; pinyin: Hèbì [xɤ̂.pî]; postal: Hopi) is a prefecture-level city in northern Henan province, China. Situated in mountainous terrain at the edge of the Shanxi plateau, Hebi is about 25 miles (40 km) south of Anyang, 40 miles (64 km) northeast of Xinxiang and 65 miles (105 km) north of Kaifeng.
Q404301.img: 20241201 View of Xun County from Dapi Mountain.jpg

Q404429.name: Jiaozuo
Q404429.about: Jiaozuo (Chinese: 焦作; pinyin: Jiāozuò [tɕjáʊ.tswô]; postal: Tsiaotso) is a prefecture-level city in the northwest of Henan province, China. Sitting on the northern bank of the Yellow River, it borders the provincial capital of Zhengzhou to the south, Xinxiang to the east, Jiyuan to the west, Luoyang to the southwest, and the province of Shanxi to the north.

Q404599.name: Luohe
Q404599.about: Luohe (Chinese: 漯河; pinyin: Luòhé; postal: Loho) is a prefecture-level city in central Henan province, China. It is surrounded by the cities of Xuchang, Zhoukou, Zhumadian and Pingdingshan on its north, east, south and west respectively.

Q3889.name: Maputo
Q3889.desc: capital and chief port of Mozambique
Q3889.about: Maputo (Portuguese pronunciation: [mɐˈputu]) is the capital and largest city of Mozambique. Located near the southern end of the country, it is within 120 kilometres (75 miles) of the borders with Eswatini and South Africa.

Q3894.name: Kampala
Q3894.desc: capital and the largest city of Uganda
Q3894.about: Kampala (UK: , US:  ) is the capital and largest city of Uganda. The city proper has a population of 1,797,722 (2024 census) and is divided into the five political divisions of Kampala Central, Kawempe, Makindye, Nakawa, and Rubaga.
Q3894.img: View from 7th floor on Crane Chambers at Kampala road - panoramio.jpg

Q3897.name: Luanda
Q3897.about: Luanda is the capital and largest city of Angola. It is Angola's primary port, and its major industrial, cultural and urban centre.

Q42635.name: Wenzhou
Q42635.about: Wenzhou, formerly known as Yongjia, is a prefecture-level city in Zhejiang, China. Situated on the southeastern coast of China, the city sits at the lower reaches and estuary of the Ou River, bordered by the Zhejiang–Fujian Hills to the west and the East China Sea to the east.

Q42651.name: Wuxi
Q42651.about: Wuxi is a city in southern Jiangsu, China. As of 2024, it had a population of 7,495,000.

Q42664.name: Huzhou
Q42664.about: Huzhou (Chinese: 湖州; pinyin: Húzhōu, ; Huzhou dialect: ghou² cieu¹) is a prefecture-level city in northern Zhejiang province (Hangzhou–Jiaxing–Huzhou Plain, China). Lying south of Lake Tai, it borders Jiaxing to the east, Hangzhou to the south, and the provinces of Anhui and Jiangsu to the west and north respectively.

Q42666.name: Shaoxing
Q42666.about: Shaoxing is a prefecture-level city on the southern shore of Hangzhou Bay in northeastern Zhejiang province, China. Located on the south bank of the Qiantang River estuary, it borders Ningbo to the east, Taizhou to the southeast, Jinhua to the southwest, and Hangzhou to the west.

Q400747.name: Crittenden County
Q400747.about: Crittenden County is a county in the U.S. state of Kentucky. At the 2020 census, the population was 8,990.

Q400753.name: Elliott County
Q400753.about: Elliott County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. Its county seat is Sandy Hook.

Q400757.name: Daviess County
Q400757.about: Daviess County ( "Davis"), is a county in Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 103,312.

Q402259.name: Stevens County
Q402259.about: Stevens County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kansas.  Its county seat is Hugoton.

Q402938.name: Hancock County
Q402938.about: Hancock County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 74,920.

Q402945.name: Paulding County
Q402945.about: Paulding County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 18,806.

Q3881.name: Lusaka
Q3881.about: Lusaka ( loo-SAH-kə) is the capital and largest city of Zambia. It is one of the fastest-developing cities in southern Africa.

Q3882.name: Manama
Q3882.about: Manama (Arabic: اَلْمَنَامَة, romanized: al-Manāma, Bahrani pronunciation: [elmɐˈnɑːmɐ]) is the capital and largest city of Bahrain, with an approximate population of 743,066 as of 2025 estimate. Long an important trading center in the Persian Gulf, Manama is home to a diverse population.

Q42448.name: Sheffield
Q42448.desc: city in South Yorkshire, England, United Kingdom
Q42448.about: Sheffield is a city in South Yorkshire, England, situated 29 miles (47 km) south of Leeds and 32 miles (51 km) east of Manchester. It is the second largest city in Yorkshire and the administrative centre of the larger metropolitan borough of Sheffield, which had an estimated population of 579,517 in 2025.

Q42622.name: Suzhou
Q42622.desc: prefecture-level city in Jiangsu, China, former capital of the kingdom of Wu
Q42622.about: Suzhou is a prefecture-level city in Jiangsu province, Eastern China. Suzhou is a major tourist destination and industrial hub of Eastern China, specializing in high-end manufacturing.

Q394080.name: Beni Suef
Q394080.about: Beni Suef (Egyptian Arabic: بنى سويف, romanized: Baniswēf) is the capital city of the Beni Suef Governorate in Egypt. The city is the location of Beni Suef University.

Q397905.name: Columbia
Q397905.desc: planned community in Howard County, Maryland, United States
Q397905.about: Columbia is a planned community in Howard County, Maryland, United States, consisting of 10 self-contained villages. With a population of 104,681 at the 2020 census, it is the second-most-populous community in Maryland, after Baltimore.

Q398939.name: Howard County
Q398939.about: Howard County is located in the U.S. state of Maryland. As of the 2020 census, the population is 334,529.

Q399119.name: Chitungwiza
Q399119.about: Chitungwiza is the third populous urban centre in Zimbabwe and town of Harare Province in Zimbabwe. It is located on the outskirts of Harare.

Q399270.name: Uruapan del Progreso
Q399270.desc: municipal seat of Uruapan, State of Michoacán, Mexico
Q399270.about: Uruapan del Progreso, simply known as Uruapan (Spanish pronunciation: [uˈɾwa.pan]), is the second largest city in the Mexican state of Michoacán. It is located at the western edge of the Purépecha highlands, just to the east of the Tierra Caliente region.

Q399976.name: Palm Desert
Q399976.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q399976.about: Palm Desert is a city in the Coachella Valley region of Riverside County, California. The city is located in the Colorado Desert arm of the Sonoran Desert, about 14 miles (23 km) east of Palm Springs, 121 miles (195 km) northeast of San Diego and 122 miles (196 km) east of Los Angeles.

Q3927.name: Astrakhan
Q3927.desc: city in the south of Russia
Q3927.about: Astrakhan is the largest city and administrative centre of Astrakhan Oblast in southern Russia. The city lies on two banks of the Volga, in the upper part of the Volga Delta, on eleven islands of the Caspian Depression, 100 km (62 mi) from the Caspian Sea, with a population of 475,629 residents at the 2021 Census.

Q3929.name: Port Louis
Q3929.about: Port Louis (French: Port-Louis, [pɔʁ lwi] ; Mauritian Creole: Porlwi, [poːlwi]) is the capital and most populous city of Mauritius, mainly located in the Port Louis District, with a small western part in the Black River District. Port Louis is the country's financial and political centre.

Q42773.name: Kunshan
Q42773.about: Kunshan  is a county-level city in southeastern Jiangsu province with Shanghai bordering its eastern border. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Suzhou.

Q42780.name: Ningbo
Q42780.about: Ningbo is a sub-provincial city in the northeast of Zhejiang, People's Republic of China. It comprises six urban districts, two satellite county-level cities, and two rural counties, including several islands in Hangzhou Bay and the East China Sea.

Q42941.name: Agra
Q42941.about: Agra (; Hindi: Āgarā, pronounced [ˈaːɡɾaː] ) is a city on the banks of the Yamuna river in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is a part of Western Uttar Pradesh, about 230 kilometres (140 mi) south-east of the national capital Delhi and 330 km west of the state capital Lucknow.

Q416922.name: Huaihua
Q416922.about: Huaihua (simplified Chinese: 怀化市; traditional Chinese: 懷化市; pinyin: Huáihuà Shì) is a prefecture-level city in western Hunan province, China. It is known as the "Western Gate" of Hunan and is the largest prefecture-level city by area in the province.

Q416988.name: Loudi
Q416988.about: Loudi (Chinese: 娄底; pinyin: Lóudǐ) is a prefecture-level city located in central Hunan province, China. It is situated about 110 km (68 mi) southwest of the provincial capital of Changsha and is considered to be a small- to medium-sized city within the province.

Q421956.name: Harrison County
Q421956.about: Harrison County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,483, making it the fifth-least populous county in Ohio.

Q421960.name: Columbiana County
Q421960.about: Columbiana County is located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 101,877.

Q421963.name: Tuscarawas County
Q421963.about: Tuscarawas County ( TUS-kə-RAH-wəs) is a county located in the northeastern part of the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 93,263.

Q421970.name: Carroll County
Q421970.about: Carroll County is a county located in the state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 26,721.

Q3915.name: Antananarivo
Q3915.desc: capital and largest city of Madagascar
Q3915.about: Antananarivo (Malagasy: [antananaˈrivʷ]; French: Tananarive, pronounced [tananaʁiv]), also known by its colonial shorthand form Tana (pronounced [tana]), is the capital and largest city of Madagascar. The administrative area of the city, known as Antananarivo-Renivohitra ("Antananarivo-Mother Hill" or "Antananarivo-Capital"), is the capital of Analamanga region.

Q3919.name: Gaborone
Q3919.about: Gaborone (UK:  GAB-ə-ROH-nee, HAB-, US:  GAH-bə-ROH-nee, -⁠nay, Tswana: [χabʊˈrʊnɛ]) is the capital and largest city of Botswana. It was formerly spelled as Gaberones during the colonial era, a name occasionally used in older English texts and maps.

Q3921.name: Harare
Q3921.desc: capital and largest city of Zimbabwe
Q3921.about: Harare ( hə-RAR-eh) is the capital and largest city of Zimbabwe. The city proper has an area of 982.3 km2 (379.3 sq mi), a population of 1,849,600 as of the 2022 census, and an estimated 2,487,209 people in its metropolitan province.

Q3926.name: Pretoria
Q3926.desc: administrative capital of South Africa located in the Gauteng province
Q3926.about:
Pretoria ( prih-TOR-ee-ə, pree-; Afrikaans: [prəˈtʉəria] ) is the executive capital of South Africa, serving as the seat of the executive branch of government, and as the host to all foreign embassies to the country.
Pretoria straddles the Apies River and extends westward into the foothills of the Magaliesberg mountains.

Q404636.name: Sanmenxia
Q404636.about: Sanmenxia (simplified Chinese: 三门峡; traditional Chinese: 三門峽; pinyin: Sānménxiá; postal: Sanmenhsia) is a prefecture-level city in the west of Henan Province, China. The westernmost prefecture-level city in Henan, Sanmenxia borders Luoyang to the east, Nanyang to the southeast, Shaanxi Province to the west and Shanxi Province to the north.
Q404636.img: 20260503 Swan Lake and Skyline of Hubin District, Sanmenxia.jpg

Q404763.name: Nanyang
Q404763.about: Nanyang is a prefecture-level city in the southwest of Henan province, China. The city with the largest administrative area in Henan, Nanyang borders Xinyang to the southeast, Zhumadian to the east, Pingdingshan to the northeast, Luoyang to the north, Sanmenxia to the northwest, the province of Shaanxi to the west, and the province of Hubei to the south.

Q404817.name: Shangqiu
Q404817.about: Shangqiu (Chinese: 商丘), alternately romanized as Shangkiu, is a city in eastern Henan province, Central China. It borders Kaifeng to the northwest, Zhoukou to the southwest, and the provinces of Shandong and Anhui to the northeast and southeast respectively.

Q404873.name: Xinyang
Q404873.about: Xinyang (simplified Chinese: 信阳; traditional Chinese: 信陽; pinyin: Xìnyáng; postal: Sinyang) is a prefecture-level city in southeastern Henan province, People's Republic of China, the southernmost administrative division in the province. Its total population was 6,234,401 according to the 2020 census.

Q404898.name: Aiken County
Q404898.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q404898.about: Aiken County () is a county in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, its population was 168,808.

Q408187.name: Tlalpan
Q408187.about: Tlalpan (Classical Nahuatl: Tlālpan [ˈtɬaːlpan̥] , 'place on the earth') is a borough (demarcación territorial) in Mexico City. It is the largest borough, with over 80% under conservation as forest and other ecologically sensitive area.

Q408537.name: Airdrie
Q408537.about: Airdrie ( AIR-dree) is a city in Alberta, Canada, located north of Calgary within the Calgary–Edmonton Corridor at the intersection of Queen Elizabeth II Highway (Highway 2) and Highway 567. The city is part of the Calgary census metropolitan area and is surrounded by Rocky View County.

Q408744.name: Falls Church
Q408744.desc: independent city in Virginia, United States
Q408744.about: Falls Church is an independent city in the Commonwealth of Virginia, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 14,658.

Q416544.name: Changde
Q416544.about: Changde (Chinese: 常德; pinyin: Chángdé; traditional Chinese: 常德  [ʈʂʰǎŋ.tɤ̌]) is a prefecture-level city in the northwest of Hunan province, People's Republic of China. Changde, known as "Wuling" in ancient times, is located on the west side of Dongting Lake in the south of the Yangtze River, at the foot of Wuling Mountain.

Q4093.name: Glasgow
Q4093.about: Glasgow is the most populous city in Scotland, located on the banks of the River Clyde in west central Scotland. It is the third-most populous city in the United Kingdom and comprises 23 wards which represent the areas within the city boundaries.

Q4301.name: Arusha
Q4301.about: Arusha  is a city in Tanzania. The city is the capital of the Arusha Region.

Q43199.name: Omaha
Q43199.desc: seat of Douglas County, and largest city in State of Nebraska, United States
Q43199.about: Omaha is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Nebraska. It is located in the Midwestern United States along the Missouri River, about 10 mi (15 km) north of the mouth of the Platte River.
Q43199.img: Compilation of images of Omaha, Nebraska, omahacollage.tif

Q43301.name: Fresno
Q43301.desc: county seat of Fresno County, California, United States
Q43301.about: Fresno ( ; Spanish for 'ash tree') is a city in the San Joaquin Valley of California, United States. It is the county seat of Fresno County and the largest city in the greater Central Valley region, as well as the most populated city in Central California.

Q425996.name: Deyang
Q425996.about: Deyang (Chinese: 德阳; pinyin: Déyáng) is a prefecture-level city of Sichuan province, China. Deyang is a largely industrial city, with companies such as China National Erzhong Group and Dongfang Electric having major operations there.

Q426130.name: Mianyang
Q426130.about: Mianyang (simplified Chinese: 绵阳; traditional Chinese: 綿陽; pinyin: Miányáng; Wade–Giles: Mien2-yang2; Sichuanese romanization: Mien2-iang2; formerly known as Mienchow, Chinese: 綿州; pinyin: Mianzhou; Sichuanese romanization: Miencheo; lit. 'Mian Prefecture') is the second largest prefecture-level city of Sichuan province in Southwestern China. It borders Nanchong City to the east, Suining City to the south, Deyang City to the southwest, Aba Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture to the west, Gansu Province to the north, and Guangyuan City to the northeast.

Q426237.name: Guangyuan
Q426237.about: Guangyuan (simplified Chinese: 广元; traditional Chinese: 廣元; pinyin: Guǎngyuán; Wade–Giles: Kuang-yüan) is a prefecture-level city in Sichuan Province, China, bordering the provinces of Shaanxi to the northeast and Gansu to the northwest. Guangyuan City is located on the northern edge of the Sichuan Basin, on the upper reaches of the Jialing River, and is the junction of Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu provinces.

Q426262.name: Grant County
Q426262.desc: county in New Mexico, United States
Q426262.about: Grant County is a county located in the U.S. state of New Mexico. At the 2020 census, the population was 28,185.

Q38555.name: Santa Fe
Q38555.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of New Mexico and seat of Santa Fe County
Q38555.about: Santa Fe ( SAN-tə FAY, -⁠ fay; Spanish: [santa ˈfe]; Spanish for 'Holy Faith') is the capital city of the U.S. state of New Mexico. It is the fourth-most populous city in the state with a population of 87,505 as of the 2020 census, while the Santa Fe metropolitan area has an estimated 158,000 people.

Q38807.name: Suva
Q38807.about: Suva (Fijian: [ˈsuβa]  SOO-vuh, Fiji Hindi: सुवा) is the capital and most populous settlement of Fiji. It is the centre of Fiji's largest metropolitan area and serves as its major port.

Q38811.name: Nasiriyah
Q38811.about: Nasiriyah (UK:  NAZ-irr-EE-ə, US:  NAH-sirr-; Arabic: ٱلنَّاصِرِيَّة, romanized: an-Nāṣiriyya, BGN: An Nāşirīyah, IPA: [ænnɑːsˤɪˈrɪjjæ]), also spelled Nassiriya or Nasiriya, is a city in Iraq, the capital of the Dhi Qar Governorate. It lies on the lower Euphrates, about 360 km (225 miles) south-southeast of Baghdad, near the ruins of the ancient city of Ur, as well as the recently established Ur Tourist City located adjacent to the archaeological site.

Q38834.name: Nukuʻalofa
Q38834.about: Nukuʻalofa ( NOO-koo-ə-LOH-fə, Tongan: [nukuʔaˈlofa]) is the capital and largest city of Tonga. It is located on the north coast of the island of Tongatapu, in the country's southernmost island group.

Q38927.name: Maoming
Q38927.about: Maoming, alternately romanized as Mowming, (Maoming Yue: [mɐu22 mɪŋ21]) is a prefecture-level city located in southwestern Guangdong province, China. Facing the South China Sea to the city's south, Maoming borders Zhanjiang to the west, Yangjiang to the east, and Yunfu to the northeast, and is 362 kilometers (225 mi) from the province's capital Guangzhou and 121 kilometers (75 mi) from Zhanjiang.

Q43475.name: Derby
Q43475.desc: city in Derbyshire, in the East Midlands region of England
Q43475.about: Derby (  DAR-bee) is a city and unitary authority area on the River Derwent in Derbyshire, England. Derby was the original county town before the county town status was given to Matlock.

Q426996.name: Nanchong
Q426996.about: Nanchong (Chinese: 南充; pinyin: Nánchōng; Wade–Giles: Nan-ch'ung; Sichuanese: lan2cong1) is a prefecture-level city in the northeast of Sichuan province, China, with an area of 12,479.96 km2 (4,818.54 sq mi). At the 2020 census it was home to 5,607,565 people, of whom 1,936,534 lived in the built-up (or 'metro') area made of three urban districts.

Q427075.name: Temple
Q427075.desc: city in Bell County, Texas, United States
Q427075.about: Temple is a city in Bell County, Texas, United States.  As of 2020, the city has a population of 82,073 according to the U.S. census.
Q427075.img: Downtown Temple, TX at Main Street IMG 2384.JPG

Q427097.name: Meishan
Q427097.about: Meishan (Chinese: 眉山; Sichuanese Pinyin: Mi2san1; local pronunciation: [mi˨˩sã˥];  pinyin: Méishān; Wade–Giles: Mei-shan), formerly known as Meizhou (眉州) or Qingzhou (青州), is a prefecture-level city of Sichuan with 2,955,219 inhabitants as of the 2020 census, of whom 1,232,648 lived in the built-up (or metro) area made up of the two urban districts of Dongpo and Pengshan. Meishan is located in the southwest of Sichuan Basin.
Q427097.img: 陈庆红作品-湖畔霞光之老水车 - panoramio.jpg

Q427315.name: Daniels County
Q427315.about: Daniels County is a county located in the U.S. state of Montana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,661.

Q38453.name: Columbia
Q38453.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of South Carolina and seat of Richland County
Q38453.about: Columbia is the capital of the U.S. state of South Carolina. It is the second-most populous city in the state, with a population of 136,632 at the 2020 census and estimated at 147,035 in 2025.

Q38545.name: Adana
Q38545.desc: central district and city in Adana Province, Turkey
Q38545.about: Adana is a large city in southern Turkey. The city is situated on the Seyhan River, 35 km (22 mi) inland from the northeastern shores of the Mediterranean Sea.

Q43382.name: Plymouth
Q43382.about: Plymouth (  PLIM-əth) is a port city and unitary authority in Devon, England. It is located on the county's south coast between the rivers Plym and Tamar, about 36 miles (58 km) south-west of Exeter and 193 miles (311 km) south-west of London.

Q43421.name: Richmond
Q43421.desc: independent city in and capital of the U.S. state of Virginia
Q43421.about: Richmond (, RITCH-mənd) is the capital city of the U.S. state of Virginia. Incorporated in 1742, Richmond has been an independent city since 1871.

Q43433.name: Chandigarh
Q43433.desc: capital of Punjab and Haryana states, Union Territory of India
Q43433.about: Chandigarh is a city and union territory in northwestern India, serving as a shared capital for the states of Punjab and Haryana. Situated near the foothills of the Shivalik range of Himalayas, it borders Haryana to the east and Punjab in the remaining directions.
Q43433.img: Open Hand Monument and a Rose.jpeg

Q426360.name: Tripp County
Q426360.desc: county in South Dakota, United States of America
Q426360.about: Tripp County is a county in the U.S. state of South Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 5,624.

Q426398.name: Neshoba County
Q426398.about: Neshoba County is a county located in the central part of the U.S. state of Mississippi. As of the 2020 census, the population was 29,087.

Q426644.name: Suining
Q426644.about: Suining (simplified Chinese: 遂宁; traditional Chinese: 遂寧; Sichuanese Pinyin: Xu4nin2; Sichuanese pronunciation: [ɕy˨˦nin˨˩]; pinyin: Sùiníng; Wade–Giles: Sui-ning) is a prefecture-level city of eastern Sichuan province in Southwest China. According to the 2020 census, Suining had a population of 2,814,196, with 1,612,641 living in built up(or metro) areas.

Q426699.name: Ouray County
Q426699.about: Ouray County () is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 4,874.
Q426699.img: Ouray County Courthouse in Ouray, Colorado.JPG

Q426746.name: Sullivan County
Q426746.about: Sullivan County is a county in the U.S. state of Indiana, and determined by the US Census Bureau to include the mean center of U.S. population in 1940. As of 2023, the population was estimated at 20,757.
Q426746.img: Sullivan County Courthouse in Indiana, southern side.jpg

Q426756.name: Neijiang
Q426756.about: Neijiang (simplified Chinese: 内江; traditional Chinese: 內江; Sichuanese Pinyin: Nui4jiang1; Sichuanese pronunciation: [nuei˨˩˧tɕiaŋ˥]; pinyin: Nèijiāng; Wade–Giles: Nei-chiang) is a prefecture-level city in the southeast of Sichuan province, People's Republic of China. It is located on the Tuo River, midway between the two major cities of Chengdu and Chongqing, is a transportation and food-processing center.

Q426868.name: Leshan
Q426868.about: Leshan, formerly known as Jiading and Jiazhou, is a prefecture-level city located at the confluence of the Dadu, Min and Qingyi rivers in Sichuan province, China. By the end of 2024, the registered population of the city is 3.45 million.

Q3932.name: São Tomé
Q3932.desc: capital city of São Tomé and Príncipe
Q3932.about: São Tomé is the capital and largest city of the Central African island country of São Tomé and Príncipe. Its name is Portuguese for "Saint Thomas".

Q3935.name: Windhoek
Q3935.desc: capital of the Republic of Namibia
Q3935.about: Windhoek (; Afrikaans: [ˈvəntɦuk] ; German: [ˈvɪnthʊk] ) is the capital and largest city of Namibia. It is located in central Namibia on the Khomas Highland plateau area, at around 1,700 m (5,600 ft) above sea level in the  geographical centre of the country.

Q3940.name: Victoria
Q3940.about: Victoria is the capital and largest city of Seychelles, situated on the north-eastern side of Mahé, the archipelago's main island. The city was first established as the seat of the British colonial government.
Q3940.img: Victoria view from Bel Eau asv2024-09 img3.jpg

Q42956.name: Harbin
Q42956.about: Harbin or Hā'ěrbīn is the capital of Heilongjiang, China, and the largest city of the province—as well as the second largest urban population (after Shenyang, Liaoning province) and the largest metropolitan population (urban and rural regions together) in Northeast China. Harbin has direct jurisdiction over nine metropolitan districts, two county-level cities, and seven counties.

Q43070.name: Donetsk
Q43070.about: Donetsk (UK: , US:  dən-; Ukrainian: Донецьк [doˈnɛtsʲk] ; Russian: Донецк [dɐˈnʲetsk] ), formerly known as Aleksandrovka, Yuzivka (or Hughesovka), Stalin, and Stalino, is an industrial city in eastern Ukraine located on the Kalmius River in Donetsk Oblast, which is currently occupied by Russia as the capital of the Donetsk People's Republic. The population was estimated at 901,645 (2022 estimate) in the city core, with over 2 million in the metropolitan area (2011).

Q43196.name: Cincinnati
Q43196.desc: city in and seat of Hamilton County, Ohio, United States
Q43196.about: Cincinnati (  SIN-sin-AT-ee; colloquially nicknamed Cincy) is the most populous city in Hamilton County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. It is located along the Ohio River across from its confluence with the Licking River in Kentucky.

Q421974.name: Stark County
Q421974.about: Stark County is a county located in the northeastern part of U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 374,853, making it the eighth-most populous county in Ohio.

Q423831.name: Akure
Q423831.desc: capital of Ondo State in Nigeria
Q423831.about: Akure  is a city in south-western Nigeria. It is the capital and largest city of Ondo State.
Q423831.img: St. Thomas Anglican Church, Akure, Ondo State.jpg

Q424659.name: Caledon
Q424659.desc: town in Peel Region, Ontario, Canada
Q424659.about: Caledon (; 2021 population 76,581) is a town in Peel Region, Ontario, Canada. The name comes from a shortened form of Caledonia, the Roman name for what is now Scotland.

Q424773.name: Welland
Q424773.desc: small city in Niagara Region, Ontario, Canada
Q424773.about: Welland is a city in the Regional Municipality of Niagara in Southern Ontario, Canada. As of 2021, it had a population of 55,750.

Q424984.name: Oakville
Q424984.desc: town in Halton Region, Ontario, Canada
Q424984.about: Oakville is a town and the seat of Halton Region in Ontario, Canada. It borders Burlington to the southwest, Milton to the northwest and Mississauga to the northeast.

Q425057.name: Milton
Q425057.desc: town in Halton Region, Ontario, Canada
Q425057.about: Milton (2021 population: 132,979) is a town in Southern Ontario, Canada, and part of the Regional Municipality of Halton in the Greater Toronto Area. Between 2001 and 2011, Milton was the fastest growing municipality in Canada, with a 71.4% increase in population from 2001 to 2006 and another 56.5% increase from 2006 to 2011.

Q425070.name: Halton Hills
Q425070.desc: town in Halton Region, Ontario, Canada
Q425070.about:
Halton Hills is a town in the Regional Municipality of Halton, located in the northwestern end of the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada with a population of 62,951 (2021).
There are many natural features within these bounds; they include the Niagara Escarpment, and the Bruce Trail.

Q425415.name: Panzhihua
Q425415.about: Panzhihua (Chinese: 攀枝花; pinyin: Pānzhīhuā), formerly Dukou (渡口), is a prefecture-level city located in the far south of Sichuan province, China, at the confluence of the Jinsha and Yalong Rivers. It has an administrative area of 7,423.42 square kilometres (2,866.20 sq mi), and a population at the 2020 census of 1,212,203.
Q425415.img: 攀枝花市中心全图（炳草岗）chaselei - panoramio.jpg

Q425492.name: Luzhou
Q425492.about: Luzhou (Chinese: 泸州; pinyin: Lúzhōu; Sichuanese Pinyin: Nu2zou1; Luzhou dialect: [nu˨˩tsəu˥]) is a prefecture-level city located in the southeast of Sichuan Province, China. It is also known as the "Liquor City" (酒城).

Q40816.name: Benghazi
Q40816.about: Benghazi () (lit. 'Son of Ghazi') is the second-largest city in Libya as well as the largest city in Cyrenaica, with an estimated population of 859,000 in 2023. Located on the Gulf of Sidra in the Mediterranean, Benghazi is also a major seaport.

Q40881.name: Carson City
Q40881.desc: independent city in and capital of the U.S. state of Nevada
Q40881.about: Carson City is an independent city and the capital of the U.S. state of Nevada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 58,639, making it the 6th most populous city in the state.

Q40921.name: Honiara
Q40921.desc: capital of Solomon Islands, on the tropical island Guadalcanal
Q40921.about: Honiara ( HON-nee-AH-rə) is the capital and largest city of Solomon Islands, situated on the northwestern coast of Guadalcanal. As of 2019, it had a population of 129,569 people.

Q41057.name: Topeka
Q41057.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Kansas and seat of Shawnee County
Q41057.about: Topeka (, tə-PEE-kə) is the capital city of the U.S. state of Kansas and the county seat of Shawnee County. It is along the Kansas River in the central part of Shawnee County, within northeastern Kansas and the Central United States.

Q38968.name: Liuzhou
Q38968.about: Liuzhou (; Chinese: 柳州, Standard Mandarin: [ljòʊ.ʈʂóʊ], Liuzhou Yue dialect: [liəu53 ʦəu44]) is a prefecture-level city in north-central Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China. The prefecture's population was 4,146,000 as of the 2024 census, including 2,519,051 in the built-up area made of five urban districts.
Q38968.img: Liuzhou City seen from Ma'an Mountain.jpg

Q39042.name: Cheyenne
Q39042.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Wyoming and seat of Laramie County
Q39042.about: Cheyenne ( shy-AN or  shy-EN) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Wyoming. Its population was 65,132 at the 2020 census, while the Cheyenne metropolitan area encompassing all of Laramie County had an estimated 102,000 residents.

Q39121.name: Leeds
Q39121.desc: city in West Yorkshire, England, United Kingdom
Q39121.about: Leeds is a city in West Yorkshire, England. It is the largest settlement in Yorkshire and the administrative centre of the City of Leeds Metropolitan Borough, which is the second most populous district in the United Kingdom.

Q39178.name: Port of Spain
Q39178.hog: Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago
Q39178.about: Port of Spain (Trinidadian English: Port ah Spain [ˈpʊo̯t a ˈspɪe̯n] ) is the capital and chief port of Trinidad and Tobago. With a municipal population of 49,867 (2017), an urban population of 81,142 and a transient daily population of 250,000, it is Trinidad and Tobago's third largest municipality, after Chaguanas and San Fernando.

Q39420.name: Sochi
Q39420.about: Sochi (Russian: Сочи, IPA: [ˈsotɕɪ] , from Ubykh: Шъуача – seaside) is the largest resort city in Russia. The city is situated on the Sochi River, along the Black Sea in the North Caucasus of Southern Russia, with a population of 466,078 residents, and up to 600,000 residents in the urban area.

Q39450.name: Anchorage
Q39450.desc: consolidated city-borough and largest city in the U.S. state of Alaska
Q39450.about: Anchorage (Denaʼina: Dgheyay Kaq'; Dgheyaytnu), officially the Municipality of Anchorage, is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Alaska. With a population of 291,247 at the 2020 census, it contains nearly 40 percent of the state's population.

Q39561.name: Burbank
Q39561.desc: city in Los Angeles County, State of California, United States
Q39561.about: Burbank is a city in the southeastern end of the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles County, California, United States. Located 7 miles (11 km) northwest of downtown Los Angeles, Burbank had a population of 102,988 as of 2025.

Q39709.name: Des Moines
Q39709.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Iowa and seat of Polk County
Q39709.about: Des Moines is the capital and most populous city in the U.S. state of Iowa. It is named after the Des Moines River, likely derived from the French Rivière des Moines meaning 'River of the Monks'.

Q41087.name: Raleigh
Q41087.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of North Carolina and seat of Wake County
Q41087.about: Raleigh (  RAH-lee) is the capital city of the U.S. state of North Carolina. It is the second-most populous city in the state (after Charlotte), tenth most populous city in the Southeast, the largest city in the Research Triangle area, and the 39th-most populous city in the U.S. Known as the "City of Oaks" for its oak-lined streets, Raleigh covers 148.54 square miles (384.7 km2) and had a population of 467,665 at the 2020 census.

Q41183.name: Aleppo
Q41183.about: Aleppo is a city in northern Syria, which serves as the capital of the Aleppo Governorate, the country's most populous governorate. With an estimated population of 2,098,000 residents as of 2021, it is Syria's largest city by urban area, and the second-largest city in the country, being the most populous until it was surpassed by Damascus, the capital of Syria.
Q41183.img: Aleppo, View of the city, Syria.jpg

Q41211.name: San Juan
Q41211.about: San Juan ( san WHAHN, Spanish: [saŋ ˈxwan]; Spanish for "Saint John") is the capital city and most populous municipality in Puerto Rico, an unincorporated territory and insular area of the United States. San Juan was founded by Spanish imperialists in 1521, who called it Ciudad de Puerto Rico (Spanish for "Rich Port City").

Q41252.name: Bydgoszcz
Q41252.desc: city in the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-central Poland
Q41252.about: Bydgoszcz is a city in northern Poland and the largest city in the historical region of Kuyavia. Straddling the confluence of the Vistula River and its left-bank tributary, the Brda, the strategic location of Bydgoszcz has made it an inland port and a vital centre for trade and transportation.

Q41262.name: Nottingham
Q41262.about: Nottingham (  NOT-ing-əm) is a city and unitary authority area in Nottinghamshire, East Midlands, England. It is located 42 miles (68 km) south-east of Sheffield and 54 miles (87 km) north-east of Birmingham.

Q41295.name: Basseterre
Q41295.desc: capital of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q41295.about: Basseterre (; Saint Kitts Creole: Bastear) is the capital and largest city of Saint Kitts and Nevis with an estimated population of 14,000 in 2018. Geographically, the Basseterre port is located at 17°18′N 62°44′W, on the south-western coast of Saint Kitts Island, and it is one of the chief commercial depots of the Leeward Islands.

Q40191.name: Hobart
Q40191.about: Hobart (  HOH-bart; Southeast Tasmanian: nipaluna) is the capital and most populous city of the island state of Tasmania, Australia. Located in Tasmania's south-east on the estuary of the River Derwent, it is the southernmost capital city in Australia.

Q40194.name: Mazatlán
Q40194.desc: municipal seat of Mazatlán, State of Sinaloa, Mexico
Q40194.about: Mazatlán (Spanish pronunciation: [masaˈtlan] ) is a city in the Mexican state of Sinaloa. The city serves as the municipal seat for the surrounding municipio, known as the Mazatlán Municipality.

Q40236.name: Manaus
Q40236.about: Manaus (Portuguese: [maˈnaws, mɐ-] ) is the capital and largest city of the Brazilian state of Amazonas. It is the seventh-largest city in Brazil, with an estimated 2024 population of 2,279,686 distributed over a land area of about 11,401 km2 (4,402 sq mi).

Q40268.name: Springfield
Q40268.desc: city in Lane County, Oregon, United States
Q40268.about: Springfield is a city in Lane County, Oregon, United States. Located in the Southern Willamette Valley, it is within the Eugene-Springfield metropolitan statistical area.
Q40268.img: Eugene and Springfield from Mount Pisgah.JPG

Q40325.name: Springfield
Q40325.desc: county seat of Clark County, Ohio, United States
Q40325.about: Springfield is a city in Clark County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. It is located in southwestern Ohio along the Mad River, Buck Creek, and Beaver Creek, about 45 miles (72 km) west of Columbus and 25 miles (40 km) northeast of Dayton.

Q40340.name: Racine
Q40340.desc: city in and county seat of Racine County, Wisconsin, United States
Q40340.about: Racine ( rə-SEEN, also   RAY-seen) is a city in Racine County, Wisconsin, United States, and its county seat. It is located on the shore of Lake Michigan at the mouth of the Root River, 22 miles (35 km) south of Milwaukee and 60 miles (97 km) north of Chicago.

Q40345.name: Joliet
Q40345.about: Joliet ( JOH-lee-et, -⁠ET) is a city in Will and Kendall counties in the U.S. state of Illinois. Located 40 miles (64 km) southwest of Chicago, it is the county seat of Will County.

Q40347.name: Norman
Q40347.desc: city in Oklahoma, United States of America
Q40347.about: Norman () is the third-most populous city in the U.S. state of Oklahoma, with a population of 128,026 as of the 2020 census. It is the most populous city in and the county seat of Cleveland County and the second-most populous city in the Oklahoma City Metro Area after the state capital, Oklahoma City, 20 miles (32 kilometers) north of Norman.

Q40435.name: Buffalo
Q40435.desc: city and county seat of Erie County, New York, United States
Q40435.about: Buffalo is a city in the U.S. state of New York. It lies in Western New York on the eastern shore of Lake Erie and at the head of the Niagara River on the Canada–United States border, with a population of 278,349 at the 2020 census.

Q40626.name: Tacloban
Q40626.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Leyte
Q40626.about: Tacloban ( tak-LOH-ban; Tagalog pronunciation: [tɐkˈloban]), officially the City of Tacloban (Waray: Syudad han Tacloban; Filipino: Lungsod ng Tacloban), is a highly urbanized city in the Eastern Visayas region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 259,353, making it the most populous city in Eastern Visayas.

Q40738.name: Bursa
Q40738.desc: city in Bursa province in western Turkey
Q40738.about: Bursa is a city in northwestern Turkey and the administrative center of Bursa Province. It is the fourth-most populous city in Turkey and second-most populous in the Marmara Region after Istanbul.

Q41473.name: Nizamabad
Q41473.desc: city in Nizamabad district, Telangana, India
Q41473.about: Nizamabad, also informally known as Induru or Indur, is a city in the Indian state of Telangana. It is governed by the municipal corporation and is the headquarters of the Nizamabad district.

Q41474.name: Kingstown
Q41474.desc: capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
Q41474.about: Kingstown  is the capital and largest city of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. The city, located on the main island of Saint Vincent, has the main port and the biggest commercial center of the islands.
Q41474.img: St. Vincent, Karibik - Kingstown City - panoramio.jpg

Q41496.name: Thanjavur
Q41496.about: Thanjavur (Tamil: [t̪aɲdʑaːʋuːɾ]), also known as Thanjai, previously known as Tanjore, is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the 12th biggest city in Tamil Nadu.

Q41547.name: St. George's
Q41547.about: St. George's (Grenadian Creole French: Sen Jòj) is the capital and largest city of Grenada.

Q41561.name: Sonipat
Q41561.about: Sonipat is a planned industrial city and administrative headquarter in Sonipat district of Haryana state of India. It comes under the National Capital Region and is around 45 kilometres (28 mi) from New Delhi.

Q41562.name: Thoothukudi
Q41562.about: Thoothukudi   (formerly called Tuticorin) is a port industrial city in Thoothukudi district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It lies on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal.

Q427367.name: Guang'an
Q427367.about: Guang'an is a prefecture-level city in eastern Sichuan province. It is most famous as the birthplace of China's former paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

Q427488.name: Dazhou
Q427488.desc: prefecture-level city in Sichuan, People's Republic of China
Q427488.about: Dazhou (simplified Chinese: 达州; traditional Chinese: 達州; pinyin: Dázhōu; Wade–Giles: Ta-chou) is a prefecture-level city in the northeast of Sichuan province, China, bordering Shaanxi to the north and Chongqing to the east and south. At the end of 2024 and the beginning of 2025, the resident population will be 5,304,300, the urbanization rate is 52.72%, the urban population is 2.794 million, and the rural population is 2.506 million        live in the built-up (or metro) area made of 2 urban districts.

Q427559.name: Coral Gables
Q427559.desc: city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q427559.about: Coral Gables is a city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. The city is part of the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida and is located 7 miles (11 km) southwest of downtown Miami.

Q427732.name: Charlotte County
Q427732.about: Charlotte County is a county located in the south central part of the U.S. state of Virginia. Its county seat is the town of Charlotte Court House.

Q428298.name: Durham County
Q428298.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q428298.about: Durham County is a county in the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 324,833, making it the sixth-most populous county in North Carolina.

Q428902.name: Deuel County
Q428902.about: Deuel County () is a county located in the U.S. State of Nebraska. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 1,838.

Q429063.name: Ballari
Q429063.about:
Ballari (Kannada: [bɐɭːaːri], formerly Bellary) is a city in the Ballari district in state of Karnataka, India.
Ballari houses many steel plants such as JSW Vijayanagar, one of the largest in Asia.

Q429215.name: Sangli
Q429215.about: Sangli (ISO: Sāṁgalī; ) is a city and the headquarters of the Sangli District in Maharashtra, in south-western India. It has earned the nickname "Turmeric City of India" for being India's and Asia's largest hub for the production and global trade of this spice.

Q429687.name: Upper West Side
Q429687.desc: neighborhood in Manhattan, New York City, New York, United States
Q429687.about: The Upper West Side (UWS) is a neighborhood in the borough of Manhattan in New York City. It is bounded by Central Park on the east, the Hudson River on the west, West 59th Street to the south, and West 110th Street to the north.

Q429814.name: Livingston County
Q429814.about: Livingston County is a county located in the U.S. state of Illinois. According to the 2020 census, it has a population of 35,815.

Q430113.name: Carroll County
Q430113.about: Carroll County is a county located in the U.S. state of Iowa. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,760.

Q39297398.name: Utrecht
Q39297398.desc: capital city of the province of Utrecht, Netherlands

Q430267.name: Bellingham
Q430267.desc: city in, and the county seat of, Whatcom County in the State of Washington, United States
Q430267.about: Bellingham ( BEL-ing-ham) is a city in and the county seat of Whatcom County in the U.S. state of Washington. It lies 21 miles (34 km) south of the Canada–United States border, between Vancouver, British Columbia, 52 miles (84 km) to the northwest and Seattle 90 miles (140 km) to the south.

Q430316.name: National City
Q430316.about: National City is a city in the South Bay region of southwestern San Diego County, California, United States. The population was 56,173 at the 2020 United States census, down from 58,582 at the 2010 census.

Q430328.name: Wilkes County
Q430328.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q430328.about: Wilkes County is a county located in the U.S. state of North Carolina. It is a part of the state's western mountain region.

Q430464.name: Dearborn
Q430464.desc: city in Wayne County, Michigan, United States
Q430464.about: Dearborn is a city in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. An inner-ring suburb of Detroit, Dearborn borders Detroit to the north and east, roughly 7 miles (11.3 km) west of downtown Detroit.

Q430938.name: Dunklin County
Q430938.about: Dunklin County is located in the Bootheel of the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, the population was 28,283.

Q431440.name: Lafayette County
Q431440.about: Lafayette County, sometimes spelled La Fayette County, is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. It was part of the Wisconsin Territory at the time of its founding.

Q431533.name: Chingola
Q431533.about: Chingola is a town in Zambia's Copperbelt Province, the country's copper-mining region, with a population of 256,560 (2022 census). It is the home of Nchanga Copper Mine, a deep-shaft high-grade content copper mining operation, which subsequently (in the 1960s) led to the development of two open pit operations, Chingola Open Pit and then Nchanga Open Pit (the latter being the second largest open cast mine in the world).

Q431826.name: Shelby County
Q431826.about: Shelby County is a county in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 45,055.

Q432152.name: Chico
Q432152.desc: city in Butte County, California, United States
Q432152.about: Chico ( CHEE-koh; Spanish for "boy" or "small/little") is the most populous city in Butte County, California, United States. Located in the Sacramento Valley region of Northern California, the city had a population of 101,475 in the 2020 census, an increase from 86,187 in the 2010 census.

Q3949488.name: Santo Domingo Oeste
Q3949488.desc: place in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
Q3949488.about: Santo Domingo Oeste is a municipality of the Santo Domingo province in the Dominican Republic. It is part of the greater Santo Domingo metropolitan area, which is the de facto co-capital of the Dominican Republic as seat of the Constitutional Court and the Central Electoral Commission.

Q4115211.name: Hadayek El Kobba
Q4115211.about: Hadaek al-Qubbah (Qubbah Gardens, Arabic: حدائق القبة) is a district in the Northern Area of Cairo, Egypt.

Q4115712.name: Kaunas
Q4115712.desc: city and administrative center of Kaunas County in Lithuania
Q4115712.about: Kaunas (; Lithuanian: [ˈkɒʊ̯ˑnˠɐs] ) is the second-largest city in Lithuania (after Vilnius), the fourth-largest city in the Baltic states, and an important centre of Lithuanian economic, academic, and cultural life. Kaunas was the largest city and the centre of Kaunas County in the Duchy of Trakai of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and Trakai Palatinate since 1413.
Q4115712.img: Vytautas the Great Bridge from hill, Kaunas, Lithuania - Diliff.jpg

Q4314187.name: Natore
Q4314187.about: Natore is a city in western Bangladesh. It is the headquarters of the Natore District.

Q456737.name: Ambattur
Q456737.desc: suburb and former municipality in Chennai, India
Q456737.about:
Ambattur is a northwestern part of Chennai, India. It is located in Ambattur taluk of the Chennai District, surrounded by Avadi, Anna Nagar, Korattur, Padi, Mogappair, Kallikuppam, 
Surapet, Ayappakkam, Athipet and Thiruverkadu.

Q457334.name: Moncton
Q457334.about: Moncton (; French pronunciation: [mɔŋktœn]) is the most populous city in the Canadian province of New Brunswick. Situated in the Petitcodiac River Valley, it lies at the geographic centre of the Maritime Provinces.

Q450159.name: Jackson County
Q450159.about: Jackson County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 223,259.
Q450159.img: Jackson County Courthouse (Jackson County, Oregon scenic images) (jacDA0008).jpg

Q450374.name: Multnomah County
Q450374.about: Multnomah County   is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the county's population was 815,428.

Q458396.name: Khorramshahr
Q458396.about:
Khorramshahr (Persian: خرمشهر; [xoræmˈʃæhɾ]) is a city in the Central District of Khorramshahr County, Khuzestan province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district. 
Khorramshahr is an inland port city located approximately 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north of Abadan.

Q459360.name: Cabinda
Q459360.about: Cabinda, also known as Chioua, is a city and a municipality in the Cabinda Province, an exclave of Angola. It is the administrative capital of Cabinda.

Q437.name: Ljubljana
Q437.about: Ljubljana (spoken Slovene: Lublana; also known by other historical names) is the capital and largest city of Slovenia, located along a trade route between the northern Adriatic Sea and the Danube region, north of the country's largest marsh; it has been inhabited since prehistoric times. It is the country's cultural, educational, economic, political and administrative centre and the seat of the Urban Municipality of Ljubljana.

Q4629.name: Surat
Q4629.about: Surat (Gujarati: [suːɾət̪]) is a city in the western Indian state of Gujarat. The word Surat directly translates to countenance in Gujarati, Hindi and Urdu.

Q43983.name: Wrangell
Q43983.desc: consolidated city-borough in Alaska, United States of America
Q43983.about: Wrangell (Tlingit: Ḵaachx̱ana.áakʼw, Russian: Врангель, romanized: Vrangel') is a borough in Alaska, United States. As of the 2020 census the population was around 2,127, down from 2,369 in 2010.

Q44012.name: Trois-Rivières
Q44012.about: Trois-Rivières (French: [tʁwɑ ʁivjɛʁ], Canadian French: [tʁwɔ ʁivjaɛ̯ʁ] ; lit. 'Three Rivers') is a city in the Mauricie administrative region of Quebec, Canada. It is located at the confluence of the Saint-Maurice and Saint Lawrence rivers, on the north shore of the Saint Lawrence River across from the city of Bécancour.

Q472.name: Sofia
Q472.about: Sofia is the capital and largest city of Bulgaria. It is situated in the Sofia Valley at the foot of the Vitosha mountain, in the western part of the country.

Q43668.name: Louisville
Q43668.desc: county seat of Jefferson County, Kentucky, United States
Q43668.about: Louisville is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Kentucky, sixth-most populous city in the Southeast, and the 27th-most-populous city in the United States. By land area, it is the country's 24th-largest city; however, by population density, it is the 265th most dense city.

Q462177.name: White Plains
Q462177.desc: city in and seat of Westchester County, New York, United States
Q462177.about: White Plains is a city in and the county seat of Westchester County, New York, United States. It is an inner suburb of New York City, and a commercial hub of Westchester County, a densely populated suburban county that is home to about one million people.

Q462789.name: Cape Coral
Q462789.desc: city in Lee County, Florida, United States
Q462789.about: Cape Coral is a city  in Lee County, Florida, United States, on the Gulf of Mexico. Founded in 1957, the city's population had grown to 194,016 as of the 2020 census, a 26% increase from 154,309 at the 2010 census, making it the ninth-most populous city in Florida.

Q462799.name: Evanston
Q462799.desc: suburban city in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q462799.about: Evanston is a city in Cook County, Illinois, United States. Evanston lies on Lake Michigan 12 miles (19 km) north of the Loop.

Q44210.name: Córdoba
Q44210.desc: city in Argentina, capital of its province
Q44210.about: Córdoba (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkoɾðoβa]) is a city in central Argentina, in the foothills of the Sierras Chicas on the Suquía River, about 700 km (435 mi) northwest of Buenos Aires. It is the capital of Córdoba Province and the second-most populous city in Argentina after Buenos Aires, with about 1.6 million urban inhabitants according to the 2020 census.

Q473209.name: Kamloops
Q473209.about: Kamloops ( KAM-loops) is a city in south-central British Columbia, Canada, at the confluence of the North and South Thompson Rivers, which join to become the Thompson River in Kamloops, and east of Kamloops Lake. The city is a commercial centre for, and largest city within, Thompson Country, a region of the British Columbia Interior.

Q473605.name: Taylor County
Q473605.about: Taylor County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 26,023.
Q473605.img: Clay Hill near Campbellsville, entrance closeup.jpg

Q474868.name: Alor Setar
Q474868.about: Alor Setar (Kedah Malay: Loqstaq), known as Alor Star from 2003 to 2009, is the state capital of Kedah, Malaysia. It is the second-largest city in the state, after Sungai Petani, and one of the most important cities on the west coast of Peninsular Malaysia.

Q474999.name: Tipton County
Q474999.about: Tipton County is a county located on the western end of the U.S. state of Tennessee, in the Mississippi Delta region. As of the 2020 census, the population was 60,970.

Q484404.name: Clackamas County
