Q484404.about: Clackamas County (  CLAK-ə-məss) is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 421,401, making it Oregon's third-most populous county.

Q484408.name: Marion County
Q484408.about: Marion County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. The population was 345,920 at the 2020 census, making it the 5th most populous county in Oregon.

Q4361.name: Curitiba
Q4361.about: Curitiba ( KOOR-ih-CHEE-bə; Brazilian Portuguese: [kuɾiˈtʃibɐ]) is the capital and largest city in the state of Paraná in Southern Brazil. The city's population was 1,829,225 as of 2024, making it the eighth most populous city in Brazil and the largest in Brazil's South Region.

Q4454.name: Khabarovsk
Q4454.desc: city in Russia, administrative center of the Khabarovsk Krai
Q4454.about: Khabarovsk (Russian: Хабаровск [xɐˈbarəfsk] ) is the administrative centre and largest city of Khabarovsk Krai, Russia, located 30 kilometers (19 mi) from the China–Russia border, at the confluence of the Amur and Ussuri Rivers, about 800 kilometers (500 mi) north of Vladivostok. As of the 2021 Russian census, it had a population of 617,441.

Q43788.name: Madison
Q43788.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Wisconsin and seat of Dane County
Q43788.about: Madison is the capital of the U.S. state of Wisconsin. It is the second-most populous city in the state (after Milwaukee), with a population of 269,840 at the 2020 census.
Q43788.img: Aerial View of Campus, with Helen C. White Hall in foreground (14070186173).jpg

Q43919.name: Salem
Q43919.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Oregon and seat of Marion County
Q43919.about: Salem ( , SAY-ləm) is the capital city of the U.S. state of Oregon, and the county seat of Marion County. Founded in 1842, it is located in the center of the Willamette Valley alongside the Willamette River, which runs north through the city.

Q462804.name: Lakewood
Q462804.desc: city in Jefferson County, Colorado, United States
Q462804.about: Lakewood is the home rule city that is the most populous municipality in Jefferson County, Colorado, United States. The city population was 155,984 at the 2020 U.S. census, making Lakewood the fifth most populous city in Colorado and the 167th most populous city in the United States.

Q463165.name: Sault Ste. Marie
Q463165.about: Sault Ste. Marie ( SOO saynt mə-REE) is a city in Northern Ontario, Canada, on the north shore of the St.

Q464699.name: Bahir Dar
Q464699.about: Bahir Dar (Amharic: ባሕር ዳር, lit. 'sea shore') is the capital city of Amhara Region, Ethiopia. Bahir Dar is one of the leading tourist destinations in Ethiopia, with a variety of attractions in the nearby Lake Tana and Blue Nile river.

Q465022.name: Enugu
Q465022.about: Enugu (  ay-NOO-goo; Igbo: Enụgwụ) is the capital city of Enugu State in Nigeria. The city had a population of 876,000 (2024 estimate) spread across the three LGAs of Enugu East, Enugu North and Enugu South, according to the 2022 Nigerian census.

Q466046.name: Salé
Q466046.about: Salé is a city in northwestern Morocco, on the right bank of the Bou Regreg river, opposite the national capital Rabat, for which it serves as a commuter town. Along with some smaller nearby towns, Rabat and Salé together form a single metropolitan area.

Q466190.name: Great Falls
Q466190.desc: city in and county seat of Cascade County, Montana, United States
Q466190.about: Great Falls is the third most populous city in the U.S. state of Montana and the county seat of Cascade County. The population was 60,442 according to the 2020 census.

Q466216.name: Ta'izz
Q466216.about: Taiz (Arabic: تَعِزّ, romanized: Taʿizz, also spelled Ta'iz, Taizz, and Ta'izz) is a city in southwestern Yemen. It is located in the Yemeni highlands near the port city of Mocha on the Red Sea at an elevation of about 1,400 metres (4,600 ft) above sea level.

Q456.name: Lyon
Q456.about: Lyon (Franco-Provençal: Liyon; formerly Lyons in English) is a city in France. It is located at the confluence of the rivers Rhône and Saône, to the northwest of the French Alps, 391 km (243 mi) southeast of Paris, 278 km (173 mi) north of Marseille, and 113 km (70 mi) southwest of Geneva, Switzerland.
Q456.img: 01. Panorama de Lyon pris depuis le toit de la Basilique de Fourvière.jpg

Q459.name: Plovdiv
Q459.desc: city in Plovdiv municipality, Plovdiv oblast, Bulgaria
Q459.about: Plovdiv (Bulgarian: Пловдив, pronounced [ˈpɫɔvdif]) (greek: Φιλιππούπολη) is the second-largest city in Bulgaria and the most populous city in the Bulgarian part of the historic region of Thrace, located 144 km (93 miles) southeast of the capital Sofia. It is considered the oldest European continually inhabited city, having been inhabited since c.

Q4709.name: Barquisimeto
Q4709.about: Barquisimeto is the capital city of Lara and seat of the Iribarren Municipality in Venezuela. Barquisimeto is located in the Central-Western Region.

Q4803.name: Surakarta
Q4803.desc: city in Central Java Province, Indonesia
Q4803.about: Surakarta (Javanese: ꦯꦸꦫꦏꦂꦠ, Pegon: سوراكارتا), known colloquially as Solo (Javanese: ꦱꦭ, romanized: Sålå), is a major city in Central Java, Indonesia. The 46.72 km2 (18.04 sq mi) city adjoins Karanganyar Regency and Boyolali Regency to the north, Karanganyar Regency and Sukoharjo Regency to the east and west, and Sukoharjo Regency to the south.

Q43509.name: Guayaquil
Q43509.about: Guayaquil (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡwaʝaˈkil] ), officially Santiago de Guayaquil, is the capital of Guayas Province and the seat of Guayaquil Canton. It is the largest city in Ecuador and also the nation's economic capital and main port.

Q43595.name: Cotonou
Q43595.desc: city in Benin, seat of the government
Q43595.about: Cotonou (French pronunciation: [kɔtɔnu]; Fon: Kútɔ̀nú) is the seat of government and largest city of Benin. The official city proper population was 679,012 in 2012; however, over two million people live in the larger urban area.
Q43595.img: Vue panoramique quartier cadjéhoun-Cotonou au Bénin 1.jpg

Q459787.name: Iloilo City
Q459787.desc: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Iloilo
Q459787.about: Iloilo City, officially the City of Iloilo (Hiligaynon: Dakbanwa sang Iloilo; Tagalog: Lungsod ng Iloilo; Spanish: Ciudad de Iloílo), is a highly urbanized city in the Western Visayas region of the Philippines, located on the southeastern coast of the island of Panay. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 473,728 people, making it the most populous city in Western Visayas.

Q460222.name: Ulhasnagar
Q460222.about: Ulhasnagar is a city located 26 km from Thane City in Thane district, Maharashtra, India. This city is a part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region managed by the MMRDA. It had an estimated population of 506,098 at the 2011 Census.

Q461204.name: Bibb County
Q461204.about: Bibb County is a county in the central portion of the U.S. state of Alabama. The county is a part of the Birmingham, AL Metropolitan Statistical Area, and is included in the ARC's definition of Appalachia.

Q461307.name: Muzaffarabad
Q461307.about:
Muzaffarabad is the capital and largest city of Azad Kashmir, a Pakistani-administered administrative territory in the disputed Kashmir region.
The city is located in Muzaffarabad District, near the confluence of the Jhelum and Neelum rivers.

Q461562.name: Amelia County
Q461562.about: Amelia County is a county located just southwest of Richmond in the Commonwealth of Virginia, United States. The county is located in Central Virginia and is included in the Greater Richmond Region.

Q461826.name: Grand Island
Q461826.desc: city in and county seat of Hall County, Nebraska, United States
Q461826.about: Grand Island is a city in and the county seat of Hall County, Nebraska, United States. The population was 53,131 at the 2020 census, making it the 4th most populous city in Nebraska.

Q462161.name: Kenosha
Q462161.desc: city in and county seat of Kenosha County, Wisconsin and part of the Chicago metropolitan area, known as Chicagoland
Q462161.about: Kenosha ( ) is a city in Kenosha County, Wisconsin, United States, and its county seat. Located on the southwestern shore of Lake Michigan, it is the fourth-most populous city in Wisconsin, with 99,986 residents at the 2020 census.

Q44013.name: Vaughan
Q44013.about: Vaughan ( VAWN) (2021 population: 323,103) is a city in Ontario, Canada. It is located in the Regional Municipality of York, just north of Toronto, Ontario.
Q44013.img: View from the top of Behemoth (Canada's Wonderland).jpg

Q44016.name: Markham
Q44016.desc: city in the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada
Q44016.about: Markham () is a city in York Region, Ontario, Canada. It is approximately 30 km (19 mi) northeast of Downtown Toronto.

Q44198.name: Brampton
Q44198.about: Brampton is the ninth most populous municipality in Canada and the regional seat of the Regional Municipality of Peel. It is also the third most populous city in the Greater Golden Horseshoe urban area, behind Toronto and Mississauga.

Q44206.name: Resistencia
Q44206.desc: capital city of Chaco Province, Argentina
Q44206.about: Resistencia (pronounced [resisˈtensja] ) is the capital and largest city of the province of Chaco in north-eastern Argentina. According to the 2010 census, the population of the city proper was 291,720 inhabitants.

Q467487.name: Kurashiki
Q467487.about: Kurashiki (倉敷市, Kurashiki-shi) is a city located in Okayama Prefecture, Japan.  As of 31 March 2023, the city had an estimated population of 478,651 and a population density of 1300 persons per km2.

Q468557.name: Miami-Dade County
Q468557.about: Miami-Dade County (), known simply as Dade County prior to 1997, is located in the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Florida. The county had a population of 2,701,767 as of the 2020 census, making it the most populous county in Florida and the seventh-most-populous county in the United States.
Q468557.img: Downtown Miami photo Don Ramey Logan.jpg

Q468782.name: Huancayo
Q468782.desc: capital city of Junín region, Peru
Q468782.about: Huancayo (Spanish pronunciation: [waŋˈkaʝo]; in Wanka Quechua: Wankayu, '(place) with a (sacred) rock', Quechua pronunciation: [waŋˈkajuː]) is the capital of the Junín Region and Huancayo Province, in the central highlands of Peru, in the Mantaro Valley and is crossed by the Shullcas, Chilca and Mantaro rivers. It was founded as a reduction by the name Santísima Trinidad de Huancayo on 1 June 1572, by Don Jerónimo de Silva, a Spanish conquistador.

Q470273.name: Ames
Q470273.desc: city in Story County, Iowa, United States
Q470273.about: Ames () is a city in Story County, Iowa, United States, located approximately 30 miles (48 km) north of Des Moines in central Iowa. It is the home of Iowa State University (ISU).

Q470592.name: Amherst
Q470592.desc: town in New York, United States
Q470592.about: Amherst ( ) is a town in Erie County, New York, United States. It is a suburb of Buffalo.

Q470626.name: Amherst County
Q470626.about: Amherst County is located in the Piedmont region, near the center of the Commonwealth of Virginia in the United States. The county is part of the Lynchburg metropolitan area, and its county seat is also named Amherst.

Q472675.name: Frederick
Q472675.desc: city in Frederick County, Maryland, United States
Q472675.about: Frederick is a city in and the county seat of Frederick County, Maryland, United States. Frederick's population was 78,171 people as of the 2020 census, making it the second-largest incorporated city in Maryland behind Baltimore.

Q484385.name: Columbia County
Q484385.about: Columbia County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 52,589.

Q484388.name: Klamath County
Q484388.about: Klamath County ( KLAM-əth) is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 69,413.

Q484391.about: Josephine County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 88,090.

Q484395.name: Douglas County
Q484395.about: Douglas County is one of the 36 counties in the U.S. state of Oregon. As of the 2020 census, the population was 111,201.

Q484398.name: Douglas County
Q484398.about: Douglas County is a county in the northwestern part of the U.S. state of Nevada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 49,488.

Q484401.name: Elko County
Q484401.about: Elko County is a county in the northeastern corner of Nevada, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 53,702.

Q44211.name: Corrientes
Q44211.desc: capital of the province of Corrientes, Argentina
Q44211.about: Corrientes (Spanish pronunciation: [koˈrjentes] ; Guarani: Taragui, lit. 'Currents') is the capital city of the province of Corrientes, Argentina, on the eastern shore of the Paraná River, about 1,000 km (621 mi) from Buenos Aires and 300 km (186 mi) from Posadas, on National Route 12. It has a population of 346,334 according to the 2010 Census.

Q44217.name: San Salvador de Jujuy
Q44217.desc: city in Argentina, capital of Jujuy Province
Q44217.about: San Salvador de Jujuy (Spanish pronunciation: [san salβaˈðoɾ ðe xuˈxuj]), commonly known as Jujuy and locally often referred to as San Salvador, is the capital and largest city of Jujuy Province in northwest Argentina. Also, it is the seat of the Doctor Manuel Belgrano Department.

Q44238.name: Posadas
Q44238.about: Posadas (Spanish pronunciation: [poˈsaðas]) is the capital city of the Argentine province of Misiones, in its south, at the far northeast of the country on the left bank of the Paraná River, opposite Encarnación, Paraguay. The city has an area of 965 square kilometres (373 sq mi) and a population of 324,756 (2010 census [INDEC]), and the Greater Posadas area has a population of over 359,609 according to a 2017 estimate.

Q44244.name: Santa Fe
Q44244.desc: city in and capital of Santa Fe Province, Argentina
Q44244.about: Santa Fe de la Vera Cruz (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsanta ˈfe ðe la ˈβeɾa ˈkɾus], lit. 'Holy Faith of the True Cross'), usually called just Santa Fe, is the capital city of the province of Santa Fe, Argentina.  It is situated in north-eastern Argentina, near the junction of the Paraná and Salado rivers.

Q44253.name: Santiago del Estero
Q44253.desc: the capital of Santiago del Estero Province in northern Argentina
Q44253.about: Santiago del Estero (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo ðel esˈteɾo], Spanish for Saint-James-Upon-The-Lagoon) is the capital of Santiago del Estero Province in northern Argentina. It has a population of 252,192 inhabitants, (2010 census [INDEC]) making it the twelfth largest city in the country, with a surface area of 2,116 km2.

Q475301.name: Blount County
Q475301.about: Blount County is a county located in the East Tennessee Grand Division of the U.S. state of Tennessee. As of the 2020 census, its population was 135,280.

Q477232.name: Aktobe
Q477232.about: Aktobe (Kazakh: Ақтөбе, romanized: Aqtöbe, pronounced [ɑqtɵbʲé] ; Russian: Актобе) is a major city in western Kazakhstan, located on the river Ilek. It serves as the administrative center of the Aktobe Region and is an important cultural, economic, and industrial hub.

Q477870.name: Texas County
Q477870.about: Texas County is a county located in the southern portion of the U.S. state of Missouri. As of the 2020 census, the population was 24,487.

Q477951.name: Glascock County
Q477951.about: Glascock County is a county located in the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 2,884, making it the fourth-least populous county in Georgia.

Q478207.name: Kenitra
Q478207.about: Kenitra is a city in northwestern Morocco. It is a major urban center on the mouth of the Sebou River with a population of 507,736 as of 2024, with Mehdya counting an additional 58,558.

Q478675.name: Riobamba
Q478675.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the Chimborazo Province
Q478675.about: Riobamba (Spanish pronunciation: [rjoˈβamba], full name San Pedro de Riobamba; Quechua: Rispampa) is the capital of Chimborazo Province in central Ecuador, and is located in the Chambo River Valley of the Andes. It is located 200 km (120 mi) south of Ecuador's capital Quito and situated at an elevation of 2,754 m.

Q482657.name: Logan
Q482657.desc: city in and county seat of Cache County, Utah, United States
Q482657.about: Logan is a city in Cache County, Utah, United States. The 2020 census recorded the population at 52,778.

Q484411.name: Curry County
Q484411.about: Curry County is the southwesternmost county in the U.S. state of Oregon located on the South Coast. As of the 2020 census, the population was 23,446.

Q484418.name: Nye County
Q484418.about: Nye County is a county in the U.S. state of Nevada. As of the 2020 census, the population was 51,591.

Q515983.name: Shangluo
Q515983.about: Shangluo (Chinese: 商洛; pinyin: Shāngluò) is a prefecture-level city in southeastern Shaanxi province, People's Republic of China, bordering Henan to the northeast and Hubei to the southeast. Part of the Shannan region of the province, it is located in the eastern part of the Qin Mountains (Qin Ling).

Q5764.name: Bukhara
Q5764.desc: city in Bukhara Province of Uzbekistan
Q5764.about: Bukhara ( buu-KHAR-ə) is the seventh-largest city in Uzbekistan by population, with 305,500 residents as of 2026. It is the capital of Bukhara Region.

Q5779.name: Banda Aceh
Q5779.about: Banda Aceh ( BUN-də AH-chay; Acehnese: Banda Acèh, Jawoe: بند اچيه) is the capital and largest city in the province of Aceh, Indonesia. It is located on the island of Sumatra and has an elevation of 35 metres (115 ft).

Q5806.name: Mecca
Q5806.desc: Saudi Arabian city and capital of the Makkah province
Q5806.about: Mecca, officially Makkah al-Mukarramah, is a city in the Hejaz region of western Saudi Arabia and is the capital of Mecca Province. Mecca is considered the birthplace of Islam and the Islamic prophet Muhammad, as well as being the holiest city in Islam.

Q56151.name: Warren County
Q56151.desc: county in New York, United States
Q56151.about: Warren County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 65,737.

Q56152.name: Ulster County
Q56152.desc: county in New York, United States
Q56152.about: Ulster County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. It is situated along the Hudson River.

Q56153.name: Tompkins County
Q56153.desc: county in New York, United States
Q56153.about: Tompkins County is a county located in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 105,740.
Q56153.img: Cornell University, Ho Plaza and Sage Hall.jpg

Q56154.name: Tioga County
Q56154.desc: county in New York, United States
Q56154.about: Tioga County  is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 48,455.

Q57278.name: Newcastle
Q57278.desc: city in New South Wales, Australia
Q57278.about: Newcastle, also known as Greater Newcastle (locally  NEW-kah-səl; Awabakal: Mulubinba), is a large metropolitan area and the second-most-populous such area of New South Wales, Australia. It includes the cities of Newcastle and Lake Macquarie and it is the hub of the Lower Hunter region, which includes most parts of the cities of Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Cessnock, and Port Stephens Council.

Q516817.name: Albany
Q516817.desc: city in and county seat of Linn County, Oregon, United States
Q516817.about: Albany ( AL-bə-nee) is a city in and the county seat of Linn County, Oregon, and is the 11th most populous city in the state. Albany is located in the Willamette Valley at the confluence of the Calapooia River and the Willamette River in both Linn and Benton counties, just east of Corvallis and south of Salem.

Q518076.name: Verdun
Q518076.desc: borough in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, former municipality
Q518076.about: Verdun ( vər-DUN, Quebec French: [vaɛ̯ʁdœ̃˞]) is a borough (arrondissement) of the city of Montreal, Quebec, located in the southeastern part of the island. From 1907 to 2002, Verdun was a separate municipality from Montreal.

Q518431.name: Chimbote
Q518431.about: Chimbote  [tʃimˈbote] ; Quechua: Chimputi) is a city in northwestern Peru. It is the largest city in the Ancash Region and the tenth most populous in Peru.

Q518785.name: Butembo
Q518785.desc: city of the Democratic Republic of thé Congo
Q518785.about: Butembo is a city in North Kivu province, in the north eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on the Rwenzori graben and west of Virunga National Park. The city is an important commercial centre with large markets, a cathedral, multiple large hospitals, and an airport.

Q519486.name: Davangere
Q519486.about: Dāvanagere is a city, taluka in the centre of the southern Indian state of Karnataka. It is the seventh largest city in the state and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous Davangere district.

Q523778.name: Sahiwal
Q523778.desc: city in Sahiwal District, Punjab, Pakistan
Q523778.about:
Sahiwal (Punjabi / Urdu: ساہيوال; Punjabi pronunciation: [sä˦ʱi̯.ʋälᵊ]; Urdu pronunciation: [ˈsɑːˌɦiːˈʋɑːl]), formerly known as Montgomery in British India, is a city in central Punjab, Pakistan. 
It is the administrative capital of both Sahiwal District and Sahiwal Division.

Q526848.name: Parkchester
Q526848.about: The Parkchester station (announced as Parkchester–East 177th Street on NTT trains) is an express station on the IRT Pelham Line of the New York City Subway. It is located above Hugh J. Grant Circle in the Parkchester and Castle Hill neighborhoods of the Bronx, where East 177th Street (the Cross Bronx Expressway service road), Metropolitan Avenue, and Westchester Avenue intersect.

Q528432.name: Bamenda
Q528432.about: Bamenda, also known as Abakwa and Mankon Town, is a city in northwestern Cameroon and capital of the Northwest Region. The city has a population of about six hundred thousand people and is located 366 km (227 mi) north-west of the Cameroonian capital, Yaoundé.

Q51684.name: Gilbert
Q51684.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q51684.about: Gilbert is a town in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States. Located southeast of Phoenix, Gilbert had a population of 287,285 as of 2025.

Q51685.name: Tempe
Q51685.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q51685.about: Tempe ( tem-PEE; O'odham: Oidbaḍ) is a city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States, with the Census Bureau reporting a 2020 population of 180,587. The city is home to the main campus of Arizona State University, one of the largest public universities by enrollment in the United States.

Q51686.name: Peoria
Q51686.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q51686.about: Peoria ( pee-OR-ee-ə) is a city in Maricopa and Yavapai counties in the U.S. state of Arizona. Most of the city is located in Maricopa County, while a portion of it in the north is in Yavapai County.

Q51687.name: Surprise
Q51687.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q51687.about: Surprise is a city in Maricopa County, in the U.S. state of Arizona. Its population was 143,148 at the 2020 census, up from 117,517 in 2010 and 30,848 in 2000.

Q51689.name: Plano
Q51689.desc: city in Collin and Denton counties in Texas, United States
Q51689.about: Plano ( PLAY-noh; Spanish for 'flat surface') is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, where it is the largest city in Collin County. A small portion of Plano is located in Denton County.

Q57958.name: Zhenjiang
Q57958.about: Zhenjiang, alternately romanized as Chinkiang, is a prefecture-level city in Jiangsu Province, China. It lies on the southern bank of the Yangtze River near its intersection with the Grand Canal.

Q57970.name: Changzhou
Q57970.about: Changzhou is a prefecture-level city in southern Jiangsu, China. It was previously known as Yanling, Lanling, and Jinling.

Q533985.name: Pingliang
Q533985.about: Pingliang (simplified Chinese: 平凉; traditional Chinese: 平涼; pinyin: Píngliàng; lit. 'Pacify Liang') is a prefecture-level city in eastern Gansu province, China, bordering Shaanxi province to the south and east and the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region to the north.
Q533985.img: A gongbei sufi saints tomb at Pingliang Gansu.jpg

Q534536.name: Arcadia
Q534536.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q534536.about: Arcadia is a city in Los Angeles County, California, United States, located about 13 miles (21 km) northeast of downtown Los Angeles in the San Gabriel Valley and at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains. It contains a series of adjacent parks consisting of the Santa Anita Park racetrack, the Los Angeles County Arboretum and Botanic Garden, and Arcadia County Park.

Q535534.name: Hohhot
Q535534.about: Hohhot, formerly known as Guihua or Kweisui (Guisui), is the capital and largest city of the northern Chinese autonomous region of Inner Mongolia, serving as the region's administrative, economic and cultural center. Its population was 3,446,100 inhabitants as of the 2020 census, of whom 2,944,889 lived in the metropolitan area consisting of 4 urban districts (including Hohhot Economic and Development Zone) plus the Tumed Left Banner.

Q537853.name: Carmel
Q537853.desc: city in Hamilton County, Indiana, United States
Q537853.about: Carmel () is a suburban city in Hamilton County, Indiana, United States, immediately north of Indianapolis. With a population of 99,757 as of the 2020 census, the city spans 49 square miles (130 km2) across Clay Township and is bordered by the White River to the east and the Boone County line to the west.

Q539994.name: Division No. 3
Q539994.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q539994.about: Division No. 3 is a census division located within the Pembina Valley Region in the south-central region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q540312.name: Nagaoka
Q540312.about: Nagaoka (長岡市, Nagaoka-shi) is a city located in Niigata Prefecture, Japan. It is the second largest city in the prefecture, after the capital city of Niigata.

Q540727.name: Poway
Q540727.desc: city in San Diego County, California, United States
Q540727.about: Poway () is a city in San Diego County, California, United States. Poway's rural roots influenced its motto "The City in the Country".

Q540907.name: Marshall County
Q540907.about: Marshall County is a county in the U.S. state of Indiana. The 2020 census recorded the population at 46,095.

Q51678.name: Pago Pago
Q51678.about: Pago Pago is the capital of American Samoa.  It is in Maoputasi County on Tutuila, the main island of American Samoa.

Q51681.name: Charlotte Amalie
Q51681.desc: capital and largest city of the United States Virgin Islands
Q51681.about: Charlotte Amalie ( SHAR-lət ə-MAH-lee(-ə); Danish: [ʃɑˈlʌtʰə ɑˈmɑːljə]), on Saint Thomas, is the capital and largest town of the U.S. Virgin Islands. It is on the island's southern shore at the head of Charlotte Amalie Harbor.

Q51682.name: Glendale
Q51682.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q51682.about: Glendale () is a city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States. Bordering the state capital, as a suburb of Phoenix, Glendale is known for State Farm Stadium, which is the home of the Arizona Cardinals football team.

Q57756.name: Lianyungang
Q57756.about: Lianyungang (simplified Chinese: 连云港; traditional Chinese: 連雲港; pinyin: Liányúngǎng) is a prefecture-level city in northeastern Jiangsu province, China. It borders Yancheng to its southeast, Huai'an and Suqian to its south, Xuzhou to its southwest, and the province of Shandong to its north.

Q57787.name: Suqian
Q57787.about: Suqian (simplified Chinese: 宿迁; traditional Chinese: 宿遷; pinyin: Sùqiān, IPA: [sû.tɕʰjɛ́n]) is a prefecture-level city in northern Jiangsu Province, China. It borders Xuzhou to the northwest, Lianyungang to the northeast, Huai'an to the south, and the province of Anhui to the west.

Q57818.name: Huai'an
Q57818.about: Huai'an, formerly Huaiyin, is a prefecture-level city in Jiangsu in Eastern China. As of 2020, the built-up area (metro) of its 3 central urban districts had 2,544,767 inhabitants and the prefecture-level city as a whole had 4,556,230 inhabitants.

Q57906.name: Yangzhou
Q57906.desc: prefecture-level city in Jiangsu, People's Republic of China
Q57906.about: Yangzhou is a prefecture-level city in central Jiangsu Province, East China. Sitting on the north bank of the Yangtze, it borders the provincial capital Nanjing to the southwest, Huai'an to the north, Yancheng to the northeast, Taizhou to the east, and Zhenjiang across the river to the south.

Q57931.name: Taizhou
Q57931.about: Taizhou (Chinese: 泰州; pinyin: Tàizhōu) is a city in Jiangsu province in eastern China. Situated on the north bank of the Yangtze River, it borders Nantong to the east, Yancheng to the north and Yangzhou to the west.

Q57947.name: Nantong
Q57947.desc: Prefecture-level city in Jiangsu, China, on the north side of the mouth of the Yangtze River
Q57947.about: Nantong is a prefecture-level city in southeastern Jiangsu province, China. Located on the northern bank of the Yangtze River, near the river mouth.

Q528670.name: Les Jardins-de-Napierville
Q528670.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q528670.about: Les Jardins-de-Napierville (French pronunciation: [le ʒaʁdɛ̃ də napjɛʁvil], "The Gardens of Napierville") is a regional county municipality (RCM) in southwestern Quebec, Canada, in the Montérégie region. Founded on January 1, 1982.

Q529165.name: Royal Oak
Q529165.desc: city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q529165.about: Royal Oak is a city in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. An inner-ring suburb of Detroit, Royal Oak is located roughly 10 miles (16.1 km) north of downtown Detroit.

Q529958.name: Craven County
Q529958.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q529958.about: Craven County is a county located in the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 100,720.

Q530171.name: Ajman
Q530171.desc: Capital of the Emirate of Ajman in the United Arab Emirates
Q530171.about: Ajman (Arabic: عجمان 'Aǧmān; Gulf Arabic: عيمان ʿYmān) is the fifth-largest and fifth-most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, after Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and Al Ain. It is the capital of the Emirate of Ajman and forms part of the Dubai–Sharjah–Ajman metropolitan area.

Q531275.name: South Whittier
Q531275.desc: census designated place in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q531275.about: South Whittier () is an unincorporated community in Los Angeles County, California, United States, just south of the city of Whittier. For statistical purposes, the United States Census Bureau has defined South Whittier as a census-designated place (CDP).

Q532344.name: Parsippany-Troy Hills
Q532344.desc: township in Morris County, New Jersey, United States
Q532344.about: Parsippany–Troy Hills, commonly known as Parsippany ( par-SIP-ə-nee), is a township in Morris County, in the northern portion of the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2025 U.S Census Bureau, the township's population was 56,633.
Q532344.img: BENJAMIN HOWELL HOMESTEAD, PARSIPPANY, MORRIS COUNTY.jpg

Q532711.name: Encinitas
Q532711.desc: city in San Diego County, California, United States
Q532711.about: Encinitas is a beach city in the North County area of San Diego County, California, United States. Located in Southern California, it is approximately 25 miles (40 km) north of San Diego, between Solana Beach and Carlsbad, and about 95 miles (153 km) south of Los Angeles.

Q532981.name: Baiyin
Q532981.about: Baiyin (simplified Chinese: 白银; traditional Chinese: 白銀; pinyin: Báiyín; lit. 'White-Silver') is a prefecture-level city in northeastern Gansu province, People's Republic of China.

Q533432.name: Jiuquan
Q533432.about: Jiuquan, formerly known as Suzhou, is a prefecture-level city in the northwesternmost part of Gansu Province in the People's Republic of China. It is more than 600 km (370 mi) wide from east to west, occupying 191,342 km2 (73,878 sq mi), although its built-up area is mostly located in its Suzhou District.

Q533764.name: Qingyang
Q533764.about: Qingyang (simplified Chinese: 庆阳; traditional Chinese: 慶陽; pinyin: Qìngyáng) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Gansu province, China.
Q533764.img: 宁县二中，甘肃宁县，中国 - panoramio.jpg

Q51690.name: Irving
Q51690.desc: city in Dallas County, Texas, United States
Q51690.about: Irving is a city in Dallas County, Texas, United States. It is part of the Mid-Cities region of the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and is an inner city suburb of Dallas.
Q51690.img: View of the "Mustangs of Las Colinas" sculpture in the upscale Las Colinas neighborhood of Irving, Texas LCCN2015630710.jpg

Q51691.name: Amarillo
Q51691.desc: city in Potter and Randall counties in Texas, United States, that is also the seat of Potter County
Q51691.about: Amarillo ( AM-ə-RIL-oh; Spanish for "yellow") is a city in the U.S. state of Texas and the county seat of Potter County, though most of the southern half of the city extends into Randall County. It is the 17th-most populous city in Texas and the most populous city in the Texas panhandle.

Q51693.name: Brownsville
Q51693.desc: city in and county seat of Cameron County, Texas, United States
Q51693.about: Brownsville is a city in the U.S. state of Texas and the largest city and county seat of Cameron County, located on the western Gulf Coast in South Texas, adjacent to the border with Matamoros, Tamaulipas, Mexico. The city covers 145.2 sq mi (376.066 km2), and had a population of 186,738 at the 2020 census.

Q51694.name: Grand Prairie
Q51694.desc: city in Dallas, Tarrant, and Ellis counties in Texas, United States
Q51694.about: Grand Prairie is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, located in Dallas, Tarrant,  and  Ellis  counties with a small part extending into Johnson county. It is part of the Mid-Cities region in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.
Q51694.img: Grand Prairie May 2019 27 (Market Square water tower).jpg

Q51695.name: Pasadena
Q51695.desc: city southeast of Houston, belonging to Harris County, Texas, United States
Q51695.about: Pasadena (  PASS-ə-DEE-nə) is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, located in Harris County. It is part of the Houston–Pasadena–The Woodlands metropolitan area.

Q51696.name: Mesquite
Q51696.desc: city in Dallas and Kaufman counties in Texas, United States
Q51696.about: Mesquite is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, located in Dallas County with portions extending into Kaufman County. The population was 150,108 at the 2020 census, making it the 22nd-most populous city in Texas.

Q51697.name: McKinney
Q51697.desc: city and a county seat in Collin County, Texas, United States
Q51697.about: McKinney is a city in and the county seat of Collin County, Texas, United States. It is Collin County's third-largest city, after Plano and Frisco.

Q51698.name: McAllen
Q51698.desc: city in Hidalgo County, Texas, United States
Q51698.about: McAllen is a city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is located at the southern tip of the state in the Rio Grande Valley, on the Mexican border.

Q51733.name: Ascension Parish
Q51733.about: Ascension Parish (French: Paroisse de l'Ascension; Spanish: Parroquia de la Ascensión) is a parish located in the U.S. state of Louisiana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 126,500.

Q52250.name: Iron County
Q52250.about: Iron County is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 census, the population was 6,137, making it the third-least populous county in Wisconsin.

Q543098.name: Sunbury County
Q543098.about: Sunbury County (2021 population 27,864) is located in central New Brunswick, Canada. A large military base (CFB Gagetown) is located in the western part of the county south of the town of Oromocto.

Q544539.name: Haralson County
Q544539.about: Haralson County is a county in the Northwest region of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 29,919, up from 28,780 in 2010.

Q544890.name: Plainfield
Q544890.desc: city in Union County, New Jersey, United States of America
Q544890.about: Plainfield is a city in Union County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. Nicknamed "The Queen City," it serves as both a regional hub for Central New Jersey and a bedroom suburb of the New York Metropolitan area, located in the Raritan Valley region.

Q546463.name: Division No. 5
Q546463.about: Division No. 5 is one of eighteen census divisions in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada, as defined by Statistics Canada.

Q550219.name: Capital Regional District
Q550219.desc: administrative district in British Columbia, Canada
Q550219.about: The Capital Regional District (CRD) is a local government administrative district encompassing the southern tip of Vancouver Island and the southern Gulf Islands in the Canadian province of British Columbia. The CRD is one of several regional districts in British Columbia and had an official population of 415,451 as of the Canada 2021 Census.

Q556989.name: Ankeny
Q556989.desc: city in Polk County, Iowa, United States
Q556989.about: Ankeny (, ) is a city in Polk County, Iowa, United States and a suburb of the state capital of Des Moines. The population was 67,887 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 77,833 in 2025, making it Iowa's fifth-most populous city.

Q559834.name: Bharatpur
Q559834.about: Bharatpur is a city in the Indian state of Rajasthan, 189 km (117 mi) south of India's capital, New Delhi, 184 km (114 mi) from Rajasthan's capital Jaipur, 56 km (35 mi) west of Agra of Uttar Pradesh and 36 km (22 mi) from Mathura of Uttar Pradesh. It is the administrative headquarters of Bharatpur district and the headquarters of Bharatpur Division of Rajasthan State.
Q559834.img: View of Bharatpur from the Iron Fort (4609955939).jpg

Q564523.name: Annapolis County
Q564523.about: Annapolis County is a county in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia located in the western part of the province located on the Bay of Fundy. The county seat is Annapolis Royal.

Q569907.name: Baotou
Q569907.desc: prefecture-level city in Inner Mongolia, China
Q569907.about: Baotou is the second-largest city by urban population in Inner Mongolia, China. Governed as a prefecture-level city, its built-up (or metro) area within its five urban districts is home to 2,261,089 people while the total population is 2,709,378 as of the 2020 census.

Q570090.name: Banqiao District
Q570090.desc: district in New Taipei City, Taiwan
Q570090.about: Banqiao District (Chinese: 板橋區; pinyin: Bǎnqiáo Qū) Banciao, Panchiao or Pan-ch'iao is a district and the seat of New Taipei City, Taiwan. It has the third-highest population density in Taiwan, with over 24,000/km2 (62,000/sq mi).
Q570090.img: 新北市政府 New Taipei city hall - panoramio.jpg

Q570829.name: Chifeng
Q570829.desc: prefecture-level city in Inner Mongolia, China
Q570829.about: Chifeng is a prefecture-level city in Southeastern Inner Mongolia, People's Republic of China. It borders Xilin Gol League to the north and west, Tongliao to the northeast, Chaoyang (Liaoning) to the southeast and Chengde (Hebei) to the south.

Q54082.name: Bristol County
Q54082.about: Bristol County is a county in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 579,200.

Q54086.name: Plymouth County
Q54086.about: Plymouth County is a county in the U.S. state of Massachusetts, south of Boston. As of the 2020 census, the population was 530,819.

Q54089.name: Barnstable County
Q54089.about: Barnstable County ( BARN-stə-bəl) is a county in the U.S. state of Massachusetts. At the 2020 census, the population was 228,996.

Q54091.name: Dukes County
Q54091.about: Dukes County is a county in the U.S. state of Massachusetts. At the 2020 census, the population was 20,600, making it the second-least populous county in Massachusetts.

Q54093.name: Worcester County
Q54093.about: Worcester County ( WUUST-ər) is located in the U.S. state of Massachusetts. At the 2020 census, the population was 862,111, making it the second-most populous county in Massachusetts.
Q54093.img: Worcester County Courthouse - Worcester, MA - DSC05778.jpg

Q574593.name: Warri
Q574593.desc: Local government areas in Delta State,in Nigeria.
Q574593.about: The city of Warri is an oil hub within South-South Nigeria and houses an annex of the Delta State Government House. Warri is one of the major hubs of the petroleum industry in Nigeria.

Q574612.name: New Braunfels
Q574612.desc: city in Comal and Guadalupe counties in Texas, United States, that is the seat of Comal County
Q574612.about: New Braunfels (  BRAWN-fəlz) is a city in Comal and Guadalupe counties in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the county seat of Comal County.
Q574612.img: Guadalupe River in New Braunfels, TX IMG 0499.JPG

Q575254.name: La Vallée-de-l'Or
Q575254.desc: regional county municipality in Québec, Canada
Q575254.about: La Vallée-de-l'Or (French pronunciation: [la vale də lɔʁ]) is a regional county municipality in the Abitibi-Témiscamingue region in Northwestern Quebec, Canada. The seat is in Val-d'Or.

Q575315.name: Wheaton
Q575315.desc: city and county seat of DuPage County, Illinois, United States
Q575315.about: Wheaton is a city in and the county seat of DuPage County, Illinois, United States. It is located in Milton and Winfield Townships, approximately 25 miles (40 km) west of Chicago.

Q575407.name: Normal
Q575407.desc: town in McLean County, Illinois, United States
Q575407.about: Normal is a town in McLean County, Illinois, United States. The population was 52,736 at the 2020 census.

Q575491.name: Antigonish County
Q575491.about: Antigonish County is a historical county and census division of Nova Scotia, Canada. Local government is provided by the Municipality of the County of Antigonish, the Town of Antigonish, and by two reserves: Pomquet and Afton 23, and Summerside 38.

Q575571.name: L'Érable
Q575571.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q575571.about: L'Érable (French pronunciation: [leʁabl], Maple) is a regional county municipality in the Centre-du-Québec region of Quebec, Canada. Named for its maple trees, the area is rural in nature and is located 50 km (31 mi) southwest of Quebec City.

Q575600.name: Künes County
Q575600.about: Xinyuan County (Chinese: 新源县) as the official romanized name, also transliterated from Uyghur as Künas County (Uyghur: كۈنەس ناھىيىسى; Chinese: 巩乃斯县; pinyin: Gǒngnǎisī xiàn), is a county in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region and is under the administration of the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture. It contains an area of 7,581 km2.
Q575600.img: 鸟览那拉提空中草原 - panoramio.jpg

Q577415.name: Hancheng
Q577415.desc: county-level and sub-prefectural city in Shaanxi, People's Republic of China
Q577415.about: Hancheng (simplified Chinese: 韩城; traditional Chinese: 韓城; pinyin: Hánchéng) is a city in Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, about 125 miles northeast of Xi'an, at the point where the south-flowing Yellow River enters the Guanzhong Plain. It is a renowned historic city, containing numerous historic mansions and streets as well as over 140 protected historical sites that range from the Tang to the Qing dynasties.

Q577450.name: Hacienda Heights
Q577450.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q577450.about: Hacienda Heights () is an unincorporated community  in the San Gabriel Valley of Los Angeles County, California, United States. As of the 2020 census, the community had a total population of 54,191, up from 54,038 at the 2010 census.

Q577802.name: Bloomington
Q577802.desc: city and the county seat of McLean County, Illinois, United States
Q577802.about: Bloomington is a city in McLean County, Illinois, United States, and its county seat. The city had a population of 78,680 as of the 2020 census, making it the 13th-most populous city in Illinois and the fifth-most populous outside the Chicago metropolitan area.

Q577964.name: Champaign
Q577964.desc: city in Champaign County, Illinois, United States
Q577964.about: Champaign ( sham-PAYN) is a city in Champaign County, Illinois, United States. The population was 88,302 at the 2020 census.

Q578072.name: Berwyn
Q578072.desc: city in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q578072.about: Berwyn () is a suburban city in Cook County, Illinois, United States. It is coterminous with Berwyn Township, which was formed in 1908 after breaking off from Cicero Township.

Q578221.name: Cicero
Q578221.desc: town in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q578221.about: Cicero is a town in Cook County, Illinois, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 85,268, making it the 11th-most populous municipality in Illinois.

Q578289.name: Waukegan
Q578289.desc: city in and county seat of Lake County, Illinois, United States
Q578289.about: Waukegan ( wə-KEE-ghən) is a city in Lake County, Illinois, United States, and its county seat. Located 36 miles (58 km) north of Chicago, Waukegan is a satellite city within the greater Chicago metropolitan area.

Q578518.name: Cathedral City
Q578518.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q578518.about: Cathedral City is a desert resort city in Riverside County, California, United States, within the Colorado Desert's Coachella Valley. Situated between Palm Springs and Rancho Mirage, the city has the second largest population, after Indio, of the nine cities in the Coachella Valley.

Q579761.name: Thornton
Q579761.desc: city in Adams and Weld counties in Colorado, United States
Q579761.about: Thornton is a home rule city located in Adams and Weld counties, Colorado, United States. The city population was 141,867, all in Adams County, at the 2020 United States census, an increase of 19.44% since the 2010 United States census.

Q580649.name: Celaya
Q580649.desc: municipal seat of Celaya, State of Guanajuato, Mexico
Q580649.about: Celaya (Spanish pronunciation: [seˈlaja] ; Otomi: Ndathi) is a city and its surrounding municipality in the state of Guanajuato, Mexico, located in the southeast quadrant of the state. It is the third most populous city in the state, with a 2005 census population of 310,413.
Q580649.img: Templo de la Virgen del Carmen, Celaya, Guanajuato, México .jpg

Q580876.name: Vasai-Virar
Q580876.about: Vasai-Virar is an agglomeration of four previously governed municipal councils: Vasai (Bassein), Virar, Nallasopara and Navghar-Manikpur, as well as a few towns to the East and West of the urban area. It lies in the Konkan division of Maharashtra, India.The twin city of Vasai-Virar is a part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) and Mira-Bhayander, Vasai-Virar Police Commissionerate.

Q580965.name: Malegaon
Q580965.desc: city in Nashik district, Maharashtra, India
Q580965.about: Malegaon (IAST: Mālegāv; Pronunciation: [malegaːʋ]) is a city in Nashik District of Maharashtra State in India. It is situated on the bank of the Girna river with Mosam River river flowing through middle of the city dividing it in two parts.

Q5142559.name: Queens County
Q5142559.desc: county in New York, United States
Q5142559.about: Queens is the largest by area of the five boroughs of New York City, and the second most populous, with a population of 2,405,464 as of the 2020 census. Since 1899 the borough is coextensive with Queens County, the second-most populous county in New York state, behind Kings County (Brooklyn).

Q5170040.name: Cordova
Q5170040.desc: unincorporated community in Shelby County, Tennessee
Q5170040.about: Cordova is a community in Shelby County, Tennessee, United States. Cordova lies east of Memphis, north of Germantown, south of Bartlett, and northwest of Collierville at an elevation of 361 feet (110 meters).

Q5172108.name: Corona
Q5172108.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, United States
Q5172108.about: Corona is a neighborhood in the borough of Queens in New York City. It borders Flushing and Flushing Meadows–Corona Park to the east, Jackson Heights and  Elmhurst to the west, Forest Hills and Rego Park to the south, and East Elmhurst to the north.

Q5241708.name: San Tan Valley
Q5241708.desc: unincorporated community in Pinal County, Arizona, United States of America
Q5241708.about: San Tan Valley is a town in northern Pinal County, Arizona, United States. The population was 99,894 at the 2020 census.

Q5285403.name: Shyamnagar
Q5285403.desc: neighbourhood in North 24 Parganas, West Bengal, India
Q5285403.about: Shyamnagar is a locality in Bhatpara of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q5328357.name: East Flatbush
Q5328357.desc: neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York City, USA
Q5328357.about: East Flatbush is a residential neighborhood in the New York City borough of Brooklyn. East Flatbush is bounded by Crown Heights and Empire Boulevard to the north; Brownsville and East 98th Street to the east; Flatlands, Canarsie and the Long Island Rail Road's Bay Ridge Branch to the south; and the neighborhood of Flatbush and New York Avenue to the west.

Q5329059.name: East Norwalk
Q5329059.desc: human settlement in Norwalk, Connecticut, United States of America
Q5329059.about: East Norwalk is a neighborhood of Norwalk, Connecticut, United States. It is located mostly in Norwalk's third taxing district with segments of its northernmost area within the first and fifth taxing districts.

Q5468057.name: Fordham station
Q5468057.desc: Railway station in the Bronx, New York, US
Q5468057.about: Fordham station, also known as Fordham–East 190th Street station, is a commuter rail station located at Fordham Plaza in the Bronx, New York City. It is served by the Harlem Line and New Haven Line of the Metro-North Railroad system.

Q5479753.name: Francheville
Q5479753.about: Francheville (French pronunciation: [fʁɑ̃ʃvil] ) is a census division (CD) of Quebec, with geographical code 37. It consists of Les Chenaux Regional County Municipality and the territory equivalent to a regional county municipality (TE) of Trois-Rivières (which is a city and also a census subdivision).

Q5582862.name: Cusco
Q5582862.desc: historic city of Peru, capital of the Department of Cusco
Q5582862.about: Cusco or Cuzco (; Latin American Spanish: [ˈkusko]; Quechua: Qusqu/Qosqo [ˈqosqɔ]) is a city in southeastern Peru, near the Sacred Valley of the Andes mountain range, and the Huatanay and Urubamba rivers. It is the capital and largest city of the eponymous Cusco Province and Cusco Department.

Q5584396.name: Gorakhpur
Q5584396.about: Gorakhpur (Bhojpuri pronunciation: [ɡoˈɾəkʰ.pʊɾ]) is a city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh, along the banks of the Rapti river in the  Purvanchal region. It is situated 272 kilometres east of the state capital, Lucknow.

Q5683883.name: Havertown
Q5683883.desc: unincorporated community in Haverford Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania, United States; suburb of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
Q5683883.about: Havertown is a residential suburban unincorporated community in Haverford Township, Pennsylvania, United States. It is located approximately 9 miles west of the center of Philadelphia.

Q52607.name: Mar del Plata
Q52607.desc: city in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
Q52607.about: Mar del Plata is a city of the Atlantic Coast, in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. It is the seat of General Pueyrredón district.

Q52998.name: Richmond Hill
Q52998.about: Richmond Hill (2021 population: 202,022) is a Ontario city in the south-central Regional Municipality of York, Canada. Part of the Greater Toronto Area, it is the twelfth most populous municipality in Ontario and the twenty-seventh most populous municipality in Canada.

Q52999.name: Newmarket
Q52999.desc: town in York Region, Ontario, Canada
Q52999.about: Newmarket (2021 population: 87,942) is a town and regional seat of York Region, Ontario, Canada. It is part of the Greater Toronto Area in the Golden Horseshoe region of Southern Ontario.

Q53077.name: Saltillo
Q53077.desc: capital city of the State of Coahuila, Mexico
Q53077.about: Saltillo (Latin American Spanish: [salˈtiʝo] ) is the capital and largest city of the northeastern Mexican state of Coahuila and is also the municipal seat of the municipality of the same name. As of a 2020 census, Saltillo had a population of 879,958 people, while the Saltillo metropolitan area population was 1,031,779, making Saltillo the largest city in the state of Coahuila, and the 14th most populated metropolitan area in the country.

Q53139.name: Chita
Q53139.about: Chita (Russian: Чита, IPA: [tɕɪˈta]) is a city and the administrative center of Zabaykalsky Krai, Russia, located on the Trans-Siberian Railway route, roughly 1,100 kilometers (680 mi) east of Irkutsk and roughly 2,100 kilometers (1,300 mi) west of Khabarovsk. As of the 2021 census, the population is 334,427.
Q53139.img: Views of Chita from Titovskaya Hill (2026-06-10) - 0.jpg

Q54064.name: Nassau County
Q54064.desc: county in New York, United States
Q54064.about: Nassau County ( NASS-aw) is a densely populated and affluent suburban county located on Long Island, immediately to the east of New York City, bordering the Long Island Sound on the north and the open Atlantic Ocean to the south. As of the 2020 United States census, Nassau County's population was 1,395,774, making it the sixth-most populous county in the State of New York and 29th in the nation, reflecting an increase of 56,242 (+4.2%) from the 1,339,532 residents enumerated at the 2010 census.

Q54065.name: Suffolk County
Q54065.desc: county in New York, United States
Q54065.about: Suffolk County ( SUF-ək) is the easternmost county in the U.S. state of New York, constituting the eastern two-thirds of Long Island. Suffolk is bordered to its west by Nassau County, to its east by Gardiners Bay and the open Atlantic Ocean, to its north by Long Island Sound, and to its south by the Atlantic Ocean.

Q54066.name: Westchester County
Q54066.desc: county in New York, United States
Q54066.about: Westchester County is a county located in the southeastern portion of the U.S. state of New York, bordering the Long Island Sound and the Byram River to its east and the Hudson River on its west. The county is the seventh most populous county in the State of New York and the most populous north of New York City.

Q54072.name: Suffolk County
Q54072.about: Suffolk County ( SUF-ək) is located in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, in the United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 797,936, making it the fourth-most populous county in Massachusetts.

Q54073.name: Middlesex County
Q54073.about: Middlesex County is a county located in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, United States, one of fourteen in the state. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,632,002, making it the most populous county in both Massachusetts and New England and the 20th most populous county in the United States.
Q54073.img: Middlesex South Registry of Deeds, Cambridge MA.jpg

Q54076.name: Essex County
Q54076.about: Essex County is located in the northeastern part of the U.S. state of Massachusetts. At the 2020 census, the total population was 809,829, making it the third-most populous county in the state, and the seventy-eighth-most populous in the country.
Q54076.img: Essex County Superior Courthouse, Salem MA.jpg

Q54079.name: Norfolk County
Q54079.about: Norfolk County ( NOR-fək) is a county located in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. At the 2020 census, the population was around 725,981.

Q572014.name: Hezhou
Q572014.about: Hezhou (simplified Chinese: 贺州; traditional Chinese: 賀州) is a prefecture-level city in the northeast of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China.

Q572089.name: Hechi
Q572089.about: Hechi (Chinese: 河池) is a prefecture-level city in the northwest of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China, bordering Guizhou to the north. In June 2002 it gained city status.

Q572231.name: Chongzuo
Q572231.about: Chongzuo (Chinese: 崇左; pinyin: Chóngzuǒ; Zhuang: Cungzcoj) is a prefecture-level city in the south of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region near the Sino-Vietnamese border. It is home to one of China's largest Zhuang populations.

Q574192.name: Greenville
Q574192.desc: county seat of Greenville County, South Carolina, United States
Q574192.about: Greenville ( GREEN-vil, locally  GREEN-vəl) is a city in Greenville County, South Carolina, United States, and its county seat. It is the sixth-most populous city in South Carolina with a population of 70,720 at the 2020 census, while the Greenville metropolitan area has an estimated 997,000 residents and is the largest metropolitan area in the state.

Q55893348.name: Seville city
Q55893348.desc: human settlement in Seville, Seville Province, Andalusia, Spain
Q55893348.img: Plaza Virgen de los Reyes, Seville, Spain - Sep 2009.jpg

Q52465.name: West Valley City
Q52465.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q52465.about:
West Valley City is a city in Salt Lake County and an inner suburb of Salt Lake City in the U.S. state of Utah. The population was 140,230 at the 2020 census,
making it the second-most populous city in Utah after Salt Lake City.

Q52466.name: West Jordan
Q52466.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q52466.about: West Jordan is a city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States. It is a suburb of Salt Lake City.

Q52467.name: South Jordan
Q52467.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q52467.about: South Jordan is a city in south central Salt Lake County, Utah, United States, 18 miles (29 km) south of Salt Lake City. Part of the Salt Lake City metropolitan area, the city lies in the Salt Lake Valley along the banks of the Jordan River between the 10,000-foot (3,000 m) Oquirrh Mountains and the 11,000-foot (3,400 m) Wasatch Mountains.

Q52468.name: Orem
Q52468.desc: city in Utah County, Utah, United States
Q52468.about: Orem is a city in Utah County, Utah, United States, in the north central part of the state. It is adjacent to Provo, Lindon, and Vineyard and is approximately 45 miles (72 km) south of Salt Lake City.

Q52470.name: Sandy
Q52470.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q52470.about: Sandy is a city in the Salt Lake City metropolitan area, located in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States. The population was 96,904 according to the 2020 United States census.

Q52471.name: Ogden
Q52471.desc: city in and county seat of Weber County, Utah, United States
Q52471.about: Ogden ( OG-dən) is a city in and the county seat of Weber County, Utah, United States, located approximately 10 miles (16 km) east of the Great Salt Lake and 40 miles (64 km) north of Salt Lake City. The population was 87,321 in 2020, according to the United States Census Bureau, making it Utah's eighth largest city.

Q52472.name: St. George
Q52472.desc: city in Washington County, Utah, United States
Q52472.about: St. George or Saint George is a city in and the county seat of Washington County, Utah, United States.

Q52474.name: Layton
Q52474.desc: city in Davis County, Utah, United States
Q52474.about: Layton (/ˈleɪʔɪn/) is a city in Davis County, Utah, United States. It is part of the Ogden-Clearfield Metropolitan Statistical Area.

Q52475.name: Taylorsville
Q52475.desc: city in Salt Lake County, Utah, United States
Q52475.about: Taylorsville is a city in Salt Lake County, Utah. It is part of the Salt Lake City metropolitan area.
Q52475.img: Saint Martin de Porres Catholic Church in Taylorsville Utah 1.jpg

Q52535.name: Rosario
Q52535.about: Rosario, officially the Autonomous City of Rosario, is the largest city of the province of Santa Fe, in central Argentina. Located 300 km (186 mi) northwest of Buenos Aires on the west bank of the Paraná River, in the south of the province, it is the country's third-most populous city after Buenos Aires and Córdoba.

Q570884.name: Tongliao
Q570884.desc: prefecture-level city in Inner Mongolia, China
Q570884.about: Tongliao is a prefecture-level city in eastern Inner Mongolia, People's Republic of China. The area is 59,535 square kilometres (22,987 sq mi) and as of the 2020 census, its population was 2,873,168 (3,139,153 in 2010).
Q570884.img: 科尔沁 通霍铁路与大郑铁路线路所 01.jpg

Q570990.name: Lakewood
Q570990.desc: city in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, United States
Q570990.about: Lakewood is a city in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, United States, on the southern shore of Lake Erie. Established in 1889, it is one of Cleveland's historical streetcar suburbs and part of the Cleveland metropolitan area.

Q571033.name: Hulunbuir
Q571033.desc: prefecture-level city in Inner Mongolia, China
Q571033.about: Hulunbuir or Hulun Buir is a prefecture-level city in northeastern Inner Mongolia, China. Its administrative center is located at Hailar District, its largest urban area.

Q571219.name: Ulanqab
Q571219.desc: prefecture-level city in Inner Mongolia, China
Q571219.about: Ulanqab or Ulan Chab (Chinese: 乌兰察布; pinyin: Wūlánchábù; Mongolian: ᠤᠯᠠᠭᠠᠨᠴᠠᠪUlaɣančab qota; Mongolian Cyrillic: Улаанцав хот) is a region administered as a prefecture-level city in south-central Inner Mongolia, China. Its administrative centre is in Jining District, which was formerly a county-level city.

Q571652.name: Wuzhou
Q571652.about:
Wuzhou (Chinese: 梧州; pinyin: Wúzhōu; Jyutping: Ng⁴zau¹, postal: Wuchow; Zhuang: Ngouzcouh / Ŋouƨcouƅ) is a prefecture-level city in the east of Guangxi, China.
By the end of 2024, the city's resident population is 2,827,700, including 1,623,900 urban residents, and the urbanization rate of the resident population is 57.43%.

Q571712.name: Fangchenggang
Q571712.about:
Fangchenggang (Chinese: 防城港 "Port of Fangcheng") is a prefecture-level city in the south of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China.
Fangchenggang  is the southernmost port in China and is located in Fangcheng.
Q571712.img: 亲水湾小区看防城区 - panoramio (5).jpg

Q571766.name: Qinzhou
Q571766.about: Qinzhou (postal: Yamchow or Yen Chow, simplified Chinese: 钦州; traditional Chinese: 欽州; pinyin: Qīnzhōu, Jyutping: Jam1 zau1 (Canton/Ham1 zau1 (Local)) is a prefecture-level city in south-central Guangxi, southern China, lying on the Gulf of Tonkin and having a total population of 3,302,238 as of the 2020 census whom 1,400,134 lived in the built-up (or metro) area made of Qinbei and Qinnan urban Districts. By the end of 2024, the total registered population of the city was 4,213,300.

Q571808.name: Guigang
Q571808.about: Guigang (simplified Chinese: 贵港; traditional Chinese: 貴港; pinyin: Guìgǎng; lit. 'Distinguished Harbour'; Zhuang: Gveigangj) is a prefecture-level city in eastern Guangxi in the People's Republic of China.

Q571918.name: Yulin
Q571918.about: Yulin (Chinese: 玉林; pinyin: Yùlín; lit. 'Jade Forest', 鬱林), alternately romanized as Watlam, is one of the fourteen prefecture-level cities of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China.
Q571918.img: 鬱林 清寧路 教育中路 2013.jpg

Q60.name: New York City
Q60.desc: most populous city in the United States
Q60.about: New York, often called New York City (NYC), is the most populous city in the United States.  It is located at the southern tip of New York State on New York Harbor, one of the world's largest natural harbors.
Q60.img: NYC Downtown Manhattan Skyline seen from Paulus Hook 2019-12-20 IMG 7347 FRD (cropped).jpg

Q585.name: Oslo
Q585.about: Oslo is the capital and largest city of Norway. It constitutes both a county and a municipality.

Q588.name: Katowice
Q588.about: Katowice (/ˌkɑtəˈvitsə/, Polish: [katɔˈvit͡sɛ] ; Silesian: Katowice; German: Kattowitz) is the capital city of the Silesian Voivodeship in southern Poland and the central city of the Katowice urban area. As of 2021, Katowice has an official population of 286,960, and a resident population estimate of around 315,000.

Q61317.name: Yell County
Q61317.about: Yell County is a county in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, its population was 20,263.

Q61327.name: Saline County
Q61327.about: Saline County ( sə-LEEN) is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 123,416.

Q61368.name: Polk County
Q61368.about: Polk County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 19,221.

Q61370.name: Newton County
Q61370.about: Newton County is a county in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,225.

Q612.name: Dubai
Q612.desc: most populous city in the United Arab Emirates and the capital of the Emirate of Dubai
Q612.about: Dubai is the most populous city in the United Arab Emirates and the capital of the Emirate of Dubai. It is on a creek on the southeastern coast of the Persian Gulf.

Q61363.name: Logan County
Q61363.about: Logan County (formerly Sarber County) is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,131.

Q61365.name: Randolph County
Q61365.about: Randolph County is located between the Ozark Mountains and Arkansas Delta in the U.S. state of Arkansas. The county is named for John Randolph, a U.S. senator from Virginia influential in obtaining congressional approval of the Louisiana Purchase, which includes today's Randolph County.

Q5954.name: Binjai
Q5954.desc: city in North Sumatra Province, Indonesia
Q5954.about: Binjai (English:  or BEEN-jayh, Jawi: بينجاي), formally Kota Binjai (Binjai City), is an independent city in the North Sumatra province of Indonesia, bordered by Deli Serdang Regency to the east and Langkat Regency to the west. Binjai is connected to Medan (the provincial capital), about 22 km to the east, by the Sumatra highway that goes to Banda Aceh, and effectively forms a part of Greater Medan.
Q5954.img: Welcome gate to city of Binjai (Binjai-Deli Serdang).jpg

Q5979.name: Pematangsiantar
Q5979.desc: city in North Sumatra Province, Indonesia
Q5979.about: Pematangsiantar (Simalungun Batak pronunciation: [pə.ma.taŋ.si.an.tar]) (sometimes written as Pematang Siantar, acronym PS or P. Siantar, colloquially just Siantar), and also known as the City of Pematangsiantar, is an independent city in North Sumatra Province of Indonesia, surrounded by, but not part of, the Simalungun Regency, making Pematangsiantar an enclave within Simalungun Regency. Pematangsiantar formerly had the status of a second-level district (daerah tingkat dua) and was the administrative centre of the surrounding Regency, but in 1986 it was elevated to Kota (City) and separated from the Regency.

Q6014.name: Barnaul
Q6014.about: Barnaul (Russian: Барнау́л, IPA: [bərnɐˈul] ) is the largest city and administrative centre of Altai Krai, Russia, located at the confluence of the Barnaulka and Ob rivers in the West Siberian Plain. As of the 2021 census, its population was 630,877, making it the 20th-largest city in Russia and the fourth-largest in the Siberian Federal District.

Q6066.name: Kemerovo
Q6066.desc: city in Kemerovo Oblast in the Asiatic part of Russia
Q6066.about: Kemerovo (Russian: Ке́мерово, IPA: [ˈkʲemʲɪrəvə]) is an industrial city and the administrative center of Kemerovo Oblast, Russia, located at the confluence of the Iskitimka and Tom Rivers, in the major coal mining region of the Kuznetsk Basin. Population: 557,119 (2021 census); 532,981 (2010 census); 484,754 (2002 census); 520,263 (1989 Soviet census).

Q61458.name: Chicot County
Q61458.about: Chicot County ( SHEE-koh) is a county located in the southeastern corner of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 10,208.

Q61461.name: Calhoun County
Q61461.about: Calhoun County is a county located in the south central part of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,739, making it the least populous county in Arkansas.

Q61468.name: Faulkner County
Q61468.about: Faulkner County is a county located in the Central Arkansas region of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 123,498, making it the fifth most populous of Arkansas's 75 counties.

Q61470.name: Phillips County
Q61470.about: Phillips County is a county located in the eastern part of the U.S. state of Arkansas, in what is known as the Arkansas Delta along the Mississippi River. As of the 2020 census, the population was 16,568.

Q62.name: San Francisco
Q62.desc: city and county in California, United States
Q62.about: San Francisco, officially the City and County of San Francisco, is the 17th-largest city and second-densest major city in the United States, with a 2025 population of 826,079. It is the fourth-most populous city in California and the second most-populous in the Bay Area.
Q62.img: San Francisco from the Marin Headlands in March 2019.jpg

Q64.name: Berlin
Q64.desc: federated state, capital and largest city of Germany
Q64.about: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany. With 3.7 million inhabitants, it has the highest population within its city limits of any city in the European Union (EU).

Q5815.name: Tyumen
Q5815.about: Tyumen is the administrative center and largest city  of Tyumen Oblast, Russia. It is situated just east of the Ural Mountains, along the Tura River in North Asia.

Q5826.name: Xi'an
Q5826.about: Xi'an is the capital of the Chinese province of Shaanxi. A sub-provincial city on the Guanzhong plain, the city is the most populous in the province and third-most populous in Western China after Chongqing and Chengdu, as well as the most populous in Northwestern China.

Q5838.name: Kabul
Q5838.desc: capital and the largest city of Afghanistan
Q5838.about: Kabul is the capital and largest city of Afghanistan. It is within the jurisdiction of Kabul District and has an estimated population of 5,333,284 people.

Q58698.name: Yuma County
Q58698.about: Yuma County is a county in the southwestern corner of the U.S. state of Arizona, one of 15 counties in the state. As of the 2020 census, its population was 203,881.

Q58711.name: Yavapai County
Q58711.about: Yavapai County ( YA-və-py) is a county near the center of the U.S. state of Arizona. As of the 2020 census, its population was 236,209, making it the fourth-most populous county in Arizona.

Q589616.name: Thika
Q589616.about: Thika (Gikuyu: [ˈθika]) is an industrial town and commerce hub in Kiambu County, Kenya, lying on the A2 road 42 kilometres (26 mi), northeast of Nairobi, near the confluence of the Thika and Chania Rivers. Although Thika town is administratively in Kiambu County, the greater Thika area comprising residential areas such as Bendor estate, Maporomoko, Thika Greens, Thika Golden Pearl, Bahati Ridge, and Thika Sports Golf Club, among others, are within Murang'a County.

Q590205.name: Prince George
Q590205.about: Prince George is a city in British Columbia, Canada, situated at the confluence of the Fraser and Nechako rivers. The city itself has a population of 76,708; the metro census agglomeration has a population of 89,490.

Q590849.name: Arvada
Q590849.desc: city in Adams and Jefferson counties in Colorado, United States
Q590849.about: Arvada () is a home rule city located in Jefferson and Adams counties, Colorado, United States. The city population was 124,402 at the 2020 United States census, with 121,510 residing in Jefferson County and 2,892 in Adams County.

Q61.name: Washington, D.C.
Q61.desc: capital city of the United States of America
Q61.about:
Washington, D.C., officially the District of Columbia and commonly shortened to  Washington, or DC, is the capital city of the United States, and its only federal district.
The city stands on the north-east bank of the Potomac River, across from the state of Virginia, surrounded by Maryland to its north, east, and south.
Q61.img: Aerial view of White House and downtown, Washington, D.C LCCN2010630891.jpg

Q597.name: Lisbon
Q597.desc: municipality and capital city of Portugal
Q597.about: Lisbon (  LIZ-bən; Portuguese: Lisboa [liʒˈβoɐ] ) is the capital and most populous city of Portugal, with an estimated population of 658,236 as of 2025, within its administrative limits and 3,353,000 within the metropolis, as of 2025. The city lies in the western part of the Iberian Peninsula, fronting the northern shore of the River Tagus.

Q61330.name: Clay County
Q61330.about: Clay County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. Originally incorporated as Clayton County, as of the 2020 United States census, its population was 14,552.

Q61339.name: Lawrence County
Q61339.about: Lawrence County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 16,216.

Q61346.name: Crittenden County
Q61346.about: Crittenden County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 48,163.

Q61348.name: Hot Spring County
Q61348.about: Hot Spring County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 33,040.

Q61350.name: Independence County
Q61350.about: Independence County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 37,938.

Q61352.name: Conway County
Q61352.about: Conway County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. Created as Arkansas's 11th county on October 20, 1825, Conway County has four incorporated municipalities, including Morrilton, the county seat and most populous city.

Q61354.name: Craighead County
Q61354.about: Craighead County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 111,231.

Q61355.name: Hempstead County
Q61355.about: Hempstead County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,065, down from 22,609 at the 2010 census.

Q61358.name: Columbia County
Q61358.about: Columbia County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 22,801.

Q5869.name: Lhasa
Q5869.desc: prefecture-level city and capital of Tibet
Q5869.about: Lhasa is the capital and largest city of the Tibet Autonomous Region of China. It is a prefecture-level city that covers an area of 29,274 square kilometres (11,303 sq mi) of rugged and sparsely populated terrain.

Q5917.name: Huntington Beach
Q5917.desc: seaside city in Orange County, California, United States
Q5917.about: Huntington Beach is a city in Orange County, California, United States. The city was originally called Pacific City, but it was changed in 1903 to be named after American businessman Henry E. Huntington.
Q5917.img: Huntington Beach CA Aerial by Don Ramey Logan.jpg

Q5925.name: Orange County
Q5925.about: Orange County, officially the County of Orange, often initialized: O.C., is located in the Greater Los Angeles area in Southern California, United States. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 3,186,989, making it the third most populous county in California, the sixth most populous in the United States, and more populous than 19 U.S. states and Washington, D.C. Although mostly suburban, it is the second most densely populated county in the state behind San Francisco County.
Q5925.img: Old Orange County Courthouse, Santa Ana, California.jpg

Q5972.name: Medan
Q5972.desc: city in North Sumatra Province, Indonesia
Q5972.about: Medan ( meh-DAHN, Indonesian: [ˈmɛdan] , Batak: ᯔᯩᯑᯉ᯳) is the capital and largest city of the Indonesian province of North Sumatra. The nearby Strait of Malacca, Port of Belawan, and Kualanamu International Airport make Medan a regional hub and multicultural metropolis, acting as a financial centre for Sumatra and a gateway to the western part of Indonesia.

Q61379.name: Searcy County
Q61379.about: Searcy County ( SUR-see) is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 7,828.

Q61381.name: Miller County
Q61381.about: Miller County is a county located in the southwestern corner of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 42,600.
Q61381.img: Miller County Courthouse, Texarkana, AR IMG 6379.jpg

Q61384.name: Sevier County
Q61384.about: Sevier County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,839.
Q61384.img: Sevier County, AR, Courthouse in DeQueen IMG 8550.JPG

Q61394.name: Latur
Q61394.desc: city in the Marathwada region in the Maharashtra state of India
Q61394.about: Latur (ISO: Lātūra; formerly Ratnapur) is a city located in the Marathwada region of Maharashtra state of India country. Before 1982 Latur was a part of the Osmanabad district (now Dharashiv).

Q61414.name: Arkansas County
Q61414.about: Arkansas County, officially the County of Arkansas, is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,149.

Q61434.name: Nellore
Q61434.desc: city in Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q61434.about: Nellore, also spelt as Nelluru, is a city located on the banks of Penna River, in Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, India. It serves as the headquarters of the district, as well as Nellore Urban mandal, Nellore Rural mandal and Nellore revenue division.

Q61436.name: Loni
Q61436.desc: human settlement in Uttar Pradesh, India
Q61436.about: Loni () is a city near Ghaziabad in Ghaziabad district in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India. Loni is governed by Loni Municipal Council which reports to the Ghaziabad Metropolitan Region.

Q61445.name: Navi Mumbai
Q61445.about:
Navi Mumbai (Marathi: [nəʋiː mumbəi]; also known as New Bombay, its official name until 1995) is a city in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, located in the Konkan division of the Western Indian state of Maharashtra. Navi Mumbai is situated on the Indian mainland, opposite Salsette Island and the city of Mumbai, and is part of Thane district (North) and Raigad district (South), respectively 
The area within the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation has been ranked third among 73 cities surveyed for cleanliness and hygiene by the Union Ministry of Urban Development and the Quality Council of India as part of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, and is being modified through various projects and developments.
Q61445.img: Diagnostic Imaging and Radiology Facility in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.jpg

Q61455.name: Jonesboro
Q61455.desc: county seat city in Craighead County, Arkansas, United States
Q61455.about: Jonesboro () is a city in and it is one of two county seats of Craighead County, Arkansas, United States. The population was 78,579 as of the 2020 census, and was estimated at 83,296 in 2025, making it the fifth-most-populous city in Arkansas.

Q6106.name: Portland
Q6106.desc: seat of Multnomah County, and largest city in state of Oregon, United States
Q6106.about: Portland ( PORT-lənd) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Oregon. Located in the Pacific Northwest at the confluence of the Willamette and Columbia rivers, it is the 28th-most populous city in the United States, sixth-most populous on the West Coast, and fourth-most populous in the Pacific Northwest (after Seattle, Washington; Vancouver, Canada; and Surrey, Canada), with a population of 652,503 at the 2020 census.

Q6225.name: Coventry
Q6225.desc: city in the West Midlands in England, UK
Q6225.about: Coventry (  KOV-ən-tree or rarely  KUV-) is a cathedral city and metropolitan borough in the West Midlands county, in England, on the River Sherbourne. Coventry had been a large settlement for centuries.

Q6346.name: Indianapolis
Q6346.desc: capital city of the U.S. state of Indiana and seat of Marion County
Q6346.about: Indianapolis (  IN-dee-ə-NAP-əl-iss), colloquially known as Indy, is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Indiana and the county seat of Marion County. Indianapolis is situated in the state's central till plain region along the west fork of the White River.

Q58178.name: Jiaxing
