Q598985.about: Begusarai is a city in the Indian state of Bihar and the administrative headquarters of the Begusarai district. The district lies on the northern bank of the river Ganges in the Mithila region of India.

Q600693.name: Thiès
Q600693.about: Thiès ([tjɛs]; Noon: Chess; Arabic: ثيس, romanized: Ṯyass) is the third largest city in Senegal with a population of 391,253 in 2023. It lies 72 km (45 mi) east of Dakar on the N2 road and at the junction of railway lines to Dakar, Bamako and St-Louis.

Q601787.name: Florence-Graham
Q601787.desc: census-designated place in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q601787.about: Florence-Graham (also known as Florence-Firestone) is a census-designated place in Los Angeles County, California, United States. The population was 61,983 at the 2020 census, down from 63,387 at the 2010 census.

Q601897.name: Bally
Q601897.about: Bally is a neighbourhood in Howrah of Howrah district in the Indian state of West Bengal. Bally is under the jurisdiction of Bally Police Station of Howrah City Police.

Q602027.name: Les Etchemins
Q602027.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q602027.about: Les Etchemins is a regional county municipality in the Chaudière-Appalaches region of eastern Quebec, Canada. It is named for the Etchemin River which finds its source in the region, as well as Etchemin Lake.

Q604385.name: Shizuishan
Q604385.about: Shizuishan, formerly Shizuizi, is a prefecture-level city in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China. It is the northernmost prefecture in Ningxia and the second most populous, after the regional capital Yinchuan, bordered by Inner Mongolia to all directions except the south.

Q604517.name: Wuzhong
Q604517.about: Wuzhong (simplified Chinese: 吴忠; traditional Chinese: 吳忠; pinyin: Wúzhōng; Xiao'erjing: وُجْو شِ) is a prefecture-level city in the Ningxia autonomous region of the People's Republic of China. It was known as Yinnan Prefecture (银南地区; 銀南地區; Yínnán Dìqū; Xiao'erjing: ءٍنًا دِٿِيُوِ) before it was upgraded to a prefecture-level city in 1998.

Q604625.name: Guyuan
Q604625.about: Guyuan (Chinese: 固原; pinyin: Gùyuán ), formerly known as Xihaigu (Chinese: 西海固; pinyin: xīhǎigù, Xiao'erjing: قُ‌يُوًا شِ) or Dayuan (大原), is a prefecture-level city in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China. It occupies the southernmost section of the region, bordering Gansu province to the east, south, and due west.

Q639452.name: Lakeland
Q639452.desc: city in Polk County, Florida, United States
Q639452.about: Lakeland is a city in Polk County, Florida, United States. Located along I-4 east of Tampa and southwest of Orlando, it is the most populous city in Polk County.

Q642741.name: Division No. 23
Q642741.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q642741.about: Census Division No. 23 (Churchill - Northern Manitoba) is a census division located within the Northern Region of the Province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q642900.name: Grande Prairie
Q642900.about: Grande Prairie is a city in northwestern Alberta, Canada, within the southern portion of an area known as Peace River Country. It is located at the intersection of Highway 43 (part of the CANAMEX Corridor) and Highway 40 (the Bighorn Highway), approximately 456 kilometres (283 mi) northwest of the provincial capital, Edmonton.

Q6190853.name: Jhang Sadar
Q6190853.about: Jhang (Punjabi / Urdu: جھنگ; Punjabi pronunciation: [ˈt͡ʃə̀ŋ.gᵊ]; Urdu pronunciation: [d͡ʒʱəŋɡ]) is the headquarters of the Jhang District in central Punjab, Pakistan. Situated on the east bank of the Chenab River, it is the 14th most populous city in Pakistan.

Q6191420.name: Jiading Subdistrict
Q6191420.desc: subdistrict forming the historical core of Jiading District
Q6191420.about: Jiadingzhen (Chinese: 嘉定镇; pinyin: Jiādìngzhèn), literally Jiading Town, is a subdistrict and former town in Jiading District, Shanghai, China. It is the historical center of Jiading, which was a separate city from Shanghai until the 1950s.

Q6315392.name: Jurong West
Q6315392.about: Jurong West (IPA:  JOO-rong WEST) is a planning area and new town in the West Region of Singapore. It is bordered by Tengah to the north, Boon Lay and Pioneer to the south, Jurong East to the east, and Western Water Catchment to the west.

Q6346798.name: Kahama
Q6346798.about: Kahama  is a town in north-western Tanzania. The town serves as the headquarters of Kahama Urban District.

Q6366466.name: Kapar
Q6366466.about: Kapar (Chinese: 加埔) is a town in Klang District, Selangor, Malaysia. It is 17 km (≈11 miles) from Klang city via federal route 5.

Q6374005.name: Kasangati
Q6374005.about: Kasangati is a town in Nangabo sub-county, kyadondo East constituency Wakiso District in the Central Region of Uganda. It also serves as the headquarters for Kyadondo County.

Q6397066.name: Shiraz
Q6397066.about: Shiraz is the fifth-most-populous city of Iran and the capital of Fars province, which is historically known by the exonym Persia proper. As of the 2016 national census, the population of the city was 1,565,572 people, and its built-up area with Sadra was home to almost 1,800,000 inhabitants.

Q60999936.name: Talatona
Q60999936.about:
Talatona is a city and municipality in the province of Luanda, bordering the Angolan capital, Luanda.
It was designed by the Angolan government to reduce traffic in central Luanda; Its infrastructure was built in a location south of Luanda, which currently houses several administrative and economic services that were relocated from the central zone of the capital.

Q61042.name: Izard County
Q61042.desc: county in Arkansas, United States of America
Q61042.about: Izard County () is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,577.

Q61048.name: Johnson County
Q61048.about: Johnson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 25,749.

Q61077.name: Garland County
Q61077.about: Garland County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 100,180.

Q61084.name: Franklin County
Q61084.about: Franklin County is a county in Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,097.

Q61086.name: Baxter County
Q61086.about: Baxter County is a county in the Ozark Mountains of Arkansas. Created as Arkansas's 66th county on March 24, 1873, the county has eight incorporated municipalities, including Mountain Home, its largest city and county seat.

Q61089.name: Malacca
Q61089.about: Malacca City (Malay: Bandaraya Melaka or Kota Melaka) is the capital city of the Malaysian state of Malacca. It is the oldest Malaysian city on the Strait of Malacca, having become a successful entrepôt in the era of the Malacca Sultanate.

Q61129.name: Union County
Q61129.about: Union County is a county located on the central southern border of the U.S. state of Arkansas. It is the largest county in Arkansas by land area.

Q61131.name: Perry County
Q61131.about: Perry County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. Its population was 10,019 at the 2020 United States census.

Q61135.name: Scott County
Q61135.about: Scott County is a county located in the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 9,836.

Q61138.name: Ouachita County
Q61138.about: Ouachita County ( WAH-shih-tah) is a county located in the south central part of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 22,650.

Q61143.name: Lonoke County
Q61143.about: Lonoke County is a county located in the Central Arkansas region of the U.S. state of Arkansas. As of the 2020 census, the population was 74,015, making it the 10th-most populous of Arkansas's 75 counties.

Q61145.name: St. Francis County
Q61145.about: St. Francis County is a county in the U.S. state of Arkansas.

Q609831.name: San-Pédro
Q609831.about: San-Pédro is a city in southwestern Ivory Coast. It is the nation's second largest port and the seat of Bas-Sassandra District and San-Pédro Region.

Q610463.name: Palm Coast
Q610463.desc: city in Flagler County, Florida, United States
Q610463.about: Palm Coast is a city in Flagler County, Florida, United States. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 89,258, an increase of almost 200% since the 2000 count of 32,832.

Q615975.name: Skagway
Q615975.desc: consolidated city-borough in Alaska, United States of America
Q615975.about: The Municipality and Borough of Skagway (Tlingit: Shg̱agwei) is a borough and city in the U.S. state of Alaska, on the Alaska Panhandle. As of the 2020 census, the population was 1,240, up from 968 in 2010.

Q616048.name: Wafangdian
Q616048.about: Wafangdian (Chinese: 瓦房店; pinyin: Wǎfángdiàn), formerly Fuhsien (Fuxian) or Fu County (simplified Chinese: 复县; traditional Chinese: 復縣; pinyin: Fù Xiàn), is one of the two "northern county-level cities", the other being Zhuanghe, under the administration of Dalian, located in the south of Liaoning province, China.  The city is famous for its ball bearing industry.

Q616562.name: Tulare
Q616562.about: Tulare (  tuu-LAIR-ee) is a city in Tulare County, California, United States. The population was 68,875 per the 2020 census.
Q616562.img: Tulare Union High School Auditorium June 2006.jpg

Q618643.name: Luena
Q618643.about: Luena, formerly known as Luso, is a city and municipality in eastern Angola, administrative capital of Moxico Province. The municipality had a population of 356,880 in 2024.
Q618643.img: Jardim do Palacio do Governador Luena Moxico.jpg

Q619609.name: Cherokee County
Q619609.desc: county in South Carolina, United States
Q619609.about: Cherokee County is a county in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 56,216.

Q620310.name: Celina
Q620310.desc: city in Denton and Collin counties in Texas, United States
Q620310.about: Celina ( sil-EYE-nə) is a city in Collin and Denton counties in the U.S. state of Texas. Celina is part of the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.

Q621001.name: Malanje
Q621001.about: Malanje is the capital city of Malanje Province in Angola, with a population of 455,000 (2014 census), and a municipality, with a population of 506,847 (2014 census). Projected to be the thirteenth fastest growing city on the African continent between 2020 and 2025, with a 5.17% growth.

Q675576.name: Pueblo
Q675576.desc: city in and county seat of Pueblo County, Colorado, United States
Q675576.about: Pueblo ( PWEB-loh; Spanish for "town") is the home rule municipality that is the county seat of, and the most populous municipality in, Pueblo County, Colorado, United States. The city population was 111,876 at the 2020 United States census, making Pueblo the ninth most populous city in Colorado.
Q675576.img: Glimpse of downtown Pueblo, CO IMG 5119.JPG

Q679952.name: Renton
Q679952.desc: city in King County, Washington, USA
Q679952.about: Renton is a city in King County, Washington, United States, and an inner-ring suburb of Seattle. Situated 11 miles (18 km) southeast of Seattle, Renton straddles the southeast shore of Lake Washington, at the mouth of the Cedar River.

Q65.name: Los Angeles
Q65.desc: seat of Los Angeles County, and largest city in California, United States
Q65.about: Los Angeles (often shortened as LA or L.A.) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of California, and the commercial, financial, and cultural center of Southern California. With an estimated 3.87 million residents within the city limits as of 2025, it is the second-most populous city in the United States, behind New York City, and the largest city in the Western United States.

Q685941.name: Mawlamyine
Q685941.about: Mawlamyine (also spelled Mawlamyaing; Burmese: မော်လမြိုင်မြို့, MLCTS: mau la. mruing mrui., Burmese pronunciation: [mɔ̀ləmjàɪ̯ɰ̃ mjo̰]; Thai: เมาะลำเลิง; Mon: မတ်မလီု, Mon pronunciation: [mo̤t məlɜ̤m]), formerly Moulmein, is the fourth-largest city in Myanmar (Burma), 300 kilometres (190 mi) southeast of Yangon and 70 kilometres (43 mi) south of Thaton, at the mouth of Thanlwin (Salween) River.

Q686813.name: Kassala
Q686813.desc: capital of the state of Kassala in Sudan
Q686813.about: Kassala (Arabic: كسلا, Tigrinya: ከሰላ) is the capital of the state of Kassala in eastern Sudan.  In 2003 its population was recorded to be 530,950.

Q681340.name: Ciudad Obregón
Q681340.desc: municipal seat of Cajeme, State of Sonora, Mexico
Q681340.about: Ciudad Obregón is a city in southern Sonora. It is the state's second largest city after Hermosillo and serves as the municipal seat of Cajeme.
Q681340.img: Atardecer en la Plaza Álvaro Obregón.JPG

Q684627.name: Clay
Q684627.desc: town in Onondaga County, New York, United States
Q684627.about: Clay is a town in Onondaga County, New York, United States. As of the 2020 Census, the population was  60,527, making it Syracuse's most populous suburb.

Q685315.name: Barasat
Q685315.about: Barasat is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is the headquarters of Barasat Sadar subdivision.

Q695623.name: Barinas
Q695623.about: Barinas (Spanish pronunciation: [baˈɾinas]) is a city in west central Venezuela. According to the 2011 census, its population is 503,442.

Q694545.name: Bowling Green
Q694545.desc: city and county seat of Warren, Kentucky, United States
Q694545.about: Bowling Green is a city in and the county seat of Warren County, Kentucky, United States. Its population was 72,294 as of the 2020 census, making it the third-most populous city in the state, after Louisville and Lexington.
Q694545.img: Shops along Fountain Square in Bowling Green, Kentucky 2008.JPG

Q694939.name: Al Diwaniyah
Q694939.about: Al Diwaniyah (Arabic: ٱلدِّيوَانِيَّة ad-Dīwānīyah), also spelt Diwaniya, is the capital city of Iraq's Al-Qādisiyyah Governorate.  In 2014 the population was estimated at 700,000.

Q649.name: Moscow
Q649.desc: capital and most populous city of Russia
Q649.about: Moscow is the capital and largest city of Russia, situated on the Moskva River in Central Russia. The city has a population estimated at more than 13 million residents within city limits, more than 19.1 million residents in the urban area, and more than 21.5 million residents in the metropolitan area.

Q656.name: Saint Petersburg
Q656.desc: federal city and former capital of Russia
Q656.about: Saint Petersburg, formerly known as Petrograd (Петроград), and later Leningrad (Ленинград), is the second-largest city in Russia, after Moscow, the nation's capital. Situated on the Neva River at the head of the Gulf of Finland on the Baltic Sea, its area of 1,439 square kilometers (556 sq mi) makes it the smallest administrative division of Russia by area.

Q68481.name: Fuzhou
Q68481.desc: capital city of Fujian province, China
Q68481.about: Fuzhou is the capital of Fujian, China, lying between the Min River estuary to the south and the city of Ningde to the north. Together, Fuzhou and Ningde make up the Mindong linguistic and cultural region.

Q68534.name: Nanping
Q68534.desc: prefecture-level city in Fujian, People's Republic of China
Q68534.about: Nanping is a third-tier prefecture-level city in northwestern Fujian Province, People's Republic of China. It borders Ningde to the east, Sanming to the south, and the provinces of Zhejiang and Jiangxi to the north and west respectively.

Q68579.name: Putian
Q68579.about: Putian (Chinese: 莆田, Putian dialect: Pó-chéng), also known as Puyang (莆阳) and Puxian (莆仙), historically known as Hinghwa, Hinghua, or Henghua (simplified Chinese: 兴化; traditional Chinese: 興化), is a prefecture-level city in Fujian Province, People's Republic of China. It borders Fuzhou to the north, Quanzhou to the south, and the Taiwan Strait's Xinghua Bay to the east.

Q68593.name: Naihati
Q68593.about: Naihati is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q68614.name: Sanming
Q68614.about: Sanming (Chinese: 三明; pinyin: Sānmíng),  also known as Minzhong (simplified Chinese: 闽中; traditional Chinese: 閩中), is a prefecture-level city in western Fujian province, China. It borders Nanping City to the north, Fuzhou City to the east, Quanzhou City to the southeast, Longyan City to the south and the province of Jiangxi to the west.

Q68695.name: Quanzhou
Q68695.about: Quanzhou is a prefecture-level port city on the north bank of the Jin River, beside the Taiwan Strait in southern Fujian, People's Republic of China. It is Fujian's most populous metropolitan region, with an area of 11,245 square kilometers (4,342 sq mi) and a population of 8,782,285 as of the 2020 census.

Q695330.name: Isfara
Q695330.about: Isfara (Tajik: Исфара; Russian: Исфара) is a city in Sughd Region in northern Tajikistan, situated on the border with Kyrgyzstan. The city was the seat of the former Isfara District.

Q695511.name: College Station
Q695511.desc: city in Brazos County, Texas, United States
Q695511.about: College Station is a city in Brazos County, Texas, United States, situated in East-Central Texas in the Brazos Valley, towards the eastern edge of the region known as the Texas Triangle. It is 83 miles (130 kilometers) northwest of Houston and 87 miles (140 km) east-northeast of Austin.

Q695556.name: Bryan
Q695556.desc: city and the county seat of Brazos County, Texas, United States
Q695556.about: Bryan is a city in and the county seat of Brazos County, Texas, United States. It is located in the heart of the Brazos Valley (East and Central Texas).

Q695565.name: Council Bluffs
Q695565.desc: city and the county seat of Pottawattamie County, Iowa, United States
Q695565.about: Council Bluffs is a city in and the county seat of Pottawattamie County, Iowa, United States. A small portion of the city extends into Mills County.

Q70.name: Bern
Q70.desc: city in Switzerland, capital of the canton of Bern and de facto capital of Switzerland
Q70.about: Bern (Swiss Standard German: [bɛrn] ), or Berne (French: [bɛʁn] ), is the de facto capital of Switzerland, referred to as the "federal city". With a population of about 146,000 (as of 2024), Bern is the fifth-most populous city in Switzerland, behind Zurich, Geneva, Basel and Lausanne.

Q66485.name: Jaipur
Q66485.about: Jaipur (Rajasthani: Jayapura, pronounced [ˈd͡ʑɛpʊɾᵊ]) is the capital and the largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan. As of 2011, the city had a population of 3.1 million, making it the tenth most populous city in the country.

Q66568.name: Kanpur
Q66568.about: Kanpur (/kɑːnˈpʊər/ , Hindi pronunciation: [kaːn̪.pʊɾ]), originally named Kanhapur and formerly anglicized as Cawnpore, is a large city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. Founded by Rajput ruler Hindu Singh Chandel, Kanpur became one of the most important commercial and military stations of British Raj.
Q66568.img: JK Temple(Juggilal Kamlapati temple) is a temple in the Indian city of Kanpur.It is considered to be a unique blend of ancient and modern architecture.jpg

Q66616.name: Indore
Q66616.about: Indore ( ; ISO: Indaura, Hindi: [ɪn̪d̪ɔːr]) is the largest city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh where it serves as the capital and the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district and division. Modern-day Indore was established on the banks of the Kanh and Saraswati rivers and traces its roots to its 16th-century founding as a trading hub between the Deccan Plateau and Delhi.

Q687235.name: Sector 4
Q687235.about: Sector 4 (Romanian: Sectorul 4) is an administrative unit of Bucharest.

Q687629.name: Batu Caves
Q687629.desc: limestone hill that has a series of caves and cave temples in Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia
Q687629.about: Batu Caves are a series of limestone caves in Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia. It is located on a 325 m (1,066 ft)–tall mogote, about 13 km (8.1 mi) north of the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur.

Q688324.name: Parakou
Q688324.about: Parakou [pa.ʁa.ku] is the largest city in northern Benin, and the third-largest city in the country, with an estimated population of 206,667 people, and capital of the Borgou Department. Administratively, the commune of Parakou makes one of Benin's 77 communes.

Q688596.name: Hawthorne
Q688596.desc: city in southwestern Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q688596.about: Hawthorne is a city in southwestern Los Angeles County, California, United States. It is part of a seventeen-city subregion of the Los Angeles metropolitan area commonly known as the South Bay.

Q690255.name: Wuchuan
Q690255.about: Wuchuan is a county-level city in southwestern Guangdong province, China. It is the easternmost county-level division of the prefecture-level city of Zhanjiang.

Q690991.name: East Los Angeles
Q690991.desc: census-designated place in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q690991.about: East Los Angeles, or East L.A., (El Este de Los Angeles in Spanish) is an unincorporated community in the Eastside of Los Angeles County, California, United States. It borders Monterey Park to the northeast; the City of Los Angeles to the north, west, and a small portion to the south.

Q691614.name: Telfair County
Q691614.about: Telfair County is a county located in the southern portion of the U.S. state of Georgia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 12,477.

Q693577.name: Highland
Q693577.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q693577.about: Highland (inc. East Highlands) is a city in the Inland Empire region of San Bernardino County, California, United States located 65 miles east of Downtown Los Angeles and roughly 50 miles west of Palm Springs, California.

Q693638.name: Richland
Q693638.desc: city in Benton County, Washington, United States
Q693638.about: Richland () is a city in Benton County, Washington, United States. It is located in southeastern Washington at the confluence of the Yakima and the Columbia Rivers.

Q727.name: Amsterdam
Q727.desc: capital and most populous city of the Netherlands
Q727.about: Amsterdam (Dutch: [ˌɑmstərˈdɑm] ; lit. 'Dam in the Amstel') is the capital and largest city of the Netherlands. As of 1 January 2026, it had a population of 941,873 within the city proper, 1,457,018 in the urban area and 2,480,394 in the metropolitan area.

Q68744.name: Xiamen
Q68744.about: Xiamen, historically romanized as Amoy, is a sub-provincial city in southeastern Fujian, People's Republic of China, beside the Taiwan Strait. It is divided into six districts: Huli, Siming, Jimei, Tong'an, Haicang, and Xiang'an.

Q695631.name: Los Teques
Q695631.about: Los Teques (Spanish pronunciation: [los ˈtekes]) is the capital of the state of Miranda, and the municipality of Guaicaipuro in north-central Venezuela. The city is about 25 km southwest of Caracas, and 1,169 metres (3,835 ft) above mean sea level.

Q695782.name: Garfield County
Q695782.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q695782.about: Garfield County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, the population was 2,286, making it the least populous county in Washington; with about 3.2 inhabitants per square mile (1.2/km2), it is also the least densely populated county in Washington.

Q696605.name: Larkana
Q696605.about: Larkana (Sindhi: لاڙڪانو, romanized: lāṛkāṇō; Urdu: لاڑکانہ, romanized: lāṛkāna) is a city located in the Sindh province of Pakistan. It is the 15th largest city of Pakistan by population.

Q706161.name: Cixi City
Q706161.desc: county-level city in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China
Q706161.about: Cixi, formerly romanized as Tzeki, is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of the sub-provincial city of Ningbo, in northeastern Zhejiang province, China. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,829,488.
Q706161.img: 海皮岛欢乐世界 - Happy Live Park - 2015.10 - panoramio.jpg

Q707993.name: Arthabaska
Q707993.desc: regional county municipality of Centre-du-Québec, Quebec, Canada
Q707993.about: Arthabaska Regional County Municipality (French pronunciation: [aʁtabaska]) is a regional county municipality located in the Centre-du-Québec region of Quebec. Its seat is Victoriaville.

Q709267.name: Bardhaman
Q709267.about: Bardhaman (, Bengali: [ˈbɔrˌd̪ʱo.man]), officially Bardhaman Sadar, is a city and  municipality located on the northern bank of the Damodar river in the state of West Bengal, India. It is the headquarters of Purba Bardhaman district, having become a district capital during the period of British rule.

Q712504.name: Baranagar
Q712504.about: Baranagar is a city and a municipality in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q713357.name: Rui'an
Q713357.desc: county-level city in China's Zhejiang province
Q713357.about: Rui'an is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Wenzhou prefecture, Zhejiang province, China. It has a population of 1,125,000 people and covers a land area of 1,271 km2 (491 sq mi), 3,037 km2 (1,173 sq mi) when including water area.

Q713362.name: Yanji
Q713362.about: Yanji (Chinese: 延吉; Korean: 연길 Yŏn'gil; alternately romanized as Yenki or Yenji) is a county-level city in the east of China's Jilin Province, and is the seat of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture. Yanji City is located in the eastern part of Jilin Province.

Q713825.name: Wanzhou
Q713825.about: Wanzhou District (Chinese: 万州区; pinyin: Wànzhōu Qū) is Chongqing's second most populated urban core area on the upper reaches of the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River in China. It is currently governed as a district of Chongqing Municipality, bordering Sichuan to the northwest and Hubei to the southeast.
Q713825.img: 2013年5月太 白 岩 上 拍 万 州8 - panoramio.jpg

Q714045.name: Hechuan District
Q714045.about: Hechuan (Chinese: 合川; pinyin: Héchuān) is a district in the northern part of Chongqing Municipality, People's Republic of China. Located at the meeting point of the Jialing, Fu and Qu rivers, it has a history of 1,500 years.

Q715975.name: Taoyuan District
Q715975.desc: A district in Taoyuan City, Taiwan
Q715975.about: Taoyuan District (Chinese: 桃園區; pinyin: Táoyuán Qū) is a district of Taoyuan City in northwestern Taiwan. Formerly a county-administered city also known as Taoyuan City (桃園市) before 2014, when the former Taoyuan County was elevated to a special municipality which is now known as Taoyuan City, which this district share with the same name.

Q6602.name: Strasbourg
Q6602.desc: capital and largest city of Grand Est, located in the historical region of Alsace
Q6602.about: Strasbourg is a prefecture and commune, and the largest city of the Grand Est region of northeastern France, in the historic region of Alsace. It is the prefecture of the Bas-Rhin department and the official seat of the European Parliament.

Q6640.name: Pokhara
Q6640.about: Pokhara (Nepali: पोखरा [ˈpokʰʌɾa]) is a metropolitan city located in central Nepal, which serves as the capital of Gandaki Province. Named the country's "capital of tourism" it is the second largest city after Kathmandu, with 600,051 inhabitants living in 120,594 households as of 2021 census.

Q70979.name: Sullivan County
Q70979.desc: county in New York, United States
Q70979.about: Sullivan County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 78,624.

Q71100.name: Steuben County
Q71100.desc: county in New York, United States
Q71100.about: Steuben County ( STEW-bən or  stew-BEN) is a county located in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, its population was 93,584.

Q71136.name: Seneca County
Q71136.desc: county in New York, United States
Q71136.about: Seneca County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 33,814.
Q71136.img: The Seneca County Courthouse Complex at Ovid (August 2017).jpg

Q71190.name: Schuyler County
Q71190.desc: county in New York, United States
Q71190.about: Schuyler County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 17,898, making it the second-least populous county in New York.
Q71190.img: Schuyler County Courthouse, Watkins Glen, New York State.jpg

Q71202.name: Schoharie County
Q71202.desc: county in New York State, United States
Q71202.about: Schoharie County ( skoh-HAIR-ee) is a county in the U.S. state of New York. As of the 2020 census, the population was 29,714, making it the state's fifth-least populous county.

Q71204.name: Huangshi
Q71204.about:
Huangshi (simplified Chinese: 黄石; traditional Chinese: 黃石; pinyin: Huángshí), alternatively romanized as Hwangshih, is a prefecture-level city in southeastern Hubei province, People's Republic of China.
Its population was 2,469,079 inhabitants at the 2020 census; 1,567,108 of whom lived in the built-up (or metro) area made up of 4 urban districts plus the city of Daye, now being part of the agglomeration.

Q71227.name: Shiyan
Q71227.about: Shiyan (Chinese: 十堰; pinyin: Shíyàn) is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Hubei, China, bordering Henan to the northeast, Chongqing to the southwest, and Shaanxi to the north and west. At the 2020 census, its population was 3,209,004 of whom 1,033,407 lived in the built-up (or metro) area made up of 2 urban districts of Maojian and Zhangwan on 1,193 square kilometres (461 square miles) as Yunyang is not conurbated.

Q736834.name: St. Cloud
Q736834.desc: city on tripoint of Benton, Sherburne and Stearns Counties in Minnesota, United States
Q736834.about: St. Cloud or Saint Cloud (; French: [sɛ̃ klu]) is a city in Stearns County, Minnesota, United States.

Q738043.name: Jackson County
Q738043.about: Jackson County is a county located in the U.S. state of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 32,653.

Q738303.name: Reynosa
Q738303.desc: municipal seat of Reynosa, State of Tamaulipas, Mexico
Q738303.about:
Reynosa (Spanish pronunciation: [rejˈnosa]) is the municipal seat of Reynosa Municipality and the largest city of the state of Tamaulipas, in Mexico.
The border city is located on the southern bank of the Rio Grande in the international Reynosa–McAllen metro area, directly across the Mexican border from Hidalgo, Texas.

Q738353.name: Heroica Matamoros
Q738353.desc: municipal seat of Matamoros, State of Tamaulipas, Mexico
Q738353.about: Matamoros, officially known as Heroica Matamoros, is a city in the northeastern Mexican state of Tamaulipas, and the municipal seat of the homonymous municipality. It is on the southern bank of the Rio Grande, directly across the border from Brownsville, Texas, United States.

Q739928.name: Frontenac County
Q739928.about: Frontenac County is a county and census division of the Canadian province of Ontario.  It is located in the eastern portion of Southern Ontario.

Q744948.name: New Rochelle
Q744948.desc: city in Westchester County, State of New York, United States, suburb of NYC
Q744948.about: New Rochelle ( rə-SHEL) is a city in Westchester County, New York, United States. It is a suburb outside of New York City, located about 17 miles (27 km) from Midtown Manhattan.

Q745120.name: St. Joseph
Q745120.desc: city and seat of Buchanan County, State of Missouri, United States
Q745120.about: St. Joseph is a city in and the county seat of Buchanan County, Missouri, United States.

Q75203.name: Liaoyang
Q75203.about: Liaoyang (Chinese: 辽阳; pinyin: Liáoyáng) is a prefecture-level city of east-central Liaoning province, China, situated on the Taizi River. It is approximately one hour south of Shenyang, the provincial capital, by car.

Q75230.name: Panjin
Q75230.about: Panjin (Chinese: 盘锦; pinyin: Pánjǐn) is a coastal prefecture-level city in central Liaoning province, People's Republic of China, situated on the northern shore of the Liaodong Bay.  It borders Anshan to the east, Yingkou to the southeast, and Jinzhou to the west and north.
Q75230.img: 盘锦市兴隆台区天桥1 - panoramio.jpg

Q761.name: Białystok
Q761.desc: city and capital of Podlaskie Voivodeship in eastern Poland
Q761.about: Białystok is the largest city in northeastern Poland and the capital of the Podlaskie Voivodeship. It is the tenth-largest city in Poland, second in terms of population density, and thirteenth in area.

Q6487.name: Antalya
Q6487.about: Antalya is one of the largest cities in Turkey and the capital of Antalya Province, the fifth-most populous province. Recognized as the "capital of tourism" in Turkey and a pivotal part of the Turkish Riviera, Antalya sits on Anatolia's southwest coast, flanked by the Taurus Mountains.

Q6506.name: Varna
Q6506.desc: city in Varna municipality, Varna oblast, Bulgaria
Q6506.about: Varna (Bulgarian: Варна, pronounced [ˈvarnɐ]) is the third-largest city in Bulgaria and the largest city and seaside resort on the Bulgarian Black Sea Coast and in the Northern Bulgaria region. Situated strategically in the Gulf of Varna, the city has been a major economic, social, and cultural centre for almost three millennia.

Q6576.name: Irkutsk
Q6576.desc: capital city of Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, in eastern Russia
Q6576.about: Irkutsk is the largest city and administrative center of Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. With a population of 587,891 as of the 2010 Census, Irkutsk is the 25th-largest city in Russia by population, the fifth-largest in the Siberian Federal District, and one of the largest cities in Siberia.

Q68814.name: Zhangzhou
Q68814.about: Zhangzhou (, Mandarin: [ʈʂáŋ.ʈʂóʊ]) is a prefecture-level city in Fujian Province, China. The prefecture around the city proper comprises the southeast corner of the province, facing the Taiwan Strait and (with Quanzhou) surrounding the prefecture of Xiamen.

Q68862.name: Longyan
Q68862.about: Longyan (simplified Chinese: 龙岩; traditional Chinese: 龍巖; pinyin: ; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Lêng-nâ or Liong-nâ; lit. 'dragon rock'; Hakka: Liùng-ngàm; Longyan dialect: Liông-nâ [lioŋ¹¹ nã¹¹]) is a prefecture-level city in south-western Fujian Province, China, bordering Guangdong to the south and Jiangxi to the west.
Q68862.img: 莲花山看龙岩 - Longyan City Viewed from Lotus Mountain - 2016.09 - panoramio.jpg

Q68919.name: Ningde
Q68919.desc: prefecture-level city in Fujian, People's Republic of China
Q68919.about: Ningde, previously romanized as Ningteh and Ning-Taik, is a city located along the northeastern coast of Fujian, China. It borders the provincial capital of Fuzhou City to the south, Wenzhou Prefecture of Zhejiang to the north, and Nanping to the west.

Q68953.name: Kamarhati
Q68953.about: Kamarhati is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q69060.name: Xining
Q69060.desc: capital city of Qinghai province, China
Q69060.about: Xining is the capital and most populous city of Qinghai province in western China and the largest city on the Tibetan Plateau. As of the 2020 census, it had 2,467,965 inhabitants (2,208,708 as of 2010), of whom 1,954,795 lived in the built-up (or metro) area made of 5 urban districts.

Q716127.name: Kaechon
Q716127.about: Kaech'ŏn or Kaechon (US:  GAY-chun, Korean: [kɛtsʰʌn]; Hangul: 개천시, Hanja: 价川市) is a city in South P'yŏngan province, North Korea.

Q720001.name: Khomeyni Shahr
Q720001.about: Khomeynishahr (Persian: خمينی شهر) is a city in the Central District of Khomeynishahr County, Isfahan province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district. Khomeynishahr is now part of the Isfahan Metropolitan area.

Q720087.name: Petaluma
Q720087.desc: city in Sonoma County, California, United States
Q720087.about: Petaluma is a city in Sonoma County, California, United States, located in the North Bay region of the San Francisco Bay Area. Its population was 59,776 according to the 2020 census.

Q721455.name: Miami Gardens
Q721455.desc: city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q721455.about: Miami Gardens is a city in north-central Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. It is a suburb of Miami and located 16 miles (26 km) north of downtown Miami with city boundaries that stretch from I-95 and Northeast 2nd Avenue to its east to Northwest 47th and Northwest 57th Avenues to its west, and from the Broward County line to its north to 151st Street to its south.

Q722827.name: Sikasso
Q722827.about: Sikasso (Bambara: ߛߌߞߊߛߏ߬; Sikasǒ) is a city in the south of Mali and the capital of the Sikasso Cercle and the Sikasso Region.  It is Mali's second largest city with 225,753 residents in the 2009 census.

Q723588.name: Cabimas
Q723588.about: Cabimas is a city on the Costa Oriental del Lago de Maracaibo in Zulia State in northwestern Venezuela. In 2005, its population was around 200,859.
Q723588.img: Catedral de Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Cabimas.PNG

Q730542.name: Peterborough County
Q730542.about: Peterborough County is a county and census division located in Southern Ontario, Canada. The county seat is the City of Peterborough, which is independent of the county.

Q730938.name: Ellicott City
Q730938.desc: unincorporated community in Howard County, Maryland, United States
Q730938.about: Ellicott City ( EL-ih-kət) is an unincorporated community and census-designated place in and the county seat of Howard County, Maryland, United States. Part of the Baltimore metropolitan area, its population was 75,947 at the 2020 census, making it the most populous unincorporated county seat in the United States.
Q730938.img: Centennial Lake aerial Ellicott City Maryland.jpg

Q736586.name: Burnsville
Q736586.desc: city in Dakota County, Minnesota, United States
Q736586.about: Burnsville ( BURNZ-vil) is a city 15 miles (24 km) south of downtown Minneapolis in Dakota County, Minnesota. The city is situated on a bluff overlooking the south bank of the Minnesota River, upstream from its confluence with the Mississippi River.

Q71247.name: Jingzhou
Q71247.about: Jingzhou (Chinese: 荆州; pinyin: Jīngzhōu) is a prefecture-level city in southern Hubei province, China, located on the banks of the Yangtze River. Its total residential population was 5,231,180 according to the 2020 census, 1,068,291 of whom resided in the built-up (or metro) area comprising two urban districts.

Q71266.name: Yichang
Q71266.about: Yichang (Chinese: 宜昌), alternatively romanized as Ichang, is a prefecture-level city located in western Hubei province, China. Yichang had a population of 3.92 million people at the 2022 census, making it the third most populous city in Hubei.

Q71284.name: Xiangyang
Q71284.about: Xiangyang is the second-largest prefecture-level city by population in northwestern Hubei province, China. It was known as Xiangfan from 1950 to 2010.

Q71323.name: Jingmen
Q71323.about: Jingmen (simplified Chinese: 荆门; traditional Chinese: 荆門; pinyin: Jīngmén; Wade–Giles: Ching1mên2) is a prefecture-level city in central Hubei province, People's Republic of China. Jingmen is within an area where cotton and oil crops are planted.

Q71339.name: Xiaogan
Q71339.about: Xiaogan (Chinese: 孝感; pinyin: Xiàogǎn) is a prefecture-level city in east-central Hubei province, People's Republic of China, some 60 kilometres (37 mi) northwest of the provincial capital of Wuhan. According to the 2020 census, its population totaled 4,270,371, of whom 988,479 lived in the built-up (or metro) area of Xiaonan District.

Q71355.name: Huanggang
Q71355.about: Huanggang is a prefecture-level city in easternmost Hubei Province, China. It is situated to the north of the middle reaches of the Yangtze River and is bounded in the north by the Dabie Mountains and is named after Mount Huanggang.

Q71401.name: Suizhou
Q71401.about: Suizhou (simplified Chinese: 随州; traditional Chinese: 隨州; pinyin: Suízhōu), formerly Sui County (simplified Chinese: 随县; traditional Chinese: 隨縣; pinyin: Suí Xian, Suixian), is a prefecture-level city in northern Hubei province, People's Republic of China, bordering Henan province to the north and east.

Q72778.name: Taiyuan
Q72778.desc: capital city of Shanxi province, China
Q72778.about: Taiyuan (Taiyuan Jin: [tʰai˦˥ ye˩˩]) is the capital of Shanxi, China. It is the political, economic, cultural, and international exchange center of the province, containing an industrial base focusing on energy and heavy chemicals.

Q72818.name: Haiphong
Q72818.about: Haiphong or Hai Phong (Vietnamese: Hải Phòng, pronounced [haːj˧˩ fawŋ͡m˨˩]) is the third-largest city in Vietnam, with an area of 3,194.72 km2 (1,233.49 mi2). It includes Bạch Long Vĩ and Cát Bà islands in the Gulf of Tonkin.

Q745168.name: Miramar
Q745168.desc: city in southern Broward County, Florida, United States
Q745168.about: Miramar (, MIH-rə-mar) is a city in southern Broward County, Florida, United States. It is a suburb of the Miami metropolitan area.

Q745725.name: Sishui County
Q745725.about: Sishui County (simplified Chinese: 泗水县; traditional Chinese: 泗水縣; pinyin: Sìshuǐ Xiàn) is a county of southwestern Shandong province, People's Republic of China. It is the easternmost county-level division of Jining City.

Q746516.name: Bağcılar
Q746516.about: Bağcılar is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 23 km2, and its population is 740,069 (2022).

Q746718.name: Birkenhead
Q746718.about: Birkenhead () is an industrial port town in the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral, Merseyside, England. The town is on the Wirral Peninsula, along the west bank of the River Mersey, opposite Liverpool.

Q746801.name: Edison
Q746801.desc: township in Middlesex County, New Jersey, United States
Q746801.about: Edison is a township in Middlesex County, New Jersey, United States. Situated in Central New Jersey within the core of the state's Raritan Valley region, Edison is a commercial hub (home to Menlo Park Mall and Little India) and is a bedroom community of New York City within the New York metropolitan area.

Q747444.name: Pleasanton
Q747444.desc: city in Alameda County, California, United States
Q747444.about: Pleasanton is a city in Alameda County, California, United States. Located in the Amador Valley, it is an upscale suburb in the East Bay region of the San Francisco Bay Area.
Q747444.img: Aerial view of Dublin and Pleasanton with morning fog, December 2023.JPG

Q747466.name: Upland
Q747466.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q747466.about: Upland is a city in the Inland Empire region of San Bernardino County, California, United States, on the border with neighboring Los Angeles County. The municipality is located at an elevation of 1,242 feet (379 m).

Q748474.name: Corvallis
Q748474.desc: city in and county seat of Benton County, Oregon, United States
Q748474.about: Corvallis ( kor-VAL-iss) is a city in and the county seat of Benton County in central western Oregon, United States. It is the principal city of the Corvallis, Oregon Metropolitan Statistical Area, which encompasses all of Benton County.

Q748485.name: Morningside Heights
Q748485.desc: neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City, United States
Q748485.about: Morningside Heights is a neighborhood on the West Side of Upper Manhattan in New York City. It is bound by Morningside Drive to the east, 125th Street to the north, 110th Street to the south, and Riverside Drive to the west.

Q748828.name: L'Assomption
Q748828.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q748828.about: L'Assomption (French pronunciation: [lasɔ̃psjɔ̃]) is a regional county municipality in the Lanaudière region of Quebec, Canada. The seat is L'Assomption.

Q750569.name: Kakogawa
Q750569.about: Kakogawa (加古川市, Kakogawa-shi) is a city located in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 June 2024, the city had an estimated population of 255,523 in 110,380 households and a population density of 1,800 persons per km2.

Q750935.name: Highlands Ranch
Q750935.desc: census designated place in Douglas County, Colorado, United States
Q750935.about: Highlands Ranch is an unincorporated community in and governed by Douglas County, Colorado, United States. For statistical purposes, the United States Census Bureau has defined the community as a census-designated place (CDP) as a part of the Denver–Aurora–Lakewood, CO Metropolitan Statistical Area.

Q6647.name: Lalitpur
Q6647.about: Lalitpur (Nepali: ललितपुर [ləˈlɪt̪pʊɾ]) , locally known as Yala (Nepal Bhasa: 𑐫𑐮‎ ‎[jəˈlʌ]), is a metropolitan city and fourth most populous city of Nepal with 299,843 inhabitants living in 77,159 households per the 2021 census. It is located in the south-central part of Kathmandu Valley, a large valley in the high plateaus in central Nepal, at an altitude of 1,350 metres (4,430 feet).

Q6816.name: Ulan-Ude
Q6816.about: Ulan-Ude (; Russian: Улан-Удэ, Russian pronunciation: [ʊˈlan ʊˈdɛ]; Buryat: Улаан-Үдэ, romanized: Ulaan-Üde, IPA: [ʊˌlaːɴ‿ˈʉdə]) is the capital city of Buryatia, Russia, located about 100 kilometers (62 mi) southeast of Lake Baikal on the Uda River at its confluence with the Selenga. According to the 2021 Census, 437,565 people lived in Ulan-Ude; up from 404,426 recorded in the 2010 Census, making the city the third-largest in the Russian Far East by population.

Q7253.name: Padang
Q7253.desc: city in West Sumatra Province, Indonesia
Q7253.about: Padang (Indonesian pronunciation: [ˈpadaŋ]) is the capital and largest city of the Indonesian province of West Sumatra. It had a population of 833,562 at the 2010 census and 909,040 at the 2020 census; the official estimate as of mid 2025 was 965,050.

Q72877.name: Datong
Q72877.about: Datong is a prefecture-level city in northern Shanxi Province in the People's Republic of China. It is located in the Datong Basin at an elevation of 1,040 metres (3,410 ft) and borders Inner Mongolia to the north and west and Hebei to the east.

Q72907.name: Yangquan
Q72907.about: Yangquan (simplified Chinese: 阳泉; traditional Chinese: 陽泉; pinyin: Yángquán [jǎŋtɕʰyǎn]) is a prefecture-level city in the east of Shanxi province, China, bordering Hebei province to the east. Known as "Rippling Spring" in ancient times, it lies on the eastern edge of the Loess Plateau and the western side of the Taihang Mountains.

Q72945.name: Changzhi
Q72945.about: Changzhi (Chinese: 长治; pinyin: Chángzhì) is a prefecture-level city in the southeast of Shanxi Province, China, bordering the provinces of Hebei and Henan to the northeast and east, respectively. Historically, the city was one of the 36 administrative areas (see Administrative Divisions of Qin Dynasty) extant under the reign of Qin Shi Huang.

Q72990.name: Jincheng
Q72990.about: Jincheng is a prefecture-level city situated in the southeast of Shanxi province, China. It shares its border with Henan province to the south and southeast.
Q72990.img: 20260530 View of Jincheng from White Horse Temple Hill 03.jpg

Q73020.name: Shuozhou
Q73020.about: Shuozhou is a prefecture-level city in northern Shanxi province, China, bordering Inner Mongolia to the northwest. It is situated along the upper reaches of the Fen River.

Q73045.name: Jinzhong
Q73045.about: Jinzhong, formerly Yuci, is a prefecture-level city in east central Shanxi province of the People's Republic of China, bordering Hebei province to the east. As of the 2020 census, its total population was 3,379,498 inhabitants of whom 1,226,617 lived in the Yuci and Taigu urban districts.

Q751202.name: Hertford County
Q751202.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q751202.about: Hertford County is a county located in the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 21,552.
Q751202.img: Chowan College Administration Building, Murfreesboro, N. C. (5812043376).jpg

Q752460.name: Los Mochis
Q752460.desc: municipal seat of Ahome, State of Sinaloa, Mexico
Q752460.about: Los Mochis (Spanish pronunciation: [los ˈmotʃis]) is a coastal city in northern Sinaloa, Mexico. It serves as the municipal seat of the municipality of Ahome.
Q752460.img: Casa condado espinoza de Los Mochis.jpg

Q752671.name: Lake Forest
Q752671.desc: city in Orange County, California, United States
Q752671.about: Lake Forest is a city in Orange County, California, United States. The population was 85,858 at the 2020 census.
Q752671.img: Lake Forest and Laguna Hills Photo Don Ramey Logan.jpg

Q752681.name: Alhambra
Q752681.desc: city in the western San Gabriel Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q752681.about: Alhambra ( ,  , Spanish pronunciation: [aˈlambɾa] ; from "Alhambra")  is a city located in the western San Gabriel Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States, approximately 8 miles (13 km) east from the downtown Los Angeles civic center. It was incorporated on July 11, 1903.

Q752719.name: Gaithersburg
Q752719.desc: city in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States; suburb of Washington, D.C.
Q752719.about: Gaithersburg (  GAY-thərz-burg) is a city in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States. At the time of the 2020 United States census, Gaithersburg had a population of 69,657, making it the third-largest incorporated city and the ninth-most populous community in the state.

Q753642.name: Avellaneda
Q753642.desc: city in the province of Buenos Aires, Argentina
Q753642.about: Avellaneda (Latin American Spanish: [aβeʝaˈneða], locally [aβeʃaˈneða]) is a port city in the province of Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the seat of the Avellaneda Partido, whose population was 367,554 as per the 2022 census [INDEC]. Avellaneda is located within the Greater Buenos Aires metropolitan area, and is connected to neighboring Buenos Aires by several bridges over the Riachuelo River.

Q753830.name: Redlands
Q753830.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q753830.about: Redlands ( RED-ləndz) is a city in San Bernardino County, California, United States. As of the 2020 census, the city had a population of 73,168, up from 68,747 at the 2010 census.

Q754390.name: Dundalk
Q754390.desc: census-designated place in Maryland, United States
Q754390.about: Dundalk ( DUN-dawk or  DUN-dok) is an unincorporated community and census-designated place in Baltimore County, Maryland, United States. The population was 67,796 at the 2020 census.

Q754452.name: Glen Burnie
Q754452.desc: census designated place in Anne Arundel County, Maryland, United States
Q754452.about: Glen Burnie is an unincorporated town and census-designated place (CDP) in Anne Arundel County, Maryland, United States. It is a suburb of Baltimore.

Q7525.name: Sevastopol
Q7525.desc: port city in Crimea, disputed between Ukraine and Russia
Q7525.about: Sevastopol ( SEV-ə-STOH-pəl, sə-VAS-tə-pohl), sometimes written Sebastopol, is the largest city in Crimea and a major port on the Black Sea. Due to its strategic location and the navigability of the city's harbours, Sevastopol has been an important port and naval base throughout its history.

Q7568.name: Yogyakarta
Q7568.about: Yogyakarta is the capital city of the Special Region of Yogyakarta in Indonesia, in the south-central part of the island of Java. As the only Indonesian royal city still ruled by a monarchy, Yogyakarta is regarded as an important centre for classical Javanese fine arts and culture such as ballet, batik textiles, drama, literature, music, poetry, silversmithing, visual arts, and wayang puppetry.

Q73073.name: Yuncheng
Q73073.about: Yuncheng (simplified Chinese: 运城; traditional Chinese: 運城) is the southernmost prefecture-level city in Shanxi province, People's Republic of China. It borders Linfen and Jincheng municipalities to the north and east, and Henan (Luoyang and Jiyuan to the east, Sanmenxia to the south) and Shaanxi (Weinan) provinces to the east, south and west, respectively.

Q73119.name: Xinzhou
Q73119.about: Xinzhou, ancient name Xiurong (秀荣), is a prefecture-level city occupying the north-central section of Shanxi Province in the People's Republic of China, bordering Hebei to the east, Shaanxi to the west, and Inner Mongolia to the northwest. As of 2022, the city has a permanent population of 2,655,563.

Q73156.name: Linfen
Q73156.desc: prefecture-level city in Shanxi Province, China
Q73156.about: Linfen (simplified Chinese: 临汾; traditional Chinese: 臨汾; pinyin: Lín Fén) is a prefecture-level city in the southwest of Shanxi province, China, bordering Shaanxi province to the west. Linfen City is located in the southern part of Shanxi Province, with the remaining branches of Taiyue to the east and the Luliang Mountains to the west.

Q73186.name: Lüliang
Q73186.about: Lüliang (simplified Chinese: 吕梁; traditional Chinese: 呂梁; pinyin: Lǚliáng), also spelled as Lvliang or Lyuliang, is a prefecture-level city in western Shanxi province, People's Republic of China. It borders Shaanxi province across the Yellow River to the west, Jinzhong and the provincial capital of Taiyuan to the east, Linfen to the south, and Xinzhou to the north.

Q74290.name: Newaygo County
Q74290.about: Newaygo County ( nə-WAY-goh) is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 49,978.

Q74628.name: Isabella County
Q74628.about: Isabella County is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 64,394.

Q74633.name: Huron County
Q74633.about: Huron County ( HURE-on, -⁠ən) is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 31,407.

Q74661.name: Midland County
Q74661.about: Midland County is one of 83 counties located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 census, the population was 83,494 making it the 24th largest by population in the state.

Q74686.name: Mecosta County
Q74686.about: Mecosta County ( mə-KOSS-tə) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 39,714.

Q74704.name: Bay County
Q74704.about: Bay County is located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 103,856.

Q74881.name: Dalian
Q74881.about: Dalian ( dah-LYEN) is a major prefecture-level, sub-provincial port city in Liaoning province, People's Republic of China, and is Liaoning's second largest city (after the provincial capital Shenyang) and the third-most populous city of Northeast China (after Shenyang and Harbin). Located on the southern tip of the Liaodong peninsula, it is the southernmost city in both Liaoning and the entire Northeast.

Q74957.name: Anshan
Q74957.about: Anshan (Chinese: 鞍山; pinyin: Ānshān) is an inland prefecture-level city in central-southeast Liaoning province, People's Republic of China, about 92 kilometres (57 mi) south of the provincial capital Shenyang. As of the 2020 census, it was Liaoning's third most populous city with a population of 3,325,372 people, over an area of about 9,270 km2 (3,580 sq mi) spanning 133 km (83 mi) from east to west.

Q75026.name: Fushun
Q75026.about: Fushun is a prefecture level city in Liaoning province, China, about 45 km (28 mi) east of Shenyang, with a total area of 11,272 km2 (4,352 sq mi), 714 km2 (276 sq mi) of which is the city proper. Situated on the Hun River ("muddy river"), it is one of the industrial and economic development hubs in Liaoning.

Q75091.name: Benxi
Q75091.about: Benxi (Chinese: 本溪) is a prefecture-level city located in the east of Liaoning province, People's Republic of China, southeast of the provincial capital of Shenyang. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,326,018 (1,709,538 in 2010), of whom 809,655 lived in the built-up area made of 3 urban districts (Pingshan, Xihu and Mingshan).

Q75110.name: Dandong
Q75110.about:
Dandong is a coastal prefecture-level city in southeastern Liaoning, in the northeastern region of China.
It is the largest Chinese border city, facing Sinuiju, North Korea, across the Yalu River, which demarcates the Sino-North Korean border.

Q65433.name: Allen Parish
Q65433.about: Allen Parish (French: Paroisse d'Allen) is a parish located in the U.S. state of Louisiana. As of the 2020 census, the population was 22,750.

Q652376.name: Ratlam
Q652376.about: Ratlam (Hindi: IPA: [ɾət̪.laːm]),is a city in the northwestern part of the Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh state of India. The city of Ratlam lies 480 metres (1,570 ft) above sea level.

Q653608.name: Linxia City
Q653608.desc: City in the Autonomous Prefecture Linxia, Gansu Province, China
Q653608.about: Linxia City (simplified Chinese: 临夏市; traditional Chinese: 臨夏市; pinyin: Línxià Shì, Xiao'erjing: لٍِ‌ثِيَا شِ), once known as Hezhou (Chinese: 河州; pinyin: Hézhōu; Wade–Giles: Ho-chou, Xiao'erjing: حَ‌جِوْ), is a county-level city in the province of Gansu, China and the capital of the multi-ethnic Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture. It is located in the valley of the Daxia River (a right tributary of the Yellow River), 150 km (93 mi) (by road) southwest of the provincial capital Lanzhou.

Q656189.name: Ensenada
Q656189.desc: municipal seat of Ensenada, State of Baja California, Mexico
Q656189.about: Ensenada ('inlet', pronounced [enseˈnaða]) is a city in Ensenada Municipality, Baja California, situated on the Pacific Coast of Mexico. Located on Bahía de Todos Santos, the city had a population of 279,765 in 2018, making it the third-largest city in Baja California.

Q657072.name: Touba
Q657072.about: Ṭouba (Ḥassaniya Arabic: طوبى, 'Felicity'; Wolof: Tuubaa) is a city in central Senegal, part of Diourbel Region and Mbacké district. With a population of 1,120,824 in 2023, it is the second most populated Senegalese city after Dakar.

Q658240.name: Karamay
Q658240.desc: Prefecture-level city in Xinjiang, People's Republic of China
Q658240.about: Karamay (also spelled Karamai; Chinese: 克拉玛依, romanized: Kèlāmǎyī, Uyghur: قاراماي, romanized: Qaramay) is a prefecture-level city in the north of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China. It is surrounded on all sides by Tacheng Prefecture.

Q658402.name: Citrus Heights
Q658402.desc: city in Sacramento County, California, United States
Q658402.about: Citrus Heights is a city in Sacramento County, California, United States. As of the 2020 census, Citrus Heights had a population of 87,583, up from 83,301 at the 2010 U.S. census.

Q659400.name: Wilmington
Q659400.desc: county seat city in New Hanover County, North Carolina, United States
Q659400.about: Wilmington is a port city in New Hanover County, North Carolina, United States. With a population of 115,451 as of the 2020 census, it is the eighth-most populous city in the state.

Q661038.name: Fukuyama
Q661038.about: Fukuyama (Japanese: 福山, romanized: Fukuyama) is a city in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. As of 31 March 2023, the city had an estimated population of 459,160 in 214259 households and a population density of 890 persons per km2.
Q661038.img: 1 Chome-8 Marunouchi, Fukuyama-shi, Hiroshima-ken 720-0061, Japan - panoramio (2).jpg

Q661364.name: Hongkou
Q661364.about: Hongkou (; formerly spelled Hongkew) is a district of Shanghai, forming part of the northern urban core. It has a land area of 23.48 km2 (9.07 sq mi) and a population of 757,498 as of 2020.

Q661595.name: Auburn
Q661595.desc: city in King County, Washington, United States of America
Q661595.about: Auburn (Lushootseed: sladə) is a city in King County, Washington, United States (with a small portion crossing into neighboring Pierce County). The population was 87,256 at the 2020 Census, and was estimated at 85,513 in 2024.

Q754618.name: East Hartford
Q754618.desc: town in Hartford County, Connecticut, United States
Q754618.about: East Hartford is a town in Hartford County, Connecticut, United States. The population was 51,045 at the 2020 census.
Q754618.img: Main Street East Hartford Connecticut USA.JPG

Q754635.name: Fairfield
Q754635.desc: town in Fairfield County, Connecticut, United States
Q754635.about: Fairfield is a town in Fairfield County, Connecticut, United States. It borders the city of Bridgeport and towns of Trumbull, Easton, Weston, and Westport along the Gold Coast of Connecticut.

Q755056.name: Waldorf
Q755056.desc: census designated place in Charles County, Maryland, United States
Q755056.about: Waldorf is a census-designated place in Charles County, Maryland, United States. Located 23 miles (37 km) south-southeast of Washington, D.C., Waldorf is part of Southern Maryland.
Q755056.img: Our Lady Help of Christians, Waldorf, MD.jpg

Q755142.name: Bowie
Q755142.desc: city in Prince George's County, Maryland, United States
Q755142.about: Bowie () is a city in Prince George's County, Maryland, in the United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 58,329 persons.

Q755149.name: Bristol
Q755149.desc: city in Hartford County, Connecticut, United States
Q755149.about: Bristol is a suburban city located in Hartford County, Connecticut, United States. The city is part of the Naugatuck Valley Planning Region.

Q755271.name: Hamden
Q755271.desc: town in New Haven County, Connecticut, United States
Q755271.about: Hamden is a town in New Haven County, Connecticut, United States. The town's nickname is "The Land of the Sleeping Giant".

Q755615.name: Towson
Q755615.desc: suburb of Baltimore, Maryland, United States
Q755615.about: Towson () is an unincorporated community and a census-designated place in Baltimore County, Maryland, United States. The population was 59,533 in the 2020 census.

Q755741.name: Silver Spring
Q755741.desc: community in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States
Q755741.about: Silver Spring is a census-designated place (CDP) in southeastern Montgomery County, Maryland, United States, near Washington, D.C. Although officially unincorporated, it is an edge city. As of 2026, its population of about 84,593 makes it the 6th-largest populated place in Maryland.

Q755752.name: Dessie
Q755752.about: Dessie (Amharic: ደሴ, romanized: Däse; also spelled Dese or Dessye) is a town in north-central Ethiopia. Located in the South Wollo Zone of the Amhara Region, it sits at a latitude and longitude of 11°8′N 39°38′E, with an elevation between 2,470 and 2,550 metres above sea level.

Q6433791.name: Kota Damansara
Q6433791.about: Kota Damansara is an affluent township located in Petaling Jaya, Petaling District, Selangor, Malaysia. It is a township spread across 4,000 acres (1,600 ha).
Q6433791.img: Aerial view of Kota Damansara from Emporis Kota Damansara 20230226 180035.jpg

Q6502283.name: Laval
Q6502283.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q6502283.about: Laval was a former regional county municipality whose territory coincided with the city of Laval, Quebec.  It was established in 1979, whereas the city itself had been constituted in 1965.

Q6693765.name: Lower Sackville
Q6693765.desc: community in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada
Q6693765.about: Lower Sackville is a suburban community of the Halifax Regional Municipality, Nova Scotia, Canada.

Q6743810.name: Malir Cantonment
Q6743810.desc: cantonment town of Karachi, in Sindh, Pakistan
Q6743810.about: The Malir Cantonment (Urdu: ملیر چھاؤنی) is a cantonment town of the city of Karachi, in Sindh, Pakistan. It serves as a military base and residential establishment.

Q6781780.name: Maryvale
Q6781780.desc: urban village in Phoenix, Arizona, United States
Q6781780.about: Maryvale is an urban village of Phoenix, Arizona. With a population of over 200,000 Maryvale has the largest population of the such villages in Phoenix.

Q6803464.name: Meads
Q6803464.desc: unincorporated community in Boyd County, Kentucky
Q6803464.about: Meads is an unincorporated community in Boyd County, Kentucky, United States. It is located along the U.S. Highway 60 corridor south of Ashland.

Q6918623.name: Mott Haven
Q6918623.desc: human settlement in The Bronx, New York, United States of America
Q6918623.about: Mott Haven is a primarily residential neighborhood in the southwestern section of the New York City borough of the Bronx. It is generally bounded by East 149th Street to the north, the Bruckner Expressway to the east and south, and the Harlem River to the west, although these boundaries are not precise.

Q6959903.name: Najafgarh
Q6959903.about: Najafgarh is a town in the South West Delhi district of Delhi, India. It is one of the three subdivisions of the South West Delhi district.

Q662548.name: Qingpu
Q662548.desc: district of Shanghai, China, formerly a separate city
Q662548.about: Qingpu District is a suburban district of Shanghai Municipality. Lake Dianshan is located in Qingpu.

Q664503.name: Montebello
Q664503.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q664503.about: Montebello (Italian for "Beautiful Mountain") is a city in Los Angeles County, California, United States, located just east of East Los Angeles and southwest of San Gabriel Valley. It is 8 mi (13 km) east of downtown Los Angeles.

Q664550.name: Maradi
Q664550.about: Maradi is a city in Niger and the administrative centre of Maradi Region. It is also the seat of the Maradi Department and an Urban Commune.

Q665413.name: Little Havana
Q665413.about: Little Havana (Spanish: Pequeña Habana) is a neighborhood of Miami, Florida, United States. Home to many Cuban exiles, as well as many immigrants from Central and South America, Little Havana is named after Havana, the capital and largest city in Cuba.

Q667650.name: Lichinga
Q667650.about: Lichinga is the capital city of Niassa Province of Mozambique.  It lies on the Lichinga Plateau at an altitude of 1,360 metres (4,460 ft), east of Lake Niassa (Lake Malawi).

Q667749.name: Port St. Lucie
Q667749.desc: city in St. Lucie County, Florida, United States
Q667749.about: Port St. Lucie is a city in St.

Q668353.name: Artush
Q668353.about: Artush ( ar-TUUSH; also transliterated as Artux or Atush) is a county-level city and the capital of Kizilsu Kyrgyz Autonomous Prefecture in Xinjiang, China. The government seat is in Guangming Road Subdistrict.

Q668546.name: Davis
Q668546.desc: city in Yolo County, California, United States
Q668546.about: Davis is the most populous city in Yolo County, California, United States. Located in the Sacramento Valley region of Northern California, the city had a population of 66,850 in 2020, not including the on-campus population of the University of California, Davis, which was over 9,400 (not including students' families) in 2016.

Q755763.name: Jijiga
Q755763.about: Jijiga (Somali: Jigjiga, Amharic: ጅጅጋ, romanized: Jijiga) is the capital city of Somali Region, Ethiopia. It became the capital of the Somali Region in 1995 after it was moved from Gode.

Q755765.name: Hawaasa
Q755765.about: Hawassa (Amharic: አዋሳ; ʾäwasa, also spelled Awassa or Awasa), known historically as Adare, is a city in Ethiopia, on the shores of Lake Hawassa in the Great Rift Valley. It is 273 km (170 mi) south of Addis Ababa via Bishoftu, 130 km (81 mi) east of Sodo, and 75 km (47 mi) north of Dilla.

Q755798.name: Milford
Q755798.desc: city in New Haven County, Connecticut, United States of America
Q755798.about: Milford is a coastal city in New Haven County, Connecticut, United States, between New Haven and Bridgeport. The population was 50,558 at the 2020 United States Census.

Q755901.name: Germantown
Q755901.desc: census-designated place in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States
Q755901.about: Germantown is an urbanized census-designated place in Montgomery County, Maryland, United States. With a population of 91,249 as of the 2020 census, it is the third-most populous community in Maryland, after Baltimore and Columbia.

Q759381.name: Khamis Mushait
Q759381.about: Khamis Mushayt or Khamis Mushait (Arabic: خميس مشيط, Ḫamīs Mušayṭ Arabic pronunciation: [xamiːs muʃajtˤ], locally: [xamiːs‿ɪmʃeːtˤ]) is a city in south-west Saudi Arabia, located east of Abha, the provincial seat of the Asir Province 884 kilometres (549 mi) from the national capital of Riyadh. It is the capital of the Shahran tribe in the Asir region.

Q760144.name: Ananthapuram
Q760144.desc: city in Ananthapuram district, Andhra Pradesh, India
Q760144.about: Anantapur, officially Ananthapuramu, is a city in Anantapur district of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is the mandal headquarters of Anantapuru mandal and also the divisional headquarters of Anantapur revenue division.

Q760146.name: Bhilwara
Q760146.about: Bhilwara ( ) is a city Municipal Corporation and administrative headquarters in Bhilwara district of the Mewar region of Rajasthan, India. It has been termed as 'Textile city'.

Q760714.name: Bhagalpur
Q760714.about: Bhagalpur (official and romanised name), historically known as Champa Nagari, is a city in the Indian state of Bihar, situated on the southern bank of the Ganges river. It is the third largest city of Bihar by population and also serves the headquarters of Bhagalpur district, Bhagalpur division, and Eastern Range.

Q762724.name: Hongjiang
Q762724.desc: county-level city in Hunan Province, China
Q762724.about: Hongjiang (Chinese: 洪江; pinyin: Hóngjiāng), formerly Qianyang County (simplified Chinese: 黔阳县; traditional Chinese: 黔陽縣; pinyin: Qiányáng Xiàn) is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Huaihua.

Q763595.name: Ilesa
Q763595.about: Ilesa or Ilesha (  il-AY-shə; Yoruba: Iléṣà [īléʃà]  or, locally, Uléṣà [ūléʃà]) is a historic city located in Osun State, southwest Nigeria; it is also the name of the capital of a historic state-kingdom (also known as Ijesha) centred around that town as the capital. The state is ruled by a monarch bearing the title of His Imperial Majesty, the Owa Obokun Adimula of Ijesaland.

Q766974.name: Qods
Q766974.about: Qods (Persian: قدس) is a city in the Central District of Qods County, Tehran province, Iran, serving as capital of both the county and the district.

Q6965751.name: Narela
Q6965751.about: Narela is a Suburb and a  Tehsil of Delhi, located in the North Delhi district of Delhi, close to the border of Haryana. Narela is a part of North Delhi.

Q7055628.name: North Hills
Q7055628.desc: neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States
Q7055628.about:
North Hills, known previously as Sepulveda, is a neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles, California.
North Hills was originally part of an agricultural community known as Mission Acres.

Q7056821.name: North Stamford
Q7056821.about: North Stamford is an affluent section of Stamford, Connecticut, United States, north of the Merritt Parkway. Mostly woody and hilly, it is the least densely populated, and highest income section of the city, with a 2021 median household income in excess of $250,000.

Q7070419.name: Nutana Sector
Q7070419.about: Nutana Sector, previously known as Nutana Suburban Development Area (SDA), is a sector in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. It is a part of the east side community of Saskatoon, and should not be confused with Nutana, one of the neighbourhoods within the Core Neighbourhoods Sector.

Q7074598.name: Obalende
Q7074598.desc: neighborhood in Lagos, Lagos State, Nigeria
Q7074598.about: Obálendé, a contraction of the Yoruba saying Ibi ti Oba le wa de, meaning "Where the king chased us to", is a neighbourhood of Lagos, Nigeria, located in Eti-Osa LGA, close to Lagos Island. Eti-Osa was split by the Lagos State Government into Local Community Development Areas (LCDA) of which Ikoyi–Obalende is one.

Q7079876.name: Ogbia
Q7079876.about:
Ogbia is a town, a traditional kingdom and local government area in central Bayelsa State in the Niger Delta region of Nigeria.
Ogbia Kingdom is made up of four clans namely; Abureni Clan, Anyama Clan, Oloibiri Clan and Emeyal Clan.

Q7195018.name: Pindi Bhattian
Q7195018.about: Pindi Bhattian (Punjabi, Urdu: پِنڈى بھٹياں) is a city and the administrative headquarters of Pindi Bhattian Tehsil, Hafizabad District in Punjab, Pakistan. It is famous for being the birthplace of the 16th-century Punjabi folk hero, Dulla Bhatti, who led a rebellion against the Mughal rule in the Punjab.

Q7204554.name: Mukim Plentong
Q7204554.desc: mukim in Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
Q7204554.about: Plentong is a mukim in Johor Bahru District, Johor, Malaysia.

Q7291165.name: Rancho Peñasquitos
Q7291165.desc: human settlement in San Diego, California, United States of America
Q7291165.about: Rancho Peñasquitos is a suburban community in northeastern San Diego, California. It is named after the first Mexican land grant in San Diego County, Rancho Santa Maria de Los Peñasquitos.

Q7294643.name: Ras Beirut
Q7294643.about: Ras Beirut (Arabic: رأس بيروت, lit. 'tip of Beirut') is an upscale residential neighborhood in Beirut, Lebanon. It has a mixed population of Christians, Muslims and Druze, and is associated with nonsectarian relations between members of the groupings.

Q7315195.name: Reseda
Q7315195.desc: neighborhood in Los Angeles, California, United States
Q7315195.about: Reseda  is a neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley region of Los Angeles, California. It was founded in 1912, and its central business district started developing in 1915.

Q7332840.name: Ridgewood
Q7332840.desc: neighborhood in Queens, New York City, USA
Q7332840.about: Ridgewood is a neighborhood in the New York City borough of Queens.  It borders the Queens neighborhoods of Maspeth to the north, Middle Village to the east, and Glendale to the southeast, as well as the Brooklyn neighborhoods of Bushwick to the southwest and East Williamsburg to the west.

Q7399661.name: Sahiwal
Q7399661.desc: city in Sargodha District, Punjab, Pakistan
Q7399661.about:
Sahiwal  (Punjabi: ساہِيوال, Urdu: ساہِيوال) is the main city in Sahiwal Tehsil of Sargodha District, Punjab, Pakistan.
Sahiwal city has 8,269 households and population of 48,453 per 2017 Pakistani census.

Q7402342.name: Sainte-Foy–Sillery–Cap-Rouge
Q7402342.about:
Sainte-Foy–Sillery–Cap-Rouge (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃t fwa silʁi kap ʁuʒ]) is a borough of Quebec City, Quebec, Canada.
The borough was created on November 1, 2009, from the former borough of Sainte-Foy–Sillery and part of the former borough of Laurentien.

Q7450577.name: Sengkang New Town
Q7450577.about: Sengkang (locally , Chinese: 盛港, Tamil: செங்காங்) is a planning area and residential town located in the North-East Region of Singapore. The town is the most populous in the region, being home to 265,830 residents as of 2026.

Q7452030.name: Sept-Rivières—Caniapiscau
Q7452030.about: Sept-Rivières—Caniapiscau is a census division (CD) of Quebec, with geographical code 97. It consists of the regional county municipalities of Sept-Rivières and Caniapiscau.

Q7456354.name: Setapak
Q7456354.desc: township in Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur
Q7456354.about: Setapak is a town and mukim straddling both northeastern Kuala Lumpur and Gombak District of Selangor, Malaysia.

Q7498162.name: Shiqi Subdistrict
Q7498162.about: Shiqi Subdistrict, also known as Shiqiqu Subdistrict, is a subdistrict located in the center of Zhongshan city, covering an area of 22.72 square kilometres (8.77 mi2), and a population of 257,472 (2020). The subdistrict administers 19 residential communities, and is home to major industrial and commercial activity.

Q7524515.name: Sinjhoro
Q7524515.about: Sinjhoro (Sindhi: سنجھورو) is a small town of Sanghar District, Sindh, Pakistan, around 12 kilometers to the west of Sanghar city. The Taluka Municipal Administration is based in Sinjhoro, and a Mukhtiarkar has been in charge of handling revenue issues since the times of British colonial rule.

Q7563836.name: Soshanguve
Q7563836.about: Soshanguve is a township situated about 30 km north of Pretoria and just east of Mabopane, in Gauteng, South Africa. The name Soshanguve is an acronym for Sotho, Shangaan, Nguni and Venda, thus showing the multi-ethnic composition of the population.

Q7567323.name: South Fulton
Q7567323.desc: city in Fulton County, Georgia, United States
Q7567323.about: South Fulton is a city in Fulton County, Georgia, in the Atlanta metropolitan area of the United States. The city was incorporated in 2017 from parts of southwest Fulton County and includes the communities of Red Oak, Cooks Crossing, Stonewall, Fife, Ben Hill, Sandtown, Cliftondale, Ono, Cedar Grove, Boat Rock/Dry Pond, Maude, Lester, Enon, Welcome All, Peters Woods, and part of Campbellton.

Q7636782.name: Sultanah
Q7636782.about: Sultanah is a street with various restaurants and shops in Al Madinah Province, in western Saudi Arabia.

Q7578.name: Jambi
Q7578.about: Jambi is the capital and largest city of the Indonesian province of Jambi. Located on the island of Sumatra, the city is a busy port on the Batang Hari River and an oil- and rubber-producing centre.

Q75379.name: Huludao
Q75379.desc: prefecture-level city in Liaoning, People's Republic of China
Q75379.about: Huludao (Chinese: 葫芦岛; pinyin: Húludǎo), formerly known as Jinxi (锦西) until 1994, is a coastal prefecture-level city in southwestern Liaoning province, People's Republic of China.  Its name literally means "Gourd Island", referring to the fiddle-shaped contour of the peninsula ("half-island" in Chinese), which resembles a bottle gourd, at the city's Longgang District.

Q75933.name: San Pedro
Q75933.desc: city of the Philippines in the province of Laguna
Q75933.about: San Pedro, officially the City of San Pedro (Filipino: Lungsod ng San Pedro), is a  component city in the province of Laguna, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 348,968 people.

Q75961.name: Biñan
Q75961.desc: city of the Philippines in the province of Laguna
Q75961.about: Biñan (Tagalog pronunciation: [biˈɲan] or traditionally [biˈɲaŋ]), officially the City of Biñan (Filipino: Lungsod ng Biñan), is a  component city in the province of Laguna, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 584,479 people, making it the most populous city in the province of Laguna.

Q76001.name: San Pablo
Q76001.desc: city of the Philippines in the province of Laguna
Q76001.about: San Pablo, officially the City of San Pablo (Filipino: Lungsod ng San Pablo), is a  component city in the province of Laguna, Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 300,166 people.

Q643040.name: Bellevue
Q643040.desc: city in Sarpy County, Nebraska, United States
Q643040.about: Bellevue (French for 'beautiful view'; previously named Belleview) is a suburban city in Sarpy County, Nebraska, United States. Q651131.name: Kota Bharu

Q7786.name: Pekanbaru
Q7786.about:
Pekanbaru ([pəkanˈbaru]) is the capital city of the Indonesian province of Riau, and a major economic centre on the eastern side of Sumatra Island with its name derived from the Malay (Indonesian) word for 'new market' ('pekan' is market and 'baru' is new).
It has an area of 639.00 km2 (246.72 sq mi), with a population of 897,767 at the 2010 Census, and 983,356 at the 2020 Census; the official estimate as of mid 2025 was 1,192,990 (comprising 599,452 males and 593,538 females), and was projected to be 1,228,298 as at mid 2026.

Q7880.name: Toulouse

Q838757.about: Lakewood is a suburban city in Los Angeles County, California, United States. The population was 82,496 at the 2020 census.

Q8660.name: Karachi
Q8660.about: Karachi is the capital city of the Pakistani province of Sindh. It is the largest city in Pakistan and 11th largest in the world, with a population of over 20 million.

Q80053.name: Tabriz
Q80053.desc: city in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran
Q80053.about: Tabriz (Persian: تبریز, romanized: tabriz, pronounced [tæbˈɾiːz] )  is a city in the Central District of Tabriz County, in East Azerbaijan province of northwestern Iran. It serves as capital of the province, the county, and the district.

Q80484.name: Patna
Q80484.desc: metropolis and state capital of Bihar, India
