Q80484.about: Patna (Hindi: Paṭanā, pronounced [ˈpəʈnaː] ), historically known as Pāṭaliputra, is the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Bihar. According to the United Nations, as of 2026, Patna had a population of 3.33 million, making it the 19th largest city in India.

Q847610.name: Seremban
Q847610.desc: city and state capital in Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia
Q847610.about: Seremban (Negeri Sembilan Malay: Somban) is a city in the Seremban District and the capital of the state of Negeri Sembilan in Peninsular Malaysia. The city's administration is run by the Seremban City Council.
Q847610.img: KM Plaza intersection at Jalan Tuanku Munawir (220709).jpg

Q847673.name: Clay County
Q847673.desc: county in West Virginia, United States
Q847673.about: Clay County is a county in the U.S. state of West Virginia. As of the 2020 census, the population was 8,051.

Q847676.name: Ohio County
Q847676.desc: county in West Virginia, United States
Q847676.about: Ohio County is a county located in the Northern Panhandle of the U.S. state of West Virginia, and forms part of the Wheeling metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census, the population was 42,425.

Q847677.name: Kaolack
Q847677.desc: town and regional capital in Senegal
Q847677.about: Kaolack (Arabic: كاولاك; Wolof: Kawlax) is a town with a population of 298,904 (2023 census) on the north bank of the Saloum River about 100 kilometres (62 mi) from its mouth and the N1 road in Senegal. It is the capital of the Kaolack Region, which borders The Gambia to the south.

Q8684.name: Seoul
Q8684.desc: capital and largest city of South Korea
Q8684.about: Seoul, officially Seoul Special Metropolitan City, is the capital and largest city of South Korea, and the largest city in the whole of Korea. The broader Seoul Metropolitan Area, encompassing Seoul, Gyeonggi Province and Incheon, emerged as the world's sixth largest metropolitan economy in 2022, behind New York, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Paris, and London, and hosts more than half of South Korea's population.

Q80989.name: Bhopal
Q80989.desc: metropolis and state capital in Madhya Pradesh, India
Q80989.about: Bhopal (Hindi: Bhōpāl, pronounced [bʱoːpaːl] ) is the capital city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh and the administrative headquarters of both Bhopal district and Bhopal division. It is known as the City of Lakes, due to presence of various natural and artificial lakes near the city boundary.

Q851004.name: Novato
Q851004.desc: city in Marin County, California, United States
Q851004.about: Novato (Spanish for "Novatus") is a city in Marin County, California, United States, situated in the North Bay region of the San Francisco Bay Area. At the 2020 census, Novato had a population of 53,225.

Q851027.name: Huntington Park
Q851027.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q851027.about: Huntington Park is a city located in the South Central region of Los Angeles County, California, United States. The  area includes the separate communities of Florence, Firestone Park, Graham, and Walnut Park, California.

Q851034.name: San Leandro
Q851034.desc: city in Alameda County, California, United States
Q851034.about: San Leandro (Spanish for "St. Leander") is a city in Alameda County, California, United States.

Q851041.name: Glendora
Q851041.desc: city in the San Gabriel Valley in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q851041.about: Glendora is a city in the San Gabriel Valley in Los Angeles County, 25 miles (40 km) northeast of Downtown Los Angeles. As of the 2020 census, the population of Glendora was 52,558.

Q7903.name: Casablanca
Q7903.about: Casablanca is the largest city in Morocco and the country's economic and business centre. Located on the Atlantic coast of the Chaouia plain in the central-western part of Morocco, the city has a population of about 3.22 million in the urban area, and over 4.27 million in Greater Casablanca, making it the most populous city in the Maghreb region, and the ninth-largest in the Arab world.

Q8042.name: Bengkulu
Q8042.about: Bengkulu, formerly Bencoolen (Dutch: Benkoelen) is the capital of the Indonesian province of Bengkulu. The city is the second largest city on the west coast of Sumatra Island after Padang.

Q8131.name: Palembang
Q8131.desc: city in South Sumatra Province, Indonesia
Q8131.about: Palembang (Indonesian pronunciation: [paˈlɛmbaŋ] , Palembang: Pelémbang, Jawi: ڤليمبڠ) is the capital city of the Indonesian province of South Sumatra. The city proper covers 348.34 square kilometres (134.49 square miles) on both banks of the Musi River in the eastern lowlands of southern Sumatra.

Q79867.name: Birmingham
Q79867.desc: city in and county seat of Jefferson County, Alabama, United States
Q79867.about: Birmingham ( BUR-ming-ham) is a city in the north central region of Alabama, United States. It is the third-most populous city in the state, with an estimated population of 196,357 as of 2024.
Q79867.img: Birmingham's skyline from it's highest point.jpg

Q79875.name: Mobile
Q79875.desc: county seat of Mobile County, Alabama, United States
Q79875.about: Mobile ( moh-BEEL; French: [mɔbil] ) is a city and the county seat of Mobile County, Alabama, United States. The population was 187,041 at the 2020 census and estimated at 204,689 following an annexation in 2023, making it the second-most populous city in Alabama.

Q79889.name: Casa Grande
Q79889.desc: city in Pinal County, Arizona, United States
Q79889.about: Casa Grande (O'odham: Wainom Wo:g) is a city in Pinal County, approximately halfway between Phoenix and Tucson, in the U.S. state of Arizona. The population was 53,658 at the 2020 census, and was estimated to be 68,927 in 2024.

Q844033.name: Kennewick
Q844033.desc: city in Benton County, Washington, USA
Q844033.about: Kennewick () is a city in Benton County, Washington, United States. It is located along the southwest bank of the Columbia River, just southeast of the confluence of the Columbia and Yakima rivers and across from the confluence of the Columbia and Snake rivers.
Q844033.img: View from ISS Expedition 72, Kennewick, Washington, April 13, 2025 (ISS072-E-1080059) (cropped).jpg

Q844091.name: Calabar
Q844091.about: Calabar ()(also referred to as Callabar, Calabari, Calbari, Cali  and Kalabar) is the capital city of Cross River State, Nigeria. It was originally named Akwa Akpa, in the Efik language, as the Efik people dominate this area.

Q846040.name: Camarillo
Q846040.desc: city in Ventura County, California, United States
Q846040.about: Camarillo (  KAM-ə-REE-oh) is a city in Ventura County, California, United States. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 70,741, an increase of 5,540 from the 65,201 counted in the 2010 Census.

Q846402.name: Union City
Q846402.desc: city in Alameda County, California, United States
Q846402.about: Union City is a city in Alameda County, California, United States in the San Francisco Bay Area. The population in the 2020 census was 70,143, up from 69,628 in the 2010 census.
Q846402.img: Aerial view of Union City, September 2018.JPG

Q846409.name: Gardena
Q846409.desc: city located in the South Bay region of Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q846409.about: Gardena is a city located in the South Bay region of Los Angeles County, California, United States. The population was 61,027 at the 2020 census, up from 58,829 at the 2010 census.

Q846426.name: Brentwood
Q846426.desc: city in Contra Costa County, California, United States
Q846426.about: Brentwood is a city in Contra Costa County, California, United States. It is located near the East Bay region of the San Francisco Bay Area.

Q8673.name: Lagos
Q8673.desc: largest city and former capital of Nigeria
Q8673.about: Lagos (;  LAY-goss; Yoruba: Èkó [èkó]), or Lagos City, is a large metropolitan port city in southwestern Nigeria. As of November 2025, the size of the city's population has been estimated to be between 17 and 21 million residents, making Lagos the largest city in Nigeria, the most populous urban area on the African continent, and one of the fastest-growing megacities in the world.

Q8678.name: Rio de Janeiro
Q8678.desc: city of Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil
Q8678.about: Rio de Janeiro, also known simply as Rio, is the capital and largest city of the state of Rio de Janeiro. It is the second-largest city in Brazil after São Paulo, and the largest by number of international tourists.

Q80517.name: Shreveport
Q80517.desc: parish seat of Caddo Parish, Louisiana, United States
Q80517.about: Shreveport ( SHREEV-port) is a city in the U.S. state of Louisiana. It is the third-most populous city in Louisiana after New Orleans and Baton Rouge.

Q80561.name: Antakya
Q80561.desc: district and city in Hatay, Turkey
Q80561.about: Antakya (Turkish pronunciation: [anˈtakja]), Turkish form of Antioch, is a municipality and the capital district of Hatay Province, Turkey, with an area of 703 km2 (271 sq mi) and a population of around 400,000 people as of 2022. It is in the Hatay Province, which is the southernmost region of Turkey.

Q80985.name: Fez
Q80985.about: Fez () or Fes () is a city in northern inland Morocco and the capital of the Fez-Meknes administrative region. It is one of the largest cities in Morocco, with a population of 1.256 million, according to the 2024 census.

Q848649.name: Latimer County
Q848649.about: Latimer County is a county located in the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Oklahoma. Its county seat is Wilburton.

Q849592.name: Caldwell
Q849592.desc: city in and county seat of Canyon County, Idaho, United States
Q849592.about: Caldwell (locally CALL-dwel) is a city in and the county seat of Canyon County, Idaho, United States. Caldwell is the 5th most populous city in Idaho.

Q849619.name: Lynwood
Q849619.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q849619.about: Lynwood is a suburban city in Los Angeles County, California, United States. At the 2020 census, the city had a total population of 67,265, down from 69,772 at the 2010 census.

Q850823.name: Vacaville
Q850823.desc: city in Solano County, California, United States of America
Q850823.about: Vacaville is a city in Solano County, California, United States. It is located 35 miles (56 km) from Sacramento and 55 miles (89 km) from San Francisco, on the edge of the Sacramento Valley in Northern California.

Q850929.name: La Mesa
Q850929.desc: city in San Diego County, California, United States
Q850929.about: La Mesa (lit. 'The Table') is a city in San Diego County, California, United States, located nine miles (14 kilometers) east of downtown San Diego in Southern California. The population was 61,121 at the 2020 census, up from 57,065 at the 2010 census.

Q851000.name: Madera
Q851000.desc: county seat of Madera County, California, United States
Q851000.about:
Madera (Spanish for "lumber") is a city in and the county seat of Madera County, located in the San Joaquin Valley of California, United States.  
Founded in 1876 as a timber settlement at the terminus of a major log flume, the city grew around the lumber trade before transitioning to an agriculture-based economy during the 20th century.

Q8156.name: Bandar Lampung
Q8156.about:
Bandar Lampung (/ˈbɑːndɑː ˈlæmpʌŋ/
BUN-dar-LUM-pung; Indonesian: Kota Bandar Lampung; Lampung: Kutak Bandarlampung; and formerly Dutch: Oosthaven, lit. 'Eastern Harbor') is the capital and largest city of the Indonesian province of Lampung. Located on the southern tip of Sumatra, Bandar Lampung was originally called Tanjungkarang–Telukbetung, since it was a unification of two major settlements in Lampung, before being renamed in 1983.

Q8252.name: Birgunj
Q8252.desc: Metropolitan city in Parsa District, Madhesh Province, Nepal
Q8252.about: Birgunj (Nepali: वीरगञ्ज) is a metropolitan city in Parsa District in Madhesh Province in southern Nepal. It lies 135 km (84 mi) south of the capital Kathmandu, attached in the north to Raxaul on the border of the Indian state of Bihar.

Q8385.name: Ostrava
Q8385.about: Ostrava (Czech pronunciation: [ˈostrava] ; Polish: Ostrawa, German: Ostrau) is a city in the north-east of the Czech Republic and the capital of the Moravian-Silesian Region. It has about 281,000 inhabitants.
Q8385.img: Katedrála Božského Spasitele, Nová Karolina a Dolní oblast Vítkovic, pohled z Nové radnice, srpen 2011.jpg

Q8652.name: Miami
Q8652.desc: city in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q8652.about: Miami is a coastal city in the southeast portion of the U.S. state of Florida. It is the second-most populous city proper in Florida, with a population of 442,241 at the 2020 census.

Q79902.name: North Little Rock
Q79902.desc: city in Pulaski County, Arkansas, United States
Q79902.about: North Little Rock (often abbreviated "NLR") is a city in Pulaski County, Arkansas, United States. Located on the north side of the Arkansas River, it is the twin city of Little Rock.

Q79950.name: Hoover
Q79950.desc: city in Jefferson and Shelby counties in north central Alabama, United States
Q79950.about: Hoover is a city in Jefferson and Shelby Counties in north central Alabama, United States. The sixth-largest city in Alabama, its population was 92,606 at the 2020 census.

Q79980.name: Varanasi
Q79980.desc: city on the banks of the Ganges in the Uttar Pradesh state of India
Q79980.about: Varanasi (Hindi pronunciation: [ʋaːˈɾaːɳəsi], also Benares, Banaras Hindustani pronunciation: [bəˈnaːɾəs]), or Kashi, is a city on the Ganges river in northern India that has a central place in the traditions of pilgrimage, death, and mourning in the Hindu world. The city also has a syncretic tradition of Islamic artisanship that underpins its religious tourism.
Q79980.img: Varanasi, India, Varanasi skyline in the evening.jpg

Q79990.name: Christchurch
Q79990.desc: largest city in the South Island of New Zealand
Q79990.about: Christchurch ( ), also known by its Māori name Ōtautahi, is the largest city in the South Island and the second-largest city by urban area population in New Zealand. Christchurch has an urban population of 407,800, and a metropolitan population of 556,500.

Q846502.name: Kuala Terengganu
Q846502.about: Kuala Terengganu (Malaysian pronunciation: [ˈkuˈala ˈtəˈrəŋˈganu] ; Terengganu Malay: Kole Tranung), colloquially referred to as KT, is the administrative, economic and royal city of the state of Terengganu, Malaysia. Kuala Terengganu is also the seat of Kuala Terengganu District.

Q846606.name: Colton
Q846606.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q846606.about: Colton is a city in San Bernardino County, California, United States. Nicknamed "Hub City", Colton is located in the Inland Empire region of the state and is a suburb of San Bernardino, approximately 4 miles (6.4 km) south of the city's downtown.

Q847538.name: North Charleston
Q847538.desc: city in Berkeley, Charleston and Dorchester counties, South Carolina, United States
Q847538.about: North Charleston is a city in Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester counties in the U.S. state of South Carolina. As of the 2020 census, North Charleston had a population of 114,852, making it the third-most populous city in the state, and the 248th-most populous city in the United States.
Q847538.img: City Hall goes pink for Breast Cancer Awareness (8115852857).jpg

Q847596.name: Pontiac
Q847596.desc: city and county seat of Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q847596.about: Pontiac ( PON-(t)ee-ak) is a city in and the county seat of Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. Located roughly 26 miles (41.8 km) northwest of downtown Detroit, Pontiac is part of the Detroit metropolitan area, and is variously described as a satellite city or suburb of Detroit.

Q82505.name: Saginaw County
Q82505.about: Saginaw County (SAG-ə-naw) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 190,124.

Q82510.name: Sanilac County
Q82510.about: Sanilac County ( SAN-ə-lack) is a county located in the Thumb region of the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 40,611.

Q854934.name: Bhawana
Q854934.about: Bhawana (also spelled as Bhowana) (Punjabi: بھوآنہ, Urdu: بھوانہ) is a city and administrative capital of Bhawana Tehsil of Chiniot District in Punjab, Pakistan. It is located on the bank of the Chenab river, bounded by the cities of Faisalabad, Jhang, and Chiniot.

Q855122.name: Nanded
Q855122.about: Nanded is a city in Maharashtra state, India. It is the tenth largest city in the state and the seventy-ninth most populated city in India.

Q855974.name: Bronx County
Q855974.desc: county of New York, United States
Q855974.about: The Bronx ( BRONKS) is the northernmost of the five boroughs of New York City. The Bronx has a land area of 42 square miles (109 km2) and a population of 1,472,654 at the 2020 census.

Q855997.name: Sargodha
Q855997.about: Sargodha is the sixth-largest city in the Pakistani province of Punjab. Located along the Kirana Hills in central Punjab, it serves as the headquarters of its eponymous district and division.

Q856151.name: Chipata (Fort Jameson)
Q856151.about: Chipata is a city and administrative centre of the Eastern Province of Zambia and Chipata District. It was declared the 5th city of the country, after Lusaka, Ndola, Kitwe and Livingstone, by President Edgar Lungu on 24 February 2017.

Q856841.name: Manhattan
Q856841.desc: city in Riley and Pottawatomie counties in Kansas, United States, county seat of Riley County
Q856841.about: Manhattan is a city in and the county seat of Riley County, Kansas, United States, although the city extends into Pottawatomie County. It is located in northeastern Kansas at the junction of the Kansas River and Big Blue River.

Q893092.name: Borama
Q893092.about: Borama (Somali: Boorama, Arabic: بورما) is the largest city of the northwestern Awdal region of Somaliland. The commercial seat of the province, it is situated near the border with Ethiopia.

Q894012.name: Bornova district
Q894012.about: Bornova is a municipality and district of İzmir Province, Turkey. Its area is 220 km2, and its population is 454,470 (2022).

Q894856.name: Botshabelo
Q894856.desc: town in the Free State, South Africa
Q894856.about: Botshabelo, meaning "a place of refuge", is a large township set up in 1979. It is located east of Bloemfontein in the present-day Free State province of South Africa.

Q896048.name: Boynton Beach
Q896048.desc: city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q896048.about: Boynton Beach is a city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States. It is situated about 57 miles (92 km) north of Miami.

Q897330.name: Brahmanbaria District
Q897330.about: Brahmanbaria District (Bengali: ব্রাহ্মণবাড়িয়া জেলা, romanized: Brammôṇbaṛiya) is a district in eastern Bangladesh located in the Chittagong Division. Geographically, it is mostly farmland and is topographically part of the Gangetic Plain.

Q897489.name: Brakpan
Q897489.about: Brakpan is a mining town on the East Rand of Gauteng, South Africa, approximately 38 kilometres (23.6 mi) east of Johannesburg.

Q8826.name: Palma
Q8826.desc: city in Mallorca and capital of the Balearic Islands, Spain
Q8826.about: Palma, also known as Palma de Mallorca, is the capital and largest city of the autonomous community of the Balearic Islands in Spain. It is situated on the south coast of Mallorca on the Bay of Palma.

Q8854.name: Las Piñas
Q8854.desc: highly urbanized city in Metro Manila, Philippines
Q8854.about: Las Piñas (Tagalog: [las ˈpiɲɐs]), officially the City of Las Piñas (Filipino: Lungsod ng Las Piñas), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 615,549 people.
Q8854.img: Barangay Talon Las Pinas City Aerial Photo.jpg

Q8861.name: Malabon
Q8861.desc: city of the Philippines in Metro Manila
Q8861.about: Malabon, officially the City of Malabon (Filipino: Lungsod ng Malabon), is a highly urbanized city in the National Capital Region of the Philippines. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 389,929 people.

Q8969.name: Cancun
Q8969.desc: municipal seat of Juárez, State of Quintana Roo, Mexico
Q8969.about: Cancún is the most populous city in the state of Quintana Roo, located in southeast Mexico, on the northeast coast of the Yucatán Peninsula. It is a significant tourist destination in Mexico and the seat of the municipality of Benito Juárez.

Q81033.name: Monterrey
Q81033.desc: capital of the State of Nuevo Leon, Mexico
Q81033.about: Monterrey (  MON-tə-RAY, Spanish: [monteˈrej] ) is the capital and largest city of the northeastern Mexican state of Nuevo León. The city anchors the Monterrey metropolitan area, Mexico's second largest metropolitan area with a population of 5,347,000 as of 2026, according to the 2020 census, Monterrey proper has a population of 1,142,194.

Q81398.name: Acapulco de Juárez
Q81398.desc: municipal seat of Acapulco, State of Guerrero, Mexico
Q81398.about: Acapulco de Juárez (Spanish: [akaˈpulko ðe ˈxwaɾes] ), commonly called Acapulco ( AK-ə-PUUL-koh, US also  AHK-; Nahuatl languages: Acapolco), is a city and major seaport in the state of Guerrero on the Pacific coast of Mexico, 380 kilometres (240 mi) south of Mexico City. Located on a deep, semicircular bay, Acapulco has been a port since the early colonial period in Mexico's history.

Q81621.name: Fort-de-France
Q81621.desc: French commune; largest and capital city of Martinique
Q81621.about: Fort-de-France (, US also , French: [fɔʁ də fʁɑ̃s] ; Martinican Creole: Fodfwans) is a commune and the capital city of Martinique, an overseas department and region of France located in the Caribbean.

Q851576.name: Nyala
Q851576.desc: capital of state of South Darfur in the south-west of Sudan
Q851576.about: Nyala (Daju: "the place of chatting"; Arabic: نيالا) is a city and the capital of the state of South Darfur in the south-west of Sudan, with an estimated population of 1,100,000 in 2024.
Q851576.img: Nyala market street and post office 2012 P1010331 608 kb.jpg

Q851838.name: Delta
Q851838.about: Delta is a city in the Lower Mainland region of British Columbia, Canada, and part of Greater Vancouver. Located on the Fraser Lowland south of Fraser River's south arm, it is bordered by the city of Richmond on Lulu Island to the north, New Westminster to the northeast, Surrey to the east, the Boundary Bay and the American pene-exclave Point Roberts to the south, and the Strait of Georgia to the west.

Q852238.name: Onitsha
Q852238.about: Onitsha  (Igbo: Ọ̀nị̀chà Mmílí or simply Ọ̀nị̀chà) is a city on the eastern bank of the Niger River, in Anambra State, Nigeria. Onitsha along with various cities and towns in southern Anambra State, northern Imo State and neighboring Delta State on the western bank of the Niger River, form a continuous metropolitan area.
Q852238.img: Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe of Africa. in Owelle Osowa Anya Onitsha. Anambra State. Nigeria (2).jpg

Q852528.name: Wad Madani
Q852528.about: Wad Madani (Arabic: ود مدني, romanized: Wad Madanī; also spelled Wad Medani and known simply as Madani) is a city in Central  Sudan and the capital of the Al Jazirah state. Wad Madani lies on the west bank of the Blue Nile, nearly 85 miles (136 km) southeast of Khartoum.

Q852645.name: Longview
Q852645.desc: city in and county seat of Greg County, Texas, United States
Q852645.about: Longview is a city in and the county seat of Gregg County, Texas, United States. Longview is located in East Texas, where Interstate 20 and U.S. highways 80 and 259 converge just north of the Sabine River.

Q852647.name: Lodi
Q852647.desc: city in San Joaquin County, California, United States
Q852647.about: Lodi ( LOH-dye) is a city in San Joaquin County, California, United States, in the center portion of California's Central Valley. The population was 66,348 at the 2020 census.

Q83813.name: Savannah
Q83813.desc: city in and county seat of Chatham County, Georgia, United States
Q83813.about: Savannah is a city in and the county seat of Chatham County, Georgia, United States. Established in 1733 on the Savannah River, it is the oldest city in the state, and was the capital of the colonial Province of Georgia and later the first state capital of Georgia.

Q773516.name: Hesperia
Q773516.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q773516.about: Hesperia () is a city in San Bernardino County, California, United States. It is located 35 miles (56 km) north of downtown San Bernardino in Victor Valley and surrounded by the Mojave Desert.

Q773603.name: Dhule
Q773603.about: Dhule is one of the largest cities in Maharashtra, and central region of India. The city located in the Dhule District in the northwestern part of Maharashtra state, known as West Khandesh.

Q773926.name: Simao District
Q773926.about: Simao District (Chinese: 思茅区; pinyin: Sīmáo Qū; formerly known as Cuiyun District) is a district under the jurisdiction of Pu'er City, Yunnan Province, China. It is the seat of Pu'er Prefecture.

Q775868.name: Delano
Q775868.desc: city in Kern County, California, United States
Q775868.about: Delano ( də-LAY-noh) is a city in Kern County, California, United States. Delano is located about 30 miles (48 km) north-northwest of Bakersfield at an elevation of 315 feet (96 m), in the San Joaquin Valley, the southern half of California's Central Valley.

Q776930.name: Peterborough
Q776930.about: Peterborough ( PEE-tər-burr-oh) is a city and county seat of Peterborough County,  Ontario, Canada, about 125 kilometres (78 miles) northeast of Toronto.  According to the 2021 Census, the population of the City of Peterborough was 83,651.

Q778941.name: General Escobedo
Q778941.desc: municipal seat of Escobedo, State of Nuevo León, Mexico
Q778941.about: General Escobedo, or simply Escobedo, is a city and municipality in Nuevo León, Mexico, that is part of the Monterrey Metropolitan area. As of the census of 2005, the population was 295,131 in the city and 299,364 in the municipality.

Q862645.name: Edmond
Q862645.desc: city in Oklahoma County, Oklahoma, United States
Q862645.about: Edmond is a city in Oklahoma County, Oklahoma, United States. It is a part of the Oklahoma City metropolitan area, in Central Oklahoma.

Q862672.name: Woodbury
Q862672.desc: city in Washington County, Minnesota, United States
Q862672.about: Woodbury ( WUUD-berr-ee) is a city in Washington County, Minnesota, United States, eight miles (13 km) east of Saint Paul along Interstate 94. It is part of the Minneapolis–Saint Paul metropolitan area.

Q862711.name: Parma
Q862711.desc: city in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, United States
Q862711.about: Parma is a city in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, United States. It is a suburb south of Cleveland.

Q863461.name: Bimbo
Q863461.about: Bimbo (also, Bimo) is the second-largest city of the Central African Republic, located southwest of the capital, Bangui. Bimbo had a population of 124,176 as of the 2003 census and a calculated 2013 population of 267,859.

Q864106.name: Lake Charles
Q864106.desc: parish seat of Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana, United States
Q864106.about: Lake Charles is the fifth-most populous city in the U.S. state of Louisiana, and the parish seat of Calcasieu Parish, located on the namesake lake, Prien Lake, and the Calcasieu River. Founded in 1861 in Calcasieu Parish, it is a major industrial, cultural, and educational center in the southwest region of Louisiana.

Q864128.name: Brooklyn Park
Q864128.desc: suburb city of Minneapolis, located in Hennepin County, Minnesota, United States
Q864128.about: Brooklyn Park is a suburban city on the west bank of the Mississippi River, upstream from (north of) the Twin Cities in northern Hennepin County. It is the sixth-largest city in the U.S. state of Minnesota.

Q81788.name: Giza
Q81788.about: Giza is the third-largest city in Egypt by area and population, and is also the eighteenth-largest city in Africa by population. It is the capital of Giza Governorate with a total population of 4,458,135 as of 2023.

Q81824.name: Hillsboro
Q81824.desc: city and county seat of Washington County, Oregon, United States
Q81824.about: Hillsboro (  HILZ-bər-oh) is a city in the U.S. state of Oregon and the county seat of Washington County. Situated in the Tualatin Valley on the west side of the Portland metropolitan area, the city hosts many high-technology companies, such as Intel, in an area locally known as the Silicon Forest.

Q81844.name: Gresham
Q81844.desc: city in Multnomah County, Oregon, United States of America
Q81844.about: Gresham ( GRESH-əm) is a city in the Willamette Valley, Located in Multnomah County in the U.S. state of Oregon, bordered by Portland to the northwest and partially in the southwest. It was first settled in the early 1850s by the Powell brothers.

Q81856.name: Beaverton
Q81856.desc: city in Washington County, Oregon, United States
Q81856.about: Beaverton is a city located in Washington County in the U.S. state of Oregon, with a small portion bordering Portland. The city is among the main cities that make up the Portland metropolitan area.

Q82367.name: Tuscola County
Q82367.about: Tuscola County ( TUSS-koh-lə) is a county in the Thumb region of the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 census, the population was 53,323.

Q82499.name: Kent County
Q82499.about: Kent County is located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the county had a population of 657,974, making it the fourth most populous county in Michigan, and the largest outside of the Detroit area.
Q82499.img: Kent County Courthouse, Grand Rapids, MI.jpg

Q852665.name: Cary
Q852665.desc: town in North Carolina, United States
Q852665.about: Cary is a town in Wake, Chatham, and Durham counties in the U.S. state of North Carolina and is part of the Raleigh-Cary, NC Metropolitan Statistical Area. According to the 2020 census, its population was 174,721, making it the seventh-most populous municipality in North Carolina, and the 146th-most populous in the United States.

Q852673.name: Hamilton
Q852673.desc: city in Butler County, Ohio, United States
Q852673.about: Hamilton is a city in Butler County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. It is 20 miles (32 km) north of Cincinnati along the Great Miami River.

Q852684.name: Marietta
Q852684.desc: city and county seat of Cobb County, Georgia, United States
Q852684.about: Marietta is a city in and the county seat of Cobb County, Georgia, United States. At the 2020 census, the city had a population of 60,972, making it one of Atlanta's largest suburbs.

Q852721.name: Chino Hills
Q852721.desc: city in San Bernardino County, California, United States
Q852721.about: Chino Hills ( CHEE-noh; chino being Spanish for 'curly') is a city in the western end of the Inland Empire region of San Bernardino County, California. As of the 2020 census, Chino Hills had a population of 78,411.

Q853552.name: Livonia
Q853552.desc: city in Wayne County, Michigan, United States
Q853552.about: Livonia ( lə-VOHN-yə) is a city in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A western suburb of Detroit, Livonia is located roughly 20 miles (32.2 km) northwest of downtown Detroit.

Q853945.name: Dindigul
Q853945.about: Dindigul  (Tamil ISO: Tiṇṭukkal, IPA: [t̪iɳɖukːɐl]) is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the administrative headquarters of the Dindigul district.

Q854630.name: Chemung County
Q854630.desc: county in New York, United States
Q854630.about: Chemung County is a county in the U.S. state of New York. The population was 84,148 as of the 2020 census.

Q854914.name: Bhatpara
Q854914.about: Bhatpara is a city and a municipality of North 24 Parganas district in the Indian state of West Bengal. It is a part of the area covered by Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority (KMDA).

Q881140.name: Blaine
Q881140.desc: city in Anoka County, Minnesota, United States
Q881140.about: Blaine ( BLAYN) is a suburban city in Anoka and Ramsey Counties in Minnesota, United States. It was once a rural town, but Blaine's population began to grow significantly in the 1950s.

Q888563.name: Fleming County
Q888563.about: Fleming County is a county located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. As of the 2020 census, the population was 15,082.

Q891229.name: Boksburg
Q891229.about: Boksburg is a city on the East Rand of Gauteng province of South Africa. Gold was discovered in Boksburg in 1887.

Q891359.name: Bolingbrook
Q891359.about: Bolingbrook is a village in Will and DuPage counties in the U.S. state of Illinois. It is a southwest suburb of Chicago on I-55 and Historic Route 66 (Frontage Road).

Q892146.name: Bonaventure
Q892146.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q892146.about: Bonaventure (French pronunciation: [bɔnavɑ̃tyʁ]) is a regional county municipality in the Gaspésie–Îles-de-la-Madeleine region of eastern Quebec, Canada, on the Gaspé Peninsula. Its seat is New Carlisle.

Q892635.name: Bonita Springs
Q892635.desc: city in Lee County, Florida, USA
Q892635.about: Bonita Springs is a city in Lee County, Florida, United States. The population was 53,644 at the 2020 census, up from 43,914 at the 2010 census.

Q82603.name: Montcalm County
Q82603.about: Montcalm County ( MONT-kawlm) is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 66,614.

Q82605.name: Gratiot County
Q82605.about: Gratiot County ( GRASH-it) is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 Census, the population was 41,761.

Q83061.name: Van
Q83061.about: Van is a city in eastern Turkey's Van Province, on the eastern shore of Lake Van. It is the capital and largest city of Van Province.
Q83061.img: City of Van (view from Van Kalesi).jpg

Q83065.name: Leicester
Q83065.desc: city in Leicestershire, East Midlands, England
Q83065.about: Leicester (  LES-tər) is a city, unitary authority area, and the county town of Leicestershire, in the East Midlands of England. It is the largest city in the East Midlands, with a population of 383,116 in 2025.

Q83114.name: São Gonçalo
Q83114.desc: municipality of Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil
Q83114.about: São Gonçalo (Portuguese: [sɐ̃w ɡõˈsalu]) is a municipality in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, in the Southeast region. It is located in the Metropolitan Region of Rio de Janeiro, having land limits with the municipalities of Niterói, Maricá and Itaboraí, and a maritime limit, by Guanabara Bay, with the capital, Rio de Janeiro.

Q83317.name: Mosul
Q83317.desc: city in northern Iraq and capital of Nineveh Province
Q83317.about: Mosul is a major city in northern Iraq, serving as the capital of Nineveh Governorate. It is the second largest city in Iraq overall after the capital Baghdad.

Q83387.name: Diyarbakır
Q83387.about: Diyarbakır is the largest Kurdish-majority city in Turkey. It is the administrative center of Diyarbakır Province.

Q856860.name: Hammond
Q856860.desc: city in Lake County, Indiana, United States
Q856860.about: Hammond ( HAM-ənd) is a city in Lake County, Indiana, United States. Located along Lake Michigan, it is part of the Chicago metropolitan area and the only city in Indiana to border Chicago.

Q860210.name: Brahmapur
Q860210.desc: city and municipality in Odisha, India
Q860210.about: Brahmapur (Odia pronunciation: [bɾɔh.mɔ.puɾ]), also known as Berhampur, is a city on the eastern coastline of Odisha, India, famously known as the Silk City of Odisha. It ranks as the 4th most populous city of Odisha.

Q860304.name: Daloa
Q860304.desc: town and sub-prefecture in Daloa, Ivory Coast
Q860304.about: Daloa is a city in western Ivory Coast. It is the seat of both the Sassandra-Marahoué District and the Haut-Sassandra Region.
Q860304.img: CENTRE CULTUREL DE DALOA COTE D'IVOIRE.jpg

Q860452.name: Bilaspur
Q860452.desc: city in Chhattisgarh state of India
Q860452.about: Bilaspur is a city located in Bilaspur District in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh. Bilaspur is the administrative headquarters of the Bilaspur District and Bilaspur Division.

Q861194.name: Chandrapur
Q861194.about: Chandrapur (earlier known as Chanda, the official name until 1964) is a city and a municipal corporation in Chandrapur district, Maharashtra state, India. It is the district headquarters of Chandrapur district.

Q862141.name: Bilimora
Q862141.about: Bilimora is a city situated on the banks of the river Ambika, in Gandevi taluka & Navsari district of Gujarat state, in India. The city comes under the purview of the Surat Metropolitan Region.

Q862519.name: Eslamshahr
Q862519.about: Eslamshahr (Persian: اسلامشهر), also known as Shadshahr (Persian: شادشهر), is a city in the Central District of Eslamshahr County, Tehran province, Iran. It is the capital of both the county and the district.

Q898109.name: Brandon
Q898109.desc: census-designated place in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States
Q898109.about: Brandon is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Hillsborough County, Florida, United States. Its population was 114,626 at the 2020 census, up from 103,483 at the 2010 census.

Q899873.name: Isiro
Q899873.desc: city in the Democratic Republic of Congo, capital of the Haut-Uele province
Q899873.about: Isiro (pronounced [iˈsiro]), formerly known as Paulis, is the capital of Haut-Uele Province in the northeastern part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It lies between the equatorial forest and the savannah and its main resource is coffee.

Q7820392.name: Toms River
Q7820392.desc: unincorporated community and census designated place located within Toms River Township, in Ocean County, New Jersey, United States
Q7820392.about: Toms River is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) located within and constituting the mainland portion of Toms River Township (formerly Dover Township), in Ocean County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey. As of the 2020 United States census, the CDP's population was 92,830, its highest decennial count ever and an increase of 4,039 (+4.5%) from the 88,791 recorded at the 2010 census, which in turn reflected an increase of 2,464 (+2.9%) from the 86,327 counted in the 2000 census.

Q7885326.name: Union
Q7885326.desc: NJT station in Union, New Jersey
Q7885326.about: Union station is an active commuter railroad station in the eponymous Union Township, Union County, New Jersey. Located on Green Lane off Morris Avenue (State Route 82) near the campus of Kean University, the station serves trains of NJ Transit's Raritan Valley Line between High Bridge and Newark Penn Station.

Q7961034.name: Wakefield station
Q7961034.desc: rail station in The Bronx, New York City
Q7961034.about: Wakefield station (also known as Wakefield–East 241st Street station) is a commuter rail station on the Metro-North Railroad's Harlem Line, serving the Wakefield section of the Bronx, New York City. The station is located on East 241st Street and is the northernmost stop in New York City on the Harlem Line.

Q7984286.name: West Albany
Q7984286.desc: human settlement in New York, United States of America
Q7984286.about: West Albany is a hamlet in the town of Colonie, Albany County, New York, United States. Parts of the neighboring city of Albany around Watervliet Avenue Extension and Industrial Park Road are also considered part of West Albany and include the majority of the West Albany Rail Yard.

Q7985407.name: West Hollywood
Q7985407.desc: neighborhood in Hollywood, Florida, United States
Q7985407.about: West Hollywood is a neighborhood in Broward County, Florida, United States in the city limits of Hollywood. The latest population for the area recorded was 60,806.

Q7990573.name: Whalley
Q7990573.desc: district of Surrey, British Columbia, Canada
Q7990573.about: Whalley is the most densely populated and urban of the six town centres in Surrey, British Columbia, Canada. It encompasses City Centre, the city's central business district, and is home to the Surrey City Hall, the main branch of Surrey Libraries, Central City, SFU Surrey and the site of Kwantlen Polytechnic University's (KPU) Civic Plaza campus.

Q8032027.name: Wong Tai Sin
Q8032027.desc: area in Wong Tai Sin District, New Kowloon, Hong Kong
Q8032027.about: Wong Tai Sin is an area in Wong Tai Sin District, New Kowloon, Hong Kong. The area was named after the Wong Tai Sin Temple.

Q822865.name: South Dublin
Q822865.about: South Dublin (Irish: Baile Átha Cliath Theas) is a county in Ireland, within the province of Leinster and the Eastern and Midland Region. It is one of three successor counties to County Dublin, which was disestablished for administrative purposes in 1994.

Q824100.name: Delray Beach
Q824100.desc: city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q824100.about: Delray Beach is a city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States, and is a principal city in the Miami metropolitan area located 52 miles (83 km) north of Miami. The population of the city was 66,846 in 2020.

Q825673.name: Kushinagar
Q825673.desc: town in Uttar Pradesh, India, the place where Gautama Buddha died
Q825673.about: Kushinagar (Pali: Kusinārā; Sanskrit: Kuśinagara) is a town in the Kushinagar district in Uttar Pradesh, India. It is a Buddhist pilgrimage site where Gautama Buddha is believed to have attained parinirvana.

Q825807.name: Greene County
Q825807.about: Greene County is located in the southwestern portion of Ohio. As of the 2020 census, the population was 167,966.

Q828357.name: Sunshine Coast
Q828357.about: The Sunshine Coast is a peri-urban region in South East Queensland, Australia. In 1967, it was defined as "the area contained in the [former] Shires of Landsborough, Maroochy and Noosa, but excluding Bribie Island".

Q828706.name: Pico Rivera
Q828706.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q828706.about: Pico Rivera is a city located in southeastern Los Angeles County, California. As of the 2020 United States census, the city had a population of 62,088.

Q828782.name: Quilmes
Q828782.desc: city in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
Q828782.about: Quilmes (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkilmes]) is a city on the coast of the Rio de la Plata, in the province of Buenos Aires, Argentina, on the southeast end of the Greater Buenos Aires, being some 17 km (11 mi) away from the urban centre area of Buenos Aires. The city was founded in 1666 and is the seat of the eponymous partido (district).

Q835104.name: Lyon County
Q835104.about: Lyon County is a county in the U.S. state of Nevada. As of the 2020 census, its population was 59,235.

Q835810.name: Broken Arrow
Q835810.desc: city in Oklahoma, United States of America
Q835810.about: Broken Arrow () is a city in Tulsa and Wagoner counties in the U.S. state of Oklahoma. It is the largest suburb of Tulsa.

Q781165.name: Lebanon County
Q781165.desc: county in Pennsylvania, United States of America
Q781165.about: Lebanon County ( LEB-ə-nən; Pennsylvania German: Lebnen Kaundi) is a county in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 143,257.

Q784440.name: Gloucester
Q784440.desc: suburb of and within the City of Ottawa
Q784440.about: Gloucester ( GLOST-ər) is a former municipality and now geographic area of Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Located east of Ottawa's inner core, it was an independent city until amalgamated with the Regional Municipality of Ottawa–Carleton in 2001 to become the new city of Ottawa.

Q784496.name: Victoria
Q784496.desc: city in and the county seat of Victoria County, Texas, United States
Q784496.about: Victoria is a city in and the county seat of Victoria County, Texas, United States. The population was 65,534 as of the 2020 census.

Q785966.name: Huayin
Q785966.about: Huayin is a county-level city in Weinan, Shaanxi province, China. Prior to 1990, Huayin was regarded as a county.

Q786770.name: Sanford
Q786770.desc: county seat of Seminole County, Florida, United States
Q786770.about: Sanford is a city in and the county seat of Seminole County, Florida, United States. It is located in Central Florida and its population was 61,051 as of the 2020 census.

Q788634.name: Bahçelievler
Q788634.about: Bahçelievler (meaning "houses with gardens" in Turkish) is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 17 km2 (0.3% of Istanbul Province), and its population is 594,350 (2022).

Q794356.name: Beylikdüzü
Q794356.about: Beylikdüzü (Turkish: [bejˈlicdyzy]) is a municipality and district of Istanbul Province, Turkey. Its area is 39 km2, and its population is 415,290 (2024).

Q794813.name: Songea
Q794813.about: Songea  is the capital of Ruvuma Region in southwestern Tanzania. It is located along the A19 road.

Q794954.name: Latina
Q794954.about: Latina (Spanish pronunciation: [laˈtina]) is a district of Madrid located in the southwestern corner of the municipality.

Q794958.name: Al-Mubarraz
Q794958.about: Al-Mubarraz is a city located at Al-Ahsa in the Eastern Province of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With a population of 837,000 (as of 2020), it is the north gate for Al-Ahsa governorate.

Q799808.name: Bafoussam
Q799808.about: Bafoussam is the capital and largest city of the West Region of Cameroon, in the Bamboutos Mountains. It is the 3rd most important (financially) city in Cameroon, after Yaoundé and Douala.
Q799808.img: 6. Vue aérienne de la ville de Bafoussam.jpg

Q804669.name: Balbala
Q804669.about: Balbala (Arabic: بلبالا) is a southern suburb of Djibouti City, located west of the river Ambouli. The name is from the "Flashing" (on Somali bal-bal be derived) from the nearby lighthouse.

Q804878.name: Baldwin Park
Q804878.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q804878.about: Baldwin Park is a city located in the central San Gabriel Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was 72,176, down from 75,390 at the 2010 census.

Q864130.name: Placentia
Q864130.desc: city in Orange County, California, United States
Q864130.about: Placentia ( plə-SEN-shə) is a city in Orange County, California, United States. It is part of the Los Angeles metropolitan area.
Q864130.img: Citrus groves, Golden Ave., Placentia, June 1961.jpg

Q864965.name: Petaling Jaya
Q864965.about: Petaling Jaya (Malaysian pronunciation: [pətaliŋ d͡ʒaja] ), colloquially referred to as "PJ", is a city in Petaling District, in the state of Selangor, Malaysia. Originally developed as a satellite township for Kuala Lumpur, the capital of Malaysia, it is part of the Greater Kuala Lumpur area.
Q864965.img: RapidKL Kelana Jaya line Petaling Jaya.jpg

Q866307.name: Kettering
Q866307.desc: city in Montgomery and Greene counties, Ohio, United States
Q866307.about: Kettering is a city in Montgomery County, Ohio, United States. It is an inner suburb of Dayton.

Q866332.name: Chinatown
Q866332.desc: neighborhood in Manhattan, New York City, United States
Q866332.about: Manhattan's Chinatown is a neighborhood of Lower Manhattan in New York City, bounded by the Lower East Side to its east, Little Italy to its north, Civic Center to its south, and Tribeca to its west. With an estimated population of 90,000 to 100,000 people, Chinatown is home to the highest concentration of Chinese people in the Western Hemisphere.

Q868203.name: Osogbo
Q868203.desc: city and local government area in Osun State, Nigeria
Q868203.about: Osogbo   (also known as Oṣogbo, and seldomly as Oshogbo) is a city in Nigeria. It became the capital city of Osun State in 1991.

Q868631.name: Sukkur
Q868631.about: Sukkur is a city in the Pakistani province of Sindh along the western bank of the Indus River, directly across from the historic city of Rohri. Sukkur is the third largest city in Sindh after Karachi and Hyderabad, and 17th largest city of Pakistan by population.

Q868671.name: North Shore
Q868671.desc: geographic area of Auckland, New Zealand
Q868671.about: The North Shore (Māori: Te Whenua Roa ō Kahu or Te Raki Paewhenua) is one of the major geographical regions of Auckland, the largest city in New Zealand. The area is defined as the northern shores of the Waitematā Harbour as far north as the Ōkura River.

Q868869.name: Harlingen
Q868869.desc: city in Cameron County, Texas, United States
Q868869.about: Harlingen ( HAR-lin-jin) is a city in Cameron County, Texas. It is located in the central region of the Rio Grande Valley, about 30 miles (48 km) from the coast of the Gulf of Mexico.

Q871209.name: Solwezi
Q871209.about: Solwezi is a town in Zambia. It is the provincial capital of the mineral-rich  North-Western Province.

Q872664.name: Koreatown
Q872664.about:
Koreatown (Korean: 코리아타운) is a neighborhood in central Los Angeles, California, centered near Sixth and Alexandria streets.
Koreans began immigrating in larger numbers in the 1960s and found housing in the Mid-Wilshire area.
Q872664.img: Olympic and Harvard, Koreatown, Los Angeles.jpg

Q876122.name: New Westminster
Q876122.about:
New Westminster (colloquially known as New West) is a city in the Lower Mainland region of British Columbia, Canada, and a member municipality of the Metro Vancouver Regional District. 
It was founded in 1858 by Richard Clement Moody as the capital of the Colony of British Columbia, and served as such until the mainland and Vancouver Island colonies were merged to form the new Colony of British Columbia in 1866.

Q876195.name: Loveland
Q876195.desc: city in Larimer County, Colorado, United States
Q876195.about: Loveland is a home rule municipality and the second most populous municipality in Larimer County, Colorado, United States. Loveland is situated 46 miles (74 km) north of the Colorado State Capitol in Denver and is the 14th most populous city in Colorado.

Q876876.name: Subang Jaya
Q876876.about: Subang Jaya is a city in Petaling District, Selangor, Malaysia. It comprises the southern third district of Petaling.

Q877897.name: Bossier City
Q877897.desc: suburb city of Shreveport, located in Bossier Parish, Louisiana, United States
Q877897.about: Bossier City ( BOH-zhər) is a city in Bossier Parish, Louisiana, United States. The population was 62,701 at the 2020 census.

Q8972.name: Ecatepec de Morelos
Q8972.desc: cabecera del municipio de Ecatepec, Estado de México, México

Q806916.name: Bannu
Q806916.about: Bannu (Urdu: بنوں, romanized: bannū̃, pronounced [bənːũː] ), also called Bani Gul or Bani (Pashto: باني, romanized: bānī, pronounced [ˈbɑni] ) is a city located on the Kurram River in southern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. It is the capital of Bannu Division.

Q808789.name: Barra da Tijuca
Q808789.desc: neighborhood in municipality of Rio de Janeiro in Brazil
Q808789.about: Barra da Tijuca (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈbaʁɐ dɐ tʃiˈʒukɐ]), usually known as just Barra, is an upper-middle class neighborhood (or bairro) in the Southwest Zone of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, located in the western portion of the city on the Atlantic Ocean. Barra is well known for its beaches, its many lakes and rivers, and its lifestyle.
Q808789.img: Barra da Tijuca seen from Pedra da Gávea^ - panoramio.jpg

Q809451.name: Bartlett
Q809451.desc: city in Shelby County, Tennessee, United States
Q809451.about: Bartlett is a city in Shelby County, Tennessee, United States. The population was 57,786 at the 2020 census, and was estimated at 56,708 in 2024, making it the 14th-most populous city in Tennessee.

Q810998.name: Battle Creek
Q810998.desc: city in Calhoun County, Michigan, United States
Q810998.about: Battle Creek is a city in northwestern Calhoun County, Michigan, United States. It sits at the confluence of the Kalamazoo and Battle Creek rivers.

Q811144.name: Bauchi
Q811144.desc: city and local government area of Bauchi State, Nigeria
Q811144.about: Bauchi (earlier Yakoba) is a city in northeast Nigeria, the administrative center of Bauchi State, of the Bauchi Local Government Area within that State, and of the traditional Bauchi Emirate. It is located on the northern edge of the Jos Plateau, at an elevation of 616 metres (2,021 feet).

Q812589.name: Bayonne
Q812589.desc: city in Hudson County, New Jersey, United States
Q812589.about: Bayonne ( bay-(Y)OHN) is a city in Hudson County in the U.S. state of New Jersey, in the Gateway Region on Bergen Neck, a peninsula between Newark Bay to the west, the Kill Van Kull to the south, and New York Bay to the east. At the 2020 United States census, it was the state's 15th-most-populous municipality, surpassing Passaic, with a population of 71,686, an increase of 8,662 (+13.7%) from the 2010 census count of 63,024, which in turn reflected an increase of 1,182 (+1.9%) from the 61,842 counted in the 2000 census.

Q812646.name: Baytown
Q812646.desc: city in Harris County, Texas, United States
Q812646.about: Baytown is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, within Harris and Chambers counties. Located in the metropolitan statistical area of Greater Houston, it lies on the northern side of the Galveston Bay complex near the outlets of the San Jacinto River and Buffalo Bayou.

Q813348.name: Beauce-Sartigan
Q813348.desc: regional county municipality of Quebec, Canada
Q813348.about: Beauce-Sartigan is a regional county municipality in the Chaudière-Appalaches region of Quebec, Canada.  The county seat is Saint-Georges.

Q813402.name: Beauharnois-Salaberry
Q813402.desc: regional county municipality in Montérégie, Quebec, Canada
Q813402.about: Beauharnois-Salaberry (French pronunciation: [boaʁnwa salabɛʁi]) is a regional county municipality in the Montérégie region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Beauharnois.

Q814616.name: Bei'an
Q814616.about: Bei'an (Chinese: 北安; pinyin: Běi'ān; lit. 'northern peace') is a county-level city in west-central Heilongjiang province in the People's Republic of China.

Q815883.name: Bellechasse
Q815883.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q815883.about: Bellechasse Regional County Municipality (French pronunciation: [bɛlʃas]) is a regional county municipality in the Chaudière-Appalaches region of Quebec. The county seat is Saint-Lazare-de-Bellechasse.

Q815979.name: Bellflower
Q815979.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q815979.about: Bellflower is a city in southeastern Los Angeles County, California, in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. It was founded in 1906 and incorporated on September 3, 1957.

Q816809.name: Palm Bay
Q816809.desc: city in Brevard County, Florida, United States of America
Q816809.about: Palm Bay is a city in Brevard County, Florida, United States. The city's population was 119,760 at the 2020 United States census, up from 103,190 at the 2010 census, making it the most populous city in the county and the largest by land mass.
Q816809.img: Palm Bay FL St Joseph Cath Church02.jpg

Q816845.name: Irapuato
Q816845.desc: municipal seat of Irapuato, State of Guanajuato, Mexico
Q816845.about: Irapuato is a Mexican city and municipality located at the foot of the Arandas Hill (in Spanish: Cerro de Arandas), in the central region of the state of Guanajuato. It lies between the Silao River and the Guanajuato River, a tributary of the Lerma River, at 1,724 m (5,656 ft) above sea level.

Q817578.name: Kuantan
Q817578.about: Kuantan (Pahang Malay: Kontaeng; Terengganu Malay: Kuatang/Kuantang) is a city and the state capital of Pahang, Malaysia. It is located near the mouth of the Kuantan River.

Q818106.name: Benoni
Q818106.desc: Town in the Ekurhuleni Metropolitan Municipality in Gauteng, South Africa
Q818106.about:
Benoni is a town on the East Rand, Gauteng, South Africa, some 26 kilometres (16 mi) east of Johannesburg, within the City of Ekurhuleni municipality.
Benoni was also the setting for the MTV-inspired movie Crazy Monkey: Straight Outta Benoni, released internationally in 2005.

Q818193.name: Bensonhurst
Q818193.desc: neighborhood of Brooklyn in New York City, United States
Q818193.about: Bensonhurst is a residential neighborhood in the southwestern section of the New York City borough of Brooklyn. The neighborhood is bordered on the northwest by 14th Avenue, on the northeast by 60th Street, on the southeast by Avenue P and 22nd Avenue (Bay Parkway) and on the southwest by 86th Street.

Q818731.name: Menongue
Q818731.about: Menongue, formerly Serpa Pinto, is a municipality and the capital of Cubango Province in Angola. The municipality had a population of 320,914 in 2014.

Q818824.name: Maroua
Q818824.desc: capital of the Far North Region of Cameroon
Q818824.about: Maroua (Fula: Marwa, مَرْوَ, 𞤥𞤢𞤪𞤱𞤢) is the capital of the Far North Region of Cameroon, stretching along the banks of the Ferngo and Kaliao Rivers, in the foothills of the Mandara Mountains. The city had 201,371 inhabitants at the 2005 census, consisting mainly of the Fulbe/Fulani ethnic group.
Q818824.img: Un amphi de l'école normale supérieure de Maroua.jpg

Q820235.name: San Cristóbal
Q820235.about: San Cristóbal (Spanish pronunciation: [saŋ kɾisˈtoβal]) is the capital city of the Venezuelan state of Táchira. It is located in a mountainous region of Western Venezuela.

Q820502.name: Klickitat County
Q820502.desc: county in the state of Washington, United States
Q820502.about: Klickitat County is a county located in the U.S. state of Washington. As of the 2020 census, its population was 22,735.

Q821112.name: Federal Way
Q821112.desc: city in King County, Washington, United States
Q821112.about: Federal Way is a city in King County, Washington, United States, and part of the Seattle metropolitan area. It is 25 miles (40 km) south of Seattle and had a population was 101,030 at the 2020 census.
Q821112.img: Five Mile Lake Park, Auburn, WA.jpg

Q878237.name: Etawah
Q878237.about: Etawah (IAST: Iṭāvā), also known as Ishtikapuri, is a city situated on the banks of Yamuna River in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India. It is the administrative headquarters of Etawah District.

Q90.name: Paris
Q90.desc: capital and most populous city in France
Q90.about: Paris is the capital and largest city of France, with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km2 (40.7 sq mi), as of January 2026, and a metropolitan population of 13.3 million (2023). Located on the Seine in the centre of the Île-de-France region, it is the largest metropolitan area and fourth-most populous city in the European Union (EU).

Q92161.name: Changchun
Q92161.desc: capital city of Jilin Province, China
Q92161.about: Changchun is the capital and largest city of Jilin Province, China, on the Songliao Plain. Changchun is administered as a sub-provincial city, comprising seven districts, one county and three county-level cities.

Q92277.name: Jilin City
Q92277.about: Jilin City is the second-largest city and former capital of Jilin province in northeast China. As of the 2020 census, 3,623,713 people resided within its administrative area of 27,166.37 square kilometres (10,488.99 sq mi) and 1,895,865 in its built-up (or metro) area consisting of four urban districts.

Q92297.name: Siping
Q92297.about: Siping (Chinese: 四平; pinyin: Sìpíng), formerly Sipingjie (Chinese: 四平街; pinyin: Sìpíngjiē; Wade–Giles: Ssupingchieh), is a prefecture-level city in the west of Jilin province, People's Republic of China. It has a total population of 1,814,733 inhabitants, as of the 2020 census.

Q963597.name: St. Peters
Q963597.about: St. Peters is a city in St.
Q963597.img: All Saints Catholic Church (St. Peters, Missouri) - exterior.jpg

Q965956.name: Nansana
Q965956.about: Nansana is a town in the Central Region of Uganda. It is located in Wakiso District and is one of the five municipalities in the district.

Q966819.name: Kira Town
Q966819.desc: municipality in the Wakiso District of the Central Region of Uganda
Q966819.about: Kira Town, a municipality in the Wakiso District of the Central Region of Uganda, is the country's second most populous city. It is administered by the Kira Town Council, an urban local government.

Q967511.name: Division No. 11
Q967511.desc: census division of Canada in Manitoba, Canada
Q967511.about: Census Division No. 11 (Winnipeg) is a census division centred on the Winnipeg Capital Region of the province of Manitoba, Canada.

Q968211.name: Okara
Q968211.about: Okara (Punjabi, Urdu: اوکاڑہ) is the capital city of Okara District in the Punjab province of Pakistan. The name Okara is derived from Okaan, a type of tree.

Q975170.name: D'Autray
Q975170.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q975170.about: D'Autray (French pronunciation: [dotʁɛ]) is a regional county municipality in the Lanaudière region of Quebec, Canada. Its seat is Berthierville.

Q976180.name: Dale City
Q976180.desc: census designated place in Prince William County, Virginia, United States
Q976180.about:
Dale City is a census-designated place (CDP) in Prince William County, Virginia, United States, located 25 miles (40 km) southwest of Washington, D.C. As of 2020, the total population was 72,088.
The community is roughly bounded by Hoadly Road to the northwest, Prince William Parkway to the north, Smoketown Road to the northeast, Gideon Drive to the east, and Cardinal Drive to the south.

Q976183.name: Flower Mound
Q976183.desc: town in Denton County, Texas, United States
Q976183.about: Flower Mound is an incorporated town located in Denton County, with a minor portion in Tarrant County, in the U.S. state of Texas. Located northwest of Dallas and northeast of Fort Worth adjacent to Grapevine Lake, the town derives its name from a prominent 12.5-acre (5.1 ha) mound located in the center of town.

Q976950.name: Rowlett
Q976950.desc: city in Dallas and Rockwall counties in Texas, United States
Q976950.about: Rowlett (, traditionally ) is a city in Dallas and Rockwall Counties in Texas, United States, and an eastern suburb of Dallas. It is a growing, upscale community with nearly $1.5 billion in development in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, located on Lake Ray Hubbard.

Q959.name: Vladivostok
Q959.desc: Russian city and the administrative center of Primorsky Krai
Q959.about: Vladivostok is the largest city and the administrative center of Primorsky Krai and the capital of the Far Eastern Federal District of Russia. It is located around the Golden Horn Bay on the Sea of Japan, covering an area of 331.16 square kilometers (127.86 square miles), with a population of 603,519 residents as of 2021.

Q99648.name: Ibb
Q99648.about: Ibb (Arabic: إِبّ, romanized: ʾIbb) is a city in Yemen, the capital of Ibb Governorate, located about 117 km (73 mi) northeast of Mokha and 194 km (121 mi) south of Sanaa. A market town and administrative centre developed during the Ottoman Empire, it is one of the most important medium-sized cities in the country.

Q910851.name: Rosemead
Q910851.desc: city in Los Angeles County, California, United States
Q910851.about: Rosemead is a city in Los Angeles County, California, United States. The 2020 United States census reported a population of 51,185.

Q983600.name: West Sacramento
Q983600.desc: city in Yolo County, California, United States
Q983600.about: West Sacramento (also known as West Sac) is a city in Yolo County, California, United States. The city is separated from Sacramento by the Sacramento River, which also separates Sacramento and Yolo counties.

Q983609.name: Perris
Q983609.desc: city in Riverside County, Southern California, United States
Q983609.about: Perris is an old railway city in Riverside County, California, United States, located 71 miles (114 km) east-southeast of Los Angeles and 81 miles (130 km) north of San Diego. It is known for Lake Perris, skydiving, the Southern California Railway Museum, and its sunny dry climate.

Q956.name: Beijing
Q956.about: Beijing, previously romanized as Peking, is the capital city of China. With more than 21.8 million residents, it is the world's most populous national capital city, as well as China's second-largest city by urban area, after Shanghai.
Q956.img: Skyline of Beijing CBD with B-5906 approaching (20211016171955).jpg

Q98995.name: Volzhsky
Q98995.about: Volzhsky (Russian: Волжский, IPA: [ˈvoɫʂskʲɪɪ̯]) is an industrial city in Volgograd Oblast, Russia, located on the east bank of the Volga River and its distributary the Akhtuba, 20 kilometers (12 mi) northeast of Volgograd. It is the second-largest city in Volgograd Oblast, after Volgograd.

Q982364.name: Pharr
Q982364.desc: city in Hidalgo County, Texas, United States of America
Q982364.about: Pharr is a city in Hidalgo County, Texas, United States.  As of the 2020 census, the city population was 79,715, and in 2022, the estimated population was 80,187.

Q982421.name: The Woodlands
Q982421.desc: census-designated place in metropolitan Houston, Texas, United States
Q982421.about: The Woodlands is a special-purpose district and census-designated place in the U.S. state of Texas. The Woodlands is primarily located in Montgomery County, with portions extending into Harris County, within the Greater Houston metropolitan area.

Q982550.name: Pearland
Q982550.desc: city in Brazoria, Fort Bend, and Harris counites in Texas, United States
Q982550.about: Pearland ( PEHR-land) is a city in Brazoria County, with portions extending into Fort Bend and Harris Counties, in Texas, United States. The city of Pearland is a principal city within the Houston–Pasadena–The Woodlands metropolitan statistical area.

Q982639.name: League City
Q982639.desc: city in Galveston County, Texas, United States
Q982639.about: League City is a city primarily in Galveston County, Texas, United States. It has a small portion north of Clear Creek within Harris County zoned for residential and commercial uses.

Q983026.name: Chilliwack
Q983026.about: Chilliwack ( CHIL-ə-wak) is a city in the Canadian province of British Columbia. In 2025, the city had an estimated population of 112,500 residents.

Q908.name: Rostov-on-Don
Q908.desc: city and administrative center of Rostov Oblast in southern Russia
Q908.about: Rostov-on-Don, or simply Rostov, is a port city and the administrative centre of Rostov Oblast and the Southern Federal District of Russia. It lies in the southeastern part of the East European Plain on the Don River, 32 kilometers (20 mi) from the Sea of Azov, directly north of the North Caucasus.

Q911.name: Ufa
Q911.desc: capital city of the Republic of Bashkortostan, Russia
Q911.about: Ufa is the capital and largest city of Bashkortostan, Russia. The city lies at the confluence of the Belaya and Ufa rivers, in the centre-north of Bashkortostan, on hills forming the Ufa Plateau to the west of the southern Ural Mountains, with a population of over 1.1 million residents, up to 1.4 million residents in the urban agglomeration.

Q914.name: Volgograd
Q914.desc: city and administrative center of Volgograd Oblast in southern Russia
Q914.about: Volgograd, formerly Tsaritsyn (1589–1925) and Stalingrad (1925–1961), is the administrative centre and largest city of Volgograd Oblast, Russia. The city lies on the western bank of the Volga, covering an area of 859.4 square kilometres (331.8 square miles), with a population of slightly over one million residents.

Q93340.name: Sugar Land
Q93340.desc: city in Fort Bend County, Texas, United States
Q93340.about: Sugar Land is the largest city in Fort Bend County, Texas, United States, located in the southwestern part of the Houston–Pasadena–The Woodlands metropolitan area. Located about 19 miles (31 km) southwest of downtown Houston, Sugar Land is a populous suburban municipality centered around the junction of Texas State Highway 6 and Interstate 69/U.S. Route 59.

Q93910.name: Novokuznetsk
Q93910.about: Novokuznetsk (Russian: Новокузнецк, IPA: [nəvəkʊzˈnʲɛt͡sk] , lit. 'new smith's'; Shor: Аба-тура, romanized: Aba-tura) is a city in Kemerovo Oblast (Kuzbass) in southwestern Siberia, Russia. It is the second-largest city in the oblast, after the administrative center Kemerovo.

Q94274.name: Greeley
Q94274.desc: city in and county seat of Weld County, Colorado, United States
Q94274.about: Greeley is the home rule city that is the county seat of, and the most populous municipality in, Weld County, Colorado United States. The city population was 108,795 at the 2020 United States census, an increase of 17.12% since the 2010 United States census.

Q94663.name: Ionia County
Q94663.about: Ionia County ( eye-OH-nyə) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 census, the population was 66,804.

Q94669.name: Clinton County
Q94669.about: Clinton County is a county in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 United States census, the population was 79,128.

Q976955.name: Skardu
Q976955.about: Skardu (Urdu: سکردو, romanised: skardū, Balti: སྐར་མདོ, pronounced [skərduː]) is a city located in Pakistan-administered Gilgit-Baltistan in the disputed Kashmir region. Skardu serves as the capital of Skardu District and the Baltistan Division.

Q978246.name: Edinburg
Q978246.desc: city in and county seat of Hidalgo County, Texas, United States
Q978246.about: Edinburg ( ED-in-burg) is a city in and the county seat of Hidalgo County, Texas, United States. The population was 100,243 at the 2020 census, and in 2025, its estimated population was 110,700, making it the second-largest city in Hidalgo County, and the third-largest city in the larger Rio Grande Valley region.

Q980040.name: Cedar Park
Q980040.desc: city in Williamson and Travis counties in Texas, United States
Q980040.about: Cedar Park is a city in Williamson County in the U.S. state of Texas, with a small portion extending into Travis County. It is a suburb of Austin, located about 16 miles (26 km) northwest of downtown Austin.

Q980055.name: Missouri City
Q980055.desc: city in Fort Bend and Harris counties, Texas, United States
Q980055.about: Missouri City is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, within the Houston–Pasadena–The Woodlands metropolitan area. The city is mostly in Fort Bend County, with a small portion in Harris County.

Q980396.name: Al Ahmadi
Q980396.about: Al Ahmadi (Arabic: الأحمدي) is an area in Kuwait, and the capital of Al Ahmadi Governorate. It was founded in 1946 with the discovery of oil there.

Q980428.name: North Miami
Q980428.desc: city located in northeast Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States
Q980428.about: North Miami is a suburban city located in northeast Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States, about 10 miles (16 km) north of Miami. The city lies on Biscayne Bay and hosts the Biscayne Bay Campus of Florida International University.

Q981122.name: Montcalm
Q981122.desc: regional county municipality in Lanaudière, Quebec, Canada
Q981122.about: Montcalm (French pronunciation: [mɔ̃kalm]) is a regional county municipality, or RCM, in the Lanaudière region of Quebec, Canada.

Q900.name: Kazan
Q900.desc: city in the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia
Q900.about: Kazan is the capital and largest city of Tatarstan, Russia. The city lies at the confluence of the Volga and the Kazanka rivers, covering an area of 425.3 square kilometres (164.2 square miles), with a population of over 1.3 million residents, and up to nearly 2 million residents in the greater metropolitan area.

Q906.name: Chelyabinsk
Q906.desc: city in Russia, capital city of Chelyabinsk Oblast
Q906.about: Chelyabinsk is the administrative center and largest city of Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russia. It is the seventh-largest city in Russia, with a population of over 1.1 million people, and the second-largest city in the Ural Federal District, after Yekaterinburg.
Q906.img: Views from 360° Ferris Wheel in Chelyabinsk (August 2025) - 0 9.jpg

Q92311.name: Liaoyuan
Q92311.about: Liaoyuan (simplified Chinese: 辽源; traditional Chinese: 遼源; pinyin: Liáoyuán) is a prefecture-level city in Jilin province, People's Republic of China. It is bounded on the west and south by Tieling of Liaoning province, west and north by Siping, and east by Tonghua and Jilin City.

Q92381.name: Baicheng
Q92381.about: Baicheng (Chinese: 白城市; pinyin: Báichéng Shì; lit. 'White City') is a prefecture-level city in the northwestern part of Jilin province, China, bordering Inner Mongolia to the north and west and Heilongjiang to the east and northeast.

Q92561.name: London
Q92561.about: London is a city in Southwestern Ontario, Canada, along the Quebec City–Windsor Corridor. The city had a population of 422,324 according to the 2021 Canadian census.
Q92561.img: London, Ontario, Canada- The Forest City from above.jpg

Q93230.name: Rawalpindi
Q93230.about: Rawalpindi, colloquially known as Pindi, is the third-largest city in the Pakistani province of Punjab and the fourth-most populous city in Pakistan. Located along the Soan River in north-western Punjab, Rawalpindi lies adjacent to Pakistan's capital, Islamabad, and the two are jointly known as the "twin cities".

Q93338.name: Gaziantep
Q93338.about: Gaziantep, historically Aintab and still informally called Antep, is a major city in south-central Turkey. It is the capital of the Gaziantep Province, in the westernmost part of Turkey's Southeastern Anatolia Region and partially in the Mediterranean Region.

Q969300.name: Westland
Q969300.about: Westland is a city in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A western suburb of Detroit, Westland is located about 18 miles (29 km) west of downtown Detroit.

Q970001.name: Marysville
Q970001.about: Marysville is a city in Snohomish County, Washington, United States, part of the Seattle metropolitan area. The city is located 35 miles (56 km) north of Seattle, adjacent to Everett on the north side of the Snohomish River delta.

Q972230.name: Manicouagan
Q972230.desc: regional county municipality in Quebec, Canada
Q972230.about: Manicouagan (French pronunciation: [manikwaɡɑ̃]) is a regional county municipality in the Côte-Nord region of Quebec, Canada. It is located on the north shore of the St.

Q972756.name: Sheikhupura
Q972756.about: Sheikhupura, also known as Qila Sheikhupura (lit. 'Sheikhupura Fort'), is a city in the Pakistani province of Punjab. It was founded by the Mughal emperor Jahangir in 1607 as a citadel, west of Lahore.

Q974040.name: Mansfield
Q974040.desc: city in Texas, USA; suburb of the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex
Q974040.about: Mansfield is a city in the U.S. state of Texas, and a suburb of the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. The city is located mostly in Tarrant County, with small parts in Ellis and Johnson counties.

Q915.name: Perm
Q915.about: Perm, originally known as Yagoshikha (Ягошиха; 1723–1781) and briefly as Molotov (Молотов; 1940–1957), is the administrative centre of Perm Krai in the European part of Russia. It sits on the banks of the Kama River near the Ural Mountains, covering an area of 799.68 square kilometres (308.76 square miles).

Q919.name: Krasnoyarsk
Q919.about: Krasnoyarsk is the largest city and administrative centre of Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia. It is situated along the Yenisey River, and is the second-largest city in Siberia after Novosibirsk, with a population of over 1.1 million.

Q94673.name: Ottawa County
Q94673.about: Ottawa County ( OT-ə-wə) is a county located in the U.S. state of Michigan. As of the 2020 U.S. Census, the population was 296,200.
Q94673.img: Holland Harbor Light (Big Red) - Holland, Michigan.jpg

Q94783.name: Weld County
Q94783.about: Weld County is a county located in the U.S. state of Colorado. As of the 2020 census, the population was 328,981.

Q94919.name: Waukesha
Q94919.desc: city in and county seat of Waukesha County, Wisconsin, United States
Q94919.about: Waukesha (  WAW-ki-shaw) is a city in and the county seat of Waukesha County, Wisconsin, United States. The population was 71,158 at the 2020 census.
Q94919.img: Old Waukesha County Courthouse - corner view 2012.jpg

Q94928.name: Appleton
Q94928.desc: city in and county seat of Outagamie County, Wisconsin, United States
Q94928.about: Appleton (Menominee: Ahkōnemeh) is a city, and the county seat of Outagamie County, Wisconsin, United States, with small portions extending into Calumet and Winnebago counties. Located on the Fox River north of Lake Winnebago, it is 30 miles (48 km) southwest of Green Bay and 100 miles (160 km) north of Milwaukee.

Q95041.name: Naberezhnye Chelny
Q95041.desc: city in the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia
Q95041.about: Naberezhnye Chelny (Russian: На́бережные Челны́, IPA: [ˈnabʲɪrʲɪʐnɨjə tɕɪlˈnɨ] ; Tatar: Яр Чаллы, IPA: [ˈjar ɕɑlːɤ̆]) is the second largest city in the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia. A major industrial center, Naberezhnye Chelny stands on the Kama River 225 kilometers (140 mi) east of Kazan near Nizhnekamsk Reservoir.

Q95449.name: Magnitogorsk
Q95449.about: Magnitogorsk (Russian: Магнитого́рск, pronounced [məɡnʲɪtɐˈɡorsk], lit. '[city] of the magnetic mountain') is an industrial city in Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russia, on the eastern side of the southern Ural Mountains by the Ural River. Its population is currently 410,594 (2021 census).

Q98967.name: Nizhny Tagil
Q98967.about: Nizhny Tagil (Russian: Нижний Тагил, IPA: [ˈnʲiʐnʲɪj tɐˈgʲil]) is a city in Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russia, located 25 kilometers (16 mi) east of the boundary between Asia and Europe.

Q981346.name: Spring
Q981346.desc: census-designated place in Harris County, Texas, United States
Q981346.about: Spring is a census-designated place (CDP) in Harris County, Texas, United States. It lies within the extraterritorial jurisdiction of Houston and is part of the Greater Houston metropolitan area.

Q981771.name: DeSoto
Q981771.desc: city in Dallas County, Texas, United States
Q981771.about: DeSoto is a city in Dallas County, Texas,  United States. DeSoto is a suburb of Dallas and is part of the Best Southwest area, which includes DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, and Lancaster.

Q982054.name: Leander
Q982054.desc: city in Wiliamson Couty, Texas, United States
Q982054.about: Leander ( lee-AN-dər) is a city in Williamson and Travis Counties, Texas, United States. Its population was 59,202 at the 2020 census and 91,132 at the 2025 census estimate.

Q982138.name: Atascocita
Q982138.desc: census designated place in Harris County, Texas, United States
Q982138.about: Atascocita is a census-designated place (CDP) in Harris County, Texas, United States, within the Houston metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census it had a population of 88,174.

Q982353.name: San Marcos
Q982353.desc: city in and county seat of Hays County, Texas, United States, that extends into Caldwell and Guadalupe counties
Q982353.about: San Marcos () is a city in and the county seat of Hays County, Texas, United States. The city is mostly a part of the Greater Austin metropolitan area.

Q975.name: San Antonio
Q975.desc: city in Bexar, Comal, and Medina counties in Texas, United States; seat of Bexar County
Q975.about: San Antonio ( SAN an-TOH-nee-oh; Spanish for "Saint Anthony") is a city in the southern part of the U.S. state of Texas. It is the seventh-most populous city in the United States, the second-most populous city in Texas (after Houston), and the second-most populous city in the Southern U.S., with a population of 1.43 million at the 2020 census.

Q911310.name: Tumkur
Q911310.about: Tumkur, officially Tumakuru, is a city and the headquarters of Tumkur district in Karnataka state, India. It is known for the Siddaganga Matha Lingayat monastery.

Q912253.name: North Bay
Q912253.about: North Bay is a city in Northeastern Ontario, Canada. It is the seat of Nipissing District and takes its name from its position on the shore of Lake Nipissing.

Q913209.name: Kokomo
Q913209.about: Kokomo (  KOH-kə-moh) is a city in and the county seat of Howard County, Indiana, United States. As of the 2020 census, Kokomo had a population of 59,604.

Q913543.name: Watsonville
Q913543.desc: city in Santa Cruz County, California, United States
Q913543.about: Watsonville is a city in Santa Cruz County, California, United States, in the Monterey Bay Area of the Central Coast of California. The population was 52,590 at the 2020 census.
