Q9033543.desc: human settlement in San Diego, California, United States of America
Q9033543.about: Mira Mesa (Spanish for "Table View"), which was established in the late 1960s, is a community and neighborhood in San Diego, California. The city-recognized Mira Mesa Community Plan Area is roughly bounded by Interstate 15 on the east, Interstate 805 on the west, the Los Peñasquitos Canyon on the north and Marine Corps Air Station Miramar on the south.

Q9675019.name: Camama
Q9675019.about: Camama is a commune located in Belas Municipality, the province of Luanda, in Angola.

Q91481098.name: Chugach Census Area
Q91481098.desc: census area in Alaska, United States
Q91481098.about: Chugach Census Area is a census area located in the state of Alaska, United States. It is part of the Unorganized Borough and therefore has no seat of government.

Q91481796.name: Copper River Census Area
Q91481796.desc: census area in Alaska, United States
Q91481796.about: Copper River Census Area is a census area located in the state of Alaska, United States. It is part of the Unorganized Borough and therefore has no borough seat.

Q9022.name: Guadalajara
Q9022.desc: capital of the State of Jalisco, Mexico
Q9022.about: Guadalajara ( GWAH-də-lə-HAR-ə, Spanish: [ɡwaðalaˈxaɾa] ) is the capital and most populous city of the western Mexican state of Jalisco, as well as the most densely populated municipality in Jalisco. According to the 2020 census, the city has a population of 1,385,629 people, making it the 8th most populous city in Mexico, while the Guadalajara metropolitan area has a population of 5,268,642, making it the third-largest metropolitan area in the country and the twenty-second largest metropolitan area in the Americas.

Q927561.name: Nord-du-Québec
Q927561.about:
Nord-du-Québec (French pronunciation: [nɔʁ d͜zy kebɛk]; English: Northern Quebec) is the largest, but the least populous, of the seventeen administrative regions of Quebec, Canada.
Spread over nearly 14 degrees of latitude, north of the 49th parallel, the region covers 860,692 km2 (332,315 sq mi) on the Labrador Peninsula, making it larger than Alberta, and slightly smaller than British Columbia or Ontario.

Q929062.name: Gujrat
Q929062.about: Gujrat (Punjabi: [ɡʊd͡ʒɾaːt̪]) is a city, located along the western bank of the Chenab River, in the northern region of Punjab, Pakistan. It serves as the headquarters of its eponymous district and division.

Q932261.name: Sydney
Q932261.about: Sydney is a former city and urban community on the east coast of Cape Breton Island in Nova Scotia, Canada within the Cape Breton Regional Municipality. Sydney was founded in 1785 by the British, incorporated as a city in 1904, and dissolved on 1 August 1995, when it was amalgamated into the regional municipality.

Q932561.name: Elyria
Q932561.desc: seat of Lorain County, Ohio, United States
Q932561.about: Elyria ( ə-LEER-ee-ə) is a city in Lorain County, Ohio, United States, and its county seat. The city is at the forks of the Black River in Northeast Ohio.

Q932577.name: Largo
Q932577.desc: city in Pinellas County, Florida, United States
Q932577.about: Largo is the third largest city in Pinellas County, Florida, United States, and the fourth largest in the Tampa Bay area. As of the 2020 census, the city had a population of 82,485, up from 77,648 in 2010.

Q932951.name: Kewaunee County
Q932951.about: Kewaunee County is a county located in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 census, the population was 20,563.

Q932966.name: Monroe County
Q932966.about: Monroe County is a county  in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. As of the 2020 census, the population was 46,274.

Q932981.name: Muncie
Q932981.desc: county seat of Delaware County, Indiana, United States
Q932981.about: Muncie ( MUN-see) is a city in Delaware County, Indiana, United States, and its county seat. It is located in East Central Indiana about 50 miles (80 km) northeast of Indianapolis.

Q936510.name: Istaravshan
Q936510.about: Istaravshan (Tajik: Истаравшан; Russian: Истаравшан) is a city in Sughd Region in Tajikistan. In 2000, the Tajik government changed the name of the city from Uroteppa (Tajik: Ӯротеппа; Ura-Tyube, Russian: Ура-Тюбе).

Q986109.name: Manteca
Q986109.desc: city in San Joaquin County, California, United States
Q986109.about: Manteca ( man-TEE-kə; Spanish for "lard”) is a city in San Joaquin County, California. The city had a population of 83,498 as of the 2020 Census.

Q986328.name: Near North Side
Q986328.desc: community area in Chicago, Illinois, United States
Q986328.about: The Near North Side is one of the 77 community areas of Chicago in Illinois, United States. It is the northernmost of the three areas that constitute central Chicago, the others being the Loop and the Near South Side.

Q986329.name: Jupiter
Q986329.desc: town located in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q986329.about: Jupiter is the northernmost town in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States. Located along the Atlantic coast of South Florida at the mouth of the Loxahatchee River, the town is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the east, Martin County and the village of Tequesta to the north, unincorporated Palm Beach County to the west, and Juno Beach to the south.

Q986369.name: Jacksonville
Q986369.desc: city in Onslow County, North Carolina, United States
Q986369.about: Jacksonville is the county seat of and the most populous community in Onslow County, North Carolina, which is coterminous with the Jacksonville, NC Metropolitan Statistical Area. As of the 2020 census, the population was 72,723, which makes Jacksonville the 14th-most populous city in North Carolina.

Q986528.name: Buckeye
Q986528.desc: city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States
Q986528.about: Buckeye  is a city in Maricopa County, Arizona, United States. It is Arizona's second-largest city by area, and it is the westernmost suburb in the Phoenix Metropolitan Area.

Q986627.name: Shawnee
Q986627.desc: city in Johnson County, Kansas, United States
Q986627.about: Shawnee  shaw-NEE is a city in Johnson County, Kansas, United States.  It is the seventh-most populous municipality in the Kansas City metropolitan area.

Q986803.name: Miri
Q986803.about: Miri () is a coastal city in north-eastern Sarawak, Malaysia, located near the border of Brunei, on the island of Borneo. The city covers an area of 997.43 square kilometres (385.11 sq mi), located 798 kilometres (496 mi) northeast of Kuching and 329 kilometres (204 mi) southwest of Kota Kinabalu.

Q986928.name: Rancho Cordova
Q986928.desc: city in Sacramento County, California, United States
Q986928.about: Rancho Cordova is a city in Sacramento County, California, United States. Incorporated in 2003, it is part of the Sacramento Metropolitan Area.

Q988065.name: Spokane Valley
Q988065.desc: city in Washington, United States of America
Q988065.about: Spokane Valley is a city in Spokane County, Washington, United States, and the largest suburb of Spokane. It is located east of Spokane, west of Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, and surrounds the city of Millwood on three sides.

Q988136.name: Taylor
Q988136.about: Taylor is a city in Wayne County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A Downriver suburb of Detroit, Taylor is located roughly 16 miles (25.7 km) southwest of downtown Detroit.

Q9310.name: Dili
Q9310.about: Dili (Portuguese: Díli) is the capital and largest city of Timor-Leste. It lies on the northern coast of the island of Timor, in a small area of flat land hemmed in by mountains.

Q9326.name: Vientiane
Q9326.about: Vientiane is the capital and largest city of Laos. Comprising the 5 urban districts of Vientiane Prefecture, the city is located on the banks of the Mekong, close to the border with Thailand.

Q9347.name: Malé
Q9347.about: Malé is the capital and most populous city of the Maldives. With a population of 211,908 in 2022 within its administrative area and coterminous geographical area of 1.9 square kilometres (0.73 sq mi), Malé is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.

Q9361.name: Bishkek
Q9361.about: Bishkek, formerly known as Pishpek (until 1926), and then Frunze (1926–1991), is the capital and largest city of Kyrgyzstan, and the capital of the Chüy Region. It is situated near the border with Kazakhstan and has a population of around 1,200,000 people as of 2024.

Q937673.name: Northumberland County
Q937673.about: Northumberland County is located in northeastern New Brunswick, Canada.

Q938835.name: Guadalupe
Q938835.desc: municipal seat of Guadalupe, State of Nuevo León, Mexico
Q938835.about: Guadalupe is a city and surrounding municipality located in the state of Nuevo León, which is located in northern Mexico. It is part of the Greater Monterrey Metropolitan area.

Q939127.name: St. Albert
Q939127.about: St. Albert is a suburban city in Alberta, Canada, next to the Sturgeon River, northwest of the City of Edmonton, the provincial capital.

Q939738.name: Sungai Petani
Q939738.desc: town in Kuala Muda, Kedah, Malaysia

Q943772.name: Chowan County
Q943772.desc: county in North Carolina, United States
Q943772.about: Chowan County ( choh-WON) is one of the 100 counties located in the U.S. state of North Carolina. As of the 2020 census, the population was 13,708.

Q988906.name: Coconut Creek
Q988906.desc: city in Broward County, Florida, United States
Q988906.about: Coconut Creek is a city in Broward County, Florida, United States. Situated 37 miles (60 km) north of Miami, it had an estimated population of 57,348 in 2022.

Q989283.name: Kasur
Q989283.about: Kasur (Punjabi / Urdu: قصور; Punjabi pronunciation: [ˈkɐsuːɾᵊ]; Urdu pronunciation: [ˈqəsuːɾ] also romanized as Qasūr; from pluralized Arabic word Qasr meaning "palaces" or "forts") is a city to the south of Lahore, in the Pakistani province of Punjab. The city serves as the headquarters of Kasur District.

Q989297.name: Rahim Yar Khan
Q989297.desc: city in Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan
Q989297.about: Rahim Yar Khan (Urdu: رحیم یار خان, romanized: Rahīm Yār Khān; Urdu pronunciation: [ɾəɦiːm jɑːɾ xɑːn]) is a city in the Punjab, Pakistan. It is the 21st most populous city in Pakistan and is the capital of the Rahim Yar Khan District.

Q989468.name: Margate
Q989468.desc: city in Broward County, Florida, United States
Q989468.about: Margate is a city in Broward County, Florida, United States. The city of Margate is part of the Miami metropolitan area.

Q9824.name: Erode
Q9824.desc: Village in Erode District, Tamil Nadu, India
Q9824.about: Erode (Tamil: [iːɾoːɽɯ]; īrōṭu), is a city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the banks of the Kaveri river and is surrounded by the Western Ghats.

Q9863.name: Salem
Q9863.about: Salem (pronounced [seːlam] ) is a  city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the banks of the Thirumanimutharu River and surrounded by the Eastern Ghats.

Q9885.name: Coimbatore
Q9885.about: Coimbatore (Tamil: Kōyamputtūr, IPA: [koːjɐmbut̪ːuːɾ] ), also known as Kovai (IPA: [koːʋaj] ), is a metropolitan city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is located on the banks of the Noyyal River and surrounded by the Western Ghats.
Q9885.img: Panoramic View of Coimbatore from Atop Marudhamalai Temple.jpg

Q943775.name: Gastonia
Q943775.desc: city in North Carolina, United States
Q943775.about: Gastonia is a city in and the county seat of Gaston County, North Carolina, United States. The most populous city in the county and the 13th-most populous city in North Carolina, the population was 80,411 at the 2020 census.

Q943829.name: Rainy River District
Q943829.about: Rainy River District is a district and census division in Northwestern Ontario in the Canadian province of Ontario. It was created in 1885.

Q944697.name: Loja
Q944697.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the Loja Province
Q944697.about: Loja (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈlo.xa]), formerly Loxa and fully City of the Immaculate Conception of Loja (Spanish: Ciudad de la Inmaculada Concepción de Loja), is the capital of Ecuador's Loja Province. It is located in the Cuxibamba valley in the south of the country, sharing borders with the provinces of Zamora-Chinchipe and other cantons of the province of Loja.

Q945201.name: Regional District of Central Okanagan
Q945201.about: The Regional District of Central Okanagan (RDCO) is a regional district in the Canadian province of British Columbia, representing two unincorporated Electoral Areas of Central Okanagan East and Central Okanagan West, along with the member municipalities of the City of Kelowna, City of West Kelowna, the District of Lake Country, the District of Peachland, and Westbank First Nation. The RDCO office is located in Kelowna.

Q948050.name: Seeb
Q948050.about: Al-Seeb, alternatively known as As Seeb, As Sib, or Seeb (Arabic: ٱلسِّيْب, romanized: As-Sīb) is a coastal fishing province, located several kilometres northwest of Muscat, in northeastern Oman. At the 2020 census, it had a population of 470,878.

Q948071.name: La Habra
Q948071.desc: city in Orange County, California, United States
Q948071.about: La Habra (luh HAH-bruh; archaic spelling of la abra, Spanish for 'the opening') is a city in the northwestern corner of Orange County, California, United States. In the 2020 census, the city had a population of 63,097.
Q948071.img: La Habra Circle Shopping Center, La Habra, California (2021-06-25).jpeg

Q948086.name: Laguna Niguel
Q948086.desc: city in Orange County, California, United States
Q948086.about: Laguna Niguel ( luh-GOO-nuh nih-GEL) is a city in Orange County, California, United States. The name Laguna Niguel is derived from the words "Laguna" (Spanish for "lagoon") and "Niguili" (the name of a Native American village once located near Aliso Creek).

Q948102.name: Lake Elsinore
Q948102.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q948102.about: Lake Elsinore is a city in the Inland Empire region of western Riverside County, California, United States. Established as a city in 1888, it is on the shore of Lake Elsinore, a natural freshwater lake about 3,000 acres (1,200 ha) in size.

Q989903.name: Grand Junction
Q989903.desc: city in and county seat of Mesa County, Colorado, United States
Q989903.about: Grand Junction is a home rule municipality that is the county seat of and the largest city in Mesa County, Colorado, United States. Grand Junction's population was 65,560 at the 2020 United States census, making it the most populous city in western Colorado and the 17th most populous Colorado municipality overall.

Q989919.name: Farmington Hills
Q989919.desc: city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q989919.about: Farmington Hills is a city in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A northwestern suburb of Detroit, Farmington Hills is located roughly 22 miles (35.4 km) from downtown Detroit.

Q990001.name: Heroica Nogales
Q990001.desc: municipal seat of Nogales, State of Sonora, Mexico
Q990001.about: Nogales, also known formally as Heroica Nogales (Spanish pronunciation: [eˈɾojka noˈɣales]), is a city in the Mexican state of Sonora. It is located in the north of the state on the U.S. border, and is abutted on its north by the city of Nogales, Arizona.

Q990271.name: Troy
Q990271.desc: city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q990271.about: Troy is a city in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A northern suburb of Detroit, Troy is located about 15 miles (24 km) north of downtown Detroit.

Q990644.name: Weston
Q990644.desc: city in Broward County, Florida, United States
Q990644.about: Weston is a master-planned city in Broward County, Florida, United States. The population was 68,107 at the time of the 2020 census.

Q990716.name: Portoviejo
Q990716.desc: city in Ecuador, capital of the Manabí Province
Q990716.about: Portoviejo (Spanish pronunciation: [poɾtoˈβjexo]), also known as San Gregorio de Portoviejo, is a city in Ecuador, and the capital of the Province of Manabí, located  about 30 km (19 mi) from the Pacific coast. It is still known as the city of the "Royal Tamarind Trees" due to the former Tamarind plantations in the area.

Q990738.name: Manta
Q990738.about: Manta, also known as San Pablo de Manta, is a city in Ecuador, cantonal head of the Manta Canton, as well as the largest and most populated city in the Manabí Province. It is the seventh most populous in the country.

Q990898.name: Georgetown
Q990898.desc: city in and county seat of Williamson County, Texas, United States
Q990898.about: Georgetown is a city in Texas and the county seat of Williamson County, Texas, United States. The population was 67,176 at the 2020 census, and according to 2025 census estimates, the city is estimated to have a population of 106,907.

Q991279.name: Brownsville
Q991279.desc: residential neighborhood located in eastern Brooklyn, New York City, USA
Q991279.about: Brownsville is a residential neighborhood in eastern Brooklyn in New York City. The neighborhood is bordered by Crown Heights to the northwest; Bedford–Stuyvesant and the subsection of Ocean Hill to the north; East New York to the east; Canarsie to the south; and East Flatbush to the west.

Q991464.name: Kenner
Q991464.desc: suburb city of New Orleans, located in Jefferson Parish, Louisiana, United States
Q991464.about: Kenner is a city in the U.S. state of Louisiana. It is the most populous city in Jefferson Parish, and is the largest incorporated suburb of New Orleans.

Q994159.name: Palm Beach Gardens
Q994159.desc: city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q994159.about: Palm Beach Gardens is a city in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States, approximately 80 miles (130 km) north of Miami. Palm Beach Gardens is a principal city of the Miami metropolitan area.
Q994159.img: Cathedral of Saint Ignatius Loyola - Palm Beach Gardens 02.JPG

Q9080055.name: Stratford
Q9080055.desc: census designated place in Connecticut, United States

Q948129.name: Westminster
Q948129.desc: city in Adams and Jefferson counties in Colorado, United States
Q948129.about: Westminster is a home rule city located in Adams and Jefferson counties, Colorado, United States. The city population was 116,317 at the 2020 United States census with 71,240 residing in Adams County and 45,077 residing in Jefferson County.

Q948188.name: Hemet
Q948188.desc: city in Riverside County, California, United States
Q948188.about: Hemet is a city in the San Jacinto Valley in Riverside County, California, United States. It covers a total area of 29.3 square miles (76 km2), about half of the valley, which it shares with the neighboring city of San Jacinto.

Q948231.name: Aliso Viejo
Q948231.desc: city in Orange County, California, United States
Q948231.about: Aliso Viejo (uh-LEE-so vee-AY-ho; Spanish for "old alder tree") is a city in the San Joaquin Hills of southern Orange County, California. It had a population of 52,176 as of the 2020 census, up from 47,823 as of the 2010 census.
Q948231.img: Aliso Niguel High School and Chet Holifield Federal Building from Hillview Park.jpg

Q949746.name: Cox's Bazar
Q949746.about: Cox's Bazar is a city, fishing port, tourism centre, and the headquarters of the Cox's Bazar District and Cox's Bazar Sadar Upazila in south-eastern Bangladesh. The city has a population of about 196,000.

Q949766.name: Pickens County
Q949766.about: Pickens County is a county located on the west central border of the U.S. state of Alabama. As of the 2020 census, the population was 19,123.

Q949779.name: Melbourne
Q949779.desc: city in Brevard County, Florida, United States of America
Q949779.about: Melbourne (MEL-burn) is a city in Brevard County, Florida, United States. It is located 72 miles (116 km) southeast of Orlando along Florida's Space Coast, so named because of the region's proximity to Cape Canaveral and the Kennedy Space Center.

Q950205.name: West New York
Q950205.desc: town in Hudson County, New Jersey, United States
Q950205.about: West New York is a town in the northern part of Hudson County, in the U.S. state of New Jersey, situated upon the New Jersey Palisades. As of the 2020 United States census, the town's population was 52,912, an increase of 3,204 (+6.4%) from the 2010 census count of 49,708, which in turn reflected an increase of 3,940 (+8.6%) from the 45,768 counted in the 2000 census.

Q950944.name: Yongji
Q950944.about:
Yongji (simplified Chinese: 永济; traditional Chinese: 永濟; pinyin: Yǒngjì) is a county-level city in the prefecture-level city of Yuncheng, in the southwest of Shanxi province, China, bordering Shaanxi province to the west.
According to a census in 2011, the population in Yongji was 446,000.

Q991601.name: Bruce County
Q991601.about: Bruce County is a county in Southwestern Ontario, Canada. It has eight lower-tier municipalities with a total 2021 population of 73,396.

Q992507.name: Spring Valley
Q992507.desc: census-designated place in Clark County, Nevada, United States
Q992507.about: Spring Valley is an unincorporated town and census-designated place in Clark County, Nevada, United States, located 2 miles (3 km) west of the Las Vegas Strip. The population was 215,597 at the 2020 census.

Q992536.name: Lenexa
Q992536.desc: city in Johnson County, Kansas, United States
Q992536.about: Lenexa  is a city in Johnson County, Kansas, United States, and part of the Kansas City metropolitan area.  As of the 2020 census, the population of the city was 57,434.

Q992652.name: Wellington
Q992652.desc: village in Palm Beach County, Florida, United States
Q992652.about: Wellington is a village in Palm Beach County and 66 mi (106 km) north of Miami. It is part of the Miami metropolitan area and the fifth largest municipality in Palm Beach County by population.

Q993444.name: Rochester Hills
Q993444.desc: city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q993444.about: Rochester Hills is a city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States. A northern suburb of Detroit, Rochester Hills is located about 25 miles (40 km) north of downtown Detroit.

Q993575.name: Novi
Q993575.desc: city in Oakland County, Michigan, United States
Q993575.about: Novi (  NOH-vy) is a city in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. A northwestern suburb of Detroit, Novi is located roughly 25 miles (40.2 km) northwest of downtown Detroit.

Q993721.name: Germiston
Q993721.about: Germiston, also known as kwaDukathole, is a city in the East Rand region of Gauteng, South Africa, administratively forming part of the City of Ekurhuleni Metropolitan Municipality since the latter's establishment in 2000. It functions as the municipal seat of Ekurhuleni, hosting the municipal council and administration.

Q993749.name: Sunrise Manor
Q993749.desc: census designated place in Clark County, Nevada, United States
Q993749.about: Sunrise Manor is a census-designated place in Clark County, Nevada, United States, located on the western base of Frenchman Mountain, east of Las Vegas. The population was 205,618 at the 2020 census.

Q994452.name: Commerce City
Q994452.desc: city in Adams County, Colorado, United States
Q994452.about: Commerce City is a home rule city located in Adams County, Colorado, United States. The city population was 62,418 at the 2020 United States census, a 35.95% increase since the 2010 United States census.

Q994457.name: Castle Rock
Q994457.desc: town in and seat of Douglas County, Colorado, United States
Q994457.about: Castle Rock is a home rule town that is the county seat of and the most-populous municipality in Douglas County, Colorado, United States. The town's population was 73,158 at the 2020 census, a 51.68% increase since the 2010 census.

Q994514.name: Rangpur
Q994514.about:
Rangpur (; Bengali: রংপুর, romanized: Rongpur;
pronounced [rɔŋpuɾ] ) is a major metropolitan city in Bangladesh. This city serves as the administrative center of the Rangpur Division.

Q994867.name: Azcapotzalco
Q994867.about: Azcapotzalco (Classical Nahuatl: Āzcapōtzalco [aːskapoːˈt͡saɬko] ; Spanish pronunciation: [askapoˈtsalko] ; from āzcapōtzalli "anthill" + -co "place"; literally, "In the place of the anthills") is a borough (demarcación territorial) in Mexico City. Azcapotzalco is in the northwestern part of Mexico City.

Q995163.name: Tawau
Q995163.desc: A town, division and district in Sabah, Malaysia
Q995163.about: Tawau (Malaysian: [ˈta wau]) is the capital of the Tawau District in Sabah, Malaysia. It is the third-largest city (or town) in Sabah, after Kota Kinabalu and Sandakan.

Q995793.name: Mount Prospect
Q995793.desc: village in Elk Grove and Wheeling Townships in Cook County, Illinois, United States
Q995793.about: Mount Prospect is a village in Cook County, Illinois, United States. It is part of Elk Grove and Wheeling townships, about 20 miles (32 km) northwest of downtown Chicago and approximately 4 miles (6.4 km) north of O'Hare International Airport.

Q997084.name: Turmero
Q997084.about: Turmero is a city in the state of Aragua in northern Venezuela. It is the capital of Santiago Mariño Municipality.

Q997132.name: Arlington Heights
Q997132.desc: village in Cook County, Illinois, United States; suburb of Chicago, Illinois
Q997132.about: Arlington Heights is a village in Cook County, Illinois, United States. A northwestern suburb of Chicago, it lies about 25 miles (40 km) northwest of the city's downtown.
Q997132.img: Banta, Nathaniel Moore House (Arlington Heights, IL) 02.JPG
